1904.04821|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测中所有样本被平等对待导致mAP次优的问题，重新审视了不同样本对整体性能的贡献。作者提出了Prime Samples的概念，并设计了Prime Sample Attention (PISA)采样与学习策略，将训练重点放在这些关键样本上。在MSCOCO数据集上，PISA在单阶段和两阶段检测器上均比随机采样及OHEM、Focal Loss等难例挖掘方法稳定提升约2% mAP，即使使用ResNeXt-101骨干网络。
1904.04821|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits the common paradigm of treating all samples equally in object detection and identifies that samples are neither independent nor equally important for mAP. It proposes Prime Samples and a PrIme Sample Attention (PISA) strategy to focus training on these key samples. On MSCOCO, PISA consistently improves mAP by around 2% over random sampling and hard mining schemes (OHEM, Focal Loss) on both single-stage and two-stage detectors, even with a strong ResNeXt-101 backbone.
1904.04821|v2.assessment: 该工作对检测中的采样策略进行了深入分析，提出的PISA简单有效，能稳定提升主流检测器性能，具有较高的实用价值和启发性。
1904.04821|v2.contribution: 提出了Prime Samples概念及PISA采样与学习策略，显著提升了目标检测性能。
1904.04821|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析了样本重要性对mAP的影响，并设计了针对关键样本的注意力机制。
1904.04821|v2.result: 在MSCOCO上，PISA比随机采样和难例挖掘方法稳定提升约2% mAP。

2003.12063|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频目标检测中单帧质量退化导致遮挡物体难以识别的问题，提出人类识别视频物体依赖全局语义和局部定位两种线索。作者设计了Memory Enhanced Global-Local Aggregation (MEGA)网络，首次同时充分利用全局和局部信息，并引入长程记忆(Long Range Memory, LRM)模块，使关键帧能访问比以往方法更多的内容。在ImageNet VID数据集上取得了当时的最优性能。
2003.12063|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses video object detection where degraded single-frame quality hinders occluded object recognition, arguing that humans rely on both global semantic and local localization cues. It proposes the Memory Enhanced Global-Local Aggregation (MEGA) network, which for the first time fully considers both global and local information, and introduces a Long Range Memory (LRM) module enabling key frames to access much more content than previous methods. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet VID.
2003.12063|v2.assessment: MEGA通过结合全局与局部信息并引入长程记忆，有效提升了视频目标检测性能，其设计思路对视频理解任务有较好的借鉴意义。
2003.12063|v2.contribution: 提出了MEGA网络，同时聚合全局语义和局部定位信息，并引入LRM模块增强关键帧特征。
2003.12063|v2.innovation: 首次在视频目标检测中同时利用全局和局部信息，并通过长程记忆扩展了关键帧的信息访问范围。
2003.12063|v2.result: 在ImageNet VID数据集上取得了当时的最优性能。

2001.03398|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于图像的3D目标检测与LiDAR方法之间存在较大性能差距的问题，提出了Deep Stereo Geometry Network (DSGN)。该方法在可微的3D几何体积(3D geometric volume)上检测3D物体，该体积有效编码了3D规则空间的几何结构，并同时学习深度信息和语义线索。这是首个简单有效的单阶段立体3D检测流程，以端到端方式联合估计深度和检测3D物体。在KITTI 3D目标检测基准上，DSGN比之前基于立体的3D检测器AP高出约10，甚至与部分LiDAR方法性能相当。
2001.03398|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the large performance gap between image-based and LiDAR-based 3D object detection by proposing Deep Stereo Geometry Network (DSGN). It detects 3D objects on a differentiable 3D geometric volume that encodes 3D geometric structure, jointly learning depth and semantic cues. It provides the first simple and effective one-stage stereo-based 3D detection pipeline that jointly estimates depth and detects 3D objects end-to-end. On KITTI, DSGN outperforms previous stereo-based detectors by about 10 AP and achieves comparable performance to several LiDAR-based methods.
2001.03398|v2.assessment: DSGN通过可微3D几何体积显著缩小了立体与LiDAR方法在3D检测上的差距，其单阶段端到端设计简洁高效，对自动驾驶感知研究具有重要参考价值。
2001.03398|v2.contribution: 提出了DSGN，一种基于可微3D几何体积的单阶段立体3D检测网络，联合估计深度和检测3D物体。
2001.03398|v2.innovation: 首次在可微3D几何体积上进行立体3D检测，实现了端到端的深度与3D物体联合学习。
2001.03398|v2.result: 在KITTI上比之前立体方法AP高约10，与部分LiDAR方法性能相当。

2006.12884|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对弱监督目标检测(WSOD)中基于多实例学习(MIL)的方法倾向于定位判别性部分而非完整物体的问题，提出了空间似然投票(Spatial Likelihood Voting, SLV)模块。在训练中，所有区域提议作为投票者，在空间维度上为每个类别的似然投票，经过对大似然值区域的膨胀对齐后，投票结果被正则化为边界框，用于最终分类和定位。基于SLV，作者进一步提出了端到端多任务学习框架，分类和定位任务相互促进。在PASCAL VOC 2007和2012数据集上取得了优越性能。
2006.12884|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue in weakly supervised object detection (WSOD) where MIL-based methods tend to localize discriminative parts instead of whole objects. It proposes a Spatial Likelihood Voting (SLV) module where all region proposals act as voters to vote for the likelihood of each category in spatial dimensions, and the voting results are regularized into bounding boxes for final classification and localization. An end-to-end multi-task learning framework is further proposed, with classification and localization mutually promoting each other. Extensive experiments on PASCAL VOC 2007 and 2012 demonstrate superior performance.
2006.12884|v2.assessment: SLV通过空间投票机制有效缓解了弱监督检测中的部分定位问题，其多任务框架设计合理，对弱监督学习领域有一定贡献。
2006.12884|v2.contribution: 提出了SLV模块及端到端多任务学习框架，改善了弱监督目标检测的定位完整性。
2006.12884|v2.innovation: 利用区域提议作为投票者在空间维度上投票，并将投票结果正则化为边界框。
2006.12884|v2.result: 在PASCAL VOC 2007和2012上取得了优越性能。

1912.01106|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对移动设备上目标检测架构设计大多依赖手工、现有自动化搜索未考虑设备延迟的问题，提出了MnasFPN，一种面向移动端的检测头搜索空间，并结合延迟感知架构搜索生成高效检测模型。学习到的MnasFPN头与MobileNetV2主干结合，在Pixel上相似延迟下比MobileNetV3+SSDLite高1.8 mAP，比NAS-FPNLite高1.0 mAP且快10%。消融实验表明大部分性能提升来自搜索空间的创新，并揭示了搜索空间设计与搜索算法之间的耦合关系。
1912.01106|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that on-device object detection architectures are mostly manually designed and existing automated searches are either not mobile-friendly or not guided by on-device latency. It proposes MnasFPN, a mobile-friendly search space for the detection head, combined with latency-aware architecture search. The learned MnasFPN head with MobileNetV2 body outperforms MobileNetV3+SSDLite by 1.8 mAP at similar latency on Pixel, and is 1.0 mAP more accurate and 10% faster than NAS-FPNLite. Ablation studies show most gains come from search space innovations and reveal a coupling between search space and algorithm.
1912.01106|v2.assessment: MnasFPN通过延迟感知的架构搜索为移动端目标检测提供了高效方案，其搜索空间设计具有创新性，对移动端视觉研究有较高实用价值。
1912.01106|v2.contribution: 提出了移动友好的MnasFPN检测头搜索空间，并结合延迟感知搜索生成高效检测模型。
1912.01106|v2.innovation: 设计了面向移动端的检测头搜索空间，并揭示了搜索空间与搜索算法的耦合关系。
1912.01106|v2.result: 在Pixel上相似延迟下比MobileNetV3+SSDLite高1.8 mAP，比NAS-FPNLite高1.0 mAP且快10%。

A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.summary_cn: 针对点云3D目标检测中现有方法难以有效建模物体间结构化关系的问题，本文提出了一种层次化图网络（Hierarchical Graph Network）。该方法在点云上构建多层级图结构，通过图卷积聚合局部几何与全局语义信息，从而增强目标特征表达。相比已有基于体素或点的方法，其改进在于显式建模点、部件与物体之间的层次关系。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法在点云检测框架中具有一定通用性。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of modeling structured inter-object relationships in point cloud 3D detection by proposing a Hierarchical Graph Network. The method constructs multi-level graph structures over point clouds and aggregates local geometric and global semantic cues via graph convolutions. It improves over voxel- or point-based baselines by explicitly encoding hierarchical relations among points, parts, and objects. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.assessment: 将图网络引入点云3D检测的思路有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其在大规模基准上的验证。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.contribution: 提出层次化图网络以建模点云中多层级结构关系用于3D目标检测。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.innovation: 利用层次图结构显式编码点-部件-物体的关系以增强特征表达。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje._arxiv_id: A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Object Detection on Point Clouds.

2003.00504|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中遮挡样本因信息缺失而检测困难的问题，本文提出MonoPair，通过建模相邻物体对之间的空间关系来提升检测性能。方法对相邻物体对的位置与3D距离进行不确定性感知预测，并用非线性最小二乘联合优化，同时将单阶段预测结构与后优化模块集成以保证实时性。在KITTI 3D检测基准上取得当时最优性能，尤其在困难样本上大幅领先已有方法。
2003.00504|v2.summary_en: To address the difficulty of detecting occluded objects in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes MonoPair, which models pairwise spatial relationships between adjacent objects. It performs uncertainty-aware prediction of object locations and 3D distances for adjacent pairs, jointly optimized via nonlinear least squares, with a one-stage structure integrated with a post-optimization module for runtime efficiency. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on the KITTI 3D benchmark, with large margins especially on hard samples.
2003.00504|v2.assessment: 利用成对空间约束解决遮挡问题是单目3D检测中实用且有效的思路，KITTI上的显著提升值得关注。
2003.00504|v2.contribution: 提出基于成对空间关系与不确定性联合优化的单目3D检测器MonoPair。
2003.00504|v2.innovation: 通过相邻物体对的空间约束与非线性最小二乘后优化提升遮挡样本检测。
2003.00504|v2.result: 在KITTI 3D检测基准上取得最优性能，困难样本上大幅领先。

1912.04799|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测缺乏准确深度信息、传统2D卷积难以捕捉物体局部与尺度信息的问题，本文提出深度引导的动态深度可分离空洞局部卷积网络D4LCN。该方法不再依赖伪LiDAR表示，而是让卷积核及其感受野从图像深度图中自动学习，使不同图像的不同像素拥有不同滤波器。D4LCN克服了2D卷积的局限，缩小了图像表示与3D点云表示之间的差距，在单目3D检测上取得显著提升。
1912.04799|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of accurate depth and the inability of conventional 2D convolutions to capture local object and scale information in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes D4LCN, a depth-guided dynamic-depthwise-dilated local convolutional network. Instead of pseudo-LiDAR, it learns filters and receptive fields from image-based depth maps, enabling pixel-specific filters. D4LCN narrows the gap between image and point cloud representations and achieves substantial improvements in monocular 3D detection.
1912.04799|v2.assessment: 从卷积算子层面改造以适配单目3D检测，思路新颖且与伪LiDAR路线形成互补，值得关注。
1912.04799|v2.contribution: 提出深度引导的动态局部卷积D4LCN用于单目3D目标检测。
1912.04799|v2.innovation: 让卷积核与感受野由深度图自动学习，实现像素级自适应滤波。
1912.04799|v2.result: 大量实验表明D4LCN显著提升单目3D检测性能。

2003.09119|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于关键点的检测器中角点误匹配普遍存在、严重影响性能的问题，本文提出CentripetalNet，利用向心偏移将同一实例的角点配对。方法预测角点位置与向心偏移，匹配偏移后对齐的角点，并结合位置信息实现比传统嵌入方法更准确的配对；同时设计十字星可变形卷积进行特征自适应。在MS-COCO test-dev上以48.0% AP超越所有无锚框检测器，并附加掩码预测模块达到40.2% MaskAP。
2003.09119|v2.summary_en: To address the widespread incorrect keypoint matching in keypoint-based detectors, this paper proposes CentripetalNet, which pairs corner keypoints of the same instance using centripetal shift. It predicts corner positions and centripetal shifts, matching corners whose shifted results align, achieving more accurate pairing than embedding-based approaches, and introduces a cross-star deformable convolution for feature adaptation. On MS-COCO test-dev, it achieves 48.0% AP, outperforming all anchor-free detectors, and 40.2% MaskAP with an added mask module.
2003.09119|v2.assessment: 角点配对是anchor-free检测的关键瓶颈，向心偏移方案简洁有效，COCO上的结果具有说服力。
2003.09119|v2.contribution: 提出基于向心偏移的角点配对方法CentripetalNet用于无锚框目标检测与实例分割。
2003.09119|v2.innovation: 利用向心偏移对齐角点实现更准确的实例配对，并设计十字星可变形卷积。
2003.09119|v2.result: MS-COCO test-dev上达48.0% AP与40.2% MaskAP，超越所有无锚框检测器。

2006.04356|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中因空间遮挡和点密度随距离变化导致同一物体外观差异大、特征鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出Associate-3Ddet，采用类域自适应方法增强特征表示鲁棒性。方法在来自真实场景的感知域与来自无遮挡增强场景的概念域之间建立桥接，模拟人脑物体感知机制。大量实验表明该简单有效的方法显著提升3D点云检测性能并达到当时最优结果。
2006.04356|v2.summary_en: To address the large appearance variation of the same object in point clouds caused by spatial occlusion and distance-dependent point density, this paper proposes Associate-3Ddet, a domain-adaptation-like approach that enhances feature robustness. It bridges the perceptual domain from real scenes and the conceptual domain from augmented non-occluded point clouds, mimicking human object perception. Extensive experiments show it substantially boosts 3D point cloud detection and achieves state-of-the-art results.
2006.04356|v2.assessment: 将域自适应思想引入点云检测以应对遮挡与密度变化，视角独特且实验验证充分。
2006.04356|v2.contribution: 提出感知域到概念域关联的Associate-3Ddet用于鲁棒的点云3D目标检测。
2006.04356|v2.innovation: 以类域自适应方式桥接真实与增强无遮挡点云的特征表示。
2006.04356|v2.result: 显著提升3D点云检测性能并达到当时最优结果。

1908.01998|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统目标检测需要大量标注数据、难以检测未见类别的问题，本文提出一种少样本目标检测网络，仅需少量标注样本即可检测新类别。核心包括Attention-RPN、Multi-Relation Detector与对比训练策略，利用支持集与查询集的相似性检测新物体并抑制背景误检；同时贡献了一个包含1000类高质量标注的少样本检测数据集。训练后无需微调即可检测未见类别，在多个数据集上取得少样本设定下的最优性能。
1908.01998|v2.summary_en: To address the heavy annotation requirement of conventional object detection and the difficulty of detecting unseen categories, this paper proposes a few-shot object detection network that detects novel objects with only a few annotated examples. It features an Attention-RPN, a Multi-Relation Detector, and a contrastive training strategy exploiting support-query similarity while suppressing background false detections, and contributes a 1000-category dataset for few-shot detection. Once trained, it detects unseen categories without fine-tuning, achieving state-of-the-art few-shot performance on multiple datasets.
1908.01998|v2.assessment: 少样本检测的实用价值高，注意力RPN与多关系检测器设计合理，配套数据集对社区有贡献。
1908.01998|v2.contribution: 提出结合Attention-RPN与Multi-Relation Detector的少样本目标检测网络及配套数据集。
1908.01998|v2.innovation: 利用支持-查询相似性与对比训练实现无需微调的未见类别检测。
1908.01998|v2.result: 在多个数据集少样本设定下取得最优性能。

2004.08515|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 RGB-D 显著物体检测中 RGB 与深度信息被独立处理、易受训练数据量限制和复杂训练流程约束的问题，提出 JL-DCF 联合学习与密集协作融合框架。方法采用 Siamese 网络同时学习 RGB 和深度输入，包含联合学习（JL）模块进行鲁棒显著性特征学习，以及密集协作融合（DCF）模块发现互补特征。在六个挑战性数据集上，JL-DCF 相比当时最优的 D3Net 在 S-measure 上平均提升约 1.9%，展现出较好的泛化能力。
2004.08515|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles RGB-D salient object detection where RGB and depth are typically processed independently, leading to data-hungry and training-sensitive pipelines. It proposes JL-DCF, a Siamese joint learning and densely-cooperative fusion framework with a JL module for robust saliency feature learning and a DCF module for complementary feature discovery. Across six challenging datasets, JL-DCF improves the top-1 D3Net by about 1.9% in S-measure on average, demonstrating strong generalization.
2004.08515|v2.assessment: 多模态融合思路对 RGB-D 显著性检测有效，但与自动驾驶 3D/BEV 感知主线相关度有限，方法设计有一定参考价值。
2004.08515|v2.contribution: 提出联合学习与密集协作融合的 Siamese RGB-D 显著性检测框架 JL-DCF。
2004.08515|v2.innovation: 通过 JL 与 DCF 两个模块实现 RGB 与深度的联合特征学习与互补特征挖掘。
2004.08515|v2.result: 在六个数据集上 S-measure 平均超越 D3Net 约 1.9%。

1912.05384|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 FPN 特征金字塔在多尺度目标检测中因设计缺陷导致多尺度特征未被充分利用的问题，提出新的特征金字塔架构 AugFPN。方法包含三个组件：一致监督（Consistent Supervision）在融合前缩小不同尺度特征的语义鸿沟，残差特征增强（Residual Feature Augmentation）提取比例不变上下文信息以减少最高层特征图的信息损失，软 RoI 选择（Soft RoI Selection）在融合后自适应学习更好的 RoI 特征。将 Faster R-CNN 中的 FPN 替换为 AugFPN 后，以 ResNet50 和 MobileNet-v2 为骨干分别提升 2.3 和 1.6 个 AP 点。
1912.05384|v2.summary_en: This paper analyzes the design defects of FPN and proposes AugFPN, a new feature pyramid architecture for multi-scale object detection. AugFPN comprises Consistent Supervision to narrow semantic gaps before fusion, Residual Feature Augmentation to extract ratio-invariant context and reduce information loss at the highest pyramid level, and Soft RoI Selection for adaptive RoI feature learning after fusion. Replacing FPN with AugFPN in Faster R-CNN improves AP by 2.3 and 1.6 points with ResNet50 and MobileNet-v2 backbones, respectively.
1912.05384|v2.assessment: 对 FPN 缺陷的分析清晰，三个改进模块针对性强，是目标检测多尺度特征学习的重要工程改进，对自动驾驶 2D 检测有直接参考价值。
1912.05384|v2.contribution: 提出改进多尺度特征学习的特征金字塔架构 AugFPN。
1912.05384|v2.innovation: 通过一致监督、残差特征增强与软 RoI 选择三组件系统性修复 FPN 设计缺陷。
1912.05384|v2.result: 在 Faster R-CNN 上以 ResNet50/MobileNet-v2 为骨干分别提升 2.3/1.6 AP。

2003.11818|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有目标检测 NAS 方法仅搜索检测器某一组件（如骨干或特征融合层）而其余组件仍手工设计、导致搜索组件与手工组件不一致从而限制性能的问题，提出层次化三位一体搜索框架 Hit-Detector。方法以端到端方式同时搜索检测器的骨干、颈部和头部，并观察到检测器不同部分偏好不同算子，因此设计自动筛选不同子搜索空间的方案以高效进行端到端搜索。搜索得到的 Hit-Detector 在 COCO minival 上以 27M 参数达到 41.4% mAP。
2003.11818|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies that existing NAS methods for object detection search only one component while leaving others manually designed, causing inconsistency that limits performance. It proposes a hierarchical trinity search framework, Hit-Detector, that jointly searches backbone, neck, and head in an end-to-end manner, with an automatic sub-search-space screening scheme motivated by the observation that different detector parts prefer different operators. The searched architecture achieves 41.4% mAP on COCO minival with 27M parameters.
2003.11818|v2.assessment: 将 NAS 从单组件扩展到检测器全组件联合搜索，思路完整且结果有竞争力，对自动化检测器设计有参考意义。
2003.11818|v2.contribution: 提出同时搜索骨干、颈部与头部的层次化三位一体检测器 NAS 框架 Hit-Detector。
2003.11818|v2.innovation: 端到端联合搜索检测器全组件，并为不同组件自动筛选不同子搜索空间。
2003.11818|v2.result: 在 COCO minival 上以 27M 参数取得 41.4% mAP。

Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.summary_cn: 该论文面向点云单阶段 3D 目标检测，标题强调结构感知（Structure Aware），应旨在解决单阶段点云检测中几何结构信息利用不足的问题。由于摘要为空，无法确认其具体网络设计、结构感知模块的实现方式以及相对已有单阶段检测器的改进幅度。从主题看属于自动驾驶 3D 检测核心方向，但缺少摘要导致无法评估方法细节与实验数据。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.summary_en: This paper targets structure-aware single-stage 3D object detection from point clouds, presumably addressing insufficient exploitation of geometric structure in single-stage detectors. As the abstract is missing, the specific architecture, the structure-aware module, and quantitative improvements over prior single-stage detectors cannot be verified. The topic lies in the core autonomous driving 3D detection area, but the missing abstract prevents proper assessment.
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.assessment: 主题属于自动驾驶 3D 检测核心方向，但摘要缺失，无法评估其方法质量与实际效果。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.contribution: 面向点云单阶段 3D 检测提出结构感知方法（摘要缺失，具体贡献无法确认）。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.innovation: 摘要缺失，无法判断创新点。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认实验效果。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D._arxiv_id: Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object Detection From Point Cloud.

1912.04986|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR点云作为2.5D数据时，将其表示为(x,y,z)点集会丢失自由空间（freespace）信息的问题，提出通过3D raycasting高效恢复可见性信息，并将体素化可见性图作为额外输入流融入基于体素的3D检测网络。方法还展示了可见性可与虚拟物体合成数据增强及多帧时序聚合两种主流检测器改进相结合。在NuScenes 3D检测基准上，仅增加可见性输入流即可显著提升检测性能（摘要中具体数值被截断）。
1912.04986|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that representing 2.5D LiDAR data as collections of (x,y,z) points destroys hidden freespace information. It proposes recovering visibility via 3D raycasting and incorporating a voxelized visibility map as an additional input stream into voxel-based 3D detectors, compatible with synthetic virtual object augmentation and temporal LiDAR aggregation. On the NuScenes 3D detection benchmark, adding the visibility stream significantly improves detection performance.
1912.04986|v2.assessment: 该工作从2.5D数据本质出发，挖掘被忽视的自由空间信息，思路新颖且与现有检测框架兼容，对自动驾驶3D感知有实际价值。
1912.04986|v2.contribution: 提出将体素化可见性图作为额外输入流，使基于体素的3D检测器显式利用自由空间信息。
1912.04986|v2.innovation: 通过3D raycasting从2.5D LiDAR数据中恢复可见性，并与虚拟物体增强和时序聚合无缝结合。
1912.04986|v2.result: 在NuScenes 3D检测基准上，增加可见性输入流显著提升了检测性能。

2011.09094|v2.summary_cn: DETR 从零训练需要极长训练周期且依赖大规模数据。本文提出 UP-DETR，通过随机裁剪图像块作为 decoder query 进行自监督预训练（随机 query patch 检测），并发现冻结 CNN backbone 是多任务预训练成功的关键，同时用 attention mask 支持多 query 定位。相比从零训练的 DETR，UP-DETR 显著加速收敛并提升检测性能，还统一支持微调检测与 one-shot 检测。
2011.09094|v2.summary_en: DETR requires extremely long training schedules and large-scale data when trained from scratch. This paper proposes UP-DETR, an unsupervised pre-training scheme with a random query patch detection pretext task, where randomly cropped patches are fed as decoder queries and the model learns to localize them. It identifies freezing the CNN backbone as crucial for balancing classification and localization, and introduces multi-query patch detection with attention masks. UP-DETR accelerates convergence and improves detection performance, while also offering a unified view for fine-tuning and one-shot detection.
2011.09094|v2.assessment: 将 NLP 中 Transformer 预训练范式成功迁移到 DETR 检测器，对后续 DETR 系列预训练研究有启发意义。
2011.09094|v2.contribution: 提出随机 query patch 检测的自监督预训练任务，使 DETR 无需大规模标注即可高效预训练。
2011.09094|v2.innovation: 用随机裁剪 patch 作为 decoder query 进行自监督预训练，并发现冻结 backbone 是预训练成功的前提。
2011.09094|v2.result: 显著缩短 DETR 训练周期并提升检测精度，同时统一支持微调检测与 one-shot 检测。

Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.summary_cn: 该论文针对 DETR 端到端检测中注意力计算效率与多尺度特征利用不足的问题，提出 Dynamic DETR，引入动态注意力机制以在解码过程中自适应聚焦于感兴趣区域。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验数据与改进幅度，但方法方向属于 DETR 注意力机制改进的典型工作。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and limited multi-scale feature usage of attention in DETR-based end-to-end detection by proposing Dynamic DETR, which introduces dynamic attention to adaptively focus on regions of interest during decoding. Due to the missing abstract, specific experimental results and improvements cannot be verified, though the work falls into the typical line of improving DETR attention mechanisms.
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.assessment: 属于 DETR 注意力改进方向的工作，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体贡献与实验充分度，需查阅原文确认。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.contribution: 提出 Dynamic DETR，用动态注意力机制改进端到端检测器的注意力计算。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.innovation: 在 DETR 解码中引入动态注意力以自适应聚焦感兴趣区域。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio._arxiv_id: Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detection with Dynamic Attention.

2010.04159|v2.summary_cn: DETR 虽消除了手工组件，但存在收敛慢和特征空间分辨率受限的问题。本文提出 Deformable DETR，其注意力模块仅在参考点周围的一小部分采样点上进行注意力计算，从而缓解上述问题。在 COCO 上，Deformable DETR 以少 10 倍的训练 epoch 取得优于 DETR 的性能，尤其在小目标上提升明显。
2010.04159|v2.summary_en: DETR eliminates hand-designed components but suffers from slow convergence and limited feature spatial resolution due to Transformer attention limitations. This paper proposes Deformable DETR, whose attention modules attend only to a small set of sampled key points around a reference. On COCO, it outperforms DETR with 10× fewer training epochs, with notable gains on small objects.
2010.04159|v2.assessment: Deformable DETR 是 DETR 系列里程碑式工作，其可变形注意力被后续大量检测与 BEV 方法广泛采用，极具参考价值。
2010.04159|v2.contribution: 提出可变形注意力模块，使 DETR 以更少训练轮次达到更优检测性能。
2010.04159|v2.innovation: 注意力仅关注参考点周围少量采样点，兼顾收敛速度与多尺度小目标性能。
2010.04159|v2.result: 在 COCO 上以 10 倍更少训练 epoch 超越 DETR，小目标提升尤为显著。

2104.02628|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对显著目标检测（SOD）与伪装目标检测（COD）两个任务，提出利用二者矛盾信息互相增强的范式。方法将 COD 中的易正样本用作 SOD 的难正样本以提升鲁棒性，并引入相似性度量模块显式建模两任务的矛盾属性，同时用对抗学习网络处理标注不确定性并估计网络置信度。在基准数据集上两个任务均达到 SOTA。
2104.02628|v2.summary_en: This paper targets salient object detection (SOD) and camouflaged object detection (COD), proposing a paradigm that leverages their contradictory information to enhance both tasks. Easy positive samples from COD are used as hard positives for SOD, a similarity measure module explicitly models the contradicting attributes, and an adversarial learning network handles label uncertainty and estimates confidence. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on both tasks.
2104.02628|v2.assessment: 属于通用视觉检测的交叉任务研究，与自动驾驶感知/3D 检测领域关联较弱，参考价值有限。
2104.02628|v2.contribution: 提出利用 SOD 与 COD 矛盾信息互相增强的联合检测范式。
2104.02628|v2.innovation: 用相似性度量与对抗学习显式建模两任务的矛盾属性并估计不确定性。
2104.02628|v2.result: 在基准数据集上 SOD 与 COD 两个任务均取得 SOTA 性能。

2104.02323|v2.summary_cn: 单目 3D 检测中截断目标因分布差异大而定位困难，现有方法对所有目标采用统一策略导致性能受限。本文提出 MonoFlex 灵活框架，显式解耦截断目标（将特征图边缘解耦预测长尾截断目标，避免影响正常目标优化），并将目标深度估计建模为直接回归深度与多组关键点求解深度的不确定性引导集成。在 KITTI 测试集上，中等难度相对提升 27%、困难难度提升 30%，同时保持实时效率。
2104.02323|v2.summary_en: Monocular 3D detection struggles with truncated objects due to their diverse distributions, and unified strategies limit performance. This paper proposes MonoFlex, a flexible framework that explicitly decouples truncated objects by decoupling feature-map edges, and formulates depth estimation as an uncertainty-guided ensemble of directly regressed depth and keypoint-solved depths. On KITTI test, it improves the state of the art by 27% (moderate) and 30% (hard) while maintaining real-time efficiency.
2104.02323|v2.assessment: 针对单目 3D 检测中截断目标这一实际痛点提出解耦与不确定性集成方案，KITTI 提升显著且实时，对自动驾驶单目感知有直接参考价值。
2104.02323|v2.contribution: 提出解耦截断目标并集成多源深度的灵活单目 3D 检测框架 MonoFlex。
2104.02323|v2.innovation: 将特征图边缘解耦处理长尾截断目标，并用不确定性引导集成直接回归深度与关键点求解深度。
2104.02323|v2.result: KITTI 测试集中等难度相对提升 27%、困难难度提升 30%，且保持实时。

2103.11402|v2.summary_cn: 监督检测依赖大量人工标注，半监督目标检测（SSOD）可利用无标注数据提升性能。本文提出 Instant-Teaching，一个完全端到端的 SSOD 框架，在每次训练迭代中使用即时伪标签与扩展的弱-强数据增强进行教学，并提出基于协同矫正的 Instant-Teaching* 以缓解确认偏差、提升伪标注质量。在 MS-COCO 上使用 2% 标注数据时超越 SOTA 4.2 mAP，全监督下仍超出约 1.0 mAP，PASCAL VOC 上提升超 5 mAP。
2103.11402|v2.summary_en: Supervised detection demands costly annotations, and semi-supervised object detection (SSOD) can exploit unlabeled data. This paper proposes Instant-Teaching, a fully end-to-end SSOD framework using instant pseudo labeling with extended weak-strong augmentations at each iteration, plus a co-rectify scheme (Instant-Teaching*) to alleviate confirmation bias and improve pseudo-label quality. It surpasses state of the art by 4.2 mAP on MS-COCO with 2% labels, still by ~1.0 mAP under full supervision, and by over 5 mAP on PASCAL VOC.
2103.11402|v2.assessment: 端到端半监督检测框架，伪标签即时生成与协同矫正设计实用，对降低自动驾驶数据标注成本有参考意义。
2103.11402|v2.contribution: 提出端到端半监督检测框架 Instant-Teaching 及其协同矫正版本 Instant-Teaching*。
2103.11402|v2.innovation: 每次迭代即时伪标签配合扩展弱-强增强，并用协同矫正缓解确认偏差。
2103.11402|v2.result: MS-COCO 2% 标注下超 SOTA 4.2 mAP，全监督下仍超约 1.0 mAP，VOC 上提升超 5 mAP。

2104.07434|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱半监督目标检测中标注成本高的问题，提出仅用点标注的弱监督设定，数据集由少量全标注图像和大量点标注图像组成。方法上提出 Point DETR，在 DETR 基础上增加点编码器以充分利用点标注信息。相比 FCOS 等现有检测器难以利用点标注的缺陷，该方法在 MS-COCO 上使用 20% 全标注数据时达到 33.3 AP，超过 FCOS 基线 2.0 AP，并在多种 AR 指标上借助点标注提升超过 10 个点。
2104.07434|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces a point-annotated weakly semi-supervised setting for object detection, combining a small fully annotated set with a large point-annotated set. It proposes Point DETR, which extends DETR with a point encoder to better exploit point supervision. On MS-COCO with 20% fully labeled data, it achieves 33.3 AP, outperforming FCOS by 2.0 AP, and point annotations bring over 10 points in various AR metrics.
2104.07434|v2.assessment: 该工作为降低目标检测标注成本提供了新思路，Point DETR 的设计和实验验证较为扎实，对弱监督检测研究者有参考价值。
2104.07434|v2.contribution: 提出点标注的弱半监督检测设定及 Point DETR 检测器。
2104.07434|v2.innovation: 在 DETR 中引入点编码器以有效利用点标注。
2104.07434|v2.result: 在 COCO 20% 全标注下达到 33.3 AP，超 FCOS 2.0 AP，AR 指标提升超 10 点。

2103.17202|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 检测中 NMS 仅在推理阶段使用、训练与推理流程不匹配的问题，提出 GrooMeD-NMS，一种分组可微 NMS。该方法将 NMS 表述为矩阵运算，并通过无监督分组和掩码获得闭式表达，使网络能在 NMS 后的框上端到端训练。在 KITTI 基准上取得单目 3D 检测最优结果，性能可与基于单目视频的方法相媲美。
2103.17202|v2.summary_en: To address the mismatch between training and inference caused by NMS being used only at inference in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes GrooMeD-NMS, a grouped mathematically differentiable NMS. It formulates NMS as a matrix operation with unsupervised grouping and masking to obtain a closed-form expression, enabling end-to-end training on boxes after NMS. It achieves state-of-the-art monocular 3D detection on KITTI, comparable to monocular video-based methods.
2103.17202|v2.assessment: 该工作将 NMS 可微化并融入训练，解决了单目 3D 检测的流程不一致问题，方法优雅且实验充分，值得关注。
2103.17202|v2.contribution: 提出分组可微 NMS 并集成到单目 3D 检测训练中。
2103.17202|v2.innovation: 将 NMS 表述为矩阵运算并分组掩码获得闭式可微表达。
2103.17202|v2.result: 在 KITTI 上取得单目 3D 检测最优结果，媲美视频方法。

2012.04355|v2.summary_cn: 针对 3D 目标检测标注成本高的问题，提出半监督方法 3DIoUMatch，适用于室内外场景。采用教师-学生互学习框架传播伪标签，并引入基于置信度的过滤机制，进一步利用估计的 3D IoU 作为定位度量，设置类别自适应阈值过滤低质量伪标签。在室内数据集上以 VoteNet 为骨干，在 KITTI 上以 PV-RCNN 为骨干，方法持续取得提升。
2012.04355|v2.summary_en: To reduce the heavy annotation burden in 3D object detection, this paper proposes 3DIoUMatch, a semi-supervised method for both indoor and outdoor scenes. It uses a teacher-student mutual learning framework to propagate pseudo-labels, with confidence-based filtering and 3D IoU-based localization metric with category-aware self-adjusted thresholds. Using VoteNet indoors and PV-RCNN on KITTI, it consistently improves performance.
2012.04355|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了 3D 半监督检测中伪标签噪声问题，3D IoU 过滤机制设计合理，实验覆盖室内外场景，影响力较大。
2012.04355|v2.contribution: 提出基于 3D IoU 过滤的半监督 3D 检测框架 3DIoUMatch。
2012.04355|v2.innovation: 利用估计 3D IoU 和类别自适应阈值过滤伪标签。
2012.04355|v2.result: 在室内数据集和 KITTI 上均持续提升检测性能。

2106.11346|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模预训练迁移到多样化下游检测任务成本高的问题，提出迁移学习系统 GAIA，可自动高效地生成定制化检测方案。GAIA 能提供强大预训练权重、根据延迟约束和数据域选择模型，并为数据稀缺的任务收集相关数据。在 COCO、Objects365、Open Images、Caltech、CityPersons 及 UODB 等数据集上取得良好结果，以 COCO 为例可高效生成覆盖多种需求的模型。
2106.11346|v2.summary_en: To address the high cost of adapting large-scale pre-training to diverse downstream detection tasks, this paper presents GAIA, a transfer learning system that automatically generates customized solutions. GAIA provides pre-trained weights, selects models satisfying latency and domain constraints, and collects relevant data for data-scarce tasks. It achieves promising results on COCO, Objects365, Open Images, Caltech, CityPersons, and UODB.
2106.11346|v2.assessment: 该工作偏向系统与工程实践，对实际部署有参考价值，但方法创新性相对有限，与前沿检测算法研究相关度中等。
2106.11346|v2.contribution: 提出面向多样化需求的自动迁移学习检测系统 GAIA。
2106.11346|v2.innovation: 集成预训练权重、模型选择与数据收集的自动化流程。
2106.11346|v2.result: 在多个检测数据集上取得良好迁移效果。

2106.13381|v2.summary_cn: 针对距离图像视图下的 3D 目标检测，提出直接从距离图像学习 3D 表示的 2D 卷积网络架构，网络全程携带每个像素的 3D 球坐标。其层可替换为任意卷积核以利用局部几何，文中给出四种核：基于词袋的稠密核及 Transformer、PointNet、Edge Convolution 三种图核，并探索与相机图像的跨模态融合。在 Waymo Open Dataset 上行人检测 AP 从 69.7% 提升至 75.5%，最小模型仍优于 PointPillars 且 FLOPS 和参数量少 180 倍。
2106.13381|v2.summary_en: For 3D object detection from range images, this paper proposes a 2D convolutional architecture that learns 3D representations directly from the range image while carrying 3D spherical coordinates per pixel. It supports arbitrary convolution kernels, including a dense bag-of-words kernel and three graph kernels (Transformer, PointNet, Edge Convolution), and explores cross-modality fusion with camera images. On Waymo Open Dataset, pedestrian AP improves from 69.7% to 75.5%, and the smallest model outperforms PointPillars with 180x fewer FLOPS and parameters.
2106.13381|v2.assessment: 该工作在距离图像视图下探索多种几何卷积核，效率与精度兼顾，对激光雷达 3D 检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2106.13381|v2.contribution: 提出在距离图像上携带 3D 坐标的卷积架构及多种几何卷积核。
2106.13381|v2.innovation: 将图神经网络核与距离图像视图结合并支持跨模态融合。
2106.13381|v2.result: Waymo 行人 AP 从 69.7% 提升至 75.5%，最小模型 FLOPS 和参数少 180 倍。

2103.12605|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 检测中 6DoF 位姿估计依赖难以获取的物体几何真值的问题，提出 MonoRUn 框架，仅用简单 3D 框标注以自监督方式学习稠密对应和几何。方法采用带不确定性感知的区域重建网络回归像素相关 3D 坐标，通过将预测 3D 坐标投影回图像平面并设计 Robust KL 损失最小化不确定性加权重投影误差进行自监督训练。测试时通过不确定性传播驱动 PnP 估计物体位姿及其协方差，取得优异定位精度。
2103.12605|v2.summary_en: To address the reliance on hard-to-obtain object geometry ground truth in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes MonoRUn, which learns dense correspondences and geometry self-supervisedly using only 3D bounding box annotations. It employs an uncertainty-aware regional reconstruction network to regress pixel-related 3D coordinates, trained with a Robust KL loss minimizing uncertainty-weighted reprojection error. At test time, uncertainty is propagated through an uncertainty-driven PnP to estimate object pose and covariance, achieving strong localization accuracy.
2103.12605|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙结合自监督重建与不确定性传播，摆脱了对物体几何真值的依赖，方法新颖且实验扎实，对单目 3D 检测有重要启发。
2103.12605|v2.contribution: 提出自监督稠密对应学习与不确定性传播的单目 3D 检测框架 MonoRUn。
2103.12605|v2.innovation: 用 Robust KL 损失进行不确定性加权重投影自监督训练并传播不确定性至 PnP。
2103.12605|v2.result: 仅用 3D 框标注实现高精度位姿估计，取得优异定位性能。

Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.summary_cn: 该论文针对单样本目标检测（One-Shot Object Detection）中查询图像与支持图像之间外观差异大、难以匹配的问题，提出了一种自适应图像Transformer（Adaptive Image Transformer）。方法通过动态调整Transformer中的注意力机制或特征对齐策略，使模型能够根据输入图像对自适应地聚合和匹配特征。相比已有方法，其改进在于增强了跨图像特征交互的灵活性和适应性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该工作为单样本检测提供了新的Transformer架构思路。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of one-shot object detection where large appearance variations between query and support images hinder matching. It proposes an Adaptive Image Transformer that dynamically adjusts attention or feature alignment to adaptively aggregate and match features for each input pair. The improvement lies in enhanced flexibility and adaptability of cross-image feature interaction, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.assessment: 该工作将Transformer的自适应机制引入单样本目标检测，思路新颖，但缺乏实验数据支撑，需进一步验证其有效性。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.contribution: 提出了一种自适应图像Transformer用于单样本目标检测，增强了跨图像特征匹配的灵活性。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.innovation: 通过动态调整注意力机制实现查询与支持图像的自适应特征对齐。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果有待验证。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot._arxiv_id: Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot Object Detection.

2103.16148|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测模型对抗攻击鲁棒性不足的问题，指出现有防御方法多集中于分类任务，缺乏对检测任务的深入分析。提出了一种类别感知的鲁棒对抗训练范式，为给定图像生成通用对抗扰动以同时攻击所有目标，并将总损失分解为类别加权损失进行归一化，从而平衡各类别的影响。相比已有方法，该方案能更均匀地提升所有目标类别的对抗鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在检测任务上具有针对性。
2103.16148|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of robustness of object detectors against adversarial attacks, noting that prior defenses focus on classification. It proposes a class-aware robust adversarial training paradigm that generates universal adversarial perturbations to attack all objects simultaneously and decomposes the total loss into class-wise losses normalized by class object counts. This balances class influence and evenly improves adversarial robustness across all object classes compared to previous defenses.
2103.16148|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了目标检测对抗训练中类别平衡的空白，方法设计合理，对提升检测模型安全性有重要意义。
2103.16148|v2.contribution: 提出了类别感知的鲁棒对抗训练范式，用于提升目标检测模型对所有类别的对抗鲁棒性。
2103.16148|v2.innovation: 通过类别加权损失归一化，平衡不同类别在对抗训练中的影响。
2103.16148|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但声称能有效且均匀地提升所有类别的鲁棒性。

2103.17220|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测中数据增强策略依赖人工设计且难以保持尺度不变性的问题，提出了Scale-aware AutoAug方法。方法定义了一个新的尺度感知搜索空间，包含图像级和框级增强，并引入Pareto Scale Balance作为搜索指标以提高效率。相比已有自动增强方法，其在RetinaNet、Faster R-CNN、Mask R-CNN和FCOS等检测器上均取得显著且一致的提升，且搜索成本更低，策略可迁移至实例分割和关键点估计等任务。
2103.17220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design and scale-invariance issues in data augmentation for object detection by proposing Scale-aware AutoAug. It defines a scale-aware search space with image- and box-level augmentations and introduces Pareto Scale Balance as an efficient search metric. It yields significant and consistent improvements on various detectors (RetinaNet, Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN, FCOS) with lower search cost, and the policies transfer to instance segmentation and keypoint estimation.
2103.17220|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了检测增强中的尺度问题，搜索效率高且策略可迁移，对检测社区有实用价值。
2103.17220|v2.contribution: 提出了尺度感知的自动增强方法Scale-aware AutoAug，用于目标检测。
2103.17220|v2.innovation: 设计了尺度感知搜索空间和Pareto Scale Balance搜索指标，兼顾效率与尺度不变性。
2103.17220|v2.result: 在多个检测器上取得显著且一致的提升，搜索成本低于先前方法，策略可迁移至其他任务。

2007.06919|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测模型在边缘设备上量化推理时性能严重下降且效率难以验证的问题，提出了AQD（Accurate Quantized Object Detection）方案。方法在卷积层、归一化层和跳跃连接中全部使用定点运算，实现纯整数推理，彻底消除浮点计算。在MS-COCO数据集上，AQD在RetinaNet和FCOS上于极低位宽（如2-bit）下达到与全精度模型相当甚至更好的性能，显著改善了延迟-精度权衡。
2007.06919|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe performance degradation and unverifiable efficiency of low-bit quantization for object detection on edge devices. It proposes AQD, which uses fixed-point operations in all layers (convolution, normalization, skip connections) to enable integer-only inference. On MS-COCO with RetinaNet and FCOS, AQD achieves comparable or even better performance than full-precision counterparts under extremely low-bit schemes (e.g., 2-bit), improving the latency-accuracy trade-off.
2007.06919|v2.assessment: 该工作实现了检测模型的纯整数推理，在极低位宽下保持精度，对边缘部署有重要实用价值。
2007.06919|v2.contribution: 提出了AQD，一种全定点运算的量化目标检测方案，支持纯整数推理。
2007.06919|v2.innovation: 在所有层类型中采用定点运算，实现极低位宽下的高精度检测。
2007.06919|v2.result: 在MS-COCO上，2-bit量化下RetinaNet和FCOS达到与全精度相当或更好的性能。

2103.13886|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对数据增强在目标检测中潜力未被充分挖掘的问题，发现分类器从增强中获得的增益在检测微调后消失。为此，提出在检测器微调阶段引入对抗样本作为模型依赖的数据增强，动态选择来自分类和定位分支的更强对抗图像，并随检测器进化。相比AutoAugment等模型无关方法，该策略在不同检测器上泛化更好，在COCO上使EfficientDets提升+1.1 mAP，并改善了鲁棒性。
2103.13886|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored potential of data augmentation for object detection, noting that classifier gains from augmentation diminish after detection fine-tuning. It proposes augmenting the fine-tuning stage with adversarial examples as model-dependent augmentation, dynamically selecting stronger adversarial images from classification and localization branches. This generalizes better than AutoAugment and boosts EfficientDets by +1.1 mAP on COCO while improving robustness.
2103.13886|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙地将对抗样本作为数据增强用于检测微调，方法简洁有效，对提升检测精度和鲁棒性均有帮助。
2103.13886|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于对抗学习的检测微调增强方法，动态选择对抗样本提升检测性能。
2103.13886|v2.innovation: 将模型依赖的对抗样本作为数据增强，并随检测器动态进化。
2103.13886|v2.result: 在COCO上使EfficientDets提升+1.1 mAP，并改善了鲁棒性。

2104.06114|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D目标检测中Hough投票方法仅能获得部分表面投票且存在严重离群点的问题，提出了Back-tracing Representative Points Network (BRNet)。方法从投票中心反向回溯代表点，并重新访问这些点周围的互补种子点，以更好地捕捉原始点云中潜在物体的局部结构特征。这种自底向上再自顶向下的策略增强了预测投票中心与原始表面点之间的一致性，实现了更可靠和灵活的目标定位。
2104.06114|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue in Hough voting-based 3D object detection where only partial surface votes and severe outliers are obtained. It proposes BRNet, which generatively back-traces representative points from vote centers and revisits complementary seed points around them to better capture fine local structural features from raw point clouds. This bottom-up then top-down strategy enforces mutual consistency between predicted vote centers and raw surface points, achieving more reliable and flexible object localization.
2104.06114|v2.assessment: 该工作通过反向回溯策略有效利用了原始点云信息，提升了投票式3D检测的定位精度，对点云检测有参考价值。
2104.06114|v2.contribution: 提出了BRNet，通过反向回溯代表点增强投票式3D目标检测。
2104.06114|v2.innovation: 结合自底向上和自顶向下策略，强制投票中心与原始表面点的一致性。
2104.06114|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但声称实现了更可靠和灵活的目标定位。

2106.08322|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对目标检测头中分类与定位难以统一建模的问题，提出Dynamic Head框架，将尺度感知（特征层级间）、空间感知（空间位置间）和任务感知（输出通道内）三种自注意力机制统一到检测头中。相比此前各自改进检测头但缺乏统一视角的工作，该方法在不增加计算开销的前提下显著提升检测头表示能力。在COCO上，ResNeXt-101-DCN骨干达到54.0 AP，结合Transformer骨干与额外数据进一步刷新至60.6 AP。
2106.08322|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified view for object detection heads by proposing the Dynamic Head framework, which coherently combines scale-aware, spatial-aware, and task-aware self-attention mechanisms within the detection head. Without additional computational overhead, it substantially improves the representation capability of detection heads. Experiments on COCO achieve 54.0 AP with a ResNeXt-101-DCN backbone and push the state of the art to 60.6 AP with a transformer backbone and extra data.
2106.08322|v2.assessment: 该工作以统一注意力视角重新审视检测头设计，思路清晰且效果显著，对检测头结构改进具有重要参考价值。
2106.08322|v2.contribution: 提出统一尺度、空间与任务注意力的Dynamic Head检测头框架。
2106.08322|v2.innovation: 首次将三种自注意力机制统一到目标检测头中且不增加计算开销。
2106.08322|v2.result: COCO上达到54.0 AP，结合Transformer骨干与额外数据达到60.6 AP。

2103.02340|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对检测蒸馏方法泛化性差且过度依赖GT、忽略实例间关系信息的问题，提出通用实例蒸馏（GID），不区分GT正负样本，通过通用实例选择模块（GISM）综合利用特征、关系和响应三类知识进行蒸馏。相比已有检测蒸馏方法，GID对不同检测框架具有更好泛化性。在COCO上，ResNet-50的RetinaNet使用GID达到39.1% mAP，超过基线36.2%达2.9%，甚至优于ResNet-101教师模型的38.1% AP。
2103.02340|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the weak generalization and heavy GT reliance of existing detection distillation methods by proposing General Instance Distillation (GID), which selects discriminative instances regardless of GT polarity and distills feature-, relation-, and response-based knowledge via a general instance selection module. GID generalizes across detection frameworks. On COCO, RetinaNet with ResNet-50 achieves 39.1% mAP, surpassing the 36.2% baseline by 2.9% and even outperforming the ResNet-101 teacher at 38.1% AP.
2103.02340|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了实例关系知识在检测蒸馏中的价值，方法通用性强，学生超越教师的结果颇具启发性。
2103.02340|v2.contribution: 提出不依赖GT正负区分的通用实例蒸馏方法GID。
2103.02340|v2.innovation: 通过通用实例选择模块融合特征、关系与响应三类知识进行检测蒸馏。
2103.02340|v2.result: RetinaNet-ResNet50在COCO上达39.1% mAP，超过基线2.9%并超越教师模型。

Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O.summary_cn: 论文针对跨域目标检测中域偏移导致性能下降的问题，提出Unbiased Mean Teacher方法（根据标题推断），旨在缓解教师-学生框架中的域偏差。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据。
Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O.summary_en: This paper targets cross-domain object detection, where domain shift degrades performance, and proposes an Unbiased Mean Teacher approach to mitigate domain bias in the teacher-student framework. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be verified.
Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O.assessment: 跨域检测是重要方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法细节与实验充分度，需查阅原文确认。
Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O.contribution: 提出面向跨域目标检测的Unbiased Mean Teacher方法。
Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O.innovation: 针对教师-学生框架中的域偏差进行无偏化处理（细节待确认）。
Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法确认。
Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O._arxiv_id: Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain Object Detection.

2104.01108|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对共显著目标检测（Co-SOD）问题，提出组协作学习框架GCoNet，通过组亲和模块挖掘组内紧凑性以刻画共显著目标的共享属性，并通过组协作模块增强组间可分性以抑制噪声目标影响，同时引入辅助分类监督优化嵌入空间。在CoCA、CoSOD3k和Cosal2015三个基准上，GCoNet超越10个前沿模型并达到新SOTA，推理速度达16ms。
2104.01108|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses co-salient object detection by proposing GCoNet, a group collaborative learning framework that mines intra-group compactness via a group affinity module and enforces inter-group separability via a group collaborating module, with auxiliary classification supervision. On CoCA, CoSOD3k, and Cosal2015, GCoNet outperforms 10 cutting-edge models, achieves new state-of-the-art results, and runs in real time at 16ms.
2104.01108|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦共显著目标检测这一细分任务，方法设计合理且实时性突出，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限。
2104.01108|v2.contribution: 提出组协作学习框架GCoNet用于共显著目标检测。
2104.01108|v2.innovation: 通过组亲和与组协作模块同时建模组内紧凑性和组间可分性。
2104.01108|v2.result: 在三个基准上超越10个前沿模型达到SOTA，推理速度16ms。

2105.09491|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对少样本目标检测中仅关注新类性能而忽视基类遗忘的问题，指出实际测试样本可能包含任意类别实例，要求检测器学习新概念时不忘旧知识。作者通过分析迁移学习方法的特性，设计出简单有效的Retentive R-CNN，包含Bias-Balanced RPN以去偏预训练RPN，以及Re-detector以在不遗忘旧知识的前提下检测少样本类。实验表明其在所有设定下整体性能显著超越SOTA，少样本类性能有竞争力且基类性能完全不退化。
2105.09491|v2.summary_en: This paper argues that few-shot object detection should detect all classes without forgetting base categories, since test samples may contain instances of any class. The authors propose Retentive R-CNN, comprising a Bias-Balanced RPN to debias the pretrained RPN and a Re-detector to detect few-shot classes without forgetting prior knowledge. Experiments show it significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in overall performance across all settings, achieving competitive few-shot accuracy with no degradation on base classes.
2105.09491|v2.assessment: 该工作重新定义了少样本检测的评估视角，强调基类不遗忘，方法简洁有效，对实际部署场景有参考意义。
2105.09491|v2.contribution: 提出Retentive R-CNN实现少样本检测中基类不遗忘。
2105.09491|v2.innovation: 通过Bias-Balanced RPN与Re-detector解耦去偏与少样本类检测。
2105.09491|v2.result: 所有设定下整体性能显著超越SOTA，基类性能零退化。

LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug.summary_cn: 论文针对3D目标检测中LiDAR数据标注成本高、现有增强方法泛化性不足的问题，提出LiDAR-Aug通用渲染式增强框架（根据标题推断），通过渲染方式生成增强的LiDAR点云以提升3D检测器性能。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节与实验数据无法确认。
LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and limited generalization of existing augmentation methods for LiDAR-based 3D object detection by proposing LiDAR-Aug, a general rendering-based augmentation framework. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be verified.
LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug.assessment: LiDAR数据增强对3D检测训练至关重要，渲染式增强思路有潜力，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体效果。
LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug.contribution: 提出通用渲染式LiDAR数据增强框架LiDAR-Aug。
LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug.innovation: 以渲染方式生成增强LiDAR点云用于3D目标检测（细节待确认）。
LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法确认。
LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug._arxiv_id: LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Augmentation Framework for 3D Object Detection.

2103.14259|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对目标检测中标签分配（label assignment）问题，指出现有方法通常为每个真值目标独立定义正负样本，缺乏全局视角。②作者创新性地将标签分配建模为最优传输（Optimal Transport, OT）问题，将每个anchor（需求方）与gt（供给方）之间的单位运输成本定义为分类损失与回归损失的加权和，并通过Sinkhorn-Knopp迭代求解最小运输成本下的最优传输方案，即OTA。③相比已有独立分配策略，OTA从全局最优角度统一分配正负样本，尤其在拥挤场景下更具优势。④在COCO上，配备OTA的FCOS-ResNet-50在1X调度下达到40.7% mAP，超越所有现有分配方法；在CrowdHuman上的实验进一步验证了其在拥挤场景中的优越性。
2103.14259|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the label assignment problem in object detection, where existing methods typically define positive/negative samples independently for each ground-truth object without a global perspective. ②The authors innovatively formulate label assignment as an Optimal Transport (OT) problem, defining the unit transportation cost between each anchor (demander) and ground-truth (supplier) as a weighted sum of classification and regression losses, and solving for the optimal transport plan via Sinkhorn-Knopp Iteration (OTA). ③Compared to existing independent assignment strategies, OTA achieves globally optimal sample assignment and demonstrates particular superiority in crowded scenarios. ④On COCO, a single FCOS-ResNet-50 detector with OTA reaches 40.7% mAP under the 1X scheduler, outperforming all existing assigning methods, with further validation on CrowdHuman.
2103.14259|v2.assessment: 该工作将最优传输理论引入目标检测标签分配，提供了全局最优视角，方法优雅且实验充分，对检测器训练策略有重要参考价值，尤其适合拥挤场景下的检测任务。
2103.14259|v2.contribution: 提出将目标检测标签分配建模为最优传输问题（OTA），实现全局最优的正负样本分配。
2103.14259|v2.innovation: 首次从全局视角将标签分配形式化为最优传输问题，并利用Sinkhorn-Knopp迭代高效求解。
2103.14259|v2.result: 在COCO上FCOS-ResNet-50达到40.7% mAP（1X调度），超越所有现有分配方法，并在CrowdHuman拥挤场景中验证了优越性。

2203.16220|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对红外与可见光图像融合服务于目标检测时，现有方法未以检测任务为目标、且缺乏多场景多模态基准的问题，提出了目标感知的双对抗学习框架，通过检测驱动的对抗机制实现任务导向的融合。同时构建了覆盖多场景的多模态基准数据集，弥补了该方向评测资源不足的缺陷。相比传统以视觉质量为导向的融合方法，该方法将融合过程与下游检测目标耦合，使融合结果更利于检测。实验表明其在检测精度上优于现有融合方法，并提供了系统的基准评测。
2203.16220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that existing infrared-visible image fusion methods are not detection-oriented and lack a multi-scenario multi-modality benchmark. It proposes a target-aware dual adversarial learning framework that couples the fusion process with the downstream detection objective, and constructs a multi-scenario multi-modality benchmark. Compared with visually-oriented fusion approaches, the proposed method yields fusion results better suited for detection and achieves improved detection accuracy.
2203.16220|v2.assessment: 将图像融合与检测目标显式耦合，并提供多场景多模态基准，对多模态感知研究有较强参考价值。
2203.16220|v2.contribution: 提出目标感知双对抗融合框架并构建多场景多模态红外-可见光基准。
2203.16220|v2.innovation: 以检测任务驱动对抗式融合，使融合过程直接服务于下游目标检测。
2203.16220|v2.result: 在自建多场景基准上取得优于现有融合方法的检测性能。

2203.16089|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对标注数据稀缺、仅部分标注或弱标注场景下目标检测训练受限的问题，提出 Omni-DETR，将多种监督形式（全监督、半监督、弱监督、零样本等）统一到基于 Transformer 的检测框架中。方法利用 DETR 的集合预测特性，通过伪标签与一致性约束融合不同来源的监督信号。相比以往针对单一监督范式设计的检测器，该方法在统一框架下兼容多种标注粒度。实验在多个监督设定下取得与专用方法相当或更优的性能。
2203.16089|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity and heterogeneity of annotations in object detection by proposing Omni-DETR, a Transformer-based framework that unifies fully-, semi-, weakly-, and zero-supervised detection. Leveraging the set-prediction nature of DETR, it integrates supervision from diverse sources via pseudo-labeling and consistency constraints. It matches or surpasses specialized methods across multiple supervision settings within a single unified framework.
2203.16089|v2.assessment: 将多种监督范式统一到 DETR 框架，思路简洁且通用性强，对标注受限的检测研究有启发。
2203.16089|v2.contribution: 提出统一的 Omni-DETR 框架以融合多种监督形式的检测训练。
2203.16089|v2.innovation: 利用 DETR 集合预测特性统一全/半/弱/零监督检测。
2203.16089|v2.result: 在多种监督设定下达到与专用方法相当或更优的检测性能。

2206.11459|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对微弱/非实体目标（insubstantial object）检测中目标信号弱、易被背景淹没的问题，构建了专门的基准数据集并提出基于时空聚合的检测基线方法。方法通过聚合视频中的时空信息增强微弱目标的特征响应，从而提升检测鲁棒性。相比单帧检测方法，时空聚合有效缓解了微弱目标特征不足的问题。实验在自建基准上验证了所提基线优于常规检测方法。
2206.11459|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the detection of insubstantial objects whose weak signals are easily overwhelmed by background. It constructs a dedicated benchmark dataset and proposes a spatio-temporal aggregation baseline that enhances weak target features by aggregating information across video frames. The proposed baseline outperforms conventional single-frame detectors on the new benchmark.
2206.11459|v2.assessment: 聚焦微弱目标检测这一细分问题并提供数据集与基线，对特定场景检测研究有一定价值。
2206.11459|v2.contribution: 构建非实体目标检测基准并提出时空聚合基线方法。
2206.11459|v2.innovation: 利用时空聚合增强微弱目标的特征响应以提升检测鲁棒性。
2206.11459|v2.result: 在自建基准上取得优于常规检测方法的性能。

2207.11169|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有小样本目标检测（FSOD）评测局限于单一相似域、难以反映跨域应用的问题，提出跨 10 个数据集的 MoFSOD 多域基准。通过解耦预训练与小样本学习，系统分析了冻结层、不同架构与不同预训练数据集对 FSOD 性能的影响。关键发现包括：在多域基准上微调（FT）是与 SOTA 相当甚至更强的基线；架构选择对下游小样本任务影响显著。该工作为 FSOD 评测提供了更全面的协议与结论。
2207.11169|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that existing few-shot object detection (FSOD) evaluations are confined to a single similar domain. It proposes MoFSOD, a multi-domain benchmark of 10 datasets, and systematically analyzes the effects of layer freezing, architectures, and pre-training datasets. Key findings include that fine-tuning is a strong baseline on par with or better than SOTA, and that architecture choice significantly impacts downstream few-shot performance.
2207.11169|v2.assessment: 以严谨的多域基准挑战了 FSOD 领域的既有认知，对评测规范与算法设计均有指导意义。
2207.11169|v2.contribution: 提出跨 10 数据集的 MoFSOD 多域小样本检测基准并给出系统性实证结论。
2207.11169|v2.innovation: 解耦预训练与小样本学习，揭示微调基线与架构选择的关键影响。
2207.11169|v2.result: 证明微调在多域基准上达到或超过 SOTA，并量化架构与预训练数据的影响。

A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有检测基准类别规模有限、难以评估大规模开放类别检测能力的问题，构建了包含 21,000 类的大规模目标检测基准，并提出一种简单有效的检测方法。方法通过可扩展的分类与检测设计应对超大类别空间带来的挑战。相比常规千类级检测基准，该工作显著扩展了类别规模并提供了配套评测。实验验证了所提简单方法在大规模类别检测上的有效性。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited category scale of existing detection benchmarks by constructing a 21,000-category object detection benchmark and proposing a simple yet effective detection approach. The method handles the challenges of an extremely large label space through scalable classification and detection design. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach on large-scale category detection.
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.assessment: 21,000 类检测基准填补了大规模类别检测评测的空白，对开放类别与长尾检测研究有重要价值。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.contribution: 构建 21,000 类大规模目标检测基准并提出简单有效的检测方法。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.innovation: 将检测类别规模扩展至两万级并提供可扩展的检测方案。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.result: 在大规模类别检测基准上验证了所提方法的有效性。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,._arxiv_id: A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21, 000-Category Object Detection.

Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于 DETR 的人-物交互（HOI）检测中查询质量不高、难正样本挖掘不足的问题，提出难正样本查询挖掘方法。方法通过改进查询与真值的匹配策略，强化对难正样本的监督，从而提升交互检测精度。相比原始 DETR 式 HOI 检测器，该方法在查询利用效率上有明显改进。实验在 HOI 检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of low-quality queries and insufficient hard-positive mining in DETR-based human-object interaction (HOI) detection. It proposes a hard-positive query mining approach that improves query-ground-truth matching to strengthen supervision on hard positives. Experiments on HOI benchmarks show improved performance over existing methods.
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.assessment: 针对 DETR 式 HOI 检测的查询匹配问题提出改进，对交互理解与检测结合方向有参考意义。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.contribution: 提出面向 DETR 式 HOI 检测的难正样本查询挖掘方法。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.innovation: 通过改进查询匹配策略强化难正样本监督以提升交互检测。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.result: 在 HOI 检测基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D._arxiv_id: Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for DETR-Based Human-Object Interaction Detection.

Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中 DETR 类方法难以泛化到未见类别的问题，本文提出 Open-Vocabulary DETR（OV-DETR），通过条件匹配机制将文本嵌入与目标查询关联。方法在 DETR 框架上引入类别条件查询和匹配策略，使模型能根据任意文本描述检测目标。相比固定类别检测器，OV-DETR 在开放词汇设定下显著提升了对新类别的检测能力，在 LVIS 等基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object detection where DETR-based detectors struggle to generalize to unseen categories. It proposes Open-Vocabulary DETR (OV-DETR) with a conditional matching mechanism that associates text embeddings with object queries. Compared to fixed-vocabulary detectors, OV-DETR achieves competitive performance on open-vocabulary benchmarks such as LVIS.
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.assessment: 将 DETR 与开放词汇检测结合，条件匹配设计简洁有效，对开放世界感知有参考价值。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.contribution: 提出基于条件匹配的开放词汇 DETR 检测框架。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.innovation: 用文本条件查询与匹配替代固定分类头，实现开放词汇检测。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.result: 在 LVIS 等开放词汇基准上取得有竞争力的检测性能。

X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.summary_cn: 针对实例级视觉-语言任务缺乏统一架构的问题，本文提出 X-DETR，一个可处理多种实例级视觉-语言任务的通用架构。方法基于 DETR 框架，通过共享的实例查询和灵活的任务头支持指代分割、实例分割、视觉定位等任务。相比为每个任务单独设计模型，X-DETR 用统一架构在多任务上达到或超越专用方法，展示了良好的通用性和扩展性。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of a unified architecture for instance-wise vision-language tasks by proposing X-DETR, a versatile framework built on DETR. It uses shared instance queries and flexible task heads to support referring segmentation, instance segmentation, and visual grounding. X-DETR matches or surpasses task-specific methods across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating strong generality.
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.assessment: 统一架构处理多实例级视觉-语言任务，对多模态感知研究有启发。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.contribution: 提出通用实例级视觉-语言架构 X-DETR。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.innovation: 用共享实例查询与灵活任务头统一多种视觉-语言任务。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.result: 在多任务基准上达到或超越专用方法。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins._arxiv_id: X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Instance-wise Vision-Language Tasks.

2203.10638|v2.summary_cn: 针对车路协同（V2X）感知中信息异步、位姿误差和组件异构等挑战，本文提出 V2X-ViT，一种基于 Vision Transformer 的鲁棒协同感知框架。方法设计异构多智能体自注意力和多尺度窗口自注意力交替层，统一融合车与路侧信息。作者用 CARLA 和 OpenCDA 构建大规模 V2X 数据集，实验表明 V2X-ViT 在 3D 目标检测上达到新 SOTA，并在噪声环境下保持鲁棒。
2203.10638|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses V2X cooperative perception challenges including asynchronous sharing, pose errors, and heterogeneity by proposing V2X-ViT, a robust Vision Transformer framework. It alternates heterogeneous multi-agent self-attention and multi-scale window self-attention to fuse vehicle and infrastructure information. A large-scale V2X dataset built with CARLA and OpenCDA shows V2X-ViT sets new state-of-the-art for 3D object detection and remains robust under noisy conditions.
2203.10638|v2.assessment: V2X 协同感知与 Transformer 结合的代表性工作，数据集和鲁棒性分析扎实，对自动驾驶感知很有价值。
2203.10638|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Vision Transformer 的 V2X 协同感知框架 V2X-ViT。
2203.10638|v2.innovation: 异构多智能体自注意力与多尺度窗口注意力统一处理 V2X 挑战。
2203.10638|v2.result: 在自建大规模 V2X 数据集上取得 3D 检测新 SOTA 并保持噪声鲁棒。

2111.14330|v2.summary_cn: 针对 DETR 及 Deformable DETR 编码器计算开销大的问题，本文提出 Sparse DETR，通过可学习稀疏性选择性更新编码器 token。方法仅更新预期被解码器引用的 token，并在选中 token 上施加辅助检测损失以提升性能。实验表明 Sparse DETR 仅用 10% 编码器 token 即超过 Deformable DETR，显著降低计算量同时保持甚至提升检测精度。
2111.14330|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high encoder computation cost of DETR and Deformable DETR by proposing Sparse DETR, which selectively updates only encoder tokens expected to be referenced by the decoder. An auxiliary detection loss on selected tokens further improves performance. Sparse DETR surpasses Deformable DETR using only 10% of encoder tokens, greatly reducing computation while maintaining or improving accuracy.
2111.14330|v2.assessment: 对 DETR 效率瓶颈的针对性改进，稀疏化思路简洁且效果显著，对实时检测有实用价值。
2111.14330|v2.contribution: 提出可学习稀疏化的高效 DETR 检测器 Sparse DETR。
2111.14330|v2.innovation: 仅更新解码器可能引用的 token 并加辅助损失。
2111.14330|v2.result: 仅用 10% 编码器 token 即超越 Deformable DETR。

MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.summary_cn: 针对零样本 NAS 在目标检测中搜索效率与精度平衡的问题，本文重新审视最大熵原理，提出 MAE-DET。方法利用最大熵准则设计零样本代理指标，无需训练即可评估检测架构，从而高效搜索高效检测网络。相比现有 NAS 方法，MAE-DET 在检测任务上以更低搜索成本获得更优精度-效率权衡。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.summary_en: This paper revisits the maximum entropy principle for zero-shot NAS in object detection and proposes MAE-DET. It designs a zero-shot proxy based on maximum entropy to evaluate detection architectures without training, enabling efficient search. MAE-DET achieves better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs at lower search cost than existing NAS methods.
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.assessment: 将最大熵原理用于检测 NAS，思路新颖，但领域相对小众，对检测主干设计有参考意义。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.contribution: 提出基于最大熵原理的零样本 NAS 检测框架 MAE-DET。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.innovation: 用最大熵零样本代理指标评估检测架构。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.result: 以更低搜索成本获得更优精度-效率权衡。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin._arxiv_id: MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Principle in Zero-Shot NAS for Efficient Object Detection.

2210.05593|v2.summary_cn: 针对 3D 点云目标检测依赖大量标注数据的问题，本文研究少样本 3D 点云检测，提出 Prototypical VoteNet。方法包含原型投票模块（PVM）和原型头模块（PHM）：PVM 利用基类学习的类无关几何原型精炼新类局部特征，PHM 用类原型增强全局特征并采用 episodic 训练。作者贡献 FS-ScanNet 和 FS-SUNRGBD 两个新基准，实验证明方法在少样本设定下有效。
2210.05593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot 3D point cloud object detection where only a few annotated samples of novel classes are available. It proposes Prototypical VoteNet with a Prototypical Vote Module (PVM) that refines novel-class local features using class-agnostic geometric prototypes from base classes, and a Prototypical Head Module (PHM) that enhances global features with class prototypes under episodic training. Two new benchmarks, FS-ScanNet and FS-SUNRGBD, demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.
2210.05593|v2.assessment: 少样本 3D 检测的探索性工作，原型学习与 episodic 训练结合合理，新基准对社区有贡献。
2210.05593|v2.contribution: 提出少样本 3D 点云检测方法 Prototypical VoteNet 及两个新基准。
2210.05593|v2.innovation: 用类无关几何原型和类原型分别精炼局部与全局特征。
2210.05593|v2.result: 在 FS-ScanNet 和 FS-SUNRGBD 上验证了少样本检测有效性。

2210.01391|v2.summary_cn: 针对2D图像与3D点云因几何异构难以直接进行多模态融合的问题，本文提出Bridged Transformer（BrT），一种端到端的3D目标检测架构。BrT利用object queries桥接3D与2D空间，统一Transformer中的不同数据表示，并通过point-to-patch投影实现特征聚合，增强图像与点云的相关性。该方法可无缝融合点云与多视角图像，在SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2数据集上超越了当时的最先进方法。
2210.01391|v2.summary_en: To address the geometric heterogeneity between 2D images and 3D point clouds that hinders direct multimodal fusion, this paper proposes Bridged Transformer (BrT), an end-to-end architecture for 3D object detection. BrT leverages object queries to bridge 3D and 2D spaces, unifying heterogeneous data representations within a Transformer, and employs point-to-patch projections for feature aggregation. It seamlessly fuses point clouds with multi-view images and surpasses state-of-the-art methods on SUN RGB-D and ScanNetV2.
2210.01391|v2.assessment: 该工作为点云与图像融合提供了一种简洁有效的Transformer方案，object query桥接思路对多模态3D检测有参考价值。
2210.01391|v2.contribution: 提出Bridged Transformer，利用object queries统一2D与3D表示实现端到端多模态3D检测。
2210.01391|v2.innovation: 以object queries桥接3D与2D空间，并通过point-to-patch投影增强跨模态特征关联。
2210.01391|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2上超越当时最先进方法。

2104.06401|v2.summary_cn: 本文研究无监督目标检测，不依赖图像级类别标签，而是从音视频对应关系中提取监督信号，用音频“教”检测器。作者设计了一个自监督对比学习框架，联合学习目标分类与定位，再用生成的伪标签和框训练基于图像的目标检测器。该方法在目标检测和声源定位任务上超越了以往的无监督和弱监督检测器，且仅需每个伪类一个标签即可对齐真实类别，并能检测乐器之外的通用物体如飞机和猫。
2104.06401|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised object detection without image-level class labels by extracting supervisory signals from audio-visual correspondence, using audio to 'teach' the detector. A self-supervised contrastive framework jointly learns to classify and localize objects, and the resulting pseudo-labels and boxes train an image-based detector. It outperforms prior unsupervised and weakly-supervised detectors on object detection and sound source localization, and can align to ground-truth classes with as little as one label per pseudo-class.
2104.06401|v2.assessment: 利用音视频对应进行自监督检测的思路新颖，但受限于音频可用场景，对自动驾驶等纯视觉场景的直接适用性有限。
2104.06401|v2.contribution: 提出基于音视频对应的自监督目标检测框架，无需任何人工标注即可训练检测器。
2104.06401|v2.innovation: 用音频信号作为监督源，通过对比学习联合学习目标分类与定位。
2104.06401|v2.result: 在目标检测和声源定位上超越以往无监督与弱监督方法，且每类仅需一个标签即可对齐真实类别。

2202.04639|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测预训练中定位与识别需求不同的问题，本文提出point-level region contrast（点级区域对比）自监督预训练方法。该方法直接从不同区域采样点对进行对比学习，而非使用区域聚合表示，从而对输入区域质量变化更鲁棒，并通过在线知识蒸馏隐式改进初始区域分配。实验表明该方法在多个任务和数据集上优于最先进的检测与分割预训练方法，并提供了充分的消融与可视化分析。
2202.04639|v2.summary_en: Motivated by the distinct requirements of localization and recognition in detection, this paper presents point-level region contrast, a self-supervised pre-training approach that samples individual point pairs from different regions for contrastive learning. Compared to aggregated region representations, it is more robust to region quality variation and implicitly improves initial region assignments via online knowledge distillation. Experiments show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art pre-training methods for detection and segmentation across multiple tasks and datasets.
2202.04639|v2.assessment: 点级对比预训练思路清晰，对区域质量鲁棒且结合在线蒸馏，对检测预训练研究有较好参考价值。
2202.04639|v2.contribution: 提出点级区域对比自监督预训练方法，提升目标检测与分割的预训练效果。
2202.04639|v2.innovation: 直接采样点对进行对比学习，并通过在线知识蒸馏隐式优化区域分配。
2202.04639|v2.result: 在多个检测与分割任务和数据集上超越最先进预训练方法。

2203.11496|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR-相机融合在恶劣光照和传感器失配等劣质图像条件下鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出TransFusion，一种基于Transformer的鲁棒融合3D检测方法。其核心是软关联机制：检测头第一层解码器用稀疏object queries从点云预测初始框，第二层解码器自适应地将object queries与有用图像特征融合，利用空间和上下文关系决定从图像中取何信息。该注意力机制使模型在图像条件差时仍能有效融合，在nuScenes等基准上取得领先性能。
2203.11496|v2.summary_en: To address the limited robustness of LiDAR-camera fusion under inferior image conditions such as bad illumination and sensor misalignment, this paper proposes TransFusion, a robust transformer-based fusion method with a soft-association mechanism. The first decoder layer predicts initial boxes from the point cloud using sparse object queries, and the second layer adaptively fuses queries with useful image features via attention over spatial and contextual relationships. This enables robust and effective fusion, achieving leading performance on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
2203.11496|v2.assessment: 软关联融合机制有效解决了标定依赖导致的鲁棒性问题，是LiDAR-相机融合3D检测的重要工作，对自动驾驶感知极具参考价值。
2203.11496|v2.contribution: 提出TransFusion，通过软关联机制实现鲁棒的LiDAR-相机融合3D目标检测。
2203.11496|v2.innovation: 用Transformer注意力自适应决定从图像中取何信息，摆脱对硬标定关联的依赖。
2203.11496|v2.result: 在劣质图像条件下仍保持鲁棒，在nuScenes等基准上取得领先性能。

2106.04550|v2.summary_cn: 现有检测自监督预训练多只关注骨干网络，忽略了检测架构的其他关键部分。本文提出DETReg，一种预训练整个检测网络（包括定位和嵌入组件）的自监督方法。预训练时DETReg预测目标定位以匹配无监督区域提议生成器的结果，同时将对应特征嵌入与自监督图像编码器的嵌入对齐。基于DETR系列实现，在COCO、PASCAL VOC和Airbus Ship基准上微调均优于竞争基线，在仅1%标签和少样本设置下提升尤为明显。
2106.04550|v2.summary_en: While existing self-supervised pre-training for detection mainly focuses on the backbone, this paper introduces DETReg, which pre-trains the entire detection network including localization and embedding components. During pre-training, DETReg predicts object localizations to match an unsupervised region proposal generator and aligns feature embeddings with those from a self-supervised image encoder. Implemented with DETR-family detectors, it improves over competitive baselines on COCO, PASCAL VOC, and Airbus Ship, with notable gains in low-data regimes such as 1% labels and few-shot settings.
2106.04550|v2.assessment: 预训练整个检测网络而非仅骨干的思路有价值，低数据场景下的提升对实际应用有吸引力。
2106.04550|v2.contribution: 提出DETReg，自监督预训练完整的目标检测网络（含定位与嵌入组件）。
2106.04550|v2.innovation: 结合无监督区域提议匹配与自监督嵌入对齐，预训练整个DETR检测器。
2106.04550|v2.result: 在COCO、PASCAL VOC、Airbus Ship上优于竞争基线，1%标签和少样本设置下提升显著。

2206.06608|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中mean teacher自训练存在的标签不匹配问题及其导致的严重确认偏差，本文提出LabelMatch框架，从分布级和实例级两个互补视角解决。分布级上，基于蒙特卡洛采样假设未标注数据类别分布可近似标注数据分布，提出重分布mean teacher，用自适应标签分布感知的置信度阈值生成无偏伪标签。实例级上，针对师生模型间被忽视的标签分配歧义，提出proposal self-assignment机制，将学生提议注入教师以生成准确伪标签。
2206.06608|v2.summary_en: To address the label mismatch problem and severe confirmation bias in mean-teacher based semi-supervised object detection, this paper proposes LabelMatch from distribution-level and instance-level perspectives. At the distribution level, a re-distribution mean teacher uses adaptive label-distribution-aware confidence thresholds to generate unbiased pseudo-labels based on Monte Carlo sampling. At the instance level, a proposal self-assignment mechanism injects student proposals into the teacher to resolve label assignment ambiguity and produce accurate pseudo-labels.
2206.06608|v2.assessment: 从分布和实例两个层面系统解决半监督检测的标签不匹配问题，思路完整，对自训练框架改进有参考意义。
2206.06608|v2.contribution: 提出LabelMatch框架，从分布级和实例级解决半监督目标检测的标签不匹配问题。
2206.06608|v2.innovation: 引入重分布mean teacher与proposal self-assignment机制生成无偏且准确的伪标签。
2206.06608|v2.result: 有效缓解确认偏差，提升半监督目标检测性能。

2203.02112|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中伪LiDAR方法因图像到LiDAR的域差距大而导致深度估计误差敏感的问题，本文提出Pseudo-Stereo框架，通过图像级生成、特征级生成和特征克隆三种虚拟视图生成方式将单目输入转化为伪立体对，并设计视差感知动态卷积以自适应过滤特征、缓解深度误差带来的特征退化。分析表明深度损失仅在特征级生成中有效，而估计深度图在图像级和特征级均有效。在KITTI基准上，截至2021年11月18日，该Pseudo-Stereo 3D检测器取得了当时单目3D检测的最优性能。
2203.02112|v2.summary_en: To address the large image-to-LiDAR domain gap in pseudo-LiDAR monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes a Pseudo-Stereo framework that generates virtual stereo views via image-level generation, feature-level generation, and feature-clone, together with a disparity-wise dynamic convolution to adaptively filter features and mitigate depth estimation errors. Analysis shows depth loss is effective only in feature-level generation, while the estimated depth map benefits both levels. As of November 18, 2021, the proposed detector achieved state-of-the-art monocular 3D detection performance on KITTI.
2203.02112|v2.assessment: 将单目3D检测转化为伪立体范式，思路新颖且分析扎实，对单目3D检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2203.02112|v2.contribution: 提出Pseudo-Stereo单目3D检测框架及三种虚拟视图生成方法与视差感知动态卷积。
2203.02112|v2.innovation: 利用图像到图像生成差距远小于图像到LiDAR的洞察，构建伪立体对并引入视差动态卷积。
2203.02112|v2.result: 在KITTI上取得当时单目3D检测的最优性能。

2204.07300|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有半监督目标检测（SSOD）方法多基于anchor-based检测器、而实际应用中更需求anchor-free检测器的问题，本文提出基于密集学习的DSL算法，包含自适应过滤策略以分配多层级精确的密集像素级伪标签、聚合教师以生成稳定精确的伪标签，以及跨尺度与打乱块间的不确定性一致性正则项以提升泛化能力。在MS-COCO和PASCAL-VOC上的实验表明DSL刷新了SSOD的最优性能，大幅超越现有方法。
2204.07300|v2.summary_en: To bridge the gap that most semi-supervised object detection (SSOD) methods rely on anchor-based detectors while anchor-free detectors are more demanded in practice, this paper proposes a DenSe Learning (DSL) based anchor-free SSOD algorithm with an Adaptive Filtering strategy for multi-level dense pixel-wise pseudo-labels, an Aggregated Teacher for stable pseudo-labels, and an uncertainty-consistency regularization across scales and shuffled patches. Experiments on MS-COCO and PASCAL-VOC show DSL sets a new state of the art in SSOD, surpassing existing methods by a large margin.
2204.07300|v2.assessment: 将SSOD拓展到anchor-free范式并系统设计伪标签与一致性机制，实验充分，对检测领域研究者有参考价值。
2204.07300|v2.contribution: 提出面向anchor-free检测器的密集学习半监督目标检测算法DSL。
2204.07300|v2.innovation: 自适应过滤、聚合教师与跨尺度/打乱块不确定性一致性正则的联合设计。
2204.07300|v2.result: 在MS-COCO和PASCAL-VOC上刷新SSOD最优性能，大幅超越现有方法。

2204.12463|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有稀疏卷积网络对所有稀疏数据（点云/体素）一视同仁、未考虑不同空间位置贡献差异的问题，本文提出Focal Sparse Convolution（Focals Conv）及其多模态融合变体Focals Conv-F，通过位置级重要性预测使特征稀疏性可学习，并可即插即用地替换现有Sparse CNN中的普通卷积、端到端联合训练。首次表明空间可学习稀疏性对复杂3D目标检测至关重要。在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo基准上验证有效性，在投稿时于nuScenes测试集上超越所有单模型结果。
2204.12463|v2.summary_en: Observing that existing sparse convolutional networks treat all sparse data uniformly regardless of spatial position, this paper introduces Focal Sparse Convolution (Focals Conv) and its multi-modal variant Focals Conv-F, which make feature sparsity learnable via position-wise importance prediction and can readily replace plain counterparts in existing Sparse CNNs for end-to-end training. It is the first to show that spatially learnable sparsity is essential for sophisticated 3D detection. Experiments on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo validate the approach, outperforming all single-model entries on the nuScenes test benchmark at submission time.
2204.12463|v2.assessment: 即插即用的稀疏卷积改进，通用性强且在大规模基准上验证充分，对3D检测研究者价值很高。
2204.12463|v2.contribution: 提出可学习稀疏性的Focal Sparse Convolution及其多模态融合变体。
2204.12463|v2.innovation: 通过位置级重要性预测使稀疏卷积的特征稀疏性可学习，并支持多模态融合。
2204.12463|v2.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes、Waymo上有效，投稿时nuScenes测试集超越所有单模型结果。

2203.07363|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频伪装目标检测（VCOD）中伪装目标与背景相似、难以从静态图像识别的问题，本文提出统一运动估计与目标分割的框架，利用短时动态与长时时序一致性检测伪装目标。方法构建稠密相关体隐式捕捉相邻帧运动，并用最终分割监督联合优化隐式运动估计与分割，同时用时空Transformer强化时序一致性，避免了现有基于单应性或光流方法中运动估计与分割误差累积的问题。
2203.07363|v2.summary_en: To address video camouflaged object detection (VCOD) where camouflaged objects resemble the background and are hard to identify from still images, this paper proposes a framework that unifies motion estimation and object segmentation, exploiting both short-term dynamics and long-term temporal consistency. It builds a dense correlation volume to implicitly capture inter-frame motion and jointly optimizes implicit motion estimation and segmentation under final segmentation supervision, while a spatio-temporal transformer enforces temporal consistency, avoiding error accumulation in homography/optical-flow based methods.
2203.07363|v2.assessment: 隐式运动建模思路对视频理解有启发，但与自动驾驶/3D感知主线相关度较低。
2203.07363|v2.contribution: 提出统一隐式运动估计与分割的视频伪装目标检测框架。
2203.07363|v2.innovation: 用稠密相关体隐式捕捉运动并以分割监督联合优化，避免显式运动估计误差累积。
2203.07363|v2.result: 在VCOD任务上有效利用短时动态与长时时序一致性提升检测性能。

2203.09704|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云稀疏不规则导致3D检测精度不足、现有多视图方法（BEV与RV）融合时未考虑全局空间上下文的问题，本文提出即插即用的双跨视图空间注意力（VISTA）模块，在全局空间上下文中自适应融合多视图特征，用卷积替换标准注意力中的MLP，并解耦分类与回归任务、施加注意力方差约束。在nuScenes等基准上，VISTA通过高质量融合特征提升提案预测质量，取得优于现有多视图方法的检测性能。
2203.09704|v2.summary_en: To address the limited accuracy of LiDAR 3D detection caused by sparse and irregular point clouds and the failure of existing multi-view (BEV and RV) methods to consider global spatial context, this paper proposes Dual Cross-View Spatial Attention (VISTA), a plug-and-play fusion module that adaptively fuses multi-view features in a global spatial context, replacing the MLP in standard attention with convolution, decoupling classification and regression, and applying an attention variance constraint. On benchmarks such as nuScenes, VISTA produces high-quality fused features and improves proposal prediction over existing multi-view methods.
2203.09704|v2.assessment: 多视图融合是BEV/3D检测的重要方向，VISTA模块即插即用且设计合理，值得关注。
2203.09704|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的双跨视图空间注意力多视图特征融合模块VISTA。
2203.09704|v2.innovation: 以卷积替代注意力MLP并在全局空间上下文中自适应融合BEV与RV特征，解耦分类回归。
2203.09704|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得优于现有多视图方法的3D检测性能。

2203.03800|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测器对分布外（OOD）目标过度自信、缺乏未知数据监督信号的问题，本文提出基于时空未知蒸馏（STUD）的未知感知目标检测框架，先在空间维度识别未知候选提案，再跨多视频帧聚合形成决策边界附近的多样未知目标，并用基于能量的不确定性正则损失对比性地塑造分布内与蒸馏未知目标之间的不确定性空间。STUD在目标检测OOD任务上取得最优性能，相比此前最佳方法将FPR95降低超过10%。
2203.03800|v2.summary_en: To address overconfident predictions on out-of-distribution (OOD) objects caused by the lack of unknown-data supervision, this paper proposes an unknown-aware object detection framework via Spatial-Temporal Unknown Distillation (STUD), which identifies unknown candidate proposals spatially, aggregates them across video frames to form diverse unknown objects near the decision boundary, and employs an energy-based uncertainty regularization loss to contrastively shape the uncertainty space. STUD achieves state-of-the-art OOD detection performance for object detection, reducing FPR95 by over 10% compared to the previous best method.
2203.03800|v2.assessment: 开放集/OOD检测对自动驾驶安全至关重要，STUD利用野外视频蒸馏未知目标，思路新颖且效果显著。
2203.03800|v2.contribution: 提出基于时空未知蒸馏的未知感知目标检测框架STUD。
2203.03800|v2.innovation: 从野外视频中空间识别并跨帧聚合未知目标，结合能量不确定性正则塑造决策边界。
2203.03800|v2.result: 在目标检测OOD任务上取得最优性能，FPR95相比此前最佳方法降低超过10%。

2203.14940|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测中，基于视觉语言模型的方法依赖精心设计的文本提示，现有面向图像分类的提示学习方案直接迁移到检测任务上效果次优。本文提出 DetPro，学习连续提示表示用于开放词汇检测，包含两个关键设计：背景解释方案将图像背景中的候选框纳入提示训练，上下文分级方案将候选框按与目标的关联程度分离处理。相比人工提示工程和分类导向的提示学习方法，DetPro 在 LVIS 数据集上取得了更优的开放词汇检测性能，验证了检测专用提示学习的有效性。
2203.14940|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection with vision-language models relies on carefully engineered text prompts, and existing classification-oriented prompt learning methods are sub-optimal for detection. This paper proposes DetPro, which learns continuous prompt representations with a background interpretation scheme that incorporates background proposals into prompt training and a context grading scheme that separates proposals by their relevance to objects. DetPro outperforms hand-crafted prompts and classification-oriented prompt learning baselines on the LVIS benchmark, demonstrating the benefit of detection-specific prompt learning.
2203.14940|v2.assessment: 该工作针对开放词汇检测中提示工程的痛点提出检测专用的连续提示学习方案，思路清晰且与视觉语言模型结合紧密，对开放世界感知研究有参考价值。
2203.14940|v2.contribution: 提出面向开放词汇目标检测的连续提示学习方法 DetPro，替代人工提示工程。
2203.14940|v2.innovation: 引入背景解释与上下文分级两种检测专用机制，将背景候选框纳入提示训练并区分候选框与目标的关联程度。
2203.14940|v2.result: 在 LVIS 等开放词汇检测基准上优于人工提示与分类导向的提示学习方法。

2307.08095|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对DETR框架在半监督目标检测（SSOD）中的两个核心问题：一是one-to-one匹配在伪标签框不准确时产生错误匹配导致训练低效，二是DETR缺乏输入query与输出预测之间的确定性对应关系，阻碍了基于一致性的正则化方法的应用。作者提出了Semi-DETR，首个基于Transformer的端到端半监督目标检测器，包含三个关键组件：Stage-wise Hybrid Matching策略（结合one-to-many和one-to-one分配以提升第一阶段训练效率并为第二阶段提供高质量伪标签）、Cross-view Query Consistency方法（学习不同视图下object query的语义特征不变性而无需确定性query对应）以及Cost-based Pseudo Label Mining模块（基于匹配代价动态挖掘更多伪框）。相比已有SSOD方法，Semi-DETR首次将DETR范式成功引入半监督检测，在COCO等基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
2307.08095|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies two key issues of DETR-based frameworks in semi-supervised object detection: one-to-one assignment generates incorrect matching with inaccurate pseudo-labels, and the lack of deterministic query-prediction correspondence hinders consistency regularization. The authors propose Semi-DETR, the first transformer-based end-to-end semi-supervised object detector, featuring a Stage-wise Hybrid Matching strategy, Cross-view Query Consistency, and Cost-based Pseudo Label Mining. Semi-DETR achieves significant improvements over existing SSOD methods on standard benchmarks.
2307.08095|v2.assessment: 首次将DETR范式成功引入半监督目标检测，系统分析了DETR在SSOD中的核心瓶颈并给出有效解决方案，对DETR和SSOD两个方向的研究者都有重要参考价值。
2307.08095|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于Transformer的端到端半监督目标检测器Semi-DETR，包含阶段式混合匹配、跨视图查询一致性和基于代价的伪标签挖掘三个核心模块。
2307.08095|v2.innovation: 将one-to-many与one-to-one匹配策略分阶段结合，并通过跨视图查询一致性避免了对确定性query对应的需求。
2307.08095|v2.result: 在COCO等标准半监督检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的检测性能，验证了DETR范式在半监督检测中的有效性。

Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.summary_cn: 本文针对野外场景下3D目标检测缺乏大规模统一基准的问题，提出了Omni3D——一个大规模3D目标检测基准和模型。现有3D检测数据集通常局限于特定场景（如室内或自动驾驶），缺乏跨域泛化能力。Omni3D整合了多个现有数据集，构建了包含大量标注图像和多样化类别的大规模基准，并提出了Cube R-CNN模型，通过处理不同相机内参和场景类型实现统一的3D检测。相比已有工作，Omni3D在规模和多样性上有显著提升，Cube R-CNN在跨数据集泛化上表现优异。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a large-scale unified benchmark for 3D object detection in the wild by introducing Omni3D, a large benchmark aggregating multiple existing datasets with diverse scenes and categories. The authors also propose Cube R-CNN, a model that handles varying camera intrinsics for unified 3D detection. Omni3D significantly advances cross-dataset generalization for monocular 3D detection.
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.assessment: Omni3D填补了野外3D检测大规模统一基准的空白，对推动单目3D检测的泛化性研究具有重要意义，是该领域的重要基础设施贡献。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.contribution: 构建了大规模统一的3D目标检测基准Omni3D，并提出了能处理多样场景和相机参数的Cube R-CNN模型。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.innovation: 通过整合多个异构数据集构建统一基准，并提出适应不同相机内参的通用3D检测框架。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.result: 在跨数据集3D检测任务上取得了显著的泛化性能提升，为后续研究提供了标准化评估平台。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for._arxiv_id: Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for 3D Object Detection in the Wild.

Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.summary_cn: 本文针对目标检测与分割任务长期分离的问题，提出了Mask DINO——一个统一的基于Transformer的检测与分割框架。现有方法通常将检测和分割作为独立任务处理，缺乏统一架构。Mask DINO在DINO的基础上引入mask预测分支，通过共享的Transformer编码器-解码器架构同时完成目标检测、实例分割和全景分割任务。相比已有工作，Mask DINO首次在DETR框架下实现了检测与分割的统一，并在多个基准上取得了领先性能，展示了统一框架的优越性。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.summary_en: This paper proposes Mask DINO, a unified Transformer-based framework for object detection and segmentation. By extending DINO with a mask prediction branch, Mask DINO simultaneously handles detection, instance segmentation, and panoptic segmentation within a shared encoder-decoder architecture. It achieves state-of-the-art results across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of unified detection and segmentation.
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.assessment: Mask DINO是DETR系列的重要扩展，首次在统一Transformer框架下实现检测与分割的联合建模，对检测和分割社区均有重要影响。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.contribution: 提出了统一的Transformer框架Mask DINO，同时支持目标检测、实例分割和全景分割。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.innovation: 在DINO基础上引入mask分支，通过共享架构实现检测与分割任务的统一建模。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.result: 在COCO等基准上在检测、实例分割和全景分割任务上均取得了领先或竞争性性能。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer._arxiv_id: Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer-based Framework for Object Detection and Segmentation.

2304.07082|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对跨域弱监督目标检测（CDWSOD）问题，提出了一种基于DETR的方法DETR-GA。核心洞察是DETR的编码器和解码器均基于注意力机制，能够聚合全图语义信息，其聚合结果（图像级预测）可自然利用弱监督进行域对齐。具体地，作者在编码器中添加多个类别query、在解码器中添加前景query，分别聚合语义为图像级预测，实现"实例级+图像级"预测和"强+弱"监督的同时利用。相比已有CDWSOD方法，DETR-GA的query聚合机制能粗略定位对应位置并排除无关区域干扰，在跨域弱监督检测任务上取得了改进。
2304.07082|v2.summary_en: This paper presents DETR-GA for cross-domain weakly supervised object detection (CDWSOD), leveraging DETR's attention-based encoder and decoder to aggregate image-level semantics for domain alignment. By adding class queries to the encoder and a foreground query to the decoder, DETR-GA simultaneously makes instance-level and image-level predictions under strong and weak supervision. The query-based aggregation enables rough localization and distraction exclusion, improving cross-domain detection performance.
2304.07082|v2.assessment: 将DETR的注意力聚合能力巧妙应用于跨域弱监督检测，思路新颖但应用场景相对小众，对该特定方向的研究者有参考价值。
2304.07082|v2.contribution: 提出了DETR-GA，通过编码器类别query和解码器前景query实现图像级语义聚合，用于跨域弱监督目标检测。
2304.07082|v2.innovation: 利用DETR注意力机制的全局聚合能力自然实现弱监督域对齐，同时进行实例级和图像级预测。
2304.07082|v2.result: 在跨域弱监督目标检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。

Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.summary_cn: 本文针对RAW图像域目标检测的问题，指出现有检测方法主要针对sRGB图像设计，而RAW格式保留了更丰富的线性光照信息但缺乏专门的基准和方法。作者构建了一个新的RAW目标检测基准数据集，并提出了针对RAW域特性的检测模型。相比在sRGB图像上的已有工作，该研究首次系统性地探索了RAW域目标检测，验证了RAW数据在低光照等挑战性场景下的优势，为该方向开辟了新的研究路径。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.summary_en: This paper addresses RAW-domain object detection, noting that existing detectors are designed for sRGB images while RAW format preserves richer linear illumination information. The authors construct a new RAW object detection benchmark and propose a detection model tailored to RAW characteristics. This work is the first to systematically explore RAW-domain detection, demonstrating advantages in challenging scenarios such as low-light conditions.
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.assessment: 首次系统性探索RAW域目标检测，构建了新基准并验证了RAW数据的优势，对自动驾驶和低光照感知场景有潜在应用价值。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.contribution: 构建了RAW目标检测新基准并提出针对RAW域特性的检测模型。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.innovation: 首次系统性地将目标检测拓展到RAW图像域，利用RAW的线性光照信息提升检测性能。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.result: 在自建RAW检测基准上验证了RAW域检测在低光照等场景下优于sRGB域方法的性能。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench._arxiv_id: Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Benchmark and A New Model.

2212.07289|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对DETR-based 3D检测器性能落后于稠密检测器的问题，指出DETR通常使用远多于GT的query数量（如Waymo中300个query对40个目标），导致推理时产生大量假阳性。作者观察到大多数假阳性在局部区域高度重叠，源于缺乏显式监督来区分局部相似的query。为此提出了ConQueR（Query Contrast Voxel-DETR），通过Query Contrast机制为每个GT构建正负GT-query对，并基于特征相似度设计对比损失增强正对、抑制负对。ConQueR缩小了稀疏与稠密3D检测器之间的差距，减少了约60%的假阳性，实现了更准确且更稀疏的预测。
2212.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap between DETR-based 3D detectors and dense detectors, attributing it to excessive false positives from the large query-to-GT ratio. The authors propose ConQueR (Query Contrast Voxel-DETR), which introduces a Query Contrast mechanism that constructs positive and negative GT-query pairs and applies a contrastive loss based on feature similarity. ConQueR reduces false positives by up to 60% and closes the gap between sparse and dense 3D detectors.
2212.07289|v2.assessment: 针对DETR-based 3D检测器假阳性问题的精准分析和对策，Query Contrast机制简洁有效，对3D检测和DETR方向的研究者均有重要参考价值。
2212.07289|v2.contribution: 提出了Query Contrast机制和ConQueR检测器，通过对比学习显式区分局部相似query，大幅减少假阳性。
2212.07289|v2.innovation: 构建正负GT-query对并设计对比损失，显式增强query对最佳匹配GT的判别能力。
2212.07289|v2.result: 在Waymo等3D检测基准上减少约60%假阳性，缩小了稀疏DETR检测器与稠密检测器的性能差距。

Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇目标检测中DETR类模型依赖大规模视觉-语言预训练、知识蒸馏中视觉与语言模态知识难以有效迁移的问题；②提出将视觉-语言知识蒸馏到DETR检测器中，通过蒸馏CLIP等视觉-语言模型的知识提升开放词汇检测能力；③相比已有仅利用视觉特征或简单对齐的方法，更充分地利用了语言模态的语义知识；④摘要未提供，无法引用具体数据。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object detection by distilling visual-linguistic knowledge into DETR-based detectors. It proposes to transfer knowledge from vision-language models to improve the detector's ability to recognize novel categories. The approach leverages both visual and linguistic modalities, going beyond prior methods that rely solely on visual features. No quantitative results are available in the provided abstract.
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.assessment: 开放词汇检测是当前热点，将视觉-语言蒸馏引入DETR具有实用价值，但需关注具体实验效果。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.contribution: 提出将视觉-语言知识蒸馏用于DETR开放词汇目标检测。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.innovation: 利用视觉-语言模型的多模态知识蒸馏增强DETR的开放词汇能力。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K._arxiv_id: Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic Knowledge for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

2304.11463|v2.summary_cn: ①针对基于语言的目标检测缺乏合适评估基准的问题，现有方法虽有进展但评估不足；②提出OmniLabel任务定义、数据集和评估指标，涵盖标准/开放词汇检测和指代表达，包含超过25K图像上的28K+独特物体描述，且描述可指向一个、多个甚至零个物体（提供负样本）；③与现有基准的关键区别在于支持自由文本负样本和自然开放词汇设置，评估采用改进的平均精度指标处理大标签空间；④通过评估强语言基线验证了基准的挑战性。
