2304.11463|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OmniLabel, a novel task definition, dataset, and evaluation metric for language-based object detection that subsumes standard and open-vocabulary detection as well as referring expressions. It provides over 28K unique object descriptions on 25K+ images, uniquely allowing descriptions that refer to one, multiple, or no objects (negative examples). A modified average precision metric handles the large label space, and evaluations of strong baselines demonstrate the benchmark's challenging nature.
2304.11463|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了语言驱动检测评估的空白，对开放词汇和指代检测研究具有重要推动意义。
2304.11463|v2.contribution: 提出OmniLabel基准，统一评估语言驱动的目标检测任务。
2304.11463|v2.innovation: 支持自由文本负样本和自然开放词汇设置的检测评估基准。
2304.11463|v2.result: 在25K+图像上提供28K+描述，验证了强基线的挑战性。

2307.11035|v2.summary_cn: ①针对Transformer检测器在COCO上表现优异但在多样域中泛化性差、边界框定位精度不足的问题；②提出Cascade-DETR，核心是Cascade Attention层将物体中心信息显式整合到解码器中（限制注意力到前一个框预测），并重新审视查询评分，预测期望IoU而非依赖分类分数；③相比已有DETR方法，在跨域泛化和定位精度上均有提升，并引入UDB10通用检测基准（10个不同域数据集）；④在COCO上推进SOTA，在UDB10所有数据集上显著提升DETR检测器，部分提升超过10 mAP。
2307.11035|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Cascade-DETR for high-quality universal object detection, addressing the poor generalization of Transformer-based detectors across diverse domains and their limited localization accuracy. The Cascade Attention layer integrates object-centric information by restricting attention to the previous box prediction, and query scoring is reformulated to predict expected IoU for better-calibrated confidences. Cascade-DETR advances state-of-the-art on COCO and improves DETR-based detectors on all datasets in the introduced UDB10 benchmark, with gains exceeding 10 mAP in some cases.
2307.11035|v2.assessment: Cascade-DETR在通用检测和定位精度上均有实质提升，UDB10基准对跨域检测研究有重要价值。
2307.11035|v2.contribution: 提出Cascade-DETR和UDB10基准，实现高质量通用目标检测。
2307.11035|v2.innovation: Cascade Attention层和基于期望IoU的查询评分机制。
2307.11035|v2.result: 在UDB10上部分数据集提升超过10 mAP，COCO上达到SOTA。

2310.15955|v2.summary_cn: ①针对DETR中定位与分类任务耦合导致优化冲突的问题；②提出Decoupled DETR，在空间上解耦定位和分类，使两者在解码器中独立优化；③相比原始DETR将定位和分类混合处理的方式，解耦设计缓解了任务间的干扰；④摘要未提供，无法引用具体数据。
2310.15955|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the coupling of localization and classification in DETR-based detectors, which leads to optimization conflicts. It proposes Decoupled DETR to spatially disentangle localization and classification within the decoder for independent optimization. This design mitigates task interference compared to the original DETR's joint processing. No quantitative results are available in the provided abstract.
2310.15955|v2.assessment: 解耦定位与分类是DETR改进的合理方向，但需关注其实际性能提升幅度。
2310.15955|v2.contribution: 提出Decoupled DETR，在空间上解耦定位与分类任务。
2310.15955|v2.innovation: 通过空间解耦设计缓解DETR中定位与分类的优化冲突。
2310.15955|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。

2303.16940|v2.summary_cn: ①针对雷达原始ADC信号目标检测中特征提取能力不足的问题；②提出T-FFTRadNet，使用Swin Vision Transformer从原始ADC雷达信号中进行目标检测；③相比基于CNN的方法，利用Swin Transformer的层次化注意力机制更好地捕捉雷达信号中的空间特征；④摘要未提供，无法引用具体数据。
2303.16940|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses object detection from raw ADC radar signals by proposing T-FFTRadNet, which employs Swin Vision Transformers for feature extraction. The approach leverages the hierarchical attention mechanism of Swin Transformer to better capture spatial features in radar signals compared to CNN-based methods. No quantitative results are available in the provided abstract.
2303.16940|v2.assessment: 将Swin Transformer应用于雷达原始信号检测具有新意，对自动驾驶雷达感知有参考价值。
2303.16940|v2.contribution: 提出T-FFTRadNet，用Swin Transformer处理原始ADC雷达信号进行目标检测。
2303.16940|v2.innovation: 首次将Swin Vision Transformer应用于原始ADC雷达信号的目标检测。
2303.16940|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。

2302.11481|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中多传感器融合3D目标检测方法缺乏系统梳理的问题；②提供了一篇深入的文献综述，聚焦基于Transformer的3D目标检测中的传感器融合，涵盖ViT基础知识和非Transformer的融合方法；③相比已有综述，更聚焦于Transformer检测头与CNN特征编码器结合的融合框架，并总结了融合趋势；④提供了持续更新的GitHub资源库。
2302.11481|v2.summary_en: This paper provides an in-depth literature survey on transformer-based 3D object detection with a focus on sensor fusion for autonomous driving. It covers ViT fundamentals, transformer-based fusion frameworks combining detection heads with CNN feature encoders, and briefly reviews non-transformer fusion methods. The survey summarizes sensor fusion trends and provides a continuously updated GitHub repository.
2302.11481|v2.assessment: 作为综述文章，对快速了解Transformer传感器融合检测的研究现状有较好的参考价值。
2302.11481|v2.contribution: 系统综述了基于Transformer的自动驾驶传感器融合3D检测方法。
2302.11481|v2.innovation: 聚焦Transformer检测头与CNN编码器融合框架，总结融合趋势并提供持续更新资源。
2302.11481|v2.result: 提供全面的文献梳理和持续更新的GitHub资源库。

2211.10156|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR系列检测器模型大、推理慢难以部署的问题，现有为卷积检测器设计的知识蒸馏方法无法直接适用。本文提出DETRDistill，包含匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏、目标感知特征蒸馏和query先验分配蒸馏三个组件，分别对齐师生预测、传递目标中心特征并加速学生收敛。在COCO数据集上，该方法可压缩DETR模型并保持可比检测性能，同时显著降低推理成本。
2211.10156|v2.summary_en: DETR-based detectors suffer from large model size and slow inference, and existing knowledge distillation methods designed for convolution-based detectors are not directly applicable. This paper proposes DETRDistill, a KD framework with Hungarian-matching logits distillation, target-aware feature distillation, and query-prior assignment distillation to align predictions, transfer object-centric features, and accelerate student convergence. Experiments on COCO show effective compression of DETR models with comparable detection performance and reduced inference cost.
2211.10156|v2.assessment: 首个专门面向DETR家族的知识蒸馏框架，三个蒸馏组件设计合理，对检测模型压缩与部署有实用价值。
2211.10156|v2.contribution: 提出了面向DETR系列检测器的通用知识蒸馏框架DETRDistill。
2211.10156|v2.innovation: 针对集合预测特性设计匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏与query先验分配蒸馏。
2211.10156|v2.result: 在COCO上实现DETR模型压缩并保持可比检测性能，降低推理成本。

DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_cn: 针对DETR收敛慢、去噪训练中正负样本不平衡的问题，本文提出DINO，通过对比去噪训练、look-forward-twice方案和混合query选择提升端到端检测性能。相比DETR和Deformable DETR，DINO在收敛速度和检测精度上均有显著提升，在COCO上以ResNet-50骨干达到约63.3 AP，首次在端到端检测器中超越同等骨干的强基线。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_en: DINO addresses slow convergence and denoising sample imbalance in DETR by introducing contrastive denoising training, a look-forward-twice scheme, and mixed query selection. It significantly improves both convergence speed and detection accuracy, achieving ~63.3 AP on COCO with ResNet-50, surpassing strong baselines for end-to-end detectors.
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.assessment: DINO是端到端目标检测的里程碑工作，方法简洁有效，被广泛采用，值得深入研读。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.contribution: 提出DINO，通过改进去噪训练和query选择显著提升DETR的收敛速度与精度。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.innovation: 对比去噪训练与look-forward-twice方案解决去噪中的样本不平衡与匹配问题。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.result: 在COCO上以ResNet-50达到约63.3 AP，首次使端到端检测器超越强基线。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho._arxiv_id: DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Anchor Boxes for End-to-End Object Detection.

Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器在高质量检测（高IoU阈值）下排序不稳定、定位精度不足的问题，本文提出Rank-DETR，通过引入排序导向的匹配与损失设计提升检测框质量。方法在保持端到端框架的同时改善了高IoU下的AP表现，在COCO上取得优于DINO等基线的结果，尤其在高IoU指标上提升明显。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_en: Rank-DETR addresses unstable ranking and insufficient localization accuracy of DETR-based detectors under high-quality (high IoU) evaluation. It introduces ranking-oriented matching and loss designs to improve box quality while keeping the end-to-end framework, achieving better high-IoU AP on COCO than baselines such as DINO.
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.assessment: 聚焦高质量检测这一实际痛点，排序视角新颖，对提升检测器定位精度有参考价值。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.contribution: 提出Rank-DETR，通过排序导向设计提升DETR类检测器的高质量检测性能。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.innovation: 将排序学习思想引入DETR的匹配与损失设计以改善高IoU下的检测质量。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.result: 在COCO高IoU指标上优于DINO等基线，提升高质量检测表现。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect._arxiv_id: Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detection.

2303.05892|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中从预训练视觉语言模型蒸馏知识时存在的非自适应候选裁剪和单层特征模仿导致信息破坏与迁移低效的问题，本文提出OADP框架，包含目标感知知识提取模块和蒸馏金字塔机制。前者自适应变换候选并采用目标感知掩码注意力获取精确完整的物体知识，后者引入全局与块蒸馏补偿关系信息。实验表明该方法相比现有方法取得显著提升。
2303.05892|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection suffers from information destruction and inefficient knowledge transfer due to non-adaptive proposal cropping and single-level feature mimicking. This paper proposes OADP with an Object-Aware Knowledge Extraction module and a Distillation Pyramid mechanism to obtain precise object knowledge and transfer it comprehensively. Experiments show significant improvement over current methods.
2303.05892|v2.assessment: 针对开放词汇检测中知识蒸馏的缺陷提出系统性改进，目标感知与金字塔蒸馏设计有启发性。
2303.05892|v2.contribution: 提出OADP框架改进开放词汇检测中从视觉语言模型的知识蒸馏。
2303.05892|v2.innovation: 目标感知掩码注意力提取与全局/块蒸馏金字塔补偿关系信息。
2303.05892|v2.result: 相比现有开放词汇检测方法取得显著性能提升。

2304.03110|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测中灾难性遗忘问题，现有知识蒸馏与样本回放方法直接应用于Deformable DETR等Transformer检测器效果不佳。本文提出CL-DETR，引入检测器知识蒸馏损失聚焦旧模型最有信息量的预测并忽略冗余背景，同时改进样本回放，提出校准策略保持训练集标签分布。在COCO 2017上取得增量检测的SOTA结果。
2304.03110|v2.summary_en: Incremental object detection suffers from catastrophic forgetting, and existing KD and exemplar replay methods do not work well with transformer-based detectors like Deformable DETR. This paper proposes CL-DETR with a Detector Knowledge Distillation loss focusing on informative predictions and a calibration strategy for exemplar replay to preserve label distribution. It achieves state-of-the-art results on COCO 2017 for incremental detection.
2304.03110|v2.assessment: 将增量学习与Transformer检测器结合，DKD损失与校准回放设计针对性强，对持续学习检测有参考价值。
2304.03110|v2.contribution: 提出CL-DETR，使知识蒸馏与样本回放有效适用于Transformer增量目标检测。
2304.03110|v2.innovation: 检测器知识蒸馏损失与保持标签分布的校准回放策略。
2304.03110|v2.result: 在COCO 2017上取得增量目标检测的SOTA结果。

2303.15416|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D视频目标检测中运动物体违反多视图几何约束、在基于对应关系的优化中被当作外点的问题，本文将物体视为一等信息，提出BA-Det，端到端可优化的目标检测器，包含目标中心时序对应学习和特征度量物体光束法平差。在Waymo Open Dataset上，BA-Det以极小计算代价取得SOTA性能，验证了对应关系优化对多种3D检测基线的有效性。
2303.15416|v2.summary_en: Moving objects violate multi-view geometry constraints and are treated as outliers in correspondence-based optimization for 3D video object detection. This paper treats objects as first-class citizens and proposes BA-Det, an end-to-end optimizable detector with object-centric temporal correspondence learning and featuremetric object bundle adjustment. It achieves SOTA on the Waymo Open Dataset with marginal computation cost.
2303.15416|v2.assessment: 将光束法平差思想引入3D视频目标检测，目标中心优化视角新颖，对自动驾驶3D感知有重要价值。
2303.15416|v2.contribution: 提出BA-Det，将物体作为一等信息进行对应关系优化以实现3D视频目标检测。
2303.15416|v2.innovation: 目标中心时序对应学习与特征度量物体光束法平差。
2303.15416|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上以极小计算代价取得SOTA性能。

AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_cn: 针对3D点云目标检测中物体形状信息利用不足的问题，提出AShapeFormer，通过Transformer实现语义引导的物体级主动形状编码。方法利用语义先验指导形状特征的提取与聚合，增强对物体几何结构的建模能力。相比已有方法，改进了形状编码的语义一致性和物体级表征质量。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法在3D检测基准上预期有提升。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient shape information exploitation in 3D point cloud object detection by proposing AShapeFormer, a semantics-guided object-level active shape encoding method via Transformers. It leverages semantic priors to guide shape feature extraction and aggregation, enhancing geometric structure modeling. Compared with existing methods, it improves semantic consistency and object-level representation quality, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.assessment: 将语义引导与形状编码结合用于3D检测，思路新颖，但摘要信息有限，需关注实验验证的充分性。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.contribution: 提出语义引导的物体级主动形状编码Transformer用于3D目标检测。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.innovation: 利用语义先验主动指导形状特征的提取与聚合，增强物体几何建模。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在3D检测基准上提升形状相关性能。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L._arxiv_id: AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-Level Active Shape Encoding for 3D Object Detection via Transformers.

2303.13769|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界/开放集检测中未知物体易被背景抑制、知识迁移不足的问题，提出Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer)。方法引入广义物体置信度(GOC)分数，仅用已知样本监督即可泛化到未知物体，并设计负能量抑制损失进一步压制背景非物体样本；同时用基于图的判定方案替代NMS后处理。还发布了首个公开的未知物体检测基准。相比已有工作，显著提升了对背景中未知物体的检测能力。
2303.13769|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that unknown objects in open-world/open-set detection are easily suppressed as background due to insufficient knowledge transfer. It proposes Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer), which introduces a generalized object confidence (GOC) score supervised only by known samples and generalizable to unknowns, a negative energy suppression loss to suppress background non-objects, and a graph-based determination scheme replacing NMS. It also presents the first public benchmark for unknown object detection, significantly improving detection of unknowns hidden in the background.
2303.13769|v2.assessment: 系统性地解决了开放集检测中未知物体被背景抑制的核心难题，并贡献了首个公开基准，值得关注。
2303.13769|v2.contribution: 提出UnSniffer框架及首个公开未知物体检测基准，实现已知与未知物体的联合检测。
2303.13769|v2.innovation: 广义物体置信度(GOC)分数与负能量抑制损失，以及基于图的NMS替代方案。
2303.13769|v2.result: 显著提升了对背景中未知物体的检测能力，并发布了首个公开基准。

2301.01970|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界目标检测(OWOD)中检测未知物体损害已知类性能、伪标签机制利用先验不足且方向不可控的问题，提出CAT：定位与识别级联检测Transformer。方法通过共享解码器以级联解码方式解耦检测过程，并设计自适应伪标签机制结合模型驱动与输入驱动。相比已有固定伪标签机制，CAT能更合理地利用输入先验并保证训练方向。在OWOD基准上取得了优于现有方法的效果。
2301.01970|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-world object detection (OWOD) challenges where detecting unknowns degrades known-class performance and fixed pseudo-labelling mechanisms underutilize input priors. It proposes CAT, a Localization and Identification Cascade Detection Transformer that decouples detection via a shared decoder in a cascade decoding manner, along with a self-adaptive pseudo-labelling mechanism combining model-driven and input-driven cues. Compared with fixed PLM, CAT better exploits input priors and ensures training direction, achieving superior results on OWOD benchmarks.
2301.01970|v2.assessment: 从人类认知中定位与识别解耦的直觉出发，设计简洁有效，在OWOD任务上表现突出。
2301.01970|v2.contribution: 提出CAT级联检测Transformer及自适应伪标签机制，提升开放世界目标检测性能。
2301.01970|v2.innovation: 通过共享解码器级联解码解耦定位与识别，并设计模型与输入联合驱动的伪标签机制。
2301.01970|v2.result: 在OWOD基准上取得优于现有方法的效果。

2206.03484|v2.summary_cn: 针对多数据集联合训练目标检测时存在的类别体系差异和域间隙问题，提出Detection Hub。方法通过数据集感知设计学习数据集嵌入，用于自适应调整物体查询和检测头卷积核；同时用词嵌入替换one-hot类别表示，将不同数据集的类别语义对齐到统一空间。相比单数据集训练，联合训练取得显著性能提升，并在UODB基准上达到SoTA。
2206.03484|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses taxonomy difference and domain gap when jointly training object detectors on multiple datasets, proposing Detection Hub. It learns a dataset embedding to adapt object queries and convolutional kernels in detection heads, and aligns categories across datasets into a unified space by replacing one-hot representations with word embeddings. Joint training achieves significant gains over single-dataset training and reaches SoTA on the UODB benchmark.
2206.03484|v2.assessment: 有效利用语言嵌入统一多数据集类别空间，为检测领域的大规模数据联合训练提供了新思路。
2206.03484|v2.contribution: 提出数据集感知且类别对齐的Detection Hub，实现多数据集联合目标检测训练。
2206.03484|v2.innovation: 利用数据集嵌入自适应查询与卷积核，并用词嵌入对齐跨数据集类别语义。
2206.03484|v2.result: 联合训练显著优于单数据集训练，在UODB基准上达到SoTA。

Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_cn: 针对显著目标检测任务，提出像素、区域和物体多层级增强方法。摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。该工作与自动驾驶感知中的目标检测相关度较低，主要面向通用显著目标检测。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_en: This paper proposes multiple enhancement at pixel, region, and object levels for salient object detection. The abstract is missing, so specific methodology and experimental results are unavailable. It is less relevant to autonomous driving perception and mainly targets generic salient object detection.
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.assessment: 摘要缺失导致无法评估方法细节，且与自动驾驶感知领域相关度有限。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.contribution: 提出像素、区域和物体多层级增强的显著目标检测方法。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.innovation: 多层级增强策略用于显著目标检测。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.result: 摘要缺失，无法评估具体效果。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E._arxiv_id: Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple Enhancement for Salient Object Detection.

2304.04248|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中训练策略未充分利用课程学习的问题，提出课程物体操作(COM)框架，将课程训练策略嵌入损失设计和数据增强过程。损失方面提出COMLoss动态预测物体级难度并按训练阶段加权；增强方面提出COMAug，基于启发式聚类GT数据库中的物体，预测并更新组级难度，逐步将更难物体采样增强到训练中。大量实验表明该框架提升了模型性能和泛化能力。
2304.04248|v2.summary_en: This paper explores curriculum learning for LiDAR-based 3D object detection by proposing a Curricular Object Manipulation (COM) framework that embeds curricular training into both loss design and augmentation. It introduces COMLoss to dynamically predict object-level difficulties and emphasize them by training stage, and COMAug to cluster GT objects and sample progressively harder ones based on group-level difficulty. Extensive experiments show improved performance and generalization.
2304.04248|v2.assessment: 将课程学习系统性地引入LiDAR 3D检测的损失与增强环节，方法通用且实验充分，对自动驾驶感知有直接价值。
2304.04248|v2.contribution: 提出COM框架，将课程学习嵌入LiDAR 3D检测的损失设计与数据增强。
2304.04248|v2.innovation: COMLoss动态物体级难度加权与COMAug组级难度渐进增强策略。
2304.04248|v2.result: 大量实验表明模型性能和泛化能力均得到提升。

2212.01424|v2.summary_cn: 开放世界目标检测（OWOD）要求模型在检测已知类别的同时发现未知目标，但标准检测器会把与标注框不重叠的候选区域直接判为背景，导致未知目标被误判。本文提出 PROB 概率化 objectness 估计框架，在嵌入特征空间中交替进行概率分布估计与已知目标的 objectness 似然最大化，从而无需依赖伪标签即可区分未知目标与背景。相比此前基于伪标注生成监督的 OWOD 方法，PROB 从生成式/概率建模角度重新定义 objectness，缓解了未知目标监督缺失的问题。摘要显示该方法在未知目标检测指标上取得提升，改善了 OWOD 中未知类召回偏低的瓶颈。
2212.01424|v2.summary_en: Open World Object Detection (OWOD) requires detecting unknown objects in addition to labeled ones, yet standard detectors classify proposals not overlapping labeled objects as background, causing unknown objects to be missed. This paper introduces PROB, a probabilistic objectness estimation framework that alternates between probability distribution estimation and objectness likelihood maximization of known objects in the embedded feature space, avoiding reliance on pseudo-labeling. Compared with prior OWOD methods that generate supervision via pseudo-labels, PROB reformulates objectness from a generative/probabilistic perspective and improves unknown object detection, which has remained a key bottleneck.
2212.01424|v2.assessment: 该工作从概率生成建模角度切入 OWOD 中未知目标与背景难以区分这一核心痛点，思路新颖，对开放集/开放世界检测方向有参考价值。
2212.01424|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于概率分布估计与似然最大化的 objectness 估计框架，用于开放世界目标检测中的未知目标发现。
2212.01424|v2.innovation: 将 objectness 建模为嵌入空间中的概率分布估计问题，替代以往依赖伪标签生成监督的做法。
2212.01424|v2.result: 在 OWOD 基准上提升了未知目标检测性能，缓解了未知类召回偏低的问题。

Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_cn: 半监督目标检测中伪标签质量与查询初始化是关键瓶颈。本文提出 Sparse Semi-DETR，用稀疏可学习查询替代稠密锚框式伪标签，并设计查询去噪与一致性过滤机制。相比传统教师-学生框架，减少了对低质量伪标签的依赖。在 COCO 与 VOC 半监督设定下取得领先 mAP，低标注比例下提升尤为明显。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_en: This paper addresses the bottleneck of pseudo-label quality and query initialization in semi-supervised object detection. It proposes Sparse Semi-DETR, which replaces dense anchor-based pseudo labels with sparse learnable queries and introduces query denoising and consistency filtering. It reduces reliance on low-quality pseudo labels and achieves leading mAP on COCO and VOC semi-supervised benchmarks, especially under low-label regimes.
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.assessment: 将 DETR 稀疏查询范式引入半监督检测，思路清晰且实验扎实，对少标注场景有实用价值。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.contribution: 提出基于稀疏可学习查询的半监督 DETR 框架。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.innovation: 用稀疏查询替代稠密伪标签并加入一致性过滤。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.result: 在 COCO/VOC 半监督设定下取得领先 mAP。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri._arxiv_id: Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queries for Semi-Supervised Object Detection.

KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.summary_cn: DETR 类检测器因查询与解码层结构特殊，传统蒸馏难以对齐师生特征。本文提出 KD-DETR，设计一致性蒸馏点采样策略，使教师与学生在一对一匹配下采样同一组蒸馏点。相比直接套用 CNN 蒸馏方法，显著缓解了 DETR 蒸馏中的匹配不一致问题。在 COCO 上小模型取得稳定 mAP 提升，验证了方法有效性。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.summary_en: Knowledge distillation for DETR-style detectors is hindered by the mismatch between teacher and student queries and decoder layers. This paper proposes KD-DETR with a consistent distillation point sampling strategy that samples the same set of points under one-to-one matching. It alleviates matching inconsistency and yields consistent mAP gains for compact models on COCO.
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.assessment: 针对 DETR 蒸馏的结构性难题给出简洁有效的采样对齐方案，对模型压缩方向有参考意义。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.contribution: 提出面向 DETR 的一致性蒸馏点采样蒸馏框架。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.innovation: 在一对一匹配下对齐师生蒸馏点采样。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.result: 在 COCO 上小模型获得稳定 mAP 提升。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete._arxiv_id: KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Detection Transformer with Consistent Distillation Points Sampling.

Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_cn: DETR 缺乏显式空间关系建模，导致查询定位与关系推理能力受限。本文提出 Relation DETR，引入显式位置关系先验，将成对位置关系编码为注意力偏置注入解码器。相比仅依赖内容注意力的 DETR，增强了空间关系感知。在 COCO 上取得优于基线 DETR 的 mAP，且收敛更快。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_en: DETR lacks explicit spatial relation modeling, limiting query localization and relational reasoning. This paper proposes Relation DETR, which introduces an explicit position relation prior encoded as attention bias into the decoder. It enhances spatial relation awareness over content-only attention and achieves higher mAP with faster convergence than DETR baselines on COCO.
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.assessment: 把位置关系先验显式注入 DETR 注意力，思路新颖，对检测器关系建模有启发。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.contribution: 提出显式位置关系先验的 Relation DETR。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.innovation: 将成对位置关系编码为注意力偏置。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.result: 在 COCO 上 mAP 优于基线且收敛更快。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi._arxiv_id: Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Position Relation Prior for Object Detection.

2404.03507|v2.summary_cn: DETR 类方法在微小目标检测上因查询位置未针对小尺度定制、且固定查询数不适应实例数不均衡而表现不佳。本文提出 DQ-DETR，包含类别计数模块、计数引导特征增强与动态查询选择三部分，利用预测与密度图动态调整查询数量并优化查询位置。相比 CNN 与 DETR 类方法，在 AI-TOD-V2 上取得 30.2% mAP 的 SOTA。
2404.03507|v2.summary_en: DETR-like detectors struggle on tiny objects because query positions are not tailored to small scales and a fixed query count cannot handle imbalanced instance numbers. This paper proposes DQ-DETR with a categorical counting module, counting-guided feature enhancement, and dynamic query selection to adapt query number and positions. It achieves state-of-the-art 30.2% mAP on AI-TOD-V2, outperforming CNN-based and DETR-like methods.
2404.03507|v2.assessment: 针对微小目标与实例数不均衡问题给出动态查询方案，在航拍数据集上效果显著，实用性强。
2404.03507|v2.contribution: 提出动态查询选择的 DQ-DETR 用于微小目标检测。
2404.03507|v2.innovation: 用类别计数与密度图动态调整查询数量与位置。
2404.03507|v2.result: 在 AI-TOD-V2 上达到 30.2% mAP 的 SOTA。

Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.summary_cn: 开放集目标检测需要模型能检测任意文本描述的目标，传统闭集检测器难以泛化。本文提出 Grounding DINO，将 DINO 检测器与基于图文预训练的 grounding 能力结合，通过跨模态融合实现文本条件下的开放集检测。相比 GLIP 等方法，在零样本与开放集设定下显著提升。在 COCO 零样本检测上达到 52.5 AP，刷新开放集检测记录。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.summary_en: Open-set object detection requires detecting objects described by arbitrary text, which closed-set detectors cannot generalize to. This paper proposes Grounding DINO, marrying the DINO detector with grounded image-text pre-training via cross-modal fusion for text-conditioned open-set detection. It substantially improves over GLIP and achieves 52.5 AP on COCO zero-shot detection, setting a new open-set detection record.
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.assessment: 开放集检测的里程碑工作，跨模态 grounding 与 DETR 结合效果突出，对多模态感知研究极具参考价值。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.contribution: 提出融合图文预训练的开放集检测器 Grounding DINO。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.innovation: 将 DINO 与 grounded 预训练跨模态融合。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.result: COCO 零样本检测达 52.5 AP，刷新纪录。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun._arxiv_id: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-training for Open-Set Object Detection.

SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_cn: 点云 3D 检测中 DETR 类方法受限于稀疏性与查询初始化，性能不及基于体素/点的方法。本文提出 SEED，一个简单有效的 3D DETR，通过体素化特征编码与查询生成策略提升点云检测。相比复杂 3D DETR 变体，结构更简洁且精度更高。在 nuScenes 与 Waymo 等数据集上取得有竞争力的 3D 检测结果。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_en: DETR-style 3D detection in point clouds is limited by sparsity and query initialization, underperforming voxel- or point-based methods. This paper proposes SEED, a simple yet effective 3D DETR that improves point cloud detection via voxelized feature encoding and query generation. It is simpler yet more accurate than complex 3D DETR variants and achieves competitive 3D detection results on nuScenes and Waymo.
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.assessment: 为点云 3D DETR 提供简洁有效的设计范式，对自动驾驶 3D 感知有直接参考价值。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.contribution: 提出简洁有效的点云 3D DETR 框架 SEED。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.innovation: 通过体素化编码与查询生成简化 3D DETR。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.result: 在 nuScenes/Waymo 上取得有竞争力的 3D 检测结果。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in._arxiv_id: SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in Point Clouds.

2308.04409|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR框架在点云3D目标检测中因训练数据有限而难以学到准确归纳偏置、query常关注远离目标的点、违背局部性原则的问题，提出3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding（3DV-RPE），在每个decoder层根据query预测的3D框相对位置为每个点计算位置编码，从而引导模型聚焦目标附近的点。此外还从数据归一化等方面系统改进整体流程。在ScanNetV2上AP25/AP50从3DETR的65.0%/47.0%提升到77.8%/66.0%，并在ScanNetV2和SUN RGB-D上刷新纪录。
2308.04409|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal performance of DETR-based 3D point cloud detectors caused by their failure to learn accurate inductive biases from limited training data, where queries often attend to points far from target objects. It proposes a 3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding (3DV-RPE) that computes per-point positional encodings based on relative positions to the 3D boxes predicted by queries in each decoder layer, enforcing locality, along with systematic pipeline improvements such as data normalization. The method improves 3DETR on ScanNetV2 from 65.0%/47.0% to 77.8%/66.0% in AP25/AP50 and sets new records on ScanNetV2 and SUN RGB-D.
2308.04409|v2.assessment: 该工作直击DETR类3D检测器归纳偏置不足的核心痛点，3DV-RPE设计简洁有效，性能提升显著，对点云3D检测研究具有重要参考价值。
2308.04409|v2.contribution: 提出3DV-RPE位置编码方法，使DETR框架在点云3D检测中遵循局部性原则并大幅提升精度。
2308.04409|v2.innovation: 在每个decoder层基于query预测框的相对位置为点计算位置编码，显式注入局部性归纳偏置。
2308.04409|v2.result: ScanNetV2上AP25/AP50从65.0%/47.0%提升至77.8%/66.0%，并在ScanNetV2与SUN RGB-D上刷新纪录。

2403.06534|v2.summary_cn: 针对SAR目标检测领域公开数据集规模小（多数不足2K图像且仅单类目标）且源码不可获取的问题，构建了SARDet-100K基准数据集，整合标准化10个现有SAR检测数据集，成为首个COCO级别的大规模多类SAR目标检测数据集。通过大量实验揭示了RGB预训练与SAR微调在数据域和模型结构上的显著差异，并提出多阶段滤波增强（MSFA）预训练框架来弥合这一差距。该工作为SAR目标检测提供了开源基准与工具包。
2403.06534|v2.summary_en: To address the scarcity of large public datasets and inaccessible source code in SAR object detection, this paper builds SARDet-100K, the first COCO-level large-scale multi-class SAR detection benchmark by standardizing 10 existing datasets. Comprehensive experiments reveal substantial disparities between RGB pretraining and SAR finetuning in both data domain and model structure, motivating a Multi-Stage with Filter Augmentation (MSFA) pretraining framework to bridge these gaps.
2403.06534|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了SAR目标检测大规模基准的空白，数据集与开源工具包对领域发展有推动作用，但方法创新相对有限。
2403.06534|v2.contribution: 构建首个COCO级别大规模多类SAR目标检测基准SARDet-100K并提出MSFA预训练框架。
2403.06534|v2.innovation: 通过整合标准化多源SAR数据集构建大规模基准，并针对RGB-SAR域差异设计滤波增强预训练策略。
2403.06534|v2.result: 提供10万级图像的多类SAR检测基准与开源方法，验证了MSFA在弥合RGB-SAR域差距上的有效性。

2410.17534|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OVT）研究因缺乏基准而进展缓慢的问题，构建了大规模开放词汇多目标跟踪基准OVT-B，包含1,048个类别、1,973个视频和637,608个边界框标注，规模远超此前唯一的OVTAO-val数据集（200+类别、900+视频）。同时提出一个简单有效的OVT基线方法，将此前OVT方法忽略但对MOT至关重要的运动特征整合进跟踪流程。实验验证了基准的实用性和方法的有效性，并已公开基准。
2410.17534|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of benchmarks hindering open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OVT) research by constructing OVT-B, a large-scale benchmark with 1,048 categories, 1,973 videos, and 637,608 bounding box annotations, far exceeding the only prior OVTAO-val dataset. It also proposes a simple yet effective OVT baseline that integrates motion features, which are crucial for MOT but ignored in prior OVT methods, with experiments validating both the benchmark and the method.
2410.17534|v2.assessment: OVT-B显著扩充了开放词汇跟踪的评测规模，对推动OVT研究有重要价值，基线方法虽简单但指出了运动特征被忽视的问题。
2410.17534|v2.contribution: 构建大规模开放词汇多目标跟踪基准OVT-B并提出整合运动特征的有效基线。
2410.17534|v2.innovation: 首次提供千类别、近两千视频规模的OVT基准，并在OVT中引入被忽视的运动特征。
2410.17534|v2.result: OVT-B含1,048类、1,973视频、637,608框标注，基线方法实验验证有效。

2403.10191|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇/开放端目标检测中类别定义受限、依赖人工标注类别的问题，本文提出生成式区域-语言预训练方法，利用图像-文本对中的区域-语言对齐进行预训练。方法通过生成式建模区域与语言的联合分布，使模型能够在推理时检测任意文本描述的目标，无需固定类别集。相比传统闭集检测器和仅用分类损失的弱监督方法，该工作提升了开放端检测的泛化能力。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在多个开放端检测基准上取得领先性能。
2403.10191|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-ended object detection where categories are not pre-defined, proposing a generative region-language pretraining approach that models the joint distribution of regions and language from image-text pairs. Unlike closed-set detectors or weakly supervised methods, it enables detection of arbitrary objects described by free-form text without a fixed label set. The method claims state-of-the-art results on open-ended detection benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
2403.10191|v2.assessment: 开放端检测是当前视觉-语言交叉的重要方向，该工作将生成式预训练引入区域-语言对齐，思路新颖，值得关注。
2403.10191|v2.contribution: 提出生成式区域-语言预训练框架，实现无需固定类别的开放端目标检测。
2403.10191|v2.innovation: 将生成式建模用于区域-语言联合分布学习，突破闭集检测的类别限制。
2403.10191|v2.result: 在开放端检测基准上取得领先性能，具备检测任意文本描述目标的能力。

2403.05061|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点云稀疏、噪声大导致基于雷达的3D目标检测性能远低于LiDAR的问题，本文提出RadarDistill，通过知识蒸馏将LiDAR特征中的几何与语义信息迁移到雷达检测器中。方法设计了特征级蒸馏损失，对齐雷达与LiDAR的中间特征表示，并处理模态差异。相比直接训练雷达检测器，该方法显著缩小了雷达与LiDAR检测的性能差距。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在nuScenes等基准上大幅提升雷达检测精度。
2403.05061|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance gap between radar-based and LiDAR-based 3D object detection caused by sparse and noisy radar point clouds, proposing RadarDistill which transfers geometric and semantic knowledge from LiDAR features to a radar detector via knowledge distillation. It designs feature-level distillation losses to align intermediate representations across modalities while handling modality discrepancies. The method substantially narrows the radar-LiDAR performance gap, with claimed significant improvements on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
2403.05061|v2.assessment: 雷达与LiDAR的模态差距是自动驾驶感知的痛点，该工作用知识蒸馏有效 bridging，实用性强。
2403.05061|v2.contribution: 提出RadarDistill，通过LiDAR特征蒸馏提升雷达3D目标检测性能。
2403.05061|v2.innovation: 设计跨模态特征级蒸馏损失，对齐雷达与LiDAR的中间表示。
2403.05061|v2.result: 显著缩小雷达与LiDAR检测的性能差距，在nuScenes等基准上大幅提升雷达检测精度。

GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_cn: 针对目标检测模型在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性问题，本文提出GLOW（Global Layout Aware Attacks），利用图像全局布局信息生成对抗扰动。方法通过建模目标间的空间关系与全局场景布局，生成更自然且有效的攻击，而非仅依赖局部扰动。相比传统局部攻击方法，GLOW在保持视觉真实性的同时提升了攻击成功率。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在多个检测器上取得更高的攻击迁移性。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_en: This paper addresses adversarial robustness of object detectors by proposing GLOW, a global layout aware attack that exploits global scene layout and spatial relationships among objects to generate perturbations. Unlike local perturbation methods, it produces more natural and effective attacks by modeling inter-object spatial context. The method claims improved attack success rate and transferability across multiple detectors, though specific numbers are not provided.
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.assessment: 从全局布局角度研究检测攻击，视角独特，对理解检测器鲁棒性有参考价值。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.contribution: 提出GLOW，利用全局布局信息生成针对目标检测的对抗攻击。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.innovation: 将全局场景布局与目标空间关系引入对抗扰动生成。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.result: 在多个检测器上取得更高的攻击成功率和迁移性。

2404.18150|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达目标检测中真实数据标注昂贵、合成数据与真实数据存在域差距的问题，本文提出RadSimReal，通过仿真生成逼真的雷达数据以弥合合成与真实的鸿沟。方法构建了包含真实雷达噪声与场景布局的仿真管线，并设计域适应策略缩小差距。相比纯合成或纯真实数据训练，该方法在真实雷达数据上取得更好的检测性能。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称显著提升了跨域雷达检测精度。
2404.18150|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap between synthetic and real radar data for radar object detection, proposing RadSimReal, a simulation pipeline that generates realistic radar data with authentic noise and scene layouts, combined with domain adaptation. Compared to training on purely synthetic or real data, it achieves better detection performance on real radar data. The abstract claims significant improvement in cross-domain radar detection accuracy without providing specific numbers.
2404.18150|v2.assessment: 雷达仿真与域适应是解决雷达数据稀缺的关键路径，该工作系统性强，对雷达感知研究有推动。
2404.18150|v2.contribution: 提出RadSimReal仿真管线与域适应策略，弥合合成与真实雷达数据的差距。
2404.18150|v2.innovation: 构建含真实噪声与布局的雷达仿真，并结合域适应提升跨域检测。
2404.18150|v2.result: 显著提升跨域雷达目标检测精度。

Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_cn: 针对恶劣天气（雨、雾、雪）下LiDAR性能下降导致3D目标检测鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出融合LiDAR与4D雷达的鲁棒3D检测方法。4D雷达在恶劣天气下具有更强的穿透与测速能力，方法设计多模态融合网络，在特征级融合LiDAR点云与4D雷达点云。相比单一LiDAR或雷达检测器，该方法在多种天气条件下均取得更优的检测精度。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在恶劣天气基准上显著优于现有方法。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_en: This paper tackles the degraded performance of LiDAR-based 3D object detection in adverse weather (rain, fog, snow) by fusing LiDAR with 4D radar, which offers better penetration and velocity measurement under such conditions. It designs a multi-modal fusion network that combines LiDAR and 4D radar point clouds at the feature level. Compared to single-modality detectors, the method achieves superior accuracy across various weather conditions, with claimed significant improvements on adverse-weather benchmarks.
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.assessment: 4D雷达与LiDAR融合是提升恶劣天气感知鲁棒性的前沿方向，该工作针对性强，实验设计合理。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.contribution: 提出LiDAR与4D雷达融合的鲁棒3D目标检测方法，应对恶劣天气。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.innovation: 利用4D雷达在恶劣天气下的优势，设计特征级多模态融合网络。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.result: 在多种恶劣天气条件下显著优于单一模态检测器。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with._arxiv_id: Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with LiDAR and 4D Radar Fusion in Various Weather Conditions.

2304.05370|v2.summary_cn: 针对边缘设备上目标检测模型的延迟攻击问题，本文提出Overload，通过生成对抗扰动最大化检测器的推理延迟，导致实时系统超时。方法针对边缘设备的计算特性，设计扰动以增加检测器处理时间，而非仅降低精度。相比传统精度攻击，Overload揭示了延迟维度的安全威胁。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在多种边缘检测器上显著增加推理延迟。
2304.05370|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses latency attacks on object detection for edge devices, proposing Overload, which generates adversarial perturbations to maximize inference latency and cause timeouts in real-time systems. Unlike traditional accuracy attacks, it targets the computational characteristics of edge devices to increase processing time. The method reveals a latency-dimension security threat, with claimed significant latency increases across multiple edge detectors, though specific numbers are not provided.
2304.05370|v2.assessment: 延迟攻击是边缘部署中常被忽视的安全维度，该工作视角新颖，对实时感知系统安全有警示意义。
2304.05370|v2.contribution: 提出Overload延迟攻击方法，针对边缘设备目标检测器。
2304.05370|v2.innovation: 将对抗攻击目标从精度转向推理延迟，揭示实时系统超时风险。
2304.05370|v2.result: 在多种边缘检测器上显著增加推理延迟。

Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_cn: 针对无人机多模态（RGB-红外）目标检测中模态间弱对齐导致特征融合失效的问题，论文提出了一种弱错位无关的自适应特征对齐方法。方法通过可学习的对齐模块在特征层面动态校正跨模态空间偏移，而非依赖严格的像素级配准。相比已有假设严格对齐的多模态融合方法，该工作放宽了对配准精度的要求，在弱对齐条件下仍能有效融合。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在无人机多模态检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of multimodal RGB-thermal fusion in UAV-based object detection caused by weak cross-modal misalignment. It proposes a weakly misalignment-free adaptive feature alignment module that dynamically corrects spatial offsets at the feature level instead of relying on strict pixel-level registration. Compared with prior fusion methods that assume strict alignment, it remains effective under weak alignment and reports improved performance on UAV multimodal detection benchmarks.
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.assessment: 多模态无人机检测中的对齐鲁棒性问题具有实际价值，思路合理，但摘要信息有限，需关注其定量结果与泛化性。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.contribution: 提出一种对弱错位鲁棒的自适应跨模态特征对齐机制用于无人机多模态目标检测。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.innovation: 将严格配准假设替换为可学习的特征级动态对齐，降低对模态配准精度的依赖。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.result: 在弱对齐条件下实现优于现有多模态融合方法的检测性能。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur._arxiv_id: Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Feature Alignment for UAVs-Based Multimodal Object Detection.

2401.17270|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中实时性与零样本泛化难以兼顾的问题，论文提出 YOLO-World，将 YOLO 检测器与视觉-语言预训练结合，实现实时开放词汇检测。方法通过可重参数化的视觉-语言路径聚合网络与在线词汇训练策略，在推理时无需文本编码器即可高效检测任意类别。相比 GLIP、Grounding DINO 等开放词汇检测器，YOLO-World 在保持零样本能力的同时大幅提升推理速度，在 LVIS 上达到具有竞争力的零样本 AP 并实现数十 FPS 的实时性能。
2401.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the trade-off between real-time efficiency and zero-shot generalization in open-vocabulary object detection by proposing YOLO-World, which integrates a YOLO detector with vision-language pretraining. It introduces a re-parameterizable vision-language PAN and an online vocabulary training scheme, enabling efficient detection of arbitrary categories without a text encoder at inference. Compared with GLIP and Grounding DINO, it achieves competitive zero-shot AP on LVIS while running at real-time speed.
2401.17270|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入实时 YOLO 框架，工程与学术价值兼具，对自动驾驶开放场景感知有直接参考意义。
2401.17270|v2.contribution: 提出首个兼顾实时推理与开放词汇零样本检测能力的 YOLO-World 框架。
2401.17270|v2.innovation: 可重参数化视觉-语言路径聚合与在线词汇训练，使推理阶段摆脱文本编码器开销。
2401.17270|v2.result: 在 LVIS 零样本检测上取得有竞争力的 AP，同时保持实时（数十 FPS）推理速度。

Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_cn: 针对单域泛化目标检测中模型对未见域泛化能力不足的问题，论文从数据多样性与特征对齐两个角度提出改进方法。方法通过增强训练域的风格与内容多样性，并引入对齐机制缩小域间特征分布差异，从而提升跨域检测鲁棒性。相比已有单域泛化检测工作，该研究强调多样化与对齐的协同作用。摘要未提供具体数据集数值，但声称在多个跨域检测基准上取得提升。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_en: This paper targets the limited generalization of single domain-generalized object detection to unseen domains. It improves both data diversification and feature alignment by enriching style and content diversity in the training domain and aligning cross-domain feature distributions. Compared with prior single-DG detection methods, it emphasizes the synergy of diversification and alignment, reporting gains on multiple cross-domain detection benchmarks.
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.assessment: 单域泛化检测是自动驾驶跨域部署的关键问题，多样化与对齐的组合思路合理，但需关注其定量对比的充分性。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.contribution: 提出结合多样化与对齐的单域泛化目标检测改进方案。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.innovation: 将数据/风格多样化与跨域特征对齐协同设计以提升单域泛化能力。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.result: 在多个跨域检测基准上取得优于已有单域泛化方法的性能。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje._arxiv_id: Improving Single Domain-Generalized Object Detection: A Focus on Diversification and Alignment.

D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_cn: 针对 RGB-热红外域自适应目标检测中模态鸿沟导致跨域迁移困难的问题，论文提出 D3T（双域教师之字形训练）框架。方法采用双域教师分别指导 RGB 与热红外分支，并通过之字形交替训练策略逐步弥合模态间差异。相比传统单教师域自适应方法，该工作显式建模 RGB-T 模态鸿沟。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在 RGB-T 域自适应检测基准上取得提升。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_en: This paper addresses the modality gap in RGB-thermal domain-adaptive object detection by proposing D3T, a distinctive dual-domain teacher framework with a zigzagging training strategy. Two domain-specific teachers guide the RGB and thermal branches alternately to progressively bridge the cross-modal gap. Compared with conventional single-teacher domain adaptation, it explicitly models the RGB-T modality gap and reports improvements on RGB-T domain-adaptive detection benchmarks.
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.assessment: 双教师之字形训练为 RGB-T 域自适应提供了新视角，对多模态自动驾驶感知有参考价值，但需验证其泛化与效率。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.contribution: 提出双域教师之字形训练框架用于 RGB-热红外域自适应目标检测。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.innovation: 以双教师交替指导显式弥合 RGB-T 模态鸿沟。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.result: 在 RGB-T 域自适应检测基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig._arxiv_id: D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zigzagging Across RGB-Thermal Gap for Domain-Adaptive Object Detection.

Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_cn: 针对目标检测在昼夜域差异下性能下降的问题，论文提出利用零样本昼夜域自适应提升检测性能。方法通过图像层面的昼夜风格转换与特征层面的域对齐，在无需目标域标注的情况下缩小昼夜域差距。相比需要目标域标注或成对数据的域自适应方法，该工作强调零样本设定。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在昼夜跨域检测任务上取得提升。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance drop of object detection under day-night domain shift by proposing a zero-shot day-night domain adaptation approach. It combines image-level day-night style translation with feature-level domain alignment to narrow the gap without target-domain labels. Unlike adaptation methods requiring target annotations or paired data, it operates in a zero-shot setting and reports gains on day-night cross-domain detection.
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.assessment: 零样本昼夜域自适应对全天候自动驾驶感知有实际意义，思路清晰，但需关注其定量结果与真实夜间场景的验证。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.contribution: 提出零样本昼夜域自适应方法以提升跨昼夜目标检测性能。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.innovation: 结合图像级昼夜风格转换与特征级对齐，在无目标域标注下弥合昼夜域差距。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.result: 在昼夜跨域检测任务上取得优于基线的性能。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot._arxiv_id: Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot Day-Night Domain Adaptation.

InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_cn: 针对真实检测数据标注成本高、长尾类别样本稀缺的问题，论文提出 InstaGen，利用扩散模型生成的合成数据增强目标检测训练。方法通过实例级条件生成与检测器协同训练，使合成图像中的实例与检测标注一致，从而有效补充稀有类别。相比直接使用通用文生图合成数据，InstaGen 强调实例级可控生成与检测器反馈。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在长尾与少样本检测设定下提升了检测性能。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and long-tail scarcity in object detection by proposing InstaGen, which augments detector training with diffusion-generated synthetic data. It employs instance-level conditional generation and detector-in-the-loop co-training so that synthesized instances align with detection labels, effectively supplementing rare categories. Unlike generic text-to-image synthesis, it emphasizes instance-level controllability and detector feedback, reporting improved detection under long-tail and few-shot settings.
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.assessment: 将实例级可控扩散生成与检测器协同训练结合，为数据稀缺场景提供可行方案，对自动驾驶长尾目标检测有启发。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.contribution: 提出 InstaGen，通过实例级合成数据生成增强目标检测训练。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.innovation: 实例级条件生成与检测器协同训练，使合成数据与检测标注对齐。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.result: 在长尾与少样本检测设定下取得优于基线的检测性能。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by._arxiv_id: InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by Training on Synthetic Dataset.

Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_cn: ①该论文针对少样本目标检测（Few-Shot Object Detection, FSOD）中标注数据稀缺、模型难以泛化到新类别的问题。②提出利用基础模型（Foundation Models）的通用表征能力来辅助少样本检测，可能通过冻结或微调大规模预训练模型（如CLIP、DINO等）并设计适配模块完成新类别的快速检测。③相比传统FSOD方法依赖元学习或微调策略，该工作借助基础模型的强泛化性减少对大量标注的依赖。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，无法引用数值结果。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot object detection (FSOD), where models must generalize to novel categories with scarce annotations. It proposes leveraging foundation models' general-purpose representations to assist few-shot detection, likely by adapting large pretrained models (e.g., CLIP, DINO) with lightweight modules. Compared to conventional meta-learning or fine-tuning based FSOD methods, it reduces reliance on extensive annotations via foundation model generalization. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.assessment: 将基础模型引入少样本检测是当前热点方向，思路合理，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体适配机制与实验充分性。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.contribution: 提出利用基础模型通用表征进行少样本目标检测的框架。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.innovation: 将大规模预训练基础模型的能力迁移至少样本检测场景，降低对标注的依赖。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果待验证。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundation Models.

2503.01463|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有DETR类模型级联解码器架构限制object query只能沿级联方向更新、难以充分利用图像特征的问题，本文提出并行多时询问（Multi-time Inquiries, MI）机制的新型解码器架构MI-DETR。MI让object query从多个并行路径学习更全面的信息，从而更好应对极小目标、严重遮挡和背景混淆等挑战。在COCO基准上，MI-DETR在不同backbone和训练epoch下均超越所有现有DETR类模型，在ResNet-50下相比代表性模型DINO和SOTA模型Relation-DETR分别提升+2.3 AP和+0.6 AP。诊断与可视化实验进一步验证了MI的有效性、合理性和可解释性。
2503.01463|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies that the cascaded decoder architecture in existing DETR-like models restricts object queries to update along a single cascaded direction, limiting their ability to exploit image features. It proposes a parallel Multi-time Inquiries (MI) mechanism, yielding MI-DETR, which enables queries to learn more comprehensive information. MI-DETR outperforms all existing DETR-like models on COCO across backbones and training schedules, achieving +2.3 AP and +0.6 AP over DINO and Relation-DETR respectively under ResNet-50, with diagnostic and visualization experiments confirming its effectiveness and interpretability.
2503.01463|v2.assessment: 对DETR解码器架构提出了有洞察力的改进，在COCO上取得一致且显著的提升，且方法通用性强，值得检测方向研究者关注。
2503.01463|v2.contribution: 提出并行多时询问（MI）解码器机制，突破级联解码器对object query信息学习的限制。
2503.01463|v2.innovation: 用并行多路径查询替代传统级联单向更新，使object query能更全面地利用图像特征。
2503.01463|v2.result: 在COCO上不同backbone和epoch设置下均超越所有DETR类模型，ResNet-50下较DINO提升+2.3 AP、较Relation-DETR提升+0.6 AP。

2412.06647|v2.summary_cn: 针对事件流目标检测中现有SNN、Transformer和CNN检测器分别存在性能受限、计算开销大或局部感受野有限的问题，本文提出一种基于混合专家（MoE）热传导的检测算法，在精度与计算效率间取得良好平衡。方法先用stem网络嵌入事件数据，再通过创新的MoE-HCO块（每个块集成多个专家模块模拟事件流中的热传导），随后用基于IoU的query选择模块高效提取token并送入检测头。同时发布了基于Prophesee EVK4-HD事件相机采集的新基准数据集EvDET200K，为事件目标检测提供大规模评测平台。
2412.06647|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of existing SNN-, Transformer-, and CNN-based event-stream detectors in performance, computation, or receptive field, this paper proposes a Mixture-of-Experts heat-conduction (MoE-HCO) object detection algorithm that balances accuracy and efficiency. A stem network embeds event data, MoE-HCO blocks with multiple experts mimic heat conduction, and an IoU-based query selection module feeds tokens to the detection head. The authors also release EvDET200K, a new benchmark dataset captured with a Prophesee EVK4-HD event camera.
2412.06647|v2.assessment: 将MoE与热传导建模引入事件相机检测，并配套发布大规模数据集，对事件视觉与检测交叉方向有较高参考价值。
2412.06647|v2.contribution: 提出MoE热传导检测器并发布EvDET200K事件相机目标检测基准数据集。
2412.06647|v2.innovation: 用多专家模块模拟事件流热传导过程，结合IoU query选择实现精度与效率的平衡。
2412.06647|v2.result: 在精度与计算效率间取得显著平衡，并提供大规模事件检测基准EvDET200K。

2510.13620|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有UAV可见光-红外多模态检测数据集成像条件覆盖不足、难以反映真实世界复杂性的问题，本文构建了高多样性数据集ATR-UMOD，覆盖80m至300m高度、0°至75°角度以及全天候全年的丰富天气与光照条件，并为每对RGB-IR图像标注6种条件属性。为应对多样条件挑战，提出提示引导的条件感知动态融合（PCDF），通过将成像条件编码为文本提示，利用任务特定的软门控变换自适应重分配多模态贡献，并用提示引导的条件解耦模块保证可用性。
2510.13620|v2.summary_en: To address the limited imaging-condition coverage of existing UAV RGB-IR detection datasets, this paper introduces ATR-UMOD, a high-diversity dataset spanning altitudes of 80-300m, angles of 0-75 degrees, and all-day/all-year weather and illumination variations, with 6 condition attributes annotated per RGB-IR pair. It further proposes prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF), which encodes imaging conditions as text prompts and uses a task-specific soft-gating transformation to adaptively reassign multimodal contributions, complemented by a prompt-guided condition-decoupling module.
2510.13620|v2.assessment: 数据集与条件感知融合方法结合紧密，对多模态鲁棒感知和UAV检测研究者有实用价值。
2510.13620|v2.contribution: 构建高多样性UAV RGB-IR多模态检测数据集ATR-UMOD并提出提示引导条件感知动态融合方法PCDF。
2510.13620|v2.innovation: 将成像条件编码为文本提示，通过软门控自适应调节多模态融合权重。
2510.13620|v2.result: 数据集覆盖80-300m高度、0-75°角度及全天候条件，PCDF在多样条件下提升多模态检测鲁棒性。

2506.23575|v2.summary_cn: 针对反无人机任务中小目标检测因目标尺寸小、背景复杂而困难，且现有事件相机数据集规模小、目标大、背景单一不适合小目标检测的问题，本文提出首个大规模高多样性事件小目标检测基准EV-UAV，包含147个序列、超过230万事件级标注，目标平均仅6.8×5.4像素，覆盖城市杂乱和极端光照等场景。基于小运动目标在时空事件点云中形成连续曲线的观察，提出事件稀疏分割网络EV-SpSegNet作为新基线。
2506.23575|v2.summary_en: To address the difficulty of small object detection in anti-UAV tasks and the unsuitability of existing event datasets, this paper introduces EV-UAV, the first large-scale, highly diverse event-based small object detection benchmark, containing 147 sequences with over 2.3 million event-level annotations and extremely small targets averaging 6.8x5.4 pixels across urban clutter and extreme lighting. Observing that small moving targets form continuous curves in spatiotemporal event point clouds, it proposes EV-SpSegNet as a novel event sparse segmentation baseline.
2506.23575|v2.assessment: 填补了事件相机小目标检测基准的空白，数据规模与标注粒度突出，对事件视觉与反无人机检测研究有重要价值。
2506.23575|v2.contribution: 发布首个大规模事件小目标检测基准EV-UAV并提出基线EV-SpSegNet。
2506.23575|v2.innovation: 利用小运动目标在时空事件点云中形成连续曲线的特性进行稀疏分割检测。
2506.23575|v2.result: 数据集含147序列、230万+事件级标注，目标平均6.8×5.4像素，为事件小目标检测提供新基准。

When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测（FSOD）中 ViT 类检测器难以充分利用局部像素差异线索的问题，本文提出 PiDiViT，将像素差异模式（Pixel Difference Patterns）与 ViT 主干相结合。方法通过显式建模相邻像素差分特征并将其注入 ViT 的 token 表示，增强模型在极少标注样本下对目标边界的判别能力。相比已有基于 CNN 或纯 ViT 的 FSOD 方法，PiDiViT 在保持 ViT 全局建模优势的同时补足了局部细节感知。在标准 FSOD 基准上取得了优于同类方法的精度，验证了像素差分先验对少样本检测的有效性。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of ViT-based few-shot object detection (FSOD) in exploiting local pixel-difference cues. It proposes PiDiViT, which integrates pixel difference patterns into the ViT backbone to enhance boundary discrimination under scarce annotations. Compared with prior CNN- or pure-ViT-based FSOD methods, it preserves global modeling while recovering local detail sensitivity, achieving improved accuracy on standard FSOD benchmarks.
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.assessment: 将经典像素差分先验与 ViT 结合用于 FSOD，思路简洁且对少样本检测有实际参考价值，但创新幅度中等。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.contribution: 提出将像素差异模式嵌入 ViT 的少样本目标检测框架 PiDiViT。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.innovation: 用像素差分先验弥补 ViT 在少样本场景下局部细节感知不足的问题。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.result: 在标准 FSOD 基准上取得优于现有同类方法的检测精度。

DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_cn: 针对跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD）中在新域上重新训练代价高的问题，本文提出一种无需重训练的混合框架，将 DETR 类检测器与视觉基础模型（VFM）相结合。方法利用 VFM 的开放词汇与泛化能力为 DETR 提供跨域类别定位与语义先验，从而在目标域仅有少量样本时直接适配而无需微调。相比需要域内重训练或大量标注的已有 CD-FSOD 方法，该方案显著降低了适配成本。实验表明其在多个跨域少样本基准上取得有竞争力的性能，同时避免了对新域的再训练。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_en: This paper targets cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD) where retraining on new domains is costly. It proposes a retraining-free mixture of DETR and vision foundation models (VFMs), leveraging VFM open-vocabulary generalization to supply cross-domain localization and semantic priors to DETR. Compared with prior CD-FSOD methods requiring in-domain retraining, it substantially reduces adaptation cost while achieving competitive performance across cross-domain few-shot benchmarks.
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.assessment: 免重训练的 DETR+VFM 组合对实际部署中的跨域适配有较强工程价值，但方法层面的理论新意有限。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.contribution: 提出一种无需重训练的 DETR 与视觉基础模型混合的跨域少样本检测框架。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.innovation: 利用 VFM 的开放词汇泛化能力替代新域重训练来完成跨域少样本适配。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.result: 在多个跨域少样本检测基准上取得有竞争力性能且无需域内再训练。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR._arxiv_id: DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR and Vision Foundation Models for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection.

2505.20612|v2.summary_cn: 针对 VLM 在预训练分布之外的类别、任务与成像模态上泛化能力差的问题，本文提出 Roboflow100-VL，一个包含 100 个多模态目标检测数据集的大规模基准，覆盖医学影像等 VLM 预训练中罕见的概念。作者主张应通过包含少量视觉示例与丰富文本描述的标注指令将 VLM 对齐到新概念，并在零样本、少样本、半监督与全监督四种数据设定下系统评测了 SOTA 模型。结果显示 GroundingDINO、Qwen2.5-VL 等在困难医学影像数据集上零样本精度不足 2%，凸显少样本概念对齐的必要性，并分享了 CVPR 2025 Foundational FSOD 竞赛的社区洞察。
2505.20612|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Roboflow100-VL, a large-scale benchmark of 100 multi-modal detection datasets covering concepts rarely seen in VLM pre-training. It argues for aligning VLMs to new concepts via annotation instructions with few visual examples and rich text, and evaluates state-of-the-art models under zero-shot, few-shot, semi-supervised, and fully-supervised regimes. Notably, GroundingDINO and Qwen2.5-VL achieve under 2% zero-shot accuracy on challenging medical datasets, underscoring the need for few-shot concept alignment.
2505.20612|v2.assessment: 该基准系统揭示了 VLM 在分布外概念上的严重短板，对开放词汇检测与少样本对齐研究具有重要参考价值。
2505.20612|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖 100 个多模态检测数据集、支持多数据设定的 Roboflow100-VL 基准。
2505.20612|v2.innovation: 以标注指令+少量视觉示例的概念对齐范式替代单纯扩大视觉预训练数据。
2505.20612|v2.result: SOTA VLM 在困难医学影像上零样本精度不足 2%，验证了少样本概念对齐的必要性。

2503.18430|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模词表目标检测中分类式检测器的两大缺陷——稀有正类梯度稀释与大量易负样本导致的难负梯度稀释，本文提出 CQ-DINO，将分类重构为物体查询与可学习类别查询之间的对比任务。方法引入图像引导的查询选择，通过交叉注意力为每张图像自适应检索 top-K 相关类别，从而压缩负样本空间、重平衡梯度分布并实现隐式难例挖掘。CQ-DINO 还能在结构化数据集（如 V3Det）中显式建模层级类别关系，或在通用数据集（如 COCO）中通过自注意力学习隐式类别相关性，在挑战性大规模词表检测上取得优越性能。
2503.18430|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies positive and hard-negative gradient dilution as key limitations of classification-based detectors in vast-vocabulary detection. It proposes CQ-DINO, which reformulates classification as contrastive matching between object queries and learnable category queries, with image-guided top-K category retrieval via cross-attention to rebalance gradients and enable implicit hard example mining. CQ-DINO further integrates explicit hierarchical category relations on structured datasets (e.g., V3Det) or learns implicit correlations on generic datasets (e.g., COCO), achieving superior performance on challenging vast-vocabulary detection.
2503.18430|v2.assessment: 从梯度稀释角度切入大规模词表检测，问题分析清晰、方法设计合理，对开放词表检测研究有较好启发。
2503.18430|v2.contribution: 提出基于类别查询对比的 CQ-DINO 框架以缓解大规模词表检测中的梯度稀释。
2503.18430|v2.innovation: 用图像引导的 top-K 类别查询检索将分类转为对比任务并实现隐式难例挖掘。
2503.18430|v2.result: 在 V3Det 等挑战性大规模词表检测任务上取得优于现有方法的性能。

2411.17761|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界 3D 感知缺乏全面基准与鲁棒通用方法的问题，本文提出 OpenAD，首个面向 3D 目标检测的真实开放世界自动驾驶基准。OpenAD 基于结合多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的 corner case 发现与标注流水线构建，在五个自动驾驶感知数据集的 2000 个场景中以统一格式标注 corner case 目标，并设计了相应评测方法。作者评测了多种开放世界与专用 2D/3D 模型，提出一个视觉中心的 3D 开放世界检测基线，并进一步引入融合通用与专用模型的集成方法以缓解现有开放世界方法精度偏低的问题，同时组织了 EvalAI 在线挑战。
2411.17761|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenAD, the first real-world open-world benchmark for 3D object detection in autonomous driving, addressing the lack of comprehensive benchmarks and robust generalizable methods. Built on an MLLM-integrated corner-case discovery and annotation pipeline, OpenAD annotates corner-case objects in a unified format across five perception datasets with 2000 scenarios, and provides evaluation protocols. The authors benchmark open-world and specialized 2D/3D models, propose a vision-centric 3D open-world baseline, and introduce an ensemble of general and specialized models to mitigate low precision, hosting an online EvalAI challenge.
2411.17761|v2.assessment: 作为首个真实开放世界 3D 检测基准，OpenAD 对自动驾驶开放世界感知研究具有里程碑意义，配套基线与挑战赛进一步提升了影响力。
2411.17761|v2.contribution: 构建了首个真实开放世界自动驾驶 3D 目标检测基准 OpenAD 及配套评测与基线。
2411.17761|v2.innovation: 用 MLLM 驱动的 corner case 发现与标注流水线统一五个数据集的开放世界标注。
2411.17761|v2.result: 提供 2000 场景统一标注基准，并通过通用与专用模型集成缓解开放世界方法精度偏低问题。

2501.16665|v2.summary_cn: 针对 X 射线安检图像中目标重叠导致的前景-背景特征耦合问题，本文提出类别语义先验对比学习（CSPCL）机制，用于基于 Deformable DETR 的违禁品检测器。方法通过将分类器感知的类别原型与内容查询对齐，修正并补充分类所需的缺失语义信息，从而提升模型对前景特征的敏感度；为此设计了 CSP 损失，包含类内截断吸引（ITA）损失与类间自适应排斥（IAR）损失。ITA 利用类别原型吸引类内内容查询并通过梯度截断函数保留类内多样性，IAR 则依据原型间相似度自适应地排斥类间查询，性能优于经典对比损失。
2501.16665|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses foreground-background feature coupling caused by object overlap in X-ray security images, which degrades general natural-image detectors. It proposes Category Semantic Prior Contrastive Learning (CSPCL) for Deformable DETR-based prohibited item detectors, aligning classifier-perceived class prototypes with content queries to correct missing semantic information. The CSP loss combines Intra-Class Truncated Attraction (ITA) with gradient truncation for intra-class diversity and Inter-Class Adaptive Repulsion (IAR) scaled by prototype similarity, outperforming classic contrastive losses.
2501.16665|v2.assessment: 面向 X 射线安检这一特定场景，对比学习设计有针对性，但领域相关性对通用检测研究者有限。
2501.16665|v2.contribution: 提出类别语义先验对比学习 CSPCL 以缓解 X 射线图像中前景-背景特征耦合。
2501.16665|v2.innovation: 设计含梯度截断的 ITA 损失与基于原型相似度自适应的 IAR 损失。
2501.16665|v2.result: 在 X 射线违禁品检测上性能优于经典对比损失方法。

Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界目标检测中新颖类别难以识别的问题，提出用"objectness"建模统一新颖目标检测框架。方法通过将目标性（objectness）从封闭类别语义中解耦，使其能够泛化到未见类别，从而在开放世界设定下统一检测已知与未知目标。相比已有开放集检测方法依赖伪标签或不确定性估计，该工作从objectness本质出发提供了更简洁的建模范式。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该思路对开放世界检测具有潜在推动意义。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.summary_en: This paper addresses novel object detection in open-world settings by proposing a unified framework based on objectness modeling. By decoupling objectness from closed-set category semantics, the method generalizes to unseen categories and unifies detection of known and unknown objects. Unlike prior open-set detectors relying on pseudo-labeling or uncertainty estimation, this work offers a more principled formulation rooted in the nature of objectness.
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.assessment: 开放世界检测是当前热点方向，从objectness角度切入具有新意，值得关注其后续实验验证。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.contribution: 提出以objectness建模统一开放世界新颖目标检测的框架。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.innovation: 将目标性与类别语义解耦以实现对未见类别的泛化。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N._arxiv_id: Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies Novel Object Detection.

2503.15293|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测模型在测试时易受后门攻击的问题，指出现有防御因检测输出多目标及复杂攻击效果（如幽灵目标、目标消失）而失效。作者提出TRACE方法，基于两个观察：中毒样本在不同背景下检测结果更一致，干净样本在不同焦点信息下检测更一致，通过对测试样本施加前景/背景变换并计算变换一致性来判别中毒样本。该方法为检测模型后门防御提供了新思路，但摘要未给出具体检测指标。
2503.15293|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles test-time backdoor detection for object detection models, where existing defenses fail due to multi-object outputs and complex attack effects such as ghost or vanishing objects. The authors propose TRACE, which applies foreground and background transformations and measures transformation consistency, based on observations that poisoned samples show higher cross-background consistency while clean samples show higher consistency under varying focal information. This offers a new direction for backdoor defense in detection, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2503.15293|v2.assessment: 目标检测后门防御是安全与感知交叉的重要问题，TRACE的双重一致性观察具有启发性。
2503.15293|v2.contribution: 提出基于变换一致性评估的测试时后门检测方法TRACE。
2503.15293|v2.innovation: 利用前景/背景变换下检测一致性的差异区分中毒与干净样本。
2503.15293|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.summary_cn: 该论文针对旋转目标检测中方向敏感性问题，提出旋转等变扩散模型ReDiffDet。方法将扩散模型与旋转等变性结合，使检测器在旋转变换下保持特征一致性，从而提升有向目标检测的精度与鲁棒性。相比已有有向检测方法依赖数据增强或旋转不变特征，该工作从等变建模角度提供了更本质的解决方案。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.summary_en: This paper addresses orientation sensitivity in oriented object detection by proposing ReDiffDet, a rotation-equivariant diffusion model. By integrating diffusion models with rotation equivariance, the detector maintains feature consistency under rotations, improving accuracy and robustness for oriented detection. Unlike prior methods relying on data augmentation or rotation-invariant features, this work offers a more principled equivariant modeling approach.
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.assessment: 旋转等变与扩散模型的结合在有向检测中较为新颖，对遥感与自动驾驶场景均有参考价值。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.contribution: 提出旋转等变扩散模型ReDiffDet用于有向目标检测。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.innovation: 将旋转等变性引入扩散检测框架以提升方向鲁棒性。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio._arxiv_id: ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusion Model for Oriented Object Detection.

SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应目标检测中域间语义对齐不足的问题，提出语义熵引导的域感知注意力方法SEEN-DA。方法利用语义熵衡量预测不确定性，引导注意力机制关注域敏感区域，从而提升跨域检测性能。相比已有域自适应方法多依赖对抗对齐或风格迁移，该工作从语义不确定性角度提供了更细粒度的对齐策略。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient semantic alignment in domain adaptive object detection by proposing SEEN-DA, a semantic entropy guided domain-aware attention method. It leverages semantic entropy to measure prediction uncertainty and guides attention toward domain-sensitive regions, improving cross-domain detection. Unlike prior adversarial or style-transfer based approaches, this work offers finer-grained alignment from a semantic uncertainty perspective.
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.assessment: 语义熵引导注意力在域自适应检测中思路清晰，但需实验验证其相对现有方法的增益。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.contribution: 提出语义熵引导的域感知注意力方法SEEN-DA。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.innovation: 利用语义熵衡量不确定性以引导域敏感区域的注意力分配。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.summary_cn: 该论文针对增量目标检测中灾难性遗忘问题，提出学习内生注意力（Endogenous Attention）的方法。方法通过让模型自主学习内在注意力机制，在不依赖外部蒸馏或回放的前提下缓解旧类别遗忘，同时保持新类别学习能力。相比已有增量检测方法依赖知识蒸馏或样本回放，该工作从注意力内生机制角度提供了更轻量的解决方案。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in incremental object detection by learning endogenous attention. The method enables the model to autonomously learn intrinsic attention mechanisms, mitigating forgetting of old classes while maintaining plasticity for new ones, without relying on external distillation or replay. Unlike prior incremental detectors, this work offers a lightweight solution from an endogenous attention perspective.
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.assessment: 增量检测是持续学习在感知中的重要应用，内生注意力机制思路新颖，值得关注。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.contribution: 提出学习内生注意力以缓解增量目标检测中的遗忘。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.innovation: 以模型内生注意力机制替代外部蒸馏或回放来保持旧类性能。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm._arxiv_id: Learning Endogenous Attention for Incremental Object Detection.

2502.04268|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点监督有向目标检测（OOD）中实例空间布局未被充分利用的问题，提出Point2RBox-v2。方法基于三条原则：高斯重叠损失学习实例上界、Voronoi分水岭损失学习实例下界、一致性损失学习尺寸/旋转变化，并辅以边缘损失和copy-paste技术。这是首个探索实例间空间布局用于点监督OOD的工作，在DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M上分别达到62.61%/86.15%/34.71%，在密集场景中表现尤为突出。
2502.04268|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses point-supervised oriented object detection by exploiting spatial layout among instances, proposing Point2RBox-v2. It introduces three principles: Gaussian overlap loss for instance upper bounds, Voronoi watershed loss for lower bounds, and consistency loss for size/rotation variation, supplemented by edge loss and copy-paste. As the first to explore inter-instance spatial layout for point-supervised OOD, it achieves 62.61%/86.15%/34.71% on DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M, excelling in densely packed scenes.
2502.04268|v2.assessment: 点监督有向检测的实用性强，三条损失原则设计优雅且实验充分，密集场景表现突出，值得重点关注。
2502.04268|v2.contribution: 提出首个利用实例间空间布局的点监督有向目标检测方法Point2RBox-v2。
2502.04268|v2.innovation: 通过高斯重叠、Voronoi分水岭与一致性损失联合建模实例空间布局。
2502.04268|v2.result: 在DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M上达到62.61%/86.15%/34.71%，密集场景优势明显。

2503.12009|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中Transformer将3D体素序列化为1D序列会破坏空间结构、且因体素数量庞大与二次复杂度需分组导致感受野受限的问题，本文提出Unified Mamba（UniMamba），将3D卷积与状态空间模型（SSM）以多头方式融合，通过空间局部性建模、互补Z-order序列化与局部-全局序列聚合器实现高效的局部与全局空间上下文聚合。相比Transformer框架，该方法在保持线性复杂度的同时避免了序列化造成的结构破坏并扩大了感受野。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称在LiDAR 3D检测上取得有竞争力的性能。
2503.12009|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issues that Transformer-based LiDAR 3D detectors destroy spatial structure during serialization and suffer limited receptive fields due to grouping with quadratic complexity. It proposes Unified Mamba (UniMamba), which integrates 3D convolution and state space models in a multi-head manner via spatial locality modeling, complementary Z-order serialization, and a local-global sequential aggregator. The method achieves efficient simultaneous local and global context aggregation with linear complexity, though concrete numerical gains are not stated in the abstract.
2503.12009|v2.assessment: 将Mamba/SSM引入LiDAR 3D检测是当前热点方向，UniMamba对序列化与感受野问题的处理思路清晰，值得关注其后续实验数据。
2503.12009|v2.contribution: 提出融合3D卷积与SSM的UniMamba统一空间-通道表示学习框架用于LiDAR 3D检测。
2503.12009|v2.innovation: 设计空间局部性建模、互补Z-order序列化与局部-全局序列聚合器，在多头框架下同时实现局部与全局上下文聚合。
2503.12009|v2.result: 在LiDAR 3D检测上以线性复杂度实现高效局部-全局聚合，摘要未给出具体数值指标。

2410.11774|v2.summary_cn: 针对真实数据集长尾分布导致稀有类别检测困难的问题，现有重加权与重采样方法仅利用类别频率统计而忽略类别在图像空间中的分布。本文提出FRActal CALibration（FRACAL），一种无需训练的后校准方法，利用分形维数估计类别在图像空间中分布的均匀程度，并在推理时据此反向降低均匀间隔类别预测的概率，从而在频繁/稀有类别与均匀/稀疏间隔类别两个维度上实现平衡。FRACAL可即插即用地结合单阶段sigmoid检测器与两阶段实例分割模型，显著提升稀有类别性能。
2410.11774|v2.summary_en: To address long-tailed object detection where existing re-weighting and re-sampling methods only exploit class frequency statistics while ignoring spatial class distribution, this paper proposes FRActal CALibration (FRACAL), a training-free post-calibration method. FRACAL uses fractal dimension to estimate how uniformly classes are distributed in image space and inversely downweights probabilities of uniformly spaced class predictions at inference, balancing both frequent-rare and uniform-sparse axes. It is plug-and-play with one-stage sigmoid detectors and two-stage instance segmentation models, substantially boosting rare-class performance.
2410.11774|v2.assessment: 从图像空间分布而非仅类别频率切入长尾检测是一个新颖视角，且方法无需训练、易于集成，实用性强。
2410.11774|v2.contribution: 提出基于分形维数的免训练后校准方法FRACAL用于长尾目标检测。
2410.11774|v2.innovation: 首次利用分形维度量类别在图像空间的分布均匀性，并在推理时进行logit调整以平衡两类不平衡。
2410.11774|v2.result: 作为即插即用后处理显著提升稀有类别性能，摘要称大幅提升但具体数值被截断。

Believing is Seeing: Unobserved Object D.summary_cn: 该论文针对检测模型只能识别可见区域目标、无法推断被遮挡或未观测物体的问题，提出利用生成模型进行未观测物体检测（Unobserved Object Detection）。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推断，其核心思想是借助生成模型的先验知识推断图像中未直接观测到的物体位置与类别，属于开放集/遮挡场景检测的新范式。
Believing is Seeing: Unobserved Object D.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that detection models can only recognize visible objects and cannot infer occluded or unobserved ones, proposing unobserved object detection using generative models. Due to the missing abstract, methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified. The core idea appears to leverage generative priors to infer the location and category of objects not directly observed, forming a new paradigm for open-set/occlusion-aware detection.

Due to the missing abstract, methodological details, comparisons, and quantitative results cannot be verified. The core idea appears to estimate Gaussian distributions of object positions from feature information to more accurately localize tiny objects, likely involving label assignment or regression improvements.

2502.19630|v2.summary_cn: 现有 3D 目标检测依赖 LiDAR 与相机的固定帧率同步数据，受限于传感器延迟与带宽，无法在帧间间隔内输出检测结果，难以满足自动驾驶对低延迟的需求。本文首次将异步事件相机引入 3D 目标检测，利用其高时间分辨率与低带宽特性，通过事件相机检索历史 3D 信息，实现帧间间隔内的高速检测。作者还发布了首个基于事件的 3D 检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD，提供 100 FPS 的 3D 真值框，建立了事件 3D 检测器的首个基准。该工作将 3D 检测的时间边界从固定帧率推进到异步高帧率，为低延迟感知提供了新范式。
2502.19630|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D object detectors rely on synchronized fixed-frame-rate LiDAR and camera data, whose latency and bandwidth constraints prevent detection during inter-frame intervals. This paper introduces asynchronous event cameras into 3D object detection for the first time, retrieving previous 3D information via events to enable high-speed detection even when synchronized data is unavailable. It also releases DSEC-3DOD, the first event-based 3D detection dataset with 100 FPS 3D ground-truth boxes, establishing the first benchmark for event-based 3D detectors.
2502.19630|v2.assessment: 首次将事件相机用于 3D 目标检测并配套发布 100 FPS 数据集，为突破固定帧率传感器的时间边界提供了新思路，对低延迟自动驾驶感知有较高参考价值。
2502.19630|v2.contribution: 首次将异步事件相机引入 3D 目标检测，并发布首个 100 FPS 真值的 event-based 3D 检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD。
2502.19630|v2.innovation: 利用事件相机的高时间分辨率与低带宽，在帧间间隔内通过事件检索历史 3D 信息实现高速检测。
2502.19630|v2.result: 建立了事件 3D 检测的首个基准，实现帧间间隔内的高速 3D 检测，突破固定帧率传感器的时间限制。

IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.summary_cn: 针对双目视觉3D目标检测中深度估计与实例感知耦合不足的问题，提出IDA-3D框架，通过实例深度感知模块将实例级深度估计与3D检测联合优化。方法在立体匹配中引入实例掩码引导的深度细化，相比两阶段伪LiDAR方案减少了深度误差传播。在KITTI数据集上取得了有竞争力的精度，但摘要未提供具体数值。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.summary_en: This paper addresses stereo-based 3D object detection by proposing IDA-3D, an instance-depth-aware framework that jointly optimizes instance-level depth estimation and 3D detection. It introduces instance-mask-guided depth refinement to reduce error propagation compared to two-stage pseudo-LiDAR pipelines. Competitive results are reported on KITTI, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.assessment: 将实例级深度感知融入双目3D检测，思路合理，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际精度与泛化性。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.contribution: 提出实例深度感知的端到端双目3D检测框架。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.innovation: 利用实例掩码引导深度估计，减少背景深度对检测的干扰。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.result: 在KITTI上取得有竞争力的精度，但摘要未给出具体数值。

2001.10692|v2.summary_cn: 针对纯点云3D检测缺乏颜色和纹理信息的问题，提出ImVoteNet，在VoteNet基础上融合2D图像投票和3D点云投票。方法从图像中提取几何与语义特征，利用相机参数提升到3D空间，并设计多塔训练方案增强2D-3D特征融合。在SUN RGB-D数据集上mAP提升5.7，达到当时最优。
2001.10692|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of color and texture in point-cloud-only 3D detection, this paper proposes ImVoteNet, which fuses 2D image votes and 3D point cloud votes on top of VoteNet. It extracts geometric and semantic features from images, lifts them to 3D using camera parameters, and introduces a multi-tower training scheme for better fusion. It advances state-of-the-art on SUN RGB-D by 5.7 mAP.
2001.10692|v2.assessment: 多模态融合思路清晰，在RGB-D场景下显著提升检测精度，对多传感器融合研究有参考价值。
2001.10692|v2.contribution: 提出融合2D图像投票与3D点云投票的RGB-D 3D检测框架。
2001.10692|v2.innovation: 显式提取图像几何与语义特征并提升到3D，结合多塔训练增强融合。
2001.10692|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D上mAP提升5.7，达到当时最优。

2004.03080|v2.summary_cn: 针对伪LiDAR方法中深度估计与3D检测网络需分开训练的问题，提出可微分的Change of Representation模块，实现端到端训练。该框架兼容多种深度估计和3D检测网络，与PointRCNN结合后在KITTI图像3D检测榜单上取得当时最高成绩。方法显著缩小了基于立体相机与LiDAR方法之间的精度差距。
2004.03080|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the separate training of depth estimation and 3D detection networks in pseudo-LiDAR pipelines by introducing differentiable Change of Representation modules for end-to-end training. The framework is compatible with various networks and, combined with PointRCNN, achieves the top entry on the KITTI image-based 3D detection leaderboard at submission time. It significantly narrows the gap between stereo-based and LiDAR-based methods.
2004.03080|v2.assessment: 端到端伪LiDAR训练是重要改进，提升了图像3D检测的实用性和精度，值得关注。
2004.03080|v2.contribution: 提出可微分CoR模块实现伪LiDAR端到端训练。
2004.03080|v2.innovation: 将深度估计与3D检测联合优化，消除两阶段训练的不一致性。
2004.03080|v2.result: 在KITTI图像3D检测榜单上取得当时最高成绩。

1912.13192|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中体素CNN与PointNet各自局限，提出PV-RCNN框架，深度融合体素CNN和基于PointNet的集合抽象。方法通过体素集合抽象模块提取关键点，并设计RoI-grid池化从关键点聚合多感受野的提案特征。在KITTI和Waymo Open数据集上均取得领先精度，成为3D检测的经典基线。
1912.13192|v2.summary_en: To combine the strengths of voxel CNNs and PointNet-based set abstraction, this paper proposes PV-RCNN, a 3D detection framework that deeply integrates both. It summarizes scenes into keypoints via voxel set abstraction and introduces RoI-grid pooling to aggregate multi-receptive-field features. It achieves leading accuracy on both KITTI and Waymo Open datasets, becoming a classic baseline.
1912.13192|v2.assessment: PV-RCNN是3D检测领域的里程碑工作，方法优雅且实验充分，强烈推荐关注。
1912.13192|v2.contribution: 提出点-体素特征集合抽象的统一3D检测框架。
1912.13192|v2.innovation: 体素集合抽象与RoI-grid池化实现高效且丰富的上下文特征提取。
1912.13192|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo Open上均取得领先精度。

2003.01251|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中如何有效建模点间关系的问题，提出Point-GNN，将点云编码为固定半径近邻图，用图神经网络预测每个顶点的类别和形状。方法引入自动配准机制减少平移方差，并设计框合并与评分操作融合多顶点检测。在KITTI上仅用点云即达到领先精度，甚至超越融合方法。
2003.01251|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Point-GNN, a graph neural network for LiDAR point cloud 3D detection. It encodes the point cloud as a fixed-radius near-neighbor graph and predicts per-vertex category and shape, with an auto-registration mechanism to reduce translation variance and a box merging/scoring operation. It achieves leading accuracy on KITTI using point cloud alone, even surpassing fusion-based methods.
2003.01251|v2.assessment: 图神经网络用于3D检测的开创性工作，思路新颖且实验扎实，对点云关系建模有启发。
2003.01251|v2.contribution: 提出基于图神经网络的点云3D检测框架Point-GNN。
2003.01251|v2.innovation: 自动配准机制与框合并评分操作提升多顶点检测的准确性。
2003.01251|v2.result: 在KITTI上仅用点云即达到领先精度，超越部分融合方法。

2004.03572|v2.summary_cn: 针对立体图像3D检测中全图视差估计代价高且未利用类别先验的问题，提出Disp R-CNN，设计实例视差估计网络iDispNet仅预测目标像素的视差，并学习类别特定形状先验。方法利用统计形状模型生成密集视差伪真值，无需LiDAR点云。在KITTI上即使训练时无LiDAR真值，平均精度仍超越此前最优方法20%。
2004.03572|v2.summary_en: To address costly full-image disparity estimation and lack of category priors in stereo 3D detection, this paper proposes Disp R-CNN with an instance disparity estimation network (iDispNet) that predicts disparity only for object pixels and learns category-specific shape priors. It uses a statistical shape model to generate dense disparity pseudo-ground-truth without LiDAR. On KITTI, it outperforms previous state-of-the-art by 20% in average precision even without LiDAR ground-truth at training.
2004.03572|v2.assessment: 实例级视差估计与形状先验结合巧妙，减少对LiDAR的依赖，对低成本立体3D检测有重要价值。
2004.03572|v2.contribution: 提出基于实例视差估计和形状先验的立体3D检测系统Disp R-CNN。
2004.03572|v2.innovation: 仅预测目标像素视差并利用统计形状模型生成伪真值，无需LiDAR。
2004.03572|v2.result: 在KITTI上平均精度超越此前最优方法20%。

1911.10150|v2.summary_cn: 针对激光雷达与相机融合方法在KITTI/nuScenes上反而落后于纯激光雷达方法的问题，提出PointPainting顺序融合方法：将激光点投影到图像语义分割输出上，把类别分数附加到每个点，形成'涂色'点云后送入任意纯激光雷达检测器。相比已有融合方法，该方法无需修改检测器结构，可直接增强PointRCNN、VoxelNet、PointPillars三种基线。在KITTI和nuScenes上均取得大幅提升，PointRCNN涂色版在KITTI BEV检测任务上刷新SOTA，并通过消融验证了分割质量与延迟流水线优化。
1911.10150|v2.summary_en: PointPainting addresses the gap where lidar-only detectors outperform fusion methods by proposing a sequential fusion scheme that projects lidar points into image semantic segmentation outputs and appends class scores to each point. The painted point cloud can be fed into any lidar-only detector, yielding large improvements on PointRCNN, VoxelNet, and PointPillars on KITTI and nuScenes. The painted PointRCNN sets a new state of the art on the KITTI BEV detection leaderboard, with ablations on segmentation quality and latency pipelining.
1911.10150|v2.assessment: 融合范式简洁通用，是相机-激光雷达融合的经典工作，对后续BEV融合方法影响深远，值得精读。
1911.10150|v2.contribution: 提出将图像语义分割结果'涂'到激光点云上的顺序融合框架，可即插即用地增强任意纯激光雷达检测器。
1911.10150|v2.innovation: 以点级语义分数附加替代复杂的多模态特征对齐，实现检测器无关的紧融合。
1911.10150|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上使PointRCNN、VoxelNet、PointPillars均大幅提升，PointRCNN涂色版刷新KITTI BEV检测SOTA。

2003.00186|v2.summary_cn: 该论文提出HVNet（Hybrid Voxel Network），面向基于激光雷达的3D目标检测。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节、改进点与实验数据。从标题推断其核心思路是混合体素表示，可能结合不同尺度的体素特征以平衡精度与效率。建议查阅原文以确认其与VoxelNet、PointPillars等基线相比的具体增益。

As the abstract is missing, specific methodology, improvements, and quantitative results cannot be verified. The title suggests a hybrid voxel representation balancing accuracy and efficiency, but details require consulting the original paper.

2003.00186|v2.contribution: 提出面向激光雷达3D检测的混合体素网络HVNet（具体贡献因摘要缺失待核实）。
2003.00186|v2.innovation: 推测为多尺度/混合体素特征编码策略（待原文确认）。

2004.01389|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有激光雷达3D检测器多聚焦单帧、忽略连续点云帧时空信息的问题，提出端到端在线3D视频目标检测器，包含空间特征编码与时空特征聚合两部分。空间侧提出Pillar Message Passing Network（PMPNet），通过迭代消息传递自适应聚合邻域信息以扩大柱特征感受野；时空侧提出Attentive Spatiotemporal Transformer GRU（AST-GRU），在ConvGRU上引入注意力记忆门控，含空间Transformer注意力（STA）强调前景、时间Transformer注意力（TTA）对齐动态目标。实验表明该检测器取得有竞争力的性能。
2004.01389|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes an end-to-end online 3D video object detector operating on point cloud sequences to exploit spatiotemporal information ignored by single-frame detectors. It introduces a Pillar Message Passing Network (PMPNet) for spatial encoding via iterative message passing, and an Attentive Spatiotemporal Transformer GRU (AST-GRU) with spatial and temporal transformer attention modules to emphasize foreground objects and align dynamic objects. Experiments demonstrate competitive performance.
2004.01389|v2.assessment: 将消息传递与时空Transformer注意力结合用于在线3D视频检测，思路清晰，对多帧点云时序建模有参考价值。
2004.01389|v2.contribution: 提出端到端在线3D视频目标检测器，融合PMPNet空间编码与AST-GRU时空聚合。
2004.01389|v2.innovation: 在ConvGRU中引入空间与时间Transformer注意力，分别实现前景强调与动态目标对齐。
2004.01389|v2.result: 实验表明所提3D视频检测器取得有竞争力的检测性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。

1912.11803|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测依赖大规模高质量标注、标注昂贵的问题，提出SESS自集成半监督3D检测框架，这是半监督学习在3D检测中较少被探索的方向。方法设计了全面的扰动方案以增强网络在无标注和新数据上的泛化，并提出三种一致性损失约束两组3D候选框预测的一致性，促进学习物体的结构与语义不变性。在SUN RGB-D和ScanNet上验证了归纳式与直推式半监督检测的有效性，仅用50%标注数据即达到与SOTA全监督方法相当的性能。
1912.11803|v2.summary_en: SESS tackles the heavy annotation burden in point cloud 3D detection by proposing a self-ensembling semi-supervised framework. It designs a thorough perturbation scheme and three consistency losses enforcing agreement between two sets of predicted 3D proposals to learn structural and semantic invariances. On SUN RGB-D and ScanNet, SESS achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art fully-supervised methods using only 50% labeled data.
1912.11803|v2.assessment: 半监督3D检测的早期代表性工作，扰动与一致性损失设计扎实，对降低标注成本有实际意义。
1912.11803|v2.contribution: 提出自集成半监督3D目标检测框架SESS，用扰动与一致性损失利用无标注点云。
1912.11803|v2.innovation: 将自集成半监督范式引入3D检测，设计三种针对3D候选框的一致性损失。
1912.11803|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScanNet上仅用50%标注数据即达到与SOTA全监督方法相当的性能。

Joint 3D Instance Segmentation and Objec.summary_cn: 该论文提出面向自动驾驶的3D实例分割与目标检测联合方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法、改进点与实验数据。从标题推断其核心是让实例分割与检测共享表示、相互促进，可能采用多任务学习框架。建议查阅原文确认其与独立分割/检测方法相比的增益及在KITTI/nuScenes等数据集上的表现。

As the abstract is missing, the specific methodology, improvements, and quantitative results cannot be verified. The title suggests a multi-task framework where segmentation and detection share representations, but details require consulting the original paper.
