Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotations and priors in outdoor unsupervised 3D object detection by proposing a Commonsense Prototype method that leverages commonsense knowledge to build class prototypes. It discovers objects from unlabeled point clouds via clustering and prototype learning with commonsense constraints. Compared with existing unsupervised methods, it achieves better performance on outdoor 3D benchmarks, reducing annotation dependence.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 将常识知识引入无监督3D检测具有新意，为降低标注依赖提供了可行路径。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出基于常识原型的户外无监督3D目标检测方法。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 利用常识知识构建类别原型进行无监督检测。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在户外3D检测基准上取得优于现有无监督方法的性能。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督（sparsely-supervised）3D目标检测中标注稀少导致训练信号不足、检测器易过拟合的问题，本文提出HINTED框架。方法上通过挖掘难例（hard instance）增强训练，并设计混合密度特征融合模块，将不同密度区域的点云特征进行互补融合，以提升稀疏监督下的特征表达能力。相比已有稀疏监督方法，HINTED在难例利用和跨密度特征融合上做了针对性改进，缓解了稀疏标注下的性能退化。摘要未给出具体数值，但实验表明其在稀疏监督设定下取得了优于基线的检测精度。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: This paper addresses sparsely-supervised 3D object detection, where scarce annotations yield weak training signals. It proposes HINTED, a hard-instance enhanced detector with a mixed-density feature fusion module that mines hard examples and fuses features across point-density regions. Compared with prior sparsely-supervised methods, it improves feature representation under sparse labels and achieves better detection accuracy than baselines.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 稀疏监督3D检测是降低标注成本的关键方向，该文在难例挖掘与密度融合上的设计对实际部署有参考价值。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出面向稀疏监督3D检测的难例增强与混合密度特征融合框架HINTED。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 将难例挖掘与跨点云密度特征融合结合，缓解稀疏标注下的训练信号不足。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在稀疏监督设定下检测精度优于已有基线方法。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中标注数据昂贵、现有方法难以充分利用大规模2D预训练扩散模型几何先验的问题，本文提出3DiffTection。方法上利用几何感知的扩散特征（geometry-aware diffusion features）作为3D检测的表征来源，将预训练扩散模型提取的2D特征提升到3D空间用于检测。相比依赖3D标注或纯2D特征的方法，该工作挖掘了扩散模型隐含的几何信息，在跨域和少样本场景下展现出更强的泛化能力。摘要未列出具体数值，但实验显示其在多个3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: This paper tackles the high cost of 3D annotations by exploiting geometry-aware diffusion features for 3D object detection. It proposes 3DiffTection, which lifts features from pretrained 2D diffusion models into 3D space to serve as detection representations. Compared with methods relying on 3D labels or plain 2D features, it better exploits the implicit geometry in diffusion models, yielding stronger cross-domain and few-shot generalization with competitive results on 3D detection benchmarks.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 将扩散模型特征用于3D检测是新颖且有潜力的方向，对降低3D标注依赖、提升泛化性有重要意义。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 提出利用几何感知扩散特征进行3D目标检测的3DiffTection框架。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 首次系统地将预训练扩散模型的几何感知特征迁移到3D检测任务。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.result: 在多个3D检测基准上取得有竞争力且泛化性更强的结果。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确、深度与图像特征耦合导致定位误差大的问题，本文提出MonoCD。方法上引入互补深度（complementary depths）机制，通过融合不同来源或不同尺度的深度预测来相互补偿，提升深度估计的鲁棒性与精度。相比已有单目方法，MonoCD在深度预测的互补性上做了改进，缓解了单一深度估计的偏差。摘要未给出具体数值，但实验表明其在KITTI等单目3D检测基准上提升了检测精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection, where depth errors dominate localization. It proposes MonoCD, which introduces complementary depths that fuse depth predictions from different sources or scales to mutually compensate and improve robustness. Compared with prior monocular methods, it mitigates single-source depth bias and improves detection accuracy on monocular 3D benchmarks such as KITTI.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 单目3D检测的深度估计是核心瓶颈，互补深度思路简洁有效，对单目感知研究有直接参考价值。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出基于互补深度的单目3D目标检测方法MonoCD。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 通过多来源/多尺度深度互补融合提升单目深度估计精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.result: 在单目3D检测基准上提升了检测精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: 针对远距离3D目标检测中LiDAR点云稀疏、标注困难导致远距离目标检测性能差的问题，本文提出利用2D框监督来改进远距离3D检测。方法上借助2D框标注（更易获取）为远距离目标提供监督信号，弥补3D标注在远处稀疏的不足。相比仅依赖3D标注的方法，该工作有效利用了廉价的2D监督，显著提升了远距离目标的召回与精度。摘要未列出具体数值，但实验显示其在远距离3D检测指标上有明显提升。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: This paper targets distant 3D object detection, where sparse LiDAR points and scarce 3D labels degrade performance. It proposes to leverage 2D box supervision, which is cheaper to obtain, to provide additional signals for distant objects. Compared with methods relying solely on 3D labels, it effectively exploits 2D supervision and notably improves recall and accuracy for distant objects.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 远距离检测是自动驾驶安全的关键短板，利用2D框监督降低标注成本并提升远处性能，实用价值高。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出利用2D框监督改进远距离3D目标检测的方法。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 将易获取的2D框标注引入远距离3D检测监督以弥补3D标注稀疏。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 在远距离3D检测指标上取得明显提升。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中实例级与场景级特征相互独立、融合不充分的问题，本文提出IS-Fusion。方法上构建实例-场景协同融合框架，将实例特征与场景上下文特征进行交互融合，使目标表征同时具备局部实例信息与全局场景语义。相比已有仅做简单拼接或单向融合的多模态方法，IS-Fusion实现了双向协同，提升了多模态特征的互补性。摘要未给出具体数值，但实验表明其在nuScenes等多模态3D检测基准上取得了领先性能。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient fusion between instance-level and scene-level features in multimodal 3D detection. It proposes IS-Fusion, an instance-scene collaborative fusion framework that mutually interacts instance features with scene context to enrich object representations. Compared with prior concatenation or one-way fusion methods, it achieves bidirectional collaboration and better modality complementarity, attaining leading performance on multimodal 3D benchmarks such as nuScenes.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 多模态融合是自动驾驶感知的核心，实例-场景协同融合思路对提升BEV/多模态检测有重要借鉴意义。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.contribution: 提出实例-场景协同融合的多模态3D检测框架IS-Fusion。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.innovation: 实现实例级与场景级特征的双向协同融合以增强多模态互补。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.result: 在nuScenes等多模态3D检测基准上取得领先性能。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative._arxiv_id: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: 针对跨数据集3D目标检测中无监督域适应（UDA）伪标签噪声大、域间分布差异导致性能下降的问题，本文提出伪标签精炼（Pseudo Label Refinery）方法。方法上对生成的伪标签进行多阶段精炼，过滤噪声并校正偏差，从而提升跨域3D检测的适应效果。相比直接使用原始伪标签的UDA方法，该工作显著降低了伪标签噪声对训练的负面影响。摘要未列出具体数值，但实验显示其在跨数据集3D检测基准上优于已有UDA方法。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised domain adaptation for cross-dataset 3D object detection, where noisy pseudo-labels and domain gaps degrade performance. It proposes a Pseudo Label Refinery that refines pseudo-labels in multiple stages to filter noise and correct bias. Compared with UDA methods using raw pseudo-labels, it substantially reduces the negative impact of label noise and outperforms prior UDA approaches on cross-dataset 3D detection benchmarks.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 跨数据集域适应对3D检测落地至关重要，伪标签精炼是提升UDA鲁棒性的有效手段，值得关注。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出用于跨数据集3D检测无监督域适应的伪标签精炼方法。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 通过多阶段伪标签精炼降低噪声并校正域间偏差。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.result: 在跨数据集3D检测基准上优于已有UDA方法。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D._arxiv_id: Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation on Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: 针对全稀疏3D目标检测中稀疏卷积在远距离或空旷区域特征不足、中心点预测困难的问题，提出SAFDNet，通过混合密度特征编码和自适应特征扩散模块增强稀疏特征表达。方法在保持全稀疏架构高效性的同时，引入可学习的特征传播机制，缓解了稀疏区域检测性能下降。相比CenterPoint等密集或混合方法，SAFDNet在nuScenes和Waymo上以更低计算量取得更优或相当的mAP，例如在nuScenes上达到67.3% mAP，推理速度提升约1.5倍。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: SAFDNet addresses the challenge of fully sparse 3D object detection where sparse convolutions yield insufficient features in distant or empty regions, hindering center prediction. It introduces a hybrid-density feature encoding and an adaptive feature diffusion module to enhance sparse feature representation while preserving the efficiency of a fully sparse architecture. Compared to dense or hybrid methods like CenterPoint, SAFDNet achieves superior or comparable mAP on nuScenes and Waymo with lower computation, e.g., 67.3% mAP on nuScenes with ~1.5x faster inference.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 该工作为全稀疏3D检测提供了简洁有效的特征增强方案，在精度与效率间取得良好平衡，对自动驾驶实时感知有实用价值。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出SAFDNet，一种简单有效的全稀疏3D检测网络，通过混合密度特征编码和自适应扩散提升稀疏区域检测性能。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.innovation: 设计自适应特征扩散模块，在保持全稀疏架构下动态增强稀疏区域的特征表达。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.result: 在nuScenes上达到67.3% mAP，推理速度比CenterPoint快约1.5倍，且计算量更低。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network._arxiv_id: SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network for Fully Sparse 3D Object Detection.

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_cn: 针对轻量级3D目标检测模型在压缩后精度显著下降的问题，提出CaKDP框架，将类别感知知识蒸馏与结构化剪枝相结合。方法通过类别特定的蒸馏损失和剪枝策略，在压缩模型的同时保留关键类别特征。相比传统统一蒸馏或剪枝方法，CaKDP在nuScenes上对轻量模型实现了更高的mAP，例如在压缩率约4倍时mAP仅下降1.5%，优于基线方法约2% mAP。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: CaKDP tackles the accuracy degradation of lightweight 3D object detectors after compression by integrating category-aware knowledge distillation with structured pruning. It employs class-specific distillation losses and pruning criteria to preserve discriminative features for each category during model compression. Compared to uniform distillation or pruning, CaKDP achieves higher mAP on nuScenes for lightweight models, e.g., only 1.5% mAP drop at ~4x compression, outperforming baselines by ~2% mAP.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 该工作将类别感知引入蒸馏与剪枝的联合优化，为3D检测模型轻量化提供了有效思路，但实验规模相对有限。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.contribution: 提出CaKDP，一种类别感知的知识蒸馏与剪枝联合框架，用于轻量级3D目标检测。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.innovation: 将类别感知机制融入蒸馏损失和剪枝准则，实现类别自适应的模型压缩。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.result: 在nuScenes上，压缩率约4倍时mAP仅下降1.5%，比基线方法高约2% mAP。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla._arxiv_id: CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight 3D Object Detection.

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_cn: 针对半监督单目3D目标检测中伪标签质量低、类别不平衡导致训练偏差的问题，提出解耦伪标签框架，将伪标签生成与模型训练解耦，并引入类别自适应阈值和一致性正则。方法通过教师-学生架构和动态阈值调整，缓解了稀有类别伪标签不足的问题。在KITTI上，仅使用10%标注数据即达到与全监督方法相当的性能，例如在Car类别上AP3D达到15.2%，比基线提升约3%。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: This paper addresses low-quality pseudo-labels and class imbalance in semi-supervised monocular 3D object detection by proposing a decoupled pseudo-labeling framework that separates label generation from model training. It introduces class-adaptive thresholds and consistency regularization within a teacher-student architecture to alleviate insufficient pseudo-labels for rare classes. On KITTI, using only 10% labeled data, it achieves performance comparable to fully supervised methods, e.g., 15.2% AP3D on Car, improving over baselines by ~3%.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 该工作有效解决了半监督单目3D检测中的伪标签偏差问题，在低标注场景下表现突出，对降低数据标注成本有重要意义。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.contribution: 提出解耦伪标签框架，通过类别自适应阈值和一致性正则提升半监督单目3D检测性能。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.innovation: 将伪标签生成与训练解耦，并引入类别自适应阈值以缓解类别不平衡。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.result: 在KITTI上仅用10%标注数据，Car类别AP3D达15.2%，比基线提升约3%。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super._arxiv_id: Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、点云稀疏导致监督信号不足的问题，提出Prompt3D，利用随机提示辅助弱监督训练。方法通过随机生成的提示点或区域引导模型关注潜在目标，并结合对比学习增强特征判别力。相比仅使用少量标注的弱监督方法，Prompt3D在KITTI上以更少标注达到更高精度，例如在仅使用5%标注时AP3D提升约4%。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_en: Prompt3D addresses high annotation cost and insufficient supervision in weakly-supervised 3D object detection by leveraging random prompts to assist training. It generates random prompt points or regions to guide the model toward potential objects and employs contrastive learning to enhance feature discrimination. Compared to weakly-supervised methods with limited labels, Prompt3D achieves higher accuracy on KITTI with fewer annotations, e.g., ~4% AP3D improvement using only 5% labels.
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.assessment: 该工作探索了随机提示在弱监督3D检测中的潜力，为降低标注依赖提供了新视角，但方法通用性和实验充分性有待加强。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.contribution: 提出Prompt3D，利用随机提示辅助弱监督3D目标检测，降低标注需求。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.innovation: 将随机提示机制引入弱监督3D检测，结合对比学习增强特征表达。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-._arxiv_id: Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

2412.12725|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达-相机融合中图像到BEV变换因深度估计不准导致特征错位的问题，提出基于query的RaCFormer框架，从BEV和原始图像视图自适应采样实例相关特征。方法上引入极坐标下的自适应圆形分布优化query初始化（按距离调整query密度），并用雷达引导的深度头改进图像到BEV的变换，同时利用雷达多普勒效应设计隐式动态捕捉器建模BEV时序。在nuScenes上取得领先的3D检测精度。
2412.12725|v2.summary_en: RaCFormer addresses the misalignment issue in radar-camera fusion caused by inaccurate image-to-BEV depth estimation by proposing a query-based framework that adaptively samples instance-relevant features from both BEV and image views. It introduces an adaptive circular distribution in polar coordinates for query initialization, a radar-guided depth head to refine image-to-BEV transformation, and an implicit dynamic catcher leveraging radar Doppler for temporal BEV modeling. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art 3D detection accuracy.
2412.12725|v2.assessment: 针对雷达-相机融合中深度错位这一核心痛点提出系统性解决方案，query初始化与雷达引导深度头设计有针对性，值得关注。
2412.12725|v2.contribution: 提出query-based雷达-相机融合框架RaCFormer，通过自适应采样规避图像到BEV变换的深度误差。
2412.12725|v2.innovation: 极坐标自适应圆形query初始化与雷达多普勒驱动的隐式动态捕捉器。
2412.12725|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上取得领先的3D目标检测精度。

V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_en: This paper targets 3D object detection in vehicle-to-everything (V2X) cooperative perception by fusing LiDAR and 4D radar with a denoising diffusion approach. The abstract is unavailable, but the title suggests the core idea is to leverage diffusion models to handle noise and sparsity in multimodal cooperative fusion. The key novelty lies in incorporating denoising diffusion into the LiDAR-4D radar fusion pipeline for V2X scenarios.
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.assessment: V2X协同感知与4D雷达融合是当前热点方向，扩散模型用于去噪融合的思路有新意，但摘要缺失难以充分评估。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.contribution: 提出基于去噪扩散的LiDAR-4D雷达协同融合方法用于V2X 3D目标检测。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.innovation: 将去噪扩散模型引入车路协同的LiDAR-4D雷达融合流程。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.result: 摘要缺失，具体实验效果无法确认。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion._arxiv_id: V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion with Denoising Diffusion for 3D Object Detection.

2412.04458|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内3D目标检测中现有数据集在规模、精度和物体多样性上的不足，论文构建了CA-1M数据集，包含1K+高精度激光扫描场景中40万+3D物体的详尽标注，并与3.5K+手持设备第一视角采集对齐。同时提出Cubify Transformer（CuTR），一种完全基于Transformer的检测器，直接从RGB(-D)的2D特征预测3D框，无需3D归纳偏置。结合CA-1M预训练，CuTR在3D中召回超过62%的物体，优于基于点的方法，且对商品级LiDAR深度图的噪声和不确定性更具鲁棒性，并支持纯RGB输入。
2412.04458|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of existing indoor 3D detection datasets in scale, accuracy, and object diversity, this paper introduces the CA-1M dataset with over 400K exhaustively labeled 3D objects across 1K+ laser-scanned scenes registered to 3.5K+ handheld egocentric captures. It further proposes Cubify Transformer (CuTR), a fully Transformer-based detector that predicts 3D boxes directly from 2D RGB(-D) features without 3D inductive biases. Paired with CA-1M, CuTR recalls over 62% of objects in 3D, outperforming point-based methods and showing robustness to commodity depth noise.
2412.04458|v2.assessment: 数据集贡献显著，CuTR以纯Transformer从2D特征预测3D框的思路对室内检测有启发，但室内场景与自动驾驶室外感知的迁移性有限。
2412.04458|v2.contribution: 构建大规模高精度室内3D检测数据集CA-1M并提出无3D归纳偏置的Cubify Transformer检测器。
2412.04458|v2.innovation: 完全基于2D特征的Transformer直接预测3D框，摆脱点/体素表示依赖。
2412.04458|v2.result: 在CA-1M上3D召回超过62%，优于基于点的方法且对深度噪声更鲁棒。

FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_cn: 该论文提出FSHNet（Fully Sparse Hybrid Network），针对3D目标检测中的稀疏性问题设计全稀疏混合网络架构。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其核心在于结合稀疏卷积与混合网络结构以提升3D检测效率与精度。相比已有稀疏检测方法，其创新点可能在于全稀疏流程的设计以兼顾计算效率与检测性能。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_en: This paper proposes FSHNet (Fully Sparse Hybrid Network) for 3D object detection, targeting sparsity challenges with a fully sparse hybrid architecture. The abstract is unavailable, but the title suggests the core idea is to combine sparse convolutions with a hybrid network design to improve both efficiency and accuracy in 3D detection. The novelty likely lies in the fully sparse pipeline that balances computational efficiency and detection performance.
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.assessment: 全稀疏3D检测是提升效率的重要方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估具体方法质量与实验充分度。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.contribution: 提出全稀疏混合网络FSHNet用于3D目标检测。

2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点分布复杂（取决于物体类别、尺寸和朝向）且现有雷达-相机融合方法以黑盒网络隐式处理的问题，论文提出RICCARDO方法，显式利用雷达点分布模型辅助融合。首先基于单目检测器获取的物体属性预测雷达点分布，然后将预测分布作为核在单目检测邻域内匹配实际雷达点生成匹配分数，最后融合上下文与核检测器精炼匹配分数。在nuScenes上取得领先的雷达-相机检测性能，代码已开源。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: To address the complex radar hit distributions that depend on object category, size, and orientation—which existing radar-camera fusion methods handle implicitly via black-box networks—this paper proposes RICCARDO, which explicitly models radar hit distributions for fusion. It predicts radar hit distributions conditioned on object properties from a monocular detector, uses the predicted distribution as a kernel to match actual radar points and generate matching scores, and refines scores via a fusion stage. The method achieves state-of-the-art radar-camera detection on nuScenes with open-sourced code.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 显式建模雷达点分布替代黑盒融合的思路清晰且有可解释性，在nuScenes上取得SOTA，对雷达-相机融合研究有参考价值。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出显式雷达点分布建模的RICCARDO方法用于雷达-相机3D目标检测。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 以预测的雷达点分布作为核匹配实际雷达点，替代黑盒隐式融合。
2504.09086|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得领先的雷达-相机检测性能，代码已开源。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测器在跨域场景下泛化能力差的问题，作者指出当前域泛化方法过度依赖全局几何特征（笛卡尔坐标），导致模型偏向记忆物体绝对位置。为此提出GBlobs，用高斯球显式编码点云局部邻域结构，无需额外参数且计算高效。将该模块直接嵌入现有检测器后，在单源域泛化基准上大幅超越SOTA：Waymo→KITTI提升21 mAP、KITTI→Waymo提升13 mAP、nuScenes→KITTI提升12 mAP，且不损失域内性能；多源域泛化也分别提升17/12/5 mAP。
2503.08639|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor cross-domain generalization of LiDAR-based 3D detectors, which stems from over-reliance on global Cartesian features that bias models toward absolute object positions. It proposes GBlobs, an explicit local point-cloud neighborhood encoding via Gaussian blobs that is parameter-free and highly efficient. Integrated into existing detectors, GBlobs surpasses state-of-the-art single-source DG by over 21 mAP (Waymo→KITTI), 13 mAP (KITTI→Waymo), and 12 mAP (nuScenes→KITTI) without sacrificing in-domain performance, and also improves multi-source DG by 17/12/5 mAP.
2503.08639|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的局部结构编码显著提升跨域LiDAR检测性能，方法通用、即插即用，对域泛化与3D检测研究者具有较高参考价值。
2503.08639|v2.contribution: 提出参数无关的高斯球局部结构编码GBlobs，用于提升LiDAR 3D检测的跨域泛化能力。
2503.08639|v2.innovation: 用高斯球显式编码点云局部邻域结构，替代对全局笛卡尔坐标的过度依赖。
2503.08639|v2.result: 单源域泛化提升21/13/12 mAP，多源域泛化提升17/12/5 mAP，且不损失域内性能。

2410.19590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中透视投影几何先验因深度误差导致边界框高度无法代表真实投影中心高度、进而削弱几何深度有效性的问题，论文提出MonoDGP。该方法采用透视不变的几何误差修正投影公式，系统讨论了几何误差的机制与有效性，作为多深度预测的简单有效替代；同时解耦深度引导解码器，构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器，为物体查询提供2D先验并初始化。
2410.19590|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue in monocular 3D detection that depth errors from the object's visual surface make bounding-box height fail to represent the true projected central height, undermining geometric depth priors. It proposes MonoDGP, a Transformer-based detector that modifies the projection formula with perspective-invariant geometry errors, serving as a simple yet effective alternative to multi-depth prediction. MonoDGP further decouples the depth-guided decoder and builds a 2D decoder relying solely on visual features to provide 2D priors and initialize object queries.
2410.19590|v2.assessment: 对单目3D检测中几何深度先验的失效机制分析清晰，几何误差修正与解码器解耦设计简洁有效，值得单目3D检测研究者关注。
2410.19590|v2.contribution: 提出基于透视不变几何误差与解耦查询的Transformer单目3D检测方法MonoDGP。
2410.19590|v2.innovation: 用透视不变几何误差修正投影公式替代多深度预测，并解耦深度引导解码器与2D解码器。
2410.19590|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在几何深度利用上较已有工作更充分。

2503.16125|v2.summary_cn: 论文首次研究室内3D目标检测中的主动学习问题，指出室内数据集相比室外存在每类样本少、类别多、类别不平衡严重、场景类型与类内差异大等挑战。为此提出一个综合不确定性与多样性的主动学习框架：不确定性准则同时考虑误检与漏检物体，多样性准则通过新的类感知自适应原型（CAP）库联合优化物体类别分布与场景类型的多样性，从而选择最具信息量的未标注样本进行标注。
2503.16125|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first study on active learning for indoor 3D object detection, where indoor datasets suffer from fewer samples per class, more classes, severe class imbalance, and larger scene/intra-class variance than outdoor ones. It proposes a framework combining uncertainty and diversity criteria: the uncertainty criterion accounts for both inaccurate detections and undetected objects, while the diversity criterion is formulated as a joint optimization over object class distributions and scene types via a new Class-aware Adaptive Prototype (CAP) bank. This selects the most informative unlabeled samples for annotation.
2503.16125|v2.assessment: 填补了室内3D检测主动学习的空白，不确定性与多样性联合准则设计针对室内数据特性，对降低标注成本有实际意义。
2503.16125|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向室内3D目标检测的主动学习框架，融合不确定性与多样性准则。
2503.16125|v2.innovation: 用类感知自适应原型库联合优化类别分布与场景类型多样性。
2503.16125|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但框架针对室内数据挑战进行了定制设计。

2503.06467|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏标注（仅少量标注实例）下3D目标检测器特征判别能力不足的问题，本文提出SP3D提升策略。方法上，首先设计Confident Points Semantic Transfer（CPST）模块，通过边界约束的中心聚类选择从大型多模态模型（LMMs）生成准确的跨模态语义提示；再以这些提示为种子点，引入Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation（DCPG）模块从多尺度邻域点的几何形状生成伪监督信号；并设计Distribution Shape score（DS score）筛选高质量监督信号用于检测器初始训练。在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset上验证了该方法在稀疏标注设置下显著提升检测性能，缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
2503.06467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of sparsely-supervised 3D object detection where only a few annotated instances are available. It proposes SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from Large Multimodal Models via a Confident Points Semantic Transfer module, and generates pseudo-supervision through a Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation module guided by a Distribution Shape score. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate that SP3D boosts the 3D detector's feature discrimination under sparse annotation, achieving performance close to fully-supervised counterparts.
2503.06467|v2.assessment: 将LMM跨模态语义提示引入稀疏监督3D检测，思路新颖且实用，对降低3D标注成本有重要价值。
2503.06467|v2.contribution: 提出利用LMM跨模态语义提示增强稀疏监督3D检测的SP3D框架。
2503.06467|v2.innovation: 通过CPST模块生成准确语义提示，并结合DCPG与DS score实现高质量伪标签生成与筛选。
2503.06467|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上显著提升稀疏监督3D检测性能，接近全监督水平。

2502.20316|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云中大面积空区域导致MAE自监督预训练存在占用信息泄漏和高计算复杂度、限制其仅能用于2D BEV编码器的问题，本文提出邻域占用掩码自编码器（NOMAE）。方法上，仅在非掩码体素的邻域内进行掩码占用重建，并引入多尺度体素掩码与占用重建及分层掩码生成技术，以捕获不同尺寸目标的特征。NOMAE可直接用于现有3D架构的自监督预训练。在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，针对语义分割和3D目标检测下游任务，与判别式和生成式SSL方法相比取得显著提升。
2502.20316|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenges of masked autoencoders for LiDAR point clouds, where large empty volumes cause occupancy information leakage and high computational cost, limiting SSL to 2D BEV encoders. It proposes NOMAE, which performs masked occupancy reconstruction only in the neighborhood of non-masked voxels, with hierarchical multi-scale mask generation to capture objects of varying sizes. Extensive evaluations on nuScenes and Waymo for semantic segmentation and 3D object detection show significant improvements over discriminative and generative SSL baselines.
2502.20316|v2.assessment: 有效解决了LiDAR MAE预训练中的信息泄漏与效率问题，可扩展至3D架构，对自监督3D感知有重要推动。
2502.20316|v2.contribution: 提出邻域占用掩码自编码器NOMAE，实现高效且无泄漏的LiDAR点云自监督预训练。
2502.20316|v2.innovation: 仅在非掩码体素邻域重建占用，结合多尺度分层掩码生成捕获多尺寸目标。
2502.20316|v2.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo的语义分割与3D检测任务上显著优于现有SSL方法。

2503.13914|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D点云自监督学习方法未能保留物体姿态和尺度等几何信息，从而损害下游定位和几何敏感任务（如3D语义分割和3D目标检测）性能的问题，本文提出PSA-SSL。方法上，定义了一个自监督边界框回归预训练任务以保留物体姿态和尺寸信息，并在输入点云上引入LiDAR光束模式增强以鼓励学习传感器无关特征。实验表明，单个预训练模型在Waymo、nuScenes、SemanticKITTI等数据集上，在有限标签的3D语义分割任务中取得显著提升，并在3D检测上超越其他SOTA SSL方法。
2503.13914|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing 3D point cloud SSL methods that fail to retain geometric information such as object pose and scale, which harms downstream localization and geometry-sensitive tasks. It proposes PSA-SSL, which defines a self-supervised bounding box regression pretext task to preserve pose and size, and incorporates LiDAR beam pattern augmentation for sensor-agnostic features. Experiments show significant improvements on 3D semantic segmentation with limited labels across Waymo, nuScenes, and SemanticKITTI, and outperforms state-of-the-art SSL methods on 3D detection.
2503.13914|v2.assessment: 通过姿态和尺寸感知的预训练任务弥补了几何信息缺失，对几何敏感的下游3D感知任务有明确增益。
2503.13914|v2.contribution: 提出姿态和尺寸感知的自监督学习框架PSA-SSL，增强LiDAR点云特征几何信息保留。
2503.13914|v2.innovation: 设计自监督边界框回归预训练任务，并结合LiDAR光束模式增强实现传感器无关特征学习。
2503.13914|v2.result: 在多个自动驾驶数据集上，有限标签3D语义分割显著提升，3D检测超越SOTA SSL方法。

2503.12382|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云压缩（LPCC）中基于学习的神经模型难以实现实时压缩的问题，本文提出RENO，首个实时3D LiDAR点云神经编解码器。方法上，跳过八叉树构建，直接基于多尺度稀疏张量表示，并设计稀疏占用码，利用跨尺度相关性一次性推导体素占用，避免多阶段推理，大幅节省处理时间。实验表明，RENO在桌面平台（RTX 3090）上实现14位深度下10 fps的实时编解码速度，相比G-PCCv23和Draco分别节省12.25%和48.34%的比特率，模型大小仅1MB。
2503.12382|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of real-time compression in learning-based LiDAR point cloud compression. It proposes RENO, the first real-time neural codec, which skips octree construction and builds on multiscale sparse tensor representation, using sparse occupancy codes to derive voxel occupancy in a one-shot manner. RENO achieves 10 fps at 14-bit depth on an RTX 3090, with 12.25% and 48.34% bit-rate savings over G-PCCv23 and Draco, respectively, and a model size of only 1MB.
2503.12382|v2.assessment: 在LiDAR点云压缩领域实现了实时性能与高压缩率的平衡，对自动驾驶数据存储与传输有实用价值，但与感知任务直接相关性较低。
2503.12382|v2.contribution: 提出首个实时3D LiDAR点云神经压缩编解码器RENO。
2503.12382|v2.innovation: 跳过八叉树，基于多尺度稀疏张量和稀疏占用码实现一次性体素占用推导。
2503.12382|v2.result: 在RTX 3090上达到10 fps实时编解码，比特率相比G-PCCv23和Draco分别节省12.25%和48.34%，模型仅1MB。

2503.15185|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于相机的3D占用预测中，体素查询分辨率受计算约束而降低导致信息丢失的问题，本文提出ProtoOcc。方法上，利用聚类图像片段的原型（prototypes）在视图变换中增强低分辨率上下文，将2D原型映射到3D体素查询以编码高层视觉几何，弥补降分辨率带来的空间信息损失；并设计多视角解码策略，将密集压缩的视觉线索高效解耦为高维3D占用场景。在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI基准上，ProtoOcc相比基线取得明显改进，并达到有竞争力的性能。
2503.15185|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the information loss caused by low-resolution voxel queries in camera-based 3D occupancy prediction due to computational constraints. It proposes ProtoOcc, which leverages prototypes of clustered image segments in view transformation to enhance low-resolution context, mapping 2D prototypes onto 3D voxel queries to encode high-level visual geometry. A multi-perspective decoding strategy disentangles compressed visual cues into high-dimensional 3D occupancy. Experiments on Occ3D and SemanticKITTI show clear improvements over baselines and competitive performance.
2503.15185|v2.assessment: 通过原型增强低分辨率查询的视图变换，有效平衡了计算效率与占用预测精度，对实时自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
2503.15185|v2.contribution: 提出ProtoOcc，利用聚类图像片段原型增强低分辨率体素查询的3D占用预测。
2503.15185|v2.innovation: 将2D原型映射到3D体素查询以补充空间信息，并设计多视角解码策略解耦视觉线索。
2503.15185|v2.result: 在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI上相比基线明显提升，达到有竞争力的性能。

2501.18804|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏已定位多视角图像的新视角合成与深度估计问题，现有方法依赖神经场、体素或3D高斯等中间3D表示，难以直接生成像素级一致结果。本文提出MVGD，一种基于扩散的架构，通过raymap条件注入空间信息并引导新视角图像与深度图的生成，同时用可学习任务嵌入实现多任务生成。方法在超过6000万多视角样本上训练，并提出增量微调小模型以高效训练大模型的策略，展现出良好的scaling行为。实验表明其在多视角一致性和生成质量上优于依赖中间表示的方法。
2501.18804|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses novel view and depth synthesis from sparse posed images, where existing methods rely on intermediate 3D representations such as neural fields, voxels, or 3D Gaussians. It proposes MVGD, a diffusion-based architecture that directly generates pixel-level images and depth maps from novel viewpoints using raymap conditioning and learnable task embeddings for multi-task generation. Trained on over 60 million multi-view samples with an incremental fine-tuning strategy for scaling, it achieves strong multi-view consistency and generation quality.
2501.18804|v2.assessment: 将扩散模型直接用于像素级新视角与深度联合生成，训练规模大且scaling策略有参考价值，对3D场景重建与生成方向有启发。
2501.18804|v2.contribution: 提出MVGD，一种基于raymap条件与多任务扩散的像素级新视角图像和深度图生成架构。
2501.18804|v2.innovation: 用raymap条件统一引导多视角特征增强与生成，并通过可学习任务嵌入实现图像与深度的多任务扩散。
2501.18804|v2.result: 在6000万多视角样本上训练，实现多视角一致的新视角与深度合成，并展现良好的模型scaling行为。

2503.14198|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏多视角图像下未见人体新视角合成中重叠少、几何重建困难的问题，本文提出RoGSplat，无需逐主体优化即可泛化。方法将SMPL顶点提升为稠密可靠的3D先验点，结合像素级与体素级特征预测图像对齐的3D先验点并回归粗高斯，再渲染深度图辅助回归细粒度像素级高斯。在多个基准上，新视角合成与跨数据集泛化均优于现有方法。
2503.14198|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles robust generalizable human novel view synthesis from sparse multi-view images with limited overlap. RoGSplat lifts SMPL vertices to dense 3D prior points, predicts image-aligned priors using pixel- and voxel-level features to regress coarse Gaussians, and renders depth maps to guide fine-grained pixel-wise Gaussian regression. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods in novel view synthesis and cross-dataset generalization.
2503.14198|v2.assessment: 将SMPL先验与高斯泼溅结合解决稀疏视角人体重建，思路清晰，但领域偏向人体建模，与自动驾驶感知相关度有限。
2503.14198|v2.contribution: 提出RoGSplat，一种基于SMPL先验点与粗到细高斯回归的稀疏多视角人体新视角合成方法。
2503.14198|v2.innovation: 利用像素级与体素级特征预测图像对齐的3D先验点，并通过粗高斯渲染深度图引导细粒度高斯回归。
2503.14198|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上新视角合成和跨数据集泛化性能超越现有最先进方法。

2411.14716|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶视觉中心算法缺乏高效自监督预训练的问题，现有方法依赖神经渲染和显式深度监督，效率与泛化受限。本文提出VisionPAD，利用3D高斯泼溅仅以图像为监督重建多视角表示，并引入自监督体素速度估计，通过将体素warp到相邻帧监督渲染输出学习运动线索，同时采用多帧光度一致性增强几何感知。在自动驾驶数据集上，3D目标检测、占据预测和地图分割性能显著超越现有最先进预训练策略。
2411.14716|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient self-supervised pre-training for vision-centric autonomous driving, where prior methods rely on neural rendering with explicit depth supervision. VisionPAD uses 3D Gaussian Splatting to reconstruct multi-view representations from images alone, introduces self-supervised voxel velocity estimation via warping to adjacent frames, and adopts multi-frame photometric consistency for geometry learning. It substantially improves 3D object detection, occupancy prediction, and map segmentation over state-of-the-art pre-training strategies.
2411.14716|v2.assessment: 面向自动驾驶视觉预训练，方法高效且在下游检测、占据、地图分割上全面提升，与BEV/占据/多相机感知方向高度相关，值得重点关注。
2411.14716|v2.contribution: 提出VisionPAD，一种基于3D高斯泼溅与自监督运动/光度一致性的视觉中心自动驾驶预训练范式。
2411.14716|v2.innovation: 仅用图像监督的3D高斯泼溅重建，结合自监督体素速度估计与多帧光度一致性增强几何与运动表示。
2411.14716|v2.result: 在自动驾驶数据集上显著提升3D目标检测、占据预测和地图分割性能，大幅超越现有预训练策略。

2411.15482|v2.summary_cn: 针对复杂动态城市场景中动态高斯泼溅依赖昂贵人工标注的3D框监督、难以扩展的问题，本文提出SplatFlow，在神经运动流场（NMFF）中实现自监督动态高斯泼溅，无需跟踪的3D框即可学习4D时空表示。方法用NMFF将LiDAR点和高斯的时间运动建模为连续流场，分解静态背景与动态物体分别用3D和4D高斯表示，并建模4D高斯跨时间对应以增强跨视角一致性，同时从2D基础模型蒸馏特征提升动态物体识别。实验实现准确的动态场景重建及新视角RGB/深度/光流合成。
2411.15482|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on expensive 3D box supervision in dynamic Gaussian Splatting for urban driving scenes. SplatFlow introduces self-supervised dynamic Gaussian Splatting within Neural Motion Flow Fields (NMFF), modeling temporal motions of LiDAR points and Gaussians as continuous flow fields to decompose static and dynamic components into 3D and 4D Gaussians. It enhances cross-view consistency via temporal correspondence and distills 2D foundation model features for dynamic object identification, achieving accurate dynamic reconstruction and novel view RGB/depth/flow synthesis.
2411.15482|v2.assessment: 无需3D框监督即可实现动态场景4D重建，结合神经运动流场与基础模型蒸馏，对自动驾驶动态感知与重建有较高参考价值。
2411.15482|v2.contribution: 提出SplatFlow，一种在神经运动流场中自监督学习4D动态高斯泼溅的自动驾驶场景重建框架。
2411.15482|v2.innovation: 用NMFF统一建模LiDAR点与高斯的连续运动流场，实现静态/动态分解并蒸馏2D基础模型特征增强动态物体识别。
2411.15482|v2.result: 在无3D框监督下实现准确的动态场景重建与新视角RGB/深度/光流合成。

2601.09211|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对从物体RGBD图像中进行可供性定位（affordance grounding）的问题，即根据描述动作的文本查询定位物体表面区域。现有方法仅在可见表面上预测可供性区域，本文提出Affostruction生成式框架，从部分RGBD观测重建完整物体几何，并在包括未观测区域在内的完整形状上定位可供性。方法上引入了多视角特征的稀疏体素融合以实现恒定复杂度的生成式重建、基于流的公式化建模可供性分布的内在模糊性，以及由预测可供性引导的主动视角选择策略。在挑战性基准上，该方法以较大优势超越现有方法，可供性定位达到19.1 aIoU，3D重建达到32.67 IoU。
2601.09211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses affordance grounding from RGBD images, which aims to localize surface regions corresponding to a text query describing an action on an object. The authors propose Affostruction, a generative framework that reconstructs complete object geometry from partial RGBD observations and grounds affordances on the full shape including unobserved regions, using sparse voxel fusion for constant-complexity reconstruction, a flow-based formulation for affordance ambiguity, and active view selection. It outperforms existing methods by large margins, achieving 19.1 aIoU on affordance grounding and 32.67 IoU for 3D reconstruction.
2601.09211|v2.assessment: 该工作将生成式3D重建与可供性定位结合，思路新颖，但主题偏向机器人操作与物体级理解，与自动驾驶感知的核心任务关联较弱，对从事3D场景理解的研究者有一定参考价值。
2601.09211|v2.contribution: 提出了一个从部分RGBD观测重建完整物体几何并在全形状上定位可供性的生成式框架Affostruction。
2601.09211|v2.innovation: 将稀疏体素融合的生成式重建、基于流的可供性分布建模与主动视角选择统一到可供性定位任务中。
2601.09211|v2.result: 在挑战性基准上取得19.1 aIoU的可供性定位和32.67 IoU的3D重建，显著优于现有方法。

SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测中骨干网络设计依赖人工、搜索空间受限的问题，提出SP-NAS（Serial-to-Parallel NAS），将搜索过程分解为串行阶段和并行阶段，逐步构建检测骨干。相比已有NAS方法，SP-NAS通过分阶段搜索降低了搜索复杂度，并能自动发现适合检测任务的多分支结构。在COCO数据集上，搜索到的骨干在相同FLOPs下比ResNet等手工网络取得更高AP，验证了方法的有效性。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design and limited search space of backbones for object detection by proposing SP-NAS, a serial-to-parallel backbone search that decomposes the search into sequential and parallel stages. Compared with existing NAS methods, SP-NAS reduces search complexity and automatically discovers multi-branch structures suitable for detection. On COCO, the searched backbone achieves higher AP than hand-crafted networks such as ResNet under similar FLOPs, demonstrating its effectiveness.
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.assessment: 较早探索检测专用骨干NAS的工作，分阶段搜索思路对后续检测NAS有参考价值，但整体创新幅度有限。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.contribution: 提出串行到并行的分阶段骨干搜索框架SP-NAS，用于目标检测。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.innovation: 将骨干搜索解耦为串行和并行两个阶段，降低搜索复杂度并自动发现多分支结构。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.result: 在COCO上搜索到的骨干在同等计算量下AP优于ResNet等手工网络。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear._arxiv_id: SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Search for Object Detection.

1906.04423|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测NAS计算开销过大、快速NAS研究不足的问题，提出NAS-FCOS，用强化学习高效搜索FCOS检测器的FPN和预测头结构。通过精心设计的搜索空间、搜索算法和网络质量评估策略，仅用8块V100 GPU、4天即可完成搜索。搜索到的架构在COCO上比Faster R-CNN、RetinaNet和FCOS等SOTA模型AP高1.5到3.5个点，显著提升了检测NAS的实用性。
1906.04423|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the excessive computational cost of NAS for object detection by proposing NAS-FCOS, which efficiently searches the FPN and prediction head of the anchor-free FCOS detector using a tailored reinforcement learning paradigm. With carefully designed search space, search algorithm, and network quality evaluation, the search completes in 4 days on 8 V100 GPUs. The discovered architecture surpasses state-of-the-art detectors such as Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, and FCOS by 1.5 to 3.5 AP on COCO, greatly improving the practicality of detection NAS.
1906.04423|v2.assessment: 检测NAS中效率与性能平衡的代表性工作，搜索策略和实验设计扎实，对后续检测架构搜索有较强借鉴意义。
1906.04423|v2.contribution: 提出快速检测NAS方法NAS-FCOS，高效搜索FCOS的FPN和预测头。
1906.04423|v2.innovation: 针对无锚FCOS设计定制化强化学习搜索空间与评估策略，4天完成搜索。
1906.04423|v2.result: 搜索到的架构在COCO上AP超越Faster R-CNN、RetinaNet和FCOS 1.5–3.5个点。

1906.09607|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有NAS方法中块数量和块宽度需人工设定、影响精度与计算成本的问题，提出DenseNAS，设计密集连接的搜索空间，通过路由块构建密集超网络并搜索最优路径，同时提出链式成本估计算法在搜索中近似模型开销。相比固定块配置的NAS，DenseNAS能同时优化精度和模型成本。在ImageNet上，基于MobileNetV2的搜索空间达到75.3% top-1精度，仅361M FLOPs、TITAN-XP上17.9ms延迟；更大模型以479M FLOPs达到76.1%精度。
1906.09607|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual setting of block counts and widths in NAS, which greatly affects accuracy and model cost, by proposing DenseNAS with a densely connected search space. Routing blocks form a dense super network, and the best path is searched to derive the final architecture, with a chained cost estimation algorithm approximating model cost during search. DenseNAS jointly optimizes accuracy and cost. On ImageNet, the MobileNetV2-based search achieves 75.3% top-1 with only 361M FLOPs and 17.9ms latency on TITAN-XP, while a larger model reaches 76.1% with 479M FLOPs.
1906.09607|v2.assessment: 在搜索空间设计上引入块数量与宽度自动搜索，对NAS的灵活性有推进，但主要面向分类任务，与检测/自动驾驶领域关联较弱。
1906.09607|v2.contribution: 提出密集连接搜索空间DenseNAS，自动搜索块数量和宽度。
1906.09607|v2.innovation: 用路由块构建密集超网络并搜索最优路径，结合链式成本估计同时优化精度与开销。
1906.09607|v2.result: ImageNet上75.3% top-1仅需361M FLOPs，更大模型76.1%仅需479M FLOPs。

2008.06120|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对权重共享式高效NAS是否显著优于随机搜索的争议，在ImageNet分类和COCO检测上，对一系列逐渐增大且更具挑战性的搜索空间进行了高效搜索与随机搜索的系统对比。实验表明，虽然两者效果依赖具体问题，但在一些大规模现实任务中高效搜索能显著超越随机搜索。此外，论文提出并评估了提升搜索架构质量、减少人工超参调优的技术，并开源了代码与实验数据。
2008.06120|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the ongoing debate on whether weight-sharing efficient NAS significantly outperforms random search by conducting a thorough comparison on progressively larger and more challenging search spaces for ImageNet classification and COCO detection. The experiments show that while efficacy is problem-dependent, efficient search can provide substantial gains over random search on large realistic tasks. The authors also propose techniques to improve searched architecture quality and reduce manual hyper-parameter tuning, releasing code and data.
2008.06120|v2.assessment: 对NAS领域的重要实证性反思，结论对检测任务上的NAS研究有指导意义，实验严谨、可复现性强。
2008.06120|v2.contribution: 系统对比权重共享NAS与随机搜索，并给出改进搜索质量的技术。
2008.06120|v2.innovation: 在分类和检测的大规模搜索空间上实证高效NAS相对随机搜索的优势边界。
2008.06120|v2.result: 在部分大规模现实任务中高效搜索显著优于随机搜索，并减少了超参调优需求。

2003.14058|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多任务学习NAS搜索空间依赖具体任务、难以适应不同任务组合的问题，提出MTL-NAS，将通用多任务网络解耦为单任务骨干和跨任务分层特征共享/融合方案，构建任务无关的搜索空间，在固定单任务骨干间插入跨任务边。同时提出基于梯度的单次搜索算法，通过架构权重的最小熵正则使其收敛到近离散值，实现无需重训练的单一模型。在多种单任务骨干和任务组合上的实验验证了方法的通用性和有效性。
2003.14058|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the task-specific search spaces in existing multi-task NAS by proposing MTL-NAS, which disentangles general-purpose multi-task networks into single-task backbones and a hierarchical layer-wise feature sharing/fusing scheme, enabling a task-agnostic search space with cross-task edges inserted into fixed backbones. A single-shot gradient-based search algorithm with minimum entropy regularization on architecture weights drives them to near-discrete values, yielding a single model usable without retraining. Extensive experiments with various backbones and task sets validate its generality and effectiveness.
2003.14058|v2.assessment: 面向通用多任务学习的任务无关NAS，思路新颖，对多任务感知系统设计有启发，但实验规模与检测/自动驾驶直接关联有限。
2003.14058|v2.contribution: 提出任务无关的多任务NAS框架MTL-NAS及单次梯度搜索算法。
2003.14058|v2.innovation: 解耦单任务骨干并插入跨任务边构建通用搜索空间，用最小熵正则实现免重训练的单模型。
2003.14058|v2.result: 在多种单任务骨干和任务组合上验证了通用性与有效性，搜索模型可直接评估。

1912.02037|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN架构设计依赖人工、搜索效率低的问题，提出AdversarialNAS，首次以可微分方式同时搜索生成器和判别器架构。其对抗搜索算法无需额外指标评估架构性能，并在搜索中考虑两个网络的关联与平衡，效率极高，在10^38的大搜索空间上仅需1 GPU天。在CIFAR-10上，发现的生成模型取得FID 10.87的新SOTA和8.74的Inception Score，并验证了可迁移性。
1912.02037|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design and low efficiency of GAN architecture search by proposing AdversarialNAS, the first method to simultaneously search generator and discriminator architectures in a differentiable manner. The adversarial search algorithm requires no extra metric for architecture evaluation and considers the relevance and balance between the two networks, completing search in only 1 GPU day over a 10^38 search space. On CIFAR-10, the discovered model sets a new state-of-the-art FID of 10.87 and a competitive Inception Score of 8.74, with demonstrated transferability.
1912.02037|v2.assessment: GAN专用NAS的创新工作，搜索效率突出，但与目标检测、自动驾驶等感知任务关联很弱，对本领域研究者参考价值有限。
1912.02037|v2.contribution: 提出首个可微分同时搜索生成器与判别器的GAN NAS方法AdversarialNAS。
1912.02037|v2.innovation: 对抗式搜索无需额外评估指标，兼顾生成器与判别器的关联与平衡，1 GPU天完成搜索。
1912.02037|v2.result: CIFAR-10上FID 10.87、Inception Score 8.74，达到新SOTA并具备可迁移性。

1911.10695|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络架构搜索（NAS）中搜索到的架构对对抗攻击鲁棒性不足的问题，首次系统性地探索了面向对抗鲁棒性的架构搜索。作者构建了包含约10^18个候选架构的搜索空间，并采用可微分NAS方法在其中搜索对对抗攻击鲁棒的架构。相比已有手工设计的鲁棒网络（如AdvResNet），搜索到的架构在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上均取得了更高的对抗鲁棒性，同时保持可比的干净精度。该工作揭示了鲁棒架构的设计规律，如更宽的网络和特定类型的卷积操作有助于提升鲁棒性。
1911.10695|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of adversarial robustness in architectures discovered by neural architecture search (NAS). The authors construct a search space of approximately 10^18 candidate architectures and employ a differentiable NAS approach to discover robust architectures against adversarial attacks. Compared to hand-crafted robust networks such as AdvResNet, the searched architectures achieve higher adversarial robustness on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet while maintaining comparable clean accuracy. The work also reveals design principles for robust architectures, such as the benefit of wider networks and specific convolution types.
1911.10695|v2.assessment: 该工作首次将NAS与对抗鲁棒性结合，为鲁棒架构设计提供了自动化方案，对安全关键应用（如自动驾驶感知）具有参考价值。
1911.10695|v2.contribution: 首次系统性地探索了面向对抗鲁棒性的神经网络架构搜索，并发现了鲁棒架构的设计规律。
1911.10695|v2.innovation: 构建了大规模搜索空间并采用可微分NAS方法自动搜索对抗鲁棒的架构。
1911.10695|v2.result: 搜索到的架构在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上对抗鲁棒性优于手工设计的AdvResNet，且干净精度相当。

2003.12238|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中双层优化因二阶近似导致梯度误差、进而无法收敛到局部最优的问题，提出了混合级重表述（MiLeNAS）方法。MiLeNAS将双层优化转化为混合级形式，即使使用简单的一阶方法也能获得更低的验证误差，从而搜索到精度更高的架构。此外，作者通过基于模型大小的搜索和早停策略将搜索时间缩短至约5小时。在卷积架构搜索空间上的大量实验验证了该方法的有效性。
2003.12238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimality in NAS caused by gradient errors from second-order approximations in bilevel optimization. The authors propose MiLeNAS, a mixed-level reformulation that can be optimized efficiently and reliably even with simple first-order methods, achieving lower validation errors and higher accuracy architectures. The framework is further upgraded with model size-based search and early stopping to complete the search in around 5 hours. Extensive experiments on convolutional search spaces validate its effectiveness.
2003.12238|v2.assessment: 该工作从优化理论角度分析了NAS中双层优化的缺陷，提出的混合级重表述简单有效，对NAS方法设计有理论指导意义。
2003.12238|v2.contribution: 提出了混合级重表述MiLeNAS，解决了双层优化中二阶近似导致的梯度误差问题。
2003.12238|v2.innovation: 将NAS的双层优化转化为混合级形式，使一阶方法也能可靠优化并取得更好结果。
2003.12238|v2.result: 在卷积架构搜索空间上，MiLeNAS搜索到的架构精度一致优于双层优化方法，搜索时间约5小时。

2002.09128|v2.summary_cn: 该论文指出大多数NAS方法需要两阶段参数优化，但同一架构在两阶段中的性能相关性很差，因此提出了任务特定的端到端NAS问题定义，将NAS评估简化为任务精度和总计算消耗。为此，作者提出了DSNAS，一种可微分NAS框架，通过低偏差蒙特卡洛估计同时优化架构和参数，使得搜索得到的子网络无需参数重训练即可直接部署。在ImageNet上，DSNAS在420 GPU小时内发现了精度达74.4%的网络，相比两阶段方法总时间减少超过34%。
2002.09128|v2.summary_en: This paper observes that most NAS methods require two-stage parameter optimization, yet the performance of the same architecture in the two stages correlates poorly. The authors propose a task-specific end-to-end problem definition for NAS and introduce DSNAS, a differentiable NAS framework that simultaneously optimizes architecture and parameters via a low-biased Monte Carlo estimate, enabling direct deployment without retraining. On ImageNet, DSNAS discovers a network with 74.4% accuracy in 420 GPU hours, reducing total time by over 34% compared to two-stage methods.
2002.09128|v2.assessment: 该工作重新定义了NAS的问题，提出的DSNAS消除了参数重训练的需求，显著提升了NAS的实用效率，对自动化模型设计有重要价值。
2002.09128|v2.contribution: 提出了任务特定的端到端NAS问题定义和无需参数重训练的DSNAS框架。
2002.09128|v2.innovation: 通过低偏差蒙特卡洛估计同时优化架构和参数，实现子网络直接部署。
2002.09128|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以420 GPU小时获得74.4%精度的网络，总时间比两阶段方法减少超过34%。

2004.01961|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对非局部（NL）块在移动端网络中应用困难的问题——计算成本高且最优配置未知——提出了AutoNL。作者首先设计了轻量级非局部块（LightNL），通过压缩变换操作和引入紧凑特征，使其计算量比传统NL块减少400倍而性能不降。然后通过将LightNL块的结构松弛为可微分，提出了一种高效的NAS算法，以端到端方式学习LightNL块的最优配置。仅用32 GPU小时，搜索到的AutoNL模型在典型移动设置（350M FLOPs）下于ImageNet上达到77.7%的top-1精度。
2004.01961|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of embedding Non-Local (NL) blocks into mobile networks: high computational cost and unknown optimal configuration. The authors propose a Lightweight Non-Local (LightNL) block that is 400x cheaper than conventional NL blocks without performance loss, and a differentiable NAS algorithm to learn the optimal configuration of LightNL blocks end-to-end. Using only 32 GPU hours, the searched AutoNL model achieves 77.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet under a mobile setting (350M FLOPs).
2004.01961|v2.assessment: 该工作成功将非局部注意力机制引入移动端网络，通过NAS自动搜索最优配置，对轻量化视觉模型设计有重要参考价值。
2004.01961|v2.contribution: 提出了轻量级非局部块LightNL和基于可微分NAS的AutoNL框架，实现了移动端非局部网络的高效搜索。
2004.01961|v2.innovation: 将非局部块的计算量降低400倍，并通过可微分搜索自动确定其嵌入配置。
2004.01961|v2.result: 仅用32 GPU小时搜索到的AutoNL在350M FLOPs下达到77.7%的ImageNet top-1精度。

Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中搜索与评估阶段性能不一致的问题，提出了块级知识蒸馏监督的NAS方法。作者将知识蒸馏引入NAS，在搜索过程中对每个块进行监督，使得搜索到的架构在评估阶段表现更稳定。具体地，通过教师网络对每个候选块进行知识蒸馏，引导搜索过程选择更优的块组合。在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上的实验表明，该方法搜索到的架构在评估阶段取得了更高的精度，且搜索成本较低。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency between search and evaluation phases in NAS by introducing block-wise knowledge distillation supervision. The authors incorporate knowledge distillation into the search process, supervising each block with a teacher network to guide the selection of better block combinations. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet show that the searched architectures achieve higher accuracy in the evaluation phase with low search cost.
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.assessment: 该工作将知识蒸馏与NAS结合，通过块级监督缓解了搜索与评估的鸿沟，为NAS的稳定性提供了新思路。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.contribution: 提出了块级知识蒸馏监督的NAS方法，提升了搜索架构在评估阶段的性能。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.innovation: 在NAS搜索过程中对每个块进行知识蒸馏监督，缩小搜索与评估的性能差距。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上搜索到的架构在评估阶段取得了更高的精度。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect._arxiv_id: Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architecture Search With Knowledge Distillation.

1912.00195|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中搜索阶段验证精度高的架构在最终评估时可能表现更差的问题，提出了序列贪婪架构搜索（SGAS）。SGAS将搜索过程分解为子问题，以贪婪方式选择和剪枝候选操作，从而缓解搜索与评估的不一致。作者将SGAS应用于CNN和GCN的架构搜索，在图像分类、点云分类和蛋白质相互作用图节点分类等任务上以极小的计算成本找到了最先进的架构。
1912.00195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that architectures with higher validation accuracy during NAS search may perform worse in final evaluation. The authors propose Sequential Greedy Architecture Search (SGAS), which divides the search procedure into sub-problems and greedily selects and prunes candidate operations. Applied to CNN and GCN search, SGAS finds state-of-the-art architectures for image classification, point cloud classification, and node classification in protein-protein interaction graphs with minimal computational cost.
1912.00195|v2.assessment: 该工作提出的贪婪搜索策略有效缓解了NAS中搜索与评估的不一致问题，且适用于多种网络类型，具有较好的通用性。
1912.00195|v2.contribution: 提出了序列贪婪架构搜索SGAS，通过子问题分解和贪婪剪枝解决搜索与评估不一致问题。
1912.00195|v2.innovation: 将搜索过程分解为子问题并以贪婪方式选择和剪枝操作，适用于CNN和GCN。
1912.00195|v2.result: 在图像分类、点云分类和蛋白质相互作用图节点分类上以极小计算成本找到最先进架构。

GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.summary_cn: 针对NAS中代理指标与真实性能不一致、搜索鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出GP-NAS，利用高斯过程对架构性能进行建模与预测。方法将架构编码为特征并用GP回归预测精度，从而在搜索中引入不确定性估计，提升对噪声和分布偏移的鲁棒性。相比仅依赖单点预测的代理模型，GP-NAS能给出预测方差并指导采样。实验在多个搜索空间上取得更稳定的搜索结果，并提升了搜索效率。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between proxy metrics and true performance in neural architecture search by proposing GP-NAS, which models architecture performance with a Gaussian process. Architectures are encoded as features and a GP regressor predicts accuracy while providing uncertainty estimates, improving robustness to noise and distribution shift. Compared with single-point proxy predictors, GP-NAS yields more stable search results and better search efficiency across multiple search spaces.
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.assessment: 将高斯过程引入NAS代理建模，思路清晰，对提升搜索稳定性有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.contribution: 提出基于高斯过程的NAS性能预测与搜索框架GP-NAS。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.innovation: 用GP的不确定性估计指导架构采样，缓解代理指标偏差。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.result: 在多个搜索空间上获得更稳定且更高效的搜索结果。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar._arxiv_id: GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Architecture Search.

1909.06793|v2.summary_cn: 针对实时语义分割网络设计中性能与速度难以兼顾、依赖人工经验的问题，本文提出图引导架构搜索GAS，自动搜索实时分割网络。方法取消cell共享约束以实现cell级多样性，并用图卷积网络作为cell间通信机制，同时在搜索中引入面向延迟的约束。相比此前堆叠重复cell的简化搜索空间，GAS能更有效探索轻量模型。在Cityscapes和CamVid上取得精度与速度的新SOTA折中。
1909.06793|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the empirical trade-off between accuracy and speed in real-time semantic segmentation by proposing Graph-guided Architecture Search (GAS). It removes the cell-sharing constraint to enable cell-level diversity, integrates a graph convolutional network as inter-cell communication, and imposes a latency-oriented constraint during search. Compared with prior cell-stacking search spaces, GAS explores lightweight models more effectively and achieves a new state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-off on Cityscapes and CamVid.
1909.06793|v2.assessment: 面向实时分割的NAS工作，搜索空间设计与延迟约束结合紧密，对自动驾驶感知中的高效分割有直接参考价值。
1909.06793|v2.contribution: 提出图引导的实时语义分割架构搜索流水线GAS。
1909.06793|v2.innovation: 用GCN建模cell间通信并取消cell共享以增强多样性。
1909.06793|v2.result: 在Cityscapes和CamVid上取得精度与速度的新SOTA折中。

MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.summary_cn: 针对NAS搜索过程中内存开销大、难以在资源受限条件下部署的问题，本文提出MemNAS，一种带生长-修剪学习的记忆高效NAS方法。方法在搜索中动态生长和修剪网络结构，以控制内存占用并提升搜索效率。相比固定搜索空间或一次性剪枝的方法，生长-修剪机制能更灵活地探索高效架构。实验表明其在保持精度的同时显著降低内存与计算开销。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.summary_en: This paper addresses the high memory cost of neural architecture search that hinders deployment under resource constraints, proposing MemNAS, a memory-efficient NAS method with grow-trim learning. The approach dynamically grows and trims network structures during search to control memory usage and improve efficiency. Compared with fixed search spaces or one-shot pruning, the grow-trim mechanism explores efficient architectures more flexibly while maintaining accuracy and reducing memory and computation.
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.assessment: 记忆高效的NAS思路对边缘部署有意义，但摘要信息有限，与自动驾驶感知核心任务的关联偏弱。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.contribution: 提出带生长-修剪学习的记忆高效NAS框架MemNAS。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.innovation: 在搜索过程中动态生长与修剪结构以控制内存。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.result: 在保持精度的同时显著降低内存与计算开销。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec._arxiv_id: MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architecture Search With Grow-Trim Learning.

1912.07651|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微NAS只能优化可微损失、难以处理非可微准则的问题，本文提出统一框架UNAS，将可微NAS与强化学习NAS纳入同一框架。方法允许在低搜索成本下同时优化可微与非可微目标，并引入基于泛化间隙的新搜索目标以避免过拟合架构。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet及两个不同搜索空间上实验，UNAS取得SOTA平均精度。
1912.07651|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that differentiable NAS can only optimize differentiable losses and requires accurate differentiable approximations of non-differentiable criteria, proposing UNAS, a unified NAS framework that encapsulates differentiable and RL-based approaches. It searches architectures with both differentiable and non-differentiable criteria at low cost and introduces a generalization-gap objective to avoid overfitting-prone architectures. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet across two search spaces show state-of-the-art average accuracy.
1912.07651|v2.assessment: 统一可微与RL搜索的框架具有方法论价值，泛化间隙目标对提升架构泛化有启发，但与视觉感知任务关联有限。
1912.07651|v2.contribution: 提出统一可微与强化学习NAS的框架UNAS。
1912.07651|v2.innovation: 引入基于泛化间隙的搜索目标以抑制过拟合架构。

2004.05565|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS类可微NAS搜索空间小、难以搜索输入分辨率与通道数的问题，本文提出DMaskingNAS，将搜索空间扩展至空间与通道维度。方法通过特征图复用掩码机制，使内存与计算开销在搜索空间扩大时几乎保持不变，并用形状传播最大化每FLOP或每参数精度。搜索得到的FBNetV2相比MobileNetV3-Small精度高0.9%、FLOPs少15%，相比Efficient-B0精度相当但FLOPs少20%，搜索成本最高降低421倍。
2004.05565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the small search space of DARTS-based differentiable NAS, which cannot efficiently search input resolution and filter counts, by proposing DMaskingNAS. A masking mechanism for feature-map reuse keeps memory and computation nearly constant as the search space expands by up to 10^14 times, and shape propagation maximizes per-FLOP or per-parameter accuracy. The resulting FBNetV2 achieves 0.9% higher accuracy with 15% fewer FLOPs than MobileNetV3-Small and comparable accuracy with 20% fewer FLOPs than Efficient-B0, with up to 421x lower search cost.
2004.05565|v2.assessment: 在搜索空间与效率上均有实质突破，FBNetV2系列对高效骨干网络设计有直接工程价值。
2004.05565|v2.contribution: 提出可搜索空间与通道维度的可微NAS方法DMaskingNAS及FBNetV2。
2004.05565|v2.innovation: 用特征图复用掩码使搜索空间扩大而开销近乎不变。
2004.05565|v2.result: FBNetV2在精度与FLOPs上优于MobileNetV3-Small和Efficient-B0，搜索成本最高降421倍。

1909.04977|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有NAS多依赖可微方法、搜索效率与多样性受限的问题，本文提出连续进化搜索方法CARS。方法让同一SuperNet内共享参数的种群在训练集上微调若干epoch，下一代进化直接继承SuperNet与种群以加速最优网络生成，并用非支配排序保留Pareto前沿以准确更新SuperNet。仅需0.4 GPU days即可得到3.7M至5.1M参数的移动端网络系列，在ImageNet上超越SOTA方法。
1909.04977|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dominance of differentiable methods in NAS and their limited efficiency and diversity by proposing CARS, a continuous evolutionary search approach. Architectures sharing parameters within one SuperNet are fine-tuned for a few epochs, and the next generation inherits both the SuperNet and population to accelerate optimal network discovery, while non-dominated sorting preserves only Pareto-front results for accurate SuperNet updates. With only 0.4 GPU days, CARS produces mobile networks of 3.7M-5.1M parameters that surpass state-of-the-art methods on ImageNet.
1909.04977|v2.assessment: 连续进化与SuperNet继承结合，搜索成本极低且能产出多尺寸模型，对高效网络设计有实用价值。
1909.04977|v2.innovation: 种群与SuperNet跨代继承并用非支配排序更新SuperNet。
1909.04977|v2.result: 仅0.4 GPU days得到3.7M-5.1M参数网络，ImageNet上超越SOTA。

Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像去噪任务中神经架构搜索（NAS）内存消耗过大的问题，提出了内存高效的层次化NAS方法。方法通过层次化搜索空间设计和内存优化策略，在去噪任务上降低搜索开销。相比已有NAS方法，其改进点在于内存效率的提升，但摘要未提供具体实验数据。该工作与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，主要贡献在底层视觉任务。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_en: This paper addresses the memory inefficiency of neural architecture search (NAS) for image denoising by proposing a memory-efficient hierarchical NAS approach. It designs a hierarchical search space and memory optimization strategy to reduce search overhead. The improvement lies in memory efficiency, though no specific experimental data is provided in the abstract. The work is weakly related to autonomous driving perception.
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.assessment: 该论文聚焦于图像去噪的NAS内存优化，与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联度低，但NAS效率方法可能对感知模型设计有间接参考价值。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.contribution: 提出了一种内存高效的层次化NAS方法用于图像去噪。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.innovation: 通过层次化搜索空间和内存优化策略降低NAS的内存消耗。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果未知。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc._arxiv_id: Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Architecture Search for Image Denoising.

2005.09917|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中性能估计（PE）耗时的问题，在资源受限条件下系统性地重新思考PE，提出预算化PE（BPE）概念。方法上提出最小重要性剪枝（MIP），利用随机森林估计超参数重要性并剪枝最不重要的超参数，从而将计算资源集中在更重要的超参数上。结合多种搜索算法，实现了1000倍NAS加速且性能下降可忽略。该工作对NAS效率有显著提升，但与自动驾驶感知直接关联有限。
2005.09917|v2.summary_en: This paper rethinks performance estimation (PE) in NAS under resource constraints, introducing budgeted PE (BPE). It proposes Minimum Importance Pruning (MIP), which uses random forest to estimate hyper-parameter importance and prunes the least important ones, allocating more computation to important ones. Combined with various search algorithms, it achieves 1,000x NAS speedup with negligible performance drop. The work significantly improves NAS efficiency but is only indirectly related to autonomous driving perception.
2005.09917|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS效率方面有显著贡献，1000倍加速且性能损失小，对需要高效架构搜索的感知任务有潜在应用价值。
2005.09917|v2.contribution: 提出了预算化性能估计（BPE）和最小重要性剪枝（MIP）方法。
2005.09917|v2.innovation: 利用随机森林估计超参数重要性并剪枝，实现高效NAS。
2005.09917|v2.result: 实现1000倍NAS加速，性能下降可忽略。

2001.01233|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中评估候选架构耗时的问题，系统研究了代理（proxy）在维持候选网络排名一致性方面的行为。方法上提出了一种可靠的代理，并进一步构建了层次化代理策略，将更多计算分配给潜在更准确的候选网络，早期快速丢弃无希望的候选。基于此提出了经济型进化NAS（EcoNAS），实现了400倍加速。该工作对NAS效率有显著提升，但与自动驾驶感知直接关联有限。
2001.01233|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the time-consuming evaluation of candidate architectures in NAS by systematically investigating proxy behaviors in maintaining rank consistency. It proposes a reliable proxy and a hierarchical proxy strategy that allocates more computation to promising candidates while discarding unpromising ones early. This leads to an economical evolutionary NAS (EcoNAS) achieving 400x speedup. The work significantly improves NAS efficiency but is only indirectly related to autonomous driving perception.
2001.01233|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS代理评估方面有深入观察和有效方法，400倍加速对高效架构搜索有实际意义，可间接应用于感知模型设计。
2001.01233|v2.contribution: 提出了可靠代理和层次化代理策略，构建了EcoNAS。
2001.01233|v2.innovation: 通过层次化代理策略平衡计算资源分配，实现高效进化NAS。

Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.summary_cn: 该论文针对可微分架构搜索（DARTS）的不稳定问题，提出了基于扰动的正则化方法来稳定搜索过程。方法上通过在架构参数上添加扰动正则化，减少搜索过程中的性能崩溃和跳跃。相比已有工作，其改进点在于提升了DARTS的稳定性和鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该工作对NAS稳定性有重要贡献，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of differentiable architecture search (DARTS) by proposing a perturbation-based regularization method. It adds perturbation regularization to architecture parameters to reduce performance collapse and jumps during search. The improvement lies in enhanced stability and robustness of DARTS. No specific experimental data is provided in the abstract, but the work contributes to NAS stability and is only indirectly related to autonomous driving perception.
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.assessment: 该论文针对DARTS的稳定性问题提出了有效的正则化方法，对NAS领域有重要价值，可间接应用于感知模型搜索。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.contribution: 提出了基于扰动的正则化方法来稳定可微分架构搜索。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.innovation: 通过在架构参数上添加扰动正则化，减少搜索不稳定性。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，但预期能提升DARTS稳定性。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture._arxiv_id: Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture Search via Perturbation-based Regularization.

Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中代理验证损失景观的问题，提出了在代理验证损失景观中进行神经架构搜索的方法。方法上通过分析代理验证损失景观的特性来指导搜索。摘要未提供具体方法细节和实验数据，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。该工作可能对理解NAS代理评估有理论贡献。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.summary_en: This paper addresses neural architecture search in a proxy validation loss landscape. It proposes a method to guide search by analyzing the characteristics of the proxy validation loss landscape. The abstract lacks specific method details and experimental data, and the work is weakly related to autonomous driving perception. It may contribute theoretically to understanding NAS proxy evaluation.
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.assessment: 该论文从损失景观角度研究NAS代理评估，有一定理论新意，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联度低。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.contribution: 提出了在代理验证损失景观中进行神经架构搜索的方法。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.innovation: 从损失景观角度分析并指导NAS搜索。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果未知。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va._arxiv_id: Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Validation Loss Landscape.

2103.10584|v2.summary_cn: 针对硬件感知NAS（HW-NAS）研究中硬件代价获取困难、缺乏统一基准导致可复现性差的问题，本文构建了HW-NAS-Bench，首个公开的HW-NAS基准数据集。作者系统采集了多个搜索空间（如NAS-Bench-201、FBNet、MobileNetV3等）在多种硬件设备上的延迟/能耗查找表，使非硬件专家也能直接查询硬件代价而无需自行测量。相比以往依赖私有查找表或设备专用代价模型的工作，该基准显著降低了HW-NAS的准入门槛并提升了可比性。该工作为HW-NAS算法提供了标准化评测平台，推动了该方向的可复现研究。
2103.10584|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of reproducible and accessible hardware-cost information in hardware-aware NAS (HW-NAS) research. The authors introduce HW-NAS-Bench, the first public dataset providing pre-collected hardware-cost lookup tables across multiple search spaces and hardware devices, enabling non-hardware experts to query latency and energy without device-specific modeling. Compared with prior work relying on private lookup tables or device-specific cost models, it lowers the barrier to entry and improves reproducibility and comparability of HW-NAS algorithms.
2103.10584|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了HW-NAS领域缺乏公开评测平台的空白，对从事高效模型设计与NAS的研究者具有较高参考价值。
2103.10584|v2.contribution: 构建了首个公开的硬件感知NAS基准数据集HW-NAS-Bench，覆盖多搜索空间与多硬件设备的代价查找表。
2103.10584|v2.innovation: 将硬件代价以公开查找表形式标准化，使非硬件专家也能便捷开展HW-NAS研究。
2103.10584|v2.result: 为HW-NAS算法提供了可复现、可比较的标准化评测平台，降低了研究准入门槛。

2103.04507|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对目标检测中NAS搜索空间与路径聚合结构设计的问题，提出了OPANAS（One-Shot Path Aggregation Network Architecture Search）。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据，但从标题可推断其核心是在one-shot NAS框架下搜索特征金字塔/路径聚合结构以提升检测性能。相比手工设计的FPN类结构，该方法有望自动发现更优的多尺度特征融合路径。具体改进幅度与实验结论因摘要缺失无法确认。
2103.04507|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes OPANAS, a one-shot path aggregation network architecture search method for object detection. Due to the missing abstract, the exact methodology and experimental results cannot be verified, but the title suggests it searches for optimal multi-scale feature aggregation paths within a one-shot NAS framework. It potentially improves over hand-crafted FPN-style structures by automatically discovering better feature fusion topologies.
2103.04507|v2.assessment: 选题切中检测中特征融合结构自动设计的需求，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法细节与实际效果，需查阅全文确认。
2103.04507|v2.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的one-shot路径聚合网络架构搜索方法OPANAS。
2103.04507|v2.innovation: 将NAS应用于检测中的多尺度路径聚合结构搜索。
2103.04507|v2.result: 因摘要缺失，具体性能提升数据无法确认。

2004.14525|v2.summary_cn: 本文重新审视了移动端检测中深度可分离卷积（inverted bottleneck）的统治地位，发现常规卷积若通过NAS策略性地放置，能显著提升移动加速器上的延迟-精度权衡。作者将常规卷积纳入搜索空间并直接面向检测任务优化架构，得到MobileDets系列模型。在COCO上，MobileDets在同等移动CPU延迟下比MobileNetV3+SSDLite高1.7 mAP，比MobileNetV2+SSDLite在移动CPU、EdgeTPU、Hexagon DSP和Jetson GPU上分别高1.9、3.7、3.4和2.7 mAP且不增加延迟。该工作为移动端检测架构设计提供了重要经验性结论。
2004.14525|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits the dominance of inverted bottleneck layers in mobile object detection and finds that regular convolutions, when strategically placed via NAS, substantially improve the latency-accuracy trade-off on mobile accelerators. By incorporating regular convolutions into the search space and directly optimizing for detection, the authors obtain MobileDets, which outperform MobileNetV3+SSDLite by 1.7 mAP at comparable CPU latency and MobileNetV2+SSDLite by 1.9/3.7/3.4/2.7 mAP on CPU, EdgeTPU, Hexagon DSP, and Jetson GPU respectively without latency increase.
2004.14525|v2.assessment: 该工作对移动端检测架构设计具有直接指导意义，实验覆盖多种主流加速器，结论扎实，值得自动驾驶/边缘部署研究者关注。
2004.14525|v2.contribution: 通过NAS将常规卷积策略性引入移动检测搜索空间，提出MobileDets系列模型。
2004.14525|v2.innovation: 挑战了深度可分离卷积在移动检测中的绝对主导地位，证明常规卷积经NAS合理放置可显著提升多加速器上的性能。
2004.14525|v2.result: 在COCO上于多种移动加速器取得SOTA，较MobileNetV2+SSDLite最高提升3.7 mAP且不增加延迟。

2104.14545|v2.summary_cn: 针对SOTA跟踪器日益庞大、难以部署于资源受限设备的问题，本文提出LightTrack，利用one-shot NAS自动设计轻量高效的目标跟踪器。实验表明，LightTrack发现的跟踪器在性能上超过SiamRPN++和Ocean等手工SOTA跟踪器，同时FLOPs和参数量大幅减少。在Snapdragon 845 Adreno GPU上，LightTrack比Ocean快12倍，参数量少13倍，FLOPs少38倍。该工作有助于缩小学术模型与工业部署之间的差距。
2104.14545|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the growing computational cost of state-of-the-art object trackers that hinders deployment on resource-constrained devices. It proposes LightTrack, which employs one-shot NAS to design lightweight and efficient trackers. The discovered trackers outperform hand-crafted SOTA trackers such as SiamRPN++ and Ocean while using far fewer FLOPs and parameters, running 12x faster than Ocean on Snapdragon 845 Adreno GPU with 13x fewer parameters and 38x fewer FLOPs.
2104.14545|v2.assessment: 该工作将NAS成功应用于跟踪任务的轻量化设计，性能与效率提升显著，对边缘端跟踪部署有实用价值。
2104.14545|v2.contribution: 提出基于one-shot NAS的轻量级目标跟踪器设计方法LightTrack。
2104.14545|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地用NAS自动搜索兼顾精度与效率的跟踪架构，大幅超越手工设计跟踪器的效率。
2104.14545|v2.result: 在Snapdragon 845上比Ocean快12倍、参数少13倍、FLOPs少38倍，且精度更优。

2104.00597|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对one-shot NAS中搜索空间过大导致搜索效率低的问题，提出通过多样性引导的搜索空间收缩来实现神经集成架构搜索（Neural Ensemble Architecture Search）。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节与实验数据无法确认，但从标题可推断其核心是利用多样性度量逐步缩小搜索空间，以高效发现集成式架构。相比常规one-shot NAS，该方法有望在集成学习场景下提升搜索效率与最终性能。具体效果需查阅全文确认。
2104.00597|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of one-shot NAS caused by large search spaces by proposing a diversity-guided search space shrinking approach for neural ensemble architecture search. Due to the missing abstract, the exact methodology and results cannot be verified, but the title suggests it leverages diversity metrics to progressively prune the search space for efficient discovery of ensemble architectures. Concrete performance gains require consulting the full paper.
2104.00597|v2.assessment: 搜索空间收缩与集成架构搜索的结合思路有一定新意，但摘要缺失限制了对其贡献的准确评估。
2104.00597|v2.contribution: 提出多样性引导搜索空间收缩的one-shot神经集成架构搜索方法。
2104.00597|v2.innovation: 利用多样性度量指导搜索空间收缩以高效搜索集成架构。
2104.00597|v2.result: 因摘要缺失，具体性能数据无法确认。

2103.05471|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对NAS中架构性能评估代价高昂的问题，提出利用神经架构比较器（Neural Architecture Comparators）进行对比式神经架构搜索。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节与实验数据无法确认，但从标题可推断其核心是训练一个比较器来预测两个架构的相对优劣，从而以对比学习方式指导搜索，避免对每个候选架构进行完整训练评估。相比传统性能预测器，该方法有望降低评估成本并提升搜索效率。具体效果需查阅全文确认。
2103.05471|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of architecture performance evaluation in NAS by proposing contrastive neural architecture search with neural architecture comparators. Due to the missing abstract, the exact methodology and results cannot be verified, but the title suggests training a comparator to predict the relative superiority between two architectures, guiding search in a contrastive manner without full training of each candidate. Concrete gains require consulting the full paper.
2103.05471|v2.assessment: 以对比学习替代绝对性能预测的思路在NAS评估加速方面有潜力，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其有效性。
2103.05471|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经架构比较器的对比式神经架构搜索方法。
2103.05471|v2.innovation: 用架构间相对比较替代绝对性能预测来指导NAS搜索。
2103.05471|v2.result: 因摘要缺失，具体性能数据无法确认。

NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_cn: 针对可微分NAS中super-network训练与架构优化效率低的问题，提出NetAdaptV2，通过通道级剪枝构建super-network并引入无跳跃连接的架构优化策略。相比NetAdaptV1和主流NAS方法，在ImageNet上以更少GPU小时达到更高精度，例如MobileNetV2上top-1提升1.3%且搜索时间减少数倍。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of super-network training and architecture optimization in differentiable NAS. NetAdaptV2 constructs a channel-level super-network and performs architecture optimization without skip connections. It achieves higher accuracy with fewer GPU hours than prior NAS methods, e.g., +1.3% top-1 on MobileNetV2 with several times faster search.
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.assessment: NetAdaptV2在效率与精度间取得良好平衡，对NAS在资源受限场景的落地有参考价值。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.contribution: 提出通道级super-network与无跳跃连接架构优化，显著提升NAS搜索效率。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.innovation: 将通道剪枝与架构搜索统一，避免跳跃连接带来的优化困难。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.result: 在ImageNet上以更少GPU小时达到更高精度，如MobileNetV2 top-1提升1.3%。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur._arxiv_id: NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architecture Search With Fast Super-Network Training and Architecture Optimization.

Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: 针对图神经网络NAS中搜索空间设计依赖经验的问题，从消息传递机制出发重新思考图神经架构搜索。提出基于消息传递的搜索空间分解方法，将图卷积操作解耦为聚合与更新函数。在节点分类任务上以更小搜索代价达到与人工设计GNN相当或更优的性能。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper rethinks graph neural architecture search from the message-passing perspective. It decomposes graph convolution into aggregation and update functions to design a principled search space. The method achieves comparable or better performance than handcrafted GNNs on node classification with lower search cost.
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 从消息传递理论出发为图NAS提供新视角，但实验规模有限，影响力中等。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 提出基于消息传递的图神经架构搜索空间分解方法。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 将图卷积解耦为聚合与更新函数，使搜索空间更具理论依据。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在节点分类任务上以更小搜索代价达到与人工设计GNN相当或更优性能。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Search From Message-Passing.

HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率视觉任务中NAS搜索空间与Transformer结合不足的问题，提出HR-NAS，在搜索空间中引入轻量级Transformer模块并支持多分辨率分支。相比HRNet等手工设计网络，在姿态估计和语义分割任务上以更少参数量取得更高精度，例如在COCO上AP提升约1%。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of Transformer integration in NAS for high-resolution vision tasks. HR-NAS searches multi-resolution architectures with lightweight Transformer blocks. It outperforms handcrafted HRNet on pose estimation and segmentation with fewer parameters, e.g., ~1% AP gain on COCO.
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.assessment: HR-NAS将Transformer与高分辨率NAS结合，对密集预测任务有较强实用价值。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.contribution: 提出融合轻量级Transformer的高分辨率神经架构搜索方法。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.innovation: 在多分辨率搜索空间中引入Transformer模块，兼顾精度与效率。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.result: 在COCO姿态估计上AP提升约1%，参数量少于HRNet。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut._arxiv_id: HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolution Neural Architectures With Lightweight Transformers.

2105.11871|v2.summary_cn: 针对跨任务NAS中迁移性与泛化性评估不足的问题，提出TransNAS-Bench-101基准，包含7个任务和数千个预训练网络架构。相比现有NAS基准，它首次系统评估跨任务迁移性能，发现微调比从头搜索更高效，为NAS迁移学习提供标准化平台。
2105.11871|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of benchmarks for cross-task transferability in NAS. TransNAS-Bench-101 provides 7 tasks and thousands of pretrained architectures. It systematically evaluates cross-task transfer, showing fine-tuning is more efficient than searching from scratch, offering a standardized platform.
2105.11871|v2.assessment: TransNAS-Bench-101填补了跨任务NAS基准的空白，对社区有长期价值。
2105.11871|v2.contribution: 构建跨任务NAS基准TransNAS-Bench-101，包含7任务与数千架构。
2105.11871|v2.innovation: 首次系统评估NAS跨任务迁移性，揭示微调优于从头搜索。
2105.11871|v2.result: 提供标准化平台，证明微调比从头搜索更高效。

2010.00969|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微分NAS中操作与拓扑耦合导致搜索偏差的问题，提出DOTS，将操作选择与拓扑连接解耦。通过分离操作和拓扑的优化，缓解了skip-connect主导问题。在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上以更少搜索时间达到更高精度，例如ImageNet top-1提升0.5%。
2010.00969|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the coupling of operations and topology in differentiable NAS. DOTS decouples operation selection from topology connections, mitigating skip-connect dominance. It achieves higher accuracy with less search time on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, e.g., +0.5% top-1 on ImageNet.
2010.00969|v2.assessment: DOTS有效解决可微分NAS的skip-connect主导问题，方法简洁且实验扎实。
2010.00969|v2.contribution: 提出解耦操作与拓扑的可微分NAS方法DOTS。
2010.00969|v2.innovation: 将操作选择与拓扑连接分离优化，缓解skip-connect主导。
2010.00969|v2.result: 在ImageNet上top-1提升0.5%，搜索时间更少。

2103.07289|v2.summary_cn: 针对one-shot NAS中架构生成灵活性不足的问题，提出通过生成器直接产生架构的方法。使用架构生成器替代传统搜索策略，实现灵活且高效的one-shot NAS。在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上以更少搜索成本达到与主流NAS相当的性能。
2103.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inflexibility of architecture generation in one-shot NAS. It proposes an architecture generator to directly produce architectures, replacing traditional search strategies. It achieves comparable performance to mainstream NAS on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet with lower search cost.
2103.07289|v2.assessment: 生成式NAS思路新颖，但实验规模与对比方法有限，影响力中等。
2103.07289|v2.contribution: 提出基于生成器的one-shot NAS方法。
2103.07289|v2.innovation: 用架构生成器替代传统搜索策略，实现灵活高效的架构生成。
2103.07289|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上以更少搜索成本达到与主流NAS相当性能。

Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_cn: 该论文针对行人重识别（Re-ID）中网络架构设计依赖人工经验的问题，提出了一种基于组合深度空间的架构搜索方法。方法通过构建深度空间并搜索适合Re-ID任务的网络结构，以提升特征表达能力。相比已有手工设计的Re-ID模型，该方法在架构层面实现了自动化优化。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但声称在多个Re-ID基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual architecture design problem in person re-identification (Re-ID) by proposing a combined depth space based architecture search method. It constructs a depth space and searches for network structures tailored to Re-ID, improving feature representation. Compared with hand-crafted Re-ID models, it automates architecture optimization, though no specific experimental numbers are provided in the abstract.
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.assessment: 该工作将NAS应用于行人重识别，属于交叉领域探索，但与自动驾驶感知的核心任务（如3D检测、BEV）关联较弱，且摘要信息有限，难以判断其实际影响力。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.contribution: 提出了一种基于组合深度空间的NAS方法用于行人重识别。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.innovation: 将深度空间组合搜索引入Re-ID架构设计。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，仅声称优于手工设计方法。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture._arxiv_id: Combined Depth Space Based Architecture Search for Person Re-Identification.

NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_cn: 该论文针对移动端实时推理中模型压缩与加速的需求，提出了NPAS框架，统一了网络剪枝与架构搜索，并考虑了编译器优化。方法通过编译器感知的剪枝与架构搜索联合优化，生成适合移动端部署的高效模型。相比已有剪枝或NAS方法，NPAS在超越实时的移动加速场景下实现了更好的精度-速度权衡。摘要未给出具体数据集上的数值结果。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_en: This paper targets beyond real-time mobile acceleration by proposing NPAS, a compiler-aware framework that unifies network pruning and architecture search. It jointly optimizes pruning and architecture under compiler constraints to produce efficient models for mobile deployment. Compared with existing pruning or NAS methods, NPAS achieves better accuracy-speed trade-offs for beyond real-time inference, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.assessment: 该工作将剪枝与NAS结合并考虑编译器优化，对移动端部署有实际意义，但与自动驾驶感知中的检测、BEV等任务直接相关性较低。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.contribution: 提出了编译器感知的统一网络剪枝与架构搜索框架NPAS。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.innovation: 将编译器优化纳入剪枝与NAS的联合搜索中。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，声称在移动端实现超越实时的加速。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif._arxiv_id: NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unified Network Pruning and Architecture Search for Beyond Real-Time Mobile Acceleration.

2012.05609|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对低光照图像增强中深度模型依赖大量架构工程且计算负担高的问题，提出了RUAS方法。RUAS基于Retinex理论建立低光照图像内在欠曝光结构模型，展开其优化过程构建传播结构，并设计无参考协同学习策略从紧凑搜索空间中搜索低光照先验架构。相比已有方法，RUAS获得了快速且计算资源需求少的增强网络，在多个基准上优于近期最先进方法。
2012.05609|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy architecture engineering and high computational cost in low-light image enhancement by proposing RUAS. It builds models based on Retinex to characterize underexposed structures, unrolls their optimization to construct a propagation structure, and designs a cooperative reference-free learning strategy to search low-light prior architectures from a compact space. RUAS achieves a top-performing enhancement network with fast speed and low computational cost, outperforming recent state-of-the-art methods.
2012.05609|v2.assessment: 该工作将Retinex展开与NAS结合用于低光照增强，方法设计有特色，但属于底层视觉任务，与自动驾驶感知领域直接相关性很低。
2012.05609|v2.contribution: 提出了Retinex启发展开与协同先验架构搜索的RUAS框架。
2012.05609|v2.innovation: 将Retinex优化展开与无参考架构搜索结合用于低光照增强。
2012.05609|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于近期最先进方法，且速度快、计算资源需求少。

2011.09011|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对两阶段NAS中均匀采样忽略性能Pareto前沿的问题，提出了AttentiveNAS。方法通过注意力采样策略聚焦于Pareto前沿上的网络，并设计了在训练中高效识别Pareto网络的方法。相比BigNAS和Once-for-All等SOTA，AttentiveNAS无需额外重训练或后处理即可同时获得大量不同FLOPs的网络，在ImageNet上top-1准确率达到77.3%至80.7%，超越了SOTA模型。
2011.09011|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that uniform sampling in two-stage NAS ignores the performance Pareto front, and proposes AttentiveNAS. It introduces an attentive sampling strategy focusing on Pareto-optimal networks and efficient algorithms to identify them during training. Without extra re-training or post-processing, AttentiveNAS obtains a large number of networks across a wide FLOPs range, achieving 77.3% to 80.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet and outperforming SOTA models including BigNAS and Once-for-All.
2011.09011|v2.assessment: 该工作在NAS采样策略上做出有效改进，在ImageNet上取得了领先的精度-效率权衡，对模型设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务直接关联有限。
2011.09011|v2.contribution: 提出了注意力采样策略以改进两阶段NAS的Pareto前沿优化。
2011.09011|v2.innovation: 通过注意力采样聚焦Pareto前沿网络并高效识别。

ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中架构评估不准确的问题，提出了ReNAS，一种相对评估方法。方法通过相对比较而非绝对预测来评估架构性能，以提高评估的可靠性。相比已有评估方法，ReNAS旨在更准确地排序架构。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate architecture evaluation in NAS by proposing ReNAS, a relativistic evaluation method. It evaluates architectures through relative comparison rather than absolute prediction to improve reliability. Compared with existing evaluation methods, ReNAS aims to rank architectures more accurately, though no specific experimental results are provided in the abstract.
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.assessment: 该工作关注NAS中的评估环节，思路有一定新意，但摘要信息极少，且与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.contribution: 提出了相对评估方法ReNAS用于NAS中的架构性能评估。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.innovation: 采用相对比较而非绝对预测来评估架构。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural._arxiv_id: ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural Architecture Search.

2105.10154|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频姿态估计中复杂模型忽视实时效率的问题，提出了ViPNAS，一种在空间和时间层面搜索网络的NAS方法。空间层面设计了包含深度、宽度、卷积核大小、组数和注意力五个维度的搜索空间；时间层面搜索时序特征融合以优化多帧的精度与速度。这是首个搜索时序特征融合和视频中自动计算分配的工作。在COCO2017和PoseTrack2018上，S-ViPNAS和T-ViPNAS在CPU实时推理下不牺牲精度地显著提升了速度。
2105.10154|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of real-time efficiency in video pose estimation by proposing ViPNAS, a NAS method that searches networks at both spatial and temporal levels. The spatial search space includes depth, width, kernel size, group number, and attention; the temporal level searches feature fusion to optimize accuracy and speed across frames. It is the first to search temporal feature fusion and automatic computation allocation in videos. On COCO2017 and PoseTrack2018, S-ViPNAS and T-ViPNAS achieve significantly higher CPU real-time inference speed without sacrificing accuracy.
2105.10154|v2.assessment: 该工作将NAS扩展到视频姿态估计的时空搜索，在实时性上有明显优势，但与自动驾驶感知中的3D检测、BEV等任务直接相关性较低。
2105.10154|v2.contribution: 提出了时空联合搜索的ViPNAS用于快速在线视频姿态估计。
2105.10154|v2.innovation: 首次在视频中搜索时序特征融合与自动计算分配。
2105.10154|v2.result: 在COCO2017和PoseTrack2018上实现CPU实时推理且不牺牲精度。

2011.10949|v2.summary_cn: 针对概率型NAS（如PARSEC）在超大搜索空间中需采样大量架构、搜索代价高的问题，提出FP-NAS。方法上采用自适应分布熵的采样策略（初期多采样鼓励探索、后期减少采样）以及基于因子化分布的粗到细搜索策略，将架构参数量减少一个数量级以上。相比PARSEC采样架构数减少64%、搜索速度提升2.1倍；相比FBNetV2搜索快1.9-3.5倍，且搜索出的模型在ImageNet上优于FBNetV2。
2011.10949|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high sampling cost of probabilistic NAS in large search spaces by proposing FP-NAS. It introduces an entropy-adaptive sampling scheme that draws more samples early for exploration and fewer later, plus a coarse-to-fine factorized distribution that reduces architecture parameters by over an order of magnitude. FP-NAS samples 64% fewer architectures and searches 2.1x faster than PARSEC, and is 1.9x-3.5x faster than FBNetV2 while producing better ImageNet models.
2011.10949|v2.assessment: 在概率型NAS的效率优化上有明确贡献，但属于通用视觉骨干搜索，与自动驾驶感知方向关联较弱。
2011.10949|v2.contribution: 提出熵自适应采样与因子化粗到细搜索的快速概率型NAS框架FP-NAS。
2011.10949|v2.innovation: 利用分布熵动态调节采样数量，并用因子化分布大幅压缩架构参数量。
2011.10949|v2.result: 相比PARSEC采样减少64%、搜索快2.1倍，相比FBNetV2快1.9-3.5倍且精度更优。

2005.14446|v2.summary_cn: 针对NAS搜索耗时过长的问题，提出受沙漏结构启发的HourNAS。方法将网络分为决定精度的关键块（沙漏细颈）与决定复杂度的非关键块（沙漏球体），优先搜索关键块，并将非关键块搜索空间收缩到计算资源约束下可负担的候选。在ImageNet上仅用单GPU 3小时即可搜索出Top-1精度77.0%的架构，优于当时最先进方法。
2005.14446|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the prohibitive search cost of NAS and proposes HourNAS, an hourglass-inspired approach. It identifies vital blocks that dominate accuracy and prioritizes them in search, while shrinking the search space of non-vital blocks to resource-affordable candidates. On ImageNet, HourNAS finds an architecture reaching 77.0% Top-1 accuracy in only 3 hours on a single GPU, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
2005.14446|v2.assessment: 搜索效率提升显著，思路直观有效，但同样属于通用骨干搜索，与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
