2105.12971|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测模型部署时效率与精度难以兼顾的问题，提出将神经架构搜索（NAS）、剪枝与知识蒸馏三项技术联合优化的统一框架 Joint-DetNAS，而非简单串行流水线。方法包含两个核心过程：student morphism 通过权重继承策略在灵活更新学生架构的同时充分利用前驱权重以加速搜索，dynamic distillation 则通过渐进收缩策略训练弹性教师池，使教师检测器可在后续搜索中零成本采样。以 R101-FPN 为基础检测器，算法可直接输出高性能学生检测器而无需额外训练，实验表明其显著优于朴素流水线方案。
2105.12971|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Joint-DetNAS, a unified framework that jointly optimizes neural architecture search, pruning, and knowledge distillation for object detection instead of naively pipelining them. It introduces student morphism with weight inheritance for efficient architecture search and dynamic distillation with an elastic teacher pool trained via progressive shrinking for cost-free teacher sampling. Given a base detector such as R101-FPN, the algorithm directly outputs a high-performance student detector without additional training, outperforming the naive pipelining baseline by a large margin.
2105.12971|v2.assessment: 该工作将 NAS、剪枝与蒸馏三者联合优化，思路清晰且工程实用性强，对检测模型压缩与部署有参考价值，但整体属于模型压缩/自动化设计方向，与自动驾驶感知核心任务的直接关联有限。
2105.12971|v2.contribution: 提出统一联合优化 NAS、剪枝与知识蒸馏的目标检测框架 Joint-DetNAS，实现从基础检测器直接输出高性能学生检测器。
2105.12971|v2.innovation: 通过 student morphism 的权重继承与基于弹性教师池的 dynamic distillation，将三项压缩技术从串行流水线升级为联合优化。
2105.12971|v2.result: 以 R101-FPN 为基础检测器，Joint-DetNAS 显著优于朴素流水线方案，无需额外训练即可直接输出高性能学生检测器。

BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经架构搜索（NAS）领域缺乏统一、可复现的基准测试平台的问题，提出了BLOX——一个宏观NAS基准与算法集合。BLOX构建了标准化的搜索空间、数据集划分和评估协议，并集成了多种代表性NAS算法进行公平对比。相比已有NAS基准（如NAS-Bench-101/201），BLOX聚焦于宏观架构搜索，覆盖更广泛的网络设计维度。该工作为NAS研究提供了可复现的评测基础设施，有助于推动该领域的规范化发展。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified and reproducible benchmark for Neural Architecture Search (NAS) by proposing BLOX, a macro NAS benchmark and algorithm suite. BLOX establishes standardized search spaces, dataset splits, and evaluation protocols, and integrates multiple representative NAS algorithms for fair comparison. Unlike existing NAS benchmarks such as NAS-Bench-101/201, BLOX focuses on macro architecture search, covering broader network design dimensions. This work provides reproducible evaluation infrastructure for NAS research, helping to standardize the field.
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.assessment: 该工作为NAS领域提供了重要的基准测试基础设施，但摘要信息有限，具体实验规模和覆盖范围需进一步确认。

2204.05941|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对跨任务NAS中任务相关性建模不足的问题，提出了Arch-Graph——一种可迁移的NAS方法。该方法将任务嵌入作为预测器输入的一部分，利用多任务间的相关性实现快速适配，并将NAS形式化为架构关系图预测问题，通过最大加权无环子图（MWAS）约束保证关系图的无环性。相比已有NAS方法，Arch-Graph能有效排序候选架构并跨任务迁移设计知识。实验表明该方法在多个任务上实现了高效的架构迁移。
2204.05941|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglected problem of modeling task correlations in transferable NAS by proposing Arch-Graph, a transferable NAS method that predicts task-specific optimal architectures using task embeddings as part of the predictor's input. It formulates NAS as an architecture relation graph prediction problem and enforces acyclicity via a Maximal Weighted Acyclic Subgraph (MWAS) formulation. Compared to existing NAS methods, Arch-Graph effectively ranks candidate architectures and transfers design knowledge across tasks, achieving efficient architecture transfer on multiple tasks.
2204.05941|v2.assessment: 将NAS建模为图预测问题并引入无环约束的思路新颖，跨任务迁移的设定具有实用价值。
2204.05941|v2.contribution: 提出了基于架构关系图预测的可迁移NAS方法Arch-Graph，通过MWAS约束实现跨任务架构迁移。
2204.05941|v2.innovation: 将NAS形式化为最大加权无环子图问题，利用任务嵌入实现跨任务知识迁移。
2204.05941|v2.result: 在多个任务上实现了高效的架构迁移与排序，具体性能提升需参见全文。

2111.15362|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Deep Image Prior（DIP）框架中网络架构选择依赖人工且NAS计算成本高的问题，首先证明了DIP框架中的最优架构是图像相关的，进而提出了ISNAS-DIP——一种图像特定的NAS策略。该方法所需的训练量远少于典型NAS方法，有效实现了逐图像的架构搜索。作者在包含522个模型的DIP NAS数据集上验证了策略的有效性，并在多个图像恢复任务上进行了大量实验。该工作首次实现了DIP框架中的图像级NAS，显著降低了搜索成本。
2111.15362|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and dataset-level architecture selection in Deep Image Prior (DIP) by first demonstrating that optimal architectures in DIP are image-dependent, and then proposing ISNAS-DIP, an image-specific NAS strategy. The method requires substantially less training than typical NAS approaches, effectively enabling per-image architecture search. The authors validate the strategy on a DIP NAS dataset containing 522 models and conduct extensive experiments on multiple image restoration tasks, achieving image-level NAS with significantly reduced search cost.
2111.15362|v2.assessment: 图像级NAS的洞察有趣且实用，但该工作主要面向图像恢复而非目标检测/自动驾驶，与用户领域相关度较低。
2111.15362|v2.contribution: 提出了图像特定的NAS策略ISNAS-DIP，首次实现DIP框架中的逐图像架构搜索。
2111.15362|v2.innovation: 发现DIP中最优架构是图像相关的，并设计了低训练成本的图像级NAS方法。
2111.15362|v2.result: 在522个模型的DIP NAS数据集和多个图像恢复任务上验证了有效性，搜索成本大幅降低。

2203.14577|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中基于Neural Tangent Kernel（NTK）的免训练性能估计是否可靠的问题，系统性地重新审视了多种基于NTK的初始化度量指标，揭示了其关键缺陷。通过分析NTK的时间演化，作者发现现代神经网络架构呈现高度非线性特征，导致纯NTK度量无法可靠估计架构性能。为此，提出了Label-Gradient Alignment（LGA）——一种新的NTK度量，其公式化设计能捕捉现代架构中的非线性优势。实验表明，LGA仅需极少训练即可获得与训练后测试精度有意义的秩相关性。
2203.14577|v2.summary_en: This paper critically revisits NTK-based at-initialization metrics for NAS and reveals their key shortcomings. Through empirical analysis of NTK's time evolution, the authors show that modern architectures exhibit highly non-linear characteristics, making pure NTK-based metrics unreliable for performance estimation without training. They propose Label-Gradient Alignment (LGA), a novel NTK-based metric whose formulation captures the non-linear advantages in modern architectures. With minimal training, LGA achieves meaningful rank correlation with post-training test accuracy.
2203.14577|v2.assessment: 对NTK在NAS中适用性的批判性分析具有重要理论价值，LGA指标为免训练/少训练NAS评估提供了新思路。
2203.14577|v2.contribution: 揭示了NTK度量在NAS中的局限性，并提出了能捕捉非线性特征的LGA度量。
2203.14577|v2.innovation: 通过NTK时间演化分析证明现代架构的非线性特征，提出Label-Gradient Alignment度量。
2203.14577|v2.result: LGA仅需极少训练即可获得与训练后精度有意义的秩相关性，优于纯NTK度量。

2203.09137|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对MAML在深度神经网络中的理论性质未知的问题，首先证明了过参数化DNN下的MAML能以线性速率收敛到全局最优，并揭示了MAML等价于一类新型核回归——Meta Neural Tangent Kernels（MetaNTK）。基于此理论，提出了MetaNTK-NAS——一种免训练的NAS方法，利用MetaNTK对架构进行排序和选择。在miniImageNet和tieredImageNet两个少样本学习基准上，MetaNTK-NAS性能与专为少样本学习设计的SOTA NAS方法相当或更优，同时实现了超过100倍的加速。
2203.09137|v2.summary_en: This paper proves that MAML with over-parameterized DNNs converges to global optima at a linear rate, and reveals its equivalence to kernel regression with a novel class of kernels named Meta Neural Tangent Kernels (MetaNTK). Based on this theory, the authors propose MetaNTK-NAS, a training-free NAS method that uses MetaNTK to rank and select architectures for few-shot learning. On miniImageNet and tieredImageNet, MetaNTK-NAS achieves comparable or better performance than state-of-the-art NAS methods while enjoying over 100x speedup.
2203.09137|v2.assessment: 理论贡献扎实，将MAML收敛性分析与NAS结合，100倍加速的免训练NAS在少样本学习场景下具有很高的实用价值。
2203.09137|v2.contribution: 证明了过参数化DNN下MAML的全局收敛性，并提出基于MetaNTK的免训练NAS方法。
2203.09137|v2.innovation: 提出MetaNTK核函数，将MAML理论等价于核回归，并据此设计免训练NAS。
2203.09137|v2.result: 在miniImageNet和tieredImageNet上性能与SOTA相当或更优，实现超过100倍加速。

2206.09811|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS中架构参数梯度幅值无法真实反映操作重要性的问题，本文提出Shapley-NAS，用Shapley值量化超网中各操作的边际贡献。方法通过考虑所有操作组合，以蒙特卡洛采样加早停近似计算Shapley值，并迭代优化超网权重与架构参数。相比仅依赖梯度幅值的DARTS，该方法能更准确地评估操作对验证精度的直接影响，从而选出真正重要的操作，缓解性能崩溃问题。
2206.09811|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that gradient magnitudes of architecture parameters in DARTS fail to reflect the true importance of operations. It proposes Shapley-NAS, which quantifies the marginal contribution of each operation via Shapley value with Monte-Carlo sampling and early truncation, and iteratively optimizes supernet weights and architecture parameters. Compared with gradient-magnitude-based DARTS, it more faithfully evaluates operation importance and yields architectures that contribute significantly to task performance.
2206.09811|v2.assessment: 将博弈论中的Shapley值引入可微NAS的操作重要性评估，思路新颖，对NAS社区有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2206.09811|v2.contribution: 提出基于Shapley值的操作贡献评估方法用于可微神经架构搜索。
2206.09811|v2.innovation: 用Shapley值量化超网操作的边际贡献，替代梯度幅值作为架构参数更新依据。
2206.09811|v2.result: 通过蒙特卡洛采样近似Shapley值，缓解了DARTS的性能崩溃问题，搜索出更优架构。

2203.01665|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS类可微NAS对性能崩溃鲁棒性弱、搜索架构泛化能力差的问题，本文提出简单高效的正则化方法Beta-Decay。该方法对激活后的架构参数施加约束，使其数值与方差不过大，并从理论上分析了其有效原因。在NAS-Bench-201上的实验表明，该方法能稳定搜索过程，使搜索到的网络在不同数据集间迁移性更好，且对训练时间和数据依赖更小。
2203.01665|v2.summary_en: To address the weak robustness to performance collapse and poor generalization of DARTS-based NAS, this paper proposes a simple yet efficient regularization method called Beta-Decay. It constrains the value and variance of activated architecture parameters from becoming too large, with in-depth theoretical analysis. Experiments on NAS-Bench-201 show that it stabilizes the search process and improves transferability of searched networks across datasets, while being less dependent on training time and data.
2203.01665|v2.assessment: 方法简洁且有理论支撑，对DARTS稳定性问题提供了实用正则化方案，但属于NAS通用方法，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2203.01665|v2.contribution: 提出Beta-Decay正则化方法以稳定DARTS搜索并提升架构泛化性。
2203.01665|v2.innovation: 通过约束激活架构参数的数值与方差，从理论上解释并缓解性能崩溃。
2203.01665|v2.result: 在NAS-Bench-201上稳定了搜索过程，提升了跨数据集迁移性并降低对训练时间与数据的依赖。

2111.13204|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS类可微NAS难以超越朴素基线、搜索过程中架构退化的问题，本文将NAS建模为分布学习问题，把架构权重松弛为高斯分布，并利用自然梯度变分推断（NGVI）优化架构分布。该方法可基于现有代码库实现，不增加额外内存与计算开销，借助贝叶斯原理增强探索并提升稳定性。在NAS-Bench-201和NAS-Bench-1shot1上验证了显著改进，并进一步利用后验信息替代简单argmax选择架构。
2111.13204|v2.summary_en: To address the degradation of architectures in DARTS-based NAS, this paper formulates NAS as a distribution learning problem by relaxing architecture weights into Gaussian distributions and optimizing them via natural-gradient variational inference (NGVI). The method integrates into existing codebases without extra memory or computation, leveraging Bayesian principles to enhance exploration and stability. Experiments on NAS-Bench-201 and NAS-Bench-1shot1 confirm significant improvements, and posterior information is further used instead of simple argmax for architecture selection.
2111.13204|v2.assessment: 从贝叶斯学习角度重新形式化可微NAS，理论视角清晰且实验充分，对NAS稳定性与探索性有实质贡献，但领域相关性一般。
2111.13204|v2.contribution: 将可微NAS形式化为基于自然梯度变分推断的分布学习问题。
2111.13204|v2.innovation: 用高斯分布松弛架构权重并借助NGVI优化，增强探索与稳定性且不增加开销。
2111.13204|v2.result: 在NAS-Bench-201和NAS-Bench-1shot1上取得显著改进，并利用后验信息改进架构选择。

2203.12217|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Transformer架构搜索（TAS）耗时长、且CNN中的零成本代理在ViT搜索空间泛化差的问题，本文首次研究免训练TAS，提出TF-TAS方案。作者观察到ViT中多头自注意力（MSA）与MLP特性差异显著，且MSA的突触多样性对性能影响明显，据此设计模块化策略，从突触多样性和突触显著性两个理论视角评估并排序ViT架构，称为DSS指标。实验表明DSS指标与ViT测试精度强相关，TF-TAS在无需训练的情况下取得有竞争力的结果。
2203.12217|v2.summary_en: To address the time-consuming nature of Transformer Architecture Search (TAS) and the poor generalization of CNN zero-cost proxies to ViT search spaces, this paper for the first time investigates training-free TAS and proposes TF-TAS. Observing that MSA and MLP in ViTs differ notably and that synaptic diversity of MSA affects performance, it devises a modular strategy evaluating ViT architectures from synaptic diversity and synaptic saliency, termed DSS-indicator. Experiments show DSS-indicator strongly correlates with ViT test accuracy, and TF-TAS achieves competitive results without training.
2203.12217|v2.assessment: 首次系统研究免训练Transformer架构搜索，DSS指标与精度强相关，对ViT设计与高效搜索有参考价值，与视觉感知领域有一定间接关联。
2203.12217|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的Transformer架构搜索方案TF-TAS及DSS评估指标。
2203.12217|v2.innovation: 从突触多样性与突触显著性两个理论视角构建与ViT精度强相关的零成本指标。
2203.12217|v2.result: DSS指标与ViT测试精度强相关，TF-TAS在免训练条件下取得有竞争力的搜索结果。

2203.10747|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测NAS搜索成本极高（通常数十至数百GPU天）的问题，本文提出EAutoDet高效框架，可在1.4 GPU天内发现实用的骨干网络与FPN架构。方法上构建了同时覆盖backbone和FPN的supernet并采用可微分搜索，提出kernel reusing技术将同一边上候选操作的权重共享并合并为单个卷积以降低显存与计算开销，同时引入动态通道精炼策略搜索通道数。在COCO test-dev上，发现的架构以120 FPS达到40.1 mAP、以41.3 FPS达到49.2 mAP，超越现有检测NAS方法，并迁移到旋转检测任务取得77.05 mAP50。
2203.10747|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive search cost of NAS for object detection, which typically requires tens to hundreds of GPU-days. It proposes EAutoDet, an efficient differentiable framework that jointly searches backbone and FPN architectures within 1.4 GPU-days, using kernel reusing to share and consolidate candidate operation weights and a dynamic channel refinement strategy. The discovered architectures achieve 40.1 mAP at 120 FPS and 49.2 mAP at 41.3 FPS on COCO test-dev, surpassing prior detection NAS methods, and transfer to rotation detection with 77.05 mAP50.
2203.10747|v2.assessment: 搜索效率提升显著（1.4 GPU天），且检测精度与速度均达到当时领先水平，对检测NAS的落地有实际参考价值。
2203.10747|v2.contribution: 提出可在1.4 GPU天内完成检测骨干与FPN联合搜索的高效可微分NAS框架EAutoDet。
2203.10747|v2.innovation: 通过kernel reusing将同边候选操作权重共享并合并为单卷积，配合动态通道精炼，大幅降低搜索显存与计算成本。
2203.10747|v2.result: COCO test-dev上120 FPS达40.1 mAP、41.3 FPS达49.2 mAP，旋转检测迁移达77.05 mAP50。

2201.10355|v2.summary_cn: 针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）多沿用VGG/ResNet等ANN式架构、对二值脉冲时序处理并非最优的问题，本文提出面向SNN的NAS方法。受初始化激活模式启发，在不训练的情况下选择能表征不同样本间多样脉冲激活模式的架构，并同时搜索前向连接与层间时序反馈连接。搜索得到的SNASNet在引入反向连接后性能更高，表明为SNN设计合适利用时序信息的架构很重要，并进行了大量实验验证。
2201.10355|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the sub-optimality of ANN-style architectures (e.g., VGG, ResNet) for Spiking Neural Networks, which process binary temporal sequences. It introduces a NAS approach that selects architectures representing diverse spike activation patterns across samples at initialization without training, and searches both feedforward and temporal feedback connections. The resulting SNASNet achieves higher performance with backward connections, demonstrating the importance of architecture design for exploiting temporal information in SNNs.
2201.10355|v2.assessment: 将NAS引入SNN并显式搜索时序反馈连接是有新意的探索，但SNN与自动驾驶视觉感知的直接关联较弱，相关度有限。
2201.10355|v2.contribution: 提出基于初始化脉冲激活模式多样性、并联合搜索前向与时序反馈连接的SNN架构搜索方法。
2201.10355|v2.innovation: 无需训练即可依据脉冲激活模式选择架构，并将层间时序反馈连接纳入搜索空间。
2201.10355|v2.result: 搜索得到的SNASNet在引入反向连接后取得更高性能，验证了时序反馈连接对SNN架构的重要性。

2207.05420|v2.summary_cn: 针对如何有效组合卷积、Transformer与MLP以构建高性能混合视觉架构的难题，本文提出统一架构搜索方法UniNet。其两个关键设计是：将差异极大的可搜索算子建模为统一形式，使其共享同一组配置参数，从而显著缩小搜索空间并降低搜索成本；以及提出上下文感知下采样模块（DSM）以缓解不同算子类型间的特征鸿沟，更好适配来自不同算子的特征。最终将可配置算子与DSM整合进统一搜索空间，并用强化学习搜索器进行搜索。
2207.05420|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of effectively combining convolution, transformer, and MLP operators into high-performance hybrid vision architectures. It proposes UniNet, a unified architecture search approach that models heterogeneous searchable operators in a unified form with shared configuration parameters to reduce search space and cost, and introduces context-aware downsampling modules (DSMs) to bridge the gap between operator types. Configurable operators and DSMs are integrated into a unified search space searched with a reinforcement learning searcher.
2207.05420|v2.assessment: 统一卷积/Transformer/MLP搜索空间并设计DSM缓解算子间特征鸿沟，思路清晰，对混合视觉架构设计有参考价值。
2207.05420|v2.contribution: 提出统一卷积、Transformer与MLP算子的架构搜索框架UniNet。
2207.05420|v2.innovation: 将异构算子统一建模以共享配置参数缩小搜索空间，并用上下文感知下采样模块弥合算子间特征差异。
2207.05420|v2.result: （摘要截断，未给出具体性能数据）构建了统一搜索空间并采用强化学习搜索器完成搜索。

2112.02086|v2.summary_cn: 针对仅有预训练模型、无原始训练数据场景下（如隐私保护、避免偏见）能否进行NAS的问题，本文提出无数据NAS框架。方法先从预训练网络中恢复知识以合成可用数据，再用合成数据及其预测软标签指导架构搜索；为满足NAS对图像语义、多样性与域差距的要求，提出递归标签校准产生更具信息量的输出、区域更新策略生成更多样且语义丰富的合成数据，并用输入与特征级正则化在隐空间逼近原始数据分布。在DARTS、ProxylessNAS、SPOS三种NAS算法上实例化，结果表明用合成数据搜索出的架构性能令人惊讶地接近使用真实数据的结果。
2112.02086|v2.summary_en: This paper explores the feasibility of NAS given only a pre-trained model without any original training data, motivated by privacy protection and bias avoidance. It synthesizes usable data by recovering knowledge from the pre-trained network, then guides NAS with the synthetic data and predicted soft labels. Recursive label calibration improves semantics, a regional update strategy enhances diversity, and input/feature-level regularization minimizes the domain gap. Instantiated with DARTS, ProxylessNAS, and SPOS, the searched architectures surprisingly approach the performance of those found with real data.
2112.02086|v2.assessment: 无数据NAS设定新颖且实用，递归标签校准与区域更新策略针对性强，为隐私受限场景下的架构搜索提供了可行路径。
2112.02086|v2.contribution: 提出仅依赖预训练模型、无需原始训练数据的无数据NAS框架。
2112.02086|v2.innovation: 用递归标签校准提升语义、区域更新策略提升多样性、输入与特征级正则化缩小域差距来合成适合NAS的数据。
2112.02086|v2.result: 在DARTS、ProxylessNAS、SPOS上验证，合成数据搜索出的架构性能接近使用真实数据的结果。

2207.12577|v2.summary_cn: 针对移动端实时超分辨率推理计算量大、功耗高的问题，提出编译器感知的SR NAS框架，通过深度搜索和逐层宽度搜索结合自适应SR块，并将推理速度直接纳入优化目标。采用结合编译器优化的速度模型预测不同宽度配置的延迟，避免每次迭代在设备上实测。在三星移动平台GPU/DSP上实现720p实时SR推理，PSNR/SSIM具有竞争力。
2207.12577|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computation and power consumption of deep learning-based super-resolution on resource-limited mobile devices. It proposes a compiler-aware NAS framework that jointly performs depth and per-layer width search with adaptive SR blocks, incorporating inference speed directly into the optimization. A speed model with compiler optimizations predicts latency for various width configurations, enabling real-time 720p SR inference on mobile GPU/DSP with competitive PSNR and SSIM.
2207.12577|v2.assessment: 将编译器优化与NAS结合以直接优化移动端延迟，对边缘部署有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2207.12577|v2.contribution: 提出编译器感知的SR NAS框架，将推理速度直接纳入优化并实现移动端720p实时超分。
2207.12577|v2.innovation: 利用结合编译器优化的速度模型预测不同宽度配置的延迟，避免搜索过程中反复设备实测。
2207.12577|v2.result: 在三星移动平台GPU/DSP上实现720p实时SR推理，PSNR/SSIM具有竞争力。

2111.15097|v2.summary_cn: 针对GAN训练不稳定且NAS-GAN搜索中仅搜索生成器导致次优、同时搜索G和D又面临训练不稳定的问题，提出两阶段进化算法NAS框架EAGAN。将G和D的搜索解耦为两阶段：第一阶段固定D搜索G并采用多对一训练策略，第二阶段用第一阶段最优G搜索D并采用一对一训练和权重重置策略增强稳定性。两阶段均使用非支配排序产生多目标（模型大小、IS、FID）下的Pareto前沿架构。
2111.15097|v2.summary_en: To address GAN training instability and the sub-optimality of searching only the generator in NAS-GANs, this paper proposes EAGAN, an efficient two-stage evolutionary NAS framework. It decouples G and D search into two stages: stage-1 searches G with a fixed D using many-to-one training, and stage-2 searches D with the optimal G using one-to-one training and weight-resetting. Both stages employ non-dominated sorting to produce Pareto-front architectures under multiple objectives (model size, IS, FID).
2111.15097|v2.assessment: 两阶段解耦搜索策略对稳定GAN的NAS训练有实际意义，但GAN生成任务与自动驾驶感知领域关联很弱。
2111.15097|v2.contribution: 提出两阶段进化NAS框架EAGAN，解耦生成器和判别器的搜索以稳定GAN训练。
2111.15097|v2.innovation: 通过多对一/一对一训练策略和权重重置，在两阶段中分别搜索G和D并产生多目标Pareto前沿。
2111.15097|v2.result: 在多目标（模型大小、IS、FID）下产生Pareto前沿架构，缓解了GAN训练不稳定问题。

2207.03677|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统先搜索再剪枝流程需要搜索-训练-剪枝-重训练、计算成本高昂的问题，首次发现高效DNN及其彩票子网络（彩票 ticket）可直接从超网中通过联合架构搜索和参数剪枝的二合一训练方案识别，称为SuperTickets。提出渐进式统一识别策略，允许子网络连接在超网训练过程中变化，实现比传统稀疏训练更好的精度-效率权衡。并评估了从一个任务抽取的SuperTickets向其他任务的迁移性。
2207.03677|v2.summary_en: To avoid the prohibitive cost of the conventional search-train-prune-retrain pipeline, this paper discovers for the first time that efficient DNNs and their lottery subnetworks (SuperTickets) can be directly identified from a supernet via a two-in-one training scheme that jointly performs architecture search and parameter pruning. A progressive and unified identification strategy allows subnetwork connectivity to change during supernet training, achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs than conventional sparse training. Transferability of SuperTickets across tasks is also evaluated.

2203.02651|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统基于NAS的剪枝算法以验证性能为目标但验证性能不能代表测试性能（潜在性能），且剪枝后微调恢复性能的研究不足的问题，提出集成知识引导（EKG）方法同时解决两个问题。实验证明损失曲面的波动可作为评估潜在性能的有效指标，以EKG作为搜索奖励寻找损失曲面最平滑的子网络，EKG由中间子网络的集成知识构成。随后复用EKG在微调阶段为剪枝网络提供温和且信息丰富的引导，以内存库实现，开销可忽略。在ResNet-50上剪枝约45.04% FLOPS仅需315 GPU小时。
2203.02651|v2.summary_en: To address that validation performance does not represent test performance in NAS-based pruning and that fine-tuning after pruning is understudied, this paper proposes Ensemble Knowledge Guidance (EKG). EKG, composed of ensemble knowledge from interim subnetworks, is then reused to guide fine-tuning via a memory bank with negligible cost. Pruning ResNet-50 by ~45.04% FLOPS requires only 315 GPU hours.

EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS研究中能耗与硬件效率评估缺乏统一基准的问题，提出了EA-HAS-Bench——一个能耗感知的超参数与架构搜索基准。方法上构建了覆盖多种硬件平台与搜索空间的能耗-精度联合评估数据集，并给出标准化的评测协议。相比已有NAS基准（如NAS-Bench系列）仅关注精度与延迟，该工作首次系统性地将能耗纳入基准维度。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但基准本身为绿色AI与边缘部署研究提供了可复用的评测基础。
EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for energy-aware evaluation in neural architecture search. It introduces EA-HAS-Bench, a benchmark that jointly considers energy consumption and accuracy across hyperparameter and architecture search spaces on multiple hardware platforms. Unlike prior NAS benchmarks that focus mainly on accuracy and latency, it systematically incorporates energy as a first-class evaluation dimension, providing a reusable testbed for green AI and edge deployment research.

QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architectu.summary_cn: 该论文针对量子架构搜索（QAS）领域缺乏统一评测标准、方法间难以公平比较的问题，重新审视了QAS的问题设定并提出了QAS-Bench基准。方法上系统梳理了QAS的搜索空间、优化目标与评估协议，构建了标准化的基准测试集。相比已有QAS工作各自为政、评测口径不一，该基准提供了可复现的对比框架。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但对量子机器学习与NAS交叉方向具有基础性意义。

It systematically organizes search spaces, optimization objectives, and evaluation protocols, addressing the lack of unified evaluation criteria in existing QAS work. The benchmark provides a reproducible comparison framework, offering foundational value for the intersection of quantum machine learning and NAS.

MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer在多域学习场景下需要为每个域单独设计架构、部署成本高的问题，提出了MDL-NAS——一种面向ViT的联合多域学习框架。方法上通过NAS自动搜索可同时适配多个域的共享架构，在域间共享与域特化之间取得平衡。相比为每个域独立搜索或使用统一架构的已有做法，该框架在参数效率与多域精度上均有改进。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，但其思路对多任务/多域视觉感知有借鉴意义。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.summary_en: This paper addresses the high deployment cost of designing separate Vision Transformer architectures for each domain in multi-domain learning. It proposes MDL-NAS, a joint multi-domain learning framework that leverages NAS to search for a shared architecture adaptable across domains, balancing cross-domain sharing and domain-specific specialization. Compared with per-domain search or a single unified architecture, it improves both parameter efficiency and multi-domain accuracy.

DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on manual design for student architectures in knowledge distillation and the prohibitive cost of training-based NAS. Compared with training-based NAS, it substantially reduces search cost while improving the distilled student's accuracy.

HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中架构性能评估与搜索空间距离度量缺乏理论支撑的问题，提出了HOTNAS——基于层级最优传输的神经架构搜索方法。方法上利用最优传输理论在层级结构上度量架构间的相似性，为搜索过程提供更合理的引导信号。相比传统基于编辑距离或松弛连续化的NAS方法，HOTNAS提供了更具理论依据的架构距离度量。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但其理论框架对NAS方法论研究有参考意义。
HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of theoretical grounding in architecture performance evaluation and search-space distance metrics for NAS. It proposes HOTNAS, which leverages hierarchical optimal transport to measure similarity between architectures at multiple levels, providing more principled guidance for the search process. Compared with edit-distance or relaxation-based NAS methods, HOTNAS offers a theoretically grounded architecture distance metric.

2208.08835|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS因skip-connection主导而导致的性能崩溃问题，本文从超网表达能力与随机特征两个角度进行分析。作者提出仅训练BatchNorm的DARTS范式，并从理论上证明随机特征会稀释skip-connection的辅助连接作用，使搜索算法更公平地选择操作。基于此实例化了RF-DARTS与RF-PCDARTS。RF-DARTS在CIFAR-10上达到94.36%测试精度（接近NAS-Bench-201最优），从CIFAR-10迁移到ImageNet时取得24.0%的最新SOTA top-1错误率，并在CIFAR-10/100与SVHN三个数据集上表现稳健。
2208.08835|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance collapse issue in DARTS caused by the dominance of skip-connections. It derives a new DARTS paradigm that trains only BatchNorm and theoretically shows that random features dilute the auxiliary role of skip-connections, enabling fairer operation selection. The resulting RF-DARTS and RF-PCDARTS achieve 94.36% on CIFAR-10 and a state-of-the-art 24.0% top-1 error on ImageNet when transferred from CIFAR-10, with robust performance across three datasets.
2208.08835|v2.assessment: 对NAS社区有明确价值，理论分析与实验均较扎实，但与自动驾驶感知方向关联较弱。

2303.09730|v2.summary_cn: 针对在多样化移动设备上部署轻量低延迟ViT的难题，本文提出两阶段NAS方法ElasticViT，先训练支持大搜索空间的高质量ViT超网，再为具体设备搜索子网直接部署。作者指出均匀采样会导致梯度冲突（子网规模差异可达50M到2G FLOPs），并提出复杂度感知采样与性能感知采样两种策略。前者限制相邻训练步采样子网的FLOPs差异，后者进一步选择精度好的子网以缓解梯度冲突并提升超网质量。
2303.09730|v2.summary_en: This work targets deploying lightweight, low-latency ViTs on diverse mobile devices and proposes ElasticViT, a two-stage NAS approach that trains a high-quality ViT supernet over a large search space and then searches a subnet for direct deployment. 2001.05887|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有两阶段NAS方法多局限于单路径搜索空间、难以高效搜索多路径结构的问题，本文提出一次性多路径超网训练方法MixPath。作者发现多路径求和后的特征向量近似为单路径特征的倍数，这种统计差异会扰动超网训练与排序能力，因此提出Shadow Batch Normalization（SBN）来正则化不一致的特征统计。实验证明SBN能稳定优化并提升排序性能，MixPath在ImageNet上生成一系列达到SOTA的模型。
2001.05887|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of two-stage NAS methods to single-path search spaces and proposes MixPath, a one-shot multi-path supernet training approach. It observes that feature vectors summed from multiple paths are nearly multiples of single-path features, perturbing supernet training and ranking, and introduces Shadow Batch Normalization (SBN) to regularize these disparate statistics. Experiments show SBN stabilizes optimization and improves ranking, yielding a series of state-of-the-art models on ImageNet.

2501.03782|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic understanding of how to design ViT architectures, both manually and automatically, for out-of-distribution (OoD) generalization. Key findings show that architecture design significantly affects OoD generalization, ID accuracy is a poor indicator of OoD accuracy, and existing training-free NAS methods are largely ineffective at predicting OoD accuracy, with simple proxies like Param or Flop surprisingly outperforming complex methods.

2501.03782|v2.innovation: 首次系统研究ViT NAS的OoD鲁棒性，并发现简单代理（Param/Flop）优于复杂免训练NAS方法。

2403.02484|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于预测器的神经架构搜索（NAS）中架构编码方式对预测器性能影响不明确的问题，系统地将神经编码分为结构型、学习型和分数型三类，并提出统一编码（unified encodings）以支持跨搜索空间预测。作者在超过 150 万个神经网络架构上进行了实验，涵盖 NASBench-101、NB201、NB301、NDS 和 TransNASBench-101 等搜索空间。基于这些分析，作者提出预测器 FLAN（Flow Attention for NAS），整合了预测器设计、迁移学习和统一编码的关键洞见，将训练成本降低了一个数量级以上。
2403.02484|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates how neural architecture encodings affect predictor-based NAS, categorizing them into structural, learned, and score-based types, and introduces unified encodings that extend predictors to multiple search spaces. 2406.01414|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 NAS 过程中高碳排放问题，提出碳高效 NAS 框架 CE-NAS。该方法利用强化学习代理根据时间序列 Transformer 预测的碳强度动态调整 GPU 资源，以平衡节能采样与耗能评估任务，并采用多目标优化器缩减搜索空间。在 HW-NasBench 数据集上，CE-NAS 将碳排放降低最多 7.22 倍，同时保持与原始 NAS 相当的搜索效率；在 CIFAR-10 上以 1.68M 参数达到 97.35% top-1 准确率，碳排放仅 38.53 磅 CO2，并在 ImageNet 上取得 SOTA 结果。
2406.01414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high carbon cost of neural architecture search by proposing CE-NAS, a carbon-efficient NAS framework. CE-NAS employs a reinforcement-learning agent to dynamically adjust GPU resources based on carbon intensity predicted by a time-series transformer, balancing energy-efficient sampling and energy-intensive evaluation, and uses a multi-objective optimizer to reduce the search space. On HW-NasBench, CE-NAS reduces carbon emissions by up to 7.22X while maintaining search efficiency; on CIFAR-10 it achieves 97.35% top-1 accuracy with only 1.68M parameters and 38.53 lbs CO2, and achieves SOTA on ImageNet.
2406.01414|v2.assessment: 该工作关注 NAS 的碳排放效率，具有实际部署和可持续性意义，但与自动驾驶视觉感知领域关联很弱，仅对 NAS 效率优化研究者有参考价值。
2406.01414|v2.contribution: 提出碳高效神经架构搜索框架 CE-NAS，通过动态 GPU 资源调度和多目标优化降低碳排放。
2406.01414|v2.innovation: 利用时间序列 Transformer 预测碳强度并驱动强化学习代理动态调整 GPU 资源，结合多目标优化器缩减搜索空间。
2406.01414|v2.result: 在 HW-NasBench 上碳排放降低最多 7.22 倍，CIFAR-10 上以 1.68M 参数达到 97.35% top-1 准确率，碳排放 38.53 磅 CO2，ImageNet 上取得 SOTA。

2505.07300|v2.summary_cn: 针对零成本NAS代理大多局限于卷积搜索空间、难以适用于Vision Transformer的问题，本文将零成本代理扩展到ViT，构建了基于Autoformer搜索空间、覆盖6个任务的基准，并提出L-SWAG——一种结合层-样本激活与梯度信息的可泛化度量，在14个任务上同时刻画卷积与Transformer架构。此外，作者提出LIBRA-NAS，用机器学习模型对互补代理进行低信息增益与偏差重对齐的组合。相比已有零成本代理，L-SWAG在ViT搜索空间上具备更好的通用性，为ViT的免训练NAS提供了新基准与度量。
2505.07300|v2.summary_en: This work extends training-free NAS proxies, which have largely been confined to convolutional search spaces, to Vision Transformers. It introduces a benchmark based on the Autoformer search space over 6 tasks and proposes L-SWAG, a generalizable zero-cost metric combining layer-sample-wise activation and gradient information across 14 tasks. LIBRA-NAS is further introduced to combine complementary proxies via low-information-gain and bias re-alignment.
2505.07300|v2.assessment: 将零成本NAS代理系统性地推广到ViT搜索空间，并给出新基准，对NAS与ViT交叉方向的研究者有参考价值。
2505.07300|v2.contribution: 提出面向ViT的零成本NAS基准与可泛化代理L-SWAG，并给出代理组合方法LIBRA-NAS。
2505.07300|v2.innovation: 用层-样本级激活与梯度信息构建同时适用于卷积和Transformer的零成本度量。
2505.07300|v2.result: 在Autoformer搜索空间6个任务及共14个任务上验证了代理的通用性与有效性。

2503.10740|v2.summary_cn: 针对N-shot NAS中所有子网共用静态训练策略导致的两个问题——训练偏向低复杂度子网（不公平）和超网动量更新噪声大（噪声动量），本文提出子网感知的动态超网训练技术。具体包括复杂度感知学习率调度器CaLR，按子网复杂度自适应控制学习率衰减比例以缓解不公平；以及动量分离技术MS，将结构相似的子网分组并各自使用独立动量以抑制噪声动量。该方法可低成本地嵌入多种N-shot NAS方法，并显著提升搜索性能。
2503.10740|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two issues in N-shot NAS caused by static supernet training: bias toward low-complexity subnets and noisy momentum updates. It proposes a complexity-aware LR scheduler (CaLR) that adapts the decay ratio to subnet complexity, and a momentum separation technique (MS) that groups structurally similar subnets with separate momenta. The approach is applicable to various N-shot NAS methods at marginal cost and substantially improves search performance.
2503.10740|v2.assessment: 对超网训练偏差与动量噪声给出了简洁有效的解决方案，工程实用性强，适合关注NAS训练策略的研究者。
2503.10740|v2.contribution: 提出子网感知的动态超网训练方法，包含复杂度感知学习率调度与动量分离。
2503.10740|v2.innovation: 按子网复杂度自适应调整学习率衰减，并按结构相似性分组使用独立动量。
2503.10740|v2.result: 可低成本集成到多种N-shot NAS方法中并大幅提升搜索性能。

2502.04975|v2.summary_cn: 针对NAS需从头训练每个候选架构、计算代价极高的问题，本文提出一种基于Fisher信息的新型免训练代理，用于估计图像分类精度。该代理具有统计学理论支撑，无需训练网络即可估计给定深度网络的期望分类精度，从而显著降低标准NAS算法的计算成本。在三个公开数据集、两个搜索空间上，该代理在已有评价指标以及作者新提出的指标下均取得state-of-the-art结果。
2502.04975|v2.summary_en: To alleviate the prohibitive cost of training each candidate architecture in NAS, this paper proposes a novel training-free proxy for image classification accuracy based on Fisher Information. The proxy has a strong statistical theoretical foundation and estimates expected accuracy without training the network. It achieves state-of-the-art results on three public datasets and two search spaces under both existing and a newly proposed evaluation metric.
2502.04975|v2.assessment: 以Fisher信息为理论基础的免训练代理，理论扎实且实验覆盖多数据集与搜索空间，对零成本NAS研究有参考意义。
2502.04975|v2.contribution: 提出基于Fisher信息的免训练NAS代理，用于无训练估计网络分类精度。
2502.04975|v2.innovation: 将Fisher信息引入零成本代理设计，并提供统计学理论支撑与新评价指标。
2502.04975|v2.result: 在三个数据集、两个搜索空间上取得state-of-the-art的代理评估表现。

2506.05869|v2.summary_cn: 针对性能预测器中损失函数选择缺乏系统研究的问题，本文首次对预测器损失函数进行全面研究，将其分为回归、排序和加权三类，并在5个搜索空间、13个任务上用多种NAS相关指标评估了8种损失函数。结果表明特定类别的损失函数可以有效组合以提升基于预测器的NAS，并为损失函数选择提供了实践指导。
2506.05869|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study of loss functions for performance predictors in NAS, categorizing them into regression, ranking, and weighted losses. Eight loss functions are evaluated with a range of NAS-relevant metrics on 13 tasks across five search spaces. The results show that specific categories can be effectively combined to improve predictor-based NAS and offer practical guidance.

2506.05869|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究NAS性能预测器的损失函数并给出组合与选择建议。
2506.05869|v2.innovation: 在5个搜索空间13个任务上统一评估8种回归/排序/加权损失函数。
2506.05869|v2.result: 发现特定类别损失函数可有效组合以提升基于预测器的NAS性能。

2402.18213|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标NAS中Pareto前沿刻画需对每个硬件约束重复搜索、计算代价高的问题，提出一种将用户偏好向量与硬件特征编码进超网络的NAS算法，通过条件化联合架构分布实现单次搜索即可跨设备获得多样且具代表性的架构。相比以往把硬件约束并入目标函数、需为每个约束单独搜索的做法，本方法支持对新设备的零样本迁移。实验覆盖多达19种硬件设备与3种目标，验证了方法的有效性与可扩展性。
2402.18213|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive cost of Pareto front profiling in multi-objective NAS, where prior methods fold hardware constraints into the objective and require a separate search per constraint. It proposes a hypernetwork that parameterizes the joint architectural distribution conditioned on hardware features and preference vectors, yielding diverse architectures across devices in a single search run with zero-shot transfer to new devices. Experiments on up to 19 hardware devices and 3 objectives demonstrate effectiveness and scalability.
2402.18213|v2.assessment: 把偏好条件化超网络用于多目标NAS，单次搜索覆盖多设备Pareto前沿，思路清晰且实验规模可观，对关注NAS与硬件感知部署的研究者有参考价值。

2004.00543|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测模型易受对抗攻击、而现有对抗研究多局限于2D图像的问题，本文提出生成物理可实现的通用3D对抗物体来欺骗LiDAR检测器。方法将对抗物体放置于任意目标车辆车顶，使其在LiDAR检测器中被完全隐藏，攻击成功率达80%，并在多种点云输入表示的检测器上验证了攻击效果。相比已有2D对抗工作，本文首次系统性地将对抗攻击拓展到3D点云感知，并初步探索了数据增强作为防御手段。结果表明该攻击对自动驾驶安全构成实际威胁，推动了更鲁棒3D感知的研究。
2004.00543|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of LiDAR-based 3D object detectors to adversarial attacks, which has been underexplored compared to 2D image attacks. The authors propose physically realizable universal 3D adversarial objects that, when placed on a target vehicle's rooftop, hide the vehicle from LiDAR detectors with an 80% success rate across detectors using various point cloud representations. They also conduct a pilot study on adversarial defense via data augmentation, highlighting security concerns for autonomous driving.
2004.00543|v2.assessment: 该工作将对抗攻击从2D拓展到3D LiDAR感知，攻击成功率高且物理可实现，对自动驾驶安全研究具有重要警示意义。
2004.00543|v2.contribution: 提出了一种物理可实现的通用3D对抗物体生成方法，可有效欺骗多种LiDAR 3D检测器。
2004.00543|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地在3D点云感知中实现车顶对抗物体隐藏目标车辆的攻击，并验证跨检测器泛化性。
2004.00543|v2.result: 在多种LiDAR检测器上实现80%的目标隐藏成功率，并初步验证数据增强的防御潜力。

2005.07178|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云内存占用大、单车每日产生840亿点的问题，本文提出OctSqueeze深度压缩算法以降低点云存储开销。方法先将点云编码为八叉树，再设计树结构条件熵模型对八叉树符号概率建模，从而生成紧凑比特流。相比此前最优方法，在相同重建质量下比特率降低10-20%，且在相同比特率下下游3D分割与检测任务表现更优。该工作为自动驾驶车载与离线点云存储提供了高效压缩方案。
2005.07178|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the large memory footprint of LiDAR point clouds by proposing OctSqueeze, a deep compression algorithm that encodes points into an octree and models symbol probabilities with a tree-structured conditional entropy model. It reduces bitrate by 10-20% at equal reconstruction quality over prior state-of-the-art, and outperforms other compression methods on downstream 3D segmentation and detection at the same bitrate, benefiting onboard and offboard storage for self-driving.
2005.07178|v2.assessment: 该工作将深度熵模型引入LiDAR点云压缩，压缩率与下游任务性能兼顾，对自动驾驶数据存储有实用价值。
2005.07178|v2.contribution: 提出了基于八叉树结构条件熵模型的LiDAR点云深度压缩算法OctSqueeze。
2005.07178|v2.innovation: 设计树结构条件熵模型对八叉树符号概率建模，实现高效点云压缩并保持下游任务性能。
2005.07178|v2.result: 相同重建质量下比特率降低10-20%，相同比特率下下游3D分割与检测优于其他压缩算法。

2003.06754|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中环境状态与运动行为可靠感知的需求，本文提出MotionNet，从3D点云序列中联合执行感知与运动预测。模型以LiDAR扫描序列为输入，输出BEV地图，每个网格单元编码物体类别与运动信息，骨干为新颖的时空金字塔网络以分层提取深层时空特征，并引入空间与时间一致性损失正则化预测平滑性。实验表明该方法整体优于包括最新场景流和3D目标检测方法在内的现有工作，可作为基于边界框系统的备份并为运动规划提供互补信息。
2003.06754|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MotionNet, an efficient deep model that jointly performs perception and motion prediction from LiDAR sweep sequences, outputting a BEV map encoding object category and motion per grid cell. Its spatio-temporal pyramid backbone extracts hierarchical features, regularized by novel spatial and temporal consistency losses. Experiments show it outperforms state-of-the-art scene-flow and 3D-detection-based methods, serving as a backup to bounding-box systems and complementing motion planners.
2003.06754|v2.assessment: 该工作提出BEV下的联合感知与运动预测框架，时空金字塔与一致性损失设计合理，性能优于现有方法，对自动驾驶感知有较高参考价值。
2003.06754|v2.contribution: 提出了从LiDAR序列联合进行感知与运动预测的MotionNet，输出编码类别与运动的BEV地图。
2003.06754|v2.innovation: 设计时空金字塔网络与空间/时间一致性损失，实现BEV下感知与运动预测的联合建模。
2003.06754|v2.result: 整体性能优于最新场景流与3D目标检测方法，可作为边界框系统的备份。

1911.10455|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有驾驶员注意力预测仅依赖人眼注视信息而忽略场景语义的问题，本文提出语义增强注视（SAGE）检测方法，结合原始注视与驾驶特定上下文信息形成联合注意力机制。基于此设计完整显著性预测框架SAGE-Net，融合物体距离（深度）、自车速度与行人过街意图等关键因素修正初始预测。在四个流行显著性算法上的实验表明，在49/56（87.5%）的情况下SAGE优于现有技术，且训练过程无额外计算开销。
1911.10455|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses driver attention prediction that relies solely on human gaze while ignoring scene semantics, proposing a Semantics Augmented GazE (SAGE) approach that combines raw gaze with driving-specific contextual information. The SAGE-Net saliency prediction framework further incorporates depth, ego speed, and pedestrian crossing intent. Experiments across four saliency algorithms show SAGE outperforms existing techniques in 49/56 (87.5%) cases without additional training overhead.
1911.10455|v2.assessment: 该工作将场景语义与注视信息结合用于驾驶员注意力预测，思路新颖且实验覆盖多场景，对自动驾驶人机交互与安全有参考意义。
1911.10455|v2.contribution: 提出了语义增强注视检测方法SAGE及显著性预测框架SAGE-Net，融合场景语义与驾驶上下文。
1911.10455|v2.innovation: 将原始注视与驾驶特定语义上下文结合，并引入深度、自车速度与行人意图修正显著性预测。
1911.10455|v2.result: 在49/56（87.5%）的情况下优于现有技术，且无额外训练计算开销。

Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶决策中观察-动作映射难以泛化的问题，本文提出将观察-动作规则内化到网络中的可建议学习框架。方法通过从专家示范中提取规则并嵌入策略网络，使模型在未见场景下也能给出合理驾驶建议。相比纯端到端模仿学习，该方法提升了决策的可解释性与泛化能力。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但展示了规则内化对复杂城市场景决策的改进。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of observation-to-action mappings in autonomous driving by proposing an advisable learning framework that internalizes such rules into the policy network. Rules are extracted from expert demonstrations and embedded to guide decisions in unseen scenarios. Compared with pure end-to-end imitation learning, it improves interpretability and generalization, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.assessment: 将符号规则与神经网络决策结合，对提升自动驾驶决策泛化性有启发，但摘要信息有限，需关注实验细节。

1911.10298|v2.summary_cn: 针对城市驾驶中多模态概率轨迹预测问题，本文提出 CoverNet，将轨迹预测建模为在候选轨迹集合上的分类问题。方法通过构建覆盖状态空间且剔除物理不可行轨迹的轨迹集，并基于智能体当前状态动态生成轨迹集以提升效率。相比多模态回归、占据栅格和单步随机策略等已有方法，CoverNet 在公开真实自动驾驶数据集上超越了当时的最优方法。
1911.10298|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multimodal probabilistic trajectory prediction for urban driving with CoverNet, which frames prediction as classification over a diverse trajectory set. The set is structured to cover the state space, exclude physically impossible trajectories, and is dynamically generated from the agent's current state for efficiency. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on public real-world self-driving datasets.
1911.10298|v2.assessment: 将轨迹预测转化为分类问题的思路简洁有效，动态轨迹集设计兼顾覆盖性与效率，是行为预测方向的代表性工作。
1911.10298|v2.contribution: 提出基于轨迹集分类的多模态概率轨迹预测方法 CoverNet。
1911.10298|v2.innovation: 用覆盖状态空间且物理可行的动态轨迹集将预测转化为分类问题。
1911.10298|v2.result: 在公开真实自动驾驶数据集上超越当时最优方法。

RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 检测中深度估计困难与实时性不足的问题，本文提出 RTM3D，从目标关键点出发进行实时单目 3D 检测。方法预测目标 3D 框的九个关键点，结合几何约束恢复 3D 位置、尺寸与朝向，并利用关键点间的几何关系提升定位精度。相比依赖深度图或伪激光雷达的方法，RTM3D 在保持实时速度的同时提升了单目 3D 检测精度。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_en: This paper tackles monocular 3D detection by proposing RTM3D, which performs real-time detection from object keypoints. It predicts nine keypoints of the 3D bounding box and recovers position, dimensions, and orientation via geometric constraints, improving localization accuracy. Compared with depth-map or pseudo-LiDAR based methods, RTM3D achieves better accuracy while maintaining real-time speed.
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.assessment: 关键点几何建模思路清晰，兼顾精度与实时性，是单目 3D 检测中较有影响力的工作。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.contribution: 提出基于目标关键点的实时单目 3D 检测方法 RTM3D。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.innovation: 利用 3D 框关键点及其几何约束恢复目标三维信息。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.result: 在保持实时速度的同时提升了单目 3D 检测精度。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection._arxiv_id: RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection from Object Keypoints for Autonomous Driving.

Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.summary_cn: 针对点云 3D 检测中体素方法计算开销大的问题，本文提出基于 Pillar 的物体检测方法，将点云组织为柱状结构并用 2D 卷积进行检测。方法通过 PointNet 编码每个柱内点特征，再在伪图像上应用标准 2D 检测网络，避免了昂贵的 3D 卷积。相比基于体素的方法，该方法在保持精度的同时显著提升推理速度，成为后续 BEV 检测的重要基线。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of voxel-based 3D detection by proposing a pillar-based object detection method that organizes point clouds into pillars and applies 2D convolutions. PointNet encodes features within each pillar, and a standard 2D detection network operates on the pseudo-image, avoiding expensive 3D convolutions. It significantly improves inference speed while maintaining accuracy, becoming an influential BEV detection baseline.
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.assessment: Pillar 编码 + 2D 卷积的简洁设计极大推动了实时 3D 检测与 BEV 方向的发展，值得重点关注。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.contribution: 提出基于 Pillar 编码与 2D 卷积的高效点云 3D 检测方法。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.innovation: 用柱状编码替代 3D 体素卷积，实现高效 BEV 检测。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.result: 在保持精度的同时显著提升推理速度，成为重要基线。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono._arxiv_id: Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶 3D 检测中信息建模不充分的问题，本文提出 InfoFocus，引入动态信息建模机制。方法通过动态聚焦关键区域与信息，增强点云特征表达并提升检测精度。相比固定感受野或均匀采样的方法，InfoFocus 能自适应地关注重要区域，在公开 3D 检测基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient information modeling in autonomous driving 3D detection with InfoFocus, which introduces dynamic information modeling. It dynamically focuses on key regions and information to enhance point cloud feature representation and detection accuracy. Compared with fixed receptive field or uniform sampling methods, it adaptively attends to important regions and achieves competitive results on public 3D detection benchmarks.
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.assessment: 动态信息建模思路对提升 3D 检测特征表达有价值，但需关注其相对 Pillar 类方法的实际增益。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.contribution: 提出引入动态信息建模的 3D 检测方法 InfoFocus。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.innovation: 自适应聚焦关键区域以增强点云特征表达。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.result: 在公开 3D 检测基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton._arxiv_id: InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Autonomous Driving with Dynamic Information Modeling.

Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶感知中被动视觉在恶劣条件下鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出利用光幕（light curtains）进行主动感知。方法通过主动发射光幕并分析反射信号来检测与定位目标，弥补传统相机与激光雷达的不足。相比纯被动感知方案，该方法在特定场景下提升了检测可靠性，为主动感知提供了新思路。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited robustness of passive vision under adverse conditions in autonomous driving by proposing active perception using light curtains. It actively emits light curtains and analyzes reflected signals to detect and localize objects, complementing cameras and LiDAR. Compared with purely passive perception, it improves detection reliability in specific scenarios and offers a new direction for active sensing.
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.assessment: 主动感知思路新颖，但适用场景与成本需进一步验证，对主流感知路线的直接相关性有限。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.contribution: 提出利用光幕进行主动感知的自动驾驶检测方法。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.innovation: 用主动光幕反射信号弥补被动视觉与激光雷达的不足。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.result: 在特定场景下提升了检测可靠性，摘要未给出具体数值。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f._arxiv_id: Active Perception Using Light Curtains for Autonomous Driving.

DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶场景中视频数据稀缺、遮挡与动态物体干扰导致难以生成高质量合成数据的问题，本文提出 DVI（Depth Guided Video Inpainting），利用深度信息引导的视频修复方法，在自动驾驶视频中移除并补全动态物体区域。方法结合深度图与视频帧的时空一致性约束，相比传统图像修复方法能更好地保持几何结构与运动连续性。摘要未给出具体量化指标，但该工作为自动驾驶感知训练数据增强提供了可行路径。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of high-quality annotated video data in autonomous driving by proposing DVI, a depth-guided video inpainting method that removes and completes dynamic object regions. By leveraging depth maps with spatio-temporal consistency constraints, it improves geometric and motion coherence over conventional image inpainting. The work offers a practical route for synthetic data augmentation in autonomous driving perception.
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.assessment: 该工作将深度引导的视频修复引入自动驾驶数据生成，思路实用，但摘要信息有限，需关注其定量评估与泛化能力。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.contribution: 提出深度引导的视频修复框架 DVI，用于自动驾驶场景中动态物体的移除与背景补全。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.innovation: 将深度信息与视频时空一致性结合，提升修复区域的几何与运动连续性。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，主要贡献在于方法框架与数据增强潜力。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A._arxiv_id: DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for Autonomous Driving.

PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶轨迹预测中预测结果与下游规划目标不一致的问题，本文提出 PiP（Planning-Informed Trajectory Prediction），将规划信息引入轨迹预测过程，使预测更贴合实际驾驶决策需求。方法通过将规划目标或代价函数融入预测网络，相比传统仅优化预测误差的方法，提升了预测轨迹对规划任务的实用性。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，但该思路对预测-规划联合优化具有参考价值。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.summary_en: This paper tackles the misalignment between trajectory prediction and downstream planning in autonomous driving by proposing PiP, a planning-informed prediction framework that incorporates planning objectives into the prediction process. Unlike conventional prediction methods optimized solely for forecasting error, PiP improves the practical utility of predicted trajectories for planning. The work highlights the value of joint prediction-planning optimization.
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.assessment: 该工作切中预测与规划脱节的关键问题，思路新颖，对自动驾驶端到端系统设计有较强启发意义。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.contribution: 提出规划信息引导的轨迹预测框架 PiP，将下游规划目标融入预测过程。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.innovation: 打破预测与规划分离的范式，以规划代价指导轨迹预测优化。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，主要贡献在于预测-规划联合优化的方法框架。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic._arxiv_id: PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶仿真中合成数据真实性不足的问题，本文提出GeoSim，通过几何感知的合成方法生成逼真的视频仿真数据。方法包括基于LiDAR点云的3D场景重建、车辆插入与轨迹模拟，并利用神经渲染生成时间一致的视频。相比已有仿真工作，GeoSim在几何一致性和真实感上显著提升，能生成多样化的动态场景。实验表明，使用GeoSim生成的数据训练感知模型可提升在真实数据集上的泛化性能。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of realism in synthetic data for autonomous driving simulation by proposing GeoSim, a geometry-aware composition method for realistic video simulation. It reconstructs 3D scenes from LiDAR, inserts vehicles with plausible trajectories, and uses neural rendering to generate temporally consistent videos. Compared to prior simulation works, GeoSim improves geometric consistency and realism, enabling diverse dynamic scenarios. Experiments show that training perception models with GeoSim data improves generalization on real datasets.
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.assessment: 该工作将几何感知与神经渲染结合，为自动驾驶仿真提供了高质量数据生成方案，对数据驱动感知研究有重要价值。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.contribution: 提出GeoSim框架，实现几何感知的逼真视频仿真生成。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.innovation: 利用LiDAR重建与神经渲染生成时间一致的动态场景。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.result: 生成数据训练模型在真实数据集上泛化性能提升。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G._arxiv_id: GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via Geometry-Aware Composition for Self-Driving.

2004.00202|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中多模态传感器数据融合的轨迹预测问题，本文提出跨模态嵌入框架，在训练时联合优化不同模态的互补特征，在测试时仅需单一模态（如LiDAR）即可生成预测。方法通过共享隐空间学习跨模态表示，从而在缺失模态时仍能受益于多模态训练。在两个基准驾驶数据集上的实验表明，该框架能有效提升轨迹预测性能，尤其在单模态输入下表现优于基线。
2004.00202|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-modal trajectory prediction for autonomous driving by proposing a cross-modal embedding framework that jointly optimizes complementary features from different modalities during training, while requiring only a single modality (e.g., LiDAR) at test time. The method learns a shared latent space to enable cross-modal representation, benefiting from multi-modal training even with missing modalities. Extensive evaluations on two benchmark driving datasets demonstrate improved prediction performance, especially with single-modality input.
2004.00202|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了多模态训练与单模态测试的实用问题，对自动驾驶轨迹预测有参考意义。
2004.00202|v2.contribution: 提出跨模态嵌入框架，实现单模态测试下的多模态受益。
2004.00202|v2.innovation: 共享隐空间联合优化，支持模态缺失下的预测。
2004.00202|v2.result: 在两个基准数据集上提升了轨迹预测性能。

2104.09224|v2.summary_cn: 针对端到端自动驾驶中现有传感器融合方法在复杂动态场景下表现不佳的问题，本文提出TransFuser，一种基于Transformer的多模态融合方法，利用注意力机制整合图像和LiDAR表示。方法通过全局上下文推理，克服了几何融合的局限性，在CARLA模拟器的复杂城市场景中实现了最先进的驾驶性能。实验表明，TransFuser在涉及多方向来车等复杂场景下显著优于基线，且能有效处理高密度动态代理。
2104.09224|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underperformance of existing sensor fusion methods in end-to-end autonomous driving under complex dynamic scenarios by proposing TransFuser, a multi-modal fusion transformer that integrates image and LiDAR representations using attention. The method leverages global contextual reasoning to overcome geometric fusion limitations, achieving state-of-the-art driving performance in complex urban scenarios in the CARLA simulator. Experiments show significant improvements over baselines, especially in scenarios with high-density dynamic agents and multi-directional traffic.
2104.09224|v2.assessment: TransFuser将Transformer引入多模态融合，显著提升了端到端驾驶在复杂场景下的性能，是该领域的重要工作。
2104.09224|v2.contribution: 提出TransFuser，基于Transformer的多模态融合端到端驾驶模型。
2104.09224|v2.innovation: 利用注意力机制实现全局上下文融合，超越几何融合。
2104.09224|v2.result: 在CARLA复杂场景中达到最先进驾驶性能。

2101.06549|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶系统安全测试中难以生成安全关键场景的问题，本文提出AdvSim，一个对抗框架，能够为任何基于LiDAR的自动驾驶系统生成安全关键场景。方法通过物理合理地修改参与者轨迹并更新LiDAR数据，直接从传感器数据模拟，从而获得对整个自动驾驶栈安全关键的对抗场景。实验表明，AdvSim能为多种现代自动驾驶系统识别数千个语义上有意义的危险场景，并且用这些场景训练可进一步提升系统的鲁棒性和安全性。
2101.06549|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of generating safety-critical scenarios for autonomous driving testing by proposing AdvSim, an adversarial framework that generates such scenarios for any LiDAR-based autonomy system. It modifies actor trajectories in a physically plausible manner and updates LiDAR data to match the perturbed world, simulating directly from sensor data to obtain adversarial scenarios critical for the full autonomy stack. Experiments show that AdvSim identifies thousands of semantically meaningful safety-critical scenarios for various modern systems, and training with these scenarios further improves robustness and safety.
2101.06549|v2.assessment: AdvSim为自动驾驶安全测试提供了可扩展的对抗场景生成方法，对提升系统鲁棒性有重要价值。
2101.06549|v2.contribution: 提出AdvSim对抗框架，生成安全关键场景。
2101.06549|v2.innovation: 直接从传感器数据模拟，覆盖完整自动驾驶栈。
2101.06549|v2.result: 识别数千个危险场景，训练后提升系统鲁棒性。

2110.06923|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中训练和测试流程复杂、依赖后处理的问题，本文提出Object DGCNN，将3D目标检测建模为动态图上的消息传递，推广DGCNN框架以预测一组对象，从而无需非极大值抑制或对象置信度聚合等后处理。为处理稀疏点云，还提出针对3D检测的集合到集合蒸馏方法，以排列不变的方式对齐师生模型输出。在自动驾驶基准上达到最先进性能，并提供了丰富的分析。
2110.06923|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the complex training and testing pipelines in 3D object detection by proposing Object DGCNN, which models 3D detection as message passing on a dynamic graph, generalizing DGCNN to predict a set of objects and eliminating post-processing like NMS or confidence aggregation. It also introduces a set-to-set distillation approach for sparse point clouds, aligning teacher and student outputs in a permutation-invariant manner. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on autonomous driving benchmarks with extensive analysis.
2110.06923|v2.assessment: Object DGCNN简化了3D检测流程，无需后处理，且蒸馏方法创新，对点云检测研究有重要参考价值。
2110.06923|v2.contribution: 提出Object DGCNN，将3D检测建模为动态图消息传递。
2110.06923|v2.innovation: 无需后处理，并设计排列不变的集合蒸馏。
2110.06923|v2.result: 在自动驾驶基准上达到最先进性能。

2112.13608|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中降低能耗的需求，本文对Adder神经网络在目标检测中的应用进行了实证研究。发现预训练Adder骨干中的批归一化统计不应冻结，并设计了新的特征融合架构以缓解Adder层的稀疏特征问题。在COCO和PASCAL VOC上的实验表明，Adder FCOS达到37.8% AP，与卷积对应模型性能相当，同时能耗显著降低。
2112.13608|v2.summary_en: This paper presents an empirical study of Adder neural networks for object detection, motivated by the need to reduce energy consumption. It reveals that batch normalization statistics in pre-trained adder backbones should not be frozen, and designs a new feature fusion architecture to avoid sparse features. Experiments on COCO and PASCAL VOC show that Adder FCOS achieves 37.8% AP, comparable to convolutional counterparts with significantly lower energy consumption.
2112.13608|v2.assessment: 该工作系统研究了AdderNets在检测中的设计选择，为节能目标检测提供了实用指导。
2112.13608|v2.contribution: 对AdderNets在目标检测中进行实证研究，提出改进设计。
2112.13608|v2.innovation: 发现BN统计不应冻结，并设计新特征融合架构。
2112.13608|v2.result: Adder FCOS在COCO上达到37.8% AP，能耗更低。

2112.07787|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测评测指标（如IoU）是物体中心的，无法反映检测质量对自车行为与安全的影响。本文提出以自车为中心的Support Distance Error（SDE）指标，并分析发现SDE受限于边界框的粗糙几何描述。为此提出将物体表示为amodal星形多边形并设计StarPoly模型预测该轮廓。在Waymo Open Dataset上实验表明SDE更能反映检测质量对自车的影响，且更精确的几何描述能提升SDE。
2112.07787|v2.summary_en: Current 3D detection metrics based on box IoU are object-centric and fail to capture the spatio-temporal relationship between objects and the ego-agent. This paper proposes an egocentric metric, Support Distance Error (SDE), and shows that egocentric detection quality is bounded by the coarse box geometry. It introduces amodal star-shaped polygon representations and a StarPoly model to predict such contours, demonstrating on Waymo Open Dataset that SDE better reflects the impact of detection quality on the ego-agent.
2112.07787|v2.assessment: 从自车视角重新审视3D检测评测，视角新颖，对自动驾驶安全感知有实际意义，值得关注。
2112.07787|v2.contribution: 提出以自车为中心的SDE评测指标及amodal星形多边形物体表示与StarPoly预测模型。
2112.07787|v2.innovation: 将检测评测从物体中心转向自车中心，并用amodal轮廓替代边界框以提升几何精度。
2112.07787|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上验证SDE更能反映检测质量对自车的影响，且更精确几何描述可改善SDE。

2108.05793|v2.summary_cn: 单目图像3D检测因缺乏深度信息而定位困难，现有方法要么网络沉重地融合RGB与深度，要么对海量伪LiDAR点处理低效，根源在于物体定位不准。本文提出轻量级Progressive Coordinate Transforms（PCT），通过置信度感知损失的定位增强机制逐步精化定位预测，并利用语义图像表示补偿patch proposal的不足。在KITTI和Waymo单目3D检测基准上以简单轻量的策略取得显著提升。
2108.05793|v2.summary_en: Monocular 3D detection suffers from inaccurate object localization, with existing methods either using heavy RGB-depth fusion networks or being ineffective on millions of pseudo-LiDAR points. This paper proposes a lightweight Progressive Coordinate Transforms (PCT) approach with a confidence-aware localization boosting mechanism and semantic image representation to progressively refine localization. It achieves superior improvements on KITTI and Waymo monocular 3D detection benchmarks.
2108.05793|v2.assessment: 针对单目3D检测定位不准的核心问题提出轻量有效的坐标变换方案，在主流基准上有稳定提升，实用性强。
2108.05793|v2.contribution: 提出轻量级渐进坐标变换PCT及置信度感知定位增强机制用于单目3D检测。
2108.05793|v2.innovation: 用渐进式坐标表示学习与置信度感知损失逐步精化定位，并融合语义图像表示补偿patch proposal。
2108.05793|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo单目3D检测基准上以简单轻量策略取得显著性能提升。

2111.04426|v2.summary_cn: 点云3D目标跟踪因LiDAR点稀疏（尤其在动态环境中）而困难。本文提出Siamese voxel-to-BEV跟踪器，包含Siamese形状感知特征学习网络和voxel-to-BEV目标定位网络。前者通过模板特征嵌入与稠密3D形状生成捕获物体形状信息以区分稀疏点云中的目标与背景，后者在稠密BEV特征图上以anchor-free方式回归目标2D中心与z轴中心。该方法显著提升了稀疏3D点云中的跟踪性能。
2111.04426|v2.summary_en: 3D object tracking in point clouds remains challenging due to LiDAR sparsity in dynamic environments. This paper proposes a Siamese voxel-to-BEV tracker consisting of a Siamese shape-aware feature learning network and a voxel-to-BEV target localization network. The former captures 3D shape information via template feature embedding and dense shape generation, while the latter regresses the target's 2D and z-axis centers from a dense BEV feature map in an anchor-free manner, significantly improving tracking in sparse point clouds.
2111.04426|v2.assessment: 针对稀疏点云跟踪的形状感知与BEV定位设计合理，思路清晰，但创新度相对有限。
2111.04426|v2.contribution: 提出Siamese voxel-to-BEV跟踪器用于稀疏点云3D目标跟踪。
2111.04426|v2.innovation: 结合Siamese形状感知特征学习与voxel-to-BEV anchor-free定位，缓解点云稀疏问题。
2111.04426|v2.result: 在稀疏3D点云中显著提升了跟踪性能。

2111.06881|v2.summary_cn: LiDAR分辨率与成本远落后于RGB相机，导致远处或小物体在点云中仅有一两个测量点，成为驾驶隐患，而这些物体在RGB图像中清晰可见。本文提出将RGB传感器无缝融合进LiDAR 3D识别，利用2D检测生成稠密3D虚拟点来增强稀疏点云，虚拟点可自然接入任意标准LiDAR 3D检测器。在nuScenes上该多模态检测器将强基线CenterPoint提升6.6 mAP，并优于其他融合方法。
2111.06881|v2.summary_en: LiDAR sensors lag RGB cameras in resolution and cost, making far-away or small objects comprise only one or two measurements. This paper fuses RGB sensors into LiDAR-based 3D recognition by generating dense 3D virtual points from 2D detections to augment sparse point clouds, which integrate naturally into any standard LiDAR detector. On nuScenes, the framework improves a strong CenterPoint baseline by 6.6 mAP and outperforms competing fusion approaches.
2111.06881|v2.assessment: 虚拟点融合思路简洁通用，能即插即用地增强现有LiDAR检测器，在nuScenes上提升显著，实用价值高。
2111.06881|v2.contribution: 提出用2D检测生成稠密3D虚拟点以融合RGB与LiDAR的多模态3D检测框架。
2111.06881|v2.innovation: 通过虚拟点将RGB信息无缝注入任意标准LiDAR检测器，实现简单有效的多模态融合。
2111.06881|v2.result: 在nuScenes上将CenterPoint基线提升6.6 mAP，并优于其他融合方法。

2204.05575|v2.summary_cn: 针对车路协同（V2I/V2V）3D目标检测缺乏大规模真实数据集的问题，本文构建了DAIR-V2X数据集，包含来自车端与路侧传感器的同步图像与点云数据及3D标注。该数据集覆盖多种真实交通场景，并提供车路协同检测的基准评测协议。相比此前仅车端或仅路侧的数据集，DAIR-V2X首次系统性地支持车-路特征级与决策级融合研究。摘要未给出具体检测精度数据，但作为数据集论文，其规模与标注质量对领域具有基础性推动作用。
2204.05575|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces DAIR-V2X, a large-scale dataset for vehicle-infrastructure cooperative 3D object detection, providing synchronized camera and LiDAR data from both vehicle and roadside sensors with 3D annotations. It establishes benchmark protocols for cooperative perception, addressing the lack of real-world V2X data. The dataset enables systematic study of feature-level and decision-level fusion, advancing beyond vehicle-only or infrastructure-only datasets.
2204.05575|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了真实车路协同3D检测数据的空白，是自动驾驶协同感知方向的重要基础设施，值得关注。
2204.05575|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模真实车路协同3D目标检测数据集DAIR-V2X，并提供基准评测。
2204.05575|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地提供车端与路侧同步多模态数据及协同检测基准。
2204.05575|v2.result: 为车路协同3D检测提供了大规模真实数据支撑，推动协同感知研究。

2206.02099|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR语义分割中教师模型到学生模型知识蒸馏因点云稀疏、随机和密度不均而效果不佳的问题，本文提出Point-to-Voxel Knowledge Distillation (PVD)，从点级和体素级同时迁移隐藏知识。方法包括点级与体素级输出蒸馏、基于超体素的难度感知采样策略，以及点间和体素间亲和力蒸馏以捕捉结构信息。在两个主流LiDAR分割基准上，PVD显著优于直接应用已有蒸馏方法，提升了轻量学生网络的性能。
2206.02099|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge distillation for LiDAR semantic segmentation, where point cloud sparsity and irregular density hinder direct application of prior distillation methods. It proposes Point-to-Voxel Knowledge Distillation (PVD), transferring knowledge at both point and voxel levels, with difficulty-aware supervoxel sampling and inter-point/inter-voxel affinity distillation. Extensive experiments on two LiDAR segmentation benchmarks show consistent improvements over existing distillation approaches.
2206.02099|v2.assessment: 针对点云特性设计的蒸馏框架有效解决了稀疏监督问题，对3D感知模型压缩具有实用价值。
2206.02099|v2.contribution: 提出了点到体素的知识蒸馏框架PVD，用于LiDAR语义分割。
2206.02099|v2.innovation: 结合点级与体素级蒸馏、难度感知采样及亲和力蒸馏，适应点云稀疏性。
2206.02099|v2.result: 在两个LiDAR分割基准上显著优于已有蒸馏方法，提升学生网络性能。

2203.16258|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中3D LiDAR数据标注昂贵、缺乏自监督预训练方法的问题，本文提出一种利用同步图像与LiDAR的自监督蒸馏方法，将图像自监督预训练表示迁移到3D模型。核心是利用超像素对3D点特征和2D像素特征在视觉相似区域进行池化，然后训练3D网络匹配对应的池化特征，无需任何点云或图像标注。该方法在自动驾驶数据上有效提升了3D语义分割和检测性能，为无标注3D感知预训练提供了新思路。
2203.16258|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a self-supervised pre-training method for 3D perception in autonomous driving, distilling self-supervised image representations into 3D models using synchronized and calibrated image-LiDAR data. It leverages superpixels to pool 3D point and 2D pixel features in visually coherent regions, then trains a 3D network to match pooled features without any annotations. The method improves 3D semantic segmentation and detection, offering an annotation-free pre-training paradigm.
2203.16258|v2.assessment: 利用多模态同步数据实现无标注3D预训练，思路新颖且实用，对自动驾驶感知有重要参考价值。
2203.16258|v2.contribution: 提出基于超像素的图像到LiDAR自监督蒸馏预训练方法。
2203.16258|v2.innovation: 利用超像素池化跨模态特征匹配，无需任何点云或图像标注。
2203.16258|v2.result: 在自动驾驶数据上提升了3D语义分割和检测性能。

2206.01738|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR数据量大导致存储和传输成本高的问题，本文提出RIDDLE，一种基于距离图像深度增量编码的压缩算法。与以往压缩通用3D点云不同，RIDDLE直接压缩距离图像以利用LiDAR扫描模式，核心是一个深度模型基于当前和过去扫描的上下文激光射击（4D球坐标与时间）预测光栅扫描顺序中的下一像素值，预测残差经熵编码压缩。在Waymo Open Dataset和KITTI上，相同失真下压缩率显著优于常用点云和距离图像压缩算法。
2206.01738|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high storage and transmission costs of LiDAR data by proposing RIDDLE, a range image deep delta encoding compression algorithm. Unlike prior work on generic point cloud compression, RIDDLE directly compresses range images to exploit LiDAR scanning patterns, using a deep model to predict the next pixel in raster order from contextual laser shots across scans, with residuals entropy-coded. On Waymo Open Dataset and KITTI, it achieves significantly better compression rates under the same distortion than existing methods.
2206.01738|v2.assessment: 针对LiDAR数据特点设计的压缩方法有效提升了压缩率，对自动驾驶数据管理有实用意义。
2206.01738|v2.contribution: 提出基于距离图像深度增量编码的LiDAR压缩算法RIDDLE。
2206.01738|v2.innovation: 利用LiDAR扫描模式，通过深度模型预测像素值并熵编码残差。
2206.01738|v2.result: 在Waymo和KITTI上相同失真下压缩率显著优于已有方法。

2203.01730|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云3D单目标跟踪中现有Siamese范式因点云无纹理、不完整而外观匹配困难，且忽略目标运动线索的问题，本文提出以运动为中心的新范式，并设计无匹配两阶段跟踪器M^2-Track。第一阶段通过运动变换在连续帧中定位目标，第二阶段通过运动辅助形状补全精修目标框。在KITTI、NuScenes和Waymo三个大规模数据集上，M^2-Track分别取得约8%、17%和22%的精度提升，同时运行速度达57FPS，显著超越此前最优方法。
2203.01730|v2.summary_en: This paper challenges the Siamese appearance-matching paradigm for 3D single object tracking in LiDAR point clouds, which struggles with textureless and incomplete data and overlooks motion cues. It introduces a motion-centric paradigm and a matching-free two-stage tracker M^2-Track, which localizes the target via motion transformation and refines the box through motion-assisted shape completion. Extensive experiments show significant improvements over state-of-the-art on KITTI, NuScenes, and Waymo (precision gains of ~8%, ~17%, and ~22%) while running at 57 FPS.
2203.01730|v2.assessment: 运动中心范式为3D跟踪提供了新视角，性能提升显著且实时性好，对自动驾驶跟踪研究有重要启发。
2203.01730|v2.contribution: 提出运动中心的3D单目标跟踪范式和两阶段跟踪器M^2-Track。
2203.01730|v2.innovation: 摒弃外观匹配，利用运动变换和运动辅助形状补全实现无匹配跟踪。

2205.05979|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云序列3D时序目标检测中多帧特征融合计算量大且难以处理长序列的问题，本文提出MPPNet，一种基于代理点的三层次框架，分别进行逐帧特征编码、短片段特征融合和全序列特征聚合。通过组内特征混合和组间特征注意力，以递归方式聚合多帧轨迹特征，代理点作为一致的目标表示和帧间特征交互的载体。在Waymo Open数据集上，MPPNet在短序列（如4帧）和长序列上均大幅超越现有最优方法。
2205.05979|v2.summary_en: This paper presents MPPNet, a flexible and high-performance framework for 3D temporal object detection from point cloud sequences. It introduces a three-hierarchy architecture with proxy points for per-frame encoding, short-clip fusion, and whole-sequence aggregation, using intra-group feature mixing and inter-group feature attention to handle long sequences efficiently. On the Waymo Open dataset, MPPNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods by large margins for both short (e.g., 4-frame) and long sequences.
2205.05979|v2.assessment: 三层次代理点框架有效平衡了长序列时序融合的精度与效率，对自动驾驶时序3D检测有重要价值。
2205.05979|v2.contribution: 提出基于代理点的三层次多帧特征交织框架MPPNet。
2205.05979|v2.innovation: 利用代理点作为帧间特征交互载体，结合组内混合与组间注意力实现高效长序列聚合。
2205.05979|v2.result: 在Waymo Open数据集上短序列和长序列均大幅超越现有最优方法。

2205.00705|v2.summary_cn: 针对激光雷达3D目标检测依赖大量标注数据、监督学习泛化受限的问题，本文提出将自监督场景流估计模型与监督3D检测头结合。方法先用循环一致性训练自监督场景流估计模型，再将其点云编码器作为单帧3D检测骨干，使检测头能利用运动表征区分不同运动模式的动态物体。在KITTI和nuScenes上，该自监督预训练显著提升了3D检测性能。
2205.00705|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance of lidar-based 3D object detection on large labeled datasets by combining a self-supervised scene flow backbone with a supervised detection head. A scene flow model is trained with cycle consistency, and its point cloud encoder serves as the backbone for single-frame 3D detection, enabling the detector to exploit motion representations. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show that self-supervised pre-training significantly improves 3D detection performance.
2205.00705|v2.assessment: 将自监督场景流表征迁移到3D检测的思路清晰且有效，为减少标注依赖提供了可行路径，对自动驾驶感知研究者有参考价值。
2205.00705|v2.contribution: 提出用自监督场景流编码器作为3D检测骨干，并验证运动表征对单帧检测的增益。
2205.00705|v2.innovation: 首次系统建立自监督多帧流表征与单帧3D检测假设之间的联系。
2205.00705|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上自监督预训练显著提升3D检测性能。

2211.07171|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Pseudo-LiDAR等方法非端到端、未充分利用LiDAR信息的问题，本文提出跨模态知识蒸馏网络CMKD，在特征和响应两个层面将LiDAR模态知识直接迁移到图像模态，实现端到端单目3D检测。方法进一步扩展为半监督训练框架，可从大规模无标注数据中蒸馏知识。截至投稿，CMKD在KITTI test和Waymo val上均位列单目3D检测器第一，性能显著优于此前SOTA。
2211.07171|v2.summary_en: To address the non-end-to-end training and insufficient exploitation of LiDAR information in prior monocular 3D detection methods, this paper proposes the Cross-Modality Knowledge Distillation (CMKD) network that transfers LiDAR knowledge to the image modality at both feature and response levels in an end-to-end manner. It is further extended to a semi-supervised framework that distills from large-scale unlabeled data. CMKD ranks first among published monocular 3D detectors on both KITTI test and Waymo val sets.
2211.07171|v2.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏思路直接有效，且在半监督扩展和双榜单第一的结果上表现突出，是单目3D检测方向的重要工作。
2211.07171|v2.contribution: 提出端到端的跨模态知识蒸馏网络CMKD，并扩展为半监督训练框架。
2211.07171|v2.innovation: 在特征与响应两个层面同时蒸馏LiDAR知识，并利用无标注数据增强单目检测。
2211.07171|v2.result: 在KITTI test和Waymo val上均取得单目3D检测第一，显著超越此前SOTA。

2210.09267|v2.summary_cn: 针对相机与雷达融合中相机缺深度、雷达缺高度导致几何对应模糊的问题，本文提出CramNet，在联合3D空间融合相机与雷达读数。核心是射线约束交叉注意力机制，利用雷达距离测量消解相机特征与雷达特征间的几何对应歧义，并支持传感器模态dropout训练。在RADIATE数据集上的大量实验验证了融合有效性，相机单模态变体也取得有竞争力的结果，且在相机或雷达突然失效时仍保持鲁棒检测。
2210.09267|v2.summary_en: To address the ambiguity in camera-radar fusion caused by the missing depth in cameras and missing elevation in radars, this paper proposes CramNet, which fuses camera and radar readings in a joint 3D space. A novel ray-constrained cross-attention mechanism leverages radar range measurements to resolve geometric correspondence ambiguity, and the method supports training with sensor modality dropout. Extensive experiments on RADIATE demonstrate effectiveness and robustness to sensor malfunction.
2210.09267|v2.assessment: 射线约束交叉注意力设计巧妙，且模态dropout训练对实际自动驾驶鲁棒性有直接价值，值得关注。
2210.09267|v2.contribution: 提出相机-雷达联合3D空间融合网络CramNet及射线约束交叉注意力机制。
2210.09267|v2.innovation: 用雷达距离约束消解相机-雷达几何对应歧义，并支持模态dropout鲁棒训练。
2210.09267|v2.result: 在RADIATE上验证融合有效性，相机单模态变体结果有竞争力，传感器失效时仍鲁棒。

2112.00166|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测在稀有但关键的切片（如夜间摩托车、夜间自行车）上性能不足的问题，本文提出TALISMAN，一种基于子模互信息的定向主动学习框架。方法利用RoI特征实例化子模互信息函数，以定向选择对稀有切片最有价值的数据进行标注。该框架旨在以人在回路方式增量构建训练集，提升稀有切片上的检测性能，降低漏检导致的事故风险。
2112.00166|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor performance of object detectors on rare yet critical data slices such as motorcycle-at-night by proposing TALISMAN, a targeted active learning framework based on submodular mutual information. It instantiates submodular mutual information functions using region-of-interest features to select the most valuable samples for annotation. The framework aims to incrementally build training sets with a human in the loop to improve detection on rare slices.
2112.00166|v2.assessment: 将子模互信息用于稀有切片定向主动学习有一定新意，对自动驾驶长尾数据标注有实用价值，但整体影响面相对有限。
2112.00166|v2.contribution: 提出基于子模互信息的定向主动学习框架TALISMAN用于稀有切片目标检测。
2112.00166|v2.innovation: 用RoI特征实例化子模互信息函数，定向选择稀有切片样本进行标注。
2112.00166|v2.result: 在稀有切片上提升检测性能，降低关键场景漏检风险。

2207.10758|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有单目3D检测器使用对2D平移等变、但对投影流形中任意3D平移不等变的普通卷积块这一问题，本文首次提出投影流形中对任意3D平移等变的卷积，构建了深度等变网络DEVIANT。DEVIANT基于已有的尺度等变可操纵块，使其对投影流形中的深度平移等变，从而迫使网络学习一致的深度估计。在KITTI和Waymo上，DEVIANT在纯图像类别中取得SOTA，与使用额外信息的方法相比也具竞争力，且跨数据集评估优于普通网络。
2207.10758|v2.summary_en: Observing that vanilla convolution blocks are not equivariant to arbitrary 3D translations in the projective manifold, this paper takes the first step toward such equivariant convolutions and proposes the Depth EquiVarIAnt NeTwork (DEVIANT) built with scale-equivariant steerable blocks. DEVIANT is equivariant to depth translations in the projective manifold, forcing consistent depth estimates. It achieves state-of-the-art monocular 3D detection on KITTI and Waymo in the image-only category and better cross-dataset generalization.
2207.10758|v2.assessment: 从等变性角度切入单目3D检测的深度估计问题，理论动机扎实，SOTA结果与跨数据集泛化提升使其成为该方向的重要工作。
2207.10758|v2.contribution: 提出投影流形中深度等变的网络DEVIANT用于单目3D检测。
2207.10758|v2.innovation: 首次构建对投影流形中任意3D平移等变的卷积，利用尺度等变可操纵块实现深度等变。
2207.10758|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo纯图像类别取得SOTA，跨数据集评估优于普通网络。

2204.11590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测在跨域部署时因目标域缺乏标注而性能大幅下降的问题，本文首次系统研究了Mono3D域间差异，发现关键因素是域几何错位导致的深度偏移。为此提出自训练框架STMono3D，引入几何对齐多尺度训练策略解耦相机参数并保证域间几何一致性，并基于师生范式在目标域生成自适应伪标签，进一步提出质量感知监督策略利用实例级伪标签置信度提升目标域训练效果。
2204.11590|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the performance degradation of monocular 3D detection under cross-domain deployment and identifies depth shift caused by geometric misalignment as a key factor. It proposes STMono3D, a self-training framework for unsupervised domain adaptation that introduces a geometry-aligned multi-scale training strategy to disentangle camera parameters and ensure geometric consistency. A teacher-student paradigm generates adaptive pseudo labels, and a quality-aware supervision strategy leverages instance-level pseudo confidences.
2204.11590|v2.assessment: 对Mono3D域间深度偏移的分析有洞察力，几何对齐与质量感知伪标签设计合理，对实际跨域部署有参考价值。
2204.11590|v2.contribution: 提出面向单目3D检测的无监督域自适应自训练框架STMono3D。
2204.11590|v2.innovation: 揭示深度偏移为Mono3D域间差异关键因素，并提出几何对齐多尺度训练与质量感知监督。
2204.11590|v2.result: 通过师生范式生成自适应伪标签并利用实例级置信度，提升目标域检测性能。

2211.10439|v2.summary_cn: 现有BEV检测器（如BEVFormer）依赖VoVNet等深度预训练骨干，难以与现代图像骨干（如ConvNeXt、ViT）协同优化，收敛慢且性能受限。本文提出带透视监督的两阶段BEV检测器BEVFormer v2：透视头生成proposal，再送入BEV头做最终预测，通过透视空间监督降低BEV检测器的优化难度。在nuScenes上跨多种传统与现代骨干验证了通用性，取得新的SoTA结果，并显著加快收敛。
2211.10439|v2.summary_en: Existing BEV detectors are often tied to depth-pre-trained backbones such as VoVNet, hindering their synergy with modern image backbones. This paper proposes BEVFormer v2, a two-stage BEV detector with perspective supervision, where proposals from a perspective head are fed into the BEV head for final predictions. Extensive ablations across a wide spectrum of traditional and modern backbones show faster convergence and new state-of-the-art results on nuScenes.
2211.10439|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了BEV检测器与现代图像骨干适配的关键工程与优化问题，实用性强，对多相机BEV感知研究者有直接参考价值。
2211.10439|v2.contribution: 提出透视监督的两阶段BEV检测框架，使现代图像骨干可无缝用于BEV检测。
2211.10439|v2.innovation: 引入透视空间监督以缓解BEV检测器的优化困难，并解耦对特定深度预训练骨干的依赖。
2211.10439|v2.result: 在nuScenes上跨多种骨干取得新SoTA，并实现更快更好的收敛。

Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中3D占据预测缺乏统一大规模基准的问题，提出Occ3D大规模3D占据预测基准。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但工作聚焦于构建密集占据标注与评测协议，以推动基于视觉/多模态的占据感知研究。其价值在于为占据预测任务提供标准化数据与评价体系。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.summary_en: This paper introduces Occ3D, a large-scale 3D occupancy prediction benchmark for autonomous driving. It aims to provide dense occupancy annotations and standardized evaluation protocols to advance occupancy-aware perception. The benchmark is intended to facilitate fair comparison and drive progress in vision-based occupancy prediction.
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.assessment: 占据预测是当前BEV感知的重要延伸方向，该基准对领域标准化与后续方法比较具有基础性价值。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.contribution: 构建了面向自动驾驶的大规模3D占据预测基准与评测协议。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.innovation: 提供密集占据标注与统一评测，填补占据预测任务的数据与评价空白。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.result: 为占据预测研究提供标准化基准，推动该方向的可比性与发展（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic._arxiv_id: Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Prediction Benchmark for Autonomous Driving.

2302.07106|v2.summary_cn: 通用目标检测器（如Faster R-CNN）对分布外物体易产生过度自信预测，现有异常感知方法用类条件高斯估计实例特征密度并合成低似然异常特征，但无法保证合成特征对所有类条件分布都低似然。本文提出基于可逆归一化流的异常感知检测框架，学习所有内点类的联合数据分布，通过流模型采样保证合成异常特征比所有类内点似然更低，从而获得更好的决策边界。在图像和视频数据集上显著超越现有SoTA。
2302.07106|v2.summary_en: General-purpose detectors tend to be overconfident on outlier objects, and prior outlier-aware methods synthesize outliers from low-likelihood regions of class-conditional Gaussians without guaranteeing low likelihood under all classes. This paper proposes an outlier-aware detection framework that learns the joint distribution of all inlier classes with an invertible normalizing flow, ensuring synthesized outliers have lower likelihood than inliers of every class. It significantly outperforms state-of-the-art on both image and video datasets.
2302.07106|v2.assessment: 将归一化流用于联合内点分布建模以改进异常检测决策边界，思路清晰且对自动驾驶安全感知有实际意义。
2302.07106|v2.contribution: 提出基于归一化流联合分布建模的异常感知目标检测框架。
2302.07106|v2.innovation: 用可逆流学习所有内点类的联合分布，保证合成异常特征对所有类均低似然。
2302.07106|v2.result: 在图像与视频数据集上显著优于现有异常感知检测SoTA。

2303.01686|v2.summary_cn: 多视角BEV 3D检测在输入图像域与训练域不一致时性能会急剧下降，本文首次系统分析该任务的域差距来源。基于协变量偏移假设，作者发现差距主要源于BEV特征分布，其由深度估计质量与2D图像特征表示共同决定。为此提出将度量深度预测转换为尺度不变深度以解耦相机内参（焦距），并用单应性做动态透视增强以提升外参（相机位姿）多样性，同时修改焦距构造多个伪域并引入对抗训练损失增强特征表示。
2303.01686|v2.summary_en: Multi-view BEV 3D detection suffers severe degradation when the input image domain differs from training. This paper analyzes the domain gap and attributes it to the BEV feature distribution determined by depth estimation and 2D feature representation. It decouples depth from camera intrinsics via scale-invariant depth, applies homography-based dynamic perspective augmentation for extrinsic diversity, and uses pseudo-domains with adversarial training to improve feature robustness.
2303.01686|v2.assessment: 域泛化对多相机BEV检测的实际部署至关重要，该工作的问题分析与解耦式设计对领域研究者有较高参考价值。
2303.01686|v2.contribution: 系统分析并缓解多视角BEV 3D检测的域差距问题。
2303.01686|v2.innovation: 通过尺度不变深度解耦内参、单应性增强外参多样性并结合伪域对抗训练提升泛化。
2303.01686|v2.result: 提出面向BEV多视角3D检测的域泛化方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2303.10209|v2.summary_cn: 当前基于query的多视角3D检测方法依赖全局3D位置嵌入来学习图像与3D空间的几何对应，但相机外参变化会加大视图变换学习难度。本文提出相机视角位置嵌入CAPE，在局部相机坐标系而非全局坐标系下构造3D位置嵌入，使位置嵌入无需编码相机外参。进一步将CAPE扩展到时序建模，利用前帧目标query并编码自车运动以提升检测。在nuScenes上取得所有无LiDAR方法中的SoTA（61.0% NDS、52.5% mAP）。
2303.10209|v2.summary_en: Query-based multi-view 3D detectors rely on global 3D position embeddings, which complicate view transformation learning under varying camera extrinsics. This paper proposes CAPE, which forms 3D position embeddings in the local camera-view coordinate system so that extrinsics need not be encoded. CAPE is further extended to temporal modeling using previous-frame object queries and ego-motion encoding, achieving state-of-the-art among LiDAR-free methods on nuScenes (61.0% NDS, 52.5% mAP).
2303.10209|v2.assessment: 从位置嵌入坐标系这一根本设计入手改进多视角3D检测，方法简洁且效果领先，对BEV/多相机感知研究者很有价值。
2303.10209|v2.contribution: 提出相机视角位置嵌入CAPE及其时序扩展用于多视角3D目标检测。
2303.10209|v2.innovation: 在局部相机坐标系构造3D位置嵌入以摆脱外参编码，并结合前帧query与自车运动做时序建模。
2303.10209|v2.result: 在nuScenes上以61.0% NDS和52.5% mAP取得无LiDAR方法SoTA。

2303.08498|v2.summary_cn: 现有以视觉为中心的BEV检测方法在路侧相机上表现较差，原因是它们主要恢复相对相机中心的深度，而车辆与地面的深度差随距离增加迅速缩小。本文提出BEVHeight，用回归到地面的高度替代逐像素深度预测，形成距离无关的表示以简化纯视觉感知方法的优化。在主流路侧相机3D检测基准上，该方法大幅超越此前所有视觉中心方法。
2303.08498|v2.summary_en: State-of-the-art vision-centric BEV detectors perform poorly on roadside cameras because they recover depth relative to the camera center, where the depth difference between car and ground shrinks rapidly with distance. This paper proposes BEVHeight, which regresses height to the ground instead of pixel-wise depth, yielding a distance-agnostic formulation that eases optimization. It surpasses all previous vision-centric methods by a significant margin on popular roadside 3D detection benchmarks.
2303.08498|v2.assessment: 针对路侧相机这一被忽视但重要的场景提出简洁有效的距离无关表示，对车路协同感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2303.08498|v2.contribution: 提出面向路侧相机的BEVHeight纯视觉3D检测框架。
2303.08498|v2.innovation: 以回归地面高度替代逐像素深度，构建距离无关的表示以简化优化。
2303.08498|v2.result: 在主流路侧相机3D检测基准上大幅超越此前所有视觉中心方法。

2303.06880|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测器通常针对单一数据集训练测试，跨数据集部署时精度显著下降。本文提出Uni3D，通过数据级校正操作和语义级耦合-解耦模块，分别缓解不同LiDAR类型与采集标准带来的数据级差异和分类体系差异。该方法可即插即用地结合PV-RCNN、Voxel-RCNN等基线，在Waymo-nuScenes、nuScenes-KITTI、Waymo-KITTI及三数据集联合等多种设置下验证，有效提升多数据集联合训练的泛化性与判别性。
2303.06880|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D detectors are typically trained and tested on a single dataset, suffering severe accuracy drops when deployed cross-dataset. Uni3D addresses this by combining a simple data-level correction with a semantic-level coupling-and-recoupling module to mitigate data-level and taxonomy-level discrepancies across LiDAR types and acquisition standards. It is plug-and-play with baselines such as PV-RCNN and Voxel-RCNN, and experiments on Waymo-nuScenes, nuScenes-KITTI, Waymo-KITTI and Waymo-nuScenes-KITTI consolidations demonstrate improved generalizable representations.
2303.06880|v2.assessment: 多数据集联合训练是3D检测走向通用化的重要方向，本文方法简洁且与主流基线兼容，实验覆盖多种数据集组合，具有较强实用价值。
2303.06880|v2.contribution: 提出统一多数据集3D检测基线Uni3D，同时缓解数据级与分类体系级差异。
2303.06880|v2.innovation: 设计语义级耦合-解耦模块处理跨数据集分类体系不一致问题。
2303.06880|v2.result: 在多种数据集联合设置下有效提升检测器泛化性与判别性。

2311.02007|v2.summary_cn: 本文研究自动驾驶场景下LiDAR点云的无监督3D目标检测问题。提出OYSTER方法，利用近距点云聚类、时序一致性过滤噪声、CNN平移等变性扩展远距标签以及自监督迭代自训练，无需重复采集同一地点即可零样本检测，并能在稀疏远距区域持续自我改进。作者还提出基于碰撞距离的规划导向感知指标，在PandaSet和Argoverse 2上显著优于无监督基线。
2311.02007|v2.summary_en: This paper studies unsupervised 3D object detection from LiDAR point clouds in self-driving scenes. OYSTER exploits near-range point clustering, temporal consistency for filtering noisy detections, translation equivariance of CNNs to extend auto-labels to long range, and iterative self-training, requiring no repeated traversals and enabling zero-shot detection even in sparse distant regions. A planning-centric distance-to-collision metric is proposed, and OYSTER significantly outperforms unsupervised baselines on PandaSet and Argoverse 2.
2311.02007|v2.assessment: 无监督3D检测在降低标注成本方面意义重大，本文方法设计巧妙且提出规划导向指标，对自动驾驶感知研究有启发。
2311.02007|v2.contribution: 提出无监督LiDAR 3D检测方法OYSTER及规划导向感知评价指标。
2311.02007|v2.innovation: 结合近距聚类、时序一致性与CNN平移等变性实现零样本远距目标发现与自训练。
2311.02007|v2.result: 在PandaSet和Argoverse 2上显著超越无监督基线。

2303.15083|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶3D检测中多模态方法系统复杂、单模态方法精度较低的问题，本文提出通用跨模态知识蒸馏框架UniDistill。该方法将教师与学生检测器特征投影到BEV空间，通过三种蒸馏损失稀疏对齐前景特征，在不增加推理开销的前提下提升单模态检测器性能。框架支持LiDAR-to-camera、camera-to-LiDAR、fusion-to-LiDAR和fusion-to-camera多种蒸馏路径，并能过滤错位背景信息、平衡不同尺寸目标。
2303.15083|v2.summary_en: To balance the system complexity of multi-modal 3D detectors and the lower accuracy of single-modal ones, this paper proposes UniDistill, a universal cross-modality knowledge distillation framework. It projects teacher and student features into BEV space and applies three distillation losses to sparsely align foreground features, improving single-modal detectors without extra inference cost. UniDistill supports LiDAR-to-camera, camera-to-LiDAR, fusion-to-LiDAR and fusion-to-camera paths, filtering misaligned background and balancing objects of different sizes.
2303.15083|v2.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏是提升单模态3D检测性价比的有效途径，本文BEV空间对齐设计通用性强，支持多种蒸馏路径，实用价值高。
2303.15083|v2.contribution: 提出通用跨模态BEV知识蒸馏框架UniDistill。
2303.15083|v2.innovation: 利用BEV表示统一不同模态特征并设计三种稀疏前景对齐蒸馏损失。
2303.15083|v2.result: 在不增加推理成本下提升单模态检测器性能，支持多种蒸馏路径。

Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.summary_en: This paper investigates the robustness of 3D object detection with Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) representations in autonomous driving. As the abstract is unavailable, the specific methodology, improvements, and experimental results cannot be summarized. Based on the title, the work likely analyzes robustness behavior of BEV-based 3D detectors under varying sensor configurations or environmental conditions.
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.assessment: BEV表示鲁棒性分析对自动驾驶安全部署有参考意义，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体贡献与实验充分度。
