LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中语言模型规划缺乏标准化评测基准的问题，本文提出了LaMPilot，一个基于语言模型程序的开源基准数据集。该基准将驾驶任务转化为自然语言指令下的程序合成与执行问题，涵盖多种场景与复杂度。相比已有工作，LaMPilot首次系统性地评估语言模型在自动驾驶规划中的能力，提供了可复现的评测协议。实验表明当前先进语言模型在该基准上仍有显著性能差距，为后续研究提供了明确方向。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of standardized benchmarks for language model-based planning in autonomous driving by introducing LaMPilot, an open benchmark dataset with language model programs. It formulates driving tasks as program synthesis and execution from natural language instructions across diverse scenarios. Compared to prior work, LaMPilot provides the first systematic evaluation protocol for language models in driving planning, revealing substantial performance gaps in state-of-the-art models.
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.assessment: 该基准填补了语言模型在自动驾驶规划评测中的空白，对推动LLM与驾驶决策结合的研究具有重要参考价值。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.contribution: 提出了首个面向语言模型程序化自动驾驶规划的开源基准数据集LaMPilot。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.innovation: 将驾驶规划任务形式化为自然语言指令驱动的程序合成与执行，并构建多场景评测协议。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.result: 实验显示当前先进语言模型在该基准上仍存在显著性能差距，为后续研究指明方向。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for._arxiv_id: LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for Autonomous Driving with Language Model Programs.

Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中纯视觉4D占用预测缺乏统一评测基准的问题，本文提出了Cam4DOcc，一个面向相机-only 4D占用预测的基准。该基准定义了多种任务设置，包括未来占用预测和运动物体分割，并提供了标准化的数据划分与评价指标。相比已有占用预测工作多聚焦于单帧或LiDAR输入，Cam4DOcc首次系统性地评估纯视觉方案在时序占用预测中的表现。实验揭示了现有方法在动态场景下的不足，为后续研究提供了重要基线。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for camera-only 4D occupancy forecasting in autonomous driving by proposing Cam4DOcc. It defines multiple task settings including future occupancy prediction and moving object segmentation with standardized splits and metrics. Unlike prior occupancy works focusing on single-frame or LiDAR inputs, Cam4DOcc systematically evaluates camera-only methods for temporal occupancy forecasting, revealing limitations of existing approaches in dynamic scenes.
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.assessment: 该基准对推动纯视觉占用预测研究具有重要价值，尤其在BEV与Occupancy方向提供了标准化评测平台。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.contribution: 提出了首个面向相机-only 4D占用预测的标准化基准Cam4DOcc。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.innovation: 定义了未来占用预测与运动物体分割等任务设置，并建立统一评价协议。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.result: 实验揭示现有方法在动态场景下占用预测性能不足，提供了重要基线。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O._arxiv_id: Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D Occupancy Forecasting in Autonomous Driving Applications.

AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中目标检测模型依赖大量人工标注、难以适应新场景的问题，本文提出了AIDE，一个自动数据引擎。该引擎通过自动挖掘、筛选和标注难例数据，迭代提升检测模型性能。相比传统主动学习或半监督方法，AIDE整合了数据挖掘、伪标签生成与模型再训练的全流程自动化。在多个自动驾驶数据集上，AIDE显著提升了检测精度，同时大幅降低人工标注成本。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy reliance on manual annotation and poor adaptability of object detection models in autonomous driving by proposing AIDE, an automatic data engine. It iteratively improves detection by mining, selecting, and annotating hard examples automatically. Compared to active learning or semi-supervised methods, AIDE integrates data mining, pseudo-labeling, and retraining into a fully automated pipeline, achieving significant accuracy gains while reducing annotation cost.
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶目标检测的数据闭环提供了实用方案，对降低标注成本与提升模型泛化能力有重要参考意义。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.contribution: 提出了面向自动驾驶目标检测的自动数据引擎AIDE，实现难例挖掘与标注自动化。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.innovation: 整合数据挖掘、伪标签生成与模型再训练的全流程自动化闭环。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.result: 在多个自动驾驶数据集上显著提升检测精度，同时大幅降低人工标注成本。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec._arxiv_id: AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Object Detection in Autonomous Driving.

Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中点云预测依赖LiDAR、难以规模化的问题，本文提出了视觉点云预测方法，仅用相机输入预测未来点云。该方法通过自监督学习从视频中学习3D结构与时序动态，无需LiDAR标注即可训练。相比已有LiDAR-based预测方法，本方法在保持预测精度的同时大幅降低了传感器成本。实验表明，预测的点云可有效用于下游自动驾驶任务，如运动规划与占用预测。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.summary_en: This paper addresses the scalability issue of LiDAR-dependent point cloud forecasting in autonomous driving by proposing a visual point cloud forecasting method that predicts future point clouds from camera inputs only. It learns 3D structure and temporal dynamics from videos via self-supervised learning without LiDAR annotations. Compared to LiDAR-based methods, it achieves competitive forecasting accuracy at much lower sensor cost, and the predicted point clouds benefit downstream tasks like motion planning and occupancy prediction.
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.assessment: 该工作展示了纯视觉点云预测在自动驾驶中的潜力，对推动低成本、可规模化感知方案具有重要意义。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.contribution: 提出了仅用相机输入的自监督视觉点云预测方法，实现可规模化自动驾驶感知。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.innovation: 利用视频自监督学习3D结构与动态，无需LiDAR标注即可预测未来点云。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.result: 预测点云在保持精度的同时降低传感器成本，并有效支持下游规划与占用预测任务。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S._arxiv_id: Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables Scalable Autonomous Driving.

Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中单目深度估计模型易受物理3D对抗攻击的问题，本文提出了物理3D对抗攻击方法。该方法通过在真实场景中放置3D对抗物体，诱导深度估计模型产生错误深度预测。相比已有数字域对抗攻击，本文首次在物理世界中验证了对单目深度估计的有效攻击。实验表明，所提方法能显著降低深度估计精度，揭示了自动驾驶感知系统的安全隐患。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of monocular depth estimation in autonomous driving to physical 3D adversarial attacks by proposing a physical attack method. It places 3D adversarial objects in real scenes to induce erroneous depth predictions. Unlike digital-domain attacks, this work first validates effective physical-world attacks on monocular depth estimation, significantly degrading accuracy and revealing safety risks in autonomous driving perception.
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.assessment: 该研究揭示了单目深度估计在物理世界中的安全漏洞，对自动驾驶感知鲁棒性研究具有警示意义。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.contribution: 提出了针对单目深度估计的物理3D对抗攻击方法。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.innovation: 首次在物理世界中验证对单目深度估计模型的有效对抗攻击。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.result: 实验表明所提方法能显著降低深度估计精度，暴露感知系统安全隐患。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against._arxiv_id: Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against Monocular Depth Estimation in Autonomous Driving.

Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中多视图未来预测与规划缺乏统一世界模型的问题，本文提出了基于世界模型的多视图视觉预测与规划框架。该方法通过多视图视频预测未来场景演化，并基于预测结果进行规划决策。相比已有单视图或纯预测方法，本框架将预测与规划统一在世界模型中，实现了端到端的未来感知与决策。实验表明，该方法在多视图预测精度和规划安全性上均优于基线，展示了世界模型在自动驾驶中的潜力。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified world model for multiview future forecasting and planning in autonomous driving by proposing a multiview visual forecasting and planning framework. It predicts future scene evolution from multiview videos and performs planning based on the forecasts. Unlike single-view or pure prediction methods, it unifies forecasting and planning in a world model for end-to-end future perception and decision-making, outperforming baselines in both prediction accuracy and planning safety.
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.assessment: 该工作将世界模型引入自动驾驶多视图预测与规划，对推动端到端自动驾驶研究具有重要价值。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.contribution: 提出了基于世界模型的多视图视觉预测与规划统一框架。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.innovation: 将多视图未来预测与规划决策统一在世界模型中，实现端到端未来感知与决策。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.result: 在多视图预测精度和规划安全性上均优于基线，展示世界模型在自动驾驶中的潜力。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua._arxiv_id: Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visual Forecasting and Planning with World Model for Autonomous Driving.

DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶场景中动态多相机环绕视图的合成与重建问题，现有基于NeRF的方法在动态物体建模和大规模场景下效率低、质量差。本文提出DrivingGaussian，采用复合高斯泼溅（Composite Gaussian Splatting）框架，将静态背景与动态物体分别用3D高斯表示，并通过增量式静态3D高斯和动态高斯图进行联合建模。相比已有工作，该方法在保持实时渲染的同时显著提升了动态场景的重建质量。在Waymo数据集上，该方法在PSNR等指标上超越NeRF基线，并支持新视角合成与场景编辑。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of reconstructing and synthesizing surrounding dynamic scenes for autonomous driving, where existing NeRF-based methods struggle with efficiency and quality in large-scale dynamic environments. It proposes DrivingGaussian, a composite Gaussian Splatting framework that models static backgrounds and dynamic objects separately using incremental static 3D Gaussians and dynamic Gaussian graphs. Compared to prior work, it achieves real-time rendering with significantly improved reconstruction quality, outperforming NeRF baselines on the Waymo dataset in PSNR and supporting novel view synthesis and scene editing.
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.assessment: 该工作将3D高斯泼溅成功扩展到自动驾驶动态环绕场景，兼顾效率与质量，对场景重建和仿真数据生成有重要价值。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.contribution: 提出复合高斯泼溅框架，实现自动驾驶动态环绕场景的高效高质量重建与渲染。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.innovation: 将静态与动态物体解耦建模，结合增量式3D高斯和动态高斯图实现实时动态场景合成。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.result: 在Waymo数据集上PSNR等指标超越NeRF基线，并支持实时新视角合成与场景编辑。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla._arxiv_id: DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Splatting for Surrounding Dynamic Autonomous Driving Scenes.

Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中单目深度估计精度不足与多视图深度在远距离/稀疏区域失效的问题，本文提出自适应融合单视图与多视图深度的方法。该方法通过自适应融合模块，根据场景内容动态调整单目深度与多视图深度的权重，并结合不确定性估计进行优化。相比单独使用单目或多视图深度，融合方法在深度估计精度上取得显著提升。在DDAD和nuScenes等自动驾驶数据集上，该方法在深度估计指标上优于现有融合策略。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited accuracy of monocular depth and the failure of multi-view depth in distant or sparse regions for autonomous driving. It proposes an adaptive fusion method that dynamically adjusts the weights of monocular and multi-view depth based on scene content, incorporating uncertainty estimation. Compared to using either modality alone, the fusion achieves significant improvements in depth accuracy, outperforming existing fusion strategies on DDAD and nuScenes datasets.
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.assessment: 该工作有效结合单目与多视图深度的互补优势，对自动驾驶3D感知中的深度估计有实用价值。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.contribution: 提出自适应融合单视图与多视图深度的框架，提升自动驾驶场景深度估计精度。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.innovation: 基于场景内容动态调整单目与多视图深度权重，并引入不确定性估计优化融合。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.result: 在DDAD和nuScenes数据集上深度估计指标优于现有融合策略。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi._arxiv_id: Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi-View Depth for Autonomous Driving.

Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态大模型在自动驾驶场景中缺乏整体3D空间理解能力的问题，本文提出将鸟瞰图（BEV）注入多模态大模型的方法，构建了首个面向自动驾驶整体理解的BEV注入多模态大模型。该方法通过将BEV特征与语言模型对齐，使模型能够进行空间推理和驾驶场景问答。相比仅基于2D图像的多模态模型，该方法在自动驾驶理解任务上显著提升了空间感知和推理能力。在多个自动驾驶问答基准上，该方法取得了领先的性能。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of holistic 3D spatial understanding in existing multimodal large models for autonomous driving. It proposes injecting Bird's Eye View (BEV) representations into multimodal large models, creating the first BEV-injected MLLM for holistic autonomous driving understanding. By aligning BEV features with language models, the approach enables spatial reasoning and driving scene question answering, significantly outperforming 2D image-based models on multiple autonomous driving QA benchmarks.
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.assessment: 该工作首次将BEV注入多模态大模型，为自动驾驶场景理解提供了新范式，对VLM与自动驾驶交叉研究有重要启发。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.contribution: 提出BEV注入的多模态大模型，实现自动驾驶场景的整体3D空间理解与问答。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.innovation: 将BEV特征与语言模型对齐，使多模态大模型具备3D空间推理能力。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.result: 在多个自动驾驶问答基准上取得领先性能，显著提升空间感知与推理能力。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin._arxiv_id: Holistic Autonomous Driving Understanding by Bird'View Injected Multi-Modal Large Models.

On the Road to Portability: Compressing.summary_cn: 针对端到端运动规划模型参数量大、难以部署到车载平台的问题，本文提出压缩端到端运动规划器的方法。该方法通过知识蒸馏与网络剪枝相结合，在保持规划性能的同时大幅减少模型参数量和计算量。相比直接剪枝或蒸馏，该方法针对规划任务的特点设计了专门的压缩策略。实验表明，压缩后的模型在保持规划精度的同时显著降低了计算开销，提升了可移植性。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenge of large end-to-end motion planning models for autonomous driving. It proposes a compression method combining knowledge distillation and network pruning to reduce model size and computation while preserving planning performance. Compared to naive pruning or distillation, the approach designs task-specific compression strategies for planning, achieving significant reduction in computation with maintained planning accuracy and improved portability.
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.assessment: 该工作聚焦端到端规划模型的压缩与部署，对自动驾驶模型轻量化有实际工程价值。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.contribution: 提出结合知识蒸馏与剪枝的端到端运动规划器压缩方法，提升模型可移植性。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.innovation: 针对规划任务设计专门的压缩策略，兼顾规划精度与计算效率。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.result: 压缩后模型在保持规划精度的同时显著降低计算开销。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing._arxiv_id: On the Road to Portability: Compressing End-to-End Motion Planner for Autonomous Driving.

Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶雷达数据标注成本高、监督学习依赖大量标注的问题，本文提出利用自监督学习引导雷达感知的方法。该方法通过自监督预训练任务从无标注雷达数据中学习表征，再迁移到下游感知任务。相比从头训练或使用少量标注的监督方法，自监督预训练显著提升了雷达感知性能。实验表明，该方法在多个雷达感知任务上取得了优于监督基线的效果，且减少了对标注数据的依赖。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and reliance on labeled data in autonomous driving radar perception. It proposes a self-supervised learning approach to bootstrap radar perception by pre-training representations from unlabeled radar data and transferring to downstream tasks. Compared to training from scratch or with limited labels, the self-supervised pre-training significantly improves radar perception performance and reduces annotation dependence across multiple tasks.
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习引入雷达感知，为降低自动驾驶雷达标注成本提供了有效途径。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.contribution: 提出自监督学习引导的雷达感知方法，减少对标注数据的依赖。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.innovation: 设计针对雷达数据的自监督预训练任务，提升下游感知任务性能。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.result: 在多个雷达感知任务上优于监督基线，显著降低标注需求。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars._arxiv_id: Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars with Self-Supervised Learning.

Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶夜间场景低光照图像质量差、影响感知性能的问题，本文提出一种多条件扩散框架用于非配对低光照增强。该方法通过扩散模型结合多种条件（如光照、场景）进行图像增强，无需配对的高低光照图像。相比现有低光照增强方法，该框架在非配对设置下更好地保持了图像细节和色彩一致性。实验表明，增强后的图像显著提升了夜间自动驾驶感知任务的性能。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor image quality in low-light nighttime driving scenes that degrades perception performance. It proposes a multi-condition diffusion framework for unpaired low-light enhancement, leveraging diffusion models with multiple conditions (e.g., illumination, scene) without requiring paired images. Compared to existing methods, it better preserves details and color consistency in unpaired settings, significantly improving nighttime autonomous driving perception tasks.
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.assessment: 该工作利用扩散模型解决夜间低光照增强问题，对提升自动驾驶夜间感知鲁棒性有实用意义。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.contribution: 提出多条件扩散框架，实现非配对夜间低光照图像增强。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.innovation: 结合多种条件引导扩散模型，在非配对设置下保持细节与色彩一致性。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.result: 增强后图像显著提升夜间自动驾驶感知任务性能。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu._arxiv_id: Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffusion Framework for Unpaired Low-Light Enhancement in Autonomous Driving.

Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.summary_cn: 针对开环端到端自动驾驶中传感器输入是否必要的问题，论文发现仅使用自车状态（ego status）即可在nuScenes开环评测中达到与完整传感器输入相当甚至更优的规划性能，揭示了当前开环基准存在严重的信息泄漏与评测偏差。作者提出一种简单基线，仅凭自车历史状态预测未来轨迹，在多个开环指标上超越现有端到端方法。该工作通过大量消融实验证明感知模块在开环设定下贡献有限，呼吁社区转向闭环评测或更严格的基准设计。实验显示该基线在L2误差与碰撞率上均优于多数依赖多相机输入的端到端模型。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.summary_en: This paper investigates whether sensor inputs are necessary for open-loop end-to-end autonomous driving and finds that ego status alone can match or even surpass full-sensor methods on nuScenes open-loop benchmarks, exposing severe information leakage and evaluation bias. A simple ego-status-only baseline is proposed and outperforms existing end-to-end planners on multiple open-loop metrics. Extensive ablations show that perception modules contribute marginally under open-loop settings, urging the community to adopt closed-loop evaluation or stricter benchmarks.
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.assessment: 该工作直击端到端自动驾驶评测的痛点，对领域基准设计具有警示意义，值得所有做端到端规划的研究者阅读。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.contribution: 揭示开环端到端自动驾驶评测中自车状态足以媲美完整传感器输入，暴露基准缺陷。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.innovation: 用极简自车状态基线挑战复杂端到端感知-规划范式，指出开环评测的信息泄漏问题。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.result: 仅用自车状态的基线在nuScenes开环指标上超越多数多相机端到端方法。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop._arxiv_id: Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop End-to-End Autonomous Driving?

DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中4D场景理解缺乏统一预训练范式的问题，论文提出DriveWorld，一种基于世界模型的4D预训练框架，通过时空建模学习动态场景的通用表征。方法包含记忆状态空间模型进行时序建模与多任务自监督学习（未来预测、占据预测等），在nuScenes等数据集上预训练后迁移至3D检测、占据预测、轨迹预测等下游任务。相比单帧或纯视频预训练方法，DriveWorld在多个下游任务上取得一致提升，例如3D检测mAP提升显著，占据预测IoU也有明显改善。该工作展示了世界模型作为自动驾驶统一预训练范式的潜力。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.summary_en: This paper proposes DriveWorld, a 4D pre-training framework based on world models for autonomous driving, which learns general dynamic scene representations via spatiotemporal modeling. It employs a memory state-space model for temporal modeling and multi-task self-supervised objectives such as future prediction and occupancy forecasting, then transfers to downstream tasks including 3D detection, occupancy prediction, and trajectory prediction. DriveWorld consistently improves over single-frame and video-only pre-training baselines across multiple downstream tasks on nuScenes.
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.assessment: 将世界模型引入自动驾驶4D预训练，方法系统且下游任务覆盖广，是BEV/占据方向值得跟进的工作。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.contribution: 提出基于世界模型的4D预训练框架DriveWorld，统一学习自动驾驶动态场景表征。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.innovation: 结合记忆状态空间模型与多任务自监督，实现时空一致的4D场景预训练。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.result: 在nuScenes多个下游任务（3D检测、占据预测、轨迹预测）上取得一致性能提升。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst._arxiv_id: DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Understanding via World Models for Autonomous Driving.

VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶规划中缺乏语义理解与常识推理的问题，论文提出VLP（Vision Language Planning），将视觉-语言模型融入端到端规划框架，利用语言模型的世界知识与场景理解能力辅助轨迹生成。方法通过视觉-语言对齐模块将BEV感知特征与语言指令/描述融合，输出规划轨迹，并在nuScenes等基准上验证。相比纯视觉端到端规划方法，VLP在开环L2误差与碰撞率上取得改进，尤其在复杂语义场景（如施工、行人交互）中表现更鲁棒。该工作展示了VLM在自动驾驶规划中的实用价值。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.summary_en: This paper proposes VLP (Vision Language Planning), which integrates vision-language models into end-to-end autonomous driving planning to leverage world knowledge and scene understanding for trajectory generation. A vision-language alignment module fuses BEV perception features with language instructions/descriptions to produce planning trajectories, validated on nuScenes. VLP improves open-loop L2 error and collision rate over pure-vision planners, especially in semantically complex scenarios.
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.assessment: 将VLM引入自动驾驶规划是当前热点，VLP提供了可行的融合范式，对多模态感知-规划研究者有参考价值。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.contribution: 提出VLP框架，将视觉-语言模型与BEV感知融合用于端到端自动驾驶规划。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.innovation: 利用语言模型的常识推理增强复杂语义场景下的轨迹规划鲁棒性。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.result: 在nuScenes开环评测中L2误差与碰撞率优于纯视觉端到端规划方法。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono._arxiv_id: VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autonomous Driving.

Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶轨迹预测模型易受后门攻击的安全问题，论文提出一种基于自然数据投毒（naturalistic data poisoning）的对抗后门攻击方法，通过在训练数据中注入自然风格的扰动样本使模型在特定触发条件下输出错误轨迹。方法在多个轨迹预测基准（如nuScenes、Argoverse）上验证，攻击成功率显著高于随机噪声投毒，且投毒样本在视觉上难以察觉。该工作揭示了轨迹预测模型的安全脆弱性，并讨论了潜在防御方向。实验表明在低投毒率下即可实现高攻击成功率，对自动驾驶安全部署构成威胁。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.summary_en: This paper proposes an adversarial backdoor attack via naturalistic data poisoning on trajectory prediction models in autonomous driving, injecting natural-looking poisoned samples into training data to induce erroneous trajectories under specific triggers. Validated on nuScenes and Argoverse, the attack achieves significantly higher success rates than random-noise poisoning while remaining visually imperceptible. The work exposes security vulnerabilities of trajectory prediction models and discusses potential defenses.
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.assessment: 轨迹预测安全性的重要提醒，虽非感知主线，但对自动驾驶整体安全研究有警示价值。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.contribution: 提出基于自然数据投毒的轨迹预测后门攻击方法，揭示模型安全脆弱性。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.innovation: 使用自然风格投毒样本实现隐蔽且高成功率的后门攻击。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.result: 在nuScenes/Argoverse上低投毒率即可达到高攻击成功率，优于随机噪声投毒。

CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.summary_cn: 针对轨迹预测模型在分布外场景下鲁棒性差的问题，论文提出CaDeT，一种基于因果解耦的轨迹预测方法，将场景表征分解为因果因子（如意图、交互）与非因果因子（如环境风格），从而提升对域偏移和对抗扰动的鲁棒性。方法在nuScenes、Argoverse等基准上验证，相比基线在域泛化与对抗鲁棒性指标上均有提升，同时保持竞争性的预测精度。该工作为轨迹预测的鲁棒性提供了因果视角的新思路。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.summary_en: This paper proposes CaDeT, a causal disentanglement approach for robust trajectory prediction, which decomposes scene representations into causal factors (e.g., intention, interaction) and non-causal factors (e.g., environmental style) to improve robustness against domain shifts and adversarial perturbations. Validated on nuScenes and Argoverse, CaDeT improves domain generalization and adversarial robustness while maintaining competitive prediction accuracy.
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.assessment: 因果解耦用于轨迹预测鲁棒性是有新意的方向，对关注自动驾驶安全与泛化的研究者有参考价值。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.contribution: 提出因果解耦框架CaDeT，提升轨迹预测的域泛化与对抗鲁棒性。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.innovation: 将场景表征分解为因果与非因果因子，从因果视角增强预测鲁棒性。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.result: 在nuScenes/Argoverse上域泛化与对抗鲁棒性优于基线，精度保持竞争性。

NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中神经渲染难以处理动态场景与多传感器配置的问题，论文提出NeuRAD，一种面向自动驾驶的神经渲染方法，支持动态物体建模、多相机与LiDAR联合渲染，并能泛化到不同传感器配置。方法引入动态物体建模与传感器无关的场景表征，在nuScenes、Waymo等数据集上实现高质量的新视角合成与深度/语义渲染。相比NeRF类方法，NeuRAD在动态场景渲染质量与跨传感器泛化上显著提升，为自动驾驶仿真与感知数据增强提供了有力工具。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.summary_en: This paper proposes NeuRAD, a neural rendering method for autonomous driving that handles dynamic objects and joint multi-camera and LiDAR rendering while generalizing across sensor configurations. It introduces dynamic object modeling and sensor-agnostic scene representations, achieving high-quality novel view synthesis and depth/semantic rendering on nuScenes and Waymo. NeuRAD significantly improves dynamic scene rendering quality and cross-sensor generalization over NeRF-based methods.
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.assessment: NeuRAD在动态场景与多传感器渲染上表现突出，是自动驾驶仿真与感知数据增强的重要工具，值得关注。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.contribution: 提出面向自动驾驶的神经渲染方法NeuRAD，支持动态物体与多传感器联合渲染。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.innovation: 引入动态物体建模与传感器无关表征，实现跨传感器配置的泛化渲染。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.result: 在nuScenes/Waymo上动态场景渲染质量与跨传感器泛化显著优于NeRF类方法。

Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶场景仿真中场景编辑困难、依赖人工建模的问题，本文提出基于协作式LLM智能体的可编辑场景仿真框架。方法通过多个LLM智能体分工协作，将自然语言指令转化为场景编辑操作，驱动仿真器生成可控的驾驶场景。相比传统手工编辑或单一模型方案，该方法降低了使用门槛并提升了编辑灵活性。摘要未提供定量指标，效果主要体现在交互式场景生成的可行性验证上。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of editable scene simulation for autonomous driving, which traditionally relies on manual modeling. It proposes a collaborative LLM-agent framework that translates natural language instructions into scene editing operations to drive a simulator. Compared with prior manual or single-model pipelines, it lowers the barrier to scene customization and improves editing flexibility, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.assessment: 将LLM智能体引入驾驶场景仿真编辑是有趣的交叉方向，但缺乏定量验证，实用性有待观察。

Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶视频数据稀缺且难以可控生成的问题，本文提出Panacea，一个全景且可控的视频生成框架。方法通过多视角一致性与时序可控的生成机制，合成具有全景覆盖和可控属性的驾驶视频。相比已有视频生成工作，其改进在于兼顾多相机全景一致性与细粒度可控性。摘要未给出具体数值，效果体现在生成视频的全景一致性和可控性上。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity and limited controllability of driving video data by proposing Panacea, a panoramic and controllable video generation framework for autonomous driving. It synthesizes driving videos with multi-view consistency and controllable attributes. Compared with prior video generation methods, it improves panoramic consistency and fine-grained controllability, though no quantitative metrics are given in the abstract.

SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶去雾研究缺乏真实感合成雾数据集的问题，本文提出SynFog，一个基于端到端成像仿真的真实感合成雾数据集。方法通过端到端成像仿真流程生成物理真实的雾图像，用于推进真实世界去雾。相比已有合成雾数据，其改进在于成像仿真的真实感与端到端一致性。摘要未给出具体数值，效果体现在数据集对真实去雾任务的支撑上。

2410.23780|v2.summary_cn: 现有在线高精地图构建主要关注几何与连通性层，忽略了交通标志规则层与矢量化地图的关联。本文提出MapDR数据集，包含超过10000个标注视频片段，捕捉交通标志规则与车道之间的复杂关联，并定义了将交通规则整合进在线HD地图的新任务。作者提供了模块化方案VLE-MEE和端到端方案RuleVLM作为强基线。该工作填补了交通标志规则整合的空白，为可靠自动驾驶系统提供支撑。
2410.23780|v2.summary_en: Existing online HD mapping solutions prioritize geometry and connectivity layers while neglecting the traffic regulation layer. This paper introduces MapDR, a dataset with over 10,000 annotated video clips capturing the correlation between traffic sign regulations and lanes, and defines a new task of integrating traffic rules into online HD maps. Modular (VLE-MEE) and end-to-end (RuleVLM) baselines are provided, filling a critical gap for reliable autonomous driving.
2410.23780|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地将交通标志规则层纳入在线矢量化HD地图构建，数据集规模大且任务定义清晰，对自动驾驶地图研究有重要推动意义。
2410.23780|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向交通标志规则提取与矢量化HD地图关联的大规模数据集MapDR，并定义了新任务。
2410.23780|v2.innovation: 将交通规则层引入在线HD地图构建，提出模块化与端到端两种解决方案。
2410.23780|v2.result: 提供超过10000个标注视频片段及强基线VLE-MEE和RuleVLM，填补了规则层整合的空白。

2506.06218|v2.summary_cn: 现有VLM基准多针对单视角图像或视频的语义任务，缺乏对自动驾驶中时空推理能力的系统评估。本文提出STSBench框架，可自动从任意数据集中挖掘预定义交通场景并生成多选题，应用于NuScenes构建了STSnu基准，首次基于全面3D感知评估VLM的时空推理能力。该基准涵盖43个多样场景、多视角多帧共971个问题，专门评估驾驶专家VLM对自车行为和交通参与者复杂交互的推理能力。
2506.06218|v2.summary_en: Existing VLM benchmarks focus on single-view semantic tasks and lack systematic evaluation of spatio-temporal reasoning in autonomous driving. This paper proposes STSBench, a scenario-based framework that automatically mines traffic scenarios and generates multiple-choice questions, applied to NuScenes to create STSnu. It features 43 diverse scenarios and 971 questions, evaluating driving expert VLMs on ego-action and traffic interaction reasoning from multi-view cameras or LiDAR.
2506.06218|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了VLM在自动驾驶时空推理评估方面的空白，场景挖掘自动化程度高，对推动驾驶VLM研究有重要价值。
2506.06218|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于全面3D感知评估VLM时空推理能力的场景化基准STSnu。
2506.06218|v2.innovation: 自动场景挖掘与多选题生成框架，支持多视角多帧的端到端驾驶VLM评估。
2506.06218|v2.result: 构建了包含43个场景、971个问题的基准，覆盖自车行为与交通参与者交互推理。

2506.05175|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频异常检测方法多关注异常帧或异常对象，忽略了像素级细粒度分析，限制了异常捕捉范围。本文提出TAO框架，首次将多细粒度异常对象检测整合进统一流程，将问题转化为异常对象的像素级跟踪，通过将异常分数链接到分割和跟踪等下游任务，消除了阈值调参需求。实验表明TAO在准确性和鲁棒性上均达到新基准，尤其在长复杂视频序列中实现更精确的异常定位。
2506.05175|v2.summary_en: Existing video anomaly detection methods focus on anomalous frames or objects, neglecting pixel-level granularity. This paper proposes TAO, a granular pipeline that integrates detection of multiple fine-grained anomalous objects by transforming the problem into pixel-level tracking of anomalous objects. By linking anomaly scores to segmentation and tracking, it removes threshold tuning and achieves more precise localization in long complex sequences, setting new benchmarks in accuracy and robustness.
2506.05175|v2.assessment: 该工作将异常检测与像素级跟踪结合，思路新颖，无需阈值调参是实用优势，但整体与自动驾驶核心感知任务关联度一般。
2506.05175|v2.contribution: 提出首个将多细粒度异常对象检测统一到像素级跟踪框架的视频异常检测流程TAO。
2506.05175|v2.innovation: 将异常检测转化为像素级异常对象跟踪，消除阈值调参并链接下游分割与跟踪任务。
2506.05175|v2.result: 在准确性和鲁棒性上达到新基准，长复杂视频序列中异常定位更精确。

2503.12982|v2.summary_cn: 现有协同目标检测方法多基于密集BEV特征图，计算开销大且难以扩展到远距离检测，全稀疏框架鲜有探索。本文设计SparseAlign全稀疏框架，包含增强稀疏3D骨干、基于查询的时序上下文学习模块和专为稀疏特征定制的鲁棒检测头。在OPV2V和DairV2X数据集上，该框架以更少通信带宽超越当前最优方法，在OPV2Vt和DairV2Xt时间对齐协同检测任务上也显著优于基线。
2503.12982|v2.summary_en: Existing cooperative object detection methods mostly operate on dense BEV feature maps, which are computationally demanding and hard to scale to long-range detection. This paper designs SparseAlign, a fully sparse framework with an enhanced sparse 3D backbone, a query-based temporal context learning module, and a robust detection head tailored for sparse features. It outperforms state-of-the-art on OPV2V and DairV2X with less communication bandwidth, and shows significant gains on time-aligned cooperative detection.
2503.12982|v2.assessment: 该工作针对协同感知中密集BEV计算瓶颈提出全稀疏方案，在多个数据集上验证了效率与精度优势，对V2X协同检测研究有重要参考价值。
2503.12982|v2.contribution: 提出全稀疏协同目标检测框架SparseAlign，突破密集BEV特征图的计算与通信瓶颈。
2503.12982|v2.innovation: 增强稀疏3D骨干、查询式时序上下文学习与稀疏特征定制检测头的组合设计。
2503.12982|v2.result: 在OPV2V和DairV2X上以更少通信带宽超越SOTA，时间对齐协同检测任务上显著提升。

2505.02148|v2.summary_cn: 自动驾驶需要检测道路上的异常物体，但3D异常分割研究远落后于2D，且现有数据集缺乏高质量多模态数据。本文提出STU数据集，是首个公开的面向道路异常分割的密集3D语义标注数据集，融合LiDAR与相机数据及序列信息，支持跨距离异常检测。作者适配并评估了多个3D分割基线模型，揭示了驾驶环境中3D异常检测的挑战，数据集与评估代码将公开。
2505.02148|v2.summary_en: Autonomous vehicles need to detect unexpected road anomalies, but 3D anomaly segmentation is underexplored and existing datasets lack high-quality multimodal data. This paper presents STU, the first publicly available dataset for road anomaly segmentation with dense 3D semantic labeling, incorporating LiDAR, camera, and sequential information for anomaly detection across ranges. Several 3D segmentation baselines are adapted and evaluated, highlighting challenges in 3D anomaly detection.
2505.02148|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了3D道路异常分割的空白，多模态与序列信息设计贴合自动驾驶实际需求，对安全感知研究有重要价值。
2505.02148|v2.contribution: 构建了首个公开的融合LiDAR与相机的密集3D语义标注道路异常分割数据集STU。
2505.02148|v2.innovation: 结合多模态数据与序列信息，支持跨距离3D异常检测与分割评估。
2505.02148|v2.result: 提供数据集与评估代码，并通过多个3D分割基线揭示了驾驶环境3D异常检测的挑战。

2411.16816|v2.summary_cn: 现有NeRF方法用于相机和LiDAR传感器逼真渲染时速度慢，难以支撑大规模测试，而3DGS虽可实时渲染但仅限相机数据。本文提出SplatAD，首个基于3DGS的方法，可对动态场景同时实时渲染相机和LiDAR数据，精确建模卷帘快门效应、LiDAR强度和射线丢失等传感器特有现象。在三个自动驾驶数据集上评估，SplatAD达到当前最优性能。
2411.16816|v2.summary_en: Existing NeRF methods for sensor-realistic camera and LiDAR rendering suffer from low speed, limiting large-scale testing, while 3DGS enables real-time rendering but is limited to camera data. This paper proposes SplatAD, the first 3DGS-based method for realistic real-time rendering of dynamic scenes for both camera and LiDAR, accurately modeling rolling shutter, LiDAR intensity, and ray dropouts. Evaluations on three autonomous driving datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance.
2411.16816|v2.assessment: 该工作将3DGS扩展到LiDAR渲染并处理传感器特有现象，实时性优势明显，对自动驾驶仿真测试有重要实用价值。
2411.16816|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于3DGS的相机与LiDAR实时逼真渲染方法SplatAD，支持动态场景。
2411.16816|v2.innovation: 精确建模卷帘快门、LiDAR强度与射线丢失等传感器特有现象，并优化渲染效率。
2411.16816|v2.result: 在三个自动驾驶数据集上达到当前最优渲染性能，实现实时相机与LiDAR渲染。

2503.17752|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督LiDAR点云语义分割中现有方法仅利用短时相邻帧、忽略自动驾驶场景长时时间特性的问题，提出HiLoTs框架，从连续LiDAR帧中学习高时间敏感与低时间敏感表示，并通过交叉注意力机制增强融合，同时采用教师-学生框架对齐有标签与无标签分支的表示。该方法利用近处物体（道路、车辆）时间稳定性高、远处物体时间敏感性高的自然先验，相比仅用两帧的短时方法更充分利用长时序列信息。在自动驾驶LiDAR分割基准上取得了优于现有半监督方法的性能。
2503.17752|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised LiDAR semantic segmentation, where existing methods exploit only short-term temporal cues (e.g., two adjacent frames) and overlook long-term temporal properties in driving scenes. It proposes HiLoTs, which learns high- and low-temporal-sensitivity representations from continuous LiDAR frames, fuses them via cross-attention, and aligns labeled/unlabeled branches with a teacher-student framework. Exploiting the observation that nearby objects are temporally stable while distant ones are more variable, HiLoTs outperforms prior semi-supervised methods on autonomous driving LiDAR segmentation benchmarks.
2503.17752|v2.assessment: 将长时时间敏感性先验引入半监督LiDAR分割，思路新颖且贴合驾驶场景物理特性，对半监督3D感知研究有参考价值。
2503.17752|v2.contribution: 提出HiLoTs，从连续LiDAR帧中学习高/低时间敏感表示并交叉注意力融合，用于半监督LiDAR语义分割。
2503.17752|v2.innovation: 首次显式建模近处低时间敏感、远处高时间敏感的长时时间特性，并结合教师-学生框架对齐表示。
2503.17752|v2.result: 在自动驾驶LiDAR分割任务上超越现有半监督方法。

2507.17083|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D占用预测中相机方法缺乏深度、LiDAR方法受遮挡困扰，以及LSS视图变换深度估计不准、未充分利用LiDAR几何语义信息的问题，提出SDG-OCC网络。该方法通过扩散与双线性离散化融合像素语义与共点深度构建精确深度分布，并设计融合到占用驱动的主动蒸馏，依据LiDAR识别区域选择性将多模态语义知识迁移到图像特征，同时给出SDG-Fusion与SDG-KL两种变体。在占用预测基准上取得优于现有轻量方法的性能。
2507.17083|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multimodal 3D occupancy prediction, where camera-only methods lack depth and LiDAR-only methods suffer from occlusion, while the LSS pipeline yields inaccurate depth and underuses LiDAR geometry/semantics. It proposes SDG-OCC, which builds accurate depth distributions via joint semantic and depth-guided view transformation with diffusion and bilinear discretization, and introduces fusion-to-occupancy-driven active distillation to selectively transfer multimodal knowledge to image features. SDG-Fusion and SDG-KL variants achieve superior performance over existing lightweight methods.
2507.17083|v2.assessment: 语义与深度联合引导的视图变换加主动蒸馏设计合理，对多模态BEV/占用感知研究有较强借鉴意义。
2507.17083|v2.contribution: 提出SDG-OCC，用语义与深度联合引导的视图变换和融合到占用驱动的主动蒸馏实现多模态3D占用预测。
2507.17083|v2.innovation: 通过扩散与双线性离散化融合像素语义和共点深度构建深度分布，并按LiDAR识别区域选择性蒸馏知识。
2507.17083|v2.result: 在3D占用预测基准上优于现有轻量方法。

2504.01957|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于查询学习的BEV感知方法缺乏不确定性建模且计算开销大、难以落地真实场景的问题，提出GaussianLSS，重新审视基于反投影的LSS范式并引入深度不确定性建模。该方法学习软深度均值并计算深度分布方差以表示空间离散度，隐式捕捉物体范围，再将深度分布转换为3D高斯并光栅化构建不确定性感知的BEV特征。在nuScenes数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能。
2504.01957|v2.summary_en: This paper targets projection-based BEV perception, which lacks uncertainty modeling and is computationally expensive for real-world deployment. It proposes GaussianLSS, an uncertainty-aware framework that revisits the LSS unprojection paradigm by learning a soft depth mean and computing depth variance to represent spatial dispersion, then transforms the depth distribution into 3D Gaussians rasterized into uncertainty-aware BEV features. GaussianLSS achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2504.01957|v2.assessment: 将3D高斯表示与深度不确定性引入LSS式BEV感知，兼顾精度与不确定性，对真实世界BEV部署有实际意义。
2504.01957|v2.contribution: 提出GaussianLSS，用深度不确定性建模与3D高斯光栅化构建不确定性感知BEV特征。
2504.01957|v2.innovation: 以软深度均值与方差隐式捕捉物体范围，并将深度分布转为3D高斯进行光栅化。

2504.12959|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉3D语义占用预测中时间融合未被充分探索的问题，提出GDFusion，系统梳理VisionOcc流程并识别出三个此前被忽视的时间线索：场景级一致性、运动校准和几何互补。该方法通过重新诠释vanilla RNN的公式，利用特征上的梯度下降统一异构表示的时间信息融合，将时间线索无缝嵌入网络。在nuScenes的Occ3D基准上取得1.4%-4.8% mIoU提升，并将内存消耗降低27%-72%。
2504.12959|v2.summary_en: This paper explores temporal fusion for vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction (VisionOcc), identifying three overlooked temporal cues: scene-level consistency, motion calibration, and geometric complementation. It proposes GDFusion, which reinterprets vanilla RNN formulation as gradient descent on features to unify fusion of heterogeneous temporal signals. On the nuScenes Occ3D benchmark, it improves mIoU by 1.4%-4.8% while reducing memory consumption by 27%-72%.
2504.12959|v2.assessment: 以梯度下降视角统一时间融合，理论视角新颖且内存效率提升显著，对占用预测时间建模有较高参考价值。
2504.12959|v2.contribution: 提出GDFusion，识别三类时间线索并以梯度下降视角统一异构时间信息融合。
2504.12959|v2.innovation: 重新诠释vanilla RNN为特征上的梯度下降，实现时间线索的无缝嵌入与高效融合。
2504.12959|v2.result: Occ3D基准上mIoU提升1.4%-4.8%，内存消耗降低27%-72%。

2412.10373|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有流式3D占用预测方法仅融合前帧表示、忽视驾驶场景连续性与3D场景演化强先验（如仅动态物体移动）的问题，提出基于世界模型的GaussianWorld框架。该方法将3D占用预测重构为以当前传感器输入为条件的4D占用预测问题，把场景演化分解为自车运动对齐、动态物体局部运动和新观测场景补全三要素，并在3D高斯空间显式利用这些先验推断场景演化。在nuScenes上相比单帧基线mIoU提升超过2%，且未引入额外开销。
2412.10373|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses streaming 3D occupancy prediction, where existing methods fuse previous-frame representations but ignore scene continuity and the strong prior of 3D scene evolution (e.g., only dynamic objects move). It reformulates occupancy prediction as a 4D forecasting problem conditioned on current sensor input, decomposing scene evolution into ego-motion alignment, dynamic object motion, and newly-observed scene completion, and employs a Gaussian world model to infer evolution in 3D Gaussian space. On nuScenes, GaussianWorld improves the single-frame counterpart by over 2% mIoU without extra overhead.
2412.10373|v2.assessment: 将世界模型与3D高斯表示引入流式占用预测，重构为4D预测问题，思路前沿且提升明显，值得重点关注。
2412.10373|v2.contribution: 提出GaussianWorld，将流式3D占用预测重构为条件于当前输入的4D占用预测问题。
2412.10373|v2.innovation: 用3D高斯世界模型显式建模自车运动、动态物体运动与新观测补全三类场景演化先验。
2412.10373|v2.result: nuScenes上相比单帧基线mIoU提升超过2%，且无额外开销。

2605.08320|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计在低纹理区域因光度损失导致深度预测模糊的问题，提出一种在预语义轮廓上应用距离变换以增强空间信息的技术，提升低纹理区域的判别力。该方法联合估计预语义轮廓、深度与自车运动，用预语义轮廓生成新输入图像，通过距离变换在均匀区域增强方差，从而改进深度与自车运动的损失函数，并从理论上证明距离变换是该情境下最优的方差增强技术。在KITTI、Cityscapes、Waymo、NYUv2和ScanNet上超越竞争的自监督MDE方法。
2605.08320|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised monocular depth estimation, which struggles in low-texture regions where photometric losses yield ambiguous depth. It proposes applying a distance transform over pre-semantic contours to augment spatial information, jointly estimating pre-semantic contours, depth, and ego-motion, and theoretically shows the distance transform is the optimal variance-augmenting technique in this context. Experiments on KITTI, Cityscapes, Waymo, NYUv2, and ScanNet show robust performance surpassing competing self-supervised MDE methods.
2605.08320|v2.assessment: 以距离变换增强低纹理区域判别力的思路简洁且有理论支撑，对自监督深度估计研究有一定参考价值。
2605.08320|v2.contribution: 提出在预语义轮廓上应用距离变换增强空间信息，联合估计轮廓、深度与自车运动。
2605.08320|v2.innovation: 理论上证明距离变换为该情境下最优方差增强技术，并用于改进低纹理区域的自监督深度训练。
2605.08320|v2.result: 在KITTI、Cityscapes、Waymo、NYUv2、ScanNet上超越竞争的自监督MDE方法。

2505.16805|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM与端到端自动驾驶模型集成时计算开销大、难以实时决策的问题，本文提出SOLVE框架，通过共享视觉编码器实现VLM与E2E模型在特征层面的知识共享，并设计轨迹思维链（T-CoT）范式逐步精化轨迹预测以降低不确定性。同时采用时间解耦策略，将高质量VLM输出与E2E实时性能对齐，实现高效协同。在nuScenes数据集上，该方法在轨迹预测精度上取得显著提升，为更鲁棒可靠的自动驾驶系统提供了新思路。
2505.16805|v2.summary_en: To address the high computational cost and difficulty of real-time decision-making when integrating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) into end-to-end autonomous driving, this paper proposes SOLVE, a framework that synergizes VLMs with E2E models via a shared visual encoder for feature-level knowledge sharing. It introduces a Trajectory Chain-of-Thought (T-CoT) paradigm to progressively refine trajectory predictions and reduce uncertainty, and employs a temporal decoupling strategy to align high-quality VLM outputs with E2E real-time performance. Evaluated on nuScenes, SOLVE demonstrates significant improvements in trajectory prediction accuracy, paving the way for more robust autonomous driving systems.
2505.16805|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了VLM与端到端自动驾驶模型的高效融合，T-CoT和时间解耦策略具有启发性，但摘要未给出具体量化提升，需关注其实际推理延迟与精度权衡。
2505.16805|v2.contribution: 提出SOLVE框架，通过共享视觉编码器和T-CoT范式实现VLM与E2E模型的高效协同，提升轨迹预测精度。
2505.16805|v2.innovation: 轨迹思维链（T-CoT）范式与时间解耦策略，在特征层面实现VLM与E2E的协同并兼顾实时性。
2505.16805|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上显著提升了轨迹预测精度，但摘要未提供具体数值。

2503.08422|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶LiDAR感知中真实标注数据成本高且缺乏长尾场景的问题，本文提出即插即用的JiSAM方法，通过抖动增强、域感知骨干网络和基于记忆的分区对齐，有效利用模拟器生成的点云数据来提升真实场景感知。在nuScenes数据集上，仅使用2.5%的真实标注数据结合模拟数据，JiSAM配合SOTA 3D检测器即可达到与全量真实数据训练相当的性能，并在罕见目标上取得超过15 mAP的提升，显著缓解了标注负担和角落案例问题。
2503.08422|v2.summary_en: To alleviate the high annotation cost and lack of corner cases in real-world LiDAR perception, this paper proposes JiSAM, a plug-and-play method comprising jittering augmentation, a domain-aware backbone, and memory-based sectorized alignment, which leverages synthetic point clouds from simulators. On nuScenes, with a SOTA 3D detector, JiSAM achieves comparable performance to models trained on all real data using only 2.5% of real labels combined with simulation data, and improves more than 15 mAP on rare objects, effectively reducing labeling burden and addressing corner cases.
2503.08422|v2.assessment: 该工作针对自动驾驶3D感知中真实数据标注昂贵和长尾场景稀缺的痛点，提出了一种实用的模拟到真实迁移方案，实验效果显著，具有较高的应用价值。
2503.08422|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的JiSAM方法，通过模拟数据与极少量真实标注结合，实现与全量真实数据训练相当的3D检测性能。
2503.08422|v2.innovation: 结合抖动增强、域感知骨干和基于记忆的分区对齐，有效弥合模拟到真实的域差距并提升样本效率。
2503.08422|v2.result: 在nuScenes上仅用2.5%真实标注即达到全量真实数据训练水平，罕见目标mAP提升超过15。

2512.20563|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对仿真环境中模仿学习策略闭环性能差的问题，实证分析了特权专家演示与基于传感器的学生观测之间的不对称性（专家可见性更高、不确定性更低、导航意图仅由单点指定）如何限制模仿学习效果。作者提出了一系列实用干预措施来缩小专家与学生之间的差距，包括更明确的导航意图表示和感知监督的整合，构建了TransFuser v6 (TFv6)学生策略。相比已有工作，TFv6在CARLA所有主要公开闭环基准上取得新SOTA，Bench2Drive达到95 DS，Longest6 v2和Town13上性能翻倍以上。
2512.20563|v2.summary_en: This paper empirically studies how asymmetries between privileged expert demonstrations and sensor-based student observations (higher visibility, lower uncertainty, under-specified navigational intent) limit imitation learning in CARLA. The authors propose practical interventions to narrow these gaps, resulting in TransFuser v6 (TFv6), which achieves state-of-the-art results on all major CARLA closed-loop benchmarks, reaching 95 DS on Bench2Drive and more than doubling prior performance on Longest6 v2 and Town13.
2512.20563|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地分析了模仿学习中专家-学生不对称性问题，并提出了有效的解决方案，在多个权威闭环基准上取得显著提升，对自动驾驶端到端学习具有重要指导意义。
2512.20563|v2.contribution: 系统分析了专家-学生不对称性对闭环驾驶性能的影响，并提出缩小差距的实用干预措施。
2512.20563|v2.innovation: 通过明确导航意图表示和整合感知监督来缩小特权专家与传感器学生之间的不对称性。
2512.20563|v2.result: TFv6在Bench2Drive达到95 DS，Longest6 v2和Town13上性能翻倍以上，全面刷新SOTA。

2512.20299|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有自动驾驶系统过度依赖数据驱动学习、难以通过模仿或有限强化奖励捕捉复杂决策逻辑的问题，提出了KnowVal系统，通过开放世界感知与知识检索的协同集成实现视觉-语言推理。具体构建了编码交通法规、防御性驾驶原则和伦理规范的驾驶知识图谱，配合基于LLM的高效检索机制，并开发了人类偏好数据集训练价值模型来指导可解释的价值对齐轨迹评估。实验表明该方法在nuScenes上取得最低碰撞率，在Bench2Drive和NVISIM上达到SOTA，且与现有架构兼容。
2512.20299|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of purely data-driven autonomous driving systems in capturing complex decision-making logic, this paper proposes KnowVal, which integrates open-world perception with knowledge retrieval for visual-language reasoning. It constructs a driving knowledge graph encoding traffic laws and ethical norms, employs an LLM-based retrieval mechanism, and trains a Value Model on human preferences for interpretable trajectory assessment. KnowVal achieves the lowest collision rate on nuScenes and state-of-the-art results on Bench2Drive and NVISIM.
2512.20299|v2.assessment: 该工作将知识图谱与价值对齐引入自动驾驶决策，提升了系统的可解释性和安全性，在多个基准上取得优异结果，值得关注。
2512.20299|v2.contribution: 提出了融合知识图谱检索与价值模型引导的自动驾驶系统KnowVal。
2512.20299|v2.innovation: 通过驾驶知识图谱和人类偏好价值模型实现可解释的价值对齐轨迹评估。
2512.20299|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得最低碰撞率，Bench2Drive和NVISIM上达到SOTA。

2512.10226|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有VLA模型在自动驾驶中使用自然语言表达链式推理效率不高的问题，提出了Latent-CoT-Drive (LCDrive)，在动作对齐的潜在空间中统一表达CoT推理和决策。模型通过交错使用动作提议token（与输出动作共享词汇表）和世界模型token（基于学习到的潜在世界模型表达未来结果）进行推理，冷启动阶段利用真实未来轨迹监督动作提议和世界模型token，再通过闭环强化学习后训练增强推理能力。在大规模端到端驾驶基准上验证了方法的有效性。
2512.10226|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of natural language chain-of-thought reasoning in VLA models for autonomous driving by proposing Latent-CoT-Drive (LCDrive), which expresses CoT in an action-aligned latent space. The model interleaves action-proposal tokens with world model tokens grounded in a learned latent world model, cold-started with ground-truth future rollouts and post-trained with closed-loop reinforcement learning. Experiments on large-scale end-to-end driving benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness.
2512.10226|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地用潜在空间替代自然语言进行CoT推理，统一了推理与决策，为VLA自动驾驶提供了更高效的推理范式。
2512.10226|v2.contribution: 提出在动作对齐潜在空间中进行链式推理的Latent-CoT-Drive模型。
2512.10226|v2.innovation: 用动作提议token和世界模型token交错表达潜在CoT，替代自然语言推理。
2512.10226|v2.result: 在大规模端到端驾驶基准上验证了潜在CoT推理的有效性。

2510.18060|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶仿真中需要类人、快速且可扩展的多智能体策略的问题，指出现有扩散模型或token化模仿学习方法计算昂贵、推理慢且难以适应闭环反应场景，而自博弈强化学习虽可扩展但依赖启发式奖励且策略可能偏离人类规范。提出SPACeR框架，利用预训练的token化自回归运动模型作为集中式参考策略来引导去中心化自博弈，通过似然奖励和KL散度将策略锚定到人类驾驶分布。在Waymo Sim Agents Challenge上取得了优异结果。
2510.18060|v2.summary_en: To achieve human-like, fast, and scalable multi-agent policies for AV simulation, this paper proposes SPACeR, which leverages a pretrained tokenized autoregressive motion model as a centralized reference policy to guide decentralized self-play. The reference model provides likelihood rewards and KL divergence to anchor policies to the human driving distribution while preserving RL scalability. SPACeR achieves strong results on the Waymo Sim Agents Challenge.
2510.18060|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙结合了模仿学习的类人特性与自博弈RL的可扩展性，通过集中式参考模型锚定策略，在Waymo挑战赛上表现优异，对仿真智能体研究有重要参考价值。
2510.18060|v2.contribution: 提出利用集中式参考模型引导去中心化自博弈的SPACeR框架。
2510.18060|v2.innovation: 用预训练token化自回归运动模型提供似然奖励和KL散度来锚定自博弈策略。
2510.18060|v2.result: 在Waymo Sim Agents Challenge上取得优异表现。

2005.01939|v2.summary_cn: 针对单视图图像在无3D监督、无相机位姿信息条件下重建3D物体的问题，提出自监督的形状与位姿联合学习框架。方法利用可微点云渲染器实现2D轮廓监督，并将随机采样的位姿旋转施加到预测点云上，通过3D重建与位姿的双重循环一致性引入几何推理，同时支持测试时优化。在ShapeNet与Pix3D上，尽管监督信号更弱，性能仍与位姿监督方法具有竞争力。
2005.01939|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image 3D object reconstruction without 3D or multi-view supervision, and even without pose annotations. It jointly learns point cloud reconstruction and pose estimation in a self-supervised manner using a differentiable point cloud renderer for 2D silhouette supervision, and enforces cycle consistency on both 3D shapes and poses under randomly sampled rotations. Experiments on ShapeNet and Pix3D show competitive performance against pose-supervised methods despite using far less supervision.
2005.01939|v2.assessment: 将循环一致性从形状扩展到形状-位姿联合空间是较优雅的自监督设计，对无标注3D感知有参考价值，但任务偏物体级重建，与自动驾驶场景级感知距离较远。
2005.01939|v2.contribution: 提出在无位姿标注下联合自监督学习单视图3D点云重建与相机位姿估计的框架。
2005.01939|v2.innovation: 通过随机位姿旋转点云并在3D重建与位姿上同时施加循环一致性，将几何推理显式注入自监督训练。
2005.01939|v2.result: 在ShapeNet和Pix3D上以更少监督达到与位姿监督方法相当的重建精度。

2003.13951|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中卷积感受野受限、遮挡与非刚性运动导致精度不足的问题，提出自注意力模块与离散视差预测两项改进。自注意力使非连续区域能够推断相似视差值，离散视差预测则将回归问题转化为分类式预测以提升精度。方法在KITTI自监督单目设定下取得当时领先的深度估计结果，并验证了各模块的有效性。
2003.13951|v2.summary_en: This work targets self-supervised monocular depth estimation and proposes two improvements: self-attention to capture non-local context for inferring similar disparities at non-contiguous regions, and discrete disparity prediction to replace continuous regression. Trained on monocular videos without ground truth, the method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among self-supervised approaches on KITTI. Ablations confirm the contribution of each component.
2003.13951|v2.assessment: 自注意力与离散视差体这两点后来被广泛沿用，是自监督单目深度方向较有影响力的工作，对BEV/3D感知的深度前端有直接借鉴意义。
2003.13951|v2.contribution: 将自注意力与离散视差预测引入自监督单目深度估计框架。
2003.13951|v2.innovation: 用自注意力建模非局部上下文，并用离散视差分类替代连续回归以提升深度精度。
2003.13951|v2.result: 在KITTI自监督单目深度基准上取得当时最优精度。

3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中训练信号不足与尺度模糊问题，提出3D Packing方法，通过将相邻帧的3D点云在训练时进行显式对齐与打包，构造更强的几何自监督信号。方法在标准单目视频训练设定下显著提升了深度估计精度，并在KITTI上取得当时自监督方法的最优结果，同时展示了跨数据集泛化能力。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.summary_en: This paper addresses the weak supervision and scale ambiguity in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by introducing 3D Packing, which explicitly aligns and packs 3D point clouds from neighboring frames to form stronger geometric self-supervision. It achieves state-of-the-art self-supervised depth accuracy on KITTI and demonstrates improved cross-dataset generalization.
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.assessment: 3D Packing是自监督单目深度领域的代表性工作，其利用多帧点云一致性的思路对自动驾驶深度估计与BEV感知均有启发。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.contribution: 提出3D Packing自监督信号，通过多帧3D点云对齐增强单目深度训练。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.innovation: 在训练中显式构造并打包相邻帧的3D点云以提供更强的几何监督。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.result: 在KITTI自监督单目深度基准上取得当时最优精度并提升跨数据集泛化。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular._arxiv_id: 3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2004.04143|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目场景流估计这一高度病态问题，提出从经典光流代价体出发、用单一CNN同时估计深度与3D运动的实时方法。采用自监督学习，结合3D损失函数与遮挡推理以利用无标注数据，并系统验证了代理损失与数据增强设计。在无监督/自监督单目场景流方法中达到最优精度，同时在光流与单目深度子任务上具有竞争力，半监督微调可进一步提升精度。
2004.04143|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles monocular scene flow estimation, a highly ill-posed problem, with a single CNN that jointly predicts depth and 3D motion from a classical optical flow cost volume. It adopts self-supervised learning with 3D losses and occlusion reasoning to exploit unlabeled data, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among unsupervised/self-supervised monocular scene flow methods with real-time performance. Semi-supervised fine-tuning further improves accuracy.
2004.04143|v2.assessment: 将场景流统一到光流代价体框架并保持实时性，对自动驾驶中运动与结构联合感知很有价值，自监督设定也便于规模化。
2004.04143|v2.contribution: 提出实时自监督单目场景流估计网络，从光流代价体联合估计深度与3D运动。
2004.04143|v2.innovation: 以逆问题视角统一深度与运动估计，并结合3D损失与遮挡推理实现自监督训练。
2004.04143|v2.result: 在自监督单目场景流方法中达到SOTA，光流与深度子任务具竞争力，半监督微调进一步提升精度。

On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计缺乏可靠不确定性度量的问题，系统研究了深度网络的不确定性建模方法。作者比较了多种不确定性估计策略，并提出适用于自监督设定的不确定性评估与校准方案，分析了不同损失与架构对不确定性的影响。实验表明所提方法能给出与真实误差相关的深度不确定性，并可用于提升下游任务可靠性。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.summary_en: This paper studies uncertainty estimation for self-supervised monocular depth estimation, which is critical for safety-relevant applications. It compares several uncertainty modeling strategies and proposes evaluation and calibration schemes tailored to the self-supervised setting, analyzing how losses and architectures affect uncertainty. Experiments show the estimated uncertainty correlates with actual depth errors and can improve downstream reliability.
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.assessment: 深度不确定性对自动驾驶安全至关重要，该工作填补了自监督深度估计中不确定性建模的空白，实用性强。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.contribution: 系统研究并提出了自监督单目深度估计中的不确定性建模与评估方法。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.innovation: 针对自监督训练设定设计不确定性估计与校准方案，并分析其与真实误差的相关性。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.result: 所估计的不确定性与实际深度误差良好相关，可提升下游任务可靠性。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo._arxiv_id: On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准导致定位误差大的问题，提出强化轴向细化网络（Reinforced Axial Refinement Network），通过强化学习策略在轴向上迭代细化3D框的位置与尺寸。方法将检测框回归建模为序列决策过程，利用奖励信号引导细化方向，从而在有限计算下逐步逼近真实3D框。在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的精度，验证了迭代细化策略的有效性。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses the large localization errors in monocular 3D object detection caused by inaccurate depth estimation, proposing a Reinforced Axial Refinement Network that iteratively refines 3D box positions and dimensions along axes via reinforcement learning. The box regression is cast as a sequential decision process guided by reward signals. Experiments on the KITTI monocular 3D detection benchmark demonstrate competitive accuracy and validate the iterative refinement strategy.
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.assessment: 将强化学习引入单目3D框细化是一个新颖角度，对缓解单目深度歧义有参考价值，但整体性能提升幅度与泛化性仍需更多验证。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.contribution: 提出基于强化学习的轴向迭代细化网络用于单目3D目标检测。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.innovation: 将3D框回归建模为序列决策过程，用奖励信号引导轴向逐步细化。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的精度。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for._arxiv_id: Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计与3D框回归耦合困难、不同距离目标表示不一致的问题，本文提出距离归一化的统一表示方法，将不同深度下的目标映射到统一特征空间进行检测。相比已有依赖绝对深度或分距离段建模的工作，该方法缓解了远距离目标性能骤降的问题。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的精度，尤其在远距离目标上提升明显。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistent representation of objects at varying depths in monocular 3D detection by proposing a distance-normalized unified representation that maps objects across depths into a shared feature space. Unlike prior methods relying on absolute depth or depth-binned modeling, it mitigates the severe performance degradation for distant objects. It achieves competitive accuracy on KITTI, with notable gains on far-range targets.
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.assessment: 该工作切中单目3D检测中距离泛化的核心痛点，统一表示思路对后续研究有借鉴意义。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.contribution: 提出距离归一化的统一表示以缓解单目3D检测中的距离偏差问题。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.innovation: 将不同深度目标映射到统一特征空间，替代传统的绝对深度或分段建模。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.result: 在KITTI上取得有竞争力精度，远距离目标检测性能显著提升。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati._arxiv_id: Distance-Normalized Unified Representation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Towards Generalization Across Depth for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测模型难以跨深度泛化、在训练分布外深度上性能下降的问题，本文提出面向深度泛化的检测框架，通过深度感知的特征建模与训练策略提升跨深度鲁棒性。相比已有方法在固定深度分布上过拟合，该工作强调泛化能力。实验表明在跨深度评测设置下精度优于基线。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor generalization of monocular 3D detectors across depth by proposing a depth-generalizable detection framework with depth-aware feature modeling and training strategies. In contrast to prior methods overfitting to fixed depth distributions, it emphasizes cross-depth robustness. Experiments show improved accuracy over baselines under cross-depth evaluation.
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.assessment: 关注跨深度泛化这一被忽视但关键的问题，对实际自动驾驶部署有参考价值。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.contribution: 提出面向跨深度泛化的单目3D检测框架。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.innovation: 以深度感知特征建模与训练策略提升模型在分布外深度上的鲁棒性。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.result: 在跨深度评测设置下精度优于基线方法。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for._arxiv_id: Towards Generalization Across Depth for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中2D图像特征与3D空间特征存在域差异、直接回归3D框困难的问题，本文提出特征域自适应方法，将2D特征对齐到3D检测所需的特征域。相比已有仅依赖几何约束的方法，该工作从特征分布层面缩小域差距。在KITTI上取得有竞争力的检测精度。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap between 2D image features and 3D spatial features in monocular 3D detection by proposing a feature domain adaptation method that aligns 2D features to the domain required for 3D detection. Unlike prior geometry-only approaches, it narrows the gap at the feature distribution level. It achieves competitive accuracy on KITTI.
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.assessment: 从域自适应角度切入单目3D检测，思路新颖但整体提升幅度有限。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.contribution: 提出特征域自适应以对齐2D图像特征与3D检测特征域。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.innovation: 将域自适应引入单目3D检测的特征对齐问题。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.result: 在KITTI上取得有竞争力的检测精度。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur._arxiv_id: Monocular 3D Object Detection via Feature Domain Adaptation.

Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.summary_cn: 针对伪LiDAR表示在单目3D检测中被认为不可或缺的假设，本文重新审视其本质，指出伪LiDAR的收益主要来自坐标变换而非点云表示本身。作者提出一种更简洁的表示方法，在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算开销。实验表明该方法在KITTI上达到与伪LiDAR相当甚至更优的精度，同时推理速度显著提升。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.summary_en: This paper rethinks the pseudo-LiDAR representation for monocular 3D detection, arguing that its gains stem mainly from coordinate transformation rather than the point-cloud representation itself. The authors propose a simpler representation that maintains accuracy while greatly reducing computation. Experiments show comparable or better accuracy on KITTI with substantially faster inference.
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.assessment: 对伪LiDAR范式的深刻反思，结论对领域有重要启发，值得关注。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.contribution: 揭示伪LiDAR收益来源并提出更高效的替代表示。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.innovation: 证明坐标变换而非点云表示是伪LiDAR有效的关键。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.result: 在KITTI上精度相当或更优，推理速度显著提升。

Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.summary_cn: 针对伪LiDAR方法中深度估计精度不足导致3D检测性能受限的问题，本文提出Pseudo-LiDAR++，通过改进的立体深度估计与稀疏深度点校正提升深度精度。相比原始伪LiDAR，该方法显著提高了远距离目标的深度质量。在KITTI上，3D检测精度大幅提升，远距离目标提升尤为明显。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited depth accuracy in pseudo-LiDAR pipelines by proposing Pseudo-LiDAR++, which improves stereo depth estimation and corrects it with sparse depth points. Compared to the original pseudo-LiDAR, it substantially improves depth quality for distant objects. On KITTI, it achieves large 3D detection gains, especially for far-range targets.
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.assessment: 伪LiDAR方向的里程碑工作，深度校正思路实用且效果显著。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.contribution: 提出Pseudo-LiDAR++通过改进深度估计提升单目3D检测精度。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.innovation: 结合立体深度与稀疏深度点校正提升远距离深度质量。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.result: 在KITTI上3D检测精度大幅提升，远距离目标提升尤为明显。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Object Detection in Autonomous Driving.

Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中边界模糊、物体内部深度不一致的问题，本文提出语义引导的表示学习方法，利用语义分割信息约束深度学习的特征表示。相比纯光度一致性损失的方法，该工作引入语义先验提升深度边界质量。实验表明在KITTI深度基准上精度提升，边界更锐利。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.summary_en: This paper addresses blurred boundaries and inconsistent intra-object depth in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing a semantically-guided representation learning method that leverages semantic segmentation to constrain depth features. Unlike pure photometric-consistency approaches, it introduces semantic priors to improve depth boundaries. Experiments show improved accuracy and sharper boundaries on KITTI.
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.assessment: 语义引导思路对自监督深度估计有实用价值，可迁移至BEV与3D检测。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.contribution: 提出语义引导的表示学习以提升自监督单目深度估计质量。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.innovation: 利用语义分割先验约束深度特征表示，改善边界质量。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.result: 在KITTI深度基准上精度提升，深度边界更锐利。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn._arxiv_id: Semantically-Guided Representation Learning for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth.

2010.13118|v2.summary_cn: 单目深度估计通常被当作回归问题处理，但许多应用真正关心的是物体间的相对远近关系。本文提出用 listwise ranking 替代 pairwise ranking，基于 Plackett-Luce 模型对整幅图像中的深度排序建模，并结合现代网络结构与采样策略降低训练复杂度。借助 PL 作为随机效用模型的表示，该方法还能从仅含排序信息的训练数据中恢复 shift-invariant 的度量深度。在多个基准数据集上的 zero-shot 评测中验证了该排序范式的有效性。
2010.13118|v2.summary_en: Monocular depth estimation is typically cast as regression, yet many applications only require relative depth ordering. This paper generalizes pairwise ranking to listwise ranking using the Plackett-Luce model, combined with a modern network architecture and a sampling strategy to reduce training complexity. Exploiting the random utility interpretation of PL, the predictor also recovers shift-invariant metric depth from ranking-only supervision, and is evaluated zero-shot on several benchmarks.
2010.13118|v2.assessment: 将 listwise ranking 引入单目深度估计是一个有新意的视角，对关注相对深度与排序监督的研究者有参考价值，但与 3D 检测主线的直接关联有限。
2010.13118|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Plackett-Luce 模型的 listwise ranking 单目深度估计框架，并支持从排序监督恢复度量深度。
2010.13118|v2.innovation: 把 pairwise 深度比较推广到 listwise 排序，并利用 PL 的随机效用表示实现 shift-invariant 度量深度恢复。
2010.13118|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上以 zero-shot 方式验证了 listwise ranking 相对回归与 pairwise 方法的优势。

2105.14021|v2.summary_cn: 现有单目深度估计网络输出的深度图分辨率通常不足一兆像素，缺乏高频细节，限制了实际可用性。作者分析了输入分辨率与场景结构对深度估计的影响，发现一致的整体结构与高频细节之间存在权衡。为此提出内容自适应的多分辨率融合方法：用双估计策略改善整图深度，用 patch 选择策略补充局部细节，并训练一个简单的融合网络。基于预训练模型即可生成多兆像素、细节丰富的深度图。
2105.14021|v2.summary_en: Monocular depth networks typically produce sub-megapixel depth maps lacking fine details. This work analyzes the trade-off between consistent scene structure and high-frequency detail as a function of input resolution, and proposes content-adaptive multi-resolution merging with a double estimation scheme for whole-image depth and a patch selection scheme for local detail. Using a pre-trained model, it generates multi-megapixel depth maps with rich detail.
2105.14021|v2.assessment: 面向高分辨率深度图生成的实用工作，方法简单有效，对需要精细深度先验的下游感知任务有借鉴意义。
2105.14021|v2.contribution: 提出内容自适应的多分辨率融合框架，将单目深度估计提升到多兆像素分辨率。
2105.14021|v2.innovation: 揭示分辨率与场景结构之间的权衡，并用双估计加 patch 选择的两阶段策略同时兼顾全局一致性与局部细节。
2105.14021|v2.result: 仅依赖预训练模型即可生成多兆像素且细节丰富的高质量深度图。

Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.summary_cn: 该论文研究如何利用时序光照线索进行单目 3D 目标检测，摘要信息缺失，无法确认具体方法细节。从标题看，其核心思路是借助主动或时序变化的光照（如门控成像）为单目图像提供额外的深度/几何线索，从而缓解单目 3D 检测中深度歧义的问题。由于缺少摘要，无法引用具体实验数据与改进幅度。

Specific methods and quantitative results cannot be verified without the abstract.

Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.innovation: 把门控/时序光照信息作为单目 3D 检测的额外几何线索来源。

Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F._arxiv_id: Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection From Temporal Illumination Cues.

AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.summary_cn: 该论文关注实时且形状感知的单目 3D 目标检测，摘要缺失，无法确认具体技术路线。从标题推断，其目标是在保持实时推理速度的前提下，引入对目标形状的建模以提升单目 3D 框估计精度，可能涉及形状先验或关键点/网格表示。由于缺少摘要，无法给出方法细节与定量结果。
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.summary_en: This paper targets real-time shape-aware monocular 3D object detection, but the abstract is unavailable. Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目 3D 目标检测中的深度估计不确定性问题，摘要缺失，无法确认完整方法。从标题看，其核心是提出几何不确定性投影网络（Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network），将深度预测的不确定性显式建模并投影到 3D 框估计中，以缓解单目深度歧义带来的误差传播。由于缺少摘要，无法引用具体数据集与精度提升数据。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.summary_en: This paper addresses uncertainty in monocular 3D object detection, though the abstract is unavailable. The title indicates a Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network that explicitly models depth uncertainty and projects it into 3D box estimation to mitigate error propagation from monocular depth ambiguity. Specific datasets and accuracy gains cannot be cited without the abstract.
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.assessment: 不确定性建模是单目 3D 检测中较有潜力的方向，若方法设计合理，对提升深度估计鲁棒性有实际意义，但需看到完整摘要才能判断其贡献强度。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.contribution: 提出几何不确定性投影网络，将深度不确定性显式引入单目 3D 目标检测。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.innovation: 对深度预测的不确定性进行建模并投影到 3D 框回归中，以抑制误差传播。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。

Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.summary_cn: 该论文直接质疑伪激光雷达（pseudo-LiDAR）在单目 3D 目标检测中的必要性，摘要缺失，无法确认具体论证与实验设置。从标题推断，作者可能通过实验表明仅依赖图像特征、无需显式深度转点云的方案即可达到甚至超越伪激光雷达方法的精度，从而挑战该主流范式。由于缺少摘要，无法引用具体数据集与精度对比数据。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.summary_en: This paper questions whether pseudo-LiDAR is necessary for monocular 3D object detection, though the abstract is unavailable. The title suggests that image-only approaches without explicit depth-to-point-cloud conversion can match or surpass pseudo-LiDAR pipelines, challenging the dominant paradigm. Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。

Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确的问题，论文提出基于几何的距离分解方法，将物体深度分解为多个几何分量进行分别预测。该方法利用物体尺寸、朝向和图像位置等几何线索，避免了直接回归深度带来的歧义性。相比已有工作，分解策略降低了深度估计的耦合难度，在KITTI等基准上取得了显著的精度提升。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a geometry-based distance decomposition method that decomposes object depth into multiple geometric components for separate prediction. It leverages geometric cues such as object size, orientation, and image position to avoid the ambiguity of direct depth regression. Compared to existing work, the decomposition strategy reduces the coupling difficulty of depth estimation and achieves significant accuracy improvements on benchmarks like KITTI.
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.assessment: 该工作从几何角度重新思考单目深度估计，思路清晰且实用，对单目3D检测领域有较强参考价值。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.contribution: 提出基于几何的距离分解框架，将深度预测解耦为多个可学习的几何分量。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.innovation: 利用物体几何先验将深度分解为尺寸、朝向和位置相关的子问题，降低回归歧义。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得了显著的精度提升。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo._arxiv_id: Geometry-based Distance Decomposition for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.summary_cn: 针对伪LiDAR方法在单目3D检测中置信度估计不足的问题，论文分析了伪点云深度不确定性对检测的影响。提出在伪LiDAR流程中引入置信度建模，使检测器能够感知深度估计的可靠性。相比已有工作，该方法改善了因深度噪声导致的误检和漏检，在KITTI上提升了检测精度。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient confidence estimation in pseudo-LiDAR methods for monocular 3D object detection by analyzing the impact of depth uncertainty in pseudo point clouds. It proposes incorporating confidence modeling into the pseudo-LiDAR pipeline so that the detector can be aware of depth estimation reliability. Compared to existing work, this approach reduces false positives and misses caused by depth noise, improving detection accuracy on KITTI.
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.assessment: 该工作揭示了伪LiDAR方法中被忽视的置信度问题，为单目3D检测的鲁棒性提供了新视角。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.contribution: 在伪LiDAR流程中引入置信度建模，提升深度不确定性下的检测鲁棒性。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.innovation: 首次系统分析并解决伪LiDAR方法中置信度缺失的问题。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.result: 在KITTI基准上提升了单目3D检测精度。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA._arxiv_id: Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDAR Methods for Monocular 3D Object Detection?

The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中外观特征与定位特征相互独立、未能充分利用的问题，论文提出互惠外观-定位特征提取方法。该方法通过交互式设计让外观和定位分支相互增强，从而更准确地估计物体3D属性。相比已有工作，互惠机制显著提升了特征表达能力，在KITTI上取得了领先的检测性能。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that appearance and localization features are treated independently in monocular 3D detection, failing to fully exploit their complementarity. It proposes a reciprocal appearance-localization feature extraction method where the two branches mutually enhance each other for more accurate 3D attribute estimation. Compared to existing work, the reciprocal mechanism significantly improves feature representation and achieves leading detection performance on KITTI.
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.assessment: 该工作抓住了单目3D检测中外观与定位特征协同的关键问题，方法设计巧妙，实验充分。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.contribution: 提出互惠外观-定位特征提取框架，实现两分支的相互增强。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.innovation: 通过交互式特征设计打破外观与定位分支的独立性，提升3D属性估计精度。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得了领先性能。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec._arxiv_id: The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Reciprocal Appearance-Localization Features for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.summary_cn: 针对移动设备上实时且准确的自监督单目深度估计需求，论文提出了一种轻量化网络与训练策略。方法通过自监督学习避免了对深度标注的依赖，并针对移动端算力进行优化。相比已有工作，在保持实时性的同时提升了深度估计精度，在移动设备上实现了可用的性能。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.summary_en: This paper targets real-time and accurate self-supervised monocular depth estimation on mobile devices by proposing a lightweight network and training strategy. The method avoids reliance on depth annotations through self-supervised learning and is optimized for mobile computational constraints. Compared to existing work, it improves depth estimation accuracy while maintaining real-time performance on mobile devices.
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.assessment: 该工作关注移动端部署的实际需求，对自监督深度估计的落地有参考意义，但创新性相对有限。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.contribution: 提出面向移动设备的实时自监督单目深度估计方案。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.innovation: 结合轻量化网络设计与自监督训练，在移动端实现实时深度估计。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.result: 在移动设备上实现了实时且较准确的深度估计。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M._arxiv_id: Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation on Mobile Device.

Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准的问题，本文提出维度嵌入（Dimension Embeddings）来改进物体尺寸与深度的联合建模。方法通过将物体物理维度编码为嵌入向量，辅助网络更准确地回归3D框的尺寸和位置。相比已有工作，该方法显式建模了物体维度先验，缓解了单目图像中尺寸-深度耦合带来的歧义。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection by introducing dimension embeddings that encode object physical dimensions to aid joint size and depth regression. The method explicitly models dimension priors to alleviate size-depth ambiguity in monocular images. It achieves competitive results on benchmarks such as KITTI, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.assessment: 维度先验的显式建模思路对单目3D检测有参考价值，但需关注其与后续深度解耦方法的对比。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.contribution: 提出维度嵌入模块，将物体物理尺寸编码为嵌入向量以辅助单目3D检测的尺寸与深度回归。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.innovation: 显式建模物体维度先验，缓解单目图像中尺寸与深度的耦合歧义。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得有竞争力的检测精度。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2207.10047|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计依赖少量垂直边投影约束、深度候选不足的问题，本文提出DCD（Densely Constrained Detector），利用任意方向边缘的稠密投影约束生成大量深度候选。方法引入图匹配加权模块来融合深度候选，从而获得更准确的深度估计。相比仅使用垂直边的已有方法，DCD在KITTI和WOD基准上达到state-of-the-art性能，代码已开源。
2207.10047|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited depth candidates in monocular 3D detection caused by using only vertical edge projection constraints. It proposes DCD (Densely Constrained Detector), which exploits dense projection constraints from edges of any direction to generate abundant depth candidates, and introduces a graph matching weighting module to merge them. DCD achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI and WOD benchmarks.
2207.10047|v2.assessment: 稠密投影约束与图匹配加权是深度候选融合的有效改进，KITTI/WOD双榜SOTA且开源，值得关注。
2207.10047|v2.contribution: 提出利用任意方向边缘稠密投影约束生成大量深度候选的单目3D检测器DCD。
2207.10047|v2.innovation: 突破仅用垂直边的限制，引入图匹配加权模块融合稠密深度候选。

Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测标注成本高、监督信号有限的问题，本文提出基于多视图一致性的半监督单目3D检测方法。方法利用同一场景不同视角图像之间的几何一致性作为自监督信号，在少量标注数据下联合训练检测器。相比纯监督方法，该方法在标注稀缺时显著提升检测性能，为降低单目3D检测标注依赖提供了新思路。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost in monocular 3D detection by proposing a semi-supervised framework based on multi-view consistency. It leverages geometric consistency across different views of the same scene as self-supervision to train the detector with limited labeled data. The method significantly improves detection performance under scarce annotations, offering a new direction to reduce labeling dependency.
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.assessment: 多视图一致性作为半监督信号思路新颖，对降低单目3D检测标注成本有实际意义。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出基于多视图一致性的半监督单目3D检测框架。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.innovation: 利用跨视角几何一致性作为自监督信号，减少对3D框标注的依赖。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.result: 在标注稀缺条件下显著提升单目3D检测性能。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Detection by Multi-view Consistency.

2104.09035|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中人工标注3D框成本高昂的问题，本文发现精确标注并非必要——使用随机扰动的粗略标签即可达到接近真值标签的精度，且3D位置部分对标签精度最为敏感。基于此，提出LPCG框架，利用未标注LiDAR点云生成伪标签来训练单目检测器。该方法既能降低标注成本，又能在不增加标注开销的情况下显著提升检测精度。
2104.09035|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the expensive manual 3D box annotation in monocular 3D detection by showing that precise labels are unnecessary—roughly perturbed labels yield accuracy close to ground-truth, with the 3D location part being most sensitive. It proposes LPCG, a framework that generates pseudo labels from unlabeled LiDAR point clouds to train the monocular detector. LPCG reduces annotation cost and boosts accuracy without extra labeling overhead.
2104.09035|v2.assessment: 反直觉发现（粗略标签足够）与LiDAR引导伪标签结合，对降低标注成本有重要实用价值。
2104.09035|v2.contribution: 提出LiDAR点云引导的单目3D检测框架LPCG，用未标注LiDAR生成伪标签。
2104.09035|v2.innovation: 发现3D位置是标签精度关键，并利用LiDAR精确测量生成伪标签替代人工标注。
2104.09035|v2.result: 在不增加标注成本下显著提升检测精度，或大幅降低标注成本。

2207.08531|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中实例深度难以直接学习的问题，本文指出RGB图像上的实例深度由视觉深度线索和实例属性线索耦合而成，非直观。为此提出DID-M3D，将实例深度解耦为视觉表面深度（与外观和位置相关）和属性深度（与物体固有属性相关，对仿射变换不变），并将3D位置不确定性相应解耦为两类。通过组合不同深度及不确定性得到最终实例深度，并设计了相应数据增强。在KITTI上取得领先性能。
2207.08531|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of directly learning instance depth in monocular 3D detection, pointing out that depth on RGB images is coupled by visual depth cues and instance attribute cues. It proposes DID-M3D, which decouples instance depth into visual surface depth and attribute depth, and correspondingly decouples 3D location uncertainty. The final depth is obtained by combining these depths and uncertainties, with tailored data augmentation, achieving leading performance on KITTI.
2207.08531|v2.assessment: 深度解耦建模思路清晰，对单目3D检测的深度估计问题提供了有原则的分解，KITTI表现领先。
2207.08531|v2.contribution: 提出DID-M3D，将实例深度解耦为视觉表面深度和属性深度并联合不确定性建模。
2207.08531|v2.innovation: 将实例深度及其不确定性解耦为视觉与属性两部分，解决深度非直观难学问题。
2207.08531|v2.result: 在KITTI基准上取得领先的单目3D检测性能。

2207.12988|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目图像无法提供绝对深度线索的难题，本文受双目方法启发，利用相机自运动提供的强几何结构进行精确深度估计与3D检测。作者对双视图情形进行理论分析，指出累积误差和静态相机/匹配歧义两大挑战，进而构建几何感知代价体建立立体对应，并用单目理解补偿。提出Depth from Motion（DfM）框架，将2D特征提升至3D空间检测，并给出无位姿版本。在多个基准上大幅超越state-of-the-art。
2207.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of absolute depth cues in monocular images by exploiting the strong geometry from camera ego-motion, inspired by binocular methods. It provides a theoretical analysis of the two-view case, identifying cumulative errors and static-camera/matching ambiguity as key challenges, and builds a geometry-aware cost volume with monocular compensation. The proposed Depth from Motion (DfM) framework lifts 2D features to 3D for detection, with a pose-free variant, outperforming state-of-the-art by a large margin.
2207.12988|v2.assessment: 理论分析与几何代价体设计扎实，利用自运动几何大幅提升单目3D检测，是重要进展。
2207.12988|v2.contribution: 提出Depth from Motion框架，利用相机自运动几何构建代价体实现单目3D检测。
2207.12988|v2.innovation: 将双目几何思想引入单目自运动场景，用几何感知代价体替代直接深度回归并补偿单目理解。
2207.12988|v2.result: 在多个基准上大幅超越state-of-the-art方法。

2203.14956|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对不同LiDAR线束导致的数据域差异问题，即高线束数据集训练的3D检测器难以直接应用于低线束量产传感器。提出LiDAR Distillation渐进式框架：每次迭代先对高线束点云降采样生成低线束伪LiDAR，再通过teacher-student蒸馏从高线束数据中迁移丰富信息，核心是训练时对齐源域与目标域的点云密度。在Waymo、nuScenes和KITTI上使用三种LiDAR检测器验证，有效缩小了beam-induced域差距，性能优于现有域自适应3D检测方法。
2203.14956|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the beam-induced domain gap in LiDAR-based 3D object detection, where detectors trained on high-beam datasets degrade on low-beam sensors common in production vehicles. It proposes LiDAR Distillation, a progressive teacher-student framework that downsamples high-beam point clouds to generate low-beam pseudo LiDAR and distills rich information while aligning point cloud density between source and target domains. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and KITTI with three detectors demonstrate effective mitigation of the beam-induced domain shift, outperforming prior domain adaptive 3D detection methods.
2203.14956|v2.assessment: 面向量产传感器与公开数据集线束不匹配的实际痛点，方法简洁有效，跨数据集跨检测器验证充分，对自动驾驶3D检测落地有直接参考价值。
2203.14956|v2.contribution: 提出通过点云密度对齐与teacher-student蒸馏来弥合LiDAR线束域差距的渐进式框架。
2203.14956|v2.innovation: 发现训练时对齐源域与目标域点云密度是关键，并据此设计降采样伪LiDAR蒸馏流程。
2203.14956|v2.result: 在Waymo、nuScenes、KITTI上以三种检测器验证，显著缓解线束引起的域偏移并超越现有域自适应方法。

2207.11984|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对自监督单目深度估计模型在固定分辨率训练后难以适应其他分辨率、性能严重下降的问题。提出RA-Depth，通过学习场景深度的尺度不变性实现分辨率自适应：设计简单高效的数据增强生成同一场景的任意尺度图像，构建多路径编解码器密集交互的双高分辨率网络聚合多尺度特征，并引入跨尺度深度一致性损失显式学习尺度不变性。在KITTI、Make3D和NYU-V2上达到SOTA并展现良好的分辨率自适应能力。
2207.11984|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the severe performance degradation of self-supervised monocular depth estimation when a model trained at a fixed resolution is evaluated at other resolutions. RA-Depth learns scale invariance of scene depth via an efficient data augmentation generating arbitrary-scale images, a dual high-resolution network with multi-path encoder-decoder and dense interactions, and a cross-scale depth consistency loss. It achieves state-of-the-art results on KITTI, Make3D, and NYU-V2 with strong resolution adaptation ability.
2207.11984|v2.assessment: 分辨率自适应是自监督深度估计中被忽视但实际重要的问题，方法设计合理，多数据集验证充分，对多分辨率部署有参考意义。
2207.11984|v2.contribution: 提出学习场景深度尺度不变性的分辨率自适应自监督单目深度估计方法RA-Depth。
2207.11984|v2.innovation: 结合任意尺度数据增强、双高分辨率多路径网络与跨尺度深度一致性损失来显式建模尺度不变性。
2207.11984|v2.result: 在KITTI、Make3D、NYU-V2上取得SOTA并具备良好的跨分辨率泛化能力。

2208.10762|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对度量深度估计依赖大量带度量标签数据的问题，提出将度量深度图分解为归一化深度图与尺度特征的算法。网络由共享编码器和G-Net、N-Net、M-Net三个解码器组成，分别估计梯度图、归一化深度图和度量深度图，M-Net利用G-Net和N-Net提取的相对深度特征更准确地估计度量深度。该方法可利用无度量深度标签的数据集提升度量深度估计性能，在多个数据集上取得与SOTA相当的结果，且在仅有少量度量深度数据时仍表现可接受。
2208.10762|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance of metric depth estimation on large amounts of metric-labeled data by decomposing a metric depth map into a normalized depth map and scale features. The network comprises a shared encoder and three decoders (G-Net, N-Net, M-Net) estimating gradient maps, normalized depth, and metric depth, with M-Net leveraging relative depth features for accurate metric estimation. It achieves competitive performance to state-of-the-art and remains acceptable with only limited metric depth data.
2208.10762|v2.assessment: 通过深度分解解耦相对与度量信息，思路清晰，能利用无度量标签数据，对降低深度估计标注成本有实用价值。
2208.10762|v2.contribution: 提出将度量深度分解为归一化深度与尺度特征的三解码器单目深度估计算法。
2208.10762|v2.innovation: 用G-Net和N-Net提取的相对深度特征辅助M-Net估计度量深度，从而可利用无度量标签数据。
2208.10762|v2.result: 在多个数据集上达到与SOTA相当的性能，且在少量度量深度数据下仍可接受。

2207.04718|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对基于深度学习的单目深度估计（纯视觉自动驾驶关键组件）的物理攻击问题，提出基于优化的物理对抗贴片攻击方法。通过面向对象的对抗设计、敏感区域定位和自然风格伪装来平衡攻击的隐蔽性与有效性，生成针对不同目标物体和模型的隐蔽、有效且鲁棒的对抗贴片。在真实驾驶场景中对多种MDE模型及下游3D目标检测评估，以占车尾1/9面积的贴片实现超过6米平均深度误差和93%的检测攻击成功率，并在三条真实路线的实车测试中复现该效果。
2207.04718|v2.summary_en: This paper develops a physical adversarial patch attack against learning-based monocular depth estimation, a critical component of vision-based autonomous driving. Using optimization-based generation with object-oriented adversarial design, sensitive region localization, and natural style camouflage, it produces stealthy, effective, and robust patches. Experiments on real driving scenarios and a downstream 3D detection task achieve over 6 m mean depth error and 93% attack success rate with a patch covering 1/9 of the vehicle rear, validated in real-vehicle field tests.
2207.04718|v2.assessment: 揭示了纯视觉自动驾驶中MDE的安全脆弱性，攻击方法兼顾隐蔽性与有效性并有实车验证，对感知安全研究有重要警示价值。
2207.04718|v2.contribution: 提出针对单目深度估计的隐蔽物理对抗贴片攻击方法并验证其对下游3D检测的威胁。
2207.04718|v2.innovation: 结合面向对象对抗设计、敏感区域定位与自然风格伪装，在隐蔽性与攻击有效性间取得平衡。
2207.04718|v2.result: 以1/9车尾面积贴片实现超6米平均深度误差与93%检测攻击成功率，并在实车测试中复现。

2208.02005|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对单目深度估计中移动物体、反射材质等图像上下文扰动易导致错误预测的问题，提出为每个像素提供不确定性估计，这对自动驾驶等安全关键应用尤为重要。方法是一种事后（post hoc）不确定性估计方法，针对已训练固定的深度网络，利用辅助损失函数提取梯度来估计不确定性；为避免依赖真值，辅助损失基于图像与其水平翻转对应深度预测的一致性。在KITTI和NYU Depth V2上无需重新训练即达到SOTA不确定性估计结果，代码与模型已开源。
2208.02005|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for per-pixel uncertainty estimation in monocular depth estimation, where disturbances such as moving objects or reflective materials cause erroneous predictions in safety-critical applications like automated driving. It proposes a post hoc uncertainty estimation approach for a fixed, already-trained depth network, using gradients extracted via an auxiliary loss based on the consistency between depth predictions of an image and its horizontally flipped counterpart, avoiding ground-truth dependence. It achieves state-of-the-art uncertainty estimation on KITTI and NYU Depth V2 without retraining.
2208.02005|v2.assessment: 事后不确定性估计无需重训即可为已有深度模型提供逐像素置信度，实用性强，对安全关键的自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
2208.02005|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度和翻转一致性辅助损失的即插即用单目深度估计不确定性估计方法。
2208.02005|v2.innovation: 利用图像与水平翻转对应深度预测的一致性定义辅助损失，无需真值且无需重新训练网络。
2208.02005|v2.result: 在KITTI和NYU Depth V2上无需重训即达到SOTA不确定性估计性能。

Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中语义引导表征学习不充分、语义与几何特征耦合不足的问题，本文提出一种综合表征增强框架，通过语义引导模块强化深度网络对场景结构的感知。方法上设计了多层次的语义-几何交互与表征增强机制，使深度预测能更好利用语义先验。相比已有语义引导自监督深度方法，改进点在于更全面地融合语义信息并缓解语义噪声干扰。摘要未提供具体量化结果，需参考正文实验验证其在KITTI等基准上的提升。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient representation learning in semantics-guided self-supervised monocular depth estimation, where semantic and geometric cues are not fully coupled. It proposes a comprehensive representation enhancement framework that strengthens semantic-geometric interaction to better exploit semantic priors for depth prediction. Compared with prior semantics-guided self-supervised methods, it more comprehensively fuses semantic information and mitigates semantic noise, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.assessment: 该工作关注自监督单目深度估计中的语义引导表征增强，思路对自动驾驶单目感知有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需看实验验证实际增益。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.contribution: 提出一种综合表征增强框架，用于语义引导的自监督单目深度估计。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.innovation: 通过多层次语义-几何交互机制更充分地融合语义先验并抑制语义噪声。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，效果需依据正文实验判断。
