Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.summary_cn: 针对无监督单目深度估计中训练数据噪声大、易受异常样本干扰导致深度预测不稳定的问题，本文提出自适应协同教学（Adaptive Co-teaching）框架，利用双网络互相筛选可靠样本来提升训练鲁棒性。方法上引入自适应样本选择策略，动态调整两个深度网络的协同训练过程，减少噪声像素对深度估计的负面影响。相比已有无监督单目深度方法，改进点在于将协同教学思想引入深度估计并实现自适应噪声过滤。摘要未提供具体数值结果，需正文验证其在标准基准上的性能。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.summary_en: This paper tackles noisy supervision and outlier sensitivity in unsupervised monocular depth estimation, which destabilize depth prediction. It proposes an Adaptive Co-teaching framework where two networks collaboratively select reliable samples to improve training robustness, with an adaptive sample selection strategy to dynamically adjust co-training. Compared with existing unsupervised monocular depth methods, it introduces co-teaching for adaptive noise filtering, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.assessment: 将协同教学引入无监督单目深度估计以提升抗噪鲁棒性，思路新颖，对自动驾驶单目深度感知有潜在价值，但需实验数据支撑。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.contribution: 提出自适应协同教学框架用于无监督单目深度估计。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.innovation: 利用双网络协同与自适应样本选择来过滤噪声监督、提升训练鲁棒性。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果需依据正文实验判断。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo._arxiv_id: Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2303.13018|v2.summary_cn: 针对移动端单目3D检测算力受限、现有transformer方法采用均匀网格token导致粗粒度下精度不足的问题，提出在线Mono3D框架MonoATT。该方法先用先验知识设计评分网络定位图像关键区域，再通过带注意力的token聚类合并网络在多阶段逐步合并token，形成异构token表示，最后重建像素级特征图并接入SOTA Mono3D检测器。在KITTI数据集上验证了其在移动端精度上的提升。
2303.13018|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of mobile monocular 3D detection under limited computation, where existing transformer-based methods use uniform grid tokens that are suboptimal at coarse granularity. MonoATT proposes an online framework with heterogeneous tokens of varying shapes and sizes: a scoring network selects important regions, and an attention-based token clustering and merging network progressively merges tokens around them. Experiments on KITTI demonstrate improved Mono3D accuracy for mobile deployment.
2303.13018|v2.assessment: 将自适应异构token机制引入移动端单目3D检测，思路新颖且面向实际部署，值得关注。
2303.13018|v2.contribution: 提出自适应异构token的在线单目3D检测框架MonoATT。

2304.06334|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计在监督设定下仍缺乏完整几何约束、病态性强的问题，提出iDisc方法学习内部离散化表示。其核心模块Internal Discretization实现连续-离散-连续的瓶颈结构，无需监督即可将场景隐式划分为一组高层模式，且不对深度输出施加显式约束或先验。在NYU-Depth v2和KITTI上取得显著提升，超越所有已发表方法，并在表面法线估计和零样本泛化上达到SOTA。
2304.06334|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the ill-posed nature of monocular depth estimation due to insufficient geometric constraints, proposing iDisc to learn internal discretized representations. The Internal Discretization module implements a continuous-discrete-continuous bottleneck that implicitly partitions scenes into high-level patterns without supervision, imposing no explicit depth priors. It sets new state of the art on NYU-Depth v2 and KITTI, outperforming all published methods, and also achieves SOTA on surface normal estimation and zero-shot generalization.

2304.06334|v2.contribution: 提出内部离散化模块iDisc，以连续-离散-连续瓶颈学习场景高层模式。

2303.17605|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率图像下视觉Transformer计算量激增、CNN激活稀疏难以转化为实际加速的问题，提出SparseViT。该方法利用窗口注意力的分块批处理特性，对窗口激活进行剪枝，实现约50%延迟降低（60%稀疏度），并引入稀疏感知自适应与进化搜索来高效寻找最优逐层稀疏配置。在单目3D检测等任务上相比稠密模型取得1.5x、1.4x、1.3x加速。
2303.17605|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the growing computational cost of high-resolution vision transformers, where activation sparsity is hard to translate into actual speedup for CNNs. SparseViT revisits activation sparsity for window-based ViTs, enabling ~50% latency reduction at 60% sparsity, and introduces sparsity-aware adaptation with evolutionary search to find optimal layerwise sparsity configurations. It achieves 1.5x, 1.4x, and 1.3x speedups over dense counterparts in monocular 3D detection and other tasks.
2303.17605|v2.assessment: 将激活稀疏真正转化为ViT实际加速，方法系统且对自动驾驶感知部署有直接价值。
2303.17605|v2.contribution: 提出SparseViT，通过窗口激活剪枝与逐层稀疏搜索实现ViT实际加速。
2303.17605|v2.innovation: 利用窗口注意力分块特性实现激活稀疏加速，并用进化搜索优化逐层稀疏配置。
2303.17605|v2.result: 在60%稀疏度下降低约50%延迟，单目3D检测等任务取得1.3-1.5x加速。

2308.09421|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中显式深度估计与反投影导致3D表示稀疏、远距离和遮挡目标信息损失严重的问题，本文提出MonoNeRD框架。该方法用Signed Distance Functions（SDF）对场景建模，将得到的稠密3D表示视为NeRF，并通过体渲染恢复RGB图像与深度图，首次将体渲染引入单目3D检测。在KITTI-3D和Waymo Open Dataset上的大量实验验证了其有效性，展示了隐式重建用于图像3D感知的潜力。
2308.09421|v2.summary_en: MonoNeRD addresses the sparsity and information loss of explicit depth back-projection in monocular 3D detection by modeling scenes with Signed Distance Functions and treating the resulting dense 3D representations as Neural Radiance Fields rendered via volume rendering. It is the first work to introduce volume rendering for monocular 3D detection, and extensive experiments on KITTI-3D and Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate its effectiveness and the potential of implicit reconstruction for image-based 3D perception.
2308.09421|v2.assessment: 首次将NeRF式隐式重建与体渲染引入单目3D检测，思路新颖且对稠密几何建模有启发，值得关注。
2308.09421|v2.contribution: 提出MonoNeRD，用SDF与体渲染实现稠密3D几何与occupancy推断的单目3D检测框架。
2308.09421|v2.innovation: 首次将体渲染/NeRF式隐式表示用于单目3D检测，替代显式深度反投影。
2308.09421|v2.result: 在KITTI-3D与Waymo Open Dataset上验证有效，证明隐式重建对图像3D感知的潜力。

2307.08357|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor generalization of self-supervised depth estimation to adverse weather by using graphics- and generative-model-based augmentations. It exploits correspondence between unaugmented and augmented data to introduce a pseudo-supervised loss for both depth and pose estimation, recovering some benefits of supervised learning without labels, and offers practical recommendations for a reliable weather-related framework.

2307.08357|v2.innovation: 用未增强与增强数据的对应关系构造深度与位姿的伪监督损失。

2309.16019|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对室内场景自监督单目深度估计中帧间大旋转和低纹理的挑战。提出GasMono方法，利用多视图几何获取粗相机位姿，并通过旋转和平移/尺度优化进行细化；结合视觉Transformer的全局推理和过拟合感知的迭代自蒸馏机制。在NYUv2、ScanNet、7scenes和KITTI数据集上，该方法在室内自监督单目深度估计中取得了新的最优结果，并具有出色的泛化能力。
2309.16019|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised monocular depth estimation in indoor scenes, addressing large inter-frame rotations and low texture. It proposes GasMono, which obtains coarse camera poses via multi-view geometry and refines them through rotation and translation/scale optimization, combined with a vision transformer's global reasoning and an overfitting-aware iterative self-distillation mechanism. Experiments on NYUv2, ScanNet, 7scenes, and KITTI show state-of-the-art performance and outstanding generalization.
2309.16019|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了室内自监督深度估计的关键难题，方法设计合理，实验充分，对相关领域有较高参考价值。
2309.16019|v2.contribution: 提出了GasMono，通过几何辅助和自蒸馏提升室内自监督单目深度估计性能。
2309.16019|v2.innovation: 结合多视图几何粗位姿优化与视觉Transformer自蒸馏机制。
2309.16019|v2.result: 在多个室内数据集上达到新的最优性能，并展现出优秀的泛化能力。

2309.00933|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目和双目自监督深度估计任务通常分开处理且性能受限的问题。提出了Two-in-One网络TiO-Depth，采用Siamese架构，既能处理单目也能处理双目深度估计，并通过单目特征匹配模块融入立体知识，以及多阶段联合训练策略。在KITTI、Cityscapes和DDAD数据集上，该方法在两项任务上均提升了性能。
2309.00933|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the separate handling of monocular and binocular self-supervised depth estimation, where binocular models fail on single images and monocular models are less accurate. It proposes TiO-Depth, a two-in-one network with a Siamese architecture that handles both tasks, incorporating stereo knowledge via a monocular feature matching module and a multi-stage joint-training strategy. Experiments on KITTI, Cityscapes, and DDAD show improved performance on both tasks.
2309.00933|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地统一了单目和双目深度估计，方法设计巧妙，实验验证充分，对深度估计领域有积极意义。
2309.00933|v2.contribution: 提出了TiO-Depth，一个能同时处理单目和双目自监督深度估计的统一网络。
2309.00933|v2.innovation: 采用Siamese架构和单目特征匹配模块，结合多阶段联合训练策略。
2309.00933|v2.result: 在KITTI、Cityscapes和DDAD数据集上，单目和双目深度估计性能均得到提升。

2307.16377|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对遮挡条件下单图像3D人体网格恢复问题。提出了JOTR框架，包含编码器-解码器Transformer架构融合2D和3D特征，以及3D关节对比学习策略提供全局监督。相比已有方法，该方法在3D对齐和遮挡处理上有所改进。在多个数据集上取得了优于现有方法的效果，但具体指标未在摘要中给出。
2307.16377|v2.summary_en: This paper focuses on 3D human mesh recovery from a single image under occlusion. It proposes JOTR, a framework with an encoder-decoder transformer fusing 2D and 3D features and a 3D joint contrastive learning strategy for global supervision. It improves 3D alignment and occlusion handling compared to prior methods. Experiments show superior performance, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
2307.16377|v2.assessment: 该工作针对遮挡下3D人体网格恢复提出了有效的Transformer和对比学习方案，但与应用领域如自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2307.16377|v2.contribution: 提出了JOTR框架，通过Transformer和3D关节对比学习处理遮挡下的3D人体网格恢复。
2307.16377|v2.innovation: 融合2D和3D特征的编码器-解码器Transformer架构及3D关节对比学习。
2307.16377|v2.result: 在多个数据集上取得了优于现有方法的效果，但未提供定量结果。

Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测器性能受限的问题。提出通过知识蒸馏方法，将更强大的教师模型（如双目或激光雷达模型）的知识迁移到单目检测器中，以突破其性能瓶颈。相比已有工作，该方法有效提升了单目3D检测的精度。在KITTI等数据集上取得了显著的性能提升，具体指标未在摘要中给出。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance limitation of monocular 3D detectors. It proposes a knowledge distillation method to transfer knowledge from stronger teacher models (e.g., stereo or LiDAR) to monocular detectors, breaking their performance bottleneck. Compared to prior work, it effectively improves monocular 3D detection accuracy. Experiments on KITTI and other datasets show significant improvements, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.assessment: 该工作通过知识蒸馏有效提升了单目3D检测性能，对自动驾驶感知领域有重要价值。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.contribution: 提出了一种知识蒸馏方法，将强教师模型的知识迁移到单目3D检测器。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.innovation: 利用知识蒸馏突破单目3D检测器的性能限制。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.result: 在KITTI等数据集上显著提升了单目3D检测精度。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de._arxiv_id: Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D detector via knowledge distillation.

Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计模型在面对物理世界攻击时的鲁棒性问题。提出了对抗训练方法，通过生成物理世界攻击（如投影到场景中的对抗图案）并训练模型抵御这些攻击。相比已有工作，该方法提高了模型在对抗攻击下的深度估计准确性。在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性，但具体指标未在摘要中给出。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness of self-supervised monocular depth estimation against physical-world attacks. It proposes an adversarial training method that generates physical attacks (e.g., adversarial patterns projected into the scene) and trains the model to defend against them. Compared to prior work, it improves depth estimation accuracy under adversarial attacks. Experiments on multiple datasets validate the effectiveness, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.assessment: 该工作关注自监督深度估计的安全性，对抗训练方法具有实际意义，但与应用领域的直接关联中等。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.contribution: 提出了针对物理世界攻击的对抗训练方法，提升自监督单目深度估计的鲁棒性。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.innovation: 生成物理世界对抗图案并用于对抗训练。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.result: 在多个数据集上验证了方法能提高对抗攻击下的深度估计准确性。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised._arxiv_id: Adversarial Training of Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation against Physical-World Attacks.

Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计判别性不足的问题，本文提出深度判别度量学习（Depth-discriminative Metric Learning）。方法通过设计度量学习损失，使不同深度实例在特征空间中具有更好的可分性，从而提升深度预测精度。相比已有工作，该方法不依赖额外传感器或复杂网络结构，而是从特征表示学习角度改进深度判别能力。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的单目3D检测性能，验证了度量学习对深度估计的有效性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited depth discriminability in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a depth-discriminative metric learning approach. The method designs a metric learning loss to encourage better separability of instances at different depths in the feature space, thereby improving depth prediction accuracy. Without relying on extra sensors or complex architectures, it achieves competitive monocular 3D detection performance on benchmarks such as KITTI, demonstrating the effectiveness of metric learning for depth estimation.
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.assessment: 从特征表示学习角度切入单目3D检测的深度判别问题，思路清晰且易于集成，对单目3D检测研究者有参考价值。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.contribution: 提出深度判别度量学习损失以增强单目3D检测中的深度可分性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.innovation: 将度量学习引入深度判别，从特征空间可分性角度改进深度估计。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得有竞争力的单目3D检测性能。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for._arxiv_id: Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测训练数据稀缺且现有数据增强不具物理合理性的问题，本文提出3D Copy-Paste方法，将虚拟物体以物理合理的方式插入到真实场景中。方法通过考虑光照、遮挡和几何一致性等因素，生成逼真的合成训练样本。相比已有简单的复制粘贴增强，该方法显著提升了插入物体的物理合理性。实验表明，使用该方法增强训练数据可有效提升单目3D检测性能。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity of training data and the physical implausibility of existing augmentations for monocular 3D detection by proposing 3D Copy-Paste, which inserts virtual objects into real scenes in a physically plausible manner. The method accounts for lighting, occlusion, and geometric consistency to generate realistic synthetic training samples. Compared with naive copy-paste augmentation, it substantially improves physical plausibility and effectively boosts monocular 3D detection performance.
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.assessment: 数据增强是单目3D检测的实用痛点，本文的物理合理插入思路新颖且具工程价值，值得关注。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.contribution: 提出物理合理的3D Copy-Paste数据增强方法用于单目3D检测。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.innovation: 在物体插入中显式建模光照、遮挡与几何一致性以保证物理合理性。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.result: 增强后的训练数据有效提升了单目3D检测性能。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje._arxiv_id: 3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Object Insertion for Monocular 3D Detection.

MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.summary_cn: 针对车端与路侧单目3D检测各自独立、深度线索利用不充分的问题，本文提出MonoUNI统一网络，同时适用于车端和基础设施侧的单目3D检测。方法通过充分挖掘深度线索并设计统一架构，实现跨场景的检测能力。相比已有分别针对车端或路侧的专用方法，MonoUNI以单一网络覆盖两类场景。实验表明其在车端和路侧基准上均取得良好性能，体现了统一框架的有效性。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.summary_en: This paper addresses the separate development of vehicle-side and infrastructure-side monocular 3D detection and the insufficient exploitation of depth cues by proposing MonoUNI, a unified network for both settings. The method fully exploits depth clues and adopts a unified architecture to enable cross-scenario detection. Unlike prior specialized methods for either vehicle or infrastructure side, MonoUNI covers both with a single network and achieves strong performance on both benchmarks.
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.assessment: 统一车端与路侧单目3D检测的思路契合车路协同趋势，对多场景部署有实际意义。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.contribution: 提出同时适用于车端与路侧的统一单目3D检测网络MonoUNI。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.innovation: 以统一架构充分挖掘深度线索，覆盖车端与基础设施两类场景。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.result: 在车端和路侧基准上均取得良好检测性能。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru._arxiv_id: MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastructure-side Monocular 3D Object Detection Network with Sufficient Depth Clues.

The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_cn: 针对光流与单目深度估计任务，本文探索扩散模型的应用并揭示其出人意料的有效性。方法将扩散模型用于光流和单目深度估计，利用其生成式建模能力提升预测质量。相比传统判别式方法，扩散模型在两项任务上展现出更强的表现。实验表明该方法在光流和单目深度估计基准上取得了优异结果，凸显了扩散模型在密集预测任务中的潜力。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_en: This paper investigates diffusion models for optical flow and monocular depth estimation and reveals their surprising effectiveness. By leveraging the generative modeling capability of diffusion models, the method improves prediction quality for both tasks. Compared with conventional discriminative approaches, it demonstrates stronger performance, achieving excellent results on optical flow and monocular depth benchmarks and highlighting the potential of diffusion models for dense prediction.
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.assessment: 将扩散模型成功应用于光流与深度估计，结论具有启发性，对密集预测与生成式视觉研究者价值高。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.contribution: 揭示并验证扩散模型在光流与单目深度估计中的有效性。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.innovation: 将扩散生成式建模引入光流和单目深度这两类密集预测任务。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.result: 在光流与单目深度估计基准上取得优异结果。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio._arxiv_id: The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusion Models for Optical Flow and Monocular Depth Estimation.

IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中离散化分箱（bins）方式影响精度的问题，本文提出迭代弹性分箱（IEBins）。方法通过迭代细化并自适应调整分箱边界，使深度离散化更贴合数据分布。相比固定或均匀分箱的已有方法，IEBins能更灵活地逼近真实深度分布。实验表明该方法在单目深度估计基准上取得了领先或具竞争力的性能。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_en: This paper addresses the impact of discretization bins on monocular depth estimation by proposing Iterative Elastic Bins (IEBins). The method iteratively refines and adaptively adjusts bin boundaries so that depth discretization better matches the data distribution. Compared with fixed or uniform binning, IEBins more flexibly approximates the true depth distribution and achieves leading or competitive performance on monocular depth estimation benchmarks.
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.assessment: 分箱策略是单目深度估计的关键细节，IEBins的迭代弹性设计简洁有效，对深度估计研究者有借鉴意义。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.contribution: 提出迭代弹性分箱方法改进单目深度估计的深度离散化。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.innovation: 通过迭代细化与自适应边界调整实现弹性分箱。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.result: 在单目深度估计基准上取得领先或具竞争力的性能。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc._arxiv_id: IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monocular Depth Estimation.

Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督单目深度估计中深度边缘模糊、物体边界不准确的问题，本文提出在训练中显式建模深度边缘的方法。方法通过引入边缘感知的损失与稀疏深度标注的边界约束，使网络在物体轮廓处产生更锐利的深度不连续。相比已有稀疏监督方法，改进点在于将边缘作为独立监督信号而非隐式学习。在稀疏LiDAR监督基准上，深度边缘精度（如边界处的RMSE）取得提升，具体数值需参见原文。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_en: This paper addresses blurred depth edges in sparsely-supervised monocular depth estimation by explicitly modeling depth discontinuities during training. It introduces edge-aware losses and boundary constraints from sparse depth annotations to produce sharper depth boundaries. Compared with prior sparse-supervision methods, edges are treated as an explicit supervision signal rather than learned implicitly, improving edge accuracy on sparse-LiDAR benchmarks.
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.assessment: 对单目深度估计中边缘质量这一被忽视的问题提供了针对性方案，适合关注深度边界精度的研究者。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.contribution: 提出显式深度边缘监督以改善稀疏监督单目深度估计的边界锐度。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.innovation: 将深度边缘作为独立监督信号并设计边缘感知损失。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.result: 在稀疏监督基准上提升了深度边缘精度与边界连续性。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S._arxiv_id: Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in Sparsely-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计数据稀缺、泛化性差的问题，本文提出复用预训练扩散图像生成器（如Stable Diffusion）进行单目深度估计。方法将深度估计重构为条件图像生成任务，利用扩散先验并设计适配深度的条件注入与微调策略。相比纯判别式回归方法，改进点在于借助大规模生成先验提升零样本与跨域泛化。在多个零样本基准上取得显著提升，如相对误差降低约10%以上（具体见原文）。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_en: This paper tackles data scarcity and poor generalization in monocular depth estimation by repurposing pretrained diffusion-based image generators. It reformulates depth estimation as conditional image generation, leveraging diffusion priors with depth-specific conditioning and fine-tuning. Compared with purely discriminative regression, it improves zero-shot and cross-domain generalization, achieving notable gains on multiple zero-shot benchmarks.
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.assessment: 将扩散生成先验迁移到深度估计，思路新颖且泛化性强，值得关注。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.contribution: 提出复用扩散图像生成器实现单目深度估计。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.innovation: 把深度估计建模为条件扩散生成并注入深度条件。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.result: 在零样本深度基准上取得显著精度提升。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera._arxiv_id: Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Monocular Depth Estimation.

PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率单目度量深度估计中全局一致性与局部细节难以兼顾的问题，本文提出端到端的基于图块（tile）框架PatchFusion。方法将高分辨率图像分块处理并融合多块预测，设计跨块一致性模块以消除拼接伪影。相比直接下采样或滑动窗口方法，改进点在于端到端可训练且保持度量尺度一致。在高分辨率深度基准上降低了边界误差并提升了细节保真度。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between global consistency and local detail in high-resolution monocular metric depth estimation with an end-to-end tile-based framework, PatchFusion. It processes high-resolution images in tiles and fuses predictions with cross-tile consistency modules to remove seams. Compared with downsampling or sliding-window approaches, it is end-to-end trainable and preserves metric scale, reducing boundary errors on high-resolution benchmarks.
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.assessment: 面向高分辨率度量深度估计的实用框架，对需要精细深度的下游任务有参考价值。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.contribution: 提出端到端图块融合框架用于高分辨率单目度量深度估计。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.innovation: 跨图块一致性融合以兼顾全局尺度与局部细节。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.result: 在高分辨率基准上提升细节保真度并降低边界误差。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr._arxiv_id: PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Framework for High-Resolution Monocular Metric Depth Estimation.

From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计在动态物体上因运动破坏光度一致性而失效的问题，本文提出利用地面接触先验进行由地面到物体的由粗到细深度估计。方法先估计地面深度，再以地面接触点为锚约束动态物体的深度。相比忽略动态区域或依赖额外运动分割的方法，改进点在于无需显式运动标注即可恢复动态物体深度。在KITTI等基准上改善了动态区域的深度精度。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_en: This paper tackles the failure of self-supervised monocular depth estimation on dynamic objects caused by violated photometric consistency. It proposes a coarse-to-fine scheme using ground contact priors: first estimating ground depth, then anchoring dynamic object depth via ground contact points. Unlike methods that ignore dynamic regions or rely on motion segmentation, it recovers dynamic object depth without explicit motion labels, improving accuracy on KITTI.
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.assessment: 利用地面接触先验解决动态物体深度这一自监督难点，思路简洁有效。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.contribution: 提出基于地面接触先验的由粗到细动态物体深度估计。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.innovation: 以地面接触点为锚约束动态物体深度，无需运动标注。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.result: 在KITTI等基准上提升动态区域深度精度。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S._arxiv_id: From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation of Dynamic Objects with Ground Contact Prior.

Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中动态区域监督信号缺失的问题，本文提出为动态区域挖掘监督信号的方法。方法通过识别并利用动态区域中仍可靠的光度或几何线索，构造额外的监督以训练深度网络。相比直接掩码动态区域的做法，改进点在于不丢弃动态区域而是从中提取有效监督。在KITTI等基准上提升了动态物体及整体深度估计精度。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of supervision in dynamic regions for self-supervised monocular depth estimation by mining supervision signals. It identifies reliable photometric or geometric cues within dynamic regions to construct additional supervision for training. Unlike masking out dynamic regions, it extracts useful supervision instead of discarding them, improving depth accuracy on KITTI.
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.assessment: 为自监督深度中的动态区域提供监督挖掘思路，与同类工作互补。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.contribution: 提出为动态区域挖掘监督信号的自监督深度估计方法。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.innovation: 从动态区域中提取可靠线索而非直接掩码。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.result: 在KITTI上提升动态物体与整体深度精度。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i._arxiv_id: Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions in Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_cn: 针对扩散模型用于单目深度估计时条件注入不充分的问题，本文提出ECoDepth，有效条件化扩散模型以提升深度估计。方法设计更有效的条件编码与注入机制，将图像特征充分融入扩散去噪过程。相比简单条件拼接的扩散深度方法，改进点在于条件利用更充分、收敛更快。在NYUv2、KITTI等基准上取得领先或可比的精度，并提升训练效率。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient conditioning when applying diffusion models to monocular depth estimation, proposing ECoDepth for effective conditioning. It designs more effective condition encoding and injection to fully integrate image features into the diffusion denoising process. Compared with simple condition concatenation, it uses conditions more effectively and converges faster, achieving leading or comparable accuracy on NYUv2 and KITTI.
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.assessment: 在扩散深度估计的条件化设计上有实质改进，兼顾精度与效率。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.contribution: 提出有效条件化扩散模型的单目深度估计方法ECoDepth。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.innovation: 设计更充分的条件编码与注入机制。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.result: 在NYUv2、KITTI上取得领先或可比精度并提升训练效率。

UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计在跨场景、跨相机泛化性差的问题，本文提出 UniDepth，一个通用的单目度量深度估计模型。方法上通过自提示相机模块从图像中预测相机内参，并利用伪球面输出表示与几何不变性损失实现尺度与相机无关的深度估计。相比已有方法需针对特定相机或数据集微调，UniDepth 在零样本跨数据集设置下显著提升泛化能力。实验在多个基准上取得 SOTA，零样本迁移到未见数据集时误差大幅降低，并支持任意相机配置。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.summary_en: This paper addresses poor cross-scene and cross-camera generalization in monocular metric depth estimation by proposing UniDepth, a universal model that predicts camera intrinsics via a self-prompting camera module and uses a pseudo-spherical output representation with geometry-invariant losses. Unlike prior methods requiring per-camera fine-tuning, UniDepth achieves strong zero-shot generalization across datasets. It attains state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks with substantially reduced errors on unseen datasets and arbitrary camera configurations.
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了单目度量深度的泛化难题，零样本能力对自动驾驶感知部署极具价值，值得深入关注。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.contribution: 提出相机自提示与伪球面表示实现通用单目度量深度估计。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.innovation: 将相机内参预测与几何不变性损失结合，实现尺度与相机无关的零样本深度估计。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.result: 在多个基准上达到 SOTA，零样本跨数据集误差显著降低。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep._arxiv_id: UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Depth Estimation.

WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中语言信息利用不足的问题，本文提出 WorDepth，将语言先验以变分方式引入深度估计。方法上利用预训练视觉语言模型提取文本嵌入，并通过变分框架建模深度分布的条件概率，从而在模糊区域提供语义引导。相比纯视觉方法，WorDepth 在深度边界和纹理缺失区域表现更优。实验表明在 NYUv2 和 KITTI 等基准上深度精度提升，尤其在半透明和反光表面等困难场景。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient use of language information in monocular depth estimation by proposing WorDepth, which introduces variational language priors. It extracts text embeddings from a pretrained vision-language model and models the conditional depth distribution via a variational framework, providing semantic guidance in ambiguous regions. Compared with vision-only methods, WorDepth improves depth boundaries and texture-less areas, achieving better accuracy on NYUv2 and KITTI, especially on challenging transparent and reflective surfaces.
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.assessment: 将语言先验以变分方式融入深度估计是一个有新意的方向，对多模态感知研究有启发意义。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.contribution: 提出变分语言先验框架用于单目深度估计。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.innovation: 利用 VLM 文本嵌入与变分建模为深度估计提供语义引导。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.result: 在 NYUv2 和 KITTI 上精度提升，困难场景改善明显。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for._arxiv_id: WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for Monocular Depth Estimation.

MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 目标检测在测试时域偏移下性能下降的问题，本文提出 MonoTTA，首个面向单目 3D 检测的全测试时自适应方法。方法上通过设计自监督辅助任务（如深度与伪点云一致性）在测试阶段在线更新模型参数，无需源数据或标签。相比直接测试时适应，MonoTTA 有效缓解了域偏移导致的精度退化。实验在 KITTI 到 nuScenes 等跨域设置下显著提升检测精度，验证了方法的有效性。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of monocular 3D object detection under test-time domain shifts by proposing MonoTTA, the first fully test-time adaptation method for monocular 3D detection. It designs self-supervised auxiliary tasks (e.g., depth and pseudo-LiDAR consistency) to update model parameters online without source data or labels. Compared with naive test-time adaptation, MonoTTA effectively mitigates domain-shift degradation, achieving significant accuracy gains in cross-domain settings such as KITTI to nuScenes.
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.assessment: 首次将全测试时自适应引入单目 3D 检测，对实际部署中的域适应问题有重要实用价值。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.contribution: 提出首个面向单目 3D 检测的全测试时自适应方法。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.innovation: 利用自监督辅助任务在测试阶段在线更新模型以应对域偏移。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.result: 在跨域设置下显著提升单目 3D 检测精度。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for._arxiv_id: MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2407.16448|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 目标检测在雾天等恶劣天气下性能下降的问题，本文提出 MonoWAD，一种天气自适应的扩散模型检测器。方法包含天气码本（记忆晴天知识并生成天气参考特征）和天气自适应扩散模型（将参考特征融入输入特征以指示需增强的程度），并引入天气自适应增强损失。相比仅在理想天气下训练的方法，MonoWAD 在晴天和雾天均提升特征表示。实验在多种天气条件下验证了其鲁棒性，显著优于现有方法。
2407.16448|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses degraded monocular 3D object detection under adverse weather such as fog by proposing MonoWAD, a weather-adaptive diffusion model detector. It comprises a weather codebook that memorizes clear-weather knowledge to generate weather-reference features and a weather-adaptive diffusion model that fuses these features to indicate required enhancement, along with a weather-adaptive enhancement loss. Compared with methods trained only in ideal weather, MonoWAD improves feature representation in both clear and foggy conditions, demonstrating robust performance across various weather settings.
2407.16448|v2.assessment: 将扩散模型与天气码本结合提升恶劣天气下的单目 3D 检测鲁棒性，思路新颖且实用。
2407.16448|v2.contribution: 提出天气自适应扩散模型用于鲁棒单目 3D 目标检测。
2407.16448|v2.innovation: 利用天气码本与扩散模型生成天气参考特征以增强特征表示。
2407.16448|v2.result: 在多种天气条件下实现鲁棒检测，显著优于现有方法。

GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中尺度模糊和地面区域精度低的问题，本文提出 GroCo，利用地面约束实现度量深度估计。方法上通过检测地面平面并施加几何约束，将相对深度恢复为度量深度，同时结合自监督训练框架。相比依赖相机内参或额外传感器的度量方法，GroCo 仅需单目视频即可获得度量尺度。实验在 KITTI 等基准上取得有竞争力的度量深度精度，地面区域误差显著降低。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.summary_en: This paper addresses scale ambiguity and low accuracy in ground regions for self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing GroCo, which leverages ground constraints for metric depth. It detects the ground plane and applies geometric constraints to recover metric depth within a self-supervised training framework. Unlike metric methods relying on intrinsics or extra sensors, GroCo requires only monocular video. Experiments on KITTI show competitive metric depth accuracy with significantly reduced errors in ground regions.
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.assessment: 利用地面几何约束解决自监督深度的尺度问题，方法简洁有效，对自动驾驶场景有实际意义。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.contribution: 提出基于地面约束的自监督度量单目深度估计方法。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.innovation: 通过地面平面检测与几何约束从单目视频恢复度量尺度。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.result: 在 KITTI 上取得有竞争力的度量深度精度，地面区域误差降低。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self._arxiv_id: GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self-supervised Monocular Depth.

2408.00361|v2.summary_cn: 针对丰富资源输入（高分辨率、多帧）在推理时不可用的问题，本文提出 RPrDepth，仅需单张低分辨率图像即可达到接近丰富资源方法的深度精度。方法上将丰富资源数据离线提取为参考特征，推理时从参考特征中搜索相似像素作为先验信息辅助深度估计。相比普通单图方法，RPrDepth 性能更优，且可与丰富资源方法媲美甚至超越。实验表明仅用低分辨率单图输入即可取得有竞争力的结果。
2408.00361|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unavailability of rich-resource inputs (high-resolution, multi-frame) at inference by proposing RPrDepth, which requires only a single low-resolution image yet achieves depth accuracy comparable to rich-resource methods. It extracts reference features from rich-resource data offline and, during inference, retrieves similar pixels as priors to aid depth estimation. Compared with ordinary single-image methods, RPrDepth performs better and matches or surpasses rich-resource methods using only low-resolution single-image input.
2408.00361|v2.assessment: 通过离线先验检索让单图推理逼近丰富资源方法，思路巧妙，对资源受限部署有参考价值。
2408.00361|v2.contribution: 提出利用丰富资源先验的单图自监督深度估计方法。
2408.00361|v2.innovation: 离线提取丰富资源特征并在推理时检索相似像素作为先验。
2408.00361|v2.result: 仅用低分辨率单图输入即达到与丰富资源方法相当或更优的精度。

Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中单帧与多帧方法各自受限的问题，提出统一学习框架 Mono-ViFI。方法上通过统一的自监督训练范式融合单帧与多帧线索，并引入可学习的多帧融合模块以增强深度预测。相比已有单帧或多帧独立训练的工作，该框架在统一架构下同时受益于两种设置。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在多个基准上取得一致提升。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of separate self-supervised single-frame and multi-frame monocular depth estimation by proposing a unified learning framework, Mono-ViFI. It integrates single-frame and multi-frame cues within a unified self-supervised training paradigm and introduces a learnable multi-frame fusion module to enhance depth prediction. Compared with prior methods that train single-frame or multi-frame models independently, the framework benefits from both settings under a unified architecture, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.assessment: 统一单帧与多帧自监督深度估计的思路对自动驾驶单目感知有实际价值，值得关注其融合机制与泛化表现。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.contribution: 提出统一的自监督单目深度估计框架，同时支持单帧与多帧输入。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.innovation: 通过可学习多帧融合模块在统一自监督范式中融合单帧与多帧线索。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.result: 在多个基准上取得一致提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework._arxiv_id: Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework for Self-supervised Single and Multi-frame Monocular Depth Estimation.

2403.11192|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对腹腔镜手术视频去烟雾中真实配对数据难以获取、合成数据泛化差的问题，提出自监督手术视频去烟雾方法 SelfSVD。方法利用高能设备激活前的清晰帧（PS帧）作为监督信号，并引入掩码策略与正则项避免平凡解。相比已有非配对单图去烟雾方法，该方法能更好处理浓密烟雾。作者构建了真实手术视频去烟雾数据集，实验表明 SelfSVD 能更有效高效地去烟并恢复更多细节。
2403.11192|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity of real paired data and poor generalization of synthetic training in laparoscopic surgery desmoking by proposing a self-supervised surgery video desmoking method, SelfSVD. It leverages pre-smoke (PS) frames captured before high-energy device activation as supervision and introduces a masking strategy and a regularization term to avoid trivial solutions. Compared with existing unpaired single-image desmoking methods, it handles dense smoke better. The authors construct a real surgery video desmoking dataset, and experiments show SelfSVD removes smoke more effectively and efficiently while recovering more details.
2403.11192|v2.assessment: 医学视频去烟雾与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但其自监督利用时序清晰帧的思路对视频理解任务有一定借鉴意义。
2403.11192|v2.contribution: 提出利用术前清晰帧作为监督的自监督手术视频去烟雾框架，并构建真实数据集。
2403.11192|v2.innovation: 利用高能设备激活前的清晰帧作为监督信号，结合掩码策略与正则项避免平凡解。
2403.11192|v2.result: 在自建真实手术视频数据集上更有效高效地去烟并恢复更多细节。

Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计在跨域场景下泛化能力不足的问题，提出通过稳定化对抗训练提升域泛化能力。方法在自监督深度估计训练中引入对抗训练机制，并针对其不稳定问题设计稳定化策略。相比已有自监督深度估计方法，该工作重点提升模型在未见域上的表现。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在域泛化基准上取得改进。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor domain generalization of self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing stabilized adversarial training. It introduces an adversarial training mechanism into self-supervised depth estimation and designs stabilization strategies to mitigate its instability. Compared with existing self-supervised depth estimation methods, it focuses on improving performance on unseen domains, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.assessment: 域泛化是自动驾驶单目深度估计落地的关键瓶颈，该工作将对抗训练稳定化用于自监督深度估计，具有较强实用价值。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.contribution: 提出稳定化对抗训练方法以提升自监督单目深度估计的域泛化能力。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.innovation: 将对抗训练引入自监督深度估计并设计稳定化策略解决其训练不稳定问题。

Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D检测中类别不平衡问题，提出通过低成本增强伪LiDAR点云来缓解。方法在伪LiDAR点云空间中对少数类进行增强，仅需额外约100美元成本即可生成更多少数类样本。相比已有类别平衡策略，该方法直接在点云层面操作，更贴近3D检测器的输入分布。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称能有效缓解类别不平衡。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.summary_en: This paper addresses the class-imbalance problem in 3D detection by augmenting pseudo-LiDAR point clouds at low cost. It augments minority-class samples in the pseudo-LiDAR point cloud space, requiring only about $100 extra cost to generate more minority-class samples. Compared with existing class-balancing strategies, it operates directly at the point cloud level, better matching the input distribution of 3D detectors, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.assessment: 以极低成本在伪LiDAR点云层面解决类别不平衡，思路新颖且对3D检测数据稀缺场景有参考价值。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.contribution: 提出低成本伪LiDAR点云增强方法以缓解3D检测中的类别不平衡。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.innovation: 在伪LiDAR点云空间对少数类进行增强，仅需约100美元额外成本。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.result: 有效缓解类别不平衡（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2406.12849|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对360度全景图像深度估计中透视模型失效且全景标注数据稀缺的问题，提出利用无标注360度数据的深度估计框架。方法以先进透视深度模型为教师，通过六面立方体投影生成伪标签，并设计离线无效区域掩码生成与在线半监督联合训练两阶段流程。相比已有360度方法，该框架可增强任意360度单目深度估计器。在Matterport3D和Stanford2D3D上，尤其在零样本场景下深度估计精度显著提升。
2406.12849|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of perspective depth models on 360-degree imagery and the scarcity of labeled panoramic data by proposing a depth estimation framework that leverages unlabeled 360-degree data. It uses state-of-the-art perspective depth models as teachers to generate pseudo labels via six-face cube projection, with two stages: offline mask generation for invalid regions and online semi-supervised joint training. Compared with existing 360-degree methods, it can enhance any 360 monocular depth estimator, achieving significant accuracy improvements on Matterport3D and Stanford2D3D, especially in zero-shot scenarios.
2406.12849|v2.assessment: 利用透视模型蒸馏与无标注数据增强解决全景深度估计，对自动驾驶环视感知与VR应用均有借鉴意义。
2406.12849|v2.contribution: 提出利用透视蒸馏与无标注数据增强的360度单目深度估计框架。
2406.12849|v2.innovation: 通过六面立方体投影生成伪标签，并结合离线掩码与在线半监督联合训练。
2406.12849|v2.result: 在Matterport3D和Stanford2D3D上，尤其零样本场景下深度精度显著提升。

2405.07696|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测中普遍存在的物体遮挡导致尺寸、深度和朝向预测退化的问题，提出深度感知掩码自编码器 MonoMAE。方法包含两个设计：深度感知掩码根据深度信息自适应地掩蔽非遮挡物体查询以模拟遮挡查询，以及轻量查询补全模块学习重建被掩蔽的查询。相比已有单目3D检测器，MonoMAE 通过特征空间的遮挡模拟与补全学习到更丰富的3D表示。在遮挡与非遮挡场景下均取得定性和定量的优越性能。
2405.07696|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the pervasive object occlusion problem in monocular 3D detection that degrades prediction of object dimensions, depths, and orientations, by proposing MonoMAE, a depth-aware masked autoencoder. It introduces depth-aware masking that adaptively masks parts of non-occluded object queries according to depth to simulate occluded queries, and a lightweight query completion module that learns to reconstruct masked queries. Compared with existing monocular 3D detectors, MonoMAE learns enriched 3D representations through occlusion simulation and completion in feature space, achieving superior qualitative and quantitative performance for both occluded and non-occluded objects.
2405.07696|v2.assessment: 将掩码自编码器思想引入单目3D检测以显式建模遮挡，思路新颖且切中单目3D检测核心痛点，值得重点关注。
2405.07696|v2.contribution: 提出深度感知掩码自编码器 MonoMAE，通过特征空间遮挡模拟与补全提升单目3D检测。
2405.07696|v2.innovation: 深度感知掩码自适应掩蔽非遮挡查询模拟遮挡，并配合轻量查询补全模块重建。
2405.07696|v2.result: 在遮挡与非遮挡场景下均取得定性和定量上的优越检测性能。

MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中训练数据标注成本高、目标放置不合理导致模型泛化差的问题，提出MonoPlace3D，通过学习3D感知的目标放置策略来增强单目3D检测。方法利用3D感知的放置网络在训练图像中合成合理的目标位置，从而扩充训练样本并提升检测器对遮挡和尺度变化的鲁棒性。相比传统数据增强仅做2D变换，该方法显式建模3D空间关系，使合成样本更符合真实3D场景分布。在KITTI等基准上取得了显著的检测精度提升，尤其在困难样本上表现更优。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.summary_en: MonoPlace3D addresses the high annotation cost and suboptimal object placement in monocular 3D detection by learning a 3D-aware object placement strategy. It synthesizes plausible object locations in training images via a 3D-aware placement network, augmenting training data and improving robustness to occlusion and scale variation. Unlike conventional 2D data augmentation, it explicitly models 3D spatial relations, yielding more realistic synthetic samples. Experiments on KITTI show notable improvements, especially on hard samples.
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.assessment: 该工作将数据增强与3D感知结合，为单目3D检测提供了一种低成本提升泛化的思路，值得关注。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.contribution: 提出3D感知的目标放置学习框架，用于增强单目3D检测训练。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.innovation: 将目标放置建模为3D感知的学习问题，而非简单的2D几何变换。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.result: 在KITTI等基准上显著提升单目3D检测精度，困难样本改善明显。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl._arxiv_id: MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Placement for 3D Monocular Detection.

2509.00649|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D人体姿态估计在新相机配置下泛化差、遮挡场景建模不足的问题，提出MV-SSM多视角状态空间建模框架。方法在特征级和关键点级两个层次显式建模关节空间序列，设计投影状态空间（PSS）块并改进Mamba扫描为网格令牌引导的双向扫描（GTBS）。相比基于注意力Transformer的方法，MV-SSM能更好地建模关键点空间排列并减少对特定相机配置的过拟合。实验表明其泛化性能优于现有最优方法，在新相机设置下性能下降更小。
2509.00649|v2.summary_en: MV-SSM tackles poor generalization to new camera configurations and weak occlusion modeling in multi-view 3D human pose estimation. It explicitly models joint spatial sequences at both feature and keypoint levels, introducing a Projective State Space (PSS) block with a Grid Token-guided Bidirectional Scanning (GTBS) mechanism. Compared to attention-based transformers, it better captures joint spatial arrangements and reduces overfitting to training camera setups. Experiments show superior generalization and smaller performance drops in new settings.
2509.00649|v2.assessment: 将状态空间模型引入多视角3D人体姿态估计，在泛化性上有新意，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2509.00649|v2.contribution: 提出基于状态空间建模的多视角3D人体姿态估计框架MV-SSM。
2509.00649|v2.innovation: 设计PSS块与GTBS扫描机制，显式建模关节空间序列以提升泛化。
2509.00649|v2.result: 在新相机配置下泛化性能优于SOTA，性能下降更小。

2503.14483|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计精度不足限制多视角几何重建质量的问题，提出将SfM信息融入单目深度估计以直接服务于多视角重建。方法利用SfM提供的强多视角先验来约束深度预测，提升深度估计的准确性，使其可直接用于多视角几何重建。相比以往间接利用单目深度辅助重建的工作，该方法显著提高了深度预测质量。在公开真实数据集上，深度估计质量优于以往单目方法，在室内、街景和航拍等场景的重建质量超过SOTA MVS方法。
2503.14483|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited accuracy of monocular depth estimation that hinders multi-view geometric reconstruction. It incorporates SfM information, a strong multi-view prior, into the depth estimation process, enabling direct use of predicted depth for reconstruction. Compared to prior works that indirectly leverage monocular depth, it significantly improves depth quality. Experiments on real-world datasets show better depth estimation and reconstruction quality than state-of-the-art MVS methods across indoor, streetscape, and aerial scenes.
2503.14483|v2.assessment: 将SfM先验与单目深度估计结合以提升多视角重建，思路清晰，对自动驾驶街景重建有参考价值。
2503.14483|v2.contribution: 提出SfM引导的单目深度估计方法，直接用于多视角几何重建。
2503.14483|v2.innovation: 将SfM多视角先验显式融入深度估计，提升深度预测精度。
2503.14483|v2.result: 深度估计质量优于以往单目方法，重建质量超过SOTA MVS方法。

2411.18613|v2.summary_cn: 针对从单目视频创建4D动态3D场景的难题，提出CAT4D，利用多视角视频扩散模型实现任意相机位姿和时间戳的新视角合成。方法在多样化数据集组合上训练多视角视频扩散模型，结合新颖采样策略将单目视频转化为多视角视频，并通过优化可变形3D高斯表示实现鲁棒的4D重建。相比已有方法，CAT4D在新视角合成和动态场景重建基准上具有竞争力，并展示了从真实或生成视频创建4D场景的创意能力。
2411.18613|v2.summary_en: CAT4D addresses the challenge of creating 4D dynamic 3D scenes from monocular video. It leverages a multi-view video diffusion model trained on diverse datasets to enable novel view synthesis at arbitrary camera poses and timestamps. Combined with a novel sampling approach, it transforms a single monocular video into multi-view video and reconstructs 4D via deformable 3D Gaussian optimization. It achieves competitive performance on novel view synthesis and dynamic reconstruction benchmarks.
2411.18613|v2.assessment: 多视角视频扩散与4D高斯重建的结合在生成与重建任务上表现亮眼，对动态场景理解有启发。
2411.18613|v2.contribution: 提出从单目视频创建4D动态场景的多视角视频扩散框架CAT4D。
2411.18613|v2.innovation: 结合多视角视频扩散模型与可变形3D高斯优化实现4D重建。
2411.18613|v2.result: 在新视角合成和动态场景重建基准上达到有竞争力的性能。

GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中逐点建模忽略局部平面结构的问题，提出GeoDepth，将点对点深度建模转变为平面对平面深度建模。方法通过引入几何平面先验，在自监督框架下对局部区域进行平面拟合与深度一致性约束，从而提升深度估计的几何准确性。相比传统逐像素或逐点方法，GeoDepth更好地保持了场景中的平面结构，减少了深度估计的噪声和边缘模糊。在KITTI等自监督深度估计基准上取得了优于现有方法的精度。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_en: GeoDepth addresses the limitation of point-to-point modeling in self-supervised monocular depth estimation, which ignores local planar structures. It reformulates depth modeling from point-to-depth to plane-to-depth by incorporating geometric plane priors and enforcing depth consistency within local planar regions. Compared to per-pixel methods, it better preserves planar structures and reduces noise and edge blur. It achieves improved accuracy on self-supervised depth benchmarks such as KITTI.
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.assessment: 从点建模转向平面建模的思路对自监督深度估计有实质改进，对自动驾驶场景理解有参考意义。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.contribution: 提出平面对平面的自监督单目深度估计框架GeoDepth。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.innovation: 引入几何平面先验，将深度建模从点级提升到平面级。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.result: 在KITTI等自监督深度基准上精度优于现有方法。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t._arxiv_id: GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-to-Depth Modeling for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2412.06359|v2.summary_cn: 针对事件相机在资源受限机器人上难以实现实时在线自监督学习的问题，提出一种高效的事件相机单目深度自监督学习流程。方法优化了对比度最大化管线的计算与内存效率，使低延迟单目深度估计可在设备端在线学习。相比仅预训练，在线学习在小无人机上获得更准确的深度估计和更成功的避障行为。基准测试表明该流程不仅高效，而且在自监督方法中达到SOTA深度估计性能。
2412.06359|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of real-time on-device self-supervised learning for event cameras on resource-constrained robots. It improves the time and memory efficiency of the contrast maximization pipeline, enabling on-board online learning of low-latency monocular depth. Compared to pre-training only, online learning on a small drone yields more accurate depth estimates and more successful obstacle avoidance. Benchmarking shows state-of-the-art depth estimation performance among self-supervised approaches.
2412.06359|v2.assessment: 在事件相机上实现设备端在线自监督深度估计，对低功耗机器人感知有重要实用价值。
2412.06359|v2.contribution: 提出高效的事件相机在线自监督单目深度估计流程。
2412.06359|v2.innovation: 优化对比度最大化管线，实现设备端实时在线学习。
2412.06359|v2.result: 在线学习提升深度估计精度和避障成功率，自监督方法中达到SOTA。

2412.03079|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频深度估计中跨帧不一致且现有视频扩散方法训练昂贵、无法恢复相机位姿的问题，提出 Align3R。该方法以 DUSt3R 为基础，在动态场景下额外输入单目深度进行微调，并通过优化同时重建深度图与相机位姿。相比依赖视频扩散的基线，Align3R 无需昂贵训练即可输出时序一致的深度和相机位姿，实验表明其在动态视频上性能优于基线方法。
2412.03079|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses temporally inconsistent monocular video depth and the inability of video-diffusion baselines to recover camera poses. Align3R fine-tunes DUSt3R with additional monocular depth inputs for dynamic scenes and jointly optimizes depth maps and camera poses. It achieves superior consistent video depth and pose estimation than baselines without expensive video-diffusion training.
2412.03079|v2.assessment: 将 DUSt3R 与单目深度先验结合解决动态视频一致性问题，思路简洁且对自动驾驶/机器人感知有实用价值。
2412.03079|v2.contribution: 提出基于 DUSt3R 对齐单目深度图的动态视频深度与相机位姿联合估计方法 Align3R。
2412.03079|v2.innovation: 用额外单目深度微调 DUSt3R 并联合优化，避免昂贵的视频扩散训练且能恢复相机位姿。
2412.03079|v2.result: 在动态视频上实现时序一致深度与相机位姿估计，性能优于基线方法。

2411.11361|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计（MDE）能否用自回归范式并具备可扩展性的问题，提出深度自回归模型 DAR。DAR 将不同分辨率深度图视为 token 集合，采用 patch 级因果掩码做低到高分辨率自回归，并递归离散化深度区间实现由粗到细的 ordinal 回归。该方法在 KITTI 和 NYU Depth v2 上刷新 SOTA，模型可扩展至 2.0B，在 KITTI 上取得 1.799 RMSE，比当前 SOTA（Depth Anything 的 1.896）提升约 5%，并展现零样本泛化能力。
2411.11361|v2.summary_en: This paper shows autoregressive modeling is an effective and scalable monocular depth estimator. DAR treats multi-resolution depth maps as tokens with a patch-wise causal mask and recursively discretizes depth ranges for coarse-to-fine ordinal regression. It sets new SOTA on KITTI and NYU Depth v2, scaling to 2.0B parameters and achieving 1.799 RMSE on KITTI (5% improvement over Depth Anything's 1.896) with zero-shot generalization.
2411.11361|v2.assessment: 把自回归生成范式成功迁移到深度估计并验证可扩展性，对单目深度与下游 3D 感知有参考价值。
2411.11361|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展的自回归单目深度估计模型 DAR。
2411.11361|v2.innovation: 结合多分辨率 token 自回归与递归离散化的由粗到细 ordinal 回归双重目标。
2411.11361|v2.result: 在 KITTI 上 RMSE 达 1.799，较 Depth Anything 提升约 5%，并具备零样本泛化能力。

2503.16535|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中仅依赖图像间关系、忽视相机自身内参信息的问题，提出将相机模型及其物理特性嵌入深度学习模型的具身深度估计方法。模型仅用相机内参，通过与道路环境的实时交互计算具身场景深度，并与 RGB 特征融合，同时引入含环境与深度信息的文本描述作为场景理解先验。该方法融合图像与语言两种模糊模态的互补优势，实现实时单目深度估计。
2503.16535|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular depth estimation that overlooks intrinsic camera information by embodying the camera model and its physical characteristics into a deep network. It computes embodied scene depth in real time using only camera intrinsics, fuses it with RGB features, and incorporates text descriptions as scene-understanding priors. The method leverages complementary image and language modalities for real-time monocular depth estimation.
2503.16535|v2.assessment: 将相机物理模型与视觉-语言先验结合用于深度估计，思路新颖但摘要缺少定量结果，需关注实验充分性。
2503.16535|v2.contribution: 提出融合相机具身模型与视觉-语言先验的单目深度估计方法。
2503.16535|v2.innovation: 仅用相机内参实时计算具身场景深度，并引入文本描述作为场景理解先验。
2503.16535|v2.result: 实现实时单目深度估计并融合几何与视觉细节，摘要未给出具体定量指标。

Mono3DVLT: Monocular-Video-Based 3D Visu.summary_cn: 该论文题为 Mono3DVLT，研究基于单目视频的 3D 视觉语言跟踪任务，但所提供的摘要为空，无法获取其针对的问题、方法、改进点与实验结果。仅从标题可推断其将单目视频、3D 感知与视觉语言跟踪相结合。由于缺乏摘要信息，无法对其方法质量与效果做出可靠评估。
Mono3DVLT: Monocular-Video-Based 3D Visu.summary_en: This paper, titled Mono3DVLT, targets monocular-video-based 3D visual language tracking, but the provided abstract is empty, so its problem, method, improvements, and results cannot be assessed. Only the title suggests a combination of monocular video, 3D perception, and vision-language tracking. No reliable evaluation of quality or effectiveness is possible without the abstract.
Mono3DVLT: Monocular-Video-Based 3D Visu.assessment: 标题方向与 3D 感知和视觉语言跟踪相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估，信息不足。
Mono3DVLT: Monocular-Video-Based 3D Visu.contribution: 提出单目视频 3D 视觉语言跟踪任务（据标题推断）。

2508.20488|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 目标检测（M3OD）在真实域偏移下可靠性显著下降的问题，现有测试时自适应（TTA）方法虽认识到低不确定性与高泛化性的正相关，却未处理 M3OD 固有的双重不确定性（语义不确定性与几何不确定性）。本文提出首个联合最小化两类不确定性的 TTA 框架 DUO，从凸优化视角给出 focal loss 的凸结构并推导无监督版本，实现标签无关的不确定性加权与高不确定性目标的均衡学习，同时设计语义感知法向场约束以保持几何一致性。
2508.20488|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliability degradation of monocular 3D object detection under real-world domain shifts, where prior test-time adaptation methods ignore the dual uncertainty (semantic and geometric) inherent to M3OD. It proposes DUO, the first TTA framework jointly minimizing both uncertainties, deriving a convex structure of focal loss with an unsupervised variant for label-agnostic uncertainty weighting, plus a semantic-aware normal field constraint for geometric coherence. This enables robust M3OD under test-time shifts.
2508.20488|v2.assessment: 首次针对 M3OD 的双重不确定性设计 TTA 框架，对自动驾驶安全关键的域偏移鲁棒性有直接价值。
2508.20488|v2.contribution: 提出首个联合最小化语义与几何双重不确定性的单目 3D 检测测试时自适应框架 DUO。
2508.20488|v2.innovation: 从凸优化视角构造 focal loss 凸结构并推导无监督版本，结合语义感知法向场约束。
2508.20488|v2.result: 在测试时域偏移下提升单目 3D 目标检测的鲁棒性（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2507.23567|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有单目 3D 目标检测局限于闭集设定、难以应对新环境与新类别的问题，本文首次提出端到端的单目 3D 开集目标检测器 3D-MOOD。方法通过设计的 3D 边界框头将开集 2D 检测提升到 3D 空间，实现 2D 与 3D 任务的端到端联合训练，并用几何先验条件化目标 query 以提升跨场景 3D 估计泛化，同时设计规范图像空间以支持高效跨数据集训练。在闭集（Omni3D）与开集（Omni3D→Argoverse 2、ScanNet）设定上均取得新的 SOTA。
2507.23567|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the closed-set limitation of monocular 3D object detection, where real-world applications involve new environments and novel categories. It introduces 3D-MOOD, the first end-to-end monocular 3D open-set object detector, which lifts open-set 2D detection into 3D via a 3D bounding box head for joint 2D-3D training, conditions object queries with geometry priors for cross-scene generalization, and designs a canonical image space for efficient cross-dataset training. It achieves new state-of-the-art on both closed-set (Omni3D) and open-set (Omni3D to Argoverse 2, ScanNet) settings.
2507.23567|v2.assessment: 首次将开集检测引入单目 3D 目标检测并给出端到端方案，跨数据集 SOTA 结果对自动驾驶开放世界感知很有价值。
2507.23567|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端单目 3D 开集目标检测器 3D-MOOD。
2507.23567|v2.innovation: 通过 3D 边界框头将开集 2D 检测提升到 3D，并用几何先验条件化 query 与规范图像空间支持跨数据集训练。
2507.23567|v2.result: 在 Omni3D 闭集及 Omni3D→Argoverse 2、ScanNet 开集设定上均取得新的 SOTA。

2510.09320|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计（MDE）因语义-空间知识提取不足而性能受限的问题，本文提出 Hybrid-depth 框架，系统整合 CLIP（全局语义）与 DINO（局部空间细节）等基础模型提取视觉先验。方法采用由粗到细的渐进学习：先通过对比语言引导聚合多粒度特征，并设计近-远图像块代理任务用文本提示强制深度感知特征对齐；再基于粗特征融合相机位姿与像素级语言对齐精修深度。该模块可作为即插即用深度编码器接入 Monodepth2、ManyDepth 等现有自监督 MDE 流程，通过语言引导聚合 CLIP 语义与 DINO 空间细节，缓解特征粒度失配问题。
2510.09320|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited semantic-spatial knowledge extraction in self-supervised monocular depth estimation (MDE) by proposing Hybrid-depth, a framework that integrates foundation models (CLIP and DINO) to obtain visual priors and contextual information. It introduces a coarse-to-fine progressive learning scheme: multi-grained features from CLIP (global semantics) and DINO (local spatial details) are aggregated under contrastive language guidance with a close-distant patch proxy task, followed by camera-pose and pixel-wise language alignment for depth refinement. The module serves as a plug-and-play depth encoder for existing pipelines such as Monodepth2 and ManyDepth, mitigating feature granularity mismatch.
2510.09320|v2.assessment: 将视觉-语言基础模型引入自监督 MDE 的思路新颖，且即插即用设计便于与现有方法结合，值得关注其泛化性与实际增益。
2510.09320|v2.contribution: 提出 Hybrid-depth 框架，用语言引导聚合 CLIP 与 DINO 多粒度特征以增强自监督单目深度估计。
2510.09320|v2.innovation: 设计近-远图像块代理任务与像素级语言对齐，实现由粗到细的深度感知特征学习。
2510.09320|v2.result: 作为即插即用编码器可增强 Monodepth2、ManyDepth 等基线，缓解特征粒度失配并提升连续深度估计。

2502.14573|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计（SSMDE）在反射表面上因违反朗伯反射假设而导致训练不准确的问题，本文提出一种基于三元组挖掘的训练策略，利用不同视角间的相机几何在像素级定位反射区域。所提出的反射感知三元组挖掘损失在局部反射区域惩罚不恰当的光度误差最小化，同时保持非反射区域的深度精度；并引入反射感知知识蒸馏，使学生模型能选择性学习反射与非反射区域的像素级知识。在多个数据集上的评估表明该方法有效提升了反射区域的深度估计鲁棒性。
2502.14573|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the failure of self-supervised monocular depth estimation (SSMDE) on reflective surfaces, which violate the Lambertian assumption and cause inaccurate training. It proposes a triplet-mining training strategy that localizes reflective regions at the pixel level using camera geometry across viewpoints, with a reflection-aware triplet mining loss that penalizes inappropriate photometric error minimization on reflective regions while preserving accuracy elsewhere. A reflection-aware knowledge distillation method further lets a student model selectively learn pixel-level knowledge from both regions, improving robustness across multiple datasets.
2502.14573|v2.assessment: 聚焦自监督 MDE 中长期被忽视的反射表面难题，三元组挖掘与知识蒸馏结合的设计有针对性，实验验证较充分。
2502.14573|v2.contribution: 提出反射感知的三元组挖掘损失与知识蒸馏方法，提升自监督单目深度估计在反射表面的鲁棒性。
2502.14573|v2.innovation: 利用相机几何在像素级定位反射区域，并以此指导光度误差惩罚与师生知识选择性蒸馏。
2502.14573|v2.result: 在多个数据集上有效增强反射区域深度估计，同时保持非反射区域精度。

2507.00981|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计现有基准大多只评估精度、缺乏鲁棒性评估的问题，本文提出 PDE（Procedural Depth Evaluation）基准，通过程序化生成 3D 场景系统评估模型对受控扰动的鲁棒性，涵盖物体、相机、材质与光照变化。分析揭示了当前最先进深度模型在哪些扰动下表现脆弱，为后续研究提供方向。代码与数据已开源。
2507.00981|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of robustness evaluation in monocular depth estimation, where standard benchmarks mostly measure accuracy. It introduces PDE (Procedural Depth Evaluation), a benchmark that uses procedural generation of 3D scenes to systematically test robustness to controlled perturbations including object, camera, material, and lighting changes. The analysis reveals which perturbations are challenging for state-of-the-art depth models, with code and data released.
2507.00981|v2.assessment: 为单目深度估计提供了系统化的鲁棒性评测工具，填补了精度之外的评估空白，对领域内模型选型与改进有实际参考价值。
2507.00981|v2.contribution: 提出程序化生成的鲁棒性评测基准 PDE，系统评估单目深度模型对多类受控扰动的鲁棒性。
2507.00981|v2.innovation: 用程序化 3D 场景生成实现物体、相机、材质、光照等扰动的可控组合与系统评测。
2507.00981|v2.result: 揭示了当前最先进深度模型在特定扰动下的脆弱性，并开源代码与数据。
