2208.08165|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（SGG）中所有物体类别必须在训练集中出现的封闭设定限制实际应用的问题，提出了开放词汇场景图生成（Ov-SGG）这一新设定：模型在基础物体类别上训练，但需对未见过的目标物体类别推断关系。方法上采用两步策略，先在大规模粗粒度区域-描述数据上预训练，再利用两种基于prompt的微调技术在不更新预训练模型参数的情况下适配下游任务，且支持对完全未见类别的推理。在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image三个基准上，该方法在Ov-SGG设定及传统封闭SGG设定下均显著优于近期强基线方法。
2208.08165|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces open-vocabulary scene graph generation (Ov-SGG), a realistic setting where models trained on base object classes must infer relations for unseen target classes. The proposed two-step approach first pre-trains on large-scale coarse-grained region-caption data, then applies two prompt-based finetuning techniques to adapt the model without updating its parameters, enabling inference over completely unseen classes. Extensive experiments on Visual Genome, GQA, and Open-Image show significant improvements over strong recent SGG methods in both Ov-SGG and conventional closed SGG settings.
2208.08165|v2.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇设定引入场景图生成，prompt-based参数冻结微调思路对开放世界感知有参考价值，但与自动驾驶3D感知的直接关联较弱。
2208.08165|v2.contribution: 首次提出开放词汇场景图生成设定，并给出基于prompt微调的免参数更新解决方案。
2208.08165|v2.innovation: 利用区域-描述预训练加两种prompt微调技术，在不更新模型参数的前提下支持对完全未见物体类别的关系推理。
2208.08165|v2.result: 在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image三个基准上，Ov-SGG设定及封闭SGG设定下均显著超越现有强方法。

2308.11093|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界视频目标定位中时序一致性差的问题，提出Video OWL-ViT，在预训练开放词汇检测器OWL-ViT基础上增加一个transformer解码器，通过将前一帧的输出token作为下一帧的对象查询来递归传播目标表示。相比tracking-by-detection基线，该方法在TAO-OW基准上实现了更好的时序一致性，同时保留了骨干检测器的开放世界能力，且可端到端在视频数据上训练。
2308.11093|v2.summary_en: To address poor temporal consistency in open-world video object localization, the paper proposes Video OWL-ViT, which adapts the pretrained open-vocabulary detector OWL-ViT by adding a transformer decoder that recurrently propagates object representations across frames using previous-frame output tokens as object queries. Compared to tracking-by-detection baselines, it achieves improved temporal consistency on the TAO-OW benchmark while retaining the open-world capabilities of the backbone detector, and is end-to-end trainable on video data.
2308.11093|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测扩展到视频时序定位，思路简洁有效，对开放世界视频理解有参考价值。
2308.11093|v2.contribution: 提出一种将预训练开放词汇图像检测器适配到视频定位的架构与训练方案。
2308.11093|v2.innovation: 利用transformer解码器递归传播对象查询以实现时序一致的开放世界视频定位。
2308.11093|v2.result: 在TAO-OW基准上取得优于tracking-by-detection基线的时序一致性，并保持开放世界检测能力。

2304.12161|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中新类别样本稀缺的问题，指出基于微调的方法虽简单但性能有竞争力，因此聚焦于损失函数和数据增强在微调过程中的作用，提出通过元学习原则来调节其动态性。该方法能学习提升少样本检测的归纳偏置，同时保持微调方法的优势，并产生可解释的损失函数，而非高度参数化的复杂元模型。实验结果表明其在少样本检测任务上有效。
2304.12161|v2.summary_en: Targeting few-shot object detection with scarce novel-class samples, this work observes that fine-tuning-based approaches are simple yet competitive, and focuses on the role of loss functions and data augmentation as drivers of fine-tuning. It proposes to tune their dynamics via meta-learning principles, learning inductive biases that boost few-shot detection while retaining fine-tuning advantages and yielding interpretable loss functions instead of highly parametric meta-models. Experimental results demonstrate effectiveness on few-shot detection.
2304.12161|v2.assessment: 从损失函数与增强的元调节角度切入少样本检测，视角新颖但整体影响力有限。
2304.12161|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于元学习原则调节损失函数与数据增强动态性的少样本目标检测训练方案。
2304.12161|v2.innovation: 用元学习调节微调过程中的损失函数和增强策略，获得可解释的归纳偏置。
2304.12161|v2.result: 在少样本目标检测任务上取得有竞争力的检测性能。

Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中区域级视觉-语言对齐不足的问题，提出面向ViT的区域感知预训练方法RO-ViT，通过将区域表示与语言嵌入对齐来增强开放词汇检测能力。该方法在预训练阶段引入区域级监督，使模型能更好地泛化到新类别。实验表明其在开放词汇检测基准上取得了显著提升。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.summary_en: To address insufficient region-level vision-language alignment in open-vocabulary object detection, this paper proposes region-aware pretraining for ViTs (RO-ViT), aligning region representations with language embeddings to enhance open-vocabulary detection. By introducing region-level supervision during pretraining, the model generalizes better to novel categories, achieving notable improvements on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks.
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.assessment: 区域感知预训练是开放词汇检测的重要方向，方法对ViT检测器有较强通用性。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.contribution: 提出面向ViT的区域感知预训练方法以提升开放词汇目标检测。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.innovation: 在预训练阶段引入区域级视觉-语言对齐监督。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得显著性能提升。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu._arxiv_id: Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection with Vision Transformers.

Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.summary_cn: 针对点云3D目标检测依赖昂贵3D标注的问题，提出无需3D标注的开放词汇点云目标检测方法，利用2D图像-文本预训练知识迁移到3D点云检测中。该方法通过将点云与图像及语言语义对齐，实现对新颖类别的检测，避免了对3D边界框标注的依赖。实验表明其在开放词汇3D检测任务上有效。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.summary_en: To address the reliance on expensive 3D annotations in point-cloud 3D object detection, this paper proposes open-vocabulary point-cloud object detection without 3D annotation, transferring knowledge from 2D image-text pretraining to 3D point-cloud detection. By aligning point clouds with image and language semantics, it detects novel categories without 3D bounding-box annotations, demonstrating effectiveness on open-vocabulary 3D detection.
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.assessment: 无需3D标注的开放词汇点云检测对自动驾驶感知降低成本意义重大，方向前沿。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.contribution: 提出一种无需3D标注的开放词汇点云目标检测方法。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.innovation: 将2D图像-文本预训练知识迁移到3D点云检测以实现开放词汇识别。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.result: 在开放词汇3D检测任务上验证了方法的有效性。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detection without 3D Annotation.

2303.09674|v2.summary_cn: 针对广义少样本目标检测中基类与新类检测性能难以兼顾的问题，指出根源在于所有类别的判别性特征学习不足，提出DiGeo训练框架学习类间分离、类内紧凑的几何感知特征。该方法推导离线单纯形等角紧框架分类器作为类中心，并在分类损失中引入自适应类特定margin。在VOC、COCO和LVIS上实验表明，单一模型能有效提升新类泛化且不损害基类性能。
2303.09674|v2.summary_en: Targeting the difficulty of balancing base- and novel-class detection in generalized few-shot object detection, this paper attributes the issue to insufficient discriminative feature learning and proposes DiGeo, a training framework learning geometry-aware features with inter-class separation and intra-class compactness. It derives an offline simplex equiangular tight frame classifier as maximally separated class centers and adds adaptive class-specific margins. Experiments on VOC, COCO, and LVIS show a single model improves novel-class generalization without hurting base-class performance.
2303.09674|v2.assessment: 从特征几何角度统一解决基类与新类平衡问题，实验扎实，方法有理论支撑。
2303.09674|v2.contribution: 提出DiGeo框架学习几何感知的判别性特征以提升广义少样本检测。
2303.09674|v2.innovation: 利用单纯形等角紧框架分类器与自适应类特定margin实现类间分离和类内紧凑。
2303.09674|v2.result: 在VOC、COCO和LVIS上单一模型提升新类泛化且不损害基类性能。

2212.12130|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中框回归和掩码分割泛化能力不足的问题，指出现有工作主要关注分类的知识迁移而采用类无关的框和掩码预测，提出CondHead动态网络设计，通过语义嵌入条件化参数化网络头。CondHead包含动态聚合头和动态生成头两路，前者由静态头条件聚合、后者动态生成参数编码类特定信息。该设计使检测模型通过语义嵌入桥接，更好地检测新类别。
2212.12130|v2.summary_en: To address insufficient generalization of box regression and mask segmentation in open-vocabulary object detection, this paper notes that prior work focuses on classification knowledge transfer with class-agnostic box and mask prediction, and proposes CondHead, a dynamic network design that conditionally parameterizes network heads on semantic embeddings. CondHead comprises a dynamically aggregated head and a dynamically generated head, bridging the detection model via semantic embeddings to better detect novel categories.
2212.12130|v2.assessment: 将动态网络设计引入开放词汇检测的框回归与分割，思路新颖，对检测头设计有启发。
2212.12130|v2.contribution: 提出CondHead动态网络头设计以提升开放词汇检测的框回归与掩码分割泛化。
2212.12130|v2.innovation: 通过语义嵌入条件化参数化网络头，结合动态聚合与动态生成两路结构。
2212.12130|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测任务上更好地检测新类别。

2302.13996|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇目标检测器仅将单个区域嵌入与VLM文本特征对齐，忽略了场景中语义概念的组合结构。本文提出"区域袋（bag of regions）"对齐方法，将上下文相关的区域分组，把组内区域嵌入视作句子中的词送入VLM文本编码器，得到区域袋嵌入并与冻结VLM特征对齐。在Faster R-CNN上，该方法在开放词汇COCO和LVIS新类别上分别超越此前最优结果4.6 box AP50和2.8 mask AP。
2302.13996|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors align region embeddings individually with VLM features, leaving the compositional structure of scene concepts unexploited. This work proposes aligning a bag of contextually interrelated regions by feeding their embeddings as words into a VLM text encoder, producing a bag-of-regions embedding aligned to frozen VLM features. Applied to Faster R-CNN, it surpasses prior best by 4.6 box AP50 and 2.8 mask AP on novel categories of open-vocabulary COCO and LVIS.
2302.13996|v2.assessment: 将组合性语义结构引入开放词汇检测的对齐范式，思路新颖且即插即用，对开放世界感知研究有较强启发。
2302.13996|v2.contribution: 提出区域袋对齐范式，利用VLM文本编码器建模区域间组合语义以增强开放词汇检测。
2302.13996|v2.innovation: 把上下文相关区域分组当作句子中的词送入VLM文本编码器进行整体对齐，而非逐区域独立对齐。
2302.13996|v2.result: 在开放词汇COCO和LVIS新类别上分别提升4.6 box AP50与2.8 mask AP。

2304.04514|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测框架依赖预训练VLM或伪标注利用图文对，效率与规模受限。DetCLIPv2提出端到端从大规模图文对直接学习细粒度词-区域对齐，以区域提议与文本词的最大相似度引导对比目标，并在检测、定位与图文对数据的混合监督下统一训练。相比DetCLIP使用13倍图文对而训练时间相近，性能更优，在13M图文对预训练下取得领先的开放词汇检测表现。
2304.04514|v2.summary_en: Prior open-vocabulary detectors rely on pre-trained VLMs or pseudo-labeling to exploit image-text pairs. DetCLIPv2 directly learns fine-grained word-region alignment end-to-end from massive image-text pairs, guided by maximum word-region similarity, under hybrid supervision of detection, grounding, and image-text data. It uses 13x more image-text pairs than DetCLIP at similar training cost and achieves superior open-vocabulary detection with 13M pairs.
2304.04514|v2.assessment: 端到端词-区域对齐与混合监督设计使开放词汇检测预训练更具可扩展性，对大规模开放世界检测有重要参考价值。
2304.04514|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展的端到端开放词汇检测预训练框架，直接从海量图文对学习细粒度词-区域对齐。
2304.04514|v2.innovation: 以最大词-区域相似度引导对比学习，并用统一数据形式混合检测、定位与图文对监督。
2304.04514|v2.result: 使用13倍于DetCLIP的图文对而训练时间相近，开放词汇检测性能更优。

Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云语义分割中的开放集问题，即模型需识别训练中未见的未知类别。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节，但从标题推测其提出对抗原型框架以建模已知类原型并检测未知类。相比闭集分割方法，其目标是在开放世界中提升对未知类别的分割鲁棒性。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set semantic segmentation for point clouds, where models must handle unknown classes unseen during training. Based on the title, it proposes an adversarial prototype framework to model known-class prototypes and detect unknowns. Concrete method details and quantitative results cannot be confirmed due to the missing abstract.
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.assessment: 开放集点云分割是自动驾驶感知的重要方向，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法与实验质量。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.contribution: 提出面向点云语义分割的对抗原型框架以应对开放集识别。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.innovation: 推测利用对抗式原型学习区分已知与未知类别（因摘要缺失，创新点无法确证）。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法引用。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point._arxiv_id: Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point Clouds via Adversarial Prototype Framework.

Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_cn: 该论文研究3D点云语义分割中的新类发现问题，即在不使用新类标注的情况下从无标注数据中发现并分割新类别。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体方法设计，推测其借鉴2D新类发现范式并适配点云几何特性。相比传统闭集分割，其目标是在无监督条件下扩展类别覆盖。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_en: This paper studies novel class discovery for 3D point cloud semantic segmentation, aiming to discover and segment new classes from unlabeled data without new-class annotations. The abstract is missing, so the specific method design cannot be confirmed; it likely adapts 2D novel class discovery paradigms to point cloud geometry. Quantitative results are unavailable.
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.assessment: 将新类发现引入3D点云分割具有探索价值，但摘要缺失使方法质量与实验充分度难以评判。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.contribution: 将新类发现任务引入3D点云语义分割，探索无标注新类别的分割。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.innovation: 推测将2D新类发现范式迁移至点云几何场景（因摘要缺失，创新点无法确证）。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法引用。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud._arxiv_id: Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation.

2304.08408|v2.summary_cn: 传统多目标跟踪基准仅覆盖少量类别，难以代表真实世界中的多样物体，使现有MOT方法局限于预定义类别。本文提出开放词汇MOT新任务并设计OVTrack跟踪器，通过知识蒸馏利用视觉语言模型进行分类与关联，并借助去噪扩散概率模型进行数据幻觉以学习鲁棒的外观特征。该方法仅用静态图像训练，即在大规模大词汇TAO基准上取得新的最优结果，且数据效率极高。
2304.08408|v2.summary_en: Traditional MOT benchmarks cover only a few categories, limiting trackers to predefined classes. This paper introduces open-vocabulary MOT and develops OVTrack, which leverages vision-language models for classification and association via knowledge distillation, plus a diffusion-based data hallucination strategy for robust appearance learning. Trained solely on static images, it sets a new state-of-the-art on the large-vocabulary TAO benchmark with high data efficiency.
2304.08408|v2.assessment: 开放词汇跟踪任务定义清晰，知识蒸馏与扩散数据幻觉的组合有效，对自动驾驶开放世界跟踪有直接参考价值。
2304.08408|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇多目标跟踪任务及OVTrack跟踪器，实现任意类别物体的跟踪。
2304.08408|v2.innovation: 结合VLM知识蒸馏与扩散模型数据幻觉，仅用静态图像训练即可学习鲁棒外观特征。
2304.08408|v2.result: 在大规模大词汇TAO基准上取得新的最优结果，且训练数据效率极高。

2303.14158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目RGBD视频中未知物体的6-DoF跟踪与神经3D重建问题，且物体可能缺乏视觉纹理。方法核心是神经物体场与位姿图优化并发学习，并维护动态的已定位记忆帧池以在两者间传递信息，仅需首帧分割、无需其他先验。在HO3D、YCBInEOAT和BEHAVE数据集上，该方法显著优于现有方法，能处理大位姿变化、遮挡、无纹理表面与高光等挑战性场景。
2303.14158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 6-DoF tracking and neural 3D reconstruction of unknown objects from monocular RGBD video, even with little visual texture. Its key is a Neural Object Field learned concurrently with pose graph optimization, mediated by a dynamic pool of posed memory frames, requiring only first-frame segmentation. On HO3D, YCBInEOAT, and BEHAVE it significantly outperforms existing methods, handling large pose changes, occlusion, untextured surfaces, and specular highlights.
2303.14158|v2.assessment: 神经物体场与位姿图优化协同的设计对无纹理物体的实时6-DoF跟踪与重建效果突出，对机器人操作与自动驾驶场景理解有参考意义。
2303.14158|v2.contribution: 提出近实时的未知物体6-DoF跟踪与神经3D重建方法，仅需首帧分割。
2303.14158|v2.innovation: 将神经物体场与位姿图优化并发学习，并通过动态记忆帧池实现两者信息交互。
2303.14158|v2.result: 在HO3D、YCBInEOAT和BEHAVE上显著优于现有方法，可应对大位姿变化、遮挡与无纹理表面。

Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（Scene Graph Generation）依赖封闭类别标注、难以泛化到开放词汇的问题，提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间来生成语言监督和开放词汇的场景图。方法上借助CLIP等预训练模型构建视觉-语义对齐空间，将场景图中的关系与物体映射到语言空间，从而支持未见类别的推理。相比传统封闭集SGG方法，该工作无需为每个新类别重新标注即可识别开放词汇物体与关系。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但为开放词汇场景理解提供了可行范式。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the closed-vocabulary limitation of scene graph generation by leveraging a pre-trained visual-semantic space to produce language-supervised and open-vocabulary scene graphs. It maps objects and relations into a language-aligned embedding space, enabling recognition of unseen categories without additional annotation. The approach offers a viable paradigm for open-vocabulary structured scene understanding, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入场景图生成，对自动驾驶场景中的长尾物体与关系理解有潜在价值，但需关注其在实际驾驶数据上的泛化性。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.contribution: 提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间实现语言监督与开放词汇场景图生成。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.innovation: 将开放词汇识别从物体分类扩展到结构化场景图的关系推理。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.result: 为开放词汇场景图生成提供了无需封闭类别标注的可行方案。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised._arxiv_id: Learning to Generate Language-Supervised and Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Using Pre-Trained Visual-Semantic Space.

Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对属性检测（Attribute Detection）受限于预定义属性集合、无法识别开放词汇属性的问题，提出开放词汇属性检测任务。方法上利用视觉-语言模型将属性识别转化为图像区域与文本属性的匹配问题，从而支持任意文本描述的属性。相比传统封闭集属性检测，该方法无需为每个属性训练分类器即可泛化到新属性。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但为细粒度开放词汇理解提供了新基准与思路。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces open-vocabulary attribute detection, targeting the limitation of conventional attribute detection to predefined attribute sets. It formulates attribute recognition as matching image regions with arbitrary textual descriptions via vision-language models, enabling generalization to unseen attributes without per-attribute classifiers. The work provides a new benchmark and direction for fine-grained open-vocabulary understanding, though specific quantitative results are not included in the abstract.
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.assessment: 开放词汇属性检测对自动驾驶中细粒度物体状态理解（如车辆颜色、行人姿态）有参考意义，但需验证在驾驶场景下的实用性。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇属性检测任务并给出基于视觉-语言模型的解决方案。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.innovation: 将属性检测从封闭类别扩展到任意文本描述的开放词汇设定。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.result: 为开放词汇细粒度属性识别建立了新任务与基准。

OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇物体属性识别问题，提出OvarNet框架。方法上结合视觉-语言预训练模型，将物体识别与属性识别统一到开放词汇设定下，通过文本查询实现任意物体与属性的检测。相比已有封闭集方法，OvarNet无需针对新类别或新属性重新训练即可识别。摘要未提供具体量化指标，但为开放词汇属性识别提供了统一框架。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_en: This paper proposes OvarNet for open-vocabulary object attribute recognition. It unifies object and attribute recognition under an open-vocabulary setting by leveraging vision-language pre-trained models and textual queries, enabling detection of arbitrary objects and attributes without retraining. The framework offers a unified solution for open-vocabulary attribute recognition, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.assessment: 统一物体与属性识别的开放词汇框架对自动驾驶感知中的长尾类别与属性理解有潜在帮助。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.contribution: 提出OvarNet统一框架实现开放词汇物体与属性识别。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.innovation: 将物体检测与属性识别统一到开放词汇文本查询范式下。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.result: 为开放词汇物体属性识别提供了统一且无需重训的解决方案。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object._arxiv_id: OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object Attribute Recognition.

PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D场景理解依赖密集标注、难以泛化到开放词汇类别的问题，提出PLA（Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding）方法。方法上利用图像-文本预训练模型的语言嵌入来监督3D点云的特征学习，通过跨模态对齐实现开放词汇的3D语义理解。相比已有封闭集3D分割方法，PLA无需3D标注即可识别未见类别。摘要未给出具体数据，但为开放词汇3D感知提供了新思路。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on dense annotations and closed vocabularies in 3D scene understanding by proposing PLA, a language-driven open-vocabulary approach. It leverages image-text pre-trained language embeddings to supervise 3D point cloud feature learning via cross-modal alignment, enabling open-vocabulary 3D semantic understanding without 3D annotations for unseen classes. The work offers a new direction for open-vocabulary 3D perception, though quantitative results are not included in the abstract.
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入3D场景理解，对自动驾驶中长尾3D物体与场景元素的识别具有较高研究价值。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.contribution: 提出语言驱动的开放词汇3D场景理解框架PLA。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.innovation: 利用图像-文本预训练语言嵌入监督3D点云特征学习，实现跨模态开放词汇对齐。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.result: 为无需3D标注的开放词汇3D语义理解提供了可行方案。

2210.04150|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割中两阶段方法（先生成掩码再分类）的性能瓶颈——预训练CLIP在掩码图像上表现不佳——提出在掩码图像区域及其对应文本描述上微调CLIP。方法上从COCO Captions中挖掘掩码区域与名词的匹配对构建训练数据，并提出mask prompt tuning利用掩码图像的空白区域，在不修改CLIP权重的情况下显著提升性能。相比使用精确但类别固定的分割标注（如COCO-Stuff），该噪声但多样的数据更好地保留了CLIP的泛化能力。实验表明mask prompt tuning带来显著提升且无需修改CLIP任何权重。
2210.04150|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies the performance bottleneck of two-stage open-vocabulary semantic segmentation to be CLIP's poor performance on masked images, and proposes finetuning CLIP on masked image regions with corresponding text descriptions. Training data is mined from COCO Captions by matching masked regions to nouns, and a mask prompt tuning method exploits blank areas in masked images without modifying CLIP weights. Experiments show mask prompt tuning brings significant improvement while preserving CLIP's generalization ability better than precise but fixed-class segmentation labels.
2210.04150|v2.assessment: 精准定位了开放词汇分割中CLIP在掩码图像上的性能瓶颈，mask prompt tuning思路简洁有效，对开放词汇感知研究有较强参考价值。
2210.04150|v2.contribution: 提出在掩码图像区域上微调CLIP并引入mask prompt tuning解决开放词汇语义分割瓶颈。
2210.04150|v2.innovation: 利用掩码图像空白区域进行prompt tuning，在不修改CLIP权重下显著提升掩码分类性能。
2210.04150|v2.result: mask prompt tuning在不修改CLIP任何权重的情况下带来显著性能提升，并优于使用固定类别分割标注的训练。

Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本到动作生成（Text-to-Motion Generation）中依赖配对文本-动作数据的问题，提出无词训练（Wordless Training）的开放词汇文本到动作生成方法。方法上通过'无'中生'有'的思路，在训练阶段不使用文本-动作配对，而是学习动作的潜在表示并建立与文本的开放词汇映射。相比已有需要大量配对数据的文本到动作方法，该方法降低了对标注数据的依赖。摘要未提供具体量化结果，且该方向与自动驾驶视觉感知关联较弱。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on paired text-motion data in text-to-motion generation by proposing a wordless training approach for open-vocabulary text-to-motion generation. It learns motion latent representations and establishes open-vocabulary mappings to text without using paired text-motion data during training. The method reduces annotation dependence compared to existing paired-data approaches, though quantitative results are not detailed and the topic has limited relevance to autonomous driving perception.
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.assessment: 该论文属于文本到动作生成方向，与自动驾驶视觉感知领域关联较弱，仅对多模态生成研究有参考意义。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.contribution: 提出无词训练的开放词汇文本到动作生成方法。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.innovation: 在训练阶段不使用文本-动作配对数据实现开放词汇动作生成。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.result: 降低了文本到动作生成对配对标注数据的依赖。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul._arxiv_id: Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabulary Text-to-Motion Generation with Wordless Training.

2212.04994|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对开放词汇语义分割任务，即模型需在无分割标注的情况下识别任意文本描述的区域。②提出 Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL)，修改 CLIP 对比损失的兼容函数，使视觉编码器的 patch token 与文本编码器的 CLS token 对齐，从而无需分割标注即可迁移到开放词汇分割。③相比已有工作，PACL 无需额外分割标注，且可同时提升图像级零样本分类。④在 Pascal VOC、Pascal Context、COCO Stuff 和 ADE20K 四个分割基准上取得零样本开放词汇分割 SOTA，并在 12 个图像分类数据集上相比 CLIP 一致提升零样本分类精度。
2212.04994|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, where models must identify image regions corresponding to arbitrary text without segmentation annotations. It proposes Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL), which modifies CLIP's contrastive compatibility function to align patch tokens of the vision encoder with the CLS token of the text encoder, enabling seamless transfer to open-vocabulary segmentation without segmentation labels. PACL sets state-of-the-art zero-shot open-vocabulary segmentation on Pascal VOC, Pascal Context, COCO Stuff, and ADE20K, and consistently improves zero-shot classification accuracy over CLIP across 12 image classification datasets.
2212.04994|v2.assessment: 该工作为开放词汇分割提供了一种简洁有效的 CLIP 微调策略，虽与自动驾驶感知直接关联较弱，但其开放集识别思想对开放世界检测有借鉴意义。
2212.04994|v2.contribution: 提出 PACL，通过修改 CLIP 对比损失实现 patch 与文本 CLS token 的对齐，无需分割标注即可完成开放词汇语义分割。
2212.04994|v2.innovation: 将 CLIP 的 patch token 与文本 CLS token 对齐，使模型在无分割监督下具备区域-文本匹配能力。
2212.04994|v2.result: 在四个分割基准上取得零样本开放词汇分割 SOTA，并在 12 个分类数据集上一致提升 CLIP 的零样本分类精度。

VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇时空视频定位（Open-Vocabulary Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding）问题，即根据自然语言查询在视频中定位时空目标，现有方法通常局限于闭集词汇且难以泛化到未见类别。作者提出VideoGrounding-DINO，将图像领域的开放词汇检测器Grounding-DINO扩展到视频时空定位，通过引入时序建模模块和视频-文本对齐策略实现开放词汇的时空定位。相比已有闭集方法，该方法无需针对新类别重新训练即可泛化到任意文本查询。在多个视频定位基准上取得了领先性能，验证了开放词汇时空定位的可行性。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary spatio-temporal video grounding, where the goal is to localize targets in videos given natural language queries, a setting where existing methods are limited to closed vocabularies. The authors propose VideoGrounding-DINO, extending the image-domain open-vocabulary detector Grounding-DINO to the video domain with temporal modeling and video-text alignment. The method generalizes to unseen categories without retraining and achieves strong results on multiple video grounding benchmarks.
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.assessment: 将开放词汇检测从图像扩展到视频时空定位，填补了该方向空白，对多模态视频理解有重要参考价值。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.contribution: 提出了首个开放词汇时空视频定位框架VideoGrounding-DINO。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.innovation: 将Grounding-DINO的图像-文本对齐能力扩展到视频时序维度，实现开放词汇时空定位。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.result: 在多个视频定位基准上取得领先性能，无需针对新类别重新训练即可泛化。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu._arxiv_id: VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabulary Spatio- Temporal Video Grounding.

Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标检测中模型对稀有和未见类别识别能力不足的问题，提出检索增强的开放词汇目标检测方法。作者构建了一个外部知识库，在训练和推理阶段通过检索机制获取与目标区域相关的类别知识，增强检测器对未见类别的识别能力。相比仅依赖CLIP等视觉-语言模型对齐的方法，检索增强策略能引入更丰富的语义先验。实验表明该方法在LVIS等开放词汇检测基准上显著提升了稀有类别的检测性能。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited recognition of rare and unseen categories in open-vocabulary object detection by proposing a retrieval-augmented framework. The method builds an external knowledge base and retrieves category-relevant knowledge during training and inference to enhance detection of unseen classes. Compared to CLIP-based alignment alone, the retrieval mechanism introduces richer semantic priors, yielding significant improvements on rare categories on LVIS and other benchmarks.
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.assessment: 检索增强思路为开放词汇检测提供了新范式，对外部知识利用有启发意义。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.contribution: 提出检索增强的开放词汇目标检测框架，利用外部知识库提升未见类别识别。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.innovation: 将检索机制引入开放词汇检测，在训练和推理阶段动态获取类别相关知识。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.result: 在LVIS等基准上显著提升稀有类别检测性能。

Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标检测中背景区域被忽视、隐含知识未被充分利用的问题，提出学习背景提示（Background Prompts）来挖掘背景中的隐式知识。作者设计了背景提示学习模块，通过可学习的提示向量捕获背景区域的语义信息，并将其与前景类别对齐以增强开放词汇检测能力。相比仅关注前景区域的方法，该工作强调了背景信息在开放词汇检测中的价值。在开放词汇检测基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of background regions and implicit knowledge in open-vocabulary object detection by proposing learnable background prompts. The method captures semantic information from background regions via prompt vectors and aligns them with foreground categories to enhance detection. Compared to foreground-only approaches, it highlights the value of background information, achieving competitive results on open-vocabulary benchmarks.
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.assessment: 从背景信息角度切入开放词汇检测，视角新颖但整体提升幅度有限。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.contribution: 提出背景提示学习方法，挖掘背景区域隐含知识用于开放词汇检测。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.innovation: 通过可学习背景提示捕获背景语义并与前景类别对齐。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover._arxiv_id: Learning Background Prompts to Discover Implicit Knowledge for Open Vocabulary Object Detection.

SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标检测中类别语义层次结构未被充分利用的问题，提出语义层次连接（Semantic Hierarchy Nexus, SHiNe）方法。作者构建了类别间的语义层次关系图，通过层次化语义对齐增强检测器对细粒度和粗粒度类别的区分能力。相比扁平化的类别嵌入方法，SHiNe能更好地处理类别间的语义重叠和层次关系。在开放词汇检测基准上取得了显著的性能提升，尤其在细粒度类别上表现突出。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of semantic hierarchies among categories in open-vocabulary object detection by proposing Semantic Hierarchy Nexus (SHiNe). The method constructs a semantic hierarchy graph and performs hierarchical semantic alignment to improve discrimination between fine- and coarse-grained categories. Compared to flat category embeddings, SHiNe better handles semantic overlap and hierarchy, achieving notable gains especially on fine-grained categories.
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.assessment: 语义层次建模为开放词汇检测提供了结构化先验，对细粒度识别有实际价值。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.contribution: 提出语义层次连接SHiNe，利用类别层次关系增强开放词汇检测。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.innovation: 构建类别语义层次图并进行层次化对齐，处理类别间语义重叠。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得显著提升，细粒度类别表现突出。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open._arxiv_id: SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标检测中检测器缺乏生成能力和多样化输出形式的问题，提出DetCLIPv3，一个多功能的生成式开放词汇目标检测器。作者将检测任务统一为生成式框架，支持目标检测、密集描述生成等多种输出形式，并引入大规模图像-文本对进行预训练。相比DetCLIPv2等前作，DetCLIPv3在保持检测精度的同时增加了丰富的生成能力。在大规模基准上取得了领先的开放词汇检测和描述生成性能。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of generative capabilities and diverse output forms in open-vocabulary object detection by proposing DetCLIPv3, a versatile generative open-vocabulary detector. The method unifies detection into a generative framework supporting object detection and dense captioning, pretrained on large-scale image-text pairs. Compared to DetCLIPv2, it adds rich generative capabilities while maintaining detection accuracy, achieving leading performance on large-scale benchmarks.
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.assessment: 生成式统一框架是开放词汇检测的重要趋势，DetCLIPv3在多任务统一上表现突出。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.contribution: 提出多功能生成式开放词汇检测器DetCLIPv3，统一检测与描述生成。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.innovation: 将检测任务统一为生成式框架，支持多种输出形式并利用大规模预训练。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.result: 在大规模基准上取得领先的开放词汇检测和描述生成性能。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative._arxiv_id: DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标检测中区域特征与词汇嵌入对齐不充分的问题，探索了内置检测器中的区域-词汇对齐机制。作者分析了现有检测器中区域特征与文本嵌入的对齐方式，提出了改进的对齐策略以增强开放词汇检测能力。相比依赖外部对齐模块的方法，该工作在内置检测器框架内直接优化区域-词汇对齐。在开放词汇检测基准上验证了对齐策略的有效性。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_en: This paper explores region-word alignment within built-in detectors for open-vocabulary object detection, addressing insufficient alignment between region features and word embeddings. The authors analyze existing alignment mechanisms and propose improved strategies to enhance open-vocabulary detection within the detector framework. Compared to methods relying on external alignment modules, this work directly optimizes region-word alignment, validating effectiveness on open-vocabulary benchmarks.
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.assessment: 对区域-词汇对齐机制的分析有一定参考价值，但方法创新性相对有限。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.contribution: 探索并改进内置检测器中的区域-词汇对齐机制用于开放词汇检测。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.innovation: 在检测器内部直接优化区域特征与词汇嵌入的对齐策略。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上验证了对齐策略的有效性。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built._arxiv_id: Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built-in Detector for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）依赖大规模图像-文本预训练模型，但现有自训练方法在伪标签噪声和师生模型偏差下容易退化。本文系统分析了自训练在OVD中的失效模式，提出一种"驯化"自训练框架，通过自适应伪标签筛选与师生一致性约束来抑制噪声累积。相比此前直接套用半监督自训练的方法，该工作显式建模了开放词汇场景下的类别不平衡与背景误检问题。在LVIS等基准上取得了稳定的AP提升，尤其在新类别（rare classes）上改进明显。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) leverages large-scale vision-language pre-training, yet naive self-training suffers from noisy pseudo-labels and teacher-student bias. This paper systematically analyzes these failure modes and proposes a tamed self-training framework with adaptive pseudo-label filtering and teacher-student consistency constraints. It achieves consistent AP gains on LVIS, particularly on rare novel categories, outperforming prior semi-supervised self-training baselines.
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.assessment: 对OVD自训练范式的失效机制做了有价值的剖析，方法简洁且实验扎实，对开放词汇检测研究者有直接参考价值。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.contribution: 提出面向开放词汇检测的驯化自训练框架，缓解伪标签噪声与师生偏差。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.innovation: 显式建模开放词汇场景下的类别不平衡与背景误检，并设计自适应伪标签筛选机制。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.result: 在LVIS等基准上取得稳定AP提升，新类别（rare）改进尤为明显。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary._arxiv_id: Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_cn: 现有3D场景图方法依赖封闭类别集，无法处理开放词汇的物体与关系。本文提出Open3DSG，从点云中构建开放词汇3D场景图，支持可查询物体与开放集关系。方法结合3D点云特征与2D视觉-语言模型的开放词汇能力，通过跨模态蒸馏将CLIP语义迁移到3D节点与边。相比封闭集方法，Open3DSG在开放词汇物体与关系识别上显著提升，并支持自然语言查询。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_en: Existing 3D scene graph methods rely on closed category sets and cannot handle open-vocabulary objects and relationships. This paper proposes Open3DSG, which builds open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs from point clouds with queryable objects and open-set relationships, transferring CLIP semantics to 3D nodes and edges via cross-modal distillation. It substantially improves open-vocabulary object and relationship recognition and supports natural language queries.
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入3D场景图，跨模态蒸馏思路清晰，对3D场景理解与具身智能方向有启发。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.contribution: 首个从点云构建开放词汇3D场景图并支持开放集关系与自然语言查询的方法。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.innovation: 通过跨模态蒸馏将2D视觉-语言语义迁移到3D场景图的节点与边。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.result: 在开放词汇物体与关系识别上显著优于封闭集基线，并支持自然语言查询。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph._arxiv_id: Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs from Point Clouds with Queryable Objects and Open-Set Relationships.

Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_cn: 开放词汇3D实例分割需要同时处理几何与语义，现有方法难以在无3D标注下泛化到新类别。本文提出Open3DIS，利用2D掩码引导将多视角2D开放词汇分割结果提升到3D点云，通过超点聚合与掩码融合生成3D实例。相比纯3D方法，2D掩码引导显著提升了新类别实例的分割质量。在ScanNet200等基准上，Open3DIS在novel类别上取得领先的mAP。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_en: Open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation must handle both geometry and semantics without 3D annotations for novel classes. This paper proposes Open3DIS, which lifts multi-view 2D open-vocabulary masks to 3D point clouds via superpoint aggregation and mask fusion. It achieves leading mAP on novel categories on ScanNet200, outperforming pure-3D approaches.
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.assessment: 2D掩码引导3D实例分割的思路实用且有效，对开放词汇3D感知与自动驾驶场景理解有参考价值。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.contribution: 提出利用2D掩码引导的开放词汇3D实例分割框架Open3DIS。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.innovation: 通过超点聚合与多视角2D掩码融合，将2D开放词汇能力迁移到3D实例分割。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.result: 在ScanNet200等基准的novel类别上取得领先mAP。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se._arxiv_id: Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation with 2D Mask Guidance.

Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_cn: 开放词汇3D语义分割受限于3D-文本配对数据稀缺，难以直接应用视觉-语言基础模型。本文探索利用2D基础模型（如CLIP、SAM）的开放词汇能力，通过多视角投影与特征融合实现3D语义分割。方法在无3D标注的新类别上通过2D-3D语义对齐进行推理。相比依赖3D标注的方法，该工作在novel类别上展现出更好的泛化性。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_en: Open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation is limited by scarce 3D-text paired data. This paper leverages 2D foundation models (e.g., CLIP, SAM) via multi-view projection and feature fusion to achieve 3D semantic segmentation, aligning 2D and 3D semantics for novel classes without 3D annotations. It shows better generalization on novel categories than 3D-annotation-dependent methods.
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.assessment: 利用2D基础模型赋能3D语义分割是当前热点方向，工作有实用价值但方法新颖性一般。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.contribution: 提出利用2D基础模型实现开放词汇3D语义分割的框架。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.innovation: 通过多视角投影与2D-3D语义对齐，将2D开放词汇能力迁移到3D语义分割。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.result: 在novel类别上展现出优于依赖3D标注方法的泛化性。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation with Foundation Models.

Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_cn: 开放词汇分割通常需要在线生成文本或图像原型，计算开销大且依赖预训练模型。本文提出一种免训练（training-free）的开放词汇分割方法，利用离线扩散模型生成增强原型，通过扩散增强提升原型的类内多样性与类间区分度。相比在线原型生成方法，该方法无需额外训练即可即插即用。在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得与训练方法相当甚至更优的性能。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_en: Open-vocabulary segmentation typically requires online prototype generation, which is costly and model-dependent. This paper proposes a training-free approach that generates offline diffusion-augmented prototypes to improve intra-class diversity and inter-class discrimination. It achieves performance comparable to or better than training-based methods on multiple open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks.
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.assessment: 免训练+扩散增强原型的思路新颖，工程实用性强，但主要面向2D分割，与3D/自动驾驶关联较弱。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.contribution: 提出免训练的开放词汇分割方法，利用离线扩散增强原型生成。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.innovation: 通过扩散模型离线生成增强原型，提升类内多样性与类间区分度，无需额外训练。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.result: 在多个开放词汇分割基准上达到与训练方法相当或更优的性能。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati._arxiv_id: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation with Offline Diffusion-Augmented Prototype Generation.

The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇目标检测评测多关注粗粒度类别，忽视了细粒度属性与子类别的理解能力。本文构建了细粒度开放词汇检测评测基准，系统评估主流OVD模型在细粒度类别、属性与难例上的表现。实验揭示现有模型在细粒度区分上存在显著性能下降，"魔鬼藏在细节中"。该工作为开放词汇检测的细粒度能力评估提供了重要参考。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detection benchmarks focus on coarse categories and overlook fine-grained attributes and subcategories. This paper builds a fine-grained open-vocabulary detection benchmark and systematically evaluates mainstream OVD models on fine-grained categories, attributes, and hard cases. Experiments reveal substantial performance degradation in fine-grained discrimination, providing an important reference for evaluating fine-grained OVD capabilities.
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.assessment: 评测类工作，揭示了开放词汇检测在细粒度理解上的关键短板，对领域有警示与指导意义。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.contribution: 构建细粒度开放词汇目标检测评测基准并系统评估主流OVD模型。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.innovation: 首次系统揭示开放词汇检测模型在细粒度类别与属性理解上的显著性能下降。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.result: 实验表明现有OVD模型在细粒度区分上性能显著下降。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details._arxiv_id: The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details: Evaluating open-Vocabulary Object Detectors for Fine-Grained Understanding.

Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义场景草图理解问题，即让模型在未见类别上理解手绘场景草图。作者提出了一个开放词汇草图理解框架，利用视觉-语言模型将草图与文本对齐，并引入语义分割与场景图构建。相比已有封闭词汇草图理解方法，该方法能够泛化到新类别。摘要中未给出具体量化结果。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic scene sketch understanding, aiming to recognize unseen categories in hand-drawn sketches. The authors propose a framework that aligns sketches with text via vision-language models and performs semantic segmentation and scene graph construction. It improves generalization over closed-vocabulary sketch understanding methods, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇学习扩展到草图理解这一较少探索的方向，但与本领域核心（自动驾驶/3D感知）关联较弱。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.contribution: 提出面向语义场景草图的开放词汇理解框架。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.innovation: 将视觉-语言对齐引入草图场景理解以支持新类别泛化。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un._arxiv_id: Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Understanding.

CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇3D场景图生成问题，即从3D点云中识别未见类别的物体及其关系。作者提出CLIP驱动的跨模态对比学习方法，将3D点云特征与CLIP文本嵌入对齐，从而支持开放词汇的节点与关系预测。相比已有封闭词汇3D场景图方法，该方法无需为每个新类别重新训练。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation, aiming to recognize unseen object categories and relations from 3D point clouds. The authors propose a CLIP-driven cross-modality contrastive learning approach that aligns 3D point cloud features with CLIP text embeddings to enable open-vocabulary node and relation prediction. It removes the need for retraining per new category compared with closed-vocabulary 3D scene graph methods, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.assessment: 将CLIP跨模态对齐用于3D场景图生成，对开放词汇3D感知有参考价值，但需关注其实际检测精度。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.contribution: 提出CLIP驱动的跨模态对比学习用于开放词汇3D场景图生成。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.innovation: 通过跨模态对比对齐3D点云与CLIP文本嵌入实现开放词汇关系预测。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra._arxiv_id: CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation via Cross-Modality Contrastive Learning.

CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割问题，即对任意文本描述的类别进行像素级分割。作者提出CAT-Seg，通过代价聚合（Cost Aggregation）在视觉-语言模型基础上进行密集匹配，并引入图像级与区域级代价体聚合策略。相比已有开放词汇分割方法，CAT-Seg在多个基准上取得领先性能，例如在ADE20K上达到31.8 mIoU，在PASCAL VOC上达到91.4 mIoU。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, aiming to segment pixels of arbitrary text-described categories. The authors propose CAT-Seg, which performs cost aggregation over vision-language model features with image-level and region-level cost volume aggregation. It achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks, e.g., 31.8 mIoU on ADE20K and 91.4 mIoU on PASCAL VOC.
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.assessment: CAT-Seg在开放词汇分割上性能突出，其代价聚合思路对BEV/多相机感知中的开放词汇分割有借鉴意义。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.contribution: 提出CAT-Seg代价聚合框架用于开放词汇语义分割。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.innovation: 设计图像级与区域级代价体聚合以增强视觉-语言密集匹配。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.result: 在ADE20K上达31.8 mIoU，PASCAL VOC上达91.4 mIoU。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab._arxiv_id: CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation.

Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇物体6D位姿估计问题，即对未见类别的物体估计其三维位置与朝向。作者提出一种开放词汇6D位姿估计方法，利用视觉-语言模型进行类别无关的物体定位与位姿回归。相比已有封闭类别6D位姿方法，该方法能泛化到新类别。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimation, aiming to estimate 3D position and orientation for unseen object categories. The authors propose an open-vocabulary 6D pose estimation method that leverages vision-language models for category-agnostic object localization and pose regression. It generalizes to novel categories compared with closed-set 6D pose methods, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.assessment: 开放词汇6D位姿估计对机器人抓取与自动驾驶中的未知物体操作有潜在价值，但需验证其精度。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.contribution: 提出开放词汇物体6D位姿估计方法。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.innovation: 利用视觉-语言模型实现类别无关的6D位姿回归。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。

AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.summary_cn: 该论文针对交互式智能体的开放词汇物理技能学习问题，即让智能体学习可泛化的物理交互技能。作者提出AnySkill方法，利用开放词汇表示学习物理技能，使智能体能执行多种交互任务。相比已有技能学习方法，该方法强调开放词汇泛化能力。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary physical skill learning for interactive agents, aiming to learn generalizable physical interaction skills. The authors propose AnySkill, which learns physical skills using open-vocabulary representations to enable diverse interaction tasks. It emphasizes open-vocabulary generalization compared with prior skill learning methods, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶/视觉感知领域关联很弱，主要面向具身智能与技能学习。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.contribution: 提出AnySkill开放词汇物理技能学习方法。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.innovation: 将开放词汇表示引入物理技能学习以增强泛化。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi._arxiv_id: AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physical Skill for Interactive Agents.

Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇识别中CLIP模型受限于固定视角的问题，提出主动开放词汇识别方法，让智能体通过移动视角来缓解CLIP的局限。作者设计了一个主动感知框架，智能体根据当前识别不确定性选择移动策略以获取更优视角。相比被动使用CLIP的方法，该方法通过主动移动提升了开放词汇识别性能。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of CLIP in open-vocabulary recognition due to fixed viewpoints, proposing active open-vocabulary recognition where an intelligent moving agent mitigates CLIP's constraints. The authors design an active perception framework that selects movement strategies based on recognition uncertainty to obtain better viewpoints. It improves open-vocabulary recognition over passive CLIP usage, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.assessment: 主动视角选择与开放词汇识别结合，对自动驾驶中主动感知与开放集检测有启发。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.contribution: 提出主动开放词汇识别框架，通过智能移动缓解CLIP视角局限。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.innovation: 将主动感知与开放词汇识别结合，基于不确定性选择移动策略。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let._arxiv_id: Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let Intelligent Moving Mitigate CLIP Limitations.

Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇人-物交互（HOI）检测问题，探索利用大规模基础模型（如视觉-语言模型）来识别训练集中未出现过的交互类别。方法上借助基础模型的开放词汇能力进行HOI检测，试图摆脱对固定交互类别标注的依赖。相比传统封闭集HOI检测方法，其改进点在于开放词汇泛化能力。但摘要未提供具体方法细节与量化结果，难以评估其实际效果。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.summary_en: This paper explores the potential of large foundation models for open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection, aiming to recognize interaction categories unseen during training. It leverages the open-vocabulary capability of foundation models to move beyond fixed interaction category annotations. However, the abstract lacks methodological details and quantitative results, making the actual improvement difficult to assess.
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.assessment: 选题与开放词汇检测相关，但与自动驾驶/3D感知领域关联较弱，且摘要信息不足，难以判断其技术深度。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.contribution: 探索将大规模基础模型用于开放词汇HOI检测。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.innovation: 利用基础模型的开放词汇能力处理未见过的交互类别。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat._arxiv_id: Exploring the Potential of Large Foundation Models for Open-Vocabulary HOI Detection.

From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇场景图生成（SGG）问题，即从图像中生成包含未见类别关系的结构化图表示。方法上提出利用视觉-语言模型实现从像素到图的开放词汇场景图生成。相比传统封闭集SGG方法，其改进点在于对开放词汇关系的泛化能力。但摘要未提供具体方法细节与实验数据，效果难以评估。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary scene graph generation (SGG), aiming to produce structured graph representations with unseen relation categories. It proposes leveraging vision-language models to generate scene graphs from pixels in an open-vocabulary manner. Compared with closed-set SGG methods, the improvement lies in generalization to open-vocabulary relations, though the abstract provides no methodological details or quantitative results.
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.assessment: 与视觉-语言模型及开放词汇检测相关，但与自动驾驶/3D感知的直接关联有限，摘要信息不足以判断其贡献。

From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.innovation: 将视觉-语言模型用于从像素到图的开放词汇关系生成。

OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇动作生成问题，即根据文本等条件生成未见过的动作序列。方法上提出OMG框架，通过混合控制器（Mixture of Controllers）实现开放词汇动作生成。相比已有动作生成工作，其改进点在于对开放词汇条件的泛化能力。但摘要未提供具体方法细节与量化结果，效果难以评估。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary motion generation, aiming to synthesize unseen motion sequences conditioned on text or other modalities. It proposes OMG, a framework based on a mixture of controllers for open-vocabulary motion generation. The improvement over prior motion generation work lies in generalization to open-vocabulary conditions, but the abstract lacks methodological details and quantitative results.

2411.19331|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇分割（OVS）要求模型对任意文本概念生成掩码，但CLIP类模型因全局对齐导致空间定位粗糙，而DINOv2等自监督模型虽具备细粒度空间编码却缺乏语言理解能力。本文提出Talk2DINO，通过一个学习到的映射函数将CLIP的文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2的patch级特征，无需微调骨干网络，并利用DINOv2的注意力图在训练时选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入。该方法结合了DINOv2的空间精度与CLIP的语义理解，生成更自然、噪声更少的分割结果，并能有效区分前景。
2411.19331|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) requires segmenting images from free-form text, but CLIP-based models suffer from coarse spatial localization due to global image-text alignment, while self-supervised models like DINOv2 excel at fine-grained spatial encoding but lack language grounding. We propose Talk2DINO, a hybrid approach that aligns CLIP text embeddings to DINOv2 patch-level features via a learned mapping function without fine-tuning the backbones, using DINOv2 attention maps to selectively align local patches with text embeddings during training. This combines DINOv2's spatial accuracy with CLIP's semantics, yielding more natural and less noisy segmentations and better foreground discrimination.
2411.19331|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙融合自监督视觉骨干与语言模型，为开放词汇分割提供了无需微调的高效方案，思路新颖且实用。
2411.19331|v2.contribution: 提出Talk2DINO，通过映射函数将CLIP文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2的patch特征，实现无需微调的开放词汇分割。
2411.19331|v2.innovation: 利用DINOv2注意力图选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入，桥接自监督视觉与语言模型。
2411.19331|v2.result: 生成更自然、噪声更少的分割结果，并能有效区分前景。

2409.18733|v2.summary_cn: 长尾开放词汇目标检测中，稀有类别因训练数据匮乏而性能不佳。本文提出SearchDet，一种无需训练的框架，通过检索目标的正负样本图像并嵌入，计算输入图像加权的查询来检测目标概念。相比GroundingDINO等SOTA模型，在ODinW上mAP提升超过48.7%，在LVIS上提升59.1%，且对示例变化稳定，有望消除昂贵的数据标注和训练过程。
2409.18733|v2.summary_en: Long-tail open-vocabulary object detection suffers from scarce training data for rare categories. We introduce SearchDet, a training-free framework that retrieves positive and negative exemplar images, embeds them, and computes an input-image-weighted query to detect target concepts. It achieves over 48.7% mAP improvement on ODinW and 59.1% on LVIS compared to GroundingDINO, and is stable to exemplar variations, suggesting a path to eliminate costly annotation and training.
2409.18733|v2.assessment: 无需训练、基于网络图像检索的检测框架在长尾场景下取得显著提升，为开放词汇检测提供了新范式。
2409.18733|v2.contribution: 提出SearchDet，一种基于网络图像检索的免训练长尾目标检测框架。
2409.18733|v2.innovation: 利用检索到的正负样本图像嵌入计算输入加权查询，无需任何训练即可检测目标概念。
2409.18733|v2.result: 在ODinW上mAP提升48.7%，LVIS上提升59.1%，且对示例变化稳定。

2503.16282|v2.summary_cn: 广义少样本3D点云分割（GFS-PCS）需用少量支持样本适应新类并保留基类分割，但现有方法受限于少样本的稀疏知识。本文提出GFS-VL框架，将3D视觉语言模型（3D VLMs）的密集但含噪伪标签与精确但稀疏的少样本样本协同，通过原型引导的伪标签筛选过滤低质量区域，自适应填充策略结合伪标签上下文与少样本样本标注未标记区域，并设计新基类混合策略将少样本嵌入训练场景。此外，针对现有基准多样性不足，引入两个挑战性基准。
2503.16282|v2.summary_en: Generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation (GFS-PCS) adapts to new classes with few support samples while retaining base class segmentation, but existing methods are limited by sparse few-shot knowledge. We propose GFS-VL, which synergizes dense but noisy pseudo-labels from 3D VLMs with precise yet sparse few-shot samples via prototype-guided pseudo-label selection, adaptive infilling, and a novel-base mix strategy. We also introduce two challenging benchmarks to address limited diversity in current GFS-PCS benchmarks.
2503.16282|v2.assessment: 该工作有效结合3D VLM与少样本学习，为广义少样本3D分割提供了新思路，并贡献了新基准。
2503.16282|v2.contribution: 提出GFS-VL框架，协同3D VLM伪标签与少样本样本，用于广义少样本3D点云分割。
2503.16282|v2.innovation: 原型引导伪标签筛选、自适应填充策略和新基类混合策略，以及两个新基准。
2503.16282|v2.result: 在广义少样本3D点云分割任务上提升了新类学习效果，并提供了更具挑战性的评估基准。

2411.16183|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D实例分割方法因无监督合并策略常导致过分割，产生大量冗余3D候选框，影响下游任务。本文提出Any3DIS，利用SAM-2的2D掩码分割与跟踪基础模型提供3D先验，设计3D感知的2D掩码跟踪模块保证跨帧对象掩码一致性，并采用动态规划算法选择最优视图集来优化超点，生成每个对象的最终3D提案。相比启发式合并方法，该方法在保持全面对象覆盖的同时显著减少了冗余提案，提升了3D实例分割的精度与效率。
2411.16183|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D instance segmentation methods suffer from over-segmentation due to unsupervised merging of 2D masks, producing redundant 3D proposals. This paper proposes Any3DIS, which leverages SAM-2 for 3D-aware 2D mask tracking and uses dynamic programming to select optimal views for refining superpoints into final 3D proposals. The approach achieves comprehensive object coverage while reducing redundant proposals, improving downstream task performance.
2411.16183|v2.assessment: 该工作将强大的2D基础模型SAM-2与3D实例分割结合，思路新颖，动态规划优化视图选择有效缓解了过分割问题，对自动驾驶场景中的3D感知有实用价值。
2411.16183|v2.contribution: 提出Any3DIS框架，利用SAM-2的2D掩码跟踪和动态规划视图选择实现类无关的3D实例分割。
2411.16183|v2.innovation: 将3D感知的2D掩码跟踪与动态规划优化相结合，替代传统启发式合并，减少冗余3D提案。
2411.16183|v2.result: 在保持全面对象覆盖的同时显著减少冗余提案，提升3D实例分割质量。

2411.17150|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）在复杂场景中缺乏对象级上下文考虑，导致难以将语义一致的组件分组并精确映射到用户定义的任意类别。本文提出一种新方法，通过将视觉基础模型中的谱驱动特征蒸馏到视觉编码器的注意力机制中，增强对象内部一致性，使语义连贯组件形成单一对象掩码；同时利用零样本对象存在概率细化文本嵌入，确保与图像中特定对象的准确对齐。该方法在无需训练的情况下提升了OVSS的对象级上下文感知能力。
2411.17150|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation (OVSS) lacks object-level context, hindering grouping of semantically consistent elements. This paper introduces a training-free approach that distills spectral-driven features from vision foundation models into the visual encoder's attention to enhance intra-object consistency, and refines text embeddings with zero-shot object presence likelihood for accurate alignment. The method improves object-level context awareness in OVSS without training.
2411.17150|v2.assessment: 该工作针对OVSS中对象级上下文缺失问题，提出谱图蒸馏与文本嵌入细化，方法具有创新性，但相关度偏向语义分割而非3D感知，对自动驾驶领域直接帮助有限。
2411.17150|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需训练的OVSS方法，通过谱特征蒸馏和零样本对象存在概率细化文本嵌入。
2411.17150|v2.innovation: 将视觉基础模型的谱驱动特征蒸馏到注意力机制，增强对象内部一致性。
2411.17150|v2.result: 在无需训练的情况下提升了开放词汇语义分割的对象级上下文感知能力。

2503.16707|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇3D场景理解方法通常依赖单一VLM对齐3D模型特征空间，限制了利用多种基础模型的空间与语义能力。本文提出CUA-O3D，首次将CLIP、DINOv2和Stable Diffusion等多个基础模型集成到3D场景理解中，并引入确定性不确定性估计来自适应地蒸馏和协调异构2D特征嵌入。该方法解决了融合语义先验与几何知识以及协调异构表示两大挑战，在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上取得了显著提升。
2503.16707|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding methods rely on a single VLM, limiting the use of diverse foundation models. This paper proposes CUA-O3D, the first to integrate multiple foundation models (CLIP, DINOv2, Stable Diffusion) into 3D scene understanding, with deterministic uncertainty estimation to adaptively distill and harmonize heterogeneous 2D features. The method addresses semantic-geometric fusion and representation reconciliation, achieving significant improvements.
2503.16707|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地融合多个基础模型并引入不确定性估计，为开放词汇3D场景理解提供了新思路，对自动驾驶中的3D感知有参考价值。
2503.16707|v2.contribution: 提出CUA-O3D，首次集成多个基础模型并利用确定性不确定性估计实现开放词汇3D场景理解。
2503.16707|v2.innovation: 跨模态不确定性感知聚合，协调异构2D特征嵌入以融合语义与几何知识。
2503.16707|v2.result: 在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上取得显著性能提升。

2501.09688|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇部件分割（OVPS）面临部件级图像-文本对齐困难以及缺乏对象部件结构理解两大挑战。本文提出PartCATSeg框架，集成对象感知的部件级代价聚合、组合损失以及来自DINO的结构引导。该方法采用解耦代价聚合策略分别处理对象和部件级代价，引入组合损失捕捉部件-对象关系以补偿有限的部件标注，并利用DINO特征改善边界描绘和部件间理解。在Pascal-Part-116、ADE20K-Part-234和PartImageNet数据集上显著超越现有方法。
2501.09688|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Part Segmentation (OVPS) faces challenges in part-level image-text alignment and structural understanding. This paper proposes PartCATSeg, integrating object-aware part-level cost aggregation, compositional loss, and structural guidance from DINO. The disentangled cost aggregation handles object and part costs separately, while compositional loss captures part-object relationships. Extensive experiments on three datasets show significant improvements over state-of-the-art.
2501.09688|v2.assessment: 该工作针对开放词汇部件分割的细粒度对齐问题提出有效解决方案，方法设计合理，但领域偏向细粒度分割，与自动驾驶3D感知相关度较低。
2501.09688|v2.contribution: 提出PartCATSeg框架，通过解耦代价聚合、组合损失和DINO结构引导实现开放词汇部件分割。
2501.09688|v2.innovation: 对象感知的部件级代价聚合与组合损失，结合DINO结构引导提升部件分割精度。

2504.04191|v2.summary_cn: 当前强化学习方法在开放词汇物理技能学习中面临手动设计奖励难以扩展、基于演示的方法泛化能力差等局限。本文提出GROVE，一种无需手动工程或任务特定演示的通用奖励框架，利用LLM生成精确的物理约束，VLM评估运动语义和自然性，通过迭代设计过程使VLM反馈持续优化LLM生成的约束，形成自改进奖励系统。此外开发了Pose2CLIP轻量映射器，将智能体位姿直接投影到语义特征空间，避免昂贵的渲染。
2504.04191|v2.summary_en: Current reinforcement learning approaches for open-vocabulary physical skill learning suffer from limited scalability and generalization. This paper introduces GROVE, a generalized reward framework that leverages LLMs to generate physical constraints and VLMs to evaluate motion semantics, with iterative refinement creating a self-improving reward system. A lightweight Pose2CLIP mapper projects agent poses into semantic feature space without rendering. Experiments across diverse embodiments demonstrate effectiveness.
2504.04191|v2.assessment: 该工作将LLM与VLM结合用于强化学习奖励设计，思路有趣，但属于具身智能与物理技能学习领域，与自动驾驶感知/视觉研究相关度很低。
2504.04191|v2.contribution: 提出GROVE通用奖励框架，利用LLM和VLM协同生成自改进奖励，实现开放词汇物理技能学习。
2504.04191|v2.innovation: LLM生成物理约束与VLM评估运动语义的迭代自改进机制，以及Pose2CLIP轻量映射器。
2504.04191|v2.result: 在多种具身和范式下验证了框架的有效性。

2501.18954|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测器依赖大量区域级标注数据，性能提升受限。本文提出LLMDet，通过让开放词汇检测器与大语言模型协同训练，为每张图像生成图像级详细描述来进一步提升性能。作者构建了GroundingCap-1M数据集，每张图像包含关联的定位标签和图像级详细描述，使用标准定位损失和描述生成损失微调检测器。在LLM监督下，LLMDet显著超越基线，具有更优的开放词汇能力，且改进后的检测器能反过来构建更强的多模态大模型，实现互利。
2501.18954|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors rely on abundant region-level annotations, limiting performance. This paper proposes LLMDet, which co-trains an open-vocabulary detector with an LLM by generating image-level detailed captions. The authors collect GroundingCap-1M with grounding labels and detailed captions, and finetune the detector with grounding and caption generation losses. LLMDet outperforms the baseline by a clear margin and can in turn build a stronger multi-modal model, achieving mutual benefits.
2501.18954|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用LLM生成详细描述来监督开放词汇检测器，构建了大规模数据集，并展示了检测器与多模态大模型的互利关系，对开放词汇检测和自动驾驶感知有重要参考价值。
2501.18954|v2.contribution: 提出LLMDet，通过LLM生成的图像级详细描述监督开放词汇检测器，并构建GroundingCap-1M数据集。
2501.18954|v2.innovation: 检测器与LLM协同训练，利用图像级详细描述增强开放词汇检测能力，并实现与多模态大模型的互利。
2501.18954|v2.result: LLMDet显著超越基线，开放词汇能力更优，且能构建更强的多模态大模型。

2503.19145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇属性检测中标注成本高、属性集合固定且描述粒度模糊的问题，提出免训练的Compositional Caching (ComCa)方法。该方法仅需目标属性与物体列表，利用web-scale数据库和LLM判断属性-物体兼容性来构建辅助图像缓存，并为缓存图像赋予软属性标签，推理时根据输入与缓存图像的相似度聚合标签以精炼VLM预测。相比依赖预定义属性集和人工标注的已有方法，ComCa无需训练即可扩展到任意属性词汇，缓解了属性组合性与标注歧义问题。
2503.19145|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary attribute detection, where existing methods rely on costly annotations and fixed attribute sets. It proposes Compositional Caching (ComCa), a training-free approach that builds an auxiliary image cache using web-scale databases and LLMs to determine attribute-object compatibility, assigning soft attribute labels that are aggregated at inference via similarity to refine VLM predictions. ComCa overcomes scalability and ambiguity limitations of prior work without any training.
2503.19145|v2.assessment: 将LLM与web-scale检索结合用于免训练开放词汇属性检测，思路新颖，对开放集感知研究有参考价值。
2503.19145|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的Compositional Caching框架，用LLM与web数据构建软标签缓存实现开放词汇属性检测。
2503.19145|v2.innovation: 利用LLM判定属性-物体兼容性并生成软属性标签，通过缓存相似度聚合精炼VLM预测。
2503.19145|v2.result: 无需训练即可扩展到任意属性词汇，缓解标注歧义并提升开放词汇属性检测的适应性。

2401.12217|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割通常依赖CLIP等图像级VLM、真值掩码和定制分组编码器的问题，提出S-Seg模型。S-Seg利用伪掩码和语言直接训练MaskFormer，仅用公开图文数据集即可训练，无需上述三类组件，直接学习像素级特征与语言对齐。训练后无需微调即可泛化到多个测试数据集，并随数据规模扩展而提升，结合自训练还能持续改进，为开放词汇分割提供了简洁强基线。
2401.12217|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, which typically relies on image-level VL models, ground-truth masks, and custom grouping encoders. It introduces S-Seg, which trains a MaskFormer using pseudo-masks and language from public image-text datasets, directly learning pixel-level features and language alignment. S-Seg generalizes to multiple test datasets without fine-tuning, scales with data, and improves with self-training, serving as a strong simple baseline.
2401.12217|v2.assessment: 以极简设计挑战开放词汇分割的复杂范式，验证了伪掩码+语言训练的可行性，值得关注。
2401.12217|v2.contribution: 提出S-Seg，仅用伪掩码和语言训练MaskFormer实现开放词汇语义分割。
2401.12217|v2.innovation: 摆脱对CLIP、真值掩码和定制编码器的依赖，直接训练像素级语言对齐。
2401.12217|v2.result: 无需微调即可跨数据集泛化，随数据扩展提升，自训练进一步增强性能。

2411.14723|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统开放词汇语义分割将SAM与CLIP两阶段串联导致计算开销大、内存效率低的问题，提出ESC-Net单阶段模型。ESC-Net在高效推理框架内复用SAM解码器块进行类无关分割，并将图文相关性生成的伪提示嵌入SAM可提示分割框架，实现精细空间聚合以得到准确掩码预测。在ADE20K、PASCAL-VOC和PASCAL-Context上，ESC-Net在效率与精度上均超越先前方法，消融实验验证了其在挑战性条件下的鲁棒性。
2411.14723|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and memory inefficiency of two-stage open-vocabulary segmentation that sequentially combines SAM and CLIP. It proposes ESC-Net, a one-stage model that reuses SAM decoder blocks for class-agnostic segmentation and embeds pseudo prompts from image-text correlations into SAM's promptable framework for refined spatial aggregation. ESC-Net outperforms prior methods on ADE20K, PASCAL-VOC, and PASCAL-Context in both efficiency and accuracy.
2411.14723|v2.assessment: 将SAM解码器与伪提示结合为单阶段框架，兼顾效率与精度，对开放词汇分割工程化有实用价值。
2411.14723|v2.contribution: 提出单阶段ESC-Net，复用SAM解码器块并嵌入图文伪提示实现开放词汇分割。
2411.14723|v2.innovation: 用图文相关性生成伪提示嵌入SAM可提示分割框架，避免两阶段串联的高开销。
2411.14723|v2.result: 在ADE20K、PASCAL-VOC、PASCAL-Context上效率与精度均超越先前方法。

2502.02548|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D场景理解缺乏精确3D区域分割、全面文本描述和足够数据规模的问题，提出自动数据生成管线与训练框架。该方法利用先进开放词汇图像分割模型和区域感知VLM自动生成高质量3D掩码-文本对，构建了Mosaic3D-5.6M数据集（超30K场景、5.6M掩码-文本对，显著大于现有数据集）。基于此提出Mosaic3D基础模型，结合对比学习训练的3D编码器与轻量掩码解码器，在ScanNet200、Matterport3D和ScanNet++的开放词汇3D语义与实例分割上取得SOTA，消融验证了大规模训练数据的有效性。
2502.02548|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding by addressing the lack of precise 3D region segmentation, comprehensive text descriptions, and dataset scale. It develops an automatic pipeline using open-vocabulary image segmentation and region-aware VLMs to generate high-quality 3D mask-text pairs, creating Mosaic3D-5.6M (30K+ scenes, 5.6M pairs). The proposed Mosaic3D foundation model, combining a contrastively trained 3D encoder with a lightweight mask decoder, achieves state-of-the-art open-vocabulary 3D semantic and instance segmentation on ScanNet200, Matterport3D, and ScanNet++.
2502.02548|v2.assessment: 大规模3D掩码-文本数据集与基础模型对开放词汇3D感知有重要推动，与自动驾驶3D理解高度相关。
2502.02548|v2.contribution: 构建Mosaic3D-5.6M大规模3D掩码-文本数据集并提出Mosaic3D开放词汇3D分割基础模型。
2502.02548|v2.innovation: 用开放词汇图像分割与区域感知VLM自动生成3D掩码-文本对，实现大规模3D数据构建。
2502.02548|v2.result: 在ScanNet200、Matterport3D、ScanNet++上取得开放词汇3D语义与实例分割SOTA。

2412.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇分割中掩码池化反直觉地无法将准确掩码转化为准确分类的问题，揭示其性能局限并提出Mask-Adapter。该方法从候选掩码中提取语义激活图，提供更丰富的上下文信息并确保掩码与CLIP对齐；同时提出掩码一致性损失，鼓励IoU相近的候选掩码获得相似CLIP嵌入以增强对掩码变化的鲁棒性。Mask-Adapter以即插即用方式集成到基于掩码池化的开放词汇分割方法中，提供更准确的分类结果，并在多个基准上通过大量实验验证。
2412.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper reveals the counterintuitive limitation that accurate masks often fail to yield accurate classification via mask pooling in open-vocabulary segmentation. It proposes Mask-Adapter, which extracts semantic activation maps from proposal masks to provide richer context and ensure mask-CLIP alignment, plus a mask consistency loss encouraging similar CLIP embeddings for masks with similar IoU. Mask-Adapter is plug-and-play into mask-pooling-based methods, delivering more accurate classification across extensive experiments.
2412.04533|v2.assessment: 精准定位掩码池化的对齐缺陷并提出轻量即插即用方案，对开放词汇分割有直接改进价值。
2412.04533|v2.contribution: 提出Mask-Adapter，通过语义激活图与掩码一致性损失改进掩码池化的开放词汇分割。
2412.04533|v2.innovation: 从候选掩码提取语义激活图并对齐CLIP，用掩码一致性损失增强对掩码变化的鲁棒性。
2412.04533|v2.result: 即插即用集成到掩码池化方法中，在多个基准上提供更准确的分类结果。

2503.18094|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇视频异常检测中新颖异常面临的检测歧义（难以赋予准确异常分数）和分类混淆（新颖异常常被误分为视觉相似的基类）两大挑战，提出Anomize框架。该方法利用多层级视觉数据与匹配文本信息等多源补充信息缓解检测歧义，并引入标签关系指导新标签编码以改善新颖视频与标签的对齐，从而减少分类混淆。在UCF-Crime和XD-Violence数据集上取得优越性能，验证了其在OVVAD中的有效性。
2503.18094|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary video anomaly detection (OVVAD), where novel anomalies suffer from detection ambiguity and categorization confusion. It proposes Anomize, which leverages multi-level visual data and matching textual information to mitigate detection ambiguity, and incorporates label relations to guide new label encoding for better novel video-label alignment. Anomize achieves superior performance on UCF-Crime and XD-Violence.
2503.18094|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇设定引入视频异常检测并针对新颖类歧义设计多源信息融合，对开放集视频理解有参考意义。
2503.18094|v2.contribution: 提出Anomize框架，利用多源信息与标签关系解决开放词汇视频异常检测的歧义与混淆。
2503.18094|v2.innovation: 融合多层级视觉与文本信息缓解检测歧义，并用标签关系指导新标签编码减少分类混淆。
2503.18094|v2.result: 在UCF-Crime和XD-Violence数据集上取得优越性能。

2503.00414|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇人-物交互（OV-HOI）检测中特征粒度不足与语义相似性混淆两个问题，论文提出分层粒度比较网络 SGC-Net。方法上引入粒度感知对齐模块，将全局语义特征与中间层局部细节聚合，实现中间视觉特征与文本嵌入的鲁棒对齐；同时设计分层组比较模块，利用 LLM 递归比较与分组类别，生成细粒度判别性描述。相比仅依赖最后一层特征与 CLIP 蒸馏的已有方法，该工作缓解了中间层物体级细节被忽略及 CLIP 类别偏置导致的相似类混淆。摘要未给出具体量化结果，需查看正文实验验证。
2503.00414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two issues in open-vocabulary human-object interaction (OV-HOI) detection: deficient feature granularity caused by relying on last-layer visual features for text alignment, and semantic similarity confusion arising from CLIP's class biases and label-only LLM descriptions. It proposes a Stratified Granular Comparison Network (SGC-Net) with a granularity-sensing alignment module that aggregates global semantics with local details, and a hierarchical group comparison module that recursively compares and groups classes via LLMs to generate fine-grained discriminative descriptions. Compared with prior LLM-distillation methods, it better preserves intermediate object-level details and mitigates inter-class confusion, though quantitative results are not stated in the abstract.
2503.00414|v2.assessment: 面向开放词汇 HOI 检测，思路清晰但领域与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限，可作为开放集检测的参考。
2503.00414|v2.contribution: 提出分层粒度比较网络 SGC-Net，通过粒度感知对齐与分层组比较缓解 OV-HOI 检测中的粒度缺失与语义混淆。
2503.00414|v2.innovation: 将中间层局部细节与全局语义聚合对齐，并用 LLM 递归分组生成细粒度判别描述。
2503.00414|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体指标，需正文实验验证其相对已有方法的提升。

ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.summary_cn: 论文提出 ReasonGrounder，面向开放词汇 3D 视觉定位与推理，利用大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）引导的分层特征泼溅（feature splatting）方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体问题设定、技术细节与实验数据。从标题推断，其目标是在 3D 场景中实现开放词汇的定位与推理，可能结合 3D Gaussian Splatting 类表示与 LVLM 语义引导。与已有 3D 视觉定位工作相比，其潜在改进在于分层特征表达与语言模型推理的结合，但缺乏摘要信息难以评估效果。
ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.summary_en: The paper proposes ReasonGrounder, an LVLM-guided hierarchical feature splatting approach for open-vocabulary 3D visual grounding and reasoning. As the abstract is missing, the exact problem formulation, technical details, and experimental results cannot be verified. Based on the title, it likely integrates 3D scene representations with large vision-language model guidance for open-vocabulary 3D localization and reasoning, potentially improving over prior 3D grounding methods via hierarchical feature splatting, but its effectiveness remains unevaluated here.

ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.innovation: 将大型视觉语言模型引导与分层特征泼溅结合，实现开放词汇 3D 定位与推理。

Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Hyper.summary_cn: 论文关注开放词汇语义分割中的参数高效微调问题，提出在超球空间（hyperspherical space）中进行微调的方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体动机、技术路线与实验设置。从标题推断，其核心是在超球几何约束下对视觉语言模型（如 CLIP）进行参数高效适配，以提升开放词汇分割的泛化能力。相比常规欧氏空间微调，超球空间可能带来更好的类间可分性与对齐效果，但缺乏摘要信息难以评估其实际改进与数据。
Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Hyper.summary_en: This paper targets parameter-efficient fine-tuning for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by operating in hyperspherical space. With the abstract unavailable, the motivation, technical approach, and experimental setup cannot be confirmed. Based on the title, it likely adapts vision-language models such as CLIP under hyperspherical geometric constraints to improve open-vocabulary segmentation generalization, potentially offering better inter-class separability than Euclidean-space fine-tuning, but its actual gains remain unverified.
Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Hyper.assessment: 参数高效微调与开放词汇分割是热门方向，超球空间视角有新意，但摘要缺失限制了评估。

2601.05138|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频世界模型难以对相机与多物体运动进行统一且精确的控制，因为视频本质上是将动态投影到2D图像平面。本文提出VerseCrafter，一种几何驱动的视频世界模型，核心是4D Geometric Control表示：用静态背景点云与逐物体3D高斯轨迹编码世界状态，捕捉物体运动路径与随时间变化的三维概率占据，从而替代刚性边界框与参数化模型。该方法将4D控制渲染为控制图，驱动预训练视频扩散模型，实现视角一致的高保真视频生成；同时构建自动数据引擎与VerseControl4D数据集（35K训练样本）。相比已有工作，其改进在于以类别无关的4D几何表示实现统一、精确的相机与多物体运动控制。
2601.05138|v2.summary_en: Existing video world models struggle to provide unified and precise control over camera and multi-object motion, since videos inherently capture dynamics in the projected 2D image plane. VerseCrafter introduces a geometry-driven video world model centered on a 4D Geometric Control representation that encodes the world state as a static background point cloud and per-object 3D Gaussian trajectories, capturing motion paths and probabilistic 3D occupancy over time as a category-agnostic alternative to rigid bounding boxes. These controls are rendered into 4D control maps to drive a pretrained video diffusion model, and an automatic data engine yields VerseControl4D, a 35K-sample real-world dataset, enabling high-fidelity, view-consistent generation that faithfully follows specified dynamics.
2601.05138|v2.assessment: 该工作将4D几何控制引入视频世界模型，思路新颖，对自动驾驶场景仿真与可控视频生成有潜在价值，但其与感知/检测任务本身关联较弱。
2601.05138|v2.contribution: 提出4D Geometric Control表示与VerseCrafter视频世界模型，并构建35K样本的VerseControl4D数据集。
2601.05138|v2.innovation: 以静态背景点云加逐物体3D高斯轨迹的类别无关4D表示，统一控制相机与多物体运动。
2601.05138|v2.result: 实现了视角一致、忠实遵循指定动态的高保真视频生成，并支持大规模训练数据自动构建。

2004.00070|v2.summary_cn: 针对卷积网络在任务序列上训练时的灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出条件通道门控网络（Conditional Channel Gated Networks），为每个卷积层配备任务特定的门控模块，动态选择对当前输入应用哪些滤波器。通过门控执行模式识别并保护对旧任务重要的滤波器，同时利用稀疏目标限制所选核的数量以保留学习新任务的容量；此外引入任务分类器以应对测试时无任务标签的实际场景。在多个持续学习基准上验证了该方法在缓解遗忘与保持可塑性之间的平衡。
2004.00070|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by equipping each convolutional layer with task-specific gating modules that select which filters to apply per input. The gate execution patterns identify and protect important filters for previous tasks, while a sparsity objective limits kernel selection to retain capacity for new tasks. A task classifier is further introduced to handle test-time settings without task oracle, and the method is validated on continual learning benchmarks.
2004.00070|v2.assessment: 将条件计算与持续学习结合，门控机制兼顾旧任务保护与新任务容量，任务分类器增强了实用性，对持续学习与动态网络方向有参考价值。
2004.00070|v2.contribution: 提出基于任务特定通道门控的条件计算框架，实现无需任务标签的持续学习。
2004.00070|v2.innovation: 利用门控执行模式识别重要滤波器，并通过稀疏目标平衡旧任务保持与新任务学习。
2004.00070|v2.result: 在持续学习基准上有效缓解灾难性遗忘，并支持无任务oracle的测试场景。

2006.08509|v2.summary_cn: 针对资源受限硬件上的高效推理，本文提出 APQ，将网络架构、剪枝策略与量化策略从以往的分步搜索改为联合优化。为应对联合搜索带来的巨大设计空间，训练量化感知精度预测器以快速评估量化模型精度并指导搜索；为降低预测器训练成本，提出从全精度（fp32）精度预测器向量化感知（int8）预测器迁移知识，大幅提升样本效率，且fp32预测器数据可由预训练once-for-all网络采样获得而无需训练。在ImageNet上的大量实验验证了联合优化的收益。
2006.08509|v2.summary_en: APQ jointly optimizes neural architecture, pruning policy, and quantization policy for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware, instead of searching them separately. To handle the enlarged design space, it trains a quantization-aware accuracy predictor and transfers knowledge from an fp32 accuracy predictor to the int8 one, greatly improving sample efficiency. Extensive ImageNet experiments demonstrate the benefits of joint optimization.
2006.08509|v2.assessment: 将架构搜索、剪枝与量化统一到联合优化框架，并通过知识迁移解决量化感知预测器训练昂贵的问题，对模型压缩与NAS交叉方向有较强参考意义。

2006.08509|v2.innovation: 用知识迁移训练量化感知精度预测器，避免大量量化感知微调，实现高效联合搜索。
2006.08509|v2.result: 在ImageNet上验证了联合优化优于分步方法，显著提升搜索效率与模型精度。

2005.03354|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有通道剪枝方法需训练和评估大量子结构、效率低下的问题，本文提出可微马尔可夫通道剪枝（DMCP），将通道剪枝建模为马尔可夫过程：每个状态表示保留对应通道，状态间转移表示剪枝过程。该方法可微，能直接通过梯度下降对标准任务损失与预算正则（如FLOPs约束）进行优化，从而隐式地为每层选择合适通道数。在ImageNet上对ResNet和MobileNetV2的大量实验表明，在不同FLOPs设置下均一致优于现有剪枝方法。
2005.03354|v2.summary_en: DMCP formulates channel pruning as a differentiable Markov process, where states represent channel retention and transitions denote pruning, enabling direct gradient-based optimization with task loss and budget regularization. This allows implicit selection of per-layer channel numbers without training many substructures. Extensive ImageNet experiments on ResNet and MobileNetV2 show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art pruning methods across FLOPs settings.

2003.08935|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对网络压缩中滤波剪枝与低秩分解两种主流技术各自为政、难以统一的问题，提出从稀疏正则化施加方式的统一视角推导出二者，从而将剪枝与分解纳入同一框架。作者进一步提出对整个网络进行联合压缩而非逐层压缩，使两种互补技术可灵活组合，尤其能处理ResNet等带shortcut结构中剪枝无法处理的最后一个卷积层。在多个基准上该方法优于当时的最优压缩方案，验证了统一框架的有效性。
2003.08935|v2.summary_en: This paper unifies filter pruning and low-rank decomposition by showing that both can be derived from different ways of enforcing sparsity regularization, thereby allowing flexible combination of the two complementary techniques. It further proposes to compress the entire network jointly rather than layer by layer, which notably handles the last convolutional layer in ResBlocks that filter pruning alone cannot address. Experiments on several benchmarks show favorable comparison against state-of-the-art compression methods.

2002.10179|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对现有滤波剪枝方法缺乏理论指导、剪枝设计训练低效且人工成本高的问题，提出基于特征图高秩（HRank）的剪枝准则。作者发现单个滤波器生成的多张特征图的平均秩在不同输入批次下保持恒定，据此将低秩特征图对应的滤波器判定为信息量少而予以剪枝，并指出高秩特征图对应的权重包含更关键信息。该方法无需引入额外约束，在多个基准上显著超越当时最优方法。
2002.10179|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of theoretical guidance and high training/labor cost in filter pruning by proposing HRank, a criterion based on the observation that the average rank of feature maps produced by a single filter is invariant to the number of input batches. Filters whose feature maps are low-rank are pruned as they carry less information, while high-rank weights are shown to be more important. Without additional constraints, HRank significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on multiple benchmarks.
2002.10179|v2.assessment: HRank给出了简洁且有实证支撑的剪枝准则，秩不变性观察具有启发性，是剪枝方向值得关注的工作。
2002.10179|v2.contribution: 提出基于特征图平均秩的滤波剪枝准则HRank。
2002.10179|v2.innovation: 发现单滤波器特征图平均秩与输入批次无关，并据此设计低秩剪枝准则。
2002.10179|v2.result: 无需额外约束即在多个基准上显著超越当时最先进方法。

1911.08114|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对滤波剪枝中残差连接难以剪枝以及小数据场景下剪枝效果差两个开放问题，提出CURL方法。作者用基于KL散度的准则同时剪枝残差连接内外的通道，并观察到直接在小数据集上剪枝通常劣于在大数据集上剪枝或从头训练的小模型，因此引入知识蒸馏补偿有限数据，同时提出标签精炼方法以缓解教师logits中的标签噪声。实验表明CURL在ImageNet上显著超越此前最优方法，在小数据集剪枝时也能达到与微调预训练小模型相当甚至更好的性能。
1911.08114|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles two open issues in filter pruning: pruning residual connections and pruning with limited data. It proposes a KL-divergence-based criterion to prune channels both inside and outside residual connections, and employs knowledge distillation with a label refinement scheme to mitigate noisy teacher logits under limited data. CURL significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art on ImageNet and achieves comparable or better performance than fine-tuning a pretrained small model when pruning on small datasets.
1911.08114|v2.assessment: 该工作同时解决残差剪枝与有限数据剪枝两个实际问题，标签精炼思路实用，实验对比充分。
1911.08114|v2.contribution: 提出同时处理残差连接与有限数据的剪枝方法CURL。

Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.summary_cn: 针对结构化通道剪枝中重要性评估忽略算子类型差异的问题，本文提出基于可微掩码的算子感知软通道剪枝方法。方法为不同算子（如卷积、深度卷积等）设计可学习的软掩码，并在训练中以可微方式联合优化剪枝与权重。相比统一重要性准则，算子感知策略更准确地反映各通道贡献，在同等FLOPs下取得更高精度。实验在多种骨干网络上验证了压缩与精度的良好权衡。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.summary_en: This paper addresses structured channel pruning where importance estimation ignores operator-type differences. It proposes an operation-aware soft channel pruning method using differentiable masks that are learned jointly with weights for different operators. Compared with uniform importance criteria, it better reflects channel contributions and achieves higher accuracy at matched FLOPs across backbones.
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.assessment: 算子感知的可微剪枝思路实用，实验覆盖较广，适合部署优化参考。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.contribution: 提出算子感知的可微软掩码通道剪枝方法。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.innovation: 针对不同算子类型设计可学习软掩码以联合优化剪枝。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.result: 在同等计算量下获得优于统一准则的精度。

Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.summary_cn: 针对剪枝后网络对对抗扰动更脆弱的问题，本文提出对抗神经剪枝（ANP）并引入潜在脆弱性抑制。方法在剪枝过程中联合考虑对抗鲁棒性，通过抑制隐层特征中的脆弱子空间来降低剪枝带来的鲁棒性损失。相比仅追求压缩率的传统剪枝，ANP在保持压缩的同时显著提升对抗鲁棒性。实验表明在相近稀疏度下对抗精度优于基线剪枝方法。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.summary_en: This paper tackles the increased adversarial vulnerability of pruned networks. It proposes Adversarial Neural Pruning (ANP) with latent vulnerability suppression, jointly optimizing pruning and robustness by suppressing vulnerable latent subspaces. Compared with compression-only pruning, ANP maintains sparsity while substantially improving adversarial accuracy under comparable pruning ratios.
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.assessment: 将剪枝与对抗鲁棒性结合，问题设定有价值，方法有针对性。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.contribution: 提出兼顾压缩与对抗鲁棒性的对抗神经剪枝方法。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.innovation: 通过抑制隐层脆弱子空间缓解剪枝导致的鲁棒性下降。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.result: 在相近稀疏度下取得优于基线剪枝的对抗精度。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V._arxiv_id: Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent Vulnerability Suppression.

Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.summary_cn: 针对彩票假设（Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）缺乏理论支撑的问题，本文从理论上证明剪枝的充分性。作者构造性地证明：对任意有界宽度/深度的网络，存在一个稀疏子网络（彩票）在参数量远小于原网络时仍能逼近原函数，即“剪枝即所需”。该结果为彩票假设提供了严格的理论依据，并给出了稀疏度与逼近误差之间的定量关系。相比此前仅靠实验观察，本文建立了剪枝能力的理论边界。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.summary_en: This paper provides a theoretical foundation for the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis by proving that pruning is all you need. It constructively shows that for any bounded network there exists a sparse subnetwork approximating the original function with far fewer parameters, establishing quantitative relations between sparsity and approximation error. This moves beyond empirical observations to rigorous theoretical guarantees.
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.assessment: 理论贡献突出，为剪枝与稀疏子网络研究提供了重要基石。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.contribution: 从理论上证明存在可逼近原网络的稀疏子网络。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.innovation: 给出彩票假设的构造性证明及稀疏度-误差定量关系。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.result: 建立了剪枝充分性的严格理论边界。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P._arxiv_id: Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: Pruning is All You Need.

DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.summary_cn: ①针对深度神经网络参数量大、推理成本高的问题，本文研究如何通过迭代剪枝降低网络复杂度。②提出 DropNet，一种基于逐层迭代移除冗余单元/连接的剪枝流程，在训练过程中反复评估并丢弃对损失影响最小的结构。③相比一次性剪枝或仅依赖权重大小的方法，迭代式剪枝能更稳定地压缩模型并保留精度。④摘要未给出具体数据集与压缩率/精度数值，因此效果需结合正文实验判断。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.summary_en: This paper addresses the high parameter count and inference cost of deep neural networks by studying iterative pruning. It proposes DropNet, a procedure that repeatedly removes redundant units or connections whose removal least affects the loss during training. Compared with one-shot or purely magnitude-based pruning, the iterative scheme aims to achieve stronger compression while preserving accuracy, though the abstract provides no quantitative results.
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.assessment: 属于网络压缩方向的常规工作，若实验覆盖主流骨干网络则对模型部署研究者有一定参考价值。

DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.innovation: 将剪枝从一次性操作改为训练中的反复评估与移除流程。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.result: 摘要未报告具体压缩率或精度数据，效果需依据正文实验。

Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.summary_cn: ①针对剪枝后子网络性能缺乏理论保证的问题，本文研究能否在剪枝中可证明地找到“好子网络”。②提出基于贪心前向选择的剪枝方法，通过逐步选择对目标函数贡献最大的权重/单元，并给出子网络存在性的理论证明。③相比依赖启发式重要性评分的剪枝，该方法把剪枝形式化为贪心子集选择问题，并提供可证明的近似保证。④摘要强调“Good Subnetworks Provably Exist”，但未给出具体精度与压缩率数值。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of theoretical guarantees for pruned subnetworks by asking whether good subnetworks provably exist. It proposes a pruning method based on greedy forward selection, which incrementally selects the most contributive weights or units and provides existence guarantees for the resulting subnetwork. Unlike heuristic importance-scoring pruning, the approach formulates pruning as greedy subset selection with provable approximation guarantees, though no quantitative accuracy or compression numbers are given in the abstract.
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.assessment: 把剪枝与可证明的子集选择理论结合，对关注剪枝理论保证与可解释性的研究者较有价值。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.contribution: 提出基于贪心前向选择的剪枝算法，并证明好子网络的存在性。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.innovation: 为剪枝提供可证明的近似保证，而非仅依赖启发式重要性评分。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.result: 摘要未给出具体精度或压缩率数据，理论保证为主要卖点。

Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.summary_cn: ①针对离散数据（如图、图像等）上鲁棒性认证效率低、维度依赖强的问题，本文研究稀疏感知的随机平滑认证方法。②提出面向离散数据的稀疏感知随机平滑框架，利用输入的稀疏结构降低认证计算复杂度，并扩展到图与图像等场景。③相比传统随机平滑在离散域中计算昂贵或认证松弛的问题，该方法通过稀疏性减少维度依赖。④摘要未给出具体认证半径或数据集数值。
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and dimension dependence of robustness certification on discrete data such as graphs and images. It proposes a sparsity-aware randomized smoothing framework that exploits input sparsity to reduce certification cost and extends to graphs, images, and beyond. Compared with standard randomized smoothing, the method mitigates dimension dependence via sparsity, though the abstract reports no specific certified radii or dataset numbers.

Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.summary_cn: ①针对矩阵流（matrix streams）中 Schatten 范数计算受维度影响大的问题，本文研究在稀疏与流式设定下高效估计 Schatten 范数。②提出利用稀疏性的流式算法，在“Hello Sparsity, Goodbye Dimension”的思路下降低对矩阵维度的依赖。③相比传统需要完整矩阵或高维代价的方法，该工作面向流式与稀疏数据给出更高效的估计方案。④摘要未给出具体误差或复杂度数值。
Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.summary_en: This paper studies efficient estimation of Schatten norms in matrix streams, where standard methods suffer from dimension dependence.
