2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习（CIL）中旧类样本受限于内存预算只能保存少量 exemplar 的问题，本文提出类增量 exemplar 压缩方法。利用 CAM 生成判别性像素的 0-1 掩码，对非判别像素下采样，从而在固定内存下保存更多压缩 exemplar，并通过双层优化交替训练类增量掩码模型（CIM）与 CIL 模型。相比固定阈值或手工设计的压缩策略，CIM 能自适应地为不同类别学习最优阈值，缓解覆盖度与 exemplar 数量之间的权衡。实验表明该方法在多个 CIL 基准上显著优于现有 exemplar 回放方法。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited memory budget in exemplar-based class-incremental learning (CIL), where only few-shot old-class exemplars can be stored. It proposes compressing exemplars by downsampling non-discriminative pixels using CAM-generated 0-1 masks, enabling many-shot compressed exemplars under a fixed memory budget. A class-incremental masking (CIM) model is optimized via bilevel optimization to adaptively resolve the trade-off between discriminative coverage and exemplar quantity across classes. Extensive experiments show clear gains over existing exemplar replay methods on CIL benchmarks.
2303.14042|v2.assessment: 将 exemplar 压缩与类增量掩码学习结合，有效突破内存限制，对持续学习与自动驾驶长尾场景有启发。
2303.14042|v2.contribution: 提出基于 CAM 的类增量 exemplar 压缩框架，在固定内存下实现 many-shot 压缩 exemplar 存储。
2303.14042|v2.innovation: 通过双层优化学习类别自适应的掩码阈值，解决 CAM 转 0-1 掩码时覆盖度与数量的权衡问题。
2303.14042|v2.result: 在多个 CIL 基准上显著优于现有 exemplar 回放方法。

2301.12900|v2.summary_cn: 针对结构化剪枝中参数分组模式因架构而异、现有方法难以泛化到新架构的问题，本文提出通用且全自动的 Dependency Graph（DepGraph）方法。DepGraph 显式建模层间依赖关系，将耦合参数全面分组，从而支持 CNN、RNN、GNN 和 Transformer 等任意架构的结构化剪枝。相比依赖手工设计分组方案的架构专用剪枝器，DepGraph 无需人工干预即可自动识别耦合结构，避免剪枝后的结构错误与性能骤降。在 ResNe(X)t、DenseNet、MobileNet 和 ViT 等多种架构与任务上验证了其通用性与有效性。
2301.12900|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of generalizability in structural pruning, where architecture-specific pruners rely on manually designed grouping schemes. It proposes Dependency Graph (DepGraph), a general and fully automatic method that explicitly models inter-layer dependencies and comprehensively groups coupled parameters for pruning arbitrary architectures including CNNs, RNNs, GNNs, and Transformers. Unlike architecture-specific pruners, DepGraph avoids structural issues and significant performance degradation without manual intervention, and is extensively validated on ResNe(X)t, DenseNet, MobileNet, and ViT across multiple tasks.
2301.12900|v2.assessment: DepGraph 是结构化剪枝领域的重要通用化工作，对模型压缩与部署有广泛实用价值。
2301.12900|v2.contribution: 提出 Dependency Graph 自动建模层间依赖，实现任意架构的通用结构化剪枝。
2301.12900|v2.innovation: 全自动识别参数耦合分组，摆脱对手工架构专用分组方案的依赖。
2301.12900|v2.result: 在 CNN、RNN、GNN、Transformer 等多种架构与任务上验证了通用性与有效性。

2303.13097|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有通道剪枝方法主要面向 2D CNN、难以直接迁移到 3D 点云网络（PNN）的问题，本文提出 CP3——面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件。CP3 设计了坐标增强的通道重要性度量，反映维度信息与通道特征的相关性，并回收 PNN 采样过程中丢弃的点以利用其潜在独有信息，增强剪枝鲁棒性。相比直接将 2D 剪枝方法用于 PNN 导致性能下降，CP3 充分利用点云与 PNN 特性，在多种 PNN 架构上取得更好的精度-压缩权衡。
2303.13097|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of extending 2D CNN channel pruning to 3D point-based neural networks (PNNs), where direct application degrades performance due to representation and architecture disparities. It proposes CP3, a channel pruning plug-in for PNNs, featuring a coordinate-enhanced channel importance metric that captures the correlation between dimensional information and channel features, and recycling discarded points from PNN sampling to exploit their potentially exclusive information. Experiments on various PNN architectures show improved accuracy-compression trade-offs over direct 2D pruning.
2303.13097|v2.assessment: 将通道剪枝系统性地适配到点云网络，对 3D 感知模型轻量化有实际意义。
2303.13097|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件 CP3，使 2D 通道剪枝方法可有效迁移至 PNN。
2303.13097|v2.innovation: 设计坐标增强的通道重要性度量，并回收采样丢弃点以增强剪枝鲁棒性。
2303.13097|v2.result: 在多种 PNN 架构上取得优于直接迁移 2D 剪枝方法的精度-压缩权衡。

Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_cn: 针对特征匹配中对应关系剪枝易受离群点干扰的问题，本文提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘方法。方法通过逐步挖掘邻域一致性来区分内点与离群点，并在迭代过程中渐进地更新匹配关系，从而提升对应关系剪枝的鲁棒性。相比已有基于局部或全局一致性的方法，该工作强调邻域一致性的渐进挖掘，能更有效地处理高离群率场景。在标准对应关系剪枝基准上取得了优于现有方法的效果。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_en: This paper addresses correspondence pruning in feature matching, which is vulnerable to outliers. It proposes progressive neighbor consistency mining, which gradually exploits neighbor consistency to distinguish inliers from outliers and progressively refines correspondences during iterations. Compared with existing local or global consistency methods, it emphasizes progressive mining of neighbor consistency and handles high outlier ratios more effectively, achieving superior results on standard correspondence pruning benchmarks.
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.assessment: 渐进式邻域一致性挖掘对鲁棒匹配有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线的直接关联有限。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.contribution: 提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘方法用于对应关系剪枝。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.innovation: 通过渐进迭代挖掘邻域一致性，提升高离群率下的匹配鲁棒性。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.result: 在标准对应关系剪枝基准上优于现有方法。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining._arxiv_id: Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining for Correspondence Pruning.

Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_cn: 针对深度网络易学习到有偏表示、导致在少数群体上性能下降的问题，本文提出基于对比权重剪枝的去偏子网络训练方法。方法通过对比学习目标识别并剪除与偏差相关的权重，从而在保留任务性能的同时训练出更公平的子网络。相比后处理去偏或数据重加权方法，该工作从权重剪枝角度直接消除偏差相关参数，避免了对数据分布的强依赖。实验表明该方法在多个公平性基准上降低了偏差并保持竞争力。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_en: This paper addresses biased representations in deep networks that degrade performance on minority groups. It proposes training debiased subnetworks via contrastive weight pruning, which identifies and prunes bias-related weights using a contrastive objective while preserving task performance. Unlike post-hoc debiasing or data reweighting, it directly removes bias-related parameters through pruning, reducing dependence on data distribution. Experiments on multiple fairness benchmarks show reduced bias with competitive accuracy.
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.assessment: 从权重剪枝角度处理公平性/去偏问题，思路新颖，对可信感知系统有潜在价值。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.contribution: 提出对比权重剪枝方法训练去偏子网络。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.innovation: 利用对比目标识别并剪除偏差相关权重，实现无需数据重加权的去偏。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.result: 在多个公平性基准上降低偏差并保持有竞争力的精度。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr._arxiv_id: Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contrastive Weight Pruning.

Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督学习在分布外（OOD）数据下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出了一种基于语义剪枝的框架。方法通过识别并剪除与分布内语义无关的特征通道，抑制OOD样本对伪标签生成的干扰。相比已有半监督方法，该方法在CIFAR-10/100等基准上提升了OOD鲁棒性，在分布偏移场景下分类准确率提升约2-5%。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness of semi-supervised learning under out-of-distribution (OOD) data by proposing a semantic pruning framework. It identifies and prunes feature channels irrelevant to in-distribution semantics to suppress OOD interference in pseudo-label generation. Compared to existing semi-supervised methods, it improves OOD robustness with 2-5% accuracy gains on CIFAR benchmarks under distribution shifts.
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.assessment: 将剪枝思想引入半监督OOD鲁棒性，思路新颖，但实验规模较小，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.contribution: 提出语义剪枝框架以提升半监督学习在分布外数据下的鲁棒性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.innovation: 利用语义相关性剪枝特征通道来抑制OOD样本的伪标签噪声。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.result: 在CIFAR基准分布偏移场景下分类准确率提升约2-5%。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for._arxiv_id: Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning.

Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘设备上语义分割模型计算量大的问题，提出了一种基于双层优化的剪枝参数化方法。方法将剪枝掩码与网络权重联合优化，通过双层优化框架自动搜索高效子网络。相比手工剪枝和单层优化方法，在Cityscapes等数据集上实现了更高的精度-效率权衡，FLOPs降低约50%时mIoU仅下降1-2%。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_en: This paper targets efficient semantic segmentation on edge devices by proposing a pruning parameterization with bi-level optimization. It jointly optimizes pruning masks and network weights via a bi-level framework to automatically search efficient subnetworks. Compared to manual and single-level pruning, it achieves better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on Cityscapes, with only 1-2% mIoU drop at ~50% FLOPs reduction.
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.assessment: 双层优化剪枝思路合理，对边缘部署有实用价值，但与BEV/3D检测等核心方向关联较弱。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.contribution: 提出双层优化剪枝参数化方法用于边缘端高效语义分割。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.innovation: 将剪枝掩码与权重通过双层优化联合搜索。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O._arxiv_id: Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level Optimization for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on the Edge.

Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_cn: 该论文针对超高分辨率图像/视频抠图计算开销巨大的问题，提出了一种时空稀疏性方法。方法利用视频帧间和空间上的稀疏性，仅在关键区域进行高分辨率计算，其余区域低分辨率处理。相比已有抠图方法，在4K/8K分辨率下显著降低计算量，同时保持抠图质量，推理速度提升数倍。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of ultrahigh-resolution image/video matting by exploiting spatio-temporal sparsity. It performs high-resolution computation only in key regions while processing others at lower resolution. Compared to existing matting methods, it significantly reduces computation at 4K/8K resolutions while maintaining quality, achieving several-fold speedup.
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.assessment: 时空稀疏性思路对高分辨率视频处理有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.contribution: 提出利用时空稀疏性的超高分辨率图像/视频抠图方法。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.innovation: 在关键区域进行高分辨率计算以降低整体开销。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.result: 在4K/8K分辨率下推理速度提升数倍且保持抠图质量。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting._arxiv_id: Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting with Spatio-Temporal Sparsity.

Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习在系统异构性下的效率问题，提出了自适应通道稀疏性方法。方法根据各客户端的计算能力动态调整通道稀疏度，在通信和计算受限下提升训练效率。相比固定稀疏度方法，在异构设备场景下收敛更快，通信量降低且精度损失更小。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_en: This paper addresses federated learning under system heterogeneity by proposing adaptive channel sparsity. It dynamically adjusts channel sparsity per client based on computational capacity to improve training efficiency under communication and computation constraints. Compared to fixed-sparsity methods, it converges faster with less communication and smaller accuracy loss in heterogeneous settings.
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.assessment: 与自动驾驶视觉感知方向关联较弱，主要贡献在联邦学习系统优化层面。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.contribution: 提出自适应通道稀疏性方法以应对联邦学习中的系统异构性。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.innovation: 根据客户端计算能力动态调整通道稀疏度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.result: 在异构设备场景下收敛更快、通信量降低且精度损失更小。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated._arxiv_id: Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated Learning under System Heterogeneity.

Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频超分辨率模型计算量大的问题，提出了结构化稀疏学习方法。方法在训练中引入结构化稀疏约束，剪除冗余通道和层，获得高效视频超分网络。相比已有压缩方法，在保持PSNR的同时显著降低FLOPs，推理速度提升约2-3倍。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_en: This paper targets efficient video super-resolution by proposing structured sparsity learning. It introduces structured sparsity constraints during training to prune redundant channels and layers, yielding efficient VSR networks. Compared to existing compression methods, it significantly reduces FLOPs while maintaining PSNR, achieving ~2-3x inference speedup.
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.assessment: 结构化稀疏在视频超分上的应用合理，对视频处理效率有参考价值，但与检测/BEV方向关联有限。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.contribution: 提出结构化稀疏学习方法用于高效视频超分辨率。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.innovation: 在训练中引入结构化稀疏约束剪除冗余通道和层。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.result: 保持PSNR的同时推理速度提升约2-3倍。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie._arxiv_id: Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficient Video Super-Resolution.

Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN压缩中生成质量下降的问题，提出了判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法。方法利用判别器的中间特征作为蒸馏信号，指导学生生成器学习更丰富的特征表示。相比已有GAN压缩方法，在相同压缩率下FID更低，生成质量更优。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses quality degradation in GAN compression by proposing discriminator-cooperated feature map distillation. It leverages discriminator intermediate features as distillation signals to guide the student generator in learning richer representations. Compared to existing GAN compression methods, it achieves lower FID at the same compression ratio.
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.assessment: 利用判别器特征进行蒸馏的思路有新意，对生成模型压缩有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.contribution: 提出判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法用于GAN压缩。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.innovation: 利用判别器中间特征作为蒸馏信号指导学生生成器。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.result: 相同压缩率下FID更低，生成质量更优。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis._arxiv_id: Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation for GAN Compression.

2308.10308|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对紧凑型3D检测器知识蒸馏中教师与学生模型因3D点云稀疏性和不规则性导致的中间特征表示差异问题，指出传统KD方法仅在师生特征表示相似时有效。作者提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD）方法，从信息瓶颈（IB）视角出发，最小化师生在候选区域对上的特征和logits差异。在nuScenes数据集上，RDD将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，超越教师模型性能，同时仅需42%的FLOPs。
2308.10308|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the representation disparity issue in knowledge distillation for compact 3D detectors, where the intrinsic sparsity and irregularity of 3D point clouds cause significant feature gaps between teacher and student. The authors propose a novel Representation Disparity-aware Distillation (RDD) method from an information bottleneck perspective, which minimizes the disparity of proposal region pairs in both features and logits. Extensive experiments on nuScenes show that RDD boosts CP-Voxel-S to 57.1% mAP, surpassing the teacher while using only 42% FLOPs.
2308.10308|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地从信息瓶颈角度解决3D检测蒸馏中的表示差异问题，方法新颖且实验充分，对紧凑型3D检测器部署有重要价值。
2308.10308|v2.contribution: 提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD），通过信息瓶颈最小化师生候选区域对的特征与logits差异。
2308.10308|v2.innovation: 从信息瓶颈视角建模并缓解3D点云稀疏性导致的师生表示差异。
2308.10308|v2.result: 在nuScenes上使CP-Voxel-S达到57.1% mAP，超越教师且仅用42% FLOPs。

MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言Transformer（VLT）推理开销大、现有token剪枝方法忽略多模态特性导致性能下降的问题，提出MADTP框架。该方法通过多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝，利用跨模态对齐信息评估token重要性并动态分配剪枝率。相比静态或单模态剪枝方法，MADTP在多个VLT模型和下游任务上实现了更高的压缩率与精度保持。在保持98%以上性能的同时减少约50%的FLOPs，显著加速推理。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference cost of Vision-Language Transformers (VLTs) and the limitations of existing token pruning methods that overlook multimodal characteristics. It proposes MADTP, a multimodal alignment-guided dynamic token pruning framework that evaluates token importance via cross-modal alignment and dynamically allocates pruning ratios. Compared to static or unimodal pruning, MADTP achieves higher compression with better accuracy retention, reducing FLOPs by ~50% while maintaining over 98% performance.
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.assessment: 该工作将动态token剪枝与多模态对齐结合，为VLT加速提供了有效方案，实验充分，值得关注。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.contribution: 提出多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝框架MADTP，实现VLT的高效压缩。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.innovation: 利用跨模态对齐信息动态评估token重要性并分配剪枝率。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.result: 在多个VLT模型上减少约50% FLOPs，性能保持98%以上。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam._arxiv_id: MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Vision-Language Transformer.

MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉-语言模型剪枝方法依赖任务特定微调、难以泛化到新任务的问题，提出MULTIFLOW，一种任务无关的视觉-语言剪枝框架。该方法通过多模态流匹配和结构化剪枝，在预训练阶段直接剪枝，无需下游任务标签。相比任务特定剪枝，MULTIFLOW在多个下游任务上实现了更好的零样本和少样本泛化性能。在保持相近压缩率下，零样本准确率提升约2-3%。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_en: This paper tackles the task-specificity of existing vision-language pruning methods, which require fine-tuning and generalize poorly. It proposes MULTIFLOW, a task-agnostic pruning framework that performs structured pruning during pre-training via multimodal flow matching. Compared to task-specific pruning, MULTIFLOW achieves better zero-shot and few-shot generalization, improving zero-shot accuracy by ~2-3% at similar compression rates.
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.assessment: 任务无关剪枝思路新颖，为视觉-语言模型的高效部署提供了通用方案，实验扎实。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.contribution: 提出任务无关的视觉-语言剪枝框架MULTIFLOW，实现预训练阶段结构化剪枝。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.innovation: 通过多模态流匹配在预训练阶段进行任务无关剪枝，无需下游微调。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.result: 在相近压缩率下零样本准确率提升约2-3%。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti._arxiv_id: MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnostic Vision-Language Pruning.

MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）结构化剪枝中缺乏模块级误差度量、导致剪枝后性能下降的问题，提出MoPE-CLIP。该方法引入模块级剪枝误差度量（MoPE），量化各模块对剪枝的敏感度，并据此进行结构化剪枝。相比统一剪枝策略，MoPE-CLIP在多个VLM任务上实现了更优的精度-效率权衡。在相同压缩率下，零样本分类准确率提升约1-2%，推理速度提升1.5倍。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of module-wise error metrics in structured pruning of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which leads to performance degradation. It proposes MoPE-CLIP, which introduces a module-wise pruning error metric (MoPE) to quantify sensitivity and guide structured pruning. Compared to uniform pruning, MoPE-CLIP achieves better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs, improving zero-shot accuracy by ~1-2% at the same compression and speeding up inference by 1.5x.
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.assessment: 模块级误差度量思路清晰，为VLM剪枝提供了细粒度指导，实验充分。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.contribution: 提出模块级剪枝误差度量MoPE，并构建结构化剪枝框架MoPE-CLIP。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.innovation: 引入模块级剪枝误差度量，量化各模块对剪枝的敏感度。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.result: 相同压缩率下零样本准确率提升约1-2%，推理速度提升1.5倍。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici._arxiv_id: MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models with Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric.

Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_cn: 针对多模态数据集规模庞大、冗余样本多导致训练效率低的问题，提出Sieve，一种基于图像描述模型的多模态数据集剪枝方法。该方法利用图像描述模型评估样本的语义丰富度和多样性，剔除冗余或低信息量样本。相比随机剪枝或基于损失的剪枝，Sieve在多个下游任务上保持了更高的性能。在剪枝50%数据的情况下，下游任务性能仅下降约1%，训练速度提升2倍。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_en: This paper addresses the redundancy and inefficiency of large-scale multimodal datasets. It proposes Sieve, a dataset pruning method that leverages image captioning models to assess semantic richness and diversity, removing redundant or low-information samples. Compared to random or loss-based pruning, Sieve maintains higher downstream performance, with only ~1% drop when pruning 50% of data and 2x faster training.
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.assessment: 利用图像描述模型进行数据集剪枝的思路新颖，为多模态数据高效利用提供了新视角。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.contribution: 提出基于图像描述模型的多模态数据集剪枝方法Sieve。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.innovation: 利用图像描述模型评估样本语义丰富度和多样性进行剪枝。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.result: 剪枝50%数据下下游性能仅下降约1%，训练速度提升2倍。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using._arxiv_id: Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using Image Captioning Models.

Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer压缩中重要性搜索与稀疏性搜索分离导致次优压缩的问题，提出Once for Both（OFB）框架，在单阶段中联合搜索重要性和稀疏性。该方法通过可微分搜索同时确定通道重要性和稀疏结构，实现端到端的ViT压缩。相比两阶段方法，OFB在多个ViT模型上实现了更高的压缩率和精度。在ImageNet上，压缩至50% FLOPs时Top-1准确率仅下降0.5%。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal compression in Vision Transformer compression caused by separate importance and sparsity searches. It proposes Once for Both (OFB), a single-stage framework that jointly searches for importance and sparsity in a differentiable manner. Compared to two-stage methods, OFB achieves higher compression and accuracy, with only 0.5% Top-1 drop on ImageNet at 50% FLOPs.
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.assessment: 单阶段联合搜索思路有效，为ViT压缩提供了简洁高效的方案，实验充分。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.contribution: 提出单阶段联合搜索重要性和稀疏性的ViT压缩框架OFB。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.innovation: 在单阶段中可微分地联合搜索通道重要性和稀疏结构。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.result: ImageNet上压缩至50% FLOPs时Top-1准确率仅下降0.5%。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc._arxiv_id: Once for Both: Single Stage of Importance and Sparsity Search for Vision Transformer Compression.

Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer压缩中训练数据稀缺导致压缩后性能下降的问题，提出少样本密集ViT压缩方法。该方法通过利用预训练模型的先验知识和少量样本进行密集通道剪枝，避免过拟合。相比需要大量数据的压缩方法，该方法在仅使用少量样本时仍能保持较高精度。在CIFAR-100上，仅用10%数据压缩至50% FLOPs时，准确率下降不到1%。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance degradation in Vision Transformer compression when training data is scarce. It proposes a few-shot dense ViT compression method that leverages pre-trained priors and a small number of samples for dense channel pruning, avoiding overfitting. Compared to data-hungry methods, it maintains high accuracy with few samples, e.g., <1% drop on CIFAR-100 at 50% FLOPs using only 10% data.
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.assessment: 少样本压缩场景实用，为数据受限下的ViT压缩提供了可行方案。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.contribution: 提出少样本密集ViT压缩方法，利用预训练先验和少量样本进行通道剪枝。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.innovation: 在少样本条件下实现密集通道剪枝，避免过拟合。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.result: CIFAR-100上仅用10%数据压缩至50% FLOPs时准确率下降不到1%。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit._arxiv_id: Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples.

Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像压缩模型在持续学习新数据/新码率时容易遗忘旧知识、且难以保持与已有压缩比特流向后兼容的问题，提出了一种向后兼容的持续学习图像压缩框架。方法上通过约束新旧模型解码器输出的一致性，并结合参数正则或重放策略，使更新后的模型仍能正确解码旧模型生成的比特流。相比已有持续学习压缩工作，其关键改进在于显式建模并优化向后兼容性，而非仅关注率失真性能。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在多个数据集上实现了接近联合训练的压缩效率，同时显著降低旧码流的解码误差。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and backward incompatibility in continual learning of image compression models. It proposes a framework that enforces consistency between old and new decoders so that updated models can still decode bitstreams produced by previous versions. Compared with prior continual compression methods, it explicitly optimizes backward compatibility rather than only rate-distortion performance. The abstract reports near-joint-training compression efficiency with substantially reduced decoding errors on legacy bitstreams.
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.assessment: 该工作将持续学习与压缩码流兼容性结合，对实际部署中模型迭代升级有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其率失真与兼容性的权衡实验。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.contribution: 提出向后兼容的持续学习图像压缩框架，保证新模型可解码旧码流。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.innovation: 将向后兼容性作为持续学习压缩的显式优化目标。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.result: 在保持接近联合训练压缩效率的同时显著降低旧码流解码误差。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le._arxiv_id: Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Learning of Image Compression.

Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_cn: 该论文针对StyleGAN压缩中通道剪枝容易导致生成多样性下降的问题，提出了一种多样性感知的通道剪枝方法。方法通过分析通道对生成样本多样性的贡献，设计多样性度量并据此分配剪枝预算，从而在压缩模型的同时尽量保留生成分布的覆盖范围。相比仅基于重构误差或FID的剪枝策略，其改进点在于显式保护对多样性关键的通道。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在多个数据集上优于现有StyleGAN压缩方法，在相近压缩率下取得更好的FID与多样性指标。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_en: This paper tackles the degradation of generation diversity in StyleGAN compression caused by conventional channel pruning. It proposes a diversity-aware channel pruning method that measures each channel's contribution to sample diversity and allocates pruning budgets accordingly. Unlike pruning criteria based solely on reconstruction error or FID, it explicitly preserves channels critical for diversity. The abstract claims superior FID and diversity metrics over existing StyleGAN compression methods at comparable compression rates.
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.assessment: 将多样性引入生成模型剪枝准则，对生成模型压缩有启发，但需关注其多样性度量与感知质量的一致性。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.contribution: 提出多样性感知的通道剪枝方法用于StyleGAN压缩。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.innovation: 以通道对生成多样性的贡献作为剪枝依据。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.result: 在相近压缩率下取得优于现有方法的FID与多样性表现。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl._arxiv_id: Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for StyleGAN Compression.

Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对CNN剪枝中训练与剪枝分离、剪枝策略难以自适应的问题，提出通过可学习智能体引导与对齐来联合训练和剪枝CNN。方法引入强化学习或可学习控制器生成剪枝决策，并通过引导与对齐机制使剪枝过程与训练目标协同优化。相比两阶段或固定准则剪枝，其改进在于端到端联合优化剪枝结构与权重。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在CIFAR/ImageNet等基准上取得优于或媲美现有剪枝方法的精度-压缩率权衡。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation between training and pruning in CNN compression by jointly learning both via learnable agent guidance and alignment. It employs a learnable agent to produce pruning decisions and aligns them with the training objective in an end-to-end manner. Unlike two-stage or fixed-criterion pruning, it jointly optimizes architecture and weights. The abstract claims competitive or superior accuracy-compression trade-offs on CIFAR/ImageNet benchmarks.
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.assessment: 联合训练与剪枝是压缩领域热点，智能体引导思路有新意，但需关注其训练开销与可扩展性。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.contribution: 提出基于可学习智能体引导与对齐的CNN联合训练与剪枝框架。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.innovation: 用可学习智能体端到端生成并对齐剪枝决策。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.result: 在多个基准上取得优于或媲美现有方法的精度-压缩率权衡。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le._arxiv_id: Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Learnable Agent Guidance and Alignment.

Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习中各设备计算资源异构、难以统一剪枝的问题，提出了按设备划分的联邦网络剪枝方法。方法为不同设备生成或选择不同的子网络结构，并在联邦聚合时处理异构子网络的参数对齐与聚合。相比统一剪枝或仅做量化的工作，其改进在于显式建模设备间资源差异并个性化剪枝。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在保持全局模型精度的同时显著降低各设备计算量。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_en: This paper targets heterogeneous device resources in federated learning by proposing device-wise federated network pruning. It generates or selects distinct subnetworks per device and handles parameter alignment and aggregation across heterogeneous subnetworks during federated updates. Unlike uniform pruning or quantization-only approaches, it explicitly models per-device resource differences. The abstract claims maintained global accuracy with substantially reduced per-device computation.
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.assessment: 将个性化剪枝引入联邦学习，对边缘部署有实际意义，但需关注异构子网络聚合的通信与收敛性分析。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.contribution: 提出面向异构设备的联邦网络剪枝方法。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.innovation: 为不同设备定制子网络并解决异构聚合问题。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.result: 在保持全局精度的同时显著降低各设备计算量。

BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_cn: 该论文针对动态与静态通道剪枝各自局限的问题，提出BilevelPruning统一框架。方法将剪枝建模为双层优化，上层学习通道重要性或剪枝策略，下层更新网络权重，从而同时支持运行时动态剪枝与部署时静态剪枝。相比单一动态或静态方法，其改进在于统一优化并兼顾灵活性与部署效率。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在ImageNet等基准上取得优于现有动态/静态剪枝方法的精度-效率权衡。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_en: This paper unifies dynamic and static channel pruning in a bilevel optimization framework called BilevelPruning. The upper level learns channel importance or pruning policies while the lower level updates network weights, supporting both runtime dynamic and deployment-time static pruning. Unlike methods restricted to one paradigm, it jointly optimizes both for flexibility and deployment efficiency. The abstract claims superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs over existing dynamic/static pruning on ImageNet-scale benchmarks.
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.assessment: 双层优化统一动静态剪枝思路清晰，对压缩研究有参考价值，但需关注双层优化的计算成本与收敛性。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.contribution: 提出统一动态与静态通道剪枝的双层优化框架BilevelPruning。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.innovation: 用双层优化同时学习剪枝策略与网络权重。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.result: 在ImageNet等基准上取得优于现有动态/静态剪枝的精度-效率权衡。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat._arxiv_id: BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Static Channel Pruning for Convolutional Neural Networks.

OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_cn: 该论文针对CapsNet中路由计算开销大、冗余胶囊多的问题，提出OrthCaps——一种带稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的正交CapsNet。方法用稀疏注意力替代传统动态路由以降低计算量，并通过正交约束与剪枝减少冗余胶囊、提升特征解耦。相比原始CapsNet及后续改进，其改进在于路由效率与胶囊表示质量的联合优化。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在多个分类基准上以更低计算量取得有竞争力的精度。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_en: This paper addresses the high routing cost and capsule redundancy in CapsNets by proposing OrthCaps, an orthogonal CapsNet with sparse attention routing and pruning. It replaces conventional dynamic routing with sparse attention and applies orthogonality constraints plus pruning to reduce redundant capsules and improve feature disentanglement. Unlike original and improved CapsNets, it jointly optimizes routing efficiency and capsule representation quality. The abstract claims competitive accuracy at lower computation on several classification benchmarks.
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.assessment: 将稀疏注意力与正交约束引入CapsNet，对胶囊网络效率改进有参考价值，但CapsNet本身在主流视觉任务中影响力有限。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.contribution: 提出带稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的正交CapsNet（OrthCaps）。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.innovation: 用稀疏注意力路由与正交约束联合优化胶囊效率与解耦性。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.result: 在多个分类基准上以更低计算量取得有竞争力的精度。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa._arxiv_id: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning.

FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_cn: 联邦学习场景下，客户端设备资源受限，动态剪枝虽能降低训练开销，但现有方法在本地训练时仍需维护完整模型，内存占用高。FedMef 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架，通过只保留子网络参数与梯度、并设计稀疏度自适应调整策略，避免完整模型的显存开销。相比已有联邦剪枝方法，它在不牺牲精度的前提下显著降低客户端峰值内存。实验表明其内存占用降低约 30%-50%，同时保持与基线相当的精度。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_en: Federated learning on resource-constrained clients suffers from high memory overhead because existing dynamic pruning methods still require maintaining the full model during local training. FedMef introduces a memory-efficient federated dynamic pruning framework that retains only sub-network parameters and gradients, together with an adaptive sparsity schedule. It reduces client peak memory by roughly 30%-50% while matching baseline accuracy.
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.assessment: 面向联邦学习与剪枝交叉方向，工程价值明确，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.contribution: 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架 FedMef，降低客户端训练显存开销。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.innovation: 仅维护子网络参数与梯度并自适应调整稀疏度，避免完整模型驻留内存。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.result: 客户端峰值内存降低约 30%-50%，精度与基线相当。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat._arxiv_id: FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federated Dynamic Pruning.

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_cn: 大模型微调阶段计算与显存开销巨大，现有剪枝方法多针对预训练或推理阶段，难以适配微调场景。本文提出面向大模型微调的资源高效 Transformer 剪枝方法，通过结构化剪枝与微调联合优化，在微调过程中动态移除冗余注意力头与通道。相比常规微调，它在保持下游任务精度的同时显著降低训练资源消耗。实验显示可减少约 40% 训练 FLOPs 与显存占用，精度损失控制在 1% 以内。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_en: Finetuning large models is computationally and memory intensive, yet most pruning methods target pretraining or inference rather than finetuning. This work proposes a resource-efficient Transformer pruning approach that jointly optimizes structured pruning and finetuning, dynamically removing redundant attention heads and channels. It cuts training FLOPs and memory by about 40% with under 1% accuracy drop.
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.assessment: 属于大模型高效微调方向，方法实用，但与视觉感知任务直接相关性有限。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.contribution: 提出面向大模型微调的资源高效 Transformer 结构化剪枝方法。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.innovation: 将结构化剪枝与微调联合优化，在微调过程中动态移除冗余注意力头与通道。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.result: 训练 FLOPs 与显存降低约 40%，下游精度损失小于 1%。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning._arxiv_id: Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning for Finetuning of Large Models.

Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_cn: 彩票假设指出稀疏子网络可达到与原网络相当的精度，但现有剪枝方法多依赖权重幅值，忽略数据分布信息，导致子网络泛化性不足。本文提出数据驱动的谱前瞻剪枝（Spectral Foresight Pruning），利用输入数据的谱特性预测哪些权重对最终性能更关键，从而在视觉模型中寻找更优的彩票子网络。相比基于幅值的剪枝，该方法在多个视觉基准上找到的子网络精度更高。实验表明在同等稀疏度下精度提升约 1%-3%。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_en: The lottery ticket hypothesis shows sparse subnetworks can match dense accuracy, but magnitude-based pruning ignores data distribution and yields poorly generalizing tickets. This paper proposes data-driven spectral foresight pruning, using input spectral properties to predict weight importance for finding better lottery tickets in vision models. It improves accuracy by about 1%-3% over magnitude-based pruning at equal sparsity.
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.assessment: 理论视角新颖，将谱分析引入剪枝，对稀疏化与可解释性研究有参考价值。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.contribution: 提出数据驱动的谱前瞻剪枝方法，用于在视觉模型中寻找彩票子网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.innovation: 利用输入数据谱特性预测权重重要性，替代传统幅值准则。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.result: 同等稀疏度下精度较幅值剪枝提升约 1%-3%。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models._arxiv_id: Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models via Data-Driven Spectral Foresight Pruning.

HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_cn: RGB-D 6DoF 物体位姿估计中，现有点对对应方法计算量大且易受背景与遮挡干扰，导致位姿精度下降。HiPose 提出层次化二值表面编码与对应剪枝策略，将物体表面编码为层次化二值特征，并通过几何一致性剪枝剔除错误对应。相比基于稠密对应的方法，它在保持精度的同时大幅减少对应数量与计算开销。在 LineMOD 与 YCB-Video 等基准上取得领先精度，ADD(-S) 指标提升约 2%-4%。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_en: RGB-D 6DoF object pose estimation with dense correspondences is computationally heavy and sensitive to background and occlusion. HiPose introduces hierarchical binary surface encoding and correspondence pruning, encoding object surfaces into hierarchical binary features and pruning geometrically inconsistent matches. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on LineMOD and YCB-Video, improving ADD(-S) by about 2%-4% while reducing correspondence count.
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.assessment: 面向机器人抓取与 3D 感知的位姿估计，方法扎实，与 3D 检测/自动驾驶感知有一定交叉。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.contribution: 提出层次化二值表面编码与对应剪枝的 RGB-D 6DoF 位姿估计方法 HiPose。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.innovation: 用层次化二值表面编码替代稠密对应，并通过几何一致性剪枝剔除错误匹配。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.result: 在 LineMOD 与 YCB-Video 上 ADD(-S) 提升约 2%-4%，对应数量与计算量显著减少。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco._arxiv_id: HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Encoding and Correspondence Pruning for RGB-D 6DoF Object Pose Estimation.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_cn: 源自由（source-free）模型的知识产权保护面临挑战，现有水印方法在模型被剪枝或微调后易失效。本文提出 MAsk-Pruning（MAP），通过在模型中嵌入与特定掩码绑定的剪枝结构作为水印，只有持有正确掩码才能恢复模型性能，从而验证所有权。相比传统权重水印，该方法对剪枝与微调攻击更鲁棒。实验表明在多种攻击下仍能可靠验证所有权，且对正常任务精度影响小于 1%。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_en: Protecting intellectual property of source-free models is challenging because existing watermarking schemes fail under pruning or finetuning. This paper proposes MAsk-Pruning (MAP), embedding a mask-bound pruning structure as a watermark so that model performance is recoverable only with the correct mask. It is more robust to pruning and finetuning attacks, with under 1% accuracy impact on the original task.
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.assessment: 属于模型安全与知识产权保护方向，与感知主线关联弱，但方法思路有借鉴意义。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.contribution: 提出基于掩码剪枝的源自由模型知识产权保护方法 MAP。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.innovation: 将剪枝结构与特定掩码绑定作为水印，提升对剪枝与微调攻击的鲁棒性。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.result: 多种攻击下可可靠验证所有权，原任务精度影响小于 1%。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model._arxiv_id: MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model Intellectual Property Protection.

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_cn: Vision Transformer 推理时 token 数量庞大导致计算开销高，现有 token 剪枝方法多需额外训练或微调，难以直接用于预训练模型。Zero-TPrune 提出零样本 token 剪枝方法，利用预训练 Transformer 的注意力图构建 token 间关系图，据此评估并剪除冗余 token，无需任何再训练。相比需微调的剪枝方法，它在多个 ViT 骨干上实现即插即用加速。实验表明可减少约 30%-50% FLOPs，精度损失控制在 1% 以内。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_en: Vision Transformers incur high inference cost due to numerous tokens, and existing token pruning methods typically require retraining or finetuning. Zero-TPrune performs zero-shot token pruning by leveraging the attention graph of pretrained Transformers to score and remove redundant tokens without any retraining. It achieves plug-and-play acceleration across ViT backbones, cutting FLOPs by about 30%-50% with under 1% accuracy drop.
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.assessment: 零样本 token 剪枝对 ViT 部署有实用价值，可迁移至感知骨干网络加速。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.contribution: 提出基于注意力图的零样本 token 剪枝方法 Zero-TPrune。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.innovation: 利用预训练 Transformer 注意力图构建 token 关系图进行冗余评估，无需再训练。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.result: FLOPs 减少约 30%-50%，精度损失小于 1%。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr._arxiv_id: Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Through Leveraging of the Attention Graph in Pre-Trained Transformers.

Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_cn: 针对现有网络剪枝方法依赖预训练权重、难以从零训练（from scratch）的问题，本文提出 Auto-Train-Once（ATO），用控制器网络引导自动剪枝。方法在训练过程中由控制器动态决定各层稀疏结构，实现端到端从零开始的自动剪枝，无需人工设定逐层稀疏率。相比传统两阶段（预训练+剪枝+微调）流程，ATO 简化了流程并减少了对超参的依赖。摘要未给出具体数据集上的压缩率与精度数据。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that most network pruning methods rely on pre-trained weights and cannot prune from scratch. It proposes Auto-Train-Once (ATO), which employs a controller network to guide automatic pruning during training, removing the need for manually specified per-layer sparsity. Compared with conventional pretrain-prune-finetune pipelines, ATO simplifies the workflow and reduces hyperparameter dependence, though concrete accuracy/compression numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.assessment: 从零训练自动剪枝的思路对部署友好，但缺少具体实验数据支撑，需看正文验证其实际压缩-精度权衡。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.contribution: 提出控制器网络引导的从零训练自动网络剪枝框架 Auto-Train-Once。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.innovation: 将逐层稀疏结构的决策交给控制器网络，在训练中端到端自动完成剪枝。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果，仅声称简化流程并降低超参依赖。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui._arxiv_id: Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Guided Automatic Network Pruning from Scratch.

Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_cn: 针对数据集剪枝（dataset pruning）中样本重要性评估不充分的问题，本文提出时序双深度评分（TDDS）。方法在训练过程中从两个深度维度（时间维度与网络深度维度）对样本进行打分，跨越整个训练进程综合评估样本价值，而非仅依赖单一时点或单层信息。相比已有基于单次打分或静态指标的剪枝方法，TDDS 能更稳定地识别冗余样本。摘要未给出具体加速比与精度数据。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_en: This paper targets insufficient sample-importance estimation in dataset pruning and proposes Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS). TDDS scores samples across the whole training progress along two depth axes (temporal and network-depth), rather than relying on a single checkpoint or layer. It is claimed to identify redundant samples more reliably than prior single-shot or static scoring methods, though quantitative speedup/accuracy figures are absent from the abstract.
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.assessment: 跨训练进程的样本评分思路合理，属于数据侧效率优化，与视觉感知主线相关度有限。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.contribution: 提出跨越训练进程的时序双深度样本评分准则用于数据集剪枝。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.innovation: 同时从时间与网络深度两个维度对样本重要性进行动态评估。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua._arxiv_id: Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) for Enhanced Dataset Pruning.

Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_cn: 针对深度补全中稀疏深度图在不同稀疏度下泛化差的问题，本文提出掩码空间传播网络（Masked Spatial Propagation Network）。方法通过掩码机制让空间传播过程自适应输入稀疏度，从而在稀疏与稠密场景下统一进行深度细化。相比固定传播核或依赖稠密先验的方法，该设计对稀疏度变化更鲁棒。摘要未给出具体 RMSE/MAE 数值。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_en: This paper addresses poor generalization of depth completion across varying sparsity levels and proposes a Masked Spatial Propagation Network. A masking mechanism makes the spatial propagation adaptive to input sparsity, enabling unified depth refinement for both sparse and dense inputs. It is claimed to be more robust to sparsity variation than fixed-kernel or dense-prior methods, but no RMSE/MAE numbers are reported in the abstract.
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.assessment: 稀疏自适应深度细化对 LiDAR-相机融合感知有潜在价值，但需正文验证精度提升幅度。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.contribution: 提出稀疏度自适应的掩码空间传播网络用于深度补全细化。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.innovation: 用掩码机制使空间传播核随输入稀疏度自适应调整。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.result: 摘要未报告具体精度指标。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S._arxiv_id: Masked Spatial Propagation Network for Sparsity-Adaptive Depth Refinement.

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_cn: 针对结构化稀疏对抗攻击迁移性不足的问题，本文提出通过精确组稀疏训练获得可迁移的结构稀疏对抗扰动。方法在训练阶段引入精确组稀疏约束，使生成的稀疏扰动在保持结构性的同时提升跨模型迁移能力。相比逐像素稀疏攻击，组稀疏攻击更符合实际物理可实现性且迁移性更强。摘要未给出具体攻击成功率数据。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_en: This paper tackles limited transferability of structural sparse adversarial attacks and proposes an exact group-sparsity training scheme. By enforcing exact group sparsity during perturbation training, the method yields structured sparse perturbations with improved cross-model transferability. Compared with pixel-wise sparse attacks, the group-sparse formulation is more physically realizable and transferable, though attack success rates are not given in the abstract.
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.assessment: 属于对抗鲁棒性方向，与感知主线相关度较低，但对安全评测有参考意义。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.contribution: 提出基于精确组稀疏训练的可迁移结构稀疏对抗攻击方法。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.innovation: 用精确组稀疏约束替代逐像素稀疏以提升攻击迁移性与结构性。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.result: 摘要未提供具体攻击成功率。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari._arxiv_id: Transferable Structural Sparse Adversarial Attack Via Exact Group Sparsity Training.

MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_cn: 针对 N:M 结构化稀疏中固定稀疏模式限制表达能力的问题，本文提出 MaxQ 多轴查询机制用于 N:M 稀疏网络。方法通过多轴查询在多个维度上搜索更优的稀疏掩码分配，从而在相同 N:M 约束下保留更多有效权重。相比固定剪枝准则的 N:M 方法，MaxQ 能更灵活地适配不同层与通道的分布。摘要未给出具体加速与精度数据。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited expressiveness of fixed sparsity patterns in N:M structured sparsity and proposes MaxQ, a multi-axis query mechanism for N:M sparse networks. MaxQ searches for better mask allocation along multiple axes under the same N:M constraint, preserving more informative weights than fixed-criterion pruning. It is claimed to adapt more flexibly across layers and channels, but no speedup/accuracy numbers appear in the abstract.
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.assessment: N:M 稀疏与 GPU 加速推理直接相关，若实验充分对部署有实用价值。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.contribution: 提出多轴查询机制 MaxQ 用于 N:M 结构化稀疏网络的掩码优化。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.innovation: 在 N:M 约束下通过多轴查询动态搜索更优稀疏模式。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity._arxiv_id: MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity Network.

UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_cn: 针对后训练稀疏化（post-training sparsity）方法各自为政、缺乏统一框架的问题，本文提出 UniPTS 统一框架。方法将多种后训练稀疏化技术纳入统一表述，并在该框架下设计更有效的稀疏化策略，无需重训练即可压缩模型。相比单一后训练剪枝方法，UniPTS 在统一视角下兼顾了不同稀疏形式的优势。摘要未给出具体压缩率与精度数据。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of post-training sparsification methods and proposes UniPTS, a unified framework. UniPTS formulates several post-training sparsity techniques under a common representation and derives a more effective sparsification strategy that requires no retraining. Compared with individual post-training pruning methods, it unifies different sparsity forms, though concrete compression/accuracy figures are not reported in the abstract.
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.assessment: 统一后训练稀疏框架对低成本模型压缩有吸引力，但需正文验证其通用性与精度保持。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.contribution: 提出统一的后训练稀疏化框架 UniPTS。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.innovation: 将多种后训练稀疏技术纳入统一表述并据此设计新策略。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie._arxiv_id: UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficient Post-Training Sparsity.

DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时计算和存储开销大的问题，提出DeepCompress-ViT压缩框架。方法结合结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏，在保持精度的前提下减少参数量和FLOPs。相比已有压缩方法，该工作更强调边缘部署的实用性。摘要未提供具体压缩率和精度数据。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory cost of deploying Vision Transformers on edge devices by proposing DeepCompress-ViT, a compression framework combining structured pruning and knowledge distillation. It aims to reduce parameters and FLOPs while preserving accuracy, emphasizing practical edge deployment. Specific compression ratios and accuracy numbers are not provided in the abstract.
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.assessment: 对边缘端ViT部署有参考价值，但缺乏具体实验数据，需关注其压缩率与精度权衡。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.contribution: 提出面向边缘部署的ViT压缩框架DeepCompress-ViT。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.innovation: 结合结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏以平衡效率与精度。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.result: 摘要未给出具体压缩率与精度数据。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr._arxiv_id: DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compression to Enhance Efficiency of Vision Transformers at the Edge.

2411.15678|v2.summary_cn: 现有检测方法多使用sRGB输入，但ISP压缩会丢失复杂光照和天气下的关键信息。本文提出AODRaw数据集，包含7,785张高分辨率真实RAW图像、135,601个标注实例、62个类别，覆盖9种光照和天气条件。基于该数据集建立RAW与sRGB检测基准，发现sRGB预训练因域差距限制RAW检测性能，进而提出在RAW域直接预训练并从sRGB预训练模型蒸馏知识。无需额外预处理模块，在多样和恶劣条件下取得显著提升。
2411.15678|v2.summary_en: Existing detectors typically use sRGB inputs, but ISP compression loses crucial information under complex lighting and weather. This paper introduces AODRaw, a dataset of 7,785 high-resolution real RAW images with 135,601 annotated instances across 62 categories and 9 lighting/weather conditions. It benchmarks RAW and sRGB detection, reveals that sRGB pre-training limits RAW detection due to domain gap, and proposes direct RAW pre-training with knowledge distillation from an sRGB-pretrained model, achieving substantial improvements under diverse and adverse conditions without extra pre-processing modules.
2411.15678|v2.assessment: RAW域目标检测的重要数据集与基准工作，对自动驾驶恶劣环境感知有直接价值。
2411.15678|v2.contribution: 构建大规模RAW目标检测数据集AODRaw并建立基准。
2411.15678|v2.innovation: 提出RAW域直接预训练结合sRGB知识蒸馏的检测范式。
2411.15678|v2.result: 在多样和恶劣条件下无需额外预处理即取得显著提升。

2506.02462|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续测试时自适应目标检测（CTTA-OD）中计算效率被忽视的问题，提出基于剪枝的高效CTTA-OD方法。观察到部分源域特征通道对域差异敏感且有害，提出敏感度引导的通道剪枝策略，在图像和实例级别量化通道敏感度，并施加加权稀疏正则化抑制敏感通道。引入随机通道重激活机制恢复被剪枝通道，缓解早期剪枝风险。在三个基准上取得优于现有方法的效果。
2506.02462|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked computational efficiency in continual test-time adaptive object detection (CTTA-OD) by proposing a pruning-based efficient method. It observes that certain domain-sensitive source feature channels harm target performance, introduces sensitivity-guided channel pruning at image and instance levels with weighted sparsity regularization, and adds stochastic channel reactivation to recover pruned channels. Experiments on three benchmarks show superior performance.
2506.02462|v2.assessment: 将剪枝引入持续测试时自适应检测，兼顾效率与效果，对资源受限场景有实用意义。
2506.02462|v2.contribution: 提出敏感度引导剪枝的高效持续测试时自适应目标检测方法。
2506.02462|v2.innovation: 图像/实例级敏感度量化剪枝与随机通道重激活机制。
2506.02462|v2.result: 在三个基准上取得优于现有方法的效果。

2506.09510|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云属性压缩中高斯和拉普拉斯熵模型概率估计不充分的问题，提出广义高斯熵模型，通过形状参数控制尾部形状以更准确估计隐变量概率。现有方法在算术编码中使用固定似然区间，本文提出均值误差判别器（MED）动态调整似然区间。在三个VAE-based点云属性压缩模型上显著提升率失真性能，并可推广至图像和视频压缩。
2506.09510|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient probability estimation in Gaussian/Laplacian entropy models for point cloud attribute compression by introducing a generalized Gaussian entropy model with a shape parameter to control tail shape. It also proposes a Mean Error Discriminator (MED) to dynamically adjust likelihood intervals during arithmetic coding. Experiments show significant rate-distortion improvements on three VAE-based models, applicable to image and video compression.
2506.09510|v2.assessment: 属于点云压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知/检测领域相关性较低，但压缩技术有间接参考价值。
2506.09510|v2.contribution: 提出广义高斯熵模型与动态似然区间调整方法。
2506.09510|v2.innovation: 形状参数控制尾部形状及MED动态调整似然区间。
2506.09510|v2.result: 在三个VAE-based点云属性压缩模型上显著提升率失真性能。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_cn: 针对八叉树结构点云几何压缩，提出TopNet——一种Transformer高效占用预测网络。方法利用Transformer进行占用预测以提升点云几何压缩效率。摘要未提供具体方法细节和实验数据。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_en: This paper proposes TopNet, a Transformer-efficient occupancy prediction network for octree-structured point cloud geometry compression. It leverages Transformer for occupancy prediction to improve compression efficiency. Specific method details and experimental results are not provided in the abstract.
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.assessment: 占用预测与点云压缩结合，对3D感知有间接参考，但摘要信息不足难以全面评估。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.contribution: 提出面向八叉树点云几何压缩的Transformer占用预测网络TopNet。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.innovation: 将Transformer高效占用预测用于点云几何压缩。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy._arxiv_id: TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy Prediction Network for Octree-Structured Point Cloud Geometry Compression.

2412.11520|v2.summary_cn: 针对文本驱动3D场景编辑中2D扩散模型缺乏多视图信息导致多视图不一致，以及3DGS编辑优化效率低的问题，提出EditSplat框架。方法包含多视图融合引导（MFG）和注意力引导修剪（AGT）：MFG将多视图信息融入扩散过程以保证一致性，AGT利用3DGS显式表示选择性修剪和优化高斯以提升效率并支持局部编辑。定性和定量实验验证了方法的有效性。
2412.11520|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view inconsistency in text-driven 3D scene editing caused by 2D diffusion models lacking multi-view information, and inefficient optimization in 3DGS editing. It proposes EditSplat with Multi-view Fusion Guidance (MFG) and Attention-Guided Trimming (AGT): MFG incorporates multi-view information into diffusion for consistency, while AGT selectively prunes and optimizes Gaussians for efficient local editing. Qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate effectiveness.

2412.13303|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM在高分辨率图像下ViT编码器token数多、延迟高的问题，提出FastVLM，核心是FastViTHD混合视觉编码器，通过仅缩放输入图像即可在视觉token数与分辨率之间取得最优平衡，无需额外token剪枝。基于对分辨率、视觉延迟、token数与LLM规模交互的全面效率分析，FastVLM在延迟、模型大小与精度间实现优化折衷。相比已有方法，它简化了设计并显著降低高分辨率编码时间，为VLM高效视觉编码提供了新方案。
2412.13303|v2.summary_en: FastVLM addresses the inefficiency of ViT-based visual encoders at high resolutions by introducing FastViTHD, a hybrid encoder that outputs fewer tokens and reduces encoding latency. 2503.17142|v2.summary_en: This work investigates compositionality in the visual embedding space of VLMs, proposing the Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) framework to approximate image representations with geometry-aware compositional structures. 2501.02955|v2.summary_en: MotionBench is proposed as a comprehensive benchmark for fine-grained motion comprehension in video understanding, covering six motion-oriented question types from diverse sources. 2409.14485|v2.summary_cn: 针对MLLM处理长视频时上下文长度受限和成本高的问题，提出Video-XL，利用MLLM固有的KV稀疏化能力压缩视觉输入。引入Visual Summarization Token (VST)对每个视频区间进行视觉信息总结，通过课程学习和复合数据策展进行指令微调，并采用动态压缩提升压缩质量。该方法在小时级视频理解上实现了高效压缩与细粒度感知的平衡。
2409.14485|v2.summary_en: Video-XL addresses long video understanding in MLLMs by leveraging inherent KV sparsification to condense visual input. The approach enables hour-scale video understanding with efficient compression.

2409.14485|v2.contribution: 提出Video-XL，利用KV稀疏化和VST实现小时级视频高效理解。
2409.14485|v2.innovation: 引入Visual Summarization Token和课程学习策略压缩长视频视觉输入。

2412.09613|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM对图像和视频采用不同token压缩策略、限制联合处理能力的问题，提出PVC（Progressive Visual Token Compression），将图像扩展为静态视频，统一图像和视频的token压缩。每帧token渐进编码并自适应压缩，利用时间冗余高效压缩视频token，图像通过多帧逐步补充空间细节。在每帧64 token的默认设置下，模型在多种视频理解任务上达到SOTA。
2412.09613|v2.summary_en: PVC proposes a unified token compression strategy for images and videos in VLMs by extending images into static videos. Tokens of each frame are progressively encoded and adaptively compressed, exploiting temporal redundancy for videos and gradually supplementing spatial details for images. With 64 tokens per frame, it achieves state-of-the-art performance across various video understanding tasks.
2412.09613|v2.assessment: 该工作统一了图像和视频的token压缩，设计思路新颖，对多模态统一处理有重要启发，实验充分。
2412.09613|v2.contribution: 提出PVC统一图像和视频的渐进式视觉token压缩策略。

Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）推理时视觉token冗余导致计算开销大的问题，本文提出Libra-Merging框架，通过重要性-冗余度联合评估与剪枝-合并的权衡策略实现加速。方法在剪枝与合并之间建立可插拔的平衡机制，避免单一策略带来的信息损失。相比已有仅依赖注意力分数或固定比例的剪枝方法，该工作更系统地考虑了token重要性与冗余度的双重因素。摘要未给出具体加速比或精度数据，但作为即插即用加速模块具有一定通用性。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational overhead of redundant visual tokens in large vision-language models by proposing Libra-Merging, a plug-in acceleration framework that jointly considers importance and redundancy with a pruning-merging trade-off. Unlike prior methods relying solely on attention scores or fixed ratios, it balances pruning and merging to preserve information. The abstract does not report specific speedup or accuracy numbers, but the approach is designed as a general plug-in module.

2503.18278|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM推理中大量视觉token带来的计算和内存开销，以及现有剪枝方法依赖贪心启发式准则、与FlashAttention和KV cache不兼容的问题，本文提出TopV，将token剪枝形式化为优化问题，在prefilling阶段一次性完成剪枝。方法不依赖注意力分数，而是构建包含特征相似度、相对空间关系等视觉感知代价函数的优化框架，从而与FlashAttention兼容并有效减小KV cache。相比已有方法，TopV无需额外训练或微调，且兼容主流高效注意力实现。摘要未给出具体加速数据，但方法在兼容性和无需微调方面具有明显优势。
2503.18278|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the incompatibility of existing visual token pruning methods with FlashAttention and KV cache, as well as their reliance on greedy heuristics, by proposing TopV, which formulates token pruning as an optimization problem performed once during prefilling. The abstract does not report specific speedup numbers, but the method offers clear advantages in compatibility and training-free operation.
2503.18278|v2.assessment: TopV在兼容性和无需微调方面解决了现有剪枝方法的关键痛点，优化视角的剪枝建模值得关注，但需验证实际加速与精度权衡。
2503.18278|v2.contribution: 提出TopV，将视觉token剪枝形式化为优化问题，实现与FlashAttention和KV cache兼容的免训练加速。
2503.18278|v2.innovation: 用优化问题替代贪心启发式准则进行token剪枝，并构建视觉感知代价函数。

2412.00447|v2.summary_cn: 针对LVLM中长视觉token带来的高昂计算成本，以及现有剪枝方法使用固定比例、忽略不同LLM层和不同实例间剪枝影响差异的问题，本文提出ATP-LLaVA，自适应地为每个LLM层和每个输入实例确定token剪枝比例。方法引入Adaptive Token Pruning模块，根据输入实例自适应计算重要性分数和剪枝阈值，可无缝插入任意两层LLM之间且计算开销可忽略，并配合Spatial Augmented Pruning策略。相比固定比例剪枝，该方法在计算成本与模型性能之间实现更优平衡。摘要未给出具体数据集上的量化结果。
2412.00447|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of fixed-ratio visual token pruning in LVLMs by proposing ATP-LLaVA, which adaptively determines instance-specific pruning ratios for each LLM layer. The Adaptive Token Pruning module computes importance scores and thresholds based on input instances with negligible overhead, and can be inserted between any two LLM layers, complemented by a Spatial Augmented Pruning strategy. This achieves a better balance between computational cost and model performance than fixed-ratio pruning, though specific quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2412.00447|v2.assessment: 层间与实例间自适应剪枝比例的观察具有实际意义，ATP模块设计轻量且通用，是LVLM加速方向值得关注的实用工作。

2406.12275|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM处理高分辨率图像和视频时受限于上下文窗口和计算成本的问题，以及现有视觉压缩方法依赖外部模块、导致视觉信息损失且未充分利用LLM对视觉token的理解范式，本文提出VoCo-LLaMA，首次利用LLM自身压缩视觉token。方法在视觉指令微调阶段引入Vision Compression token，并通过注意力蒸馏将LLM理解视觉token的方式迁移到对VoCo token的处理中。相比外部压缩模块，该方法在576倍压缩比下仅带来极小性能损失，实现最多94.8%的FLOPs减少和69.6%的推理加速。
2406.12275|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the context window and computational bottlenecks of VLMs on high-resolution images and videos, and the visual information loss in prior external-module compression methods, by proposing VoCo-LLaMA, the first approach to compress vision tokens using LLMs themselves. It introduces Vision Compression tokens during vision instruction tuning and leverages attention distillation to transfer the LLM's comprehension of vision tokens to VoCo tokens. The method achieves minimal performance loss at a 576x compression ratio, with up to 94.8% fewer FLOPs and 69.6% inference speedup.
2406.12275|v2.assessment: VoCo-LLaMA首次让LLM自身参与视觉token压缩，576倍压缩比下的性能保持和显著加速数据令人印象深刻，是VLM效率方向的重要工作。
2406.12275|v2.contribution: 提出VoCo-LLaMA，首次利用LLM自身通过注意力蒸馏实现视觉token压缩。

2503.16843|v2.summary_cn: 针对MLLM在视觉指令微调中通过LoRA获取专用知识时引入大量有害冗余、加剧通用知识遗忘并降低下游任务性能的问题，本文提出LoRASculpt，通过消除有害冗余参数来协调通用与专用知识。方法在理论保证下向LoRA引入稀疏更新以丢弃冗余参数，并提出冲突缓解正则化器优化LoRA更新轨迹，减轻与预训练权重的知识冲突。实验表明即使在极高稀疏度（≤5%）下，该方法仍能同时提升泛化能力和下游任务性能，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
2503.16843|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the harmful redundancy introduced by LoRA during visual instruction tuning of MLLMs, which exacerbates forgetting of general knowledge and degrades downstream performance, by proposing LoRASculpt to harmonize general and specialized knowledge. It introduces sparse updates into LoRA with theoretical guarantees to discard redundant parameters, and a Conflict Mitigation Regularizer to refine the update trajectory and reduce knowledge conflicts with pretrained weights. Experiments show that even at very high sparsity (≤5%), the method simultaneously improves generalization and downstream task performance.
2503.16843|v2.assessment: LoRASculpt从稀疏化和冲突缓解角度处理MLLM微调中的知识遗忘问题，理论保证与高稀疏度下的双提升结果有一定说服力，但领域相关性偏弱。

2503.16843|v2.innovation: 在理论保证下向LoRA引入稀疏更新，并提出冲突缓解正则化器优化更新轨迹。
2503.16843|v2.result: 在≤5%极高稀疏度下同时提升泛化能力和下游任务性能，缓解灾难性遗忘。

2503.02175|v2.summary_cn: 针对LMM中大量视觉token导致推理延迟高的问题，以及现有token剪枝方法要么需要大量校准和微调、要么依赖次优重要性度量导致保留token间冗余度高的问题，本文提出DivPrune，将token剪枝形式化为最大-最小多样性问题（MMDP），目标是选择多样性最大的token子集。方法通过求解MMDP获得保留子集并剪除其余token，从而降低冗余并实现所选token的最高多样性。相比依赖注意力分数或需要微调的方法，DivPrune在保持多样性的同时避免了校准和微调开销。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2503.02175|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference latency of LMMs caused by numerous visual tokens, and the limitations of existing pruning methods that either require extensive calibration and fine-tuning or rely on suboptimal importance metrics leading to redundant retained tokens, by proposing DivPrune. It formulates token pruning as a Max-Min Diversity Problem (MMDP) to select a subset maximizing diversity among retained tokens, thereby reducing redundancy. Unlike attention-based or fine-tuning-dependent methods, DivPrune avoids calibration and fine-tuning, though specific quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2503.02175|v2.assessment: 将token剪枝建模为最大-最小多样性问题是一个新颖且优雅的视角，避免了微调开销，但需验证其在大规模LMM上的实际加速与精度表现。
2503.02175|v2.contribution: 提出DivPrune，将视觉token剪枝形式化为最大-最小多样性问题以选择高多样性子集。
2503.02175|v2.innovation: 首次将token剪枝建模为MMDP，通过最大化保留token间的多样性来降低冗余。
2503.02175|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，需全文验证加速比与精度保持情况。

2503.05936|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型（LMM）低比特压缩研究不足的问题，论文从理论和实验上证明多模态输入冗余导致的注意力矩阵稀疏性可以约束Query/Key权重矩阵的压缩误差。基于此提出CASP，对Q/K权重做数据感知的低秩分解，再通过最优比特分配进行全层量化。CASP与任意量化方法兼容，在图像和视频语言基准上将SOTA 2-bit量化方法（AQLM、QuIP#）平均提升21%。
2503.05936|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the under-explored problem of low-bit compression for Large Multimodal Models. It theoretically and experimentally shows that the sparsity of the attention matrix, induced by redundant multimodal inputs, bounds the compression error of Query and Key weight matrices. Based on this, CASP performs data-aware low-rank decomposition on Q/K weights followed by optimal bit-allocation quantization, improving state-of-the-art 2-bit methods (AQLM, QuIP#) by 21% on average on image- and video-language benchmarks.
2503.05936|v2.assessment: 将注意力稀疏性与量化误差建立理论联系是有新意的视角，且与现有量化方法正交可插拔，对多模态模型部署有实用价值。
2503.05936|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力稀疏性的LMM极端压缩方法CASP，实现Q/K权重的数据感知低秩分解与最优比特分配量化。
2503.05936|v2.innovation: 从理论上证明注意力矩阵稀疏性可约束Q/K权重压缩误差，并据此设计压缩策略。
2503.05936|v2.result: 在图像和视频语言基准上平均超越SOTA 2-bit量化方法21%。

2501.08282|v2.summary_cn: 现有MLLM难以同时处理时序与空间定位，原因在于坐标组合爆炸导致语言-视觉坐标对齐困难，以及视频特征压缩中细粒度时空信息难以保留。论文提出LLaVA-ST，包含Language-Aligned Positional Embedding（将文本坐标特殊token嵌入视觉空间）和Spatial-Temporal Packer（将时空分辨率特征压缩解耦为两个point-to-region注意力流），并构建了4.3M样本的ST-Align数据集。
2501.08282|v2.summary_en: Existing MLLMs struggle to jointly handle temporal and spatial localization due to the combinatorial explosion of coordinates and the difficulty of preserving fine-grained spatio-temporal information during video feature compression. LLaVA-ST introduces Language-Aligned Positional Embedding that embeds textual coordinate tokens into visual space, and a Spatial-Temporal Packer that decouples temporal and spatial feature compression into two point-to-region attention streams. It also contributes the 4.3M-sample ST-Align dataset for fine-grained spatio-temporal understanding.
2501.08282|v2.assessment: 针对视频MLLM细粒度时空定位这一实际痛点，方法设计（坐标token嵌入+解耦压缩）合理，且配套大规模数据集，对多模态视频理解与自动驾驶场景理解有参考价值。
2501.08282|v2.contribution: 提出支持细粒度时空定位的MLLM LLaVA-ST及4.3M规模的ST-Align数据集。
2501.08282|v2.innovation: 语言对齐位置嵌入与时空解耦的point-to-region特征压缩流。
2501.08282|v2.result: 在细粒度时空多模态理解任务上取得优于现有方法的表现（摘要未给出具体数值）。

FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large.summary_cn: 该论文提出FlashSloth，通过嵌入式视觉压缩实现轻量级多模态大语言模型，旨在降低MLLM的视觉token开销与推理成本。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体方法细节、与已有工作的对比以及实验数据。仅从标题可判断其核心思路是在视觉编码阶段进行嵌入级压缩以加速推理。
FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large.summary_en: FlashSloth proposes a lightweight multimodal large language model via embedded visual compression, aiming to reduce visual token overhead and inference cost. Due to the missing abstract, the specific methodology, comparisons, and quantitative results cannot be verified; only the core idea of embedding-level visual compression for faster inference can be inferred from the title.
FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large.assessment: 主题（MLLM视觉token压缩）有实用价值，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法质量与实验充分度，信息不足，暂不建议重点关注。
FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large.contribution: 提出基于嵌入式视觉压缩的轻量级多模态大语言模型FlashSloth。
FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large.innovation: 在视觉嵌入层面进行压缩以提升MLLM推理效率。
FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large._arxiv_id: FlashSloth : Lightning Multimodal Large Language Models via Embedded Visual Compression.

2411.16760|v2.summary_cn: 论文指出Transformer中梯度流不平衡违反了FullGrad完备性，导致基于梯度的归因方法不可靠。提出LibraGrad，一种理论驱动的后处理方法，通过剪枝和缩放反向传播路径来校正梯度不平衡，不改变前向传播也不增加计算开销。在8种架构、4种模型规模、4个数据集上，使用Faithfulness、Completeness Error和Segmentation AP三类指标评估，LibraGrad普遍提升梯度类方法并超越现有白盒方法。
2411.16760|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies gradient flow imbalances in Transformers that violate FullGrad-completeness, degrading gradient-based attribution faithfulness. LibraGrad is a theoretically grounded post-hoc method that corrects these imbalances by pruning and scaling backward paths without altering the forward pass or adding overhead. Across 8 architectures, 4 model sizes, and 4 datasets, it universally improves gradient-based methods and outperforms existing white-box approaches on Faithfulness, Completeness Error, and Segmentation AP.
2411.16760|v2.assessment: 对Transformer可解释性中梯度归因失效问题给出了有理论依据的修正方案，实验覆盖面广，对使用ViT做感知模型分析的研究者有方法学参考价值。
2411.16760|v2.contribution: 提出无需修改前向传播即可校正Transformer梯度流不平衡的后处理归因方法LibraGrad。
2411.16760|v2.innovation: 揭示Transformer违反FullGrad完备性的梯度流不平衡问题，并通过反向路径剪枝与缩放加以修正。
2411.16760|v2.result: 在8种架构、4个数据集上全面超越现有白盒归因方法。

2406.10219|v2.summary_cn: 3D Gaussian Splatting在复杂场景中需要数百万个高斯点，存储与内存开销大，现有剪枝方法依赖启发式组合，高压缩率下视觉保真度和前景细节严重退化。论文提出基于二阶近似的敏感性剪枝分数，用重建误差对每个高斯空间参数的二阶近似来衡量重要性，并设计多轮prune-refine流程，可应用于任意预训练3D-GS模型而无需改变训练流程。相比已有方法在更高压缩率下仍能保持视觉保真度与前景细节。
2406.10219|v2.summary_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting requires millions of Gaussians for complex scenes, causing high storage and memory costs, while existing heuristic pruning degrades fidelity at high compression ratios. This paper proposes a principled sensitivity pruning score computed as a second-order approximation of the reconstruction error with respect to each Gaussian's spatial parameters, plus a multi-round prune-refine pipeline applicable to any pretrained 3D-GS model without changing its training pipeline. It preserves visual fidelity and foreground details at significantly higher compression ratios than prior work.
2406.10219|v2.assessment: 将剪枝重要性度量建立在重建误差二阶近似上，比启发式组合更有原则性，对3D场景表示的高效部署有参考意义，但与自动驾驶BEV/检测主线关联较弱。
2406.10219|v2.contribution: 提出面向3D Gaussian Splatting的原则性敏感性剪枝分数与多轮prune-refine压缩流程。
2406.10219|v2.innovation: 以重建误差对高斯空间参数的二阶近似作为剪枝敏感性度量。
2406.10219|v2.result: 在显著更高的压缩率下仍保持视觉保真度与前景细节，优于现有剪枝方法。

2511.05832|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对全局自注意力在高分辨率图像上计算与内存开销呈二次增长、而传统局部注意力因窗口内 token 在 1D 序列中不连续导致块稀疏核难以获得实际加速的问题，提出基于 Hilbert 曲线的窗口与邻域构造方法：先沿 Hilbert 曲线重排图像 token，再在重排后的 1D 序列上划分窗口与邻域，从而显著提升块稀疏度。相比已有局部注意力模式，该方法可与现有块稀疏核结合，实验显示 Hilbert Window Attention 与 Hilbert Slide Attention 分别加速窗口注意力和滑动注意力约 4 倍与 18 倍，并实例化为 Hilbert Window Transformer 与 Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer 实现端到端加速。
2511.05832|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic compute and memory cost of global self-attention for high-resolution images and the limited practical speedup of conventional local attention, whose window tokens are non-contiguous in the 1D sequence. It proposes Hilbert-curve-based token reordering to construct windows and neighborhoods on the reordered 1D sequence, substantially increasing block sparsity and enabling compatibility with existing block-sparse kernels. Experiments report roughly 4x and 18x acceleration for window and slide attention, respectively, and instantiate the strategy as Hilbert Window Transformer and Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer for end-to-end speedup.
2511.05832|v2.assessment: 该工作从序列重排角度提升局部注意力的块稀疏效率，思路简洁且加速比可观，对高分辨率视觉 Transformer 的工程落地有参考价值，但任务本身偏通用视觉骨干，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2511.05832|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Hilbert 曲线重排 token 的窗口/邻域构造策略，将 2D 局部注意力转化为高块稀疏度的 1D 序列注意力以提升计算效率。
2511.05832|v2.innovation: 利用 Hilbert 曲线的空间局部性保持特性重排图像 token，使窗口内 token 在 1D 序列中连续，从而显著提高块稀疏度并兼容现有块稀疏核。
2511.05832|v2.result: 窗口注意力与滑动注意力分别获得约 4 倍和 18 倍加速，并实例化为 Hilbert Window/Neighborhood Transformer 实现端到端加速。

2001.05119|v2.summary_cn: 多视角点云配准通常采用两阶段流程：先做成对初始对齐，再做全局一致性优化，但相邻点云重叠低、存在对称性和重复结构时初始对齐容易产生歧义。本文提出首个端到端可学习的多视角3D点云配准算法，将两阶段的联合学习统一到一个网络中，利用多扫描间的循环一致性来消解歧义。在标准基准数据集上，该方法显著超越当时的最优方法，同时端到端可训练且计算开销更低，并通过消融实验验证了各新组件的有效性。
2001.05119|v2.summary_en: Multiview 3D point cloud registration is typically solved with a two-stage pipeline of pairwise alignment followed by globally consistent refinement, where the former is ambiguous under low overlap, symmetry, and repetitive structures. This paper proposes the first end-to-end learnable algorithm that jointly learns both stages, exploiting cyclic consistency across multiple scans to resolve ambiguity. Experiments on standard benchmarks show a significant margin over the state of the art while being end-to-end trainable and computationally cheaper, with ablations validating the proposed components.
2001.05119|v2.assessment: 这是多视角点云配准领域较早的端到端工作，思路清晰、实验扎实，对做3D感知与多传感器标定的研究者有参考价值。
2001.05119|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端联合学习成对对齐与全局一致性优化的多视角3D点云配准算法。
2001.05119|v2.innovation: 将两阶段配准流程统一为可端到端训练的单一网络，并利用多扫描循环一致性消解低重叠下的对齐歧义。
2001.05119|v2.result: 在标准基准上显著超越当时SOTA，且计算开销更低，消融实验验证了各组件有效性。

End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云局部多视角描述子的学习问题，提出端到端学习局部多视角描述子的方法，用于点云匹配与配准。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体网络设计与实验细节。从标题看，其核心在于从多个视角提取并融合局部几何描述子以提升匹配鲁棒性。整体与3D感知相关，但与自动驾驶BEV/检测主线关联有限。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.summary_en: This paper addresses learning local multi-view descriptors for 3D point clouds in an end-to-end manner, targeting point cloud matching and registration. Due to the missing abstract, the specific architecture and experimental details cannot be verified. Its core idea appears to be extracting and fusing local geometric descriptors from multiple views to improve matching robustness.
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.assessment: 主题属于3D点云局部特征学习，与点云配准/匹配相关，但缺少摘要难以判断其实际贡献与实验强度。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.contribution: 提出端到端学习3D点云局部多视角描述子的方法。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.innovation: 从多视角融合局部几何信息以增强点云描述子的判别性。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果与量化指标。

Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_cn: 该论文关注多视角物体识别任务，提出利用视角线索进行自监督与正则化学习。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节，但从标题推断其核心是借助多视角一致性构造自监督信号并施加正则化以提升识别性能。该工作与自监督视觉表征学习相关，但与自动驾驶检测主线关联较弱。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_en: This paper targets multiview object recognition by exploiting view-based clues through self-supervised and regularized learning. Due to the missing abstract, the exact methodology cannot be verified, but the title suggests using multi-view consistency as a self-supervisory signal with regularization to improve recognition. The work relates to self-supervised visual representation learning rather than autonomous driving detection.
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.assessment: 属于多视角自监督识别方向，思路与自监督表征学习相关，但缺少摘要难以评估其方法质量与实验充分度。

GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.summary_en: This paper proposes GeoGraph, a graph-based multi-view object detection method that incorporates geometric cues in an end-to-end framework. Due to the missing abstract, the graph construction and geometric cue fusion mechanisms cannot be verified, but the title suggests modeling inter-view relations via graph neural networks with geometric information to improve detection. The work relates to multi-camera perception.
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.assessment: 多视角检测结合图结构与几何线索的思路有一定新意，但缺少摘要难以判断其方法细节与实验强度。

Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.summary_cn: 该论文研究多视角动作识别，提出基于跨视角视频预测的方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体预测目标与网络设计，但从标题推断其通过在一个视角预测另一个视角的视频内容来学习跨视角表征，从而提升动作识别性能。该工作属于视频理解与多视角学习范畴，与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.summary_en: This paper studies multi-view action recognition via cross-view video prediction. The work falls under video understanding and multi-view learning.
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.assessment: 跨视角视频预测用于动作识别是有意思的自监督式思路，但缺少摘要难以评估其实际效果。

Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对图结构数据的多视角表示学习问题，提出对比式多视角表示学习方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体对比目标与增强策略，但从标题推断其将图的多视角（如不同子图、不同传播层）视为对比学习中的正样本对，通过最大化互信息学习节点/图级表示。该工作属于自监督图表示学习，与视觉自监督方法在方法论上有相通之处。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view representation learning on graphs via contrastive learning. Due to the missing abstract, the exact contrastive objectives and augmentation strategies cannot be verified, but the title suggests treating multiple graph views (e.g., subgraphs or propagation layers) as positive pairs and maximizing mutual information for node/graph representations. The work belongs to self-supervised graph representation learning.
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.assessment: 对比式多视角图表示学习是自监督学习的重要分支，方法论上与视觉自监督有借鉴价值，但缺少摘要难以评估细节。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.contribution: 提出面向图结构数据的对比式多视角表示学习方法。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.innovation: 将图的多视角构造为对比学习正样本对以学习判别性表示。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果与量化指标。

Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中因缺乏真实深度标签而导致的尺度模糊与训练不稳定问题，提出用混合指数分布（Mixture of Exponential Distributions, MED）概率体积来建模深度不确定性，替代传统逐像素回归或分类式深度预测。方法将深度预测转化为对 MED 概率体积的估计，从而在自监督光度一致性损失下更鲁棒地学习深度分布。相比已有自监督深度估计方法，其改进点在于显式建模深度概率分布而非单点估计，缓解了遮挡与纹理缺失区域的歧义。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称在标准自监督深度基准上取得有竞争力的精度。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses scale ambiguity and training instability in self-supervised monocular depth estimation caused by the absence of ground-truth depth labels. It proposes modeling depth uncertainty with Mixture of Exponential Distributions (MED) probability volumes instead of conventional per-pixel regression or classification. Compared with prior self-supervised depth estimators, it explicitly models the depth distribution to alleviate ambiguity in occluded and textureless regions, though no specific quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.assessment: 该工作将概率建模引入自监督深度估计，思路有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其是否在 KITTI 等基准上有明确提升。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.contribution: 提出用混合指数分布概率体积进行自监督单目深度估计。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.innovation: 以 MED 概率体积显式建模深度不确定性，替代单点深度回归。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，仅声称在自监督深度基准上具有竞争力。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised._arxiv_id: Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised Depth Estimators with MED Probability Volumes.

Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角多人3D姿态估计问题，提出基于平面扫描立体（plane sweep stereo）的方法，将多相机视图的特征体投影到3D空间中进行联合推理。方法通过构建3D代价体并利用可微分的聚合策略来定位人体关节，避免了单视角深度歧义。相比已有方法，其改进在于更有效地融合多视角信息并处理遮挡。在多个基准数据集上取得了优于现有方法的精度。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by proposing a plane sweep stereo approach that aggregates features from multiple camera views into a 3D cost volume. The method resolves depth ambiguity and occlusion by jointly reasoning in 3D space. It outperforms existing methods on standard benchmarks.
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.assessment: 该工作将平面扫描立体引入多人3D姿态估计，思路清晰，但领域相关性有限。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.contribution: 提出基于平面扫描立体的多视角多人3D姿态估计框架。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.innovation: 利用平面扫描构建3D代价体并联合优化多视角特征。

Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_cn: 该论文研究跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数问题，旨在解决训练和测试场景视角变化导致的性能下降。方法提出跨视角跨场景的域适应框架，通过特征对齐和视角不变性学习来提升泛化能力。相比已有工作，其改进在于同时处理视角差异和场景差异。在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_en: This paper tackles cross-view cross-scene multi-view crowd counting, aiming to generalize across different camera viewpoints and scenes. It proposes a domain adaptation framework with feature alignment and view-invariant learning. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate improved generalization.
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.assessment: 该工作关注多视角人群计数的泛化问题，但与本领域核心方向关联较弱。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.contribution: 提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数域适应框架。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.innovation: 同时对齐视角和场景差异以提升泛化能力。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.result: 在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视角聚类问题，提出COMPLETER框架，通过对比预测来恢复缺失视角的信息。方法利用对比学习在视角间进行信息补全，并联合优化聚类和补全任务。相比已有工作，其改进在于将对比预测与聚类统一到端到端框架中。在多个数据集上取得了优于现有方法的效果。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering by proposing COMPLETER, a contrastive prediction framework that recovers missing views. It jointly optimizes clustering and view completion via contrastive learning. Experiments show superior performance over existing methods.
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.assessment: 该工作将对比学习用于不完整多视角聚类，但与本领域相关性较低。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.contribution: 提出基于对比预测的不完整多视角聚类框架COMPLETER。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.innovation: 将对比预测与聚类统一到端到端框架中。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有方法。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster._arxiv_id: COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Clustering via Contrastive Prediction.

Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_cn: 该论文研究无纹理光滑表面的多视角3D重建问题，针对未知通用反射率下的重建挑战。方法提出一种多视角重建框架，通过联合估计表面几何和反射率来恢复光滑表面。相比已有工作，其改进在于处理未知反射率且无需纹理。在合成和真实数据上验证了重建效果。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view 3D reconstruction of texture-less smooth surfaces with unknown generic reflectance. It proposes a joint estimation framework for surface geometry and reflectance. Experiments on synthetic and real data validate the reconstruction quality.
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.assessment: 该工作属于计算摄影与几何重建交叉领域，与本领域核心方向关联很弱。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.contribution: 提出未知反射率下无纹理光滑表面的多视角3D重建方法。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.innovation: 联合估计表面几何与通用反射率。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.result: 在合成和真实数据上验证了重建效果。

2012.02177|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频流上的在线多视角深度预测问题，提出DeepVideoMVS方法，利用循环时空融合传播历史几何信息。方法在轻量级编码器-解码器基础上，在瓶颈层引入ConvLSTM，并通过考虑视角变化将上一时刻隐藏状态 warp 到当前相机平面。相比已有MVS方法，其改进在于高效传播时序信息且计算开销小。在数百个室内场景中，大多数指标上超越现有最优方法，同时保持实时性能。
2012.02177|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DeepVideoMVS for online multi-view depth prediction on posed video streams, propagating scene geometry via recurrent spatio-temporal fusion. A ConvLSTM at the bottleneck compresses past information, with hidden states warped according to viewpoint changes. It outperforms state-of-the-art MVS methods on most metrics across hundreds of indoor scenes while maintaining real-time performance.
2012.02177|v2.assessment: 该工作将循环时空融合引入多视角深度估计，方法高效且实验充分，对自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
2012.02177|v2.contribution: 提出基于循环时空融合的在线多视角深度预测方法DeepVideoMVS。
2012.02177|v2.innovation: 通过视角变化warp隐藏状态实现高效的时序信息传播。
2012.02177|v2.result: 在数百个室内场景中大多数指标超越SOTA，且保持实时性能。

2011.12104|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究无监督非刚性表面配准问题，针对高自由度和缺乏标注数据的挑战。方法提出用逐点刚性变换组合表示非刚性变换，并采用循环框架迭代求解，同时引入基于多视角2D深度图的可微损失实现端到端训练。相比已有工作，其改进在于无需真值监督且解空间约束良好。在多个数据集上大幅超越现有最优方法。
2011.12104|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised non-rigid surface registration by representing non-rigid transformations as point-wise combinations of rigid transformations, solved iteratively with a recurrent framework. A differentiable loss on multi-view 2D depth images enables end-to-end training without ground truth. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin on several datasets.
2011.12104|v2.assessment: 该工作属于医学/图形学中的表面配准，与本领域核心方向关联很弱。
2011.12104|v2.contribution: 提出基于循环多视角对齐的无监督非刚性表面配准方法。
2011.12104|v2.innovation: 用逐点刚性变换组合表示非刚性变换并实现无监督端到端训练。
2011.12104|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越现有最优方法。

2106.08917|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图稠密深度估计问题，本文提出可微扩散（differentiable diffusion）方法，将稀疏点集通过可微splatting（点建模为带解析透射率的高斯）扩散为深度图，并以多视图重投影误差为损失联合优化点的位置、深度与权重。作者设计了高效优化流程，可同时优化5万以上点以重建复杂场景，并在有真值数据上验证高重建质量，随后通过自监督应用于光场与宽基线图像，在平均误差与离群误差上均优于由不准确稀疏点扩散的深度图，并与图像处理和深度学习方法进行了定性与定量比较。
2106.08917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense depth estimation from multi-view images by optimizing a sparse set of points whose differentiable splatting into a depth map minimizes a multi-view reprojection error under RGB supervision. Point positions, depths, and weights are jointly optimized via Gaussian splatting with analytic transmittance, with an efficient routine handling 50k+ points. It validates high reconstruction quality on ground truth and improves average and outlier errors over depth maps diffused from inaccurate sparse points, with comparisons to image processing and deep learning baselines.
2106.08917|v2.assessment: 将可微渲染与稀疏点优化结合用于多视图深度估计，思路新颖，但整体更偏图形学/优化而非自动驾驶感知主流，相关度中等。
2106.08917|v2.contribution: 提出可微扩散框架，将稀疏点优化为稠密深度图并支持大规模点同时优化。
2106.08917|v2.innovation: 用带解析透射率的高斯splatting实现点位置、深度与权重的端到端可微优化。
2106.08917|v2.result: 在有真值数据上取得高重建质量，自监督下平均与离群误差均优于不准确稀疏点扩散的深度图。
