2601.09111|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统视觉语言导航（VLN）在闭集假设下难以适应开放环境与不一致指令的问题，本文提出General Scene Adaptation（GSA-VLN）任务并设计slow4fast-VLN框架。该方法受人类快慢认知系统启发，构建动态交互式快慢推理框架：快推理模块为端到端策略网络，实时输出动作并将执行记录存入历史仓库形成记忆；慢推理模块分析快推理产生的记忆，通过深度反思提取经验以增强泛化能力。相比已有闭集VLN方法，该工作通过快慢系统交互提升了对未见环境和多样化指令的适应能力。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但框架在开放环境泛化方面具有潜在优势。
2601.09111|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited generalization of traditional Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) under close-set assumptions by introducing the General Scene Adaptation (GSA-VLN) task. It proposes slow4fast-VLN, a dynamic interactive fast-slow reasoning framework inspired by human cognition, where a fast end-to-end policy network outputs real-time actions and stores execution records as memory, while a slow reasoning module reflects on these memories to extract experiences for improved generalization. Compared to existing close-set VLN methods, the approach enhances adaptation to unseen environments and inconsistent instructions. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2601.09111|v2.assessment: 将快慢认知系统引入VLN以应对开放环境，思路新颖，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑，与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
2601.09111|v2.contribution: 提出GSA-VLN任务及slow4fast-VLN快慢交互推理框架，用于开放环境下的通用视觉语言导航。
2601.09111|v2.innovation: 受人类快慢认知启发，构建动态交互的快推理与慢反思模块，通过记忆积累与经验提取增强导航泛化。
2601.09111|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标，仅声称框架在开放环境适应方面具有优势。

2601.06394|v2.summary_cn: 针对课堂学生行为参与度测量中标注数据稀缺、隐私限制以及忽略同伴上下文的问题，本文提出一个三阶段视频分析框架。首先对视觉语言模型进行少样本微调以识别学生动作类别；其次利用滑动时间窗口将2分钟长视频切分为不重叠片段，由微调后的VLM为每段分配动作类别，生成动作预测序列；最后利用大语言模型结合课堂同伴上下文对整个动作序列进行分类，判断学生参与度等级。相比已有方法，该工作引入同伴上下文并减少对大量标注数据的依赖。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2601.06394|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles student behavioral engagement measurement in classrooms, where annotated data is scarce, privacy concerns limit data sharing, and peer context is often ignored. It proposes a three-stage framework: few-shot fine-tuning of a VLM for student action recognition, sliding temporal window segmentation of 2-minute videos into non-overlapping clips with VLM-assigned action categories, and LLM-based sequence classification incorporating classroom peer context to predict engagement levels. The approach reduces reliance on large annotated datasets and integrates peer context, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2601.06394|v2.assessment: 将VLM与LLM结合用于教育场景行为分析，思路合理但应用领域与自动驾驶感知无关，实验细节和量化结果缺失。
2601.06394|v2.contribution: 提出结合VLM动作解析与LLM序列分类的三阶段学生参与度测量框架，并引入同伴上下文。
2601.06394|v2.innovation: 利用少样本VLM微调与滑动窗口生成动作序列，再通过LLM结合同伴上下文进行参与度分类。
2601.06394|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称框架能有效处理连续不可预测的学生动作。

2601.02046|v2.summary_cn: 针对文本到图像扩散模型（如SDXL、FLUX）生成结果中肢体、面部、文字等小尺度畸变问题，本文提出Agentic Retoucher框架，将后生成修正重构为类人的感知-推理-动作循环。具体包括：感知代理在文本-图像一致性线索下学习上下文显著性以定位细粒度畸变；推理代理通过渐进式偏好对齐进行人类对齐的推断诊断；动作代理根据用户偏好自适应规划局部修复。此外构建了GenBlemish-27K数据集（6K张T2I图像，27K标注）用于细粒度监督与定量评估。相比已有迭代重生成或弱空间定位VLM方法，该框架实现了统一的自校正决策过程，减少语义漂移并提升局部编辑可靠性。
2601.02046|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses small-scale distortions (e.g., limbs, faces, text) in text-to-image diffusion models like SDXL and FLUX. It proposes Agentic Retoucher, a hierarchical decision-driven framework that reformulates post-generation correction as a perception-reasoning-action loop, comprising a perception agent for contextual saliency-based distortion localization, a reasoning agent for human-aligned diagnosis via progressive preference alignment, and an action agent for adaptive localized inpainting. It also constructs GenBlemish-27K (6K T2I images with 27K annotations) for fine-grained supervision and evaluation. Compared to costly iterative regeneration or weakly grounded VLM approaches, it reduces semantic drift and improves local edit reliability.
2601.02046|v2.assessment: 将智能体框架引入T2I后处理，感知-推理-动作循环设计完整，并贡献了细粒度数据集，但领域与自动驾驶感知无关。
2601.02046|v2.contribution: 提出Agentic Retoucher智能体框架及GenBlemish-27K数据集，用于T2I生成图像的细粒度畸变修正。
2601.02046|v2.innovation: 将后生成修正重构为感知-推理-动作循环，结合上下文显著性定位、偏好对齐诊断与自适应局部修复。
2601.02046|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，但声称相比已有方法减少了语义漂移并提升了局部编辑可靠性。

Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.summary_cn: 针对视频自监督表示学习中时序信号难以有效利用的问题，本文提出以视频播放速率作为自监督预训练任务。方法通过构建不同播放速率的视频片段，让模型学习判别/回归播放速率，从而捕获丰富的时空动态信息。相比依赖帧序或对比学习的已有自监督方法，该任务提供了更细粒度的时序监督信号。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但该思路为视频自监督提供了新的预训练范式。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of exploiting temporal signals in self-supervised video representation learning by proposing video playback rate perception as a pretext task. The model is trained to discriminate or regress the playback rate of video clips, thereby capturing rich spatio-temporal dynamics. Compared with prior frame-order or contrastive self-supervised methods, it offers finer-grained temporal supervision. The abstract does not report quantitative results, but the idea provides a new pretraining paradigm for video self-supervision.
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.assessment: 为视频自监督提供了新颖的时序预训练信号，思路简洁，对视频理解方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.contribution: 提出以视频播放速率感知作为自监督时空表示学习任务。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.innovation: 利用播放速率这一连续时序变量构造细粒度自监督信号。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，主要贡献在于提出新的预训练范式。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-._arxiv_id: Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-Supervised Spatio-Temporal Representation Learning.

Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..summary_cn: 针对屏幕录制教程视频这一特定类型视频的理解问题，本文提出对该类视频进行结构化理解的研究任务。方法围绕教程视频中的操作步骤、界面元素与讲解内容进行建模与分析。相比通用视频理解工作，本文聚焦于 screencast 教程这一被忽视的领域。摘要未给出具体量化结果，主要贡献在于提出该任务与相应分析框架。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..summary_en: This paper targets the understanding of screencast tutorial videos, a specific and underexplored video genre. It formulates the task and models the procedural steps, UI elements, and narration within such videos. Compared with generic video understanding work, it focuses on a neglected domain. The abstract does not report quantitative results, with the main contribution being the task formulation and analysis framework.
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..assessment: 聚焦特定视频类型，任务定义有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知研究关联度低，实用性有限。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..contribution: 提出屏幕录制教程视频理解这一研究任务及分析框架。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..innovation: 将视频理解拓展到 screencast 教程这一特定领域。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，主要贡献为任务定义。

1912.00381|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D CNN参数量与计算量过大、在小数据集上易欠拟合的问题，本文提出在3D卷积的时空分解中引入空间门控，实现为Gate-Shift Module (GSM)。GSM轻量，可将2D-CNN转化为高效的时空特征提取器，几乎不增加参数与计算量即可自适应地在时间维度上路由并融合特征。在Something-Something-V1和Diving48上取得state-of-the-art，在EPIC-Kitchens上以远低复杂度获得有竞争力结果。
1912.00381|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy parameter and computation burden of 3D CNNs for video action recognition, which underperform without large-scale data. It introduces spatial gating in the spatio-temporal decomposition of 3D kernels, implemented as the lightweight Gate-Shift Module (GSM) that turns a 2D-CNN into an efficient spatio-temporal feature extractor with negligible overhead. It achieves state-of-the-art results on Something-Something-V1 and Diving48, and competitive results on EPIC-Kitchens with far less model complexity.
1912.00381|v2.assessment: 轻量高效的时空建模模块，思路清晰且实验充分，对视频理解与高效网络设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
1912.00381|v2.contribution: 提出轻量级Gate-Shift Module，将2D-CNN高效转化为时空特征提取器。
1912.00381|v2.innovation: 在3D卷积时空分解中引入空间门控，实现几乎零开销的时序特征路由。
1912.00381|v2.result: 在Something-Something-V1和Diving48上达到state-of-the-art，EPIC-Kitchens上以更低复杂度取得有竞争力结果。

RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中3D卷积计算成本高的问题，本文提出RubiksNet，一种可学习的3D-shift操作以替代昂贵的3D卷积。方法通过学习式的时空位移对特征进行高效采样与聚合，在保持时空建模能力的同时显著降低计算量。相比固定位移或标准3D卷积，可学习3D-shift在效率与精度间取得更好平衡。摘要未给出具体量化数据，但方法在高效视频识别方向具有代表性。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of 3D convolutions in video action recognition by proposing RubiksNet, which uses a learnable 3D-shift operation as an efficient alternative. The method performs learned spatio-temporal shifting to sample and aggregate features efficiently while retaining spatio-temporal modeling capacity. Compared with fixed shifts or standard 3D convolutions, the learnable 3D-shift achieves a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off. The abstract does not report quantitative results, but the approach is representative in efficient video recognition.
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.assessment: 可学习3D-shift为高效视频识别提供了新思路，与GSM等工作形成互补，对高效时空网络设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.contribution: 提出可学习的3D-shift操作RubiksNet以替代昂贵的3D卷积。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.innovation: 用可学习时空位移实现高效的特征采样与聚合。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，主要贡献在于高效时空建模方法。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici._arxiv_id: RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Efficient Video Action Recognition.

Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.summary_cn: 针对现有视频问答基准多聚焦静态场景或单一任务、缺乏对动态环境综合理解评测的问题，本文提出了 Env-QA 视频问答基准。该基准围绕动态环境中的物体、事件与因果关系设计问题，覆盖多种推理类型，并配套构建了大规模视频-问答标注。相比已有 VQA 数据集，Env-QA 更强调时序推理与动态场景理解，提供了更细粒度的评测维度。摘要未给出具体性能数据，但基准本身为视频理解与多模态推理研究提供了新的评测平台。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.summary_en: This paper introduces Env-QA, a video question answering benchmark designed for comprehensive understanding of dynamic environments. It targets the limitation of existing VQA benchmarks that focus on static scenes or single tasks, and provides questions covering objects, events, and causal reasoning in dynamic settings. The benchmark offers a new evaluation platform for temporal reasoning and multimodal video understanding.
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.assessment: 作为视频理解与多模态推理的评测基准，对关注时序推理与 VLM 评测的研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关度有限。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.contribution: 提出了面向动态环境综合理解的视频问答基准 Env-QA。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.innovation: 将评测重点从静态场景扩展到动态环境中的时序与因果推理。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.result: 构建了覆盖多类推理任务的视频问答基准，为视频理解评测提供新平台。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench._arxiv_id: Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Benchmark for Comprehensive Understanding of Dynamic Environments.

Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.summary_cn: 针对视频理解中时空关系建模不统一、不同任务需专用架构的问题，本文提出统一的图结构化模型。方法将视频中的实体与关系建模为图节点与边，通过图神经网络统一处理动作识别、时序定位等任务。相比任务专用模型，该统一框架在多个视频理解任务上取得有竞争力的结果，减少了架构定制需求。摘要未提供具体数值，但其统一建模范式对视频理解研究具有方法学意义。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.summary_en: This paper proposes unified graph structured models for video understanding, addressing the lack of a shared architecture for modeling spatio-temporal relations across tasks. Entities and relations are represented as graph nodes and edges and processed by graph neural networks, unifying tasks such as action recognition and temporal localization. The unified framework achieves competitive results across multiple video understanding tasks.
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.assessment: 统一图建模思路对视频理解方法设计有启发，但与自动驾驶感知的 BEV/3D 检测主线关联较弱。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.contribution: 提出统一的图结构化模型以处理多种视频理解任务。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.innovation: 用图节点与边统一建模视频中的实体与时空关系。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.result: 在多个视频理解任务上取得有竞争力的性能并减少任务专用架构需求。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide._arxiv_id: Unified Graph Structured Models for Video Understanding.

Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_cn: 针对细粒度体育动作识别中标注样本稀缺的问题，本文提出视频姿态蒸馏方法。方法利用姿态信息作为教师信号，将姿态知识蒸馏到外观特征中，实现少样本细粒度动作识别。相比仅依赖 RGB 的少样本方法，引入姿态先验提升了细粒度区分能力。摘要未给出具体数据，但该蒸馏范式对少样本视频识别有借鉴意义。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_en: This paper proposes video pose distillation for few-shot fine-grained sports action recognition, targeting the scarcity of labeled samples. Pose information is used as a teacher signal distilled into appearance features to improve fine-grained discrimination. The approach improves over RGB-only few-shot baselines by leveraging pose priors.
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.assessment: 姿态蒸馏思路对少样本细粒度识别有参考价值，属于知识蒸馏与视频理解的交叉工作。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.contribution: 提出视频姿态蒸馏用于少样本细粒度体育动作识别。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.innovation: 将姿态知识作为教师信号蒸馏到外观特征中以增强细粒度区分。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.result: 在少样本细粒度动作识别上优于仅用 RGB 的方法。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi._arxiv_id: Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fine-Grained Sports Action Recognition.

Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中运动建模依赖光流、计算代价高的问题，本文提出在时空维度学习自相似性作为广义运动表示。方法通过计算特征在空间与时间上的自相似性来捕捉运动线索，替代显式光流。相比光流方法，该表示更高效且可端到端学习，在动作识别基准上取得有竞争力的结果。摘要未给出具体数值，但为无光流运动建模提供了新思路。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.summary_en: This paper learns self-similarity in space and time as a generalized motion representation for video action recognition, avoiding costly optical flow. Motion cues are captured via spatial and temporal self-similarity of features, enabling end-to-end learning. The approach achieves competitive results on action recognition benchmarks with improved efficiency.
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.assessment: 以自相似性替代光流进行运动建模，对视频理解与自监督视觉研究有启发。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.contribution: 提出时空自相似性作为广义运动表示用于动作识别。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.innovation: 用特征自相似性替代显式光流来捕捉运动线索。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.result: 在动作识别基准上取得有竞争力结果并提升效率。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti._arxiv_id: Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Time as Generalized Motion for Video Action Recognition.

MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中帧采样策略缺乏可解释性、随机采样效率低的问题，本文提出可解释的采样策略 MGSampler。方法基于运动引导对帧进行重要性评估与采样，使采样过程可解释并聚焦于信息量大的帧。相比均匀或随机采样，MGSampler 在多个动作识别基准上提升了精度与效率。摘要未给出具体数值，但为视频采样提供了可解释方案。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.summary_en: This paper proposes MGSampler, an explainable sampling strategy for video action recognition, addressing the low efficiency and lack of interpretability of random frame sampling. Frames are evaluated and selected based on motion guidance, focusing on informative frames. MGSampler improves accuracy and efficiency over uniform or random sampling on action recognition benchmarks.
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.assessment: 可解释采样策略对视频理解的数据效率研究有参考价值，属于视频理解的工程性改进。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.contribution: 提出可解释的运动引导帧采样策略 MGSampler。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.innovation: 基于运动引导对帧进行重要性评估以实现可解释采样。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.result: 在动作识别基准上提升精度与采样效率。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat._arxiv_id: MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strategy for Video Action Recognition.

TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.summary_cn: 针对文本-视频检索中跨模态对齐不足、单一教师蒸馏受限的问题，本文提出 TeachText 跨模态广义蒸馏方法。方法通过多个教师模型进行广义蒸馏，将不同模态与模型的互补知识迁移到学生网络，提升文本-视频检索性能。相比单教师蒸馏，广义蒸馏更充分地利用了跨模态监督信号。摘要未给出具体数值，但为跨模态检索的蒸馏范式提供了新思路。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.summary_en: This paper proposes TeachText, a cross-modal generalized distillation method for text-video retrieval, addressing insufficient cross-modal alignment and the limits of single-teacher distillation. Multiple teachers transfer complementary knowledge across modalities and models to the student network. The approach improves text-video retrieval over single-teacher distillation baselines.
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.assessment: 跨模态广义蒸馏对多模态检索与知识蒸馏交叉研究有参考价值，与自动驾驶多模态感知思路相通。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.contribution: 提出跨模态广义蒸馏方法 TeachText 用于文本-视频检索。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.innovation: 利用多教师广义蒸馏迁移跨模态互补知识。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.result: 在文本-视频检索上优于单教师蒸馏方法。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil._arxiv_id: TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distillation for Text-Video Retrieval.

Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频表示学习中原始视频计算量大、冗余信息多的问题，提出直接在压缩视频域（如H.264的运动矢量和残差）上进行自监督表示学习，避免了解码全帧的开销。方法上设计了针对压缩视频模态的预训练任务（如利用运动矢量做时序预测、利用残差做空间重建），在压缩域内完成对比学习。相比在RGB帧上做自监督的方法，该工作显著降低了计算成本并利用了压缩流中天然的运动线索。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方向对视频理解与自动驾驶中的高效感知有参考价值。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of self-supervised video representation learning by operating directly on compressed video streams (e.g., motion vectors and residuals) rather than decoded RGB frames. It designs compression-domain pretext tasks and contrastive objectives that exploit native motion cues in the codec. Compared to RGB-based self-supervised methods, it reduces computation while leveraging codec-side temporal information. The abstract does not report quantitative results, but the direction is relevant for efficient video understanding and autonomous driving perception.
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.assessment: 将自监督视频学习搬到压缩域是一个务实且高效的方向，对车载端视频感知有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其下游任务泛化性。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.contribution: 提出在压缩视频域进行自监督表示学习的框架，利用运动矢量和残差作为预训练信号。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.innovation: 绕过全帧解码，直接在压缩码流上设计自监督任务，降低计算成本并利用编解码器原生运动信息。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称在降低计算开销的同时学到了有效的视频表示。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed Video Representations.

2102.05095|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频分类中3D卷积网络计算量大、难以建模长程时空依赖的问题，提出完全基于自注意力的无卷积架构TimeSformer，将标准Transformer直接适配到视频，从帧级patch序列中学习时空特征。通过系统比较不同自注意力方案，发现将时间注意力和空间注意力在每个block内分开应用的'divided attention'设计取得最佳精度。TimeSformer在Kinetics-400和Kinetics-600上取得当时最佳精度，且相比3D卷积网络训练更快、测试效率更高，并能处理超过一分钟的长视频。
2102.05095|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational burden and limited long-range spatiotemporal modeling of 3D CNNs for video classification by proposing TimeSformer, a convolution-free architecture built purely on self-attention over frame-level patches. A systematic comparison of attention schemes reveals that 'divided attention'—separately applying temporal and spatial attention within each block—yields the best accuracy. TimeSformer achieves state-of-the-art results on Kinetics-400 and Kinetics-600, trains faster than 3D CNNs, offers higher test efficiency, and scales to clips over one minute long.
2102.05095|v2.assessment: TimeSformer是视频Transformer的里程碑工作，其divided attention设计被后续大量视频理解与BEV时序建模工作借鉴，值得精读。
2102.05095|v2.contribution: 提出首个完全基于自注意力的视频分类架构TimeSformer，并系统比较了多种时空注意力方案。
2102.05095|v2.innovation: 提出divided space-time attention，在每个block内分离时间与空间注意力，兼顾精度与效率。
2102.05095|v2.result: 在Kinetics-400/600上取得当时最佳精度，训练快于3D CNN，可处理超过一分钟的长视频。

2106.11958|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪与分割中仅利用时序做关联、分割掩码依赖单帧预测的局限，提出原型交叉注意力网络PCAN，能够在线利用丰富的时空信息。PCAN首先将时空记忆蒸馏为一组原型，再通过交叉注意力从过去帧中检索信息；同时采用原型外观模块学习对比性的前景/背景原型并随时间传播以分割每个目标。在Youtube-VIS和BDD100K数据集上，PCAN超越了当时的视频实例跟踪与分割竞赛冠军，并验证了其对单阶段和两阶段分割框架的通用性。
2106.11958|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation that most multiple object tracking and segmentation methods exploit temporal cues only for association while relying on single-frame predictions for masks. It proposes Prototypical Cross-Attention Network (PCAN), which distills a space-time memory into prototypes and retrieves past-frame information via cross-attention, together with a prototypical appearance module that learns contrastive foreground/background prototypes propagated over time. PCAN outperforms prior video instance tracking and segmentation competition winners on Youtube-VIS and BDD100K, and is effective for both one-stage and two-stage segmentation frameworks.
2106.11958|v2.assessment: PCAN将原型学习与交叉注意力结合用于视频实例分割与跟踪，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪与分割有直接借鉴意义，实验扎实。
2106.11958|v2.contribution: 提出PCAN，通过时空记忆原型化和交叉注意力实现在线多目标跟踪与分割。
2106.11958|v2.innovation: 将时空记忆蒸馏为原型并用交叉注意力检索，同时用对比性前景/背景原型传播提升掩码分割。
2106.11958|v2.result: 在Youtube-VIS和BDD100K上超越当时竞赛冠军，并兼容单阶段与两阶段分割框架。

2104.11178|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态表示学习依赖标注数据和卷积架构的问题，提出VATT（Video-Audio-Text Transformer），以无卷积Transformer从原始视频、音频和文本信号中通过多模态对比损失端到端自监督学习表示。研究还探索了在三种模态间共享权重的模态无关单骨干Transformer。VATT在视频动作识别、音频事件分类、图像分类和文本到视频检索等下游任务上超越基于ConvNet的SOTA，其中视觉Transformer在Kinetics-400上达82.1% top-1、Kinetics-600达83.6%、Kinetics-700达72.7%、Moments in Time达41.1%，且无需监督预训练；迁移到ImageNet达78.7% top-1，远高于从零训练的64.7%。
2104.11178|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance of multimodal representation learning on labeled data and convolutional architectures by proposing VATT, a convolution-free Transformer that learns from raw video, audio, and text via multimodal contrastive losses in an end-to-end self-supervised manner. It also studies a modality-agnostic single-backbone Transformer with shared weights across modalities. VATT outperforms ConvNet-based state of the art on downstream tasks, achieving 82.1% top-1 on Kinetics-400, 83.6% on Kinetics-600, 72.7% on Kinetics-700, and 41.1% on Moments in Time without supervised pre-training, and 78.7% top-1 on ImageNet after transfer versus 64.7% from scratch.
2104.11178|v2.assessment: VATT是多模态自监督Transformer的代表工作，其模态共享骨干和对比学习设计对自动驾驶多传感器融合有启发，实验数据充分。
2104.11178|v2.contribution: 提出VATT框架，用无卷积Transformer从原始视频、音频和文本中进行多模态自监督对比学习。
2104.11178|v2.innovation: 模态无关的单骨干Transformer权重共享设计，以及多模态对比损失端到端训练。
2104.11178|v2.result: Kinetics-400达82.1%、Kinetics-600达83.6%、ImageNet迁移达78.7% top-1，均无需监督预训练。

Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频表示学习中全局与局部信息难以兼顾的问题，提出同时学习全局和局部视频表示的对比学习方法。方法上通过设计不同粒度的对比目标（如全局视频级对比与局部时空片段级对比），使模型既能捕捉整体语义又能保留细粒度时空细节。相比仅使用全局或仅使用局部对比的已有工作，该联合学习策略在视频理解下游任务上取得更好表现。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但全局-局部联合对比的思路对视频自监督学习有参考价值。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of jointly capturing global and local information in video representation learning by proposing a contrastive framework that learns both global and local video representations. It designs contrastive objectives at different granularities—video-level and spatiotemporal segment-level—so the model captures holistic semantics while preserving fine-grained details. Compared to methods using only global or only local contrast, this joint strategy improves downstream video understanding. The abstract lacks quantitative results, but the global-local joint contrast idea is relevant to self-supervised video learning.
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.assessment: 全局-局部联合对比是视频自监督的合理思路，但摘要信息有限，需关注其与已有层次化对比方法的差异。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.contribution: 提出同时学习全局和局部视频表示的对比学习框架。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.innovation: 在不同粒度上设计对比目标，联合优化全局语义与局部时空细节。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称联合学习策略优于仅用全局或仅用局部的对比方法。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local._arxiv_id: Contrastive Learning of Global and Local Video Representations.

2111.01673|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有动态特征变换（包括自注意力）在视频理解中难以有效建模时空对应关系（即运动信息）的问题，提出关系自注意力RSA。RSA通过动态生成关系核并聚合关系上下文，利用视频中丰富的时空关系结构进行特征变换。实验和消融表明，RSA网络显著优于卷积和自注意力对应方法，在以运动为中心的标准视频动作识别基准Something-Something-V1&V2、Diving48和FineGym上取得SOTA。
2111.01673|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing dynamic feature transforms, including self-attention, in modeling spatiotemporal correspondence (i.e., motion) for video understanding. It introduces Relational Self-Attention (RSA), which dynamically generates relational kernels and aggregates relational contexts to leverage rich spatiotemporal relation structures. Experiments and ablations show RSA substantially outperforms convolution and self-attention counterparts, achieving state of the art on motion-centric benchmarks including Something-Something-V1&V2, Diving48, and FineGym.
2111.01673|v2.assessment: RSA针对自注意力在运动建模上的不足提出关系核动态生成，对视频理解中的运动敏感任务有明确增益，思路对时序感知有借鉴意义。
2111.01673|v2.contribution: 提出关系自注意力RSA，通过动态生成关系核和聚合关系上下文增强视频时空关系建模。
2111.01673|v2.innovation: 用关系核替代传统自注意力的相似度核，显式建模时空对应关系以捕捉运动信息。
2111.01673|v2.result: 在Something-Something-V1&V2、Diving48和FineGym等运动中心基准上取得SOTA，显著优于卷积和自注意力方法。

Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中归一化层和网络深度固定、无法适应不同视频片段的问题，提出了动态归一化（Dynamic Normalization）和动态中继（Dynamic Relay）机制。方法通过根据输入视频内容动态调整归一化参数和网络执行路径，使模型能够自适应地分配计算资源。相比已有工作，该方法在多个视频动作识别基准上取得了更好的精度-效率权衡，例如在Something-Something V2上以更少计算量达到与基线相当或更高的准确率。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that normalization layers and network depth are fixed in video action recognition, failing to adapt to diverse video clips. It proposes Dynamic Normalization and Dynamic Relay mechanisms that dynamically adjust normalization parameters and network execution paths based on input content, enabling adaptive computation allocation. Compared to existing methods, it achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off on multiple benchmarks, e.g., matching or surpassing baselines with less computation on Something-Something V2.
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.assessment: 该工作为视频理解中的动态网络提供了新思路，但主题与自动驾驶感知核心领域关联较弱，适合对视频动作识别或动态计算感兴趣的研究者参考。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.contribution: 提出了动态归一化和动态中继机制，使视频动作识别网络能根据输入自适应调整归一化参数和计算路径。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.innovation: 将动态网络思想引入归一化层和网络深度选择，实现内容自适应的视频动作识别。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.result: 在多个视频动作识别基准上取得了更优的精度-效率权衡，例如在Something-Something V2上以更少计算量达到与基线相当或更高的准确率。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide._arxiv_id: Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Video Action Recognition.

Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.summary_en: This paper addresses video action recognition by proposing a recurrent Transformer architecture that reuses the same Transformer module across time to capture long-range temporal dependencies. The approach aims to improve temporal modeling while maintaining parameter efficiency. However, the abstract is missing, preventing assessment of specific experimental results or improvements over prior work.
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法充分评估其方法细节和实验效果，仅从标题判断与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。

2208.00281|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对4D点云视频理解中相机运动、场景变化和采样模式复杂等问题，提出了Point Primitive Transformer（PPTr），利用primitive plane作为中层表示来捕捉长期时空上下文。PPTr由intra-primitive point transformer和primitive transformer组成，形成层次化骨干网络。实验表明PPTr在多个任务上超越了此前的最优方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2208.00281|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-term 4D point cloud video understanding by proposing Point Primitive Transformer (PPTr), which leverages primitive planes as a mid-level representation to capture long-term spatio-temporal context. PPTr consists of intra-primitive point transformers and primitive transformers in a hierarchical backbone. Extensive experiments show PPTr outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods on various tasks, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
2208.00281|v2.assessment: 4D点云视频理解对自动驾驶场景理解有潜在价值，层次化primitive表示思路新颖，但需关注其在实际自动驾驶数据上的泛化能力。
2208.00281|v2.contribution: 提出了基于primitive plane的层次化4D点云视频理解骨干网络PPTr。
2208.00281|v2.innovation: 利用primitive plane作为中层表示，结合intra-primitive和inter-primitive transformer捕捉长期时空上下文。
2208.00281|v2.result: 在多个任务上超越此前最优方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。

2207.10158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督视频表示学习中聚类方法偏向视觉显著特征而忽略运动信息的问题，提出了一种引导式在线聚类分配策略（GOCA）。该方法利用RGB和光流两个视图的初始聚类分配互相引导，强制两个视图形成相似的聚类结构，从而获得语义抽象且对噪声鲁棒的表示。此外，提出了新的正则化策略解决特征坍塌问题。大量评估表明学习到的表示在下游任务上有效。
2207.10158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that clustering-based self-supervised video representation learning tends to focus on visually dominant features rather than motion. It proposes Guided Online Cluster Assignment (GOCA), which uses the initial cluster assignment of each view (RGB and optical flow) as a prior to guide the other view's final assignment, enforcing similar cluster structures across views. A novel regularization strategy is also proposed to address feature collapse. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of the learned representations on downstream tasks.
2207.10158|v2.assessment: 双视图互相引导的聚类策略设计合理，对自监督视频理解有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
2207.10158|v2.contribution: 提出了引导式在线聚类分配策略GOCA用于自监督视频表示学习。
2207.10158|v2.innovation: 利用RGB和光流双视图的初始聚类分配互相引导，并引入正则化解决特征坍塌。
2207.10158|v2.result: 学习到的表示在下游任务上表现有效，但摘要未给出具体数值。

2204.04796|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对第一人称动作识别中背景干扰物影响以及现有方法需要目标域高质量物体类别标注且与动作模型紧耦合的问题，提出了SOS（Self-Supervised Learning Over Sets）方法。SOS利用现成的手-物接触检测器提取物体区域，将动作过程视为自然数据变换，利用视频内物体区域间的时空关系进行自监督预训练，得到通用的Objects In Contact（OIC）表示。该方法无需目标域物体类别标注，且与动作模型解耦，可灵活集成。
2204.04796|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in egocentric action recognition caused by background distractors and the limitations of existing methods that require high-quality object class annotations and tightly coupled action-object models. It introduces SOS (Self-Supervised Learning Over Sets), which pre-trains a generic Objects In Contact (OIC) representation from video object regions detected by an off-the-shelf hand-object contact detector. By treating the action process as natural data transformations and exploiting spatio-temporal relationships among per-video object regions, SOS avoids the need for target-domain object annotations and enables flexible integration with action models.
2204.04796|v2.assessment: 利用手-物接触检测器进行自监督物体表示学习，解耦设计具有实用价值，但主要面向第一人称视频理解，与自动驾驶关联较弱。
2204.04796|v2.contribution: 提出了SOS方法，从手-物接触检测器提取的物体区域中自监督预训练通用OIC表示。
2204.04796|v2.innovation: 将动作过程视为自然数据变换，利用视频内物体区域的时空关系进行自监督学习，无需目标域标注且与动作模型解耦。
2204.04796|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数值，但方法在灵活性和标注需求方面有改进。

2202.14019|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对健身房场景下动作姿态评估中现成姿态估计器因相机角度、遮挡、光照和服装等因素表现不佳的问题，提出了领域知识引导的自监督表示学习方法（姿态对比学习和运动解耦）。该方法利用锻炼动作的谐波运动特性以及相机角度、服装和光照的大方差来学习鲁棒的图像和视频表示，使得少量专家标注数据即可完成监督错误检测。作者还构建了Fitness-AQA数据集，包含三种锻炼动作。
2202.14019|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of workout form assessment in gym scenarios, where off-the-shelf pose estimators struggle due to camera angles, occlusion, illumination, and clothing. It proposes domain knowledge-informed self-supervised approaches (pose contrastive learning and motion disentangling) that exploit the harmonic motion of exercises and large variances in camera angles, clothes, and illumination to learn powerful representations, enabling supervised error detection with a small expert-annotated dataset. A new Fitness-AQA dataset comprising three exercises is also curated.
2202.14019|v2.assessment: 领域知识引导的自监督学习思路有一定借鉴意义，但应用场景为健身动作评估，与自动驾驶感知领域几乎无关。
2202.14019|v2.contribution: 提出了领域知识引导的自监督表示学习方法用于健身动作错误检测，并构建了Fitness-AQA数据集。
2202.14019|v2.innovation: 利用锻炼动作的谐波运动特性和环境大方差进行姿态对比学习和运动解耦。
2202.14019|v2.result: 少量专家标注即可实现监督错误检测，但摘要未给出具体性能数值。

2207.12795|v2.summary_cn: 该论文受人类理解视频方式启发，提出了一种新的自监督视频表示学习方案：先学习通用视觉概念，再关注判别性局部区域。具体利用静态帧和帧差分解静态与动态概念，在隐空间分别对齐概念分布，并加入多样性和保真度正则化以学习紧凑有意义的概念集。然后通过交叉注意力聚合不同概念的局部特征，过滤低激活冗余概念进行局部概念对比。在UCF-101、HMDB-51和Diving-48上取得最优结果。
2207.12795|v2.summary_en: Inspired by how humans understand videos, this paper proposes a novel self-supervised video representation learning scheme that first learns general visual concepts and then attends to discriminative local areas. It decouples static and dynamic concepts using static frames and frame differences, aligns concept distributions in latent space, and adds diversity and fidelity regularizations to learn a compact set of meaningful concepts. A cross-attention mechanism aggregates local features and filters redundant concepts for local concept contrast. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on UCF-101, HMDB-51, and Diving-48.
2207.12795|v2.assessment: 静态/动态概念解耦与局部概念对比的设计有创新性，在多个视频理解基准上取得最优结果，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
2207.12795|v2.contribution: 提出了解耦静态和动态概念的自监督视频表示学习方案。
2207.12795|v2.innovation: 利用静态帧和帧差解耦概念，结合多样性和保真度正则化，并通过交叉注意力进行局部概念对比。

2207.01975|v2.summary_cn: 针对边缘设备产生的大量无标注视频数据在隐私和通信成本约束下难以大规模部署自监督学习的问题，本文将联邦学习引入视频自监督学习任务。作者首先评估了现有SOTA视频SSL方法在Kinetics-400模拟的大规模联邦场景下的表现并指出其不足，进而提出FedVSSL框架，集成多种聚合策略与部分权重更新机制。实验表明FedVSSL在下游检索任务上超过集中式SOTA，UCF-101提升6.66%，HMDB-51提升5.13%。
2207.01975|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of deploying self-supervised learning on large-scale unlabelled video data at the edge under privacy and communication constraints by integrating federated learning into video SSL. The authors evaluate state-of-the-art video-SSL methods in a federated setting simulated on Kinetics-400 and propose FedVSSL, a framework incorporating various aggregation strategies and partial weight updating. FedVSSL outperforms the centralized SOTA on downstream retrieval by 6.66% on UCF-101 and 5.13% on HMDB-51.
2207.01975|v2.assessment: 将联邦学习与视频自监督结合是一个有价值的方向，但主要面向视频理解而非自动驾驶感知，与用户核心领域关联较弱。
2207.01975|v2.contribution: 提出了面向视频自监督学习的联邦学习框架FedVSSL，并系统评估了现有视频SSL方法在联邦场景下的局限。
2207.01975|v2.innovation: 将多种聚合策略与部分权重更新集成到视频SSL的联邦训练中，缓解隐私与通信瓶颈。
2207.01975|v2.result: 在下游检索任务上超越集中式SOTA，UCF-101提升6.66%，HMDB-51提升5.13%。

2112.04478|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频理解任务训练成本高的问题，本文提出一种简单但强力的基线方法，高效适配预训练的图像-语言模型。具体做法是优化少量随机向量（连续提示向量），将视频相关任务转换为与预训练目标相同的格式，并用轻量Transformer在逐帧视觉特征上编码时序信息以弥合静态图像与视频的差距。在动作识别、动作定位和文本-视频检索的10个公开基准上，覆盖闭集、少样本和零样本场景，以显著更少的可调参数取得竞争性或SOTA性能。
2112.04478|v2.summary_en: This paper presents a simple yet strong baseline for efficiently adapting pre-trained image-based visual-language models to video understanding with minimal training. It optimizes a few continuous prompt vectors to convert video tasks into the pre-training objective format and encodes temporal information via lightweight Transformers on frame-wise features. Across 10 public benchmarks on action recognition, localization, and text-video retrieval in closed-set, few-shot, and zero-shot settings, it achieves competitive or state-of-the-art results while tuning significantly fewer parameters.
2112.04478|v2.assessment: 将视觉-语言模型的提示学习高效迁移到视频理解，方法简洁且实验覆盖广泛，对多模态视频理解研究者有较高参考价值。
2112.04478|v2.contribution: 提出基于连续提示向量的高效视频理解适配方法，以极少参数实现多任务多场景的竞争性性能。
2112.04478|v2.innovation: 用连续提示向量统一视频任务与预训练目标格式，并以轻量Transformer编码时序信息。
2112.04478|v2.result: 在10个公开基准的闭集、少样本、零样本场景下取得竞争性或SOTA性能，且可调参数显著更少。
