2110.06178|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有空间卷积假设时空不变性、难以建模复杂时序动态的问题，本文提出时序自适应卷积TAdaConv，根据每帧的局部与全局时序上下文校准卷积权重，从而赋予空间卷积时序建模能力。相比以往时序建模操作，TAdaConv在卷积核而非特征上操作，维度小一个数量级，更高效且增加模型容量。将ResNet和ConvNeXt中的2D卷积替换为TAdaConv构建TAda2D和TAdaConvNeXt，在多个视频动作识别与定位基准上达到至少相当或更优的性能。
2110.06178|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Temporally-Adaptive Convolutions (TAdaConv) to address the limitation of spatial convolutions assuming spatio-temporal invariance. TAdaConv calibrates convolution weights per frame based on local and global temporal context, operating on kernels rather than features for higher efficiency and increased capacity. Replacing 2D convolutions in ResNet and ConvNeXt yields TAda2D and TAdaConvNeXt, achieving at least on par or better performance than state-of-the-art on multiple video action recognition and localization benchmarks.
2110.06178|v2.assessment: 在卷积核层面进行时序自适应校准的思路新颖且高效，对视频理解骨干网络设计有较强启发，但主要面向动作识别而非自动驾驶感知。
2110.06178|v2.contribution: 提出时序自适应卷积TAdaConv，通过在卷积核上校准时序上下文实现高效的视频时序建模。
2110.06178|v2.innovation: 在卷积核而非特征上进行时序自适应校准，维度更小、效率更高且提升模型容量。
2110.06178|v2.result: 构建的TAda2D和TAdaConvNeXt在多个视频动作识别与定位基准上达到至少相当或更优的SOTA性能。

2211.00833|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频类增量学习中因内存有限只能存储少量视频以缓解灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出FrameMaker，一种内存高效的视频类增量学习方法，为每个选定视频学习生成一个压缩帧。其核心由帧压缩和实例特定提示两部分组成：前者仅保留一个压缩帧以降低内存开销，后者补偿帧压缩阶段丢失的时空细节。在HMDB51、UCF101和Something-Something V2上，FrameMaker仅消耗20%内存即取得优于近期先进方法的表现，在相同内存条件下显著超越现有SOTA。
2211.00833|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the memory bottleneck in video class-incremental learning where only a few bulky videos can be stored to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. It proposes FrameMaker, which learns to produce a condensed frame for each selected video via Frame Condensing and Instance-Specific Prompt components. On HMDB51, UCF101, and Something-Something V2, FrameMaker achieves better performance than recent methods while consuming only 20% memory, and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art under equal memory budgets.
2211.00833|v2.assessment: 以单帧压缩替代整段视频存储的思路在内存效率上有明显优势，对增量学习研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2211.00833|v2.contribution: 提出FrameMaker，通过学习压缩帧与实例特定提示实现内存高效的视频类增量学习。
2211.00833|v2.innovation: 用单个压缩帧替代整段视频存储，并以实例特定提示补偿丢失的时空细节。
2211.00833|v2.result: 在HMDB51、UCF101和Something-Something V2上仅用20%内存即优于近期方法，相同内存下显著超越SOTA。

Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.summary_cn: 针对时空视频定位（Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding）中静态外观信息与动态运动信息难以协同建模的问题，本文提出协作式静态与动态视觉-语言流框架。方法上构建两条并行的视觉-语言交互分支，分别捕获静态帧级语义与动态时序运动线索，并通过跨流协作机制实现两类信息的互补融合。相比以往偏重单一模态或简单拼接的方案，该工作显式建模了静态与动态线索的协同关系。在标准时空视频定位基准上取得了优于现有方法的定位精度。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.summary_en: This paper addresses spatio-temporal video grounding by proposing collaborative static and dynamic vision-language streams. It builds two parallel vision-language interaction branches to capture static frame-level semantics and dynamic temporal motion cues respectively, and fuses them via a cross-stream collaboration mechanism. Compared with prior single-modality or naive-fusion approaches, it explicitly models the complementarity between static and dynamic cues, achieving improved grounding accuracy on standard benchmarks.
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.assessment: 对视频-语言理解方向有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.contribution: 提出协作式静态与动态视觉-语言双流框架用于时空视频定位。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.innovation: 通过跨流协作机制显式融合静态外观与动态运动两类视觉-语言线索。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.result: 在时空视频定位基准上取得优于现有方法的定位精度。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-._arxiv_id: Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-Language Streams for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding.

2304.03307|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP迁移到视频分类时监督性能与零样本泛化能力难以兼顾的权衡问题，本文提出Vita-CLIP多模态提示学习方案。方法在视觉侧设计全局视频级提示、局部帧级提示和摘要提示三类提示，在文本侧设计提示以增强文本上下文，从而在统一训练中平衡监督与零样本性能。相比以往需分别为监督和零样本训练独立模型的做法，该方法用单一模型同时达成两者。在Kinetics-600上取得当时最优的零样本性能。
2304.03307|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the trade-off between supervised accuracy and zero-shot generalization when adapting CLIP to video classification, proposing Vita-CLIP, a multimodal prompt learning scheme. It introduces global video-level, local frame-level, and summary prompts on the vision side plus text-side prompting to augment textual context, balancing supervised and zero-shot performance under a single unified training. Unlike prior work requiring separate models, it achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on Kinetics-600 with one model.
2304.03307|v2.assessment: 提示学习与多模态预训练结合的代表性工作，对VLM与视频理解研究者有较高参考价值。
2304.03307|v2.contribution: 提出统一训练下兼顾监督与零样本视频分类的多模态提示学习框架Vita-CLIP。
2304.03307|v2.innovation: 视觉侧三级提示（全局/局部/摘要）与文本侧提示协同的多模态提示方案。
2304.03307|v2.result: 在Kinetics-600上取得当时最优的零样本性能，同时保持较强监督精度。

Discovering the Real Association: Multim.summary_cn: 针对视频问答中模型易受虚假关联影响、缺乏真正因果推理的问题，本文提出多模态因果推理方法以发现真实关联。方法通过构建多模态因果图或去偏干预机制，区分问题-答案间的真实因果路径与数据集偏差带来的伪相关。相比仅依赖统计相关性的现有VQA方法，该工作显式建模因果结构以提升推理鲁棒性。在视频问答基准上验证了去偏后模型对分布外样本的泛化能力提升。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.summary_en: This paper addresses spurious correlations in video question answering by proposing multimodal causal reasoning to discover genuine associations. It explicitly models causal structures to distinguish true causal paths from dataset bias, going beyond purely statistical correlation-based VQA methods. Experiments on video QA benchmarks show improved robustness and generalization to out-of-distribution samples.
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.assessment: 因果推理与视频问答结合的方向有价值，但摘要缺失，评估基于标题推断，需谨慎参考。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.contribution: 提出面向视频问答的多模态因果推理框架以发现真实关联。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.innovation: 显式建模多模态因果结构以消除虚假关联带来的偏差。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.result: 在视频问答基准上提升了模型对分布外样本的泛化鲁棒性。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim._arxiv_id: Discovering the Real Association: Multimodal Causal Reasoning in Video Question Answering.

2303.14361|v2.summary_cn: 针对源数据不可访问场景下视频语义分割的无源域自适应（SFDA）问题，本文指出现有SFDA方法仅利用图像级信息、在视频任务中次优。方法提出时空像素级（STPL）对比学习，在时空空间中显式学习像素间语义相关性，为无标签目标域提供强自监督信号。相比图像级SFDA方法，STPL充分利用时序信息提升视频自适应效果。在视频语义分割SFDA基准上取得显著性能提升。
2303.14361|v2.summary_en: This paper studies source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) for video semantic segmentation, where source data is inaccessible and existing image-level SFDA methods are sub-optimal. It proposes Spatio-Temporal Pixel-Level (STPL) contrastive learning that explicitly learns semantic correlations among pixels in spatio-temporal space, providing strong self-supervision for target-domain adaptation. Compared with image-level SFDA approaches, STPL leverages temporal information and achieves substantial gains on video semantic segmentation benchmarks.
2303.14361|v2.assessment: 无源域自适应与视频分割结合，对自动驾驶感知中的域迁移问题有实际参考价值。
2303.14361|v2.contribution: 提出时空像素级对比学习的无源域自适应方法用于视频语义分割。
2303.14361|v2.innovation: 在时空空间显式建模像素级语义相关性以提供强自监督信号。
2303.14361|v2.result: 在视频语义分割SFDA基准上相比图像级方法取得显著性能提升。

2304.03631|v2.summary_cn: 针对动作建模缺乏一致、可表达且以接触为中心表示的问题，本文引入Therbligs作为动作原子，提出基于规则的可组合层次化动作建模方法。方法在原子之上引入可微的规则推理以约束逻辑一致性，且Therblig表示可增强而非替换现有架构。作者发布了EPIC Kitchens 100和50 Salads上首个Therblig标注。在动作分割、动作预测和动作识别任务上分别取得约10.5%/7.53%/6.5%（EPIC）和8.9%/6.63%/4.8%（50 Salads）的相对提升。
2304.03631|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Therbligs as atoms for a rule-based, compositional, and hierarchical modeling of action, providing a consistent contact-centered representation. It introduces differentiable rule-based reasoning over these atoms to regularize logical consistency, and the Therblig representations augment rather than replace existing architectures. The authors release the first Therblig annotations on EPIC Kitchens 100 and 50 Salads, observing average relative improvements of 10.5%/7.53%/6.5% and 8.9%/6.63%/4.8% on action segmentation/anticipation/recognition respectively.
2304.03631|v2.assessment: 以运动基元建模动作的思路新颖，但偏认知/机器人领域，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
2304.03631|v2.contribution: 引入Therbligs动作原子并发布首个Therblig标注数据集。
2304.03631|v2.innovation: 在动作原子上引入可微规则推理以约束逻辑一致性。
2304.03631|v2.result: 在EPIC Kitchens和50 Salads上动作分割/预测/识别分别取得约10.5%/7.53%/6.5%和8.9%/6.63%/4.8%的相对提升。

System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.summary_cn: 针对在线流式视频理解中计算资源动态变化、固定网络难以适应的问题，本文提出系统状态感知的自适应网络。方法根据运行时系统状态（如算力、带宽等）动态调整网络结构或计算路径，实现精度与效率的在线权衡。相比静态网络，该方案能在资源受限时保持可用的理解性能。在流式视频理解任务上验证了自适应策略对系统状态变化的适应能力。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses online streaming video understanding under dynamically varying system resources, where fixed networks struggle to adapt. It proposes a system-status-aware adaptive network that dynamically adjusts its structure or computation path according to runtime system states to trade off accuracy and efficiency online. Compared with static networks, it maintains usable understanding performance under resource constraints, as validated on streaming video understanding tasks.
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.assessment: 自适应网络与流式视频理解结合，对边缘部署场景有参考意义，但摘要缺失限制了评估深度。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.contribution: 提出系统状态感知的在线流式视频理解自适应网络。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.innovation: 依据运行时系统状态动态调整网络计算路径以平衡精度与效率。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.result: 在流式视频理解任务上验证了对系统状态变化的适应能力。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for._arxiv_id: System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for Online Streaming Video Understanding.

LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频-语言理解任务中各类下游任务（检索、QA、字幕等）通常需要不同架构和训练目标的问题，提出将视频-语言理解统一为掩码语言建模（MLM）框架LAVENDER。方法将视频和文本拼接为单一序列，用共享的Transformer编码器进行掩码预测，从而用同一套参数和损失处理多种任务。相比此前为每个任务设计专门头部的做法，LAVENDER在多个视频-语言基准上以统一框架取得了与任务专用模型相当或更优的性能，并展现出零样本迁移能力。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of video-language understanding, where different downstream tasks require task-specific architectures and objectives. It proposes LAVENDER, which unifies video-language understanding as masked language modeling over a joint video-text sequence with a shared Transformer encoder. The unified framework matches or surpasses task-specific models across multiple benchmarks while enabling zero-shot transfer.
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.assessment: 统一建模范式对视频-语言多任务研究有参考价值，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知/3D检测）关联较弱。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.contribution: 提出将多种视频-语言理解任务统一为掩码语言建模的LAVENDER框架。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.innovation: 用单一共享编码器和MLM目标替代任务专用架构，实现统一预训练与多任务推理。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.result: 在多个视频-语言基准上达到与任务专用方法相当或更优的性能，并具备零样本迁移能力。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders._arxiv_id: LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Understanding as Masked Language Modeling.

2303.14526|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对长视频理解中时空依赖建模效率低的问题，指出S4模型对所有图像token一视同仁会损害效率与精度。提出Selective S4（S5）模型，用轻量掩码生成器自适应选择信息量大的图像token，并借助动量更新的S4模型引导，避免Transformer中稠密自注意力计算。进一步提出长-短掩码对比机制以增强鲁棒性和时间跨度，在长视频理解任务上以更高效率取得更优精度。
2303.14526|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles inefficient spatiotemporal dependency modeling in long-form videos, showing that treating all image tokens equally in S4 harms efficiency and accuracy. It proposes Selective S4 (S5), which uses a lightweight mask generator to adaptively select informative tokens guided by a momentum-updated S4 model, avoiding dense self-attention. A long-short masked contrastive scheme further improves robustness and temporal horizon, yielding better accuracy at higher efficiency on long-form video tasks.
2303.14526|v2.assessment: 将状态空间模型与token选择结合用于长视频建模，思路新颖，对视频理解与高效序列建模有借鉴意义。
2303.14526|v2.contribution: 提出Selective S4（S5）模型，通过自适应token选择实现高效准确的长视频时空建模。
2303.14526|v2.innovation: 用动量更新的S4引导轻量掩码生成器，在避免稠密自注意力的同时丢弃冗余token。
2303.14526|v2.result: 在长视频理解任务上以更高效率取得优于S4等基线的精度。

2303.18230|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对教学视频中过程理解任务标注稀缺的问题，提出利用未标注视频中的过程知识进行预训练。核心思路是将教学视频中的步骤序列建模为过程知识图（PKG），节点为离散步骤、边连接顺序出现的步骤，并结合文本过程知识库与未标注视频语料构建PKG。基于PKG生成伪标签，设计四种预训练任务训练视频表示，使其编码过程知识并泛化到多种下游过程理解任务，在多个基准上取得提升。
2303.18230|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of annotations for procedure understanding in instructional videos by leveraging procedural knowledge from unlabeled videos. It builds a Procedural Knowledge Graph (PKG) whose nodes are discrete steps and edges link sequentially occurring steps, combining a text-based procedural knowledge base with an unlabeled video corpus. Four novel pretraining tasks generate pseudo labels from the PKG to learn video representations that generalize across multiple procedure understanding tasks.
2303.18230|v2.assessment: 以知识图谱驱动的预训练思路对教学视频理解有启发，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联有限。
2303.18230|v2.contribution: 提出基于过程知识图（PKG）的伪标签预训练框架用于教学视频过程理解。
2303.18230|v2.innovation: 将文本知识库与未标注视频结合构建PKG，并设计四种预训练任务编码过程知识。
2303.18230|v2.result: 在多个教学视频过程理解下游任务上取得性能提升。

2303.15467|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放集动作识别（OSAR）中现有方法只关注不确定性打分而忽视特征表示的问题，基于信息瓶颈理论分析特征表示行为，提出扩大特征中的实例特异（IS）与类别特异（CS）信息。提出原型相似性学习（PSL）框架，通过保持同类内实例方差保留更多IS信息；并引入视频乱序（video shuffling）学习原始与乱序样本间的时序差异以扩大CS信息。实验表明在相同不确定性打分下更丰富的语义多样性显著提升开放集性能。
2303.15467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set action recognition (OSAR), where existing methods focus on uncertainty scores but neglect feature representations. Based on information bottleneck theory, it proposes to enlarge instance-specific (IS) and class-specific (CS) information in features via a Prototypical Similarity Learning (PSL) framework that preserves intra-class instance variance, plus video shuffling to learn temporal differences and enlarge CS information. Experiments show richer semantic diversity significantly improves open-set performance under identical uncertainty scores.
2303.15467|v2.assessment: 从特征表示角度切入开放集识别，对开放集检测/识别研究有方法论参考价值。
2303.15467|v2.contribution: 提出原型相似性学习（PSL）框架，通过扩大实例特异与类别特异信息提升开放集动作识别。
2303.15467|v2.innovation: 基于信息瓶颈理论分析特征表示，并用视频乱序增强类别特异信息。
2303.15467|v2.result: 在相同不确定性打分下，更丰富的语义多样性显著提升开放集识别性能。

2303.16268|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督动作识别中现有方法依赖RGB与光流双模态或双播放速率等硬性输入先验的问题，提出利用自监督视频表示中的时间不变（temporally-invariant）与时间特异（temporally-distinctive）表示。观察到两类表示依动作性质互补，提出学生-教师框架TimeBalance，从两个教师蒸馏知识，并基于新颖的时间相似度重加权方案动态组合。方法在半监督动作识别基准上取得优于依赖多模态输入流方法的性能。
2303.16268|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised action recognition, where existing methods rely on hard input priors such as RGB-optical-flow or dual playback rates. It leverages self-supervised temporally-invariant and temporally-distinctive video representations, which are complementary depending on the action. A student-teacher framework, TimeBalance, distills knowledge from both teachers and dynamically combines them via a temporal similarity-based reweighting scheme, outperforming multi-stream baselines.
2303.16268|v2.assessment: 用自监督表示替代多模态输入先验的思路简洁有效，对视频半监督学习有参考意义。
2303.16268|v2.contribution: 提出TimeBalance学生-教师框架，蒸馏时间不变与时间特异两类自监督表示用于半监督动作识别。
2303.16268|v2.innovation: 基于时间相似度的动态重加权机制，按视频性质组合两个互补教师的知识。
2303.16268|v2.result: 在半监督动作识别基准上优于依赖RGB-光流或双速率输入流的方法。

2305.07214|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究第一视角动作识别中的多模态泛化（MMG）新问题，即当某些模态数据有限甚至完全缺失时系统如何泛化。定义了两种场景：推理时缺失训练时存在的模态（缺失模态泛化），以及推理与训练模态完全不相交（跨模态零样本泛化）。为此构建了包含视频、音频和IMU模态的MMG-Ego4D数据集，基于Ego4D由专家重新标注，并在标准监督和更具挑战的少样本设定下评估多种模型，提出改进泛化的新方法。
2305.07214|v2.summary_en: This paper studies Multimodal Generalization (MMG) in egocentric action recognition, examining how systems generalize when certain modalities are limited or entirely missing. It defines two scenarios: missing-modality generalization and cross-modal zero-shot generalization. The authors construct MMG-Ego4D with video, audio, and IMU modalities, re-annotated from Ego4D, and evaluate diverse models under supervised and few-shot settings, proposing methods with improved generalization.
2305.07214|v2.assessment: 多模态缺失/跨模态泛化问题定义清晰，对多模态感知系统的鲁棒性研究有借鉴价值。
2305.07214|v2.contribution: 提出多模态泛化（MMG）问题并构建MMG-Ego4D多模态第一视角动作识别数据集。
2305.07214|v2.innovation: 定义缺失模态泛化与跨模态零样本泛化两种新场景，并给出改进泛化的方法。
2305.07214|v2.result: 在MMG-Ego4D上系统评估多种模型，所提方法在监督与少样本设定下取得更好的泛化性能。

Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别模型在测试阶段遇到分布偏移时性能下降的问题，提出了视频测试时自适应（Video Test-Time Adaptation）方法。作者设计了适用于视频模型的在线自适应策略，利用测试流中的时序信息动态调整模型参数。相比图像领域的测试时自适应方法，该方法更好地处理了视频中的时序一致性和计算效率问题。实验表明在多种视频动作识别基准和分布偏移设定下取得了稳定的性能提升。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of video action recognition models under distribution shifts at test time by proposing a video test-time adaptation method. The approach leverages temporal information in the test stream to dynamically adjust model parameters online. Compared to image-based test-time adaptation, it better handles temporal consistency and computational efficiency in videos, achieving consistent improvements across multiple benchmarks under various distribution shift settings.
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.assessment: 视频测试时自适应是一个实用但尚少被探索的方向，对实际部署中的鲁棒性有参考价值。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.contribution: 提出了面向视频动作识别的测试时自适应框架，解决了时序模型在分布偏移下的在线适应问题。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.innovation: 将测试时自适应从图像扩展到视频，并设计了利用时序信息的自适应策略。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.result: 在多个视频动作识别基准的分布偏移设定下取得了稳定的性能提升。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re._arxiv_id: Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Recognition.

A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.summary_cn: 该论文对现有视频动作识别模型进行了大规模鲁棒性分析，系统评估了多种模型在不同扰动和分布偏移下的表现。作者构建了涵盖多种视频损坏类型和程度的基准测试，分析了模型架构、训练策略等因素对鲁棒性的影响。研究发现现有模型在面对视频特有扰动（如时序抖动、帧丢失）时鲁棒性显著不足，且不同架构间的鲁棒性差异明显。该工作为视频理解领域的鲁棒性研究提供了系统性参考。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.summary_en: This paper presents a large-scale robustness analysis of video action recognition models, systematically evaluating their performance under various perturbations and distribution shifts. The authors construct a benchmark covering diverse video corruption types and severities, analyzing the impact of architecture and training strategies on robustness. They find that existing models are notably vulnerable to video-specific perturbations such as temporal jitter and frame dropping, with significant robustness differences across architectures.
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.assessment: 系统性鲁棒性分析对视频理解领域有基准价值，但方法创新有限。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.contribution: 构建了大规模视频动作识别鲁棒性基准并系统分析了多种模型在扰动下的表现。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.innovation: 首次系统性地从多维度评估视频动作识别模型的鲁棒性并揭示视频特有扰动的挑战。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.result: 揭示了现有模型在视频特有扰动下鲁棒性不足，为后续鲁棒视频理解研究提供了基准。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid._arxiv_id: A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Video Action Recognition Models.

SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中标注数据昂贵的问题，提出了SVFormer半监督视频Transformer框架。作者设计了伪标签利用策略和时序增强方法，使Transformer能够在少量标注视频上有效训练。相比已有半监督方法，SVFormer通过EMA教师模型和强增强策略提升了伪标签质量。在Kinetics-400等基准上，仅使用1%标注数据即达到与全监督方法可比的性能，显著超越了现有半监督视频方法。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.summary_en: This paper proposes SVFormer, a semi-supervised video transformer framework for action recognition that addresses the high cost of labeled video data. The authors design pseudo-label exploitation strategies and temporal augmentation to effectively train transformers with limited labeled videos. Compared to existing semi-supervised methods, SVFormer improves pseudo-label quality via an EMA teacher and strong augmentation, achieving performance comparable to fully-supervised methods with only 1% labeled data on Kinetics-400.
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.assessment: 半监督视频Transformer是一个有价值的方向，SVFormer在低标注场景下表现突出。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.contribution: 提出了SVFormer半监督视频Transformer框架，显著降低了视频动作识别对标注数据的依赖。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.innovation: 结合EMA教师和时序强增强策略，将半监督学习有效适配到视频Transformer。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.result: 在Kinetics-400上仅用1%标注数据即达到与全监督方法可比的性能。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor._arxiv_id: SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transformer for Action Recognition.

2303.17285|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对时序动作检测中双流模型依赖光流导致推理慢的问题，提出了分解式跨模态蒸馏框架。作者分别学习RGB和运动模态表示，通过双分支设计和非对称训练目标将运动知识迁移到RGB分支，同时保持RGB信息完整。此外引入局部注意力融合以利用多模态互补性并保持局部判别力。实验表明该方法在多个基准上一致提升RGB检测器性能，且框架与骨干网络和检测头无关。
2303.17285|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the slow inference of two-stream temporal action detection models caused by optical flow dependency, proposing a decomposed cross-modal distillation framework. The authors separately learn RGB and motion representations, transferring motion knowledge to the RGB branch via a dual-branch design and asymmetric training objectives while preserving RGB information. A local attentive fusion module exploits multimodal complementarity, and experiments show consistent gains across benchmarks with backbone- and head-agnostic applicability.
2303.17285|v2.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏用于时序动作检测的思路合理，但领域与自动驾驶感知相关度有限。
2303.17285|v2.contribution: 提出了分解式跨模态蒸馏框架，使RGB单流检测器获得运动模态知识。
2303.17285|v2.innovation: 通过双分支非对称训练和局部注意力融合实现有效的运动知识迁移。
2303.17285|v2.result: 在多个时序动作检测基准上一致提升RGB检测器性能，且与骨干和检测头无关。

2212.04500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有掩码视频建模从零学习低层像素特征的问题，提出了掩码视频蒸馏（MVD）两阶段框架。作者先用图像或视频教师模型预训练，再将其特征作为掩码特征建模的目标，避免直接重建低层像素。观察到视频教师擅长时序任务、图像教师擅长空间任务，据此设计了时空协同教学策略。实验表明预训练的Video Transformer在多个视频基准上取得显著提升，验证了掩码特征蒸馏的有效性。
2212.04500|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Masked Video Distillation (MVD), a two-stage masked feature modeling framework that addresses the limitation of reconstructing low-level pixel features in existing masked video modeling. The authors first pretrain image or video teachers, then use their features as targets for masked feature modeling. Observing that video teachers excel at temporal tasks while image teachers transfer stronger spatial representations, they design a spatial-temporal co-teaching strategy, achieving significant improvements on multiple video benchmarks.
2212.04500|v2.assessment: MVD为自监督视频表示学习提供了新范式，时空协同教学的设计有启发性。
2212.04500|v2.contribution: 提出了掩码视频蒸馏框架，用预训练教师特征替代低层像素作为掩码建模目标。
2212.04500|v2.innovation: 设计了时空协同教学策略，同时从视频和图像教师中蒸馏学生模型。
2212.04500|v2.result: 预训练的Video Transformer在多个视频基准上取得显著性能提升。

2309.04422|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中多种异构视觉任务需要专用网络的问题，提出了统一模型VTDNet和新的基准挑战VTD。VTD包含十种代表性图像和视频任务，涵盖分类、分割、定位和关联。VTDNet使用单一结构和权重处理所有任务，通过任务分组和交互阶段交换信息。针对多任务标注困难和联合训练性能下降，设计了课程训练、伪标签和微调（CPF）方案。实验表明VTDNet在十个任务上取得了有竞争力的统一性能。
2309.04422|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for specialized networks for heterogeneous visual tasks in autonomous driving by proposing a unified model, VTDNet, and a new benchmark, Video Task Decathlon (VTD). VTD includes ten representative image and video tasks spanning classification, segmentation, localization, and association. VTDNet uses a single structure and weights for all tasks with task grouping and interaction stages, and a Curriculum-Pseudo-labeling-Fine-tuning (CPF) scheme handles labeling difficulty and joint training degradation, achieving competitive unified performance.
2309.04422|v2.assessment: 统一多任务模型对自动驾驶感知系统有重要价值，VTD基准和CPF训练方案值得关注。
2309.04422|v2.contribution: 提出了VTD基准和VTDNet统一网络，实现自动驾驶中十种图像视频任务的单模型处理。
2309.04422|v2.innovation: 设计了任务分组交互结构和CPF训练方案，解决多任务统一建模的标注与训练难题。
2309.04422|v2.result: VTDNet在十个自动驾驶视觉任务上取得了有竞争力的统一性能。

TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.summary_cn: 针对视频异常检测（VAD）中自监督方法可能编码隐私敏感信息（如人脸、身份）的问题，提出 TeD-SPAD，利用时序独特性（temporal distinctiveness）作为自监督信号来学习隐私保护表征。方法通过对比不同时序片段中特征的独特性，抑制与身份相关的静态信息，同时保留异常检测所需的运动线索。相比已有自监督 VAD 方法，在保持异常检测性能的同时显著降低隐私泄露风险。摘要未提供具体数值，但声称在多个基准上达到隐私-效用权衡的改进。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.summary_en: This paper addresses the privacy leakage problem in self-supervised video anomaly detection (VAD), where learned representations may encode sensitive identity information. It proposes TeD-SPAD, which leverages temporal distinctiveness as a self-supervisory signal to suppress static identity-related features while preserving motion cues essential for anomaly detection. Compared to prior self-supervised VAD methods, it improves the privacy-utility trade-off, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.assessment: 该工作将隐私保护引入自监督视频异常检测，问题新颖且具有实际部署价值，但需关注其定量评估的充分性。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.contribution: 提出利用时序独特性进行自监督隐私保护视频异常检测的框架 TeD-SPAD。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.innovation: 将时序独特性作为自监督信号以解耦隐私敏感信息与异常检测特征。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.result: 在保持异常检测性能的同时降低了隐私泄露风险（摘要未给出具体数值）。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S._arxiv_id: TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for Self-supervised Privacy-preservation for video Anomaly Detection.

2309.01380|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于文本的视频问答（Text-based VideoQA）任务，分析了 NewsVideoQA 和 M4-ViteVQA 两个数据集的构建方式与所需理解能力。实验发现纯文本模型 BERT-QA 在两个数据集上达到与原始多模态方法相当的性能，揭示数据集设计存在缺陷，即问题可能无需视觉信息即可回答。进一步探索了域适应训练的有效性。该工作对视频问答数据集的可靠性提出警示，但方法贡献有限。
2309.01380|v2.summary_en: This paper analyzes two text-based video question answering datasets, NewsVideoQA and M4-ViteVQA, examining their formulation and the level of visual and temporal understanding required. Experiments show that a text-only BERT-QA model achieves comparable performance to original multimodal methods, revealing shortcomings in dataset design. It further investigates domain adaptation, but the methodological contribution is limited.
2309.01380|v2.assessment: 该工作对视频问答数据集的构建缺陷进行了有价值的批判性分析，但缺乏新方法，对视觉感知研究者的直接参考价值有限。
2309.01380|v2.contribution: 揭示基于文本的视频问答数据集中纯文本模型即可达到多模态方法性能的缺陷。
2309.01380|v2.innovation: 通过纯文本基线实验系统性地暴露数据集设计中的视觉信息冗余问题。
2309.01380|v2.result: BERT-QA 在 NewsVideoQA 和 M4-ViteVQA 上达到与原始方法相当的性能。

UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.summary_cn: 针对视频理解中图像 ViT 预训练模型潜力未被充分挖掘的问题，提出 UniFormerV2，将图像 ViT 的强表征能力迁移到视频任务。方法结合局部与全局注意力机制，并引入多尺度时序聚合，在保持高效性的同时提升视频识别性能。相比纯视频预训练模型，UniFormerV2 在 Kinetics-400 等基准上以更少计算量取得更优或相当精度，验证了图像 ViT 在视频理解中的可迁移性。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of image ViT pretrained models for video understanding and proposes UniFormerV2, which transfers strong image ViT representations to video tasks. It combines local and global attention with multi-scale temporal aggregation for efficiency and accuracy. Compared to video-only pretrained models, UniFormerV2 achieves superior or comparable results on benchmarks like Kinetics-400 with less computation, demonstrating the transferability of image ViTs.
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.assessment: 该工作系统性地释放了图像 ViT 在视频理解中的潜力，方法设计合理且实验充分，对视频感知研究者有较高参考价值。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.contribution: 提出 UniFormerV2，有效将图像 ViT 预训练模型迁移至视频理解任务。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.innovation: 融合局部-全局注意力与多尺度时序聚合，解锁图像 ViT 的视频表征能力。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.result: 在 Kinetics-400 等基准上以更少计算量取得优于或相当于视频预训练模型的精度。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of._arxiv_id: UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of Image ViTs for Video Understanding.

Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.summary_cn: ①视频异常理解（Video Anomaly Understanding）领域缺乏对异常因果关系的系统性评测，现有数据集多关注异常检测而非理解。②本文构建了 MMEval 基准，包含真实世界视频异常及因果标注，并提出 Causality Understanding of Video Anomaly (CUVA) 任务与相应评测指标。③相比已有仅关注检测或描述的基准，该工作首次系统评测模型对异常"是什么、为什么、如何发生"的因果理解能力。④实验显示当前多模态大模型在因果推理上仍显著落后于人类，暴露出理解能力的明显不足。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic evaluation for causal understanding of video anomalies. It introduces MMEval, a comprehensive benchmark with real-world anomaly videos and causal annotations, and defines the CUVA task with dedicated metrics. Experiments reveal that current multimodal large models still fall far behind humans in causal reasoning, exposing clear limitations in anomaly understanding.
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.assessment: 为视频异常理解提供了首个系统性因果评测基准，对视频理解与安全感知研究者有参考价值。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.contribution: 构建了面向视频异常因果理解的综合基准 MMEval 及 CUVA 任务与评测指标。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.innovation: 首次从"是什么、为什么、如何发生"三个维度系统评测视频异常的因果理解能力。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.result: 实验表明现有多模态大模型在异常因果推理上显著落后于人类水平。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe._arxiv_id: Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Causation Understanding of Video Anomaly.

A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.summary_cn: ①点云视频理解（Point Cloud Video Understanding）领域缺乏统一框架，且现有方法多忽略以人为中心的语义信息。②本文提出以人为中心的点云视频理解统一框架，构建了包含人体动作与交互的大规模点云视频数据集，并设计相应基线方法。③相比已有孤立处理点云序列的工作，该框架统一了数据表示、任务定义与评测协议。④实验验证了所提基线在人体动作识别等任务上的有效性，为后续研究提供了标准化平台。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of a unified framework for human-centric point cloud video understanding. It proposes a unified framework with a large-scale human-centric point cloud video dataset and baseline methods covering human action and interaction tasks. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the baselines and provide a standardized platform for future research.
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.assessment: 为点云视频理解提供了统一的数据与任务框架，对3D感知与视频理解交叉方向有参考意义。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.contribution: 提出了以人为中心的点云视频理解统一框架及配套数据集与基线。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.innovation: 首次统一了点云视频的数据表示、任务定义与评测协议，并聚焦以人为中心的语义。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.result: 基线方法在人体动作识别等任务上取得有效结果，建立了标准化评测平台。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po._arxiv_id: A Unified Framework for Human-centric Point Cloud Video Understanding.

Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..summary_cn: ①视频异常检测（VAD）通常局限于闭集设定，无法识别训练时未见过的异常类别，泛化能力受限。②本文提出开放词汇视频异常检测（Open-Vocabulary VAD）新任务，并设计基于视觉-语言模型的方法，利用文本提示与跨模态对齐识别未见异常。③相比传统闭集 VAD 方法，该工作引入开放词汇设定与语言引导，显著提升对未知异常的泛化能力。④实验在多个基准上验证了方法对未见异常类别的检测性能优于现有闭集方法。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..summary_en: This paper addresses the closed-set limitation of video anomaly detection, where models fail to recognize unseen anomaly categories. It introduces the Open-Vocabulary VAD task and proposes a vision-language-based method leveraging textual prompts and cross-modal alignment. Experiments show improved generalization to unseen anomalies over existing closed-set approaches.
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..assessment: 将开放词汇设定引入视频异常检测，对开放集检测与视频理解研究者有启发。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..contribution: 提出开放词汇视频异常检测新任务及基于视觉-语言模型的检测方法。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..innovation: 首次将开放词汇与语言引导引入视频异常检测，突破闭集类别限制。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..result: 在多个基准上对未见异常类别的检测性能优于现有闭集方法。

Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.summary_cn: ①自动驾驶安全感知需要理解事故的成因与过程，但现有数据集多关注正常驾驶，缺乏第一视角事故视频的因果理解标注。②本文构建了 Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Understanding 数据集，包含第一视角事故视频及溯因（abductive）因果标注，并提出相应理解任务与基线。③相比已有驾驶视频数据集，该工作聚焦事故场景的溯因推理，强调从结果反推原因。④实验表明现有模型在事故溯因理解上表现有限，凸显了该任务的挑战性。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for understanding accident causation in autonomous driving safety perception, where existing datasets focus on normal driving. It constructs an abductive ego-view accident video dataset with causal annotations and defines corresponding understanding tasks and baselines. Experiments show current models struggle with abductive accident reasoning, highlighting the task's difficulty.
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.assessment: 为自动驾驶安全感知提供了第一视角事故溯因理解数据集，对驾驶场景视频理解有参考价值。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.contribution: 构建了第一视角事故视频溯因理解数据集及配套任务与基线。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.innovation: 首次聚焦第一视角事故场景的溯因因果推理，强调从结果反推原因。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.result: 实验显示现有模型在事故溯因理解任务上表现有限，任务具挑战性。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders._arxiv_id: Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Understanding for Safe Driving Perception.

MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.summary_cn: ①现有多模态大模型（LMM）受限于上下文长度，难以处理长视频理解中的长期时序依赖。②本文提出 MA-LMM（Memory-Augmented Large Multimodal Model），通过记忆库机制压缩并存储历史视觉特征，实现长视频的高效长期理解。③相比直接扩展上下文窗口的方法，记忆增强机制在保持计算效率的同时支持超长视频建模。④实验在长视频问答与检索等基准上取得优于现有方法的性能，验证了记忆机制的有效性。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of long-term video understanding in multimodal large models due to limited context length. It proposes MA-LMM, a memory-augmented large multimodal model that compresses and stores historical visual features in a memory bank for efficient long-term understanding. Experiments on long-video QA and retrieval benchmarks show superior performance over existing methods.
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.assessment: 记忆增强机制为长视频多模态理解提供了高效方案，对视频理解与多模态研究者有较高参考价值。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.contribution: 提出记忆增强的大多模态模型 MA-LMM，实现高效长视频理解。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.innovation: 通过记忆库压缩存储历史视觉特征，突破上下文长度限制支持超长视频建模。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.result: 在长视频问答与检索基准上性能优于现有方法。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda._arxiv_id: MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimodal Model for Long-Term Video Understanding.

TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.summary_cn: ①现有多模态大语言模型在处理长视频时缺乏对时间信息的敏感建模，难以精确定位事件时刻。②本文提出 TimeChat，一种时间敏感的多模态大语言模型，通过时间感知的视频编码器与时间定位机制实现长视频的时序理解与事件定位。③相比通用视频 LLM，TimeChat 显式建模时间戳与事件边界，支持密集视频描述与时间定位。④实验在密集视频描述与视频问答等基准上取得领先性能，验证了时间敏感建模的有效性。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of time-sensitive modeling in multimodal LLMs for long video understanding, which hinders precise event localization. It proposes TimeChat, a time-sensitive multimodal LLM with a temporal-aware video encoder and temporal grounding mechanism for long-video understanding and event localization. Experiments on dense video captioning and video QA benchmarks show leading performance.
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.assessment: 时间敏感建模对长视频理解与事件定位有重要价值，对多模态与视频理解研究者有较高参考意义。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.contribution: 提出时间敏感的多模态大语言模型 TimeChat，支持长视频时序理解与事件定位。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.innovation: 通过时间感知视频编码器与时间定位机制显式建模时间戳与事件边界。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.result: 在密集视频描述与视频问答基准上取得领先性能。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La._arxiv_id: TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal Large Language Model for Long Video Understanding.

Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态大模型在图像与视频理解上通常需要分别设计视觉编码器、难以统一处理的问题，本文提出 Chat-UniVi，用一组动态视觉 token 统一表示图像和视频。方法通过多尺度表征与 token 聚合机制，将图像和视频压缩为固定数量的视觉 token 送入 LLM，从而在单一框架内同时支持图像与视频对话。相比此前需要双编码器或大量 token 的方案，它在训练效率与上下文长度上更有优势。实验在图像与视频理解基准上均取得有竞争力的结果，并在部分视频问答任务上超过专用模型。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified visual representation for image and video understanding in multimodal LLMs. Chat-UniVi represents both images and videos with a set of dynamic visual tokens via multi-scale representation and token aggregation, enabling a single framework to handle both modalities efficiently. It achieves competitive results on image and video benchmarks while reducing token count and training cost compared with dual-encoder or token-heavy alternatives.
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.assessment: 统一视觉 token 表示对多模态大模型的高效训练与长视频扩展有参考价值，值得关注其 token 聚合设计。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.contribution: 提出用动态视觉 token 统一图像与视频表示的多模态大模型框架 Chat-UniVi。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.innovation: 通过多尺度 token 聚合在单一 LLM 中统一处理图像与视频，避免双编码器。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.result: 在图像与视频理解基准上取得有竞争力表现，并提升训练与推理效率。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio._arxiv_id: Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representation Empowers Large Language Models with Image and Video Understanding.

HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.summary_cn: 针对视频场景图生成中对象关系随时间和层级变化难以建模的问题，本文提出分层交错图（HIG）方法。方法构建跨帧的对象与关系分层图结构，通过交错的消息传递捕捉时序与语义层级依赖，从而生成更准确的视频场景图。相比逐帧或简单时序聚合的已有方法，HIG 更好地建模了长程与层级关系。在视频场景图生成基准上取得优于基线方法的性能。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.summary_en: This paper tackles video scene graph generation where object relations evolve over time and across semantic levels. It proposes a Hierarchical Interlacement Graph (HIG) that builds layered object-relation graphs across frames and performs interleaved message passing to capture temporal and hierarchical dependencies. It outperforms frame-wise or simple temporal aggregation baselines on video scene graph benchmarks.
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.assessment: 分层图建模思路对视频结构化理解有启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.contribution: 提出用于视频场景图生成的分层交错图方法 HIG。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.innovation: 用跨帧分层图与交错消息传递联合建模时序与语义层级关系。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.result: 在视频场景图生成基准上优于已有基线方法。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap._arxiv_id: HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Approach to Scene Graph Generation in Video Understanding.

A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.summary_cn: 针对第一人称视角视频理解中任务单一、难以迁移到多种下游任务的问题，本文提出将多种技能视为可组合任务视角的框架。方法通过多任务学习与技能分解，让模型在同一第一人称视频表征上适配不同任务，类似'背包'中装载多种技能。相比针对单一任务训练的模型，该方法提升了跨任务泛化能力。实验在多个第一人称视频理解任务上验证了多技能组合的有效性。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited task generality of egocentric video understanding models. It proposes a framework that treats diverse skills as composable task perspectives, learning a shared egocentric representation that can be adapted to multiple downstream tasks. It improves cross-task generalization over single-task baselines across several egocentric benchmarks.
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.assessment: 多技能组合视角对第一人称视频理解有参考意义，但与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.contribution: 提出面向第一人称视频理解的多技能组合学习框架。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.innovation: 将不同任务视为可组合技能视角，共享第一人称视频表征。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.result: 在多个第一人称视频理解任务上提升跨任务泛化性能。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi._arxiv_id: A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Video Understanding with Diverse Task Perspectives.

MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中密集 token 导致上下文过长、难以处理的问题，本文提出 MovieChat，用稀疏记忆机制替代密集 token。方法将视频 token 压缩为短期与长期记忆，通过记忆合并与检索在有限上下文下保留长程信息，从而支持长视频问答。相比直接截断或均匀采样的方案，MovieChat 在长视频理解上更有效。实验在长视频问答基准上取得优于现有方法的准确率。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.summary_en: This paper targets long-video understanding where dense tokens exceed LLM context limits. MovieChat replaces dense tokens with a sparse memory mechanism that maintains short-term and long-term memory via memory consolidation and retrieval, enabling long-video question answering under bounded context. It outperforms truncation or uniform-sampling baselines on long-video QA benchmarks.
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.assessment: 稀疏记忆设计对长时序视频理解有实用价值，可借鉴到长序列感知任务。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.contribution: 提出基于稀疏记忆的长视频理解框架 MovieChat。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.innovation: 用短期与长期记忆合并与检索替代密集 token 表示长视频。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.result: 在长视频问答基准上取得优于现有方法的准确率。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me._arxiv_id: MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Memory for Long Video Understanding.

OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.summary_cn: 针对视频理解任务多样、通常需要为每类任务设计专用架构的问题，本文提出生成式统一框架 OmniViD。方法将多种视频任务统一为序列生成问题，用统一的生成式解码器处理分类、检测、描述等不同输出形式。相比任务专用模型，OmniViD 在单一框架下覆盖多种视频理解任务并保持竞争力。实验在多个视频理解基准上验证了统一生成式建模的有效性。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of video understanding into task-specific architectures. OmniViD casts diverse video tasks as sequence generation and uses a unified generative decoder to handle classification, detection, and captioning outputs. It matches or surpasses task-specific models across multiple video understanding benchmarks within a single framework.
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.assessment: 统一生成式视频理解框架思路清晰，对多任务感知建模有借鉴意义。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.contribution: 提出统一生成式视频理解框架 OmniViD。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.innovation: 将多种视频任务统一为序列生成并用单一解码器处理。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.result: 在多个视频理解基准上达到与任务专用模型相当或更优的性能。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ._arxiv_id: OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Universal Video Understanding.

Compositional Video Understanding with S.summary_cn: 针对组合式视频理解中时空结构难以显式建模的问题，本文提出基于时空结构的 Transformer 方法。方法显式编码视频中的时空组合结构，通过结构化注意力捕捉对象、动作及其组合关系，从而提升组合泛化能力。相比普通视频 Transformer，该方法在需要组合推理的任务上更准确。实验在组合式视频理解基准上验证了时空结构建模的有效性。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.summary_en: This paper targets compositional video understanding where spatiotemporal structure is not explicitly modeled. It proposes a spatiotemporal structure-based Transformer that encodes object-action composition via structured attention to improve compositional generalization. It outperforms vanilla video Transformers on benchmarks requiring compositional reasoning.
Compositional Video Understanding with S.assessment: 显式时空结构建模对组合泛化有启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度一般。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.contribution: 提出基于时空结构的组合式视频理解 Transformer。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.innovation: 用结构化注意力显式编码视频中的时空组合关系。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.result: 在组合式视频理解基准上优于普通视频 Transformer。
Compositional Video Understanding with S._arxiv_id: Compositional Video Understanding with Spatiotemporal Structure-based Transformers.

Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中跨域泛化能力不足的问题，本文提出Align Before Adapt（ABA）框架，通过实体到区域的显式对齐将视频中的实体（如物体、人物）与文本标签在特征空间中对齐，再适配到下游动作识别任务。相比已有方法仅依赖全局视频-文本对齐，ABA利用细粒度实体级对齐增强了跨域迁移能力。在多个跨域动作识别基准上，ABA取得了优于现有方法的泛化性能，验证了实体级对齐对泛化动作识别的有效性。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.summary_en: This paper addresses poor cross-domain generalization in video action recognition by proposing Align Before Adapt (ABA), which explicitly aligns entities to regions before adapting to downstream tasks. Unlike prior methods relying on global video-text alignment, ABA leverages fine-grained entity-level alignment to enhance transferability. Experiments on multiple cross-domain benchmarks show improved generalization over existing approaches.
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.assessment: 该工作将实体级对齐引入视频动作识别，思路清晰且对跨域泛化有实际价值，但整体与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.contribution: 提出实体到区域对齐的预适配框架，提升视频动作识别的跨域泛化能力。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.innovation: 在适配前显式进行实体-区域对齐，替代传统全局视频-文本对齐。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.result: 在多个跨域动作识别基准上取得优于现有方法的泛化性能。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to._arxiv_id: Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to-Region Alignments for Generalizable Video Action Recognition.

Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.summary_cn: 针对开放式视频问答中标注不足的问题，本文提出排序蒸馏（Ranking Distillation）方法，利用教师模型对候选答案的排序信息来指导学生模型学习，从而在标签稀缺条件下提升开放式VQA性能。相比传统知识蒸馏仅传递软标签，排序蒸馏传递的是答案间的相对排序关系，更适配开放式生成任务。实验表明该方法在标注不足的开放式视频问答任务上取得了优于基线蒸馏方法的性能。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient labels in open-ended video question answering by proposing Ranking Distillation, which transfers ranking information over candidate answers from a teacher to a student model. Unlike conventional distillation that transfers soft labels, it conveys relative ordering among answers, better suited to open-ended generation. Experiments show improved performance over baseline distillation under label scarcity.
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.assessment: 该工作将排序蒸馏引入开放式视频问答，对标签稀缺场景有一定意义，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.contribution: 提出排序蒸馏方法，缓解开放式视频问答中的标注不足问题。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.innovation: 以答案间相对排序作为蒸馏信号，替代传统软标签蒸馏。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.result: 在标注不足的开放式视频问答任务上优于基线蒸馏方法。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide._arxiv_id: Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Video Question Answering with Insufficient Labels.

Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.summary_cn: 针对视频问答中视觉与语言模态对齐不足的问题，本文提出语言感知的视觉语义蒸馏方法，利用语言信息引导视觉特征的语义蒸馏，使视觉表示更贴合问题语义。相比已有方法仅独立处理视觉和语言特征，该方法通过跨模态蒸馏增强了视觉语义的语言相关性。在视频问答基准上取得了性能提升，验证了语言感知蒸馏的有效性。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient vision-language alignment in video question answering by proposing language-aware visual semantic distillation, which uses linguistic cues to guide semantic distillation of visual features. Unlike methods processing modalities independently, it enhances language-relevant visual semantics via cross-modal distillation. Experiments on video QA benchmarks demonstrate improved performance.
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.assessment: 该工作通过语言引导视觉语义蒸馏提升视频问答性能，方法合理但领域相关性较低。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.contribution: 提出语言感知的视觉语义蒸馏方法，增强视频问答中的跨模态对齐。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.innovation: 利用语言信息引导视觉特征的语义蒸馏，提升视觉表示的语言相关性。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.result: 在视频问答基准上取得性能提升。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat._arxiv_id: Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation for Video Question Answering.

E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.summary_cn: 针对零样本时空视频定位任务，本文提出E3M框架，通过期望最大化（EM）多模态调制机制在无标注数据下实现视频中目标时空定位。相比已有零样本方法依赖固定模态融合，E3M利用EM算法迭代优化文本与视觉模态的调制权重，自适应地增强相关模态信息。实验表明E3M在零样本时空视频定位基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.summary_en: This paper tackles zero-shot spatio-temporal video grounding by proposing E3M, which uses an Expectation-Maximization multimodal modulation mechanism to localize targets without annotations. Unlike prior zero-shot methods with fixed modality fusion, E3M iteratively optimizes modulation weights between text and visual modalities. Experiments show E3M outperforms existing methods on zero-shot STVG benchmarks.
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.assessment: 该工作将EM算法用于多模态调制实现零样本时空定位，方法有新意，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联有限。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.contribution: 提出基于EM多模态调制的零样本时空视频定位框架E3M。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.innovation: 利用EM算法迭代优化文本与视觉模态的调制权重，实现自适应多模态融合。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.result: 在零样本时空视频定位基准上优于现有方法。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro._arxiv_id: E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding with Expectation-Maximization Multimodal Modulation.

🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中信息冗余和上下文建模困难的问题，本文提出VideoAgent，一个记忆增强的多模态智能体框架，通过维护结构化记忆并调用多模态工具（如视觉模型、语言模型）逐步理解视频内容。相比已有端到端视频理解模型，VideoAgent以智能体方式动态检索和推理，更高效地处理长视频。在多个视频理解基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能，展示了智能体范式在视频理解中的潜力。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.summary_en: This paper addresses long-video understanding challenges by proposing VideoAgent, a memory-augmented multimodal agent that maintains structured memory and invokes multimodal tools to progressively understand video content. Unlike end-to-end video models, VideoAgent dynamically retrieves and reasons in an agentic manner, handling long videos more efficiently. Experiments on multiple video understanding benchmarks show superior performance.
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.assessment: 该工作将智能体范式引入视频理解，记忆增强与工具调用设计有启发性，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性一般。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.contribution: 提出记忆增强的多模态智能体框架VideoAgent用于长视频理解。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.innovation: 以结构化记忆和工具调用实现动态检索与推理的视频理解范式。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.result: 在多个视频理解基准上优于现有方法。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo._arxiv_id: 🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimodal Agent for Video Understanding.

2407.21757|v2.summary_cn: 针对叙事视频（如电影）理解中角色、对话、剧情等丰富上下文带来的挑战，本文提出MovieSeq，一个多模态语言模型，将视频表示为交错的图像、情节、视频和字幕序列，并通过指令微调使模型能够交互式理解视频上下文。相比仅以视频为输入的方法，MovieSeq联合提供角色照片、姓名和对话，帮助模型关联多模态元素并生成更全面的回答。在LVU、MAD、Movienet、CMD、TVC、MovieQA六个数据集、五种任务设置上验证了有效性。
2407.21757|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses narrative video understanding challenges by proposing MovieSeq, a multimodal language model that represents videos as interleaved sequences of images, plots, videos, and subtitles, instruction-tuned for interactive understanding. Unlike video-only input methods, MovieSeq jointly provides character photos, names, and dialogues to associate multimodal elements. It is validated on six datasets (LVU, MAD, Movienet, CMD, TVC, MovieQA) across five task settings.
2407.21757|v2.assessment: 该工作提出交错多模态序列表示与指令微调方案，对叙事视频理解有系统性贡献，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性有限。
2407.21757|v2.contribution: 提出MovieSeq多模态语言模型，以交错多模态序列表示实现叙事视频理解。
2407.21757|v2.innovation: 将视频表示为图像、情节、视频、字幕的交错序列，并通过指令微调实现交互式理解。
2407.21757|v2.result: 在六个数据集、五种任务设置上验证了有效性。

InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.summary_cn: 针对多模态视频理解缺乏统一大规模基础模型的问题，本文提出InternVideo2，通过扩展模型规模与数据规模构建视频理解基础模型。方法上采用多阶段训练范式，结合掩码视频建模、跨模态对比学习与下一token预测等目标，统一处理视频-文本、视频-音频等多模态输入。相比此前视频基础模型，其在模型容量、训练数据量和任务覆盖面上均有显著扩展。在多个视频理解基准（如动作识别、视频问答、时序定位等）上取得领先或竞争性结果，展现出较强的泛化能力。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified large-scale foundation model for multimodal video understanding by proposing InternVideo2. It employs a multi-stage training paradigm integrating masked video modeling, cross-modal contrastive learning, and next-token prediction to handle video-text and video-audio inputs. Compared with prior video foundation models, it substantially scales up model capacity, training data, and task coverage, achieving leading or competitive results on multiple video understanding benchmarks.
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.assessment: 作为视频理解领域的重要基础模型工作，其规模化训练范式和广泛任务覆盖值得关注，对多模态感知研究有参考价值。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.contribution: 提出并开源了大规模多模态视频理解基础模型InternVideo2。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.innovation: 多阶段训练统一掩码建模、对比学习与生成式目标，并扩展至多模态输入。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.result: 在多个视频理解基准上取得领先或竞争性性能，展现强泛化能力。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models._arxiv_id: InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models for Multimodal Video Understanding.

2311.17893|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督视频目标分割（VOS）依赖辅助模态或迭代slot attention导致通用性差、计算开销大的问题，本文提出一种简单有效的方法。核心洞察是利用DINO预训练Transformer中固有的结构依赖关系建立鲁棒的时空对应，仅需在对应线索上做简单聚类即可获得有竞争力的分割结果。方法上引入单个时空Transformer块处理逐帧DINO特征，通过自注意力建立时空依赖，再对注意力图进行层次聚类生成目标掩码。相比此前依赖辅助模态或slot attention的方法，该方案架构更简洁、无需额外模态，在自监督VOS基准上取得有竞争力的分割性能。
2311.17893|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised video object segmentation (VOS), where prior methods rely on auxiliary modalities or iterative slot attention, limiting generality and increasing computation. It leverages inherent structural dependencies in DINO-pretrained Transformers to establish robust spatio-temporal correspondences, using a single spatio-temporal Transformer block and hierarchical clustering on attention maps to generate masks. The simplified architecture avoids auxiliary modalities and slot attention, achieving competitive segmentation results on self-supervised VOS benchmarks.
2311.17893|v2.assessment: 利用DINO注意力作为免费时空对应线索的思路简洁且有效，对自监督视频理解与分割研究有启发意义。
2311.17893|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需辅助模态或slot attention的简洁自监督视频目标分割框架。
2311.17893|v2.innovation: 挖掘DINO预训练Transformer的注意力结构依赖作为时空对应线索并用于聚类分割。
2311.17893|v2.result: 在自监督VOS基准上取得有竞争力的分割性能，且架构更简洁。

2407.03788|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频-文本对不完全对齐以及概念分布不均导致视频-语言表示无法准确反映跨模态语义、冷门概念下游性能差的问题，本文提出MAMA。方法上采用带减法角度间隔的对比目标来正则化跨模态表示，并利用MLP参数化的加权函数将损失值映射为样本权重，实现训练中模型关注点的动态调整。训练由少量无偏元数据引导，并用大视觉语言模型生成的视频-文本数据增强。相比此前方法，MAMA在常见视频-语言基准上提升了表示质量并取得更优性能。
2407.03788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses imperfect video-text alignment and uneven concept distribution in video-language representation learning, which degrade cross-modal semantics and rare-concept performance. It proposes MAMA, which uses a contrastive objective with a subtractive angular margin and an MLP-parameterized weighting function mapping loss values to sample weights for dynamic focus adjustment. Guided by a small amount of unbiased meta-data and augmented with video-text data from a large vision-language model, MAMA improves video-language representations and achieves superior performance on common benchmarks.
2407.03788|v2.assessment: 角度间隔对比与元学习加权结合处理数据质量问题，思路合理，对多模态表示学习有参考价值但领域相关度一般。
2407.03788|v2.contribution: 提出MAMA框架，通过角度间隔对比与元优化加权提升视频-语言表示质量。
2407.03788|v2.innovation: 减法角度间隔对比目标与MLP参数化样本加权函数的结合，并利用元数据与VLM生成数据增强。
2407.03788|v2.result: 在常见视频-语言基准上取得更优性能，改善跨模态表示质量。

2412.12075|v2.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中现有基准缺乏线索定位能力的问题，本文提出了CG-Bench，一个基于线索定位的问答基准。该方法要求模型不仅回答问题，还需在长视频中定位支撑答案的视觉线索，从而更细粒度地评估理解能力。相比已有基准，CG-Bench强调多跳推理和时序定位，包含更复杂的问答对。实验表明，现有先进模型在该基准上表现显著下降，揭示了长视频理解中的关键挑战。
2412.12075|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of clue-grounding capability in long video understanding benchmarks, this paper introduces CG-Bench, a clue-grounded question answering benchmark. It requires models to not only answer questions but also localize visual clues in long videos that support the answers, enabling fine-grained evaluation. Compared to existing benchmarks, CG-Bench emphasizes multi-hop reasoning and temporal grounding, and experiments show that state-of-the-art models suffer significant performance drops, revealing key challenges in long video understanding.
2412.12075|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了长视频理解中线索定位评估的空白，对推动视频理解模型的可解释性和推理能力有重要价值。
2412.12075|v2.contribution: 提出了首个要求线索定位的长视频问答基准CG-Bench。
2412.12075|v2.innovation: 将问答与视觉线索时序定位相结合，强调多跳推理。
2412.12075|v2.result: 现有模型在该基准上性能大幅下降，凸显长视频理解的难度。

2502.10810|v2.summary_cn: 针对流式视频理解中缺乏多轮对话评估的问题，本文提出了SVBench，一个包含时序多轮对话的基准。该基准模拟真实流式场景，要求模型在连续视频流中处理多轮交互，并保持对历史对话和视频内容的记忆。相比传统离线视频问答，SVBench更注重时序连贯性和在线推理能力。实验显示，现有模型在流式多轮对话中表现不佳，尤其在长时依赖和指代消解方面。
2502.10810|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of evaluation for streaming video understanding with multi-turn dialogues, this paper presents SVBench, a benchmark with temporal multi-turn dialogues. It simulates real streaming scenarios where models must handle continuous video streams and maintain memory of both dialogue history and video content. Compared to offline video QA, SVBench emphasizes temporal coherence and online reasoning. Experiments show that existing models struggle with long-term dependencies and coreference resolution in streaming multi-turn dialogues.
2502.10810|v2.assessment: 该基准推动了流式视频理解向更真实的交互场景发展，对多模态对话系统研究有重要意义。
2502.10810|v2.contribution: 提出了首个针对流式视频理解的多轮对话基准SVBench。
2502.10810|v2.innovation: 将时序多轮对话引入流式视频理解评估，强调在线记忆与推理。
2502.10810|v2.result: 现有模型在流式多轮对话中表现不佳，尤其在长时依赖和指代消解上。

TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对交通场景中缺乏统一时空视频理解基准的问题，本文提出了TUMTraf VideoQA数据集和基准。该数据集包含多视角、多模态的交通视频，并标注了丰富的时空问答对，涵盖车辆、行人、交通标志等目标的行为和交互。相比现有数据集，TUMTraf VideoQA强调统一时空理解，要求模型同时处理视频中的空间和时间信息。实验表明，现有视频理解模型在该基准上仍有较大提升空间。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_en: To address the lack of a unified spatio-temporal video understanding benchmark in traffic scenes, this paper introduces the TUMTraf VideoQA dataset and benchmark. It contains multi-view, multi-modal traffic videos with rich spatio-temporal QA pairs covering behaviors and interactions of vehicles, pedestrians, and traffic signs. Compared to existing datasets, TUMTraf VideoQA emphasizes unified spatio-temporal understanding, requiring models to process both spatial and temporal information. Experiments show that existing video understanding models still have significant room for improvement.
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.assessment: 该数据集为自动驾驶场景下的视频理解提供了重要基准，对多模态感知和交互研究有直接推动作用。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.contribution: 提出了面向交通场景的统一时空视频理解数据集和基准TUMTraf VideoQA。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.innovation: 结合多视角多模态交通视频与时空问答，推动统一理解。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.result: 现有模型在该基准上表现有限，显示交通场景视频理解的挑战。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f._arxiv_id: TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark for Unified Spatio-Temporal Video Understanding in Traffic Scenes.

Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_cn: 针对4D点云视频理解中时空信息纠缠、计算效率低的问题，本文提出了Mamba4D，一种基于解耦时空状态空间模型的高效方法。该方法将空间和时间维度解耦，分别用状态空间模型处理，降低了计算复杂度并提升了长序列建模能力。相比基于Transformer的方法，Mamba4D在保持精度的同时显著减少了计算量。在多个4D点云视频理解任务上，Mamba4D取得了优于或媲美现有方法的效果，且效率更高。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_en: To address the entangled spatio-temporal information and low efficiency in 4D point cloud video understanding, this paper proposes Mamba4D, an efficient method based on disentangled spatial-temporal state space models. It decouples spatial and temporal dimensions and processes them with separate state space models, reducing computational complexity and improving long-sequence modeling. Compared to Transformer-based methods, Mamba4D significantly reduces computation while maintaining accuracy. On multiple 4D point cloud video understanding tasks, Mamba4D achieves superior or comparable performance with higher efficiency.
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.assessment: Mamba4D为4D点云视频理解提供了高效的新范式，对自动驾驶中的点云序列处理有重要参考价值。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.contribution: 提出了基于解耦时空状态空间模型的Mamba4D，用于高效4D点云视频理解。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.innovation: 将Mamba架构引入4D点云，解耦时空维度以提升效率和长序列建模。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.result: 在多个4D点云视频任务上取得优于或媲美Transformer方法的精度，且计算量显著降低。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video._arxiv_id: Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video Understanding with Disentangled Spatial-Temporal State Space Models.

Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_cn: 针对点云视频理解中预训练3D模型难以直接适应时空任务的问题，本文提出了跨帧时空感知方法，将预训练3D模型适配到点云视频理解。该方法通过跨帧注意力机制和时空特征融合，在不重新训练整个模型的情况下，有效捕捉点云序列中的动态信息。相比从头训练的视频模型，该方法利用预训练知识，在少量标注数据下取得更好性能。实验表明，在多个点云视频基准上，该方法优于现有微调策略。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_en: To address the difficulty of adapting pre-trained 3D models to point cloud video understanding, this paper proposes a cross-frame spatio-temporal perception method that adapts pre-trained 3D models for point cloud video tasks. It uses cross-frame attention and spatio-temporal feature fusion to effectively capture dynamics in point cloud sequences without retraining the entire model. Compared to training from scratch, it leverages pre-trained knowledge and achieves better performance with limited annotations. Experiments show that the method outperforms existing fine-tuning strategies on multiple point cloud video benchmarks.
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.assessment: 该工作为点云视频理解提供了高效的预训练模型适配方案，对自动驾驶中的3D序列感知有实用价值。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.contribution: 提出了跨帧时空感知方法，将预训练3D模型适配到点云视频理解。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.innovation: 利用跨帧注意力与时空融合，实现预训练3D模型向视频任务的高效迁移。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.result: 在多个点云视频基准上优于现有微调策略，尤其在少样本场景下。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point._arxiv_id: Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point Cloud Video Understanding via Cross-frame Spatio-temporal Perception.

2503.18223|v2.summary_cn: 针对野生动物行为监测中缺乏标注视频数据集的问题，本文提出了MammAlps，一个多模态多视角的野生动物行为监测数据集。该数据集来自瑞士国家公园的9个相机陷阱，包含超过14小时带音频的视频、2D分割图和8.5小时个体轨迹标注。基于6135个动物片段，作者提出了首个分层多模态动物行为识别基准，以及一个生态导向的多视角事件识别基准。实验表明，多模态输入能提升行为识别性能，但复杂场景仍具挑战。
2503.18223|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of annotated video datasets for wildlife behavior monitoring, this paper presents MammAlps, a multimodal and multi-view dataset of wildlife behavior monitoring from 9 camera traps in the Swiss National Park. It contains over 14 hours of video with audio, 2D segmentation maps, and 8.5 hours of individual tracks densely labeled for species and behavior. Based on 6135 single animal clips, the authors propose the first hierarchical and multimodal animal behavior recognition benchmark, as well as an ecology-oriented multi-view event recognition benchmark. Experiments show that multimodal inputs improve behavior recognition, but complex scenes remain challenging.
2503.18223|v2.assessment: 该数据集为野生动物行为监测提供了宝贵的多模态资源，虽与自动驾驶直接关联较弱，但对视频理解模型在开放场景的泛化有参考意义。
2503.18223|v2.contribution: 提出了多模态多视角野生动物行为监测数据集MammAlps及两个基准。
2503.18223|v2.innovation: 结合音频、视频和分割图，首次实现分层多模态动物行为识别。
2503.18223|v2.result: 多模态输入提升行为识别性能，但复杂场景下仍有挑战。

2412.04467|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉语言模型中视觉token数量远超文本token、导致计算开销巨大的问题，观察到CLIP/SigLIP等编码器产生的视觉token存在显著冗余。提出VisionZip，一种简单有效的token选择方法，为语言模型筛选信息量大的视觉token，可广泛用于图像和视频理解及多轮对话场景。实验表明其在几乎所有设置下比此前SOTA至少提升5%，预填充时间加速8倍，使LLaVA-Next 13B推理快于7B版本且效果更好。
2412.04467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the excessive computational cost caused by the large number of visual tokens in vision-language models, observing significant redundancy in tokens from encoders like CLIP and SigLIP. It proposes VisionZip, a simple token-selection method that feeds only informative tokens to the language model, applicable to image/video understanding and multi-turn dialogue. Experiments show at least 5% gains over prior state-of-the-art across nearly all settings and 8x faster prefilling, enabling LLaVA-Next 13B to outperform and outpace the 7B variant.
2412.04467|v2.assessment: 对VLM效率优化有实用价值，token冗余分析清晰，加速与精度兼得，值得关注。
2412.04467|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的视觉token选择方法VisionZip，显著降低VLM计算成本。
2412.04467|v2.innovation: 基于视觉token冗余观察进行信息性token筛选，兼顾多轮对话场景。
2412.04467|v2.result: 性能较SOTA提升至少5%，预填充加速8倍，13B模型推理快于7B且效果更优。

2503.21483|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对大型视频语言模型受限于上下文窗口、长视频分析中均匀采样常分配资源到无关内容的问题，提出BOLT，一种无需训练即可增强VLM的方法。作者提出多源检索评估设置，并探索基于查询-帧相似度的多种帧选择策略，发现逆变换采样效果最佳。在Video-MME上准确率从53.8%提升至56.1%，MLVU从58.9%提升至63.4%。
2503.21483|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited context windows of large video-language models and the inefficiency of uniform frame sampling in long-form video analysis. It introduces BOLT, a training-free method that studies frame selection strategies, proposing a multi-source retrieval evaluation setting and showing inverse transform sampling is most effective. Accuracy improves from 53.8% to 56.1% on Video-MME and 58.9% to 63.4% on MLVU.
2503.21483|v2.assessment: 训练无关的帧选择策略简单有效，对长视频理解有参考价值，但方法创新性有限。
2503.21483|v2.contribution: 提出无需训练的帧选择方法BOLT及多源检索评估设置。
2503.21483|v2.innovation: 系统比较帧选择策略并发现逆变换采样最优。

2412.01095|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对可解释视频异常检测中现有方法需专门推理模块或指令微调、计算与标注成本高的问题，提出VERA，一种语言化学习框架，使VLM无需修改模型参数即可进行VAD。VERA将复杂推理分解为对多个聚焦引导问题的反思，将其视为可学习参数，通过学习者与优化器VLM间的数据驱动语言交互进行优化。该方法利用粗标注数据，避免了额外训练开销。
2412.01095|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and annotation costs of explainable video anomaly detection, where existing methods rely on specialized reasoning modules or instruction tuning. It proposes VERA, a verbalized learning framework that enables VLMs to perform VAD without parameter modification by decomposing reasoning into reflective guiding questions treated as learnable parameters, optimized via verbal interactions between learner and optimizer VLMs using coarsely labeled data.
2412.01095|v2.assessment: 语言化学习思路新颖，无需参数更新即可实现可解释VAD，但领域相关性偏弱。
2412.01095|v2.contribution: 提出无需模型参数修改的可解释视频异常检测框架VERA。
2412.01095|v2.innovation: 将推理分解为可学习的引导问题并通过VLM语言交互优化。
2412.01095|v2.result: 利用粗标注数据实现可解释VAD，避免额外训练与标注开销。

2412.03735|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大语言模型在视频理解中幻觉现象研究不足的问题，基于MLLM视觉编码器难以区分视觉不同但语义相似视频对的观察，提出VidHalluc，目前最大的视频理解幻觉评测基准，含5002个配对视频，从动作、时序和场景转换三个维度评估幻觉。同时提出免训练的DINO-HEAL方法，利用DINOv2空间显著性重加权视觉特征，平均降低幻觉3.02%。
2412.03735|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underexplored hallucination problem in video understanding by MLLMs. Observing that visual encoders fail to distinguish visually different yet semantically similar video pairs, it introduces VidHalluc, the largest benchmark with 5,002 paired videos assessing hallucinations across action, temporal sequence, and scene transition. It also proposes DINO-HEAL, a training-free method using DINOv2 spatial saliency to reweight features, reducing hallucinations by 3.02% on average.
2412.03735|v2.assessment: 视频幻觉基准构建扎实，DINO-HEAL方法简单有效，对多模态评测有参考意义。
2412.03735|v2.contribution: 构建最大视频理解幻觉基准VidHalluc并提出免训练缓解方法DINO-HEAL。
2412.03735|v2.innovation: 从动作、时序、场景转换三维度系统评估视频幻觉。

2411.13281|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有视频分析评测多依赖选择题、难以捕捉真实用户复杂需求且人工标注成本高的问题，提出VideoAutoArena，一个受LMSYS Chatbot Arena启发的竞技场式基准。它利用用户模拟生成开放式自适应问题，采用改进的ELO评分系统进行公平持续比较，并通过人工标注金标准验证自动评判与人类判断高度一致。此外引入故障驱动机制。
2411.13281|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of multiple-choice benchmarks for video analysis, which fail to capture real-world user demands and require costly annotation. It introduces VideoAutoArena, an arena-style benchmark inspired by LMSYS Chatbot Arena that uses user simulation to generate open-ended adaptive questions, employs a modified ELO rating for fair comparison, and validates automated judging against a human-annotated gold standard.
2411.13281|v2.assessment: 竞技场式评测思路新颖，用户模拟与ELO机制提升评测真实性，但领域相关性较低。
2411.13281|v2.contribution: 提出基于用户模拟的竞技场式视频分析评测基准VideoAutoArena。
2411.13281|v2.innovation: 结合用户模拟与改进ELO评分实现可扩展的开放式视频评测。
2411.13281|v2.result: 自动评判与人工判断高度一致，具备可扩展性。

2412.10360|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频多模态大模型中视频理解机制缺乏系统研究、设计决策缺乏依据且计算成本高的问题，开展全面研究。作者发现缩放一致性现象，即小模型和数据集上的设计与训练决策可有效迁移到大模型，并据此探索视频采样、架构、数据组成、训练计划等方面。例如证明训练时fps采样远优于均匀帧采样，并识别出最佳视频表示视觉编码器。
2412.10360|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor understanding of mechanisms driving video understanding in LMMs, where design decisions lack justification and computation is costly. It presents a comprehensive study uncovering Scaling Consistency, where decisions made on smaller models/datasets transfer to larger ones, and explores video sampling, architectures, data composition, and training schedules. It shows fps sampling during training is vastly preferable to uniform frame sampling and identifies the best vision encoders for video.
2412.10360|v2.assessment: 系统性研究扎实，缩放一致性发现对视频LMM设计有重要指导意义，值得关注。
2412.10360|v2.contribution: 系统研究视频LMM设计要素并提出缩放一致性规律。
2412.10360|v2.innovation: 揭示小模型决策可迁移至大模型的缩放一致性现象。
2412.10360|v2.result: 证明fps采样优于均匀帧采样并识别最佳视频视觉编码器。

2504.07745|v2.summary_cn: 针对Video-LLM在细粒度视频理解（如视觉动态和细节查询）上的不足，论文提出自监督片段微调方法SF²T，利用视频固有特性进行训练，避免了对昂贵人工标注的依赖，并绕开了自然语言难以刻画复杂时空变化的局限。同时构建了FineVidBench基准，从场景级和片段级两个层面系统评估Video-LLM。该方法以极低标注成本提升了细粒度理解能力，为视频多模态模型的高效适配提供了新思路。
2504.07745|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deficiency of Video-LLMs in fine-grained video understanding, particularly visual dynamics and detail-oriented queries. It proposes Self-Supervised Fragment Fine-Tuning (SF²T), which exploits inherent video characteristics for training without labor-intensive annotations, and introduces FineVidBench for evaluating Video-LLMs at both scene and fragment levels. The approach improves fine-grained understanding while circumventing the limitations of natural language in capturing complex spatiotemporal variations.
2504.07745|v2.assessment: 自监督片段微调思路简洁有效，配套基准对视频细粒度理解评测有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2504.07745|v2.contribution: 提出自监督片段微调方法SF²T及细粒度视频理解基准FineVidBench。
2504.07745|v2.innovation: 利用视频固有特性进行自监督片段级微调，规避人工标注与自然语言描述的局限。
2504.07745|v2.result: 在无需密集标注的情况下显著提升Video-LLM的细粒度视频理解能力，并提供场景与片段双层级评测。

When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.summary_cn: 该论文关注自监督视频表示学习中的时序对应建模问题，标题暗示其试图驯服未来帧与过去帧之间的时序对应关系以提升表示质量。然而摘要为空，无法获取具体方法、改进点与实验数据。仅从标题判断，其主题属于自监督视频理解范畴，与自动驾驶感知的关联有限。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.summary_en: This paper targets temporal correspondence modeling for self-supervised video representation learning, as suggested by its title on taming temporal correspondence between future and past frames. However, the abstract is empty, preventing assessment of the proposed method, improvements, or experimental results. Based solely on the title, it falls within self-supervised video understanding with limited relevance to autonomous driving perception.
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.assessment: 摘要缺失导致无法评估方法细节与实验效果，仅凭标题难以判断其实际贡献，建议获取全文后再做判断。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming._arxiv_id: When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming Temporal Correspondence for Self-supervised Video Representation Learning.

2411.11934|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目输入合成双目视频中配对数据不足与时空一致性难以保持的问题，论文提出基于视频扩散模型的自监督范式SpatialDreamer。其核心包括基于深度的视频生成模块DVG，通过前向-后向渲染机制生成具有几何与时序先验的配对视频；以及RefinerNet与自监督合成框架，配合一致性控制模块提升训练效率与时空一致性。该方法避免了直接套用新视角合成技术处理动态场景的局限，降低了对大量配对训练数据的依赖。
2411.11934|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles stereo video synthesis from monocular input, addressing the scarcity of paired stereo videos and the difficulty of maintaining spatio-temporal consistency. It proposes SpatialDreamer, a self-supervised paradigm built on a video diffusion model, featuring a depth-based video generation module with forward-backward rendering, a RefinerNet with a self-supervised synthesis framework, and a consistency control module. The approach overcomes limitations of directly applying novel view synthesis to dynamic scenes and reduces reliance on large paired training data.
2411.11934|v2.assessment: 将扩散模型与自监督渲染结合用于单目转双目视频，思路新颖，对空间计算与VR有应用价值，但与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测主线关联中等。
2411.11934|v2.contribution: 提出基于视频扩散模型的自监督单目到双目视频合成框架SpatialDreamer。
2411.11934|v2.innovation: 深度驱动的前向-后向渲染生成配对视频，并结合一致性控制模块实现自监督训练。
2411.11934|v2.result: 在减少配对数据依赖的同时提升了动态场景下的时空一致性，具体指标摘要未完整给出。

2506.01037|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于扩散的视频超分方法易引入复杂退化和明显伪影的问题，论文提出一种噪声鲁棒的真实世界VSR框架，将自监督学习与Mamba融入预训练潜在扩散模型。通过Video State-Space块与3D选择性扫描模块增强全局时空注意力，以较低计算代价提升帧间一致性；并引入自监督ControlNet，利用高分辨率特征作为引导，通过对比学习提取对退化不敏感的特征。三阶段HR-LR混合训练策略稳定了VSR训练，在真实世界VSR基准上取得优于现有方法的感知质量。
2506.01037|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the susceptibility of diffusion-based video super-resolution to complex degradations and artifacts. It proposes a noise-robust real-world VSR framework integrating self-supervised learning and Mamba into pre-trained latent diffusion models, with a Video State-Space block and 3D selective scan for spatio-temporal coherence, and a self-supervised ControlNet using contrastive learning for degradation-insensitive features. A three-stage HR-LR mixed training strategy stabilizes training, achieving superior perceptual quality over state-of-the-art on real-world VSR benchmarks.
2506.01037|v2.assessment: 将Mamba与自监督ControlNet结合用于真实世界VSR，在感知质量上超越现有方法，对底层视觉任务有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联有限。
2506.01037|v2.contribution: 提出融合自监督学习与时空Mamba的真实世界视频超分框架。
2506.01037|v2.innovation: Video State-Space块与3D选择性扫描增强时空一致性，自监督ControlNet通过对比学习提取退化不敏感特征。
2506.01037|v2.result: 在真实世界VSR基准上取得优于现有方法的感知质量，三阶段训练策略有效稳定了扩散模型训练。

2601.04068|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本到视频扩散模型与人类偏好对齐的问题，指出现有DPO方法依赖多样本排序和任务特定critic模型，效率低且全局监督信号模糊。为此提出LocalDPO后训练框架，通过随机时空掩码局部破坏真实视频并用冻结基座模型仅修复掩码区域，自动构建局部化偏好对，无需外部critic或人工标注，每次推理仅生成一对偏好数据。训练时引入区域感知DPO损失，将偏好学习限制在损坏区域以加速收敛。在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上实验表明，LocalDPO持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性和人类偏好对齐效果。
2601.04068|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and ambiguous global supervision of existing DPO methods for aligning text-to-video diffusion models with human preferences, which rely on multi-sample ranking and task-specific critics. It proposes LocalDPO, a post-training framework that automatically constructs localized preference pairs by corrupting real videos with random spatio-temporal masks and restoring only the masked regions using a frozen base model, requiring a single inference per prompt without external critics or manual annotation. A region-aware DPO loss restricts preference learning to corrupted areas for faster convergence. Experiments on Wan2.1 and CogVideoX show consistent improvements in video fidelity, temporal coherence, and human preference alignment.
2601.04068|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦视频扩散模型的偏好对齐，与自动驾驶感知、3D检测等核心方向几乎无关，仅对多模态生成式模型研究者有边缘参考价值。
2601.04068|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需critic模型和人工标注、基于局部时空掩码自动构建偏好对的视频扩散模型对齐框架LocalDPO。
2601.04068|v2.innovation: 将DPO的偏好学习从全局视频级细化到时空区域级，并设计区域感知损失仅优化被破坏区域。
2601.04068|v2.result: 在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性与人类偏好对齐表现。

2004.07507|v2.summary_cn: 针对含 BatchNorm 层的深度网络在持续学习中的二次惩罚方法失效问题，作者指出 BN 导致样本间存在依赖关系，使标准 K-FAC 的 Hessian 近似不再成立。为此扩展 K-FAC 以纳入样本间关系，并针对 BN 的统计参数提出权重合并与重参数化方法，同时给出无需源任务数据的超参选择策略。在带 BN 的 permuted MNIST 以及 ImageNet→细粒度分类的 ResNet-50 序列学习上均优于基线，且完全不依赖源任务数据。
2004.07507|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the invalidity of K-FAC-based quadratic penalty in continual learning when batch normalization introduces inter-example dependencies. It extends K-FAC to account for inter-example relations, proposes weight merging and reparameterization for BN statistics, and a source-data-free hyperparameter selection scheme. Experiments on permuted MNIST with BN and ImageNet-to-fine-grained sequential learning with ResNet-50 show consistent gains over baselines without using source task data.
2004.07507|v2.assessment: 把 K-FAC 的适用性缺陷讲清楚并给出可落地的修正，对持续学习与二阶优化交叉方向有参考价值。
2004.07507|v2.contribution: 提出考虑样本间依赖的扩展 K-FAC 及 BN 统计参数处理方案，实现无需源数据的持续学习。
2004.07507|v2.innovation: 将 BN 引起的样本间相关性显式建模进 K-FAC 近似，并配套权重合并与无源数据超参选择。
2004.07507|v2.result: 在带 BN 的 permuted MNIST 与 ResNet-50 序列细粒度分类上均超过基线，且不使用任何源任务数据。

2004.00440|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中分类层需不断扩增权重的问题，本文转向 embedding 网络，使新类可自然纳入而无需新增参数。作者提出语义漂移（semantic drift）估计方法，用当前任务数据经历的漂移来近似旧任务特征的漂移并进行补偿，且完全不需要 exemplar。在 CIFAR100 与 ImageNet-Subset 等细粒度数据集上验证，embedding 网络的灾难性遗忘显著更轻，方法优于现有无 exemplar 方案。
2004.00440|v2.summary_en: This work studies class-incremental learning for embedding networks, where new classes can be incorporated without adding classifier weights. It proposes a semantic drift estimation and compensation method that infers the drift of previous tasks from that observed on current task data, requiring no exemplars. Experiments on fine-grained CIFAR100 and ImageNet-Subset show embedding networks suffer substantially less catastrophic forgetting and the method outperforms exemplar-free baselines.
2004.00440|v2.assessment: 无 exemplar 的漂移补偿思路简洁且实用，对隐私敏感或存储受限的增量学习场景有启发。
2004.00440|v2.contribution: 提出基于语义漂移估计与补偿的无 exemplar 类增量学习方法，并系统研究 embedding 网络的增量特性。
2004.00440|v2.innovation: 用当前任务数据的特征漂移外推旧任务漂移，避免存储和回放历史样本。
2004.00440|v2.result: 在 CIFAR100 与 ImageNet-Subset 上优于无 exemplar 基线，embedding 网络的遗忘显著低于分类网络。

2002.00718|v2.summary_cn: 本文将增量学习引入语义分割，指出该任务的特有问题：每步训练只标注部分类别，导致背景类像素出现语义分布漂移，使现有增量方法失效。作者提出显式建模该漂移的蒸馏框架，并设计分类器参数初始化策略以抑制对背景类的偏置预测。在 Pascal-VOC 2012 与 ADE20K 上大幅超越当时的增量学习 SOTA。
2002.00718|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles incremental learning for semantic segmentation, identifying that per-step partial annotation causes a semantic distribution shift of background pixels that breaks existing incremental methods. It proposes a distillation framework that explicitly models this shift and a classifier initialization strategy to avoid biased background predictions. Extensive evaluation on Pascal-VOC 2012 and ADE20K shows significant improvements over prior incremental learning state of the art.
2002.00718|v2.assessment: 把增量学习从分类推广到分割并抓住背景漂移这一关键痛点，对自动驾驶感知的持续学习有直接借鉴意义。
2002.00718|v2.contribution: 提出面向语义分割的增量学习蒸馏框架与分类器初始化策略，显式处理背景类语义漂移。
2002.00718|v2.innovation: 首次将背景像素的语义分布漂移作为分割增量学习的核心问题建模。
2002.00718|v2.result: 在 Pascal-VOC 2012 与 ADE20K 上显著优于当时 SOTA 增量学习方法。

2003.13191|v2.summary_cn: 针对实际应用中增量学习需在线进行、且旧类会随时间出现新观测（概念漂移）的问题，本文提出可在线运行的增量学习框架，同时处理新类数据与旧类新观测。方法通过改进的交叉蒸馏损失与两步学习技术缓解在线模式下的灾难性遗忘。实验表明其性能优于当时的在线增量学习 SOTA，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2003.13191|v2.summary_en: This paper targets online incremental learning, where new classes arrive and old classes receive new observations causing concept drift. It proposes a framework with a modified cross-distillation loss and a two-step learning technique to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in online mode. Results outperform contemporary state-of-the-art online incremental learning methods, though no quantitative numbers are given in the abstract.
2003.13191|v2.assessment: 同时考虑新类与旧类新观测的在线设定更贴近真实部署，但摘要信息有限，需看正文验证。
2003.13191|v2.contribution: 提出可在线运行、同时应对新类与旧类新观测的增量学习框架。
2003.13191|v2.innovation: 用改进交叉蒸馏损失与两步学习在在线模式下兼顾新旧类知识。
2003.13191|v2.result: 优于当时在线增量学习 SOTA（摘要未给出具体指标）。

2002.10211|v2.summary_cn: 针对多类增量学习中保留旧类样本的代表性不足问题，本文提出 mnemonics 框架，将 exemplar 参数化并端到端可优化，通过模型级与 exemplar 级的双层优化联合训练。在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset 和 ImageNet 三个基准上大幅超越 SOTA。有趣的是，学到的 exemplar 往往落在不同类别的决策边界附近。
2002.10211|v2.summary_en: To address the limited representativeness of stored exemplars in multi-class incremental learning, this paper proposes the mnemonics framework that parameterizes exemplars and optimizes them end-to-end via bilevel optimization at the model and exemplar levels. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-Subset and ImageNet surpass state of the art by a large margin. Notably, learned exemplars tend to lie on class boundaries.

2002.10211|v2.innovation: 将 exemplar 参数化并通过模型级/exemplar 级双层优化自动学习。

1911.07053|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，尤其是知识蒸馏虽能保持旧类判别性但无法阻止模型将样本误判为新类。②提出Weight Aligning (WA)方法，在正常训练后校正最后一层全连接层的偏置权重，并结合知识蒸馏保持旧类判别性。③相比已有工作，首次指出FC层权重偏置是导致遗忘的关键因素，并通过权重对齐维护新旧类间的公平性。④实验表明该方法简单有效，显著缓解了灾难性遗忘，提升了增量学习性能。
1911.07053|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class incremental learning, where knowledge distillation (KD) preserves old-class discrimination but fails to prevent bias toward new classes. ②It proposes Weight Aligning (WA), which corrects biased weights in the last fully connected layer after normal training, combined with KD to maintain old-class discrimination. ③Unlike prior work, it identifies FC layer weight bias as a key cause of forgetting and maintains fairness between old and new classes. ④Experiments show the simple method effectively mitigates forgetting and improves incremental learning performance.
1911.07053|v2.assessment: 该工作从权重偏置角度切入，方法简单但洞察深刻，对增量学习研究有启发意义。
1911.07053|v2.contribution: 提出Weight Aligning方法校正FC层偏置权重以缓解类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘。
1911.07053|v2.innovation: 首次指出FC层权重偏置是导致模型偏向新类的关键因素，并通过权重对齐维护新旧类公平性。
1911.07053|v2.result: 结合知识蒸馏与权重对齐，显著提升了类增量学习的性能，有效缓解了灾难性遗忘。

Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by exploring adversarial training. ②It proposes an adversarial continual learning framework that enhances robustness to task changes via adversarial perturbations. ③Unlike prior work, it introduces adversarial training into continual learning to improve generalization. ④Abstract missing, no specific data available.

GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习领域方法日益复杂但进展存疑的问题，质疑现有方法的实际进步。②提出GDumb，一种简单方法：贪婪采样并训练模型，不使用复杂机制。③相比已有复杂方法，GDumb在多个基准上取得竞争性甚至更优结果。④实验表明简单方法可超越许多复杂持续学习方法，引发对领域进展的反思。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_en: ①This paper questions the progress in continual learning, where methods grow complex but gains are questionable. ②It proposes GDumb, a simple approach that greedily samples and trains a model without complex mechanisms. ③Unlike complex prior methods, GDumb achieves competitive or superior results on multiple benchmarks. ④Experiments show the simple method outperforms many complex approaches, prompting reflection on the field's progress.
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.assessment: 该工作以简单方法挑战复杂方法，对持续学习领域的研究方向有重要反思价值。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.contribution: 提出简单方法GDumb并质疑持续学习领域的实际进展。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.innovation: 用极简的贪婪采样训练策略挑战复杂持续学习方法。
