PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_cn: 针对小任务增量学习（small-task incremental learning）中灾难性遗忘问题，提出PODNet，通过池化输出蒸馏（Pooled Outputs Distillation）在中间层和输出层同时约束新旧网络表示。方法结合空间维度的池化蒸馏与分类层蒸馏，并引入新的代理损失以缓解任务间不平衡。在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset等基准上，PODNet在多个小任务增量设置下优于LwF、iCaRL、EEIL等方法，平均精度提升明显。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in small-task incremental learning by proposing PODNet, which distills pooled intermediate features and output logits to preserve old knowledge. It introduces a novel proxy-based loss to handle inter-task imbalance and combines spatial pooling distillation with classification distillation. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-Subset show consistent improvements over LwF, iCaRL, and EEIL under multiple small-task protocols.
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.assessment: 该工作系统性地将特征蒸馏扩展到池化中间表示，是小任务增量学习的重要基线，实验扎实，值得关注。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.contribution: 提出PODNet，通过池化输出蒸馏与代理损失实现小任务增量学习中的知识保持。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.innovation: 在中间层引入空间池化蒸馏，并结合代理损失缓解任务间类别不平衡。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-Subset等基准上取得优于LwF、iCaRL、EEIL的增量学习精度。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for._arxiv_id: PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for Small-Tasks Incremental Learning.

Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_cn: 针对增量学习中存储旧任务样本导致内存开销大的问题，提出通过特征自适应（Feature Adaptation）实现内存高效的增量学习。方法学习一个特征变换，将旧模型提取的特征映射到新模型的特征空间，从而只需存储压缩后的特征而非原始样本。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet等基准上，该方法在显著降低内存占用的同时保持与存储原始样本方法相近的精度。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_en: This paper tackles the memory overhead of storing exemplars in incremental learning by learning a feature adaptation module that maps old-model features into the new model's feature space. This allows storing compact feature representations instead of raw images. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet show comparable accuracy to exemplar-based methods with substantially reduced memory footprint.
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.assessment: 从内存效率角度切入增量学习，特征自适应思路实用，对资源受限场景有参考价值。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.contribution: 提出基于特征自适应的内存高效增量学习框架，用压缩特征替代原始样本存储。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.innovation: 学习跨模型的特征映射，使旧特征在新特征空间中保持判别性。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上以更低内存达到与存储原始样本方法相近的精度。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th._arxiv_id: Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Through Feature Adaptation.

Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中特征空间拓扑结构被破坏导致旧类混淆的问题，提出拓扑保持类增量学习（TPCIL）。方法通过拓扑保持损失约束新旧类特征在嵌入空间中的相对距离关系，维持类间拓扑结构。在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset等基准上，TPCIL在多个增量设置下优于iCaRL、LUCIR等方法，缓解了旧类遗忘。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the distortion of feature-space topology in class-incremental learning, which causes confusion among old classes. It proposes Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Learning (TPCIL), which enforces a topology-preserving loss to maintain relative distances among class embeddings. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-Subset show improvements over iCaRL and LUCIR across several incremental settings.
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.assessment: 从拓扑结构角度约束特征空间，为类增量学习提供了新视角，方法简洁有效。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.contribution: 提出拓扑保持损失，在类增量学习中维持特征空间的类间拓扑结构。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.innovation: 显式建模并约束新旧类特征嵌入的拓扑关系以缓解遗忘。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-Subset上优于iCaRL、LUCIR等类增量学习方法。

Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习（online continual learning）中数据流类别不平衡导致模型偏向多数类的问题，提出从不平衡数据流中在线学习的方法。方法通过重采样与损失重加权策略，在单遍数据流下缓解类别不平衡带来的偏差。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet等在线持续学习基准上，该方法在类别不平衡设置下优于现有在线持续学习方法。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_en: This paper studies online continual learning from imbalanced data streams, where class imbalance biases the model toward majority classes. It proposes resampling and loss reweighting strategies tailored to single-pass online settings. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet online benchmarks show improvements over existing online continual learning methods under imbalance.
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.assessment: 关注在线持续学习中的类别不平衡这一现实问题，方法实用，填补了该方向的研究空白。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.contribution: 提出面向不平衡数据流的在线持续学习策略，缓解类别偏差。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.innovation: 将重采样与损失重加权结合，适配单遍在线数据流场景。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet在线基准的不平衡设置下优于现有方法。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning from Imbalanced Data.

Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_cn: 针对神经主题模型在动态文档流中难以持续学习新主题的问题，提出将终身学习（lifelong learning）引入神经主题建模。方法通过持续学习机制在保留旧主题知识的同时适应新文档流中的新主题。实验表明该方法在动态语料上能缓解灾难性遗忘并保持主题质量。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of neural topic models adapting to evolving document streams with new topics. It introduces continual lifelong learning into neural topic modeling to retain old topic knowledge while acquiring new topics. Experiments on dynamic corpora show reduced catastrophic forgetting and maintained topic quality.
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.assessment: 将持续学习应用于主题建模，属于跨领域应用，与视觉/自动驾驶方向关联较弱。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.contribution: 将终身学习机制引入神经主题模型以支持动态文档流中的持续主题发现。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.innovation: 在神经主题建模中引入持续学习以缓解灾难性遗忘。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.result: 在动态语料上缓解遗忘并保持主题质量。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif._arxiv_id: Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lifelong Learning.

Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_cn: 针对持续学习最优解的理论性质问题，论文证明在一般条件下最优持续学习需要完美记忆（perfect memory），且该问题是NP-hard的。作者通过形式化分析揭示了持续学习任务的内在计算复杂性，说明不存在多项式时间的通用最优算法。该结果为持续学习算法的设计提供了理论下界与指导。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_en: This paper proves that optimal continual learning requires perfect memory and is NP-hard under general conditions. Through formal analysis, it reveals the intrinsic computational complexity of continual learning, showing no polynomial-time general optimal algorithm exists. These results provide theoretical lower bounds and guidance for algorithm design.
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.assessment: 为持续学习提供重要的理论刻画，说明完美记忆的必要性与问题难度，具有理论指导意义。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.contribution: 证明最优持续学习需要完美记忆且为NP-hard问题。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.innovation: 从计算复杂性角度形式化持续学习的最优性问题。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.result: 给出最优持续学习需完美记忆且NP-hard的理论结论。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M._arxiv_id: Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect Memory and is NP-hard.

Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，论文提出一种前瞻式元学习（Look-ahead Meta Learning）方法，通过在任务序列上模拟未来梯度更新来优化当前参数。方法将元学习目标从单步适应扩展到多步前瞻，使模型在更新时考虑对后续任务的潜在影响。相比传统经验回放或正则化方法，该方法在多个持续学习基准上取得更优的稳定性-可塑性权衡，在CIFAR-100等数据集上显著降低遗忘率并提升平均精度。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing a look-ahead meta-learning approach that simulates future gradient updates during current parameter optimization. The method extends the meta-learning objective from single-step to multi-step look-ahead, enabling the model to account for potential impacts on subsequent tasks. Compared with experience replay and regularization baselines, it achieves a better stability-plasticity trade-off, significantly reducing forgetting and improving average accuracy on benchmarks such as CIFAR-100.
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.assessment: 该工作将元学习与前瞻机制结合，为持续学习提供了新的优化视角，实验扎实，值得关注。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.contribution: 提出前瞻式元学习框架，通过模拟未来更新来缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.innovation: 将多步前瞻梯度模拟引入元学习目标，使参数更新考虑对后续任务的长期影响。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.result: 在多个持续学习基准上降低遗忘率并提升平均精度，优于经验回放和正则化方法。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L._arxiv_id: Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual Learning.

Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_cn: 针对持续学习和流式数据场景中经验回放缓冲区选择样本的问题，论文提出基于双层优化的核心集（Coreset）选择方法。方法将核心集选择建模为双层优化问题，外层优化模型性能，内层优化核心集权重，从而选出最具代表性的样本子集。相比随机采样或启发式选择，该方法在持续学习和流式学习任务上以更小的缓冲区实现更低的遗忘和更高的精度，在多个数据集上验证了有效性。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of selecting representative samples for replay buffers in continual learning and streaming settings by proposing a coreset selection method based on bilevel optimization. The coreset selection is formulated as a bilevel problem where the outer level optimizes model performance and the inner level optimizes coreset weights. Compared with random or heuristic selection, it achieves lower forgetting and higher accuracy with smaller buffers across multiple datasets.
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.assessment: 将双层优化用于核心集选择，为持续学习中的缓冲区管理提供了理论驱动的方案，实验充分。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.contribution: 提出基于双层优化的核心集选择方法，用于持续学习和流式学习中的经验回放。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.innovation: 将核心集选择建模为双层优化问题，联合优化模型性能和样本权重。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.result: 以更小的缓冲区实现更低的遗忘和更高的精度，优于随机采样和启发式方法。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co._arxiv_id: Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Continual Learning and Streaming.

Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_cn: 针对一般持续学习（General Continual Learning）中任务边界模糊、数据分布漂移的问题，论文提出Dark Experience Replay（DER）方法，一种简单而强大的基线。方法在回放缓冲区中存储样本及其logits，训练时同时匹配当前logits与存储logits，从而在无任务边界信息下缓解遗忘。相比现有方法，DER无需任务标识或复杂正则化，在多个一般持续学习基准上取得最优或接近最优性能，且实现简单、计算开销低。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses general continual learning where task boundaries are blurred and data distributions drift, proposing Dark Experience Replay (DER), a strong and simple baseline. DER stores samples along with their logits in a replay buffer and matches current logits to stored ones during training, mitigating forgetting without task boundary information. Compared with existing methods, DER requires no task identifiers or complex regularization and achieves state-of-the-art or near-optimal performance on multiple general continual learning benchmarks with low computational overhead.
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.assessment: DER以极简设计在一般持续学习上取得强性能，是该领域的重要基线，值得广泛关注和引用。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.contribution: 提出Dark Experience Replay，一种简单强大的一般持续学习基线，通过匹配存储logits缓解遗忘。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.innovation: 在回放中存储并匹配logits而非仅标签，无需任务边界信息即可有效缓解遗忘。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.result: 在多个一般持续学习基准上达到最优或接近最优性能，实现简单且计算开销低。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le._arxiv_id: Dark Experience for General Continual Learning: a Strong, Simple Baseline.

Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中快速适应新任务与积累旧知识之间的矛盾，论文提出OSAKA（Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation）新框架。方法将在线持续学习形式化为元学习问题，通过任务推断和参数更新分离，实现在线快速适应同时保留历史知识。相比传统在线持续学习方法，OSAKA在多个基准上显著提升在线适应速度和知识保留能力，在CIFAR-100等数据集上取得更优的在线精度和更低遗忘。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_en: This paper addresses the tension between fast adaptation to new tasks and accumulation of past knowledge in online continual learning by proposing OSAKA (Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation). The framework formulates online continual learning as a meta-learning problem, separating task inference from parameter updates to enable rapid online adaptation while retaining historical knowledge. Compared with traditional online continual learning methods, OSAKA significantly improves online adaptation speed and knowledge retention, achieving better online accuracy and lower forgetting on benchmarks such as CIFAR-100.
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.assessment: OSAKA为在线持续学习提供了元学习视角的系统性框架，实验充分，对在线场景研究有重要参考价值。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.contribution: 提出OSAKA框架，将在线持续学习形式化为元学习问题，实现快速适应与知识积累的平衡。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.innovation: 分离任务推断与参数更新，实现在线快速适应同时有效保留历史知识。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.result: 在多个基准上提升在线适应速度和知识保留能力，取得更优在线精度和更低遗忘。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc._arxiv_id: Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation (OSAKA): a New Approach to Continual Learning.

Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中参数更新导致旧任务知识被覆盖的问题，论文提出在低秩正交子空间中学习新任务的方法。方法将每个任务的参数更新约束在低秩正交子空间内，使不同任务的更新相互正交，从而减少任务间干扰。相比现有正交子空间方法，该方法通过低秩约束进一步降低参数冲突，在多个持续学习基准上取得更优性能，显著降低遗忘并提升平均精度。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_en: This paper addresses the overwriting of old-task knowledge during parameter updates in continual learning by proposing to learn new tasks in low-rank orthogonal subspaces. The method constrains each task's parameter updates to a low-rank orthogonal subspace, making updates across tasks mutually orthogonal to reduce interference. Compared with existing orthogonal subspace methods, the low-rank constraint further reduces parameter conflicts, achieving better performance on multiple continual learning benchmarks with significantly lower forgetting and higher average accuracy.
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.assessment: 低秩正交子空间为持续学习提供了一种有效的参数隔离策略，方法简洁且实验验证充分。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.contribution: 提出在低秩正交子空间中学习新任务，通过参数正交化减少持续学习中的任务干扰。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.innovation: 将低秩约束与正交子空间结合，进一步降低任务间参数冲突。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.result: 在多个持续学习基准上显著降低遗忘并提升平均精度，优于现有正交子空间方法。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona._arxiv_id: Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogonal Subspaces.

Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中遗忘问题，论文提出实例感知参数化（Instance-Aware Parameterization）方法。方法为每个输入实例动态生成或选择参数子集，使模型能够针对不同实例进行自适应更新，从而在在线场景下缓解对旧知识的遗忘。相比固定参数或任务级参数隔离方法，实例级参数化更细粒度地控制更新范围，在多个在线持续学习基准上取得更优的精度和更低遗忘。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_en: This paper addresses forgetting in online continual learning by proposing instance-aware parameterization. The method dynamically generates or selects parameter subsets for each input instance, enabling adaptive updates per instance to mitigate forgetting of old knowledge in online settings. Compared with fixed-parameter or task-level parameter isolation methods, instance-level parameterization provides finer-grained control over update scope, achieving better accuracy and lower forgetting on multiple online continual learning benchmarks.
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.assessment: 实例级参数化为在线持续学习提供了更细粒度的遗忘缓解思路，方法新颖且实验有效。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.contribution: 提出实例感知参数化方法，通过为每个实例动态选择参数子集来缓解在线持续学习中的遗忘。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.innovation: 将参数隔离粒度从任务级细化到实例级，实现更精细的更新控制。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.result: 在多个在线持续学习基准上取得更优精度和更低遗忘，优于固定参数和任务级隔离方法。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua._arxiv_id: Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continual Learning via Instance-Aware Parameterization.

2103.17230|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中任务边界模糊（blurry boundary）、任务间共享类别这一更现实但研究不足的设定，现有方法多假设任务类别互斥，不够实际。②提出 Rainbow Memory（RM），一种基于每样本分类不确定性和数据增强的记忆管理策略，以增强 episodic memory 中样本的多样性。③相比已有持续学习方法，RM 显式关注记忆样本多样性，方法简单但有效。④在 MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100 和 ImageNet 上，在模糊持续学习设定下大幅超越当时 SOTA。
2103.17230|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the more realistic 'blurry' continual learning setting where tasks share classes rather than being disjoint. It proposes Rainbow Memory (RM), a memory management strategy based on per-sample classification uncertainty and data augmentation to enhance sample diversity in episodic memory. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and ImageNet show large accuracy gains over state-of-the-art methods in blurry continual learning setups.
2103.17230|v2.assessment: 该工作指出现有持续学习评测设定过于理想化，提出的模糊任务边界设定更贴近实际，记忆多样性视角对持续学习研究者有参考价值。
2103.17230|v2.contribution: 提出基于不确定性与数据增强的 Rainbow Memory 记忆管理策略，用于模糊任务边界的持续学习。
2103.17230|v2.innovation: 首次强调 episodic memory 中样本多样性对模糊持续学习的重要性，并用分类不确定性驱动记忆采样。
2103.17230|v2.result: 在 MNIST/CIFAR10/CIFAR100/ImageNet 的模糊持续学习设定下大幅超越当时 SOTA。

2105.04444|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘和记忆开销大的问题，从信息论视角分析遗忘成因。②发现遗忘源于学习新任务时参数上来自旧任务的 information gain 丢失，据此提出 Bit-Level Information Preserving（BLIP），通过参数量化在比特级别更新参数，冻结由任务数据估计出的高信息增益比特以防止遗忘。③相比已有方法，BLIP 以比特级冻结替代整体参数约束，兼顾抗遗忘与低内存开销。④在分类到强化学习等多类任务上取得优于或持平于先前方法的结果。
2105.04444|v2.summary_en: This paper studies continual learning from an information-theoretic perspective and observes that forgetting stems from the loss of information gain on parameters from previous tasks. It proposes Bit-Level Information Preserving (BLIP), which quantizes weights and freezes bits with high estimated information gain to prevent forgetting. Extensive experiments from classification to reinforcement learning show better or on-par results compared to prior methods.
2105.04444|v2.assessment: 从信息论角度解释遗忘并落到比特级参数冻结的实现，思路新颖且实现简洁，对持续学习与模型压缩交叉方向有启发。
2105.04444|v2.contribution: 提出比特级信息保持（BLIP）方法，通过量化与比特冻结缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。
2105.04444|v2.innovation: 用信息增益视角解释遗忘，并在比特粒度上选择性冻结参数。
2105.04444|v2.result: 在分类与强化学习任务上取得优于或持平于先前方法的表现。

2103.16597|v2.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，并进一步扩展到测试集包含训练集未见类别的任务增量广义零样本学习设定。②提出用权重校正（weight rectification）和仿射变换适配顺序到达的不同任务，仅用极少参数学习权重校正，并对网络输出学习仿射变换以适配新任务。③相比已有方法，该框架同时适用于零样本与非零样本任务增量学习。④在多个数据集的两种设定下实验验证了方法的有效性。
2103.16597|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses task incremental learning and its generalized zero-shot variant where test classes are unseen during training. It proposes weight rectifications and affine transformations with very few parameters to adapt network weights and outputs to sequentially arriving tasks. Experiments on several datasets in both zero-shot and non-zero-shot settings demonstrate its effectiveness.
2103.16597|v2.assessment: 将任务增量学习与广义零样本设定结合，参数高效的权重校正思路有一定新意，但整体影响力相对有限。
2103.16597|v2.contribution: 提出基于权重校正与仿射变换的参数高效任务增量学习框架，兼容零样本设定。
2103.16597|v2.innovation: 用少量参数学习权重校正与输出仿射变换，统一处理零样本与非零样本任务增量学习。
2103.16597|v2.result: 在多个数据集的零样本与非零样本任务增量学习设定下验证了有效性。

Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，摘要缺失，仅从标题推断其关注逐层优化。②提出基于梯度分解的逐层优化方法（Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decomposition），通过对梯度进行分解实现分层参数更新以缓解遗忘。③相比整体统一更新，逐层处理有望更精细地平衡新旧任务。④具体实验与数据因摘要缺失无法确认。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_en: This paper targets catastrophic forgetting in continual learning. It proposes a layerwise optimization scheme based on gradient decomposition to update parameters in a more fine-grained manner. Due to the missing abstract, detailed experimental results cannot be confirmed.
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.assessment: 梯度分解用于逐层优化的思路对持续学习有潜在价值，但缺少摘要信息，难以充分评估其质量与效果。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.contribution: 提出基于梯度分解的逐层优化方法用于持续学习。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.innovation: 将梯度分解引入逐层参数更新以缓解遗忘。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom._arxiv_id: Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decomposition for Continual Learning.

Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_cn: ①针对判别式与生成式持续学习任务中的遗忘问题，摘要缺失，仅从标题推断其关注高效特征变换。②提出高效特征变换方法（Efficient Feature Transformations），以少量参数对特征进行任务适配，兼顾判别与生成任务。③相比已有方法，强调参数效率并统一处理判别式与生成式设定。④具体实验与数据因摘要缺失无法确认。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning for both discriminative and generative tasks. It proposes efficient feature transformations to adapt features to new tasks with few parameters. Due to the missing abstract, detailed experimental results cannot be confirmed.
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.assessment: 统一判别式与生成式持续学习并强调参数效率是有意义的尝试，但缺少摘要难以深入评估。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.contribution: 提出面向判别式与生成式任务的高效特征变换持续学习方法。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.innovation: 以参数高效的特征变换统一处理判别与生成持续学习。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di._arxiv_id: Efficient Feature Transformations for Discriminative and Generative Continual Learning.

Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，摘要缺失，仅从标题推断其关注在特征协方差零空间中训练网络。②提出在特征协方差零空间（Null Space of Feature Covariance）中更新网络参数，使新任务学习不干扰旧任务已占用的特征子空间。③相比正则化或回放类方法，该思路从特征空间几何约束角度抑制遗忘。④具体实验与数据因摘要缺失无法确认。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning. It proposes training networks within the null space of the feature covariance so that updates for new tasks do not interfere with feature subspaces occupied by previous tasks. Due to the missing abstract, detailed experimental results cannot be confirmed.
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.assessment: 零空间投影约束是持续学习中较有理论依据的方向，若实验充分则对领域有参考价值，但摘要缺失影响评估。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.contribution: 提出在特征协方差零空间中训练网络以缓解持续学习遗忘。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.innovation: 利用特征协方差零空间约束参数更新，从几何角度保护旧任务特征。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu._arxiv_id: Training Networks in Null Space of Feature Covariance for Continual Learning.

ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督持续学习（Semi-Supervised Continual Learning）中增量无标签数据利用效率低的问题，提出ORDisCo方法。其核心思路是联合使用有标签数据的监督学习和无标签数据的自监督/一致性正则化，并设计了一种基于回放缓冲区的增量无标签数据采样策略，以平衡新旧类别的数据分布。相比仅使用有标签数据的持续学习方法，ORDisCo在多个基准上显著提升了旧类别的保持能力，同时降低了遗忘率。实验表明，在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100等数据集上，ORDisCo在有限标注预算下取得了优于现有半监督持续学习方法的精度。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of efficiently leveraging incremental unlabeled data in semi-supervised continual learning. It proposes ORDisCo, which combines supervised learning on labeled data with self-supervised and consistency regularization on unlabeled data, and introduces a replay-based sampling strategy to balance old and new class distributions. Compared to prior methods that only use labeled data, ORDisCo significantly improves retention of old classes and reduces forgetting, achieving superior accuracy on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100 under limited annotation budgets.
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.assessment: 该工作为半监督持续学习提供了有效的数据利用方案，但领域与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱，适合对持续学习感兴趣的研究者参考。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.contribution: 提出ORDisCo框架，联合监督与自监督信号并设计增量无标签数据回放策略。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.innovation: 将半监督学习中的一致性正则化与持续学习的回放机制结合，并针对增量无标签数据设计采样策略。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100上，有限标注下精度优于现有半监督持续学习方法。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o._arxiv_id: ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage of Incremental Unlabeled Data for Semi-Supervised Continual Learning.

Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本增量学习（Few-Shot Incremental Learning）中因样本极少导致分类器快速过拟合和灾难性遗忘的问题，提出持续进化分类器（Continually Evolved Classifiers, CEC）方法。CEC通过图注意力网络动态生成分类器权重，并利用伪增量学习策略在基类上模拟增量过程，使分类器能够适应新类而不遗忘旧类。相比固定分类器或简单微调的方法，CEC在CIFAR-100和ImageNet等基准上显著提升了增量学习的准确率，尤其在5-way 5-shot设置下取得了当时最优结果。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot incremental learning where scarce samples cause rapid overfitting and catastrophic forgetting. It proposes Continually Evolved Classifiers (CEC), which uses a graph attention network to dynamically generate classifier weights and employs a pseudo-incremental strategy on base classes to simulate incremental episodes. Compared to fixed or fine-tuned classifiers, CEC achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet, especially under 5-way 5-shot settings.
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.assessment: CEC为小样本增量学习提供了有效的分类器动态生成方案，但领域与自动驾驶感知的关联有限，适合持续学习方向的研究者。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.contribution: 提出持续进化分类器CEC，利用图注意力网络动态生成分类器权重。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.innovation: 将分类器权重生成与图注意力机制结合，并设计伪增量学习策略模拟增量过程。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上5-way 5-shot设置下取得当时最优准确率。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Continually Evolved Classifiers.

Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_cn: 该论文针对图像去雨（Image De-Raining）任务中模型需要适应不同雨型且不能遗忘已学雨型的问题，提出基于持续学习的去雨方法。其核心是设计一种持续学习框架，通过知识蒸馏和参数正则化使去雨网络在增量学习新雨型时保持对旧雨型的去雨能力。相比单独训练或简单微调的去雨模型，该方法在多个合成和真实雨数据集上减少了遗忘，同时保持了对新雨型的适应能力。实验表明，该方法在PSNR和SSIM指标上优于基线持续学习方法。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_en: This paper addresses image de-raining under the challenge of adapting to new rain types without forgetting previously learned ones. It proposes a continual learning framework that uses knowledge distillation and parameter regularization to preserve de-raining capability on old rain types while learning new ones. Compared to separate training or fine-tuning, the method reduces forgetting and maintains adaptability, achieving better PSNR and SSIM than baseline continual learning methods on synthetic and real rain datasets.
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..assessment: 该工作将持续学习应用于低层视觉去雨任务，与自动驾驶感知中的去雨预处理有一定关联，但整体相关性较低。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..contribution: 提出基于持续学习的图像去雨框架，利用知识蒸馏和参数正则化缓解遗忘。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..innovation: 将持续学习中的蒸馏与正则化策略引入图像去雨任务，处理多雨型增量学习。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..result: 在合成和真实雨数据集上PSNR和SSIM优于基线持续学习方法。

2104.08572|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出现有知识蒸馏方法仅最小化当前与先前响应的差异，但忽略了响应流形的几何结构。作者提出一种基于测地路径（Geodesic Path）的蒸馏方法：首先为先前和当前响应构建低维流形，然后最小化沿连接两个流形的测地路径上的响应差异。这种平滑的蒸馏约束能更有效地保留旧知识。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet等基准上，该方法在多个增量学习设置下取得了优于现有蒸馏方法的性能，显著降低了遗忘率。
2104.08572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning, noting that existing knowledge distillation methods only minimize response dissimilarity without considering the geometry of response manifolds. It proposes a geodesic path-based distillation: constructing low-dimensional manifolds for previous and current responses and minimizing dissimilarity along the geodesic connecting them. This smooth distillation constraint better preserves old knowledge, outperforming state-of-the-art distillation methods on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet with significantly reduced forgetting.
2104.08572|v2.assessment: 该工作从流形几何角度重新审视知识蒸馏，为增量学习提供了新颖且理论优雅的解决方案，值得持续学习研究者关注。
2104.08572|v2.contribution: 提出基于测地路径的知识蒸馏方法，通过流形间测地线最小化响应差异。
2104.08572|v2.innovation: 首次将响应流形的测地路径引入知识蒸馏，实现平滑且更有效的旧知识保留。
2104.08572|v2.result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上多个增量设置下优于现有蒸馏方法，遗忘率显著降低。

2107.08918|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning）中表示优化和原型重组监督不足的问题，提出一种增量原型学习方案。该方案包含随机情节选择策略，使特征表示适应不同增量情节以增强扩展性；以及自提升原型精炼机制，通过动态关系投影模块在共享嵌入空间中计算关系矩阵，并以此引导原型更新。在三个基准数据集上，该方法分别以13%、17%和11%的幅度超越当时最优方法，显著提升了小样本类增量学习的性能。
2107.08918|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning where representation optimization and prototype reorganization suffer from limited supervision. It proposes an incremental prototype learning scheme with a random episode selection strategy to adapt features to various incremental episodes, and a self-promoted prototype refinement mechanism that uses a dynamic relation projection module to compute relation matrices in a shared embedding space for bootstrapping prototype updates. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 13%, 17%, and 11% on three benchmark datasets.
2107.08918|v2.assessment: 该工作在小样本类增量学习上取得了显著性能提升，原型精炼机制设计巧妙，适合持续学习与少样本学习交叉方向的研究者。
2107.08918|v2.contribution: 提出增量原型学习方案，包含随机情节选择和自提升原型精炼机制。
2107.08918|v2.innovation: 设计动态关系投影模块，利用类间依赖关系引导原型更新。
2107.08918|v2.result: 在三个基准数据集上分别超越SOTA 13%、17%和11%。

2103.04059|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中因样本极少导致标准增量学习技术无法直接应用的问题，提出一种语义感知知识蒸馏算法。该方法利用词嵌入作为廉价语义信息辅助蒸馏，并设计基于注意力机制的多并行视觉嵌入对齐方法，将视觉与语义向量对齐，从而缓解灾难性遗忘。在MiniImageNet、CUB200和CIFAR100数据集上，该方法取得了新的最优结果，超越了现有FSCIL方法。
2103.04059|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) where limited samples prevent direct application of standard incremental learning techniques. It introduces a semantic-aware knowledge distillation algorithm that leverages word embeddings as cheap semantic information and proposes an attention-based alignment of multiple parallel visual embeddings with semantic vectors to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. It establishes new state-of-the-art results on MiniImageNet, CUB200, and CIFAR100.
2103.04059|v2.assessment: 该工作将语义信息引入FSCIL的蒸馏过程，为小样本增量学习提供了新思路，适合持续学习与多模态交叉方向的研究者。
2103.04059|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知知识蒸馏算法，利用词嵌入和注意力对齐视觉与语义向量。
2103.04059|v2.innovation: 将词嵌入作为语义信息辅助蒸馏，并设计多并行视觉嵌入的注意力对齐机制。
2103.04059|v2.result: 在MiniImageNet、CUB200和CIFAR100上取得新的最优结果。

Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出数据本身对模型更新的因果效应未被显式建模。作者提出将数据对模型参数的因果效应从训练过程中蒸馏出来，通过因果推断框架分离出真正影响旧类知识保持的因素，并据此设计增量学习策略。相比已有仅依赖回放或正则化的方法，该方法从因果角度重新审视数据作用，在多个类增量基准上取得了更优的旧类保持与新类学习平衡。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by explicitly modeling the causal effect of data on model updates. It proposes to distill the causal effect of data from the training process using a causal inference framework, separating factors that truly affect the retention of old-class knowledge. Compared with existing replay- or regularization-based methods, the proposed approach achieves a better balance between old-class retention and new-class learning on multiple class-incremental benchmarks.
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.assessment: 从因果推断角度切入类增量学习，视角新颖，对持续学习研究者有启发。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.contribution: 提出蒸馏数据因果效应的类增量学习框架，缓解灾难性遗忘。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.innovation: 将因果推断引入类增量学习，显式建模数据对模型更新的因果作用。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.result: 在多个类增量基准上取得优于已有方法的旧类保持与新类学习平衡。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas._arxiv_id: Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Class-Incremental Learning.

Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中固定网络结构难以适应新类的问题，提出自适应聚合网络（Adaptive Aggregation Networks）。方法通过动态聚合不同网络分支或层特征，使模型在增量训练时能自适应调整表征能力，从而缓解灾难性遗忘。相比固定结构的增量学习方法，该工作提升了模型对新类的适应性与旧类知识的保持能力，在标准类增量基准上取得更优性能。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_en: This paper targets the limitation of fixed network architectures in class-incremental learning and proposes Adaptive Aggregation Networks. The method dynamically aggregates features from different network branches or layers, enabling the model to adapt its representation during incremental training and alleviating catastrophic forgetting. Compared with fixed-architecture incremental learning methods, it improves both adaptation to new classes and retention of old-class knowledge on standard class-incremental benchmarks.
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.assessment: 自适应聚合思路对类增量学习中的结构僵化问题提供了有效解决方案，值得关注。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.contribution: 提出自适应聚合网络，提升类增量学习中的表征适应能力。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.innovation: 通过动态聚合网络分支/层特征实现增量学习中的自适应表征。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.result: 在标准类增量基准上取得优于固定结构方法的性能。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-._arxiv_id: Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-Incremental Learning.

2011.14593|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对深度模型在增量学习中因黑盒优化导致的灾难性遗忘问题，提出基于rate reduction原理的白盒架构。方法不依赖反向传播，而是显式逐层计算网络参数，在给定预训练网络和新类数据时可证明地构造出等价于联合训练所有旧类和新类的网络。实验表明，该方法在MNIST和CIFAR-10上分类性能衰减显著更小，大幅优于现有最先进方法，验证了白盒算法在复杂图像增量学习中的可行性。
2011.14593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning caused by black-box optimization of deep models by proposing a white-box architecture derived from the principle of rate reduction. Each layer is explicitly computed without backpropagation, and given a pre-trained network and new classes, the approach provably constructs a new network emulating joint training over all past and new classes. Experiments show significantly less decay in classification performance, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by a large margin on MNIST and CIFAR-10.
2011.14593|v2.assessment: 白盒增量学习范式具有理论保证，为持续学习提供了新思路，值得深入关注。
2011.14593|v2.contribution: 提出基于rate reduction的白盒增量学习架构，可证明地模拟联合训练。
2011.14593|v2.innovation: 无需反向传播的显式逐层计算，实现有理论保证的增量学习。
2011.14593|v2.result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10上性能衰减显著更小，大幅超越现有最先进方法。

Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出原型增强与自监督相结合的方法。方法通过为旧类生成增强原型以维持特征空间结构，并引入自监督学习增强表征的泛化能力，从而在增量训练中更好地保持旧类知识。相比仅依赖回放或正则化的方法，该工作在不存储大量旧样本的情况下提升了增量学习性能，在标准类增量基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by combining prototype augmentation and self-supervision. It generates augmented prototypes for old classes to maintain the feature space structure and introduces self-supervised learning to enhance representation generalization, thereby better preserving old-class knowledge during incremental training. Compared with replay- or regularization-based methods, it improves incremental learning performance without storing large amounts of old samples on standard class-incremental benchmarks.
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.assessment: 原型增强与自监督结合思路简洁有效，对类增量学习研究者有参考价值。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.contribution: 提出原型增强与自监督结合的类增量学习方法。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.innovation: 利用增强原型维持旧类特征结构，并引入自监督提升表征泛化。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.result: 在标准类增量基准上取得有竞争力的性能，且无需大量旧样本存储。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis._arxiv_id: Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervision for Incremental Learning.

Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对真实世界在线持续目标检测问题，指出现有持续学习方法多局限于离线设定或分类任务，难以应对动态数据流。作者提出Wanderlust框架，面向在线持续目标检测，在真实场景中处理新类别不断出现且数据不可重复访问的挑战。相比已有持续检测方法，该工作更贴近实际部署需求，在在线持续检测基准上验证了方法的有效性，为自动驾驶等领域的持续感知提供了新思路。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_en: This paper targets online continual object detection in the real world, noting that existing continual learning methods are mostly limited to offline settings or classification tasks and struggle with dynamic data streams. The authors propose Wanderlust, a framework for online continual object detection that handles continuously emerging new classes with non-repeatable data access in real-world scenarios. Compared with existing continual detection methods, it better matches practical deployment needs and demonstrates effectiveness on online continual detection benchmarks, offering new insights for continual perception in autonomous driving.
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.assessment: 在线持续目标检测贴近自动驾驶实际需求，Wanderlust框架具有重要应用价值。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.contribution: 提出面向真实世界的在线持续目标检测框架Wanderlust。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.innovation: 解决在线数据流中新类不断出现且数据不可重复访问的持续检测难题。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.result: 在在线持续检测基准上验证了方法的有效性，贴近实际部署需求。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete._arxiv_id: Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Detection in the Real World.

Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中的类增量学习问题，指出现有增量学习方法多针对静态图像，难以处理视频中时空信息的持续学习。作者提出面向视频动作识别的类增量学习框架，通过设计适合视频特征的知识保持与更新机制，缓解增量训练中的灾难性遗忘。相比图像域增量学习方法，该工作更好地利用了视频时序信息，在视频动作识别增量基准上取得更优性能，为视频理解领域的持续学习提供了参考。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental learning for action recognition in videos, noting that existing incremental learning methods mostly target static images and struggle with spatio-temporal information in videos. The authors propose a class-incremental learning framework for video action recognition that designs knowledge retention and update mechanisms suitable for video features to alleviate catastrophic forgetting during incremental training. Compared with image-domain incremental methods, it better exploits temporal information and achieves superior performance on video action recognition incremental benchmarks, providing a reference for continual learning in video understanding.
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.assessment: 将类增量学习拓展到视频动作识别，填补了视频域持续学习的空白，值得关注。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.contribution: 提出面向视频动作识别的类增量学习框架。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.innovation: 设计适合视频时空特征的知识保持与更新机制，缓解增量遗忘。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.result: 在视频动作识别增量基准上取得优于图像域方法的性能。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re._arxiv_id: Class-Incremental Learning for Action Recognition in Videos.

Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线持续学习（online continual learning）中数据分布随环境自然漂移、而非传统 i.i.d. 假设的问题，指出现有方法在真实非平稳数据流下评估不足。作者构建了基于大规模视觉数据（如 ImageNet、CORe50 等）的在线持续学习基准，模拟自然分布漂移，并系统评估了经验回放、正则化等主流持续学习策略。相比以往使用人工构造的、类别均衡的任务序列，该工作揭示了在自然分布漂移下现有方法性能显著下降，且回放缓冲区大小与更新频率对结果影响很大。实验表明，在自然漂移设定下多数方法的最终精度远低于离线训练上界，凸显了该问题的挑战性。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_en: This paper studies online continual learning under natural distribution shifts in visual data streams, rather than the conventional i.i.d. or artificially balanced task sequences. The authors construct a benchmark from large-scale visual datasets that emulates realistic non-stationary data streams and systematically evaluate replay-based and regularization-based continual learning methods. They show that existing approaches degrade substantially under natural shifts, with buffer size and update frequency strongly affecting performance, and that a large gap remains to the offline upper bound.
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.assessment: 该工作为在线持续学习提供了更贴近真实部署的评估基准，对自动驾驶等需要在线适应环境变化的应用具有参考价值。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.contribution: 构建了模拟自然分布漂移的大规模视觉在线持续学习基准并系统评测主流方法。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.innovation: 首次系统研究自然分布漂移而非人工构造任务序列下的在线持续学习。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.result: 揭示现有方法在自然漂移下性能显著下降，与离线上界存在明显差距。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning with Natural Distribution Shifts: An Empirical Study with Visual Data.

Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，提出将对比学习（contrastive learning）引入持续学习框架，命名为 Co2L。方法在监督对比损失基础上，结合回放缓冲区中的样本进行对比学习，使同类样本在表征空间中聚集、不同类样本分离，从而缓解遗忘并提升表征质量。相比仅用交叉熵或知识蒸馏的持续学习方法，Co2L 在表征层面增强了类间区分度与类内紧凑性。在 CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet 等基准上，Co2L 在多种持续学习设定下取得了优于或媲美当时最优方法的结果，尤其在类别增量场景中表现突出。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Co2L, which integrates supervised contrastive learning into continual learning to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. By combining contrastive loss with replay buffer samples, Co2L learns more discriminative and compact representations across tasks. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet show that Co2L outperforms or matches state-of-the-art continual learning methods, particularly in class-incremental settings.
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 将对比学习与持续学习结合的代表性工作，思路简洁有效，对表征学习与持续学习的交叉研究有启发。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出将监督对比学习与回放结合的持续学习框架 Co2L。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 利用对比损失在表征层面缓解灾难性遗忘并增强类间可分性。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.result: 在 CIFAR 与 ImageNet 等基准上取得优于或媲美 SOTA 的持续学习性能。

Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中数据流含噪声标签导致回放缓冲区被污染、进而加剧遗忘的问题，提出自净化回放（Self-Purified Replay, SPR）方法。方法通过估计样本标签可靠性，对回放缓冲区中的样本进行筛选或重加权，从而在噪声数据流下保持回放的净化效果。相比直接回放所有样本的基线方法，SPR 在含噪持续学习设定下显著提升了鲁棒性。实验在多个图像分类数据集上验证，在对称与非对称噪声下均优于现有持续学习与噪声标签学习方法。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning on noisy data streams, where contaminated replay buffers exacerbate forgetting. It proposes Self-Purified Replay (SPR), which estimates label reliability to filter or reweight buffered samples. Experiments on multiple image classification datasets under symmetric and asymmetric noise show consistent improvements over standard replay and noisy-label baselines.
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.assessment: 关注持续学习中噪声标签这一现实问题，方法实用，但整体创新度中等。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.contribution: 提出自净化回放机制以应对含噪数据流下的持续学习。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.innovation: 在回放缓冲区中引入标签可靠性估计以净化样本。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.result: 在对称与非对称噪声设定下均优于现有持续学习与噪声标签方法。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams._arxiv_id: Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams via Self-Purified Replay.

Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本学习与持续学习结合的场景，提出注意力独立机制（Attentive Independent Mechanisms, AIM），用于在少量样本下快速适应新任务并减少对旧任务的遗忘。方法通过注意力机制对特征进行任务相关的调制，并利用独立机制分离任务特定与共享表征。相比标准元学习或持续学习方法，AIM 在 few-shot 与 continual 设定下均取得更好或相当的性能。实验在 Omniglot、miniImageNet 等基准上验证了方法的有效性。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_en: This paper proposes Attentive Independent Mechanisms (AIM) for few-shot and continual learning, using attention to modulate features in a task-specific manner while separating task-specific and shared representations. AIM improves or matches performance in both few-shot and continual settings on Omniglot and miniImageNet benchmarks.
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.assessment: 将注意力机制用于小样本与持续学习的结合，思路有一定新意，但实验规模较小。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.contribution: 提出注意力独立机制以同时支持小样本与持续学习。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.innovation: 通过注意力调制与独立机制分离任务特定与共享表征。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.result: 在 Omniglot 与 miniImageNet 上取得优于或相当的性能。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att._arxiv_id: Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Attentive Independent Mechanisms.

RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_cn: 该论文针对语义分割中的持续学习问题，提出基于回放的框架 RECALL，以缓解在新类别/新域上训练时对旧类别分割性能的遗忘。方法在回放旧图像及其标签的基础上，结合知识蒸馏与伪标签策略，保持旧类别的分割能力。相比仅在分类任务上验证的持续学习方法，RECALL 面向密集预测任务，处理了分割中类别不平衡与背景主导等挑战。实验在多个分割基准上表明，RECALL 在持续学习设定下显著优于微调基线并接近联合训练上界。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning in semantic segmentation with RECALL, a replay-based framework that stores old images and labels and combines knowledge distillation with pseudo-labeling to preserve old-class performance. Unlike continual learning methods validated only on classification, RECALL targets dense prediction and handles class imbalance and background dominance. Experiments show substantial gains over fine-tuning baselines and performance close to joint training.
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.assessment: 面向语义分割的持续学习工作，与自动驾驶感知中的在线更新需求高度相关，方法扎实。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.contribution: 提出面向语义分割的基于回放的持续学习框架 RECALL。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.innovation: 结合回放、知识蒸馏与伪标签以应对密集预测中的遗忘与类别不平衡。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.result: 在多个分割基准上显著优于微调基线并接近联合训练上界。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning._arxiv_id: RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning in Semantic Segmentation.

Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_cn: 该论文针对人脸呈现攻击检测（face presentation attack detection）中新型攻击不断出现的问题，提出检测并持续学习新攻击类型的方法。方法在检测到未知攻击后，通过持续学习机制将其纳入模型而无需重训全部数据，从而在开放集设定下保持检测能力。相比仅针对已知攻击训练的静态检测器，该方法能适应新出现的攻击类型并减少对旧类型的遗忘。实验在公开人脸反欺骗数据集上验证了检测新攻击与持续学习的有效性。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_en: This paper tackles novel face presentation attacks by jointly detecting unknown attacks and continually learning them without full retraining. The proposed approach maintains open-set detection capability while adapting to new attack types and mitigating forgetting of old ones. Experiments on public face anti-spoofing datasets demonstrate effective novel-attack detection and continual learning.
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.assessment: 将开放集检测与持续学习结合应用于人脸反欺骗，与开放集检测和持续学习方向相关，但领域偏生物识别。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.contribution: 提出检测并持续学习新型人脸呈现攻击的框架。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.innovation: 在开放集设定下结合新攻击检测与持续学习以避免遗忘。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.result: 在公开人脸反欺骗数据集上验证了新攻击检测与持续学习的有效性。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove._arxiv_id: Detection and Continual Learning of Novel Face Presentation Attacks.

2203.11684|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在持续学习中直接应用CNN-based方法会导致严重性能退化的问题，本文提出MEta-ATtention (MEAT)，即对自注意力进行注意力掩码，以适配预训练ViT到新任务而不牺牲旧任务性能。与Piggyback等对所有参数加掩码的方法不同，MEAT利用ViT特性仅对部分参数进行掩码，从而更高效。实验表明该方法在多个持续学习基准上优于现有方法，同时保持较低的计算开销。
2203.11684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of ViT-backed continual learning when CNN-based methods are directly applied. It proposes MEta-ATtention (MEAT), which masks only a portion of ViT parameters via attention to self-attention, adapting pre-trained ViTs to new tasks without forgetting. Unlike Piggyback that masks all parameters, MEAT is more efficient and effective, achieving superior performance on continual learning benchmarks.
2203.11684|v2.assessment: 首次系统研究ViT持续学习并利用其结构特性设计高效掩码，对视觉Transformer与持续学习的交叉领域有重要参考价值。
2203.11684|v2.contribution: 提出MEAT方法，通过部分参数掩码实现ViT的高效持续学习。
2203.11684|v2.innovation: 利用ViT自注意力特性，仅对部分参数进行掩码，而非全参数掩码。
2203.11684|v2.result: 在持续学习基准上优于现有方法，且计算效率更高。

2201.09381|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频持续学习研究不足、现有工作存在任务间类别分布不均衡或数据集不适用的问题，本文提出vCLIMB，一个标准化的视频类增量持续学习基准，任务间类别数均匀分布。通过对现有CL方法的深入评估，发现视频数据带来两个独特挑战：帧级记忆选择和未修剪训练数据影响帧采样策略。为此提出时序一致性正则化，可叠加在基于记忆的CL方法上，在未修剪持续学习任务上比基线提升高达24%。
2201.09381|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces vCLIMB, a standardized video class incremental continual learning benchmark with uniform class distribution across tasks, addressing the lack of exploration in video CL. It identifies two unique challenges: frame-level memory selection and the impact of untrimmed data on frame sampling. A temporal consistency regularization is proposed, improving baselines by up to 24% on untrimmed continual learning.
2201.09381|v2.assessment: 填补了视频持续学习基准的空白，提出的时序一致性正则化有效且通用，对视频理解与持续学习交叉研究有推动作用。
2201.09381|v2.contribution: 构建了标准化的视频类增量持续学习基准vCLIMB，并提出时序一致性正则化方法。
2201.09381|v2.innovation: 针对视频数据特性，提出帧级记忆选择和时序一致性正则化。
2201.09381|v2.result: 在未修剪持续学习任务上比基线提升高达24%。

2204.02136|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测中直接微调会导致灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出弹性响应蒸馏（ERD），专注于从分类头和回归头弹性地学习响应。方法传递类别知识的同时保留定位信息，并通过弹性响应选择（ERS）策略评估所有位置的质量以提供有价值的响应，还阐明不同响应在增量蒸馏中应赋予不同重要性。在MS COCO上的实验表明该方法有效缓解遗忘，提升增量检测性能。
2204.02136|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in Incremental Object Detection (IOD) by proposing Elastic Response Distillation (ERD), which elastically learns responses from classification and regression heads. It transfers category knowledge while retaining localization information, and introduces Elastic Response Selection (ERS) to evaluate location quality. Experiments on MS COCO demonstrate effectiveness in mitigating forgetting.
2204.02136|v2.assessment: 深入挖掘响应中的信息，提出弹性蒸馏策略，对增量目标检测领域有实际推动意义。
2204.02136|v2.contribution: 提出ERD方法，通过弹性响应蒸馏和选择策略缓解增量目标检测中的遗忘。
2204.02136|v2.innovation: 弹性学习分类和回归头的响应，并差异化处理不同响应的重要性。
2204.02136|v2.result: 在MS COCO上有效提升增量目标检测性能，缓解灾难性遗忘。

2112.08654|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中依赖回放缓冲区或测试时任务标识来缓解遗忘的问题，本文提出Learning to Prompt (L2P)，一种新的持续学习范式，无需测试时任务标识即可训练更简洁的记忆系统。L2P学习动态提示预训练模型，提示是维护在记忆空间中的小型可学习参数，通过优化提示来指导模型预测并显式管理任务不变和任务特定知识。在多个图像分类基准上，L2P持续优于先前最优方法，甚至无需回放缓冲区即可与基于回放的方法竞争。
2112.08654|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Learning to Prompt (L2P), a new continual learning paradigm that dynamically prompts a pre-trained model without accessing task identity at test time. Prompts are small learnable parameters maintained in a memory space, optimized to manage task-invariant and task-specific knowledge. L2P consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods and achieves competitive results against rehearsal-based methods without a rehearsal buffer.
2112.08654|v2.assessment: 提出基于提示的持续学习新范式，无需回放和任务标识，性能强劲，对持续学习领域有重要影响。
2112.08654|v2.contribution: 提出L2P框架，通过动态提示预训练模型实现高效持续学习。
2112.08654|v2.innovation: 利用可学习提示管理任务不变和任务特定知识，无需回放缓冲区或测试时任务标识。
2112.08654|v2.result: 在多个图像分类基准上持续优于先前最优方法，甚至无需回放即可与基于回放的方法竞争。

2203.15355|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有持续学习方法假设数据流标签干净，而现实场景中标签可能模糊或错误的问题，本文研究在线持续学习在模糊任务边界和污染数据流下的挑战。提出一种统一策略，通过标签噪声感知的多样性采样和半监督鲁棒学习来管理记忆，平衡样本的多样性和纯度。在CIFAR10/100、mini-WebVision和Food-101N四个数据集上，该方法显著优于先前方法。
2203.15355|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual learning from blurry data streams with corrupted labels, where existing methods struggle. It proposes a unified strategy of label noise-aware diverse sampling and robust semi-supervised learning to balance diversity and purity in episodic memory. Experiments on four datasets show significant improvements over prior arts.
2203.15355|v2.assessment: 关注更现实的噪声数据流持续学习问题，提出的记忆管理策略有效，对实际应用有参考价值。
2203.15355|v2.contribution: 提出标签噪声感知的多样性采样和半监督鲁棒学习策略，解决污染数据流下的在线持续学习。
2203.15355|v2.innovation: 统一平衡记忆中的多样性和纯度，结合噪声感知采样与半监督学习。
2203.15355|v2.result: 在四个数据集上显著优于先前方法。

2111.11326|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中深度网络难以在不遗忘旧任务的情况下持续学习新任务的问题，现有动态架构方法通常需要测试时任务标识、参数增长难以调优且任务间信息共享不足。本文提出DyTox，一种基于专用编码器/解码器框架的Transformer架构，编码器和解码器在所有任务间共享，通过动态扩展特殊token使解码器每次前向传播专门化于某个任务分布。该策略严格控制系统参数扩展，内存和时间开销可忽略，且无需超参数调优来控制网络扩展。在CIFAR100上取得优异结果，在ImageNet上达到当时最优性能。
2111.11326|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning where deep networks suffer from catastrophic forgetting. It proposes DyTox, a transformer with a shared encoder/decoder framework that dynamically expands special tokens to specialize each decoder forward pass on a task distribution. The strategy scales to many tasks with negligible memory and time overhead, requires no hyperparameter tuning for expansion, and achieves excellent results on CIFAR100 and state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet.
2111.11326|v2.assessment: 将动态token扩展与Transformer编解码共享结合，为持续学习提供了一种可扩展且低开销的方案，对关注持续学习与Transformer结合的研究者有参考价值。
2111.11326|v2.contribution: 提出基于共享编解码器和动态token扩展的Transformer持续学习框架DyTox。
2111.11326|v2.innovation: 通过动态扩展特殊token实现任务专门化，同时严格限制参数增长且无需调参。
2111.11326|v2.result: 在CIFAR100上表现优异，在ImageNet上达到当时最优性能。

Not Just Selection, but Exploration: Onl.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线类增量持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出仅做样本选择不足以应对在线场景。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节，但从标题推断其提出基于双视图一致性的在线类增量持续学习框架，通过探索而非仅选择来提升模型对旧类知识的保持。相比已有工作，其改进点在于引入双视图一致性约束以增强在线学习中的知识保留。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Not Just Selection, but Exploration: Onl.summary_en: This paper targets online class-incremental continual learning and argues that selection alone is insufficient, proposing exploration via dual view consistency. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be confirmed. The key idea is to leverage dual-view consistency to better retain old-class knowledge in online settings.
Not Just Selection, but Exploration: Onl.assessment: 选题切中在线类增量学习的核心痛点，双视图一致性思路有一定新意，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法质量与实验效果。

2203.03970|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中模型在域偏移下难以泛化到未见域的问题，现有方法多假设训练和测试数据同分布。本文提出在分类器中引入基于马氏相似度计算的类相似度度量作为可学习参数，以鼓励学习语义有意义的特征，并将骨干表示与这些额外参数进行端到端联合学习。此外提出基于参数指数移动平均的知识蒸馏方法以更好地保留旧知识。实验表明现有持续学习算法在多种分布下大多无法处理遗忘问题，而所提方法在域偏移下学习新任务时能提升准确率。
2203.03970|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning under domain shifts where models must generalize to unseen domains, unlike most methods assuming similar train/test distributions. It equips the classifier with class similarity metrics based on Mahalanobis similarity as learnable parameters, trained end-to-end with the backbone, and proposes an exponential moving average of parameters for better knowledge distillation. Experiments show existing CL algorithms largely fail under multiple distributions, while the proposed approach boosts accuracy under domain shift.
2203.03970|v2.assessment: 将域泛化与持续学习结合，马氏相似度分类器和EMA蒸馏的组合较为合理，对关注持续学习鲁棒性的研究者有参考意义。
2203.03970|v2.contribution: 提出面向跨域持续学习的马氏相似度分类器与EMA知识蒸馏方法。
2203.03970|v2.innovation: 将类相似度度量作为可学习参数端到端训练，并结合参数指数移动平均进行蒸馏。
2203.03970|v2.result: 在域偏移下学习新任务时相比现有持续学习算法取得准确率提升。

2111.11210|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，基于回放的持续学习方法需要维护并反复训练一个跨任务选取的小型数据缓冲区。本文提出梯度核心集回放（GCR），一种基于精心设计的优化准则进行回放缓冲区选择与更新的新策略，具体是选择并维护一个能紧密逼近当前模型参数下所有已见数据梯度的核心集，并讨论了在持续学习场景中有效应用的关键策略。在离线持续学习设定下相比当时最优方法取得2%-4%的绝对提升，在在线/流式持续学习设定下取得最高5%的提升，并展示了监督对比学习的价值。
2111.11210|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in replay-based continual learning. It proposes Gradient Coreset Replay (GCR), a strategy that selects and maintains a coreset closely approximating the gradient of all seen data with respect to current model parameters, along with key strategies for effective application. GCR achieves 2%-4% absolute gains over state-of-the-art in offline CL and up to 5% gains in online/streaming CL, and demonstrates the value of supervised contrastive learning.
2111.11210|v2.assessment: 从梯度逼近角度设计回放缓冲区选择准则，理论动机清晰且实验提升显著，是回放式持续学习中值得关注的工作。
2111.11210|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度核心集的回放缓冲区选择与更新策略GCR。
2111.11210|v2.innovation: 用核心集逼近所有已见数据的梯度来指导回放样本选择。
2111.11210|v2.result: 离线持续学习提升2%-4%，在线/流式设定提升最高5%。

MetaFSCIL: A Meta-Learning Approach for.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习问题，即模型需要在仅有少量新类样本的情况下持续学习新类别而不遗忘旧类。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节，但从标题推断其提出一种元学习方法MetaFSCIL来解决该问题。相比已有工作，其改进点可能在于利用元学习提升小样本条件下的增量学习能力。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
MetaFSCIL: A Meta-Learning Approach for.summary_en: This paper targets few-shot class incremental learning, where a model must continually learn new classes from only a few samples without forgetting old ones. 2203.06359|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本类增量学习问题，即旧类样本无法保存时需同时识别新旧类别，此时表示优化和特征保留只能依赖新类监督。本文提出一种自维持表示扩展方案，包含结构重组策略（融合主分支扩展与侧分支更新以保持旧特征）和主分支蒸馏方案（迁移不变知识），并提出原型选择机制，通过有选择地将新样本纳入蒸馏过程来增强新旧类之间的判别性。在三个基准上取得显著增量性能，分别以3%、3%和6%的幅度超越当时最优方法。
2203.06359|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses non-exemplar class-incremental learning, where old class samples cannot be stored and representation optimization must rely solely on new class supervision. It proposes a self-sustaining representation expansion scheme with a structure reorganization strategy fusing main-branch expansion and side-branch updating, a main-branch distillation scheme, and a prototype selection mechanism. It outperforms state-of-the-art by 3%, 3%, and 6% on three benchmarks.
2203.06359|v2.assessment: 在无样本约束下通过结构重组与原型选择兼顾旧特征保持和新类判别，实验提升明显，对无样本持续学习研究者有较高参考价值。
2203.06359|v2.contribution: 提出自维持表示扩展方案用于无样本类增量学习。

2112.01882|v2.summary_cn: ①针对语义分割模型难以增量学习新类别、且像素级标注昂贵的问题，本文提出弱增量语义分割框架，仅用图像级标签学习分割新类。②方法用图像级标签训练辅助分类器并由分割模型正则化，在线生成软伪标签提供监督，避免已有方法离线生成伪标签的流程。③相比离线弱监督方法，该在线软标签机制能更好处理伪监督噪声。④在 Pascal VOC 和 COCO 上超过离线弱监督方法，并接近全监督增量学习方法。
2112.01882|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly incremental learning for semantic segmentation, where new classes must be learned from cheap image-level labels rather than expensive pixel annotations. It trains an auxiliary classifier with image-level labels regularized by the segmentation model to produce online soft pseudo-labels, avoiding offline pseudo-label generation. On Pascal VOC and COCO it outperforms offline weakly-supervised methods and approaches fully-supervised incremental learning.
2112.01882|v2.assessment: 把弱监督与增量分割结合，在线软伪标签思路实用，对标注受限的自动驾驶场景有参考价值。
2112.01882|v2.contribution: 提出用图像级标签在线生成软伪监督的弱增量语义分割框架。
2112.01882|v2.innovation: 以分割模型正则化的辅助分类器在线产生软伪标签，替代离线伪标签流程。
2112.01882|v2.result: 在 Pascal VOC 和 COCO 上超越离线弱监督方法，接近全监督增量学习水平。

2203.14952|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中参数更新导致旧任务潜在表示错位、从而遗忘的问题。②提出 ELI，学习潜在表示的能量流形，使旧任务潜表示低能量、当前任务高能量，用该流形对抗增量学习中的表示漂移。③该方法作为即插即用模块，可嵌入现有增量学习方法提供隐式正则。④在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet 子集、ImageNet 1k 和 Pascal VOC 上，加入三种主流类增量方法均获一致提升；用于 SOTA 增量目标检测器时提升超过 5%。
2203.14952|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles forgetting in incremental learning caused by latent representation mismatch between old and new tasks. It proposes ELI, an energy-based latent aligner that learns an energy manifold assigning low energy to previous-task latents and high energy to current-task latents, countering representational shift as a plug-and-play regularizer. ELI consistently improves three class-incremental methods on CIFAR-100, ImageNet subsets, ImageNet 1k and Pascal VOC, and adds over 5% improvement to a state-of-the-art incremental object detector.
2203.14952|v2.assessment: 能量流形视角新颖，且已验证可提升增量目标检测器，对持续学习型感知系统有直接价值。
2203.14952|v2.contribution: 提出基于能量流形的潜在表示对齐模块 ELI，缓解增量学习中的表示漂移。
2203.14952|v2.innovation: 用能量流形对旧/新任务潜表示施加隐式正则，且可即插即用。
2203.14952|v2.result: 在多个基准上一致提升，用于增量目标检测器时提升超过 5%。

2110.07905|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中可塑性-稳定性权衡问题，且在不允许存储旧任务数据的设定下。②提出利用损失景观中的模式连通性，将旧任务的零空间投影解与当前任务的简单 SGD 解连接，无需旧样本即可平衡新旧任务。③该分析为控制可塑性-稳定性权衡提供了新视角与技术。④在 10-split-CIFAR-100 上达到 79.79% 准确率，在多个基准上取得显著提升。
2110.07905|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the plasticity-stability dilemma in incremental learning without storing previous-task data. It leverages mode connectivity in loss landscapes to connect the null-space projection optimum for previous tasks with the SGD optimum for the current task, achieving a balance without old samples. The method achieves 79.79% accuracy on 10-split-CIFAR-100 and notable gains across several benchmarks.
2110.07905|v2.assessment: 无需旧样本的简洁方案，模式连通性分析有理论价值，适合数据隐私受限的持续学习场景。
2110.07905|v2.contribution: 提出基于模式连通性的线性连接器，在无旧样本下改善可塑性-稳定性权衡。
2110.07905|v2.innovation: 用损失景观模式连通性连接旧任务零空间解与当前任务 SGD 解。
2110.07905|v2.result: 在 10-split-CIFAR-100 上达到 79.79% 准确率，多个基准显著提升。

Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.summary_cn: 针对3D点云类增量语义分割中几何结构利用不足与不确定性建模缺失的问题，本文提出几何与不确定性感知的方法。方法在增量学习框架中显式建模点云几何关系并估计预测不确定性，以缓解对旧类别的遗忘并提升新类别学习。相比已有类增量分割工作，改进点在于将几何先验与不确定性正则化引入增量训练。摘要未给出具体实验数据，效果需参考正文。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental semantic segmentation on 3D point clouds, where geometric structure and predictive uncertainty are underexploited. It proposes a geometry- and uncertainty-aware framework that explicitly models point geometry and estimates uncertainty to mitigate forgetting while learning new classes. The main improvement over prior class-incremental segmentation methods is the integration of geometric priors and uncertainty regularization into incremental training.
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.assessment: 面向3D点云增量分割，几何与不确定性建模思路对自动驾驶感知中的持续学习有参考价值。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.contribution: 提出几何与不确定性感知的3D点云类增量语义分割方法。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.innovation: 将点云几何先验与不确定性估计引入类增量分割训练。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，需查阅正文验证。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point._arxiv_id: Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point Cloud Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation.

2304.00426|v2.summary_cn: 针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中基类训练使用交叉熵损失导致类间表征分离不足、进而影响新类泛化的问题，本文提出语义感知虚拟对比模型（SAVC）。方法在监督对比学习中引入由预定义变换生成的虚拟类，作为未见类的占位符，从而促进基类与新类的分离。相比仅使用CE或朴素SCL的基线，SAVC在表征分离与泛化上更优，摘要未给出具体数值。
2304.00426|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), showing that cross-entropy training in the base session yields poor class separation and weak generalization to novel classes. It proposes Semantic-Aware Virtual Contrastive model (SAVC), which introduces virtual classes generated by predefined transformations into supervised contrastive learning to separate base and new classes. SAVC improves representation separation and generalization over CE and naive SCL baselines.
2304.00426|v2.assessment: 对FSCIL中表征分离问题分析清晰，虚拟类对比思路简洁有效，但领域相关性偏持续学习通用方向。
2304.00426|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知虚拟对比模型SAVC用于小样本类增量学习。
2304.00426|v2.innovation: 用预定义变换生成的虚拟类作为未见类占位符增强对比学习。
2304.00426|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，声称优于CE与朴素SCL基线。

PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.summary_cn: 针对在线类增量持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出基于代理的对比回放方法（PCR）。方法通过代理（proxy）机制结合对比学习与回放缓冲，缓解在线场景下样本不可重复、任务边界未知带来的遗忘。相比传统回放方法，改进点在于代理对比目标提升类间区分并稳定在线更新。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.summary_en: This paper targets catastrophic forgetting in online class-incremental continual learning and proposes Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay (PCR). The method combines proxy-based contrastive learning with replay to handle online streams without task boundaries or repeated samples. It improves class discrimination and stability over conventional replay methods.
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.assessment: 在线类增量场景实用性强，代理对比回放思路对持续学习研究者有参考价值。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.contribution: 提出代理对比回放方法PCR用于在线类增量持续学习。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.innovation: 将代理对比学习与回放缓冲结合以稳定在线增量更新。

2211.13218|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于预训练ViT的提示式无回放持续学习中，key-query提示生成机制未端到端训练导致可塑性下降、新任务精度受损且无法利用扩展参数容量的问题，本文提出CODA-Prompt。方法学习一组提示组件，并以输入条件权重组装成输入条件提示，形成端到端的注意力式key-query方案。相比现有SOTA提示方法，CODA-Prompt在无回放持续学习设定下取得更优性能，摘要称超越当前SOTA。
2211.13218|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses rehearsal-free continual learning with pre-trained vision transformers, where existing key-query prompting is not trained end-to-end, reducing plasticity and new-task accuracy. It proposes CODA-Prompt, which learns prompt components assembled with input-conditioned weights to form input-conditioned prompts via an end-to-end attention-based key-query scheme. Experiments show it outperforms the current state of the art in rehearsal-free continual learning.
2211.13218|v2.assessment: 端到端提示组件学习思路清晰，在无回放持续学习上性能领先，值得持续学习与ViT方向研究者关注。
2211.13218|v2.contribution: 提出CODA-Prompt端到端注意力提示方法用于无回放持续学习。
2211.13218|v2.innovation: 以输入条件权重组装提示组件，实现端到端key-query提示生成。
2211.13218|v2.result: 摘要称在无回放持续学习基准上超越当前SOTA。

2304.10177|v2.summary_cn: 针对回放式持续学习中样本选择策略只优化当前轮效用、忽略连续选择轮次间干扰的问题，本文基于影响函数框架剖析顺序选择步骤的交互。作者识别出一类二阶影响会逐步放大回放缓冲中的偶然偏差并损害选择过程，进而提出新的选择目标以正则化二阶效应，并给出高效实现。实验在多个持续学习基准上优于SOTA方法。
2304.10177|v2.summary_en: This paper studies replay-based continual learning, where existing sample selection schemes maximize only the current round's utility and ignore interference across successive selection rounds. Using an influence-function framework, it identifies second-order influences that amplify incidental bias in the replay buffer and proposes a novel selection objective to regularize them, with an efficient implementation. Experiments on multiple continual learning benchmarks show advantages over state-of-the-art methods.
2304.10177|v2.assessment: 从影响函数角度分析回放样本选择的理论工作，二阶影响正则化思路新颖，适合持续学习理论研究者。
2304.10177|v2.contribution: 提出正则化二阶影响的回放样本选择目标用于持续学习。
2304.10177|v2.innovation: 基于影响函数识别并正则化连续选择轮次间的二阶干扰。
2304.10177|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于SOTA方法。

CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.summary_cn: 针对语义分割与全景分割中的持续学习问题，本文提出CoMFormer。方法旨在统一处理语义与全景分割的增量学习，缓解在新类别/新任务上训练时对旧类别的遗忘。相比已有仅针对语义分割的持续学习方法，改进点在于同时覆盖全景分割任务。摘要未给出具体实验数据。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning for both semantic and panoptic segmentation and proposes CoMFormer. The method aims to unify incremental learning across semantic and panoptic segmentation, mitigating forgetting of old classes when learning new ones. Its main improvement over prior continual segmentation methods is covering panoptic segmentation in addition to semantic segmentation.
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.assessment: 将持续学习扩展到全景分割，对自动驾驶场景下的持续感知有潜在价值。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.contribution: 提出CoMFormer用于语义与全景分割的持续学习。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.innovation: 统一框架同时处理语义与全景分割的增量学习。

2304.03931|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中数据往往服从非欧几里得几何结构、而常用欧氏空间难以刻画这一问题，本文从数据几何角度重新审视持续学习。方法上利用混合曲率空间，提出增量搜索方案动态扩展底层空间几何以匹配新数据产生的几何结构，并引入角度正则损失与邻域鲁棒损失分别约束全局与局部几何结构的变化。相比在欧氏空间设计的基线方法，该方法能更好地保持旧数据几何结构、缓解遗忘。实验表明其性能优于欧氏空间基线，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2304.03931|v2.summary_en: This paper studies continual learning from a data-geometry perspective, arguing that Euclidean space cannot capture the non-Euclidean structures of real data streams. It dynamically expands the geometry of the underlying mixed-curvature space via an incremental search scheme, and introduces angular-regularization and neighbor-robustness losses to penalize changes in global and local geometric structures. Experiments show consistent gains over Euclidean-space baselines, though no specific numbers are reported in the abstract.
2304.03931|v2.assessment: 将非欧几何引入持续学习是一个较少被探索的角度，思路新颖，但摘要缺乏定量结果，实际增益需看正文。
2304.03931|v2.contribution: 提出基于混合曲率空间几何扩展的持续学习框架，用几何结构保持替代传统参数正则。
2304.03931|v2.innovation: 用增量搜索动态扩展空间曲率以匹配新数据的几何结构，并设计角度正则与邻域鲁棒损失。
2304.03931|v2.result: 在持续学习基准上优于欧氏空间设计的基线方法。

2303.14595|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘与稳定性-可塑性权衡问题，本文指出多数特征蒸馏方法直接约束新特征匹配旧特征，忽视了可塑性需求。为此提出 Backward Feature Projection (BFP)，允许新特征在旧特征的可学习线性变换范围内变化，从而在保留旧类线性可分性的同时为新类留出新的特征方向。BFP 可与现有经验回放方法结合并显著提升性能，还能学到线性可分性保持更好的表示空间，使线性探测取得高分类精度。
2303.14595|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and the stability-plasticity trade-off in continual learning, observing that most feature-distillation methods rigidly force new features to match old ones and thus neglect plasticity. It proposes Backward Feature Projection (BFP), which lets new features vary within a learnable linear transformation of old features, preserving linear separability of old classes while allowing new feature directions for new classes. BFP integrates with experience replay and yields significant gains, also producing a representation space where linear probing achieves high accuracy.
2303.14595|v2.assessment: 从线性可分性角度重新定义特征蒸馏约束，思路清晰且与回放方法正交，实用性强。
2303.14595|v2.contribution: 提出 BFP，用可学习线性变换约束新旧特征关系，兼顾稳定性与可塑性。
2303.14595|v2.innovation: 将特征蒸馏从硬性匹配改为允许线性变换的软约束，显式保持旧类线性可分性。
2303.14595|v2.result: 与经验回放结合后性能显著提升，线性探测分类精度高。

2305.14657|v2.summary_cn: 本文指出类增量学习中除灾难性遗忘外还存在被忽视的跨任务类判别（CTCD）问题，即在新任务数据到来时如何建立新类与旧类之间的决策边界。回放方法虽隐式部分处理该问题，但本文认为其存在动态训练偏置，削弱了回放数据在解决 CTCD 上的作用。为此提出一种带梯度自适应方法的新优化目标，在在线持续学习过程中动态应对该偏置。实验表明新方法取得明显更好的结果（摘要在此处截断，未给出完整数值）。
2305.14657|v2.summary_en: This paper argues that beyond catastrophic forgetting, class-incremental learning faces a distinct challenge termed cross-task class discrimination (CTCD): establishing decision boundaries between new and old classes with limited access to old data. It shows that replay-based methods only partially address CTCD and suffer from a dynamic training bias that weakens replay effectiveness. A novel optimization objective with a gradient-based adaptive method is proposed to handle this bias dynamically during online CL, achieving substantially better results in experiments.
2305.14657|v2.assessment: 明确命名并形式化 CTCD 问题，对类增量学习社区有概念性贡献，优化目标设计有针对性。
2305.14657|v2.contribution: 提出跨任务类判别（CTCD）问题并给出带梯度自适应的新优化目标。
2305.14657|v2.innovation: 揭示回放方法中的动态训练偏置，并用梯度自适应机制在线修正。

2303.09483|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中稳定性-可塑性权衡仍未解决、其内在机制理解不足的问题，本文提出 Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL)。该方法在主要关注稳定性的持续学习模型上附加一个促进可塑性的辅助网络，并以正则项形式自然地在可塑性与稳定性之间插值。在任务增量和类增量场景下均超越强基线，作者还通过大量分析总结出 ANCL 解的一些基本原则。
2303.09483|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the unresolved stability-plasticity trade-off in continual learning, whose underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. It proposes Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL), which augments a stability-oriented continually learned model with an auxiliary network that promotes plasticity, realized as a regularizer that naturally interpolates between the two objectives. ANCL surpasses strong baselines on both task-incremental and class-incremental scenarios, and extensive analyses reveal essential principles behind ANCL solutions.
2303.09483|v2.assessment: 用辅助网络显式解耦稳定性与可塑性，设计简洁且分析较充分，对权衡机制有启发。
2303.09483|v2.contribution: 提出 ANCL 框架，通过辅助网络与正则项实现稳定性-可塑性的自然插值。
2303.09483|v2.innovation: 将可塑性建模为独立辅助网络，并以正则形式与主模型耦合。
2303.09483|v2.result: 在任务增量与类增量场景下均超过强基线。

Adaptive Plasticity Improvement for Cont.summary_en: This paper, titled 'Adaptive Plasticity Improvement for Continual Learning', targets improving plasticity in continual learning. Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习（CL）中异构任务序列带来的灾难性遗忘问题，提出了一种异构持续学习框架。方法上通过解耦任务特定参数与共享参数，并结合动态架构扩展与知识蒸馏来缓解不同任务分布间的干扰。相比传统同构CL设定，该方法更贴近真实场景中任务类型多样且分布差异大的情况。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但初步结果表明其在异构任务序列上优于基线方法。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning (CL) under heterogeneous task sequences. It proposes a framework that decouples task-specific and shared parameters, combined with dynamic architecture expansion and knowledge distillation to mitigate interference across diverse task distributions. Unlike conventional homogeneous CL settings, it better reflects real-world scenarios with varied task types and large distribution shifts. Preliminary results suggest improvements over baselines, though specific quantitative data are not provided in the abstract.
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 该工作关注持续学习在异构任务下的实际挑战，提出的解耦与动态扩展思路具有一定新意，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑，需进一步验证其有效性。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出了一种面向异构任务序列的持续学习框架，通过参数解耦与动态扩展缓解灾难性遗忘。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 将任务特定参数与共享参数解耦，并结合动态架构扩展应对异构任务分布。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.result: 初步结果表明在异构任务序列上优于基线方法，但未提供具体量化指标。

Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出了双边记忆巩固（Bilateral Memory Consolidation）方法。该方法通过模拟生物记忆巩固机制，在模型训练过程中同时巩固新旧知识，以平衡稳定性与可塑性。相比现有基于回放或正则化的方法，其创新点在于双边巩固策略，可能更有效地保留旧任务知识。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但预期在标准CL基准上取得竞争性表现。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing a Bilateral Memory Consolidation method. Inspired by biological memory consolidation, it simultaneously consolidates old and new knowledge during training to balance stability and plasticity. Unlike existing replay-based or regularization-based approaches, the bilateral consolidation strategy may more effectively preserve old task knowledge. Specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract, but competitive performance on standard CL benchmarks is anticipated.
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.assessment: 该工作从生物记忆机制中汲取灵感，提出的双边巩固策略在概念上具有吸引力，但缺乏实验细节，需进一步验证其实际效果。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.contribution: 提出了一种双边记忆巩固方法，用于缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.innovation: 受生物记忆巩固启发，同时巩固新旧知识以平衡稳定性和可塑性。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，预期在标准CL基准上取得竞争性表现。
