2106.10456|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签质量不足的问题，本文在teacher-student框架下提出改进方法：采用指数移动平均在线更新teacher，使用大量region proposals和软伪标签作为student训练目标，并设计轻量级检测专用数据集成让teacher生成更可靠的伪标签。相比STAC仅对稀疏选出的困难伪样本使用硬标签，本方法让teacher通过软标签在大量proposal上向student传递更丰富的信息。在VOC07 val上达到53.04% AP，比STAC高8.4%；在MS-COCO test-dev上以与标注数据相当规模的无标注数据达到53.8% AP，比全监督ResNet-152 Cascaded R-CNN高3.1%。
2106.10456|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised object detection by improving pseudo-label quality within a teacher-student framework. It employs exponential moving averaging to update the teacher online, uses abundant region proposals with soft pseudo-labels as student targets, and introduces a lightweight detection-specific data ensemble for more reliable teacher predictions. Compared to STAC which uses hard labels on sparse hard samples, the teacher exposes richer soft-label information over many proposals. It achieves 53.04% AP on VOC07 val (8.4% over STAC) and 53.8% AP on MS-COCO test-dev (+3.1% over fully supervised ResNet-152 Cascaded R-CNN).
2106.10456|v2.assessment: 软伪标签+数据集成在半监督检测中效果显著，方法简洁且实验充分，对半监督感知研究有较强参考价值。
2106.10456|v2.contribution: 提出基于软伪标签和检测专用数据集的teacher-student半监督目标检测框架。
2106.10456|v2.innovation: 用大量proposal上的软伪标签替代稀疏硬标签，并引入轻量检测专用数据集成提升伪标签可靠性。
2106.10456|v2.result: VOC07 val达53.04% AP（超STAC 8.4%），MS-COCO test-dev达53.8% AP（超全监督基线3.1%）。

2107.04384|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度网络持续学习中灾难性遗忘的理论成因不清的问题，本文将teacher-student分析框架从单teacher扩展到多teacher，每个teacher代表一个不同任务，研究任务间关系如何影响student在任务切换时的遗忘与迁移。研究发现特征相似的任务在中等相似度时遗忘最严重，并进一步将任务相似性解耦为readout层（隐层到输出权重）和特征层（输入到隐层权重）两个层面。该工作为持续学习中的任务干扰提供了理论解释，但摘要未给出具体实验数据。
2107.04384|v2.summary_en: This paper studies continual learning in the teacher-student setup to understand catastrophic forgetting theoretically. It extends prior two-layer network analysis to multiple teachers, each representing a task, and investigates how task relationships affect forgetting and transfer. It disentangles task similarity at the readout and feature levels, finding that intermediate feature similarity causes greatest forgetting. The work provides theoretical insights but the abstract lacks concrete experimental numbers.
2107.04384|v2.assessment: 理论分析视角有价值，但偏理论且与视觉感知应用距离较远，对自动驾驶检测方向参考有限。
2107.04384|v2.contribution: 将teacher-student持续学习分析扩展到多teacher设定并解耦任务相似性来源。
2107.04384|v2.innovation: 从readout和feature两个层面分离任务相似性对遗忘的影响。
2107.04384|v2.result: 发现特征相似任务在中等相似度时遗忘最严重，提供理论解释但无具体量化结果。

2110.12724|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中不同位置表征对检测目标贡献不同、导致蒸馏难以平衡的问题，本文提出条件蒸馏框架，引入可学习的条件解码模块，以每个目标实例为query检索teacher表征作为key，通过query-key注意力衡量不同特征的贡献，并由定位-识别敏感的辅助任务引导。实验表明该方法在多种设定下均有显著提升，将ResNet-50骨干的RetinaNet从37.4 mAP提升至40.7 mAP（+3.3），甚至超过ResNet-101骨干、3x schedule的teacher（40.4 mAP）。
2110.12724|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the imbalance in detection knowledge distillation caused by varying contributions of different spatial representations. It proposes a conditional distillation framework with a learnable conditional decoding module that uses each target instance as query and teacher representations as key, measuring feature contributions via attention guided by a localization-recognition-sensitive auxiliary task. It boosts RetinaNet with ResNet-50 from 37.4 to 40.7 mAP (+3.3), surpassing the ResNet-101 teacher (40.4 mAP) under 3x schedule.
2110.12724|v2.assessment: 实例条件化的注意力蒸馏思路新颖，student超越teacher的结果有说服力，对检测模型压缩与知识迁移有实用价值。
2110.12724|v2.contribution: 提出以目标实例为条件的检测知识蒸馏框架。
2110.12724|v2.innovation: 用可学习条件解码模块和query-key注意力按实例检索并加权teacher知识。
2110.12724|v2.result: RetinaNet ResNet-50从37.4提升至40.7 mAP，超过ResNet-101 teacher的40.4 mAP。

2201.10207|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对语音预训练中训练成本高和噪声鲁棒性差的问题，提出了SPIRAL方法，在教师-学生框架下学习扰动数据的去噪表示。具体地，教师网络处理原始语音，学生网络处理扰动后的语音，通过 utterance 内对比损失和位置随机化防止表示坍缩，教师权重为学生权重的移动平均。相比wav2vec 2.0，SPIRAL在BASE和LARGE模型上分别减少80%和65%的训练成本，并取得相当或更好的结果；通过多条件预训练（添加多种噪声）进一步提升了噪声鲁棒性。
2201.10207|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high training cost and noise robustness in speech pre-training by proposing SPIRAL, a teacher-student framework that learns denoising representations of perturbed data. The teacher processes the original utterance, while the student processes a perturbed version, trained with an in-utterance contrastive loss and position randomization to prevent collapse. SPIRAL reduces training cost by 80% (BASE) and 65% (LARGE) compared to wav2vec 2.0 while achieving competitive or better results, and multi-condition pre-training with additive noise improves noise robustness.
2201.10207|v2.assessment: 该工作虽在语音领域，但其自监督对比学习与教师-学生框架对视觉自监督学习有参考价值，但与自动驾驶视觉感知的直接关联较弱。
2201.10207|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于扰动不变性自监督学习的语音预训练方法SPIRAL，显著降低了训练成本并提升了噪声鲁棒性。
2201.10207|v2.innovation: 结合 utterance 内对比损失、位置随机化和教师权重移动平均，在教师-学生框架下实现高效去噪表示学习。
2201.10207|v2.result: 相比wav2vec 2.0，训练成本降低80%（BASE）和65%（LARGE），并取得相当或更好的性能。

2205.15156|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测器计算开销大的问题，探索知识蒸馏（KD）在高效3D检测器中的应用，聚焦于pillar和voxel基检测器。作者首先从模型压缩和输入分辨率降低角度构建了六个教师-学生对，并建立基准评估2D KD方法在3D检测上的表现；进而提出改进的KD流程，包括仅在教师分类响应关键的少数位置进行logit KD，以及教师引导的学生模型初始化以继承特征提取能力。在Waymo数据集上，最佳模型达到65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH，超过教师模型且仅需44%的计算量。
2205.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation of advanced 3D object detectors by exploring knowledge distillation (KD) for efficient pillar- and voxel-based detectors. It first constructs six teacher-student pairs via model compression and input resolution reduction, benchmarks existing 2D KD methods on 3D detection, and proposes an improved KD pipeline with enhanced logit KD on pivotal positions and teacher-guided student initialization. On Waymo, the best model achieves 65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH, surpassing its teacher while requiring only 44% of the computation.
2205.15156|v2.assessment: 该工作系统地将知识蒸馏引入3D检测，提出的改进KD策略有效且实验充分，对自动驾驶感知中的高效模型部署有直接参考价值。
2205.15156|v2.contribution: 构建了3D检测知识蒸馏基准，并提出改进的KD流程，实现了高效且超越教师的3D检测器。
2205.15156|v2.innovation: 提出基于教师分类响应的关键位置logit KD和教师引导的学生初始化，有效迁移特征提取能力。
2205.15156|v2.result: 在Waymo上达到65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH，超过教师模型且仅需44%计算量。

2210.04208|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单模态点云表示学习的瓶颈，提出点云跨模态训练（PointCMT）策略，利用视图图像（渲染或投影的2D图像）提升点云分析。方法采用教师-学生框架，将跨模态学习建模为知识蒸馏问题，通过新颖的特征和分类器增强准则消除模态分布差异，避免负迁移。PointCMT无需修改网络架构即可有效提升纯点云表示，在多个数据集和主流骨干网络上取得显著增益。
2210.04208|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the bottleneck of single-modality point cloud representation learning by proposing Point Cloud Cross-Modal Training (PointCMT), which leverages view images (rendered or projected 2D images) to boost point cloud analysis. It employs a teacher-student framework and formulates cross-modal learning as knowledge distillation, with novel feature and classifier enhancement criteria to eliminate modality discrepancy and avoid negative transfer. PointCMT improves point-only representations without architecture modification, achieving significant gains on various datasets and backbones.
2210.04208|v2.assessment: 该工作为点云分析提供了有效的跨模态蒸馏方案，虽不直接针对自动驾驶检测，但其多模态融合思路对3D感知有借鉴意义。
2210.04208|v2.contribution: 提出PointCMT策略，通过视图图像跨模态蒸馏提升点云表示学习。
2210.04208|v2.innovation: 将跨模态学习建模为知识蒸馏，并设计特征与分类器增强准则以消除模态差异。
2210.04208|v2.result: 在多个数据集和骨干网络上取得显著性能提升，且无需修改网络架构。

2208.12262|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP类视觉-语言对比预训练只关注全局文本相关表示、缺乏局部patch语义监督的问题，本文提出MaskCLIP框架，将掩码自蒸馏引入对比语言-图像预训练：以完整图像表示蒸馏掩码图像预测表示，从而在语言间接监督下学习局部语义，并对称地在文本分支引入局部语义监督。相比已有CLIP类方法，掩码自蒸馏与视觉-语言对比在训练目标上一致且互补，可同时提升全局与局部表示。在多种下游任务上，MaskCLIP在线性探测、微调等设置下均取得更优结果。
2208.12262|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of CLIP-style contrastive language-image pretraining in learning local patch semantics by proposing MaskCLIP, which integrates masked self-distillation that distills full-image representations into predictions from masked images. The masked self-distillation is complementary to vision-language contrastive learning and receives indirect language supervision for local semantics, with symmetric local semantic supervision also applied to the text branch. Extensive experiments show MaskCLIP achieves superior results on various downstream tasks including linear probing and fine-tuning.
2208.12262|v2.assessment: 将掩码自蒸馏与视觉-语言对比预训练有机结合，思路简洁且对多模态与自监督视觉研究者均有参考价值。
2208.12262|v2.contribution: 提出MaskCLIP，把掩码自蒸馏引入对比语言-图像预训练以增强局部语义表示。
2208.12262|v2.innovation: 利用掩码自蒸馏与视觉-语言对比在训练目标上的一致性，实现语言间接监督下的局部语义学习。
2208.12262|v2.result: 在多种下游任务的线性探测与微调上取得优于已有方法的性能。

2302.14250|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱增量语义分割（WILSS）中图像级标签无法提供定位细节、且需避免遗忘旧类的问题，本文提出数据高效的FMWISS框架。方法通过基于预训练的协同分割蒸馏互补基础模型知识以生成稠密伪标签，再用教师-学生架构配合稠密对比损失优化噪声伪掩码，并引入基于记忆的复制粘贴增强缓解灾难性遗忘。相比已有WILSS方法，该框架更充分地利用了基础模型与图像级监督，在弱监督增量分割上取得更优表现。
2302.14250|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles weakly incremental learning for semantic segmentation (WILSS), where image-level labels lack localization details and old classes must not be forgotten. It proposes FMWISS, a data-efficient framework that distills complementary foundation models via pre-training-based co-segmentation to generate dense pseudo labels, refines noisy pseudo masks with a teacher-student architecture and dense contrastive loss, and uses memory-based copy-paste augmentation to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. The approach improves over prior WILSS methods.
2302.14250|v2.assessment: 将基础模型知识蒸馏与增量学习结合，为弱监督增量分割提供了数据高效的新范式。
2302.14250|v2.contribution: 提出FMWISS框架，利用基础模型协同分割与教师-学生优化实现弱增量语义分割。
2302.14250|v2.innovation: 通过预训练协同分割蒸馏互补基础模型生成稠密伪标签，并用稠密对比损失优化噪声掩码。
2302.14250|v2.result: 在弱增量语义分割任务上取得优于已有方法的分割性能。

2311.13930|v2.summary_cn: 针对无源域目标检测（SFOD）中均值教师自训练范式因域偏移导致教师模型崩溃、学生性能急剧下降的训练不稳定问题，本文提出周期性交换教师-学生（PETS）方法。该方法构建包含静态教师、动态教师和学生的多教师框架，训练中周期性交换静态教师与学生权重，并用已交换学生的移动平均更新动态教师，使动态教师整合历史知识。相比单教师均值教师范式，PETS有效减少误差累积，在SFOD基准上获得更稳定的训练与更优的检测性能。
2311.13930|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the training instability of mean-teacher self-training in source-free object detection (SFOD), where teacher collapse under domain shift degrades the student. It proposes Periodically Exchange Teacher-Student (PETS), a multiple-teacher framework with a static teacher, a dynamic teacher, and a student, where weights are periodically exchanged between the static teacher and student, and the dynamic teacher is updated as a moving average of the exchanged student. PETS reduces error accumulation and yields more stable training and better detection performance on SFOD benchmarks.
2311.13930|v2.assessment: 多教师权重交换机制简单有效，对域自适应检测与自训练稳定性研究有直接参考意义。
2311.13930|v2.contribution: 提出PETS多教师框架，通过周期性交换教师-学生权重稳定无源域目标检测的自训练。
2311.13930|v2.innovation: 引入静态教师与动态教师并周期性交换权重，使动态教师整合历史知识以抑制误差累积。
2311.13930|v2.result: 在无源域目标检测基准上实现更稳定的训练和更优的检测精度。

Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应目标检测中教师-学生自训练易受域偏移影响、伪标签噪声累积的问题，提出掩码重训练（Masked Retraining）教师-学生框架。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其通过掩码重训练策略增强教师-学生框架的鲁棒性，以提升跨域检测性能。该工作属于域自适应目标检测方向，对相关研究者有一定参考价值。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.summary_en: This paper targets domain adaptive object detection, where teacher-student self-training suffers from domain shift and noisy pseudo labels. It proposes a Masked Retraining teacher-student framework, though the abstract is missing so method details cannot be confirmed. The work is relevant to researchers in domain adaptive detection.
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.assessment: 标题指向域自适应检测中的教师-学生改进，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法与效果。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.contribution: 提出掩码重训练教师-学生框架用于域自适应目标检测。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.innovation: 通过掩码重训练策略增强教师-学生自训练在跨域场景下的鲁棒性。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew._arxiv_id: Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framework for Domain Adaptive Object Detection.

2308.00398|v2.summary_cn: 针对端到端自动驾驶教师-学生范式中学生模型仍需从零学习规划头、受原始传感器噪声与行为克隆因果混淆困扰的问题，本文提出DriveAdapter，探索直接采用强教师模型进行规划、让学生模型专注于感知部分。方法通过适配器解耦感知与规划，使学生无需从头学习规划头，从而缓解原始输入冗余噪声与因果混淆。实验表明该方法在保持甚至提升规划性能的同时显著降低了对学生规划能力的要求。
2308.00398|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge in end-to-end autonomous driving teacher-student paradigms where the student must still learn a planning head from scratch under noisy raw sensor inputs and causal confusion in behavior cloning. It proposes DriveAdapter, which lets the strong teacher model conduct planning while the student focuses on perception, decoupling perception and planning via adapters. Experiments show improved planning performance while reducing the burden on the student's planning capability.
2308.00398|v2.assessment: 直击端到端自动驾驶中感知-规划耦合的核心痛点，对自动驾驶感知与规划研究者均有较高参考价值。
2308.00398|v2.contribution: 提出DriveAdapter，通过适配器解耦感知与规划，让学生模型专注感知而由教师负责规划。
2308.00398|v2.innovation: 打破教师-学生范式中感知与规划的耦合，避免学生从零学习规划头。
2308.00398|v2.result: 在端到端自动驾驶基准上保持或提升规划性能并降低学生规划学习难度。

TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线签名验证（Online Signature Verification）任务，提出TSOSVNet教师-学生协同知识蒸馏方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其利用教师-学生协同蒸馏提升签名验证性能。该工作属于知识蒸馏与生物特征验证交叉方向，与自动驾驶感知、3D检测等目标领域相关度较低。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.summary_en: This paper targets online signature verification and proposes TSOSVNet, a teacher-student collaborative knowledge distillation method. The abstract is missing, so method details cannot be confirmed. The work lies at the intersection of knowledge distillation and biometric verification, with low relevance to autonomous driving perception and 3D detection.
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.assessment: 属于知识蒸馏在生物特征验证中的应用，与用户关注的自动驾驶感知方向相关度低。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.contribution: 提出TSOSVNet教师-学生协同知识蒸馏方法用于在线签名验证。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.innovation: 将教师-学生协同蒸馏引入在线签名验证任务。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative._arxiv_id: TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative knowledge distillation for Online Signature Verification.

2506.07087|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督伪装目标检测（UCOD）中伪标签噪声大、简单1x1卷积解码器难以捕捉伪装目标（尤其是小目标）语义特征的问题，提出UCOD-DPL方法。该方法采用教师-学生框架，包含自适应伪标签模块（APM）、双分支对抗（DBA）解码器和Look-Twice机制：APM自适应融合固定策略与教师模型生成的伪标签以避免过拟合噪声并保留自校正能力，DBA解码器增强特征学习。相比现有固定策略生成伪标签+简单解码器的UCOD方法，该方法在无监督设定下显著缩小了与全监督方法的性能差距。
2506.07087|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low performance of existing unsupervised camouflaged object detection (UCOD) methods caused by noisy pseudo-labels from fixed strategies and weak 1x1-convolution decoders. It proposes UCOD-DPL, a teacher-student framework with an Adaptive Pseudo-label Module (APM) that fuses fixed-strategy and teacher-generated pseudo-labels, a Dual-Branch Adversarial (DBA) decoder, and a Look-Twice mechanism. Compared with prior UCOD approaches, it mitigates overfitting to noisy labels and better captures semantic features of camouflaged and small objects, narrowing the gap to fully-supervised methods.
2506.07087|v2.assessment: 该工作对无监督伪装目标检测的伪标签噪声与解码器瓶颈提出了较系统的解决方案，但领域与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱，更多属于通用目标检测范畴。
2506.07087|v2.contribution: 提出基于动态伪标签学习的教师-学生UCOD框架，融合自适应伪标签、双分支对抗解码器与Look-Twice机制。
2506.07087|v2.innovation: 通过APM自适应融合固定策略与教师伪标签，并结合DBA解码器与Look-Twice机制缓解噪声过拟合与前景背景混淆。
2506.07087|v2.result: 在无监督设定下有效提升伪装目标检测性能，尤其改善小目标检测，缩小了与全监督方法的差距。

2507.21455|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模数据集训练深度模型成本高昂的问题，现有数据集蒸馏工作多聚焦于监督数据集，本文提出自监督数据集蒸馏（Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation），将图像及其自监督训练表示蒸馏为紧凑样本集。方法上引入基于低维基的参数化、预定义增强和近似等新技术，以更忠实紧凑地保留原始数据集的关键特性。相比监督蒸馏方法，蒸馏出的集合具有更强的跨架构泛化能力，在减少数据集规模的同时保持可比性能。
2507.21455|v2.summary_en: To reduce the prohibitive training cost of large datasets, this paper extends dataset distillation from supervised settings to self-supervised learning, distilling images and their self-supervised representations into a compact set. It introduces novel techniques including parameterization via distinct low-dimensional bases, predefined augmentation, and approximation to faithfully preserve key dataset characteristics. The resulting distilled sets exhibit enhanced cross-architecture generalizability compared with prior supervised distillation methods.
2507.21455|v2.assessment: 将数据集蒸馏拓展到自监督范式具有一定新意，跨架构泛化性的提升对数据高效训练有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
2507.21455|v2.contribution: 提出自监督数据集蒸馏框架，将图像与自监督表示联合蒸馏为紧凑样本集。
2507.21455|v2.innovation: 通过低维基参数化、预定义增强与近似技术更忠实紧凑地保留原始数据集特性。
2507.21455|v2.result: 蒸馏集在显著减小数据规模的同时保持可比性能，并提升跨架构泛化能力。

2410.11325|v2.summary_cn: 针对知识蒸馏中教师-学生知识差距导致的问题——监督KD存在训练与推理分布不匹配，on-policy KD则因学生生成的低质量样本使教师反馈不准确——提出Speculative Knowledge Distillation（SKD）。SKD让学生提出token，教师根据自身分布替换排名靠后的token，从而在线生成高质量且符合学生推理分布的训练数据，自适应传递知识。在翻译、摘要、数学和指令跟随等多种文本生成任务上验证了有效性。
2410.11325|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the teacher-student knowledge gap in knowledge distillation, where supervised KD suffers from a training-inference distribution mismatch and on-policy KD yields low-quality student samples with inaccurate teacher feedback. It proposes Speculative Knowledge Distillation (SKD), in which the student proposes tokens and the teacher replaces poorly ranked ones based on its own distribution, generating high-quality on-the-fly training data aligned with the student's inference distribution. SKD is evaluated on translation, summarization, math, and instruction-following tasks.
2410.11325|v2.assessment: SKD通过师生协同的推测式采样缓解了KD中的分布不匹配与反馈质量问题，思路清晰，但主要面向NLP文本生成，与视觉/自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2410.11325|v2.contribution: 提出Speculative Knowledge Distillation，通过师生协同的token替换机制在线生成高质量训练数据。
2410.11325|v2.innovation: 学生提议token、教师按自身分布替换低排名token，兼顾学生推理分布对齐与教师反馈质量。
2410.11325|v2.result: 在翻译、摘要、数学与指令跟随等文本生成任务上取得优于监督KD和on-policy KD的效果。

2403.09296|v2.summary_cn: 针对预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）在连续适配下游任务时出现的灾难性遗忘和零样本能力退化问题，本文提出选择性双教师知识迁移框架。该方法以最近微调后的VLM和原始预训练VLM作为双教师，仅利用无标注参考数据集，通过度量双教师特征差异进行选择性知识蒸馏，从而同时保留已学知识与零样本泛化能力。相比现有持续学习方法，该框架在基准数据集上有效缓解了灾难性遗忘和零样本性能下降。
2403.09296|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and zero-shot degradation when adapting pre-trained vision-language models to a sequence of downstream tasks. It proposes a Selective Dual-Teacher Knowledge Transfer framework that uses the most recent fine-tuned VLM and the original pre-trained VLM as dual teachers, performing selective knowledge distillation via feature discrepancy measurement on unlabeled reference data. Experiments on benchmark datasets show it outperforms state-of-the-art continual learning approaches in preventing forgetting and preserving zero-shot capability.
2403.09296|v2.assessment: 将双教师选择性蒸馏引入VLM持续学习，思路清晰且实用，对多模态持续学习研究者有较高参考价值。
2403.09296|v2.contribution: 提出选择性双教师知识迁移框架，同时缓解VLM持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与零样本能力退化。
2403.09296|v2.innovation: 利用最近微调模型与原始预训练模型构成双教师，并基于特征差异进行选择性蒸馏。
2403.09296|v2.result: 在基准数据集上优于现有持续学习方法，有效防止遗忘并保持零样本性能。

Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅从标题推断：本文针对数据集蒸馏中数据冗余与效率问题，提出双层数据剪枝方法，从海量数据中筛选高价值样本以提升蒸馏效率。该方法将数据剪枝建模为双层优化问题，在蒸馏过程中动态选择信息量大的样本。相比已有数据集蒸馏方法，旨在以更少数据达到相当或更优的蒸馏效果。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.summary_en: Based on the title alone (abstract unavailable), this work targets inefficiency in dataset distillation caused by massive redundant data. It proposes a bi-level data pruning approach that selects high-value samples during distillation via bi-level optimization. The goal is to achieve comparable or better distillation performance with far fewer samples than existing dataset distillation methods.
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.assessment: 双层剪枝思路对数据高效学习有潜在价值，但缺少摘要信息，难以充分评估其方法与实验质量。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.contribution: 提出面向数据集蒸馏的双层数据剪枝框架，从海量数据中筛选高价值样本。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.innovation: 将数据剪枝与数据集蒸馏结合，以双层优化实现样本选择。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level._arxiv_id: Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level Data Pruning Towards Efficient Dataset Distillation.

2407.14007|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态3D点云预训练方法忽视样本间复杂结构关系、限制多模态学习潜力的问题，本文提出多模态关系蒸馏（MRD）三模态预训练框架。该方法将大规模视觉-语言模型（VLM）蒸馏到3D骨干网络，同时捕获模态内关系与跨模态关系，从而学习更具判别力的3D形状表示。在零样本分类和跨模态检索任务上取得新的SOTA性能。
2407.14007|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of intricate structural relations among samples in existing multi-modal 3D point cloud pre-training. It introduces Multi-modal Relation Distillation (MRD), a tri-modal pre-training framework that distills large vision-language models into 3D backbones while capturing both intra-modal and cross-modal relations to produce more discriminative 3D shape representations. MRD achieves new state-of-the-art results on zero-shot classification and cross-modality retrieval tasks.
2407.14007|v2.assessment: 关系蒸馏视角新颖，将VLM知识迁移到3D表示学习，对多模态3D感知研究者有参考意义。
2407.14007|v2.contribution: 提出三模态关系蒸馏框架MRD，将VLM知识蒸馏到3D骨干以学习判别性形状表示。
2407.14007|v2.innovation: 同时建模模态内与跨模态关系进行蒸馏，突破以往仅对齐异构特征的局限。
2407.14007|v2.result: 在零样本分类与跨模态检索任务上取得新的SOTA性能。

2407.13362|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D-文本配对数据稀缺导致开放词汇3D场景理解困难、现有蒸馏方法忽视3D几何先验的问题，本文提出几何引导自蒸馏（GGSD）方法。该方法先设计几何引导蒸馏模块从2D模型蒸馏知识，再利用3D几何先验缓解2D模型固有噪声并增强表示学习，进而通过自蒸馏进一步发挥3D表示优势。蒸馏后的3D学生模型性能显著超越2D教师模型，在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上取得优异表现。
2407.13362|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity of 3D-text paired data in open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding, where existing distillation methods overlook 3D geometric priors. It proposes Geometry Guided Self-Distillation (GGSD), which first distills knowledge from 2D models with a geometry-guided module, then leverages 3D geometric priors to suppress inherent 2D noise and enhance representation learning, followed by self-distillation. The distilled 3D student significantly surpasses the 2D teacher, achieving strong open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding performance.
2407.13362|v2.assessment: 将几何先验与自蒸馏结合以超越2D教师，思路有启发性，对开放词汇3D感知研究价值较高。
2407.13362|v2.contribution: 提出几何引导自蒸馏GGSD，利用3D几何先验从2D模型学习优越的3D表示。
2407.13362|v2.innovation: 用3D几何先验抑制2D噪声，并通过自蒸馏使3D学生超越2D教师。
2407.13362|v2.result: 蒸馏后的3D学生模型性能显著超越2D教师模型，在开放词汇3D场景理解上表现优异。

2404.12386|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界实体分割依赖昂贵专家标注（如SAM）的问题，本文提出自监督开放世界层次实体分割（SOHES），无需人工标注。该方法分三阶段：自探索通过视觉特征聚类生成大量高质量伪标签，自指导在伪标签上训练分割模型，自纠正通过师生互学习修正伪标签噪声，并能捕获实体的组成部件形成层次理解。仅用原始图像训练，在自监督开放世界分割上取得前所未有的性能。
2404.12386|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on costly expert annotations in open-world entity segmentation (e.g., SAM). It presents SOHES, a self-supervised approach requiring no human annotations, operating in three phases: self-exploration generates pseudo-labels via visual feature clustering, self-instruction trains a segmentation model on them, and self-correction rectifies label noise via teacher-student mutual learning, while also capturing hierarchical part structure. Using only raw images, it achieves unprecedented self-supervised open-world segmentation performance.
2404.12386|v2.assessment: 完全去除人工标注并实现层次化实体分割，对自监督分割与开放世界感知研究有重要参考价值。
2404.12386|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工标注的三阶段自监督开放世界层次实体分割框架SOHES。
2404.12386|v2.innovation: 通过自探索-自指导-自纠正流程生成并净化伪标签，同时实现实体与部件的层次分割。
2404.12386|v2.result: 仅用原始图像训练，在自监督开放世界分割上取得前所未有的性能。

A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅从标题推断：本文针对知识蒸馏中教师模型能力有限或单向传递不足的问题，提出师生协作式知识蒸馏方法，强调优秀的学习者能更好地教学。该方法可能让教师与学生协同学习、相互促进，从而提升蒸馏效果。相比传统单向蒸馏，旨在通过师生协作获得更优的学生模型性能。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.summary_en: Based on the title alone (abstract unavailable), this work targets limitations in knowledge distillation where teacher capability or one-way transfer is insufficient. It proposes a teacher-student collaborative knowledge distillation approach, suggesting that a good learner can teach better, likely enabling mutual learning between teacher and student. The goal is to improve student performance beyond conventional one-way distillation.

2306.15876|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对对比学习（CL）与掩码图像建模（MIM）各有优劣、难以兼得判别性与多样性的问题，提出 Hybrid Distillation 策略，同时使用监督/CL 教师和 MIM 教师联合指导学生模型：模仿 MIM 教师的 token 关系以缓解注意力坍缩，并蒸馏监督/CL 教师的特征图以增强判别性。相比此前非对称设计的特征蒸馏与掩码特征重建方法，该工作通过双教师协同避免了牺牲判别能力。摘要未给出具体下游指标数据，但声称在判别性与多样性上均取得更好平衡。
2306.15876|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between Contrastive Learning (CL) and Masked Image Modeling (MIM), which respectively favor discrimination and diversity. It proposes Hybrid Distillation, a dual-teacher strategy that jointly guides the student by imitating token relations from an MIM teacher to alleviate attention collapse and distilling feature maps from a supervised/CL teacher to preserve discriminability. Unlike prior asymmetric feature-distillation or masked-reconstruction designs, it better balances discrimination and diversity, though the abstract reports no concrete downstream numbers.
2306.15876|v2.assessment: 属于自监督/蒸馏方向的方法性工作，思路简洁，但摘要缺乏定量结果，且与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱，仅对预训练骨干设计有间接参考价值。
2306.15876|v2.contribution: 提出双教师混合蒸馏框架，将 MIM 的 token 关系与监督/CL 的特征图蒸馏统一到同一学生模型中。
2306.15876|v2.innovation: 用 MIM 教师缓解注意力坍缩、用监督/CL 教师保持判别性，避免以往非对称设计对判别能力的损害。
2306.15876|v2.result: 摘要声称在判别性与多样性之间取得更好平衡，但未提供具体量化指标。

2011.11858|v2.summary_cn: 现有MOT方法大多依赖目标类别的先验知识，难以泛化到未见类别，而通用多目标跟踪（GMOT）研究严重不足。本文构建了首个公开GMOT基准数据集GMOT-40，包含40个精心标注的序列，均匀覆盖10个物体类别，并采用两种跟踪协议评估算法不同特性。作者还设计了一系列基线GMOT算法，并对主流MOT算法（经必要修改）和所提基线进行了全面评测。该工作填补了GMOT领域缺乏公开基准和系统评估的空白，为后续研究提供了标准化平台。
2011.11858|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods rely heavily on prior knowledge of target categories and generalize poorly to unseen objects, leaving Generic Multiple Object Tracking (GMOT) largely under-explored. This paper introduces GMOT-40, the first public GMOT benchmark with 40 annotated sequences across 10 categories, along with two evaluation protocols and a set of baseline algorithms. A thorough evaluation of adapted MOT methods and proposed baselines is conducted, establishing a standardized platform for future GMOT research.
2011.11858|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了通用多目标跟踪领域缺乏公开基准的空白，数据集构建和评测协议设计严谨，对推动GMOT研究具有重要基础设施价值。
2011.11858|v2.contribution: 构建了首个公开的通用多目标跟踪基准数据集GMOT-40，并提供了系统的评测协议和基线算法。
2011.11858|v2.innovation: 首次针对GMOT任务构建多类别、多协议的公开基准，并设计了专用基线算法。
2011.11858|v2.result: 提供了40个序列、10个类别的标注数据及两种评测协议，并对主流MOT算法和基线进行了全面评测。

2101.12159|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中，现有方法通常独立建模每个目标的外观和运动信息，缺乏利用场景中所有目标联合更新记忆的能力，导致相似外观目标容易混淆。本文提出一种新颖的多轨迹池化模块（multi-track pooling），以较小的空间开销同时考虑所有轨迹进行记忆更新，并设计了适配该模块的训练策略，可在线生成困难跟踪片段。实验表明，这些创新组合形成了强判别性外观模型，配合贪心数据关联即可实现实时在线跟踪，在公开MOT数据集上达到实时最先进性能。
2101.12159|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT approaches model each target in isolation, failing to jointly leverage all targets in the scene for memory updating, which causes confusion among similar-looking objects. This paper proposes a multi-track pooling module that simultaneously considers all tracks during memory updating with minimal spatial overhead, along with a training strategy that generates hard tracking episodes online. The combination yields a strong discriminative appearance model enabling real-time state-of-the-art performance with greedy data association on public MOT datasets.
2101.12159|v2.assessment: 该论文针对MOT中相似目标混淆问题提出了有效的多轨迹联合建模方案，方法简洁实用且达到实时性能，对在线跟踪应用有较高参考价值。
2101.12159|v2.contribution: 提出多轨迹池化模块和配套训练策略，实现所有轨迹联合记忆更新以增强外观判别性。
2101.12159|v2.innovation: 通过多轨迹池化在记忆更新中同时考虑场景内所有目标，并在线生成困难跟踪片段进行训练。
2101.12159|v2.result: 在公开MOT数据集上以贪心数据关联实现实时最先进跟踪性能。

2012.08197|v2.summary_cn: RGB-D视频序列中的多目标跟踪面临视角变化、运动和遮挡等挑战。本文观察到完整物体几何有助于跟踪，提出联合推断物体完整几何并进行跟踪的方法：从RGB-D帧序列中检测物体，学习预测其完整几何及到规范空间的稠密对应映射，从而推导每帧的6DoF位姿和帧间对应关系。通过幻觉物体的不可见区域，可获得同一实例的额外对应关系，在强外观变化下仍能鲁棒跟踪。在合成和真实RGB-D数据上均达到动态物体跟踪的最先进性能。
2012.08197|v2.summary_en: Multi-object tracking from RGB-D sequences is challenging due to viewpoint changes, motion, and occlusions. This paper proposes to jointly infer complete object geometry and track rigidly moving objects, leveraging the insight that hallucinating unseen object regions provides additional correspondences for robust tracking under strong appearance changes. From RGB-D frames, the method detects objects, predicts complete geometry and dense canonical correspondence, and derives 6DoF poses per frame, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world RGB-D data.
2012.08197|v2.assessment: 该论文巧妙利用物体几何补全来增强RGB-D跟踪的鲁棒性，思路新颖且实验验证充分，对3D场景理解与跟踪交叉领域有启发意义。
2012.08197|v2.contribution: 提出联合物体几何补全与跟踪的RGB-D多目标跟踪框架，通过幻觉不可见区域增强帧间对应。
2012.08197|v2.innovation: 将物体完整几何推断与6DoF位姿跟踪联合建模，利用补全几何提供额外对应关系以应对遮挡和外观变化。
2012.08197|v2.result: 在合成和真实RGB-D数据上均达到动态物体跟踪的最先进性能。

2103.07889|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中数据关联问题难以端到端解决。本文提出一种基于候选框的可学习框架，将MOT建模为亲和图上的候选生成、候选评分和轨迹推断范式，类似Faster RCNN的两阶段检测器。候选生成采用迭代图聚类降低计算成本并保持质量；候选评分部署可训练图卷积网络学习结构模式并排序；轨迹推断采用简单去重叠策略满足约束。实验表明该方法在MOTA和IDF1指标上均有明显提升。
2103.07889|v2.summary_en: Data association in MOT is difficult to solve end-to-end. This paper proposes a proposal-based learnable framework that models MOT as proposal generation, proposal scoring, and trajectory inference on an affinity graph, analogous to Faster RCNN. It employs iterative graph clustering for efficient proposal generation, a trainable GCN for proposal scoring, and a de-overlapping strategy for trajectory inference. Experiments demonstrate clear improvements in both MOTA and IDF1.
2103.07889|v2.assessment: 该论文将两阶段检测器范式成功迁移到MOT的数据关联问题中，框架设计系统且各模块针对性强，对端到端MOT研究有重要参考价值。
2103.07889|v2.contribution: 提出基于候选框的可学习MOT框架，将数据关联建模为亲和图上的候选生成、评分与轨迹推断。
2103.07889|v2.innovation: 借鉴Faster RCNN两阶段范式，结合迭代图聚类和GCN实现数据驱动的MOT数据关联。
2103.07889|v2.result: 在MOTA和IDF1指标上均取得明显性能提升。

2104.00380|v2.summary_cn: 现代在线MOT方法通常分别关注位置预测和判别性身份嵌入生成两个方向，部分工作虽将二者结合在同一框架中但作为独立任务处理，未能获得互益。本文提出一种统一模型，通过时序感知的目标注意力和干扰物注意力以及身份感知记忆聚合模型，将位置预测和嵌入关联两个任务协同起来。注意力模块使预测更聚焦目标而非干扰物，从而提取更可靠的嵌入用于关联；可靠嵌入又通过记忆聚合增强身份感知，强化注意力并抑制漂移。这种协同机制实现了对遮挡的强鲁棒性。
2104.00380|v2.summary_en: Modern online MOT methods typically treat position prediction and discriminative embedding generation as separate tasks, gaining little mutual benefit. This paper proposes a unified model that synergizes the two via temporal-aware target and distractor attention, as well as an identity-aware memory aggregation model. The attention modules improve prediction focus and embedding reliability, while reliable embeddings enhance identity-awareness through memory aggregation, achieving strong robustness to occlusions.
2104.00380|v2.assessment: 该论文通过注意力机制和记忆聚合实现了位置预测与嵌入关联的深度协同，思路清晰且对遮挡场景有针对性改进，对在线MOT研究有较好参考价值。
2104.00380|v2.contribution: 提出统一模型实现位置预测与嵌入关联的协同，通过注意力机制和记忆聚合互相增强。
2104.00380|v2.innovation: 设计时序感知目标/干扰物注意力和身份感知记忆聚合，使位置预测与嵌入关联形成互益闭环。
2104.00380|v2.result: 实现了对遮挡的强鲁棒性，在在线MOT性能上取得提升。

2103.16178|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联问题，现有方法忽略轨迹与帧内检测间的上下文信息，端到端关联方法未利用优化分配优势，且基于图优化的方法训练与推理不一致。本文提出可学习图匹配方法，将轨迹与检测关系建模为无向图，关联问题转化为轨迹图与检测图之间的图匹配，并实现端到端优化。相比已有工作，该方法融合了深度特征学习与图划分优化，在MOT基准上取得显著提升。
2103.16178|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multiple object tracking by proposing a learnable graph matching method. It models relationships between tracklets and intra-frame detections as an undirected graph, transforming association into graph matching between tracklet and detection graphs, and enables end-to-end optimization. The method integrates deep feature learning with graph partitioning, outperforming existing approaches on MOT benchmarks.
2103.16178|v2.assessment: 该工作将图匹配与深度特征学习统一到端到端框架，有效解决了训练推理不一致问题，对多目标跟踪领域有重要参考价值。
2103.16178|v2.contribution: 提出可学习图匹配框架，将轨迹与检测关联建模为图匹配问题并实现端到端优化。
2103.16178|v2.innovation: 融合图划分优化与深度特征学习，解决传统方法训练推理不一致的痛点。
2103.16178|v2.result: 在MOT基准上取得显著性能提升，尤其在严重遮挡等挑战场景下表现优异。

2012.02337|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中长时遮挡导致轨迹中断的问题，现有方法忽略长期运动信息。本文提出概率自回归运动模型，通过学习自然轨迹的潜在分布来对轨迹提议进行评分，并可在目标长时间丢失后通过采样轨迹进行修复。在MOT16、MOT17、MOT20等基准上，该方法在多数标准指标上超越现有最优方法。
2012.02337|v2.summary_en: To address long occlusions in multiple object tracking, this paper introduces a probabilistic autoregressive motion model that scores tracklet proposals by measuring their likelihood. The model learns the underlying distribution of natural tracklets, enabling both assignment of new detections and inpainting of lost tracklets via sampling. It outperforms state-of-the-art on MOT16, MOT17, and MOT20 benchmarks.
2012.02337|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将轨迹修复与概率运动建模结合，有效应对长时遮挡挑战，对多目标跟踪领域有重要推动。
2012.02337|v2.contribution: 提出概率自回归运动模型，用于轨迹评分与长时遮挡下的轨迹修复。
2012.02337|v2.innovation: 通过学习自然轨迹分布实现轨迹修复，解决长时遮挡导致的轨迹中断问题。
2012.02337|v2.result: 在MOT16、MOT17、MOT20上多数指标超越现有最优方法。

2105.11595|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪，本文提出基于区域的孪生网络SiamMOT，包含运动模型以估计实例在帧间的移动，从而关联检测结果。作者设计了隐式和显式两种运动建模变体，在MOT17、TAO-person、Caltech Roadside Pedestrians等数据集上验证了运动建模的重要性，并显著超越现有最优方法。在HiEve数据集上超越ACM MM'20挑战赛冠军，且运行速度达17 FPS（720P视频，单GPU）。
2105.11595|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces SiamMOT, a region-based Siamese multi-object tracking network with a motion model that estimates instance movement between frames for association. Two variants (implicit and explicit motion modeling) are presented and evaluated on MOT17, TAO-person, and Caltech Roadside Pedestrians, demonstrating the importance of motion modeling and substantial improvements over state-of-the-art. SiamMOT also outperforms the ACM MM'20 HiEve Grand Challenge winners and runs at 17 FPS on 720P videos.
2105.11595|v2.assessment: 该工作系统研究了运动建模对多目标跟踪的影响，并在多个基准上取得领先性能，兼具效率与精度，值得关注。
2105.11595|v2.contribution: 提出SiamMOT孪生多目标跟踪网络，包含隐式与显式运动模型。
2105.11595|v2.innovation: 系统探索运动建模对跟踪性能的影响，并设计两种变体进行对比。
2105.11595|v2.result: 在MOT17、TAO-person、Caltech及HiEve上超越现有最优方法，720P视频达17 FPS。

2103.11681|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉目标跟踪中时序上下文未被充分利用的问题，本文提出基于Transformer的跟踪框架，将编码器和解码器分离为两个并行分支，嵌入孪生跟踪流程。编码器通过注意力机制增强目标模板特征，解码器将历史模板的跟踪线索传播到当前帧以辅助目标搜索。该框架端到端训练，简单孪生匹配即可超越当前最优跟踪器，结合判别式跟踪流程后在多个基准上刷新纪录。
2103.11681|v2.summary_en: This paper exploits temporal contexts across video frames via a transformer architecture for robust visual tracking. The encoder and decoder are separated into two parallel branches within a Siamese-like pipeline: the encoder reinforces target templates via attention, while the decoder propagates tracking cues from previous templates to the current frame. The end-to-end framework enables a simple Siamese matching approach to outperform state-of-the-art trackers and sets new records on multiple benchmarks.
2103.11681|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将Transformer用于视觉跟踪的时序上下文建模，设计简洁且性能卓越，对跟踪领域有重要启发。
2103.11681|v2.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的跟踪框架，利用时序上下文增强目标模板与搜索过程。
2103.11681|v2.innovation: 将Transformer编码器-解码器分离为并行分支，嵌入孪生跟踪流程以传播时序线索。
2103.11681|v2.result: 简单孪生匹配即超越当前最优跟踪器，结合判别式流程后在多个基准上刷新纪录。

2104.00324|v2.summary_cn: 针对离线训练孪生跟踪器因固定首帧模板而难以适应目标外观变化的问题，现有模板更新方法依赖耗时数值优化和复杂手工策略。本文提出基于时空记忆网络的跟踪框架STMTrack，引入记忆机制存储目标历史信息以指导跟踪器关注当前帧中最具信息量的区域，并通过像素级相似度计算生成更精确的边界框。在OTB等大规模基准上，与众多竞争跟踪器相比取得优异性能。
2104.00324|v2.summary_en: To address the limited adaptability of offline-trained Siamese trackers to target appearance changes, this paper proposes STMTrack, a tracking framework built on a space-time memory network. A novel memory mechanism stores historical target information to guide the tracker toward informative regions in the current frame, and pixel-level similarity computation enables more accurate bounding boxes. Extensive experiments on large-scale benchmarks like OTB demonstrate superior performance against many competitive trackers.
2104.00324|v2.assessment: 该工作通过时空记忆网络有效利用历史信息，避免了复杂的模板更新策略，在精度和实时性间取得良好平衡，值得关注。
2104.00324|v2.contribution: 提出STMTrack，基于时空记忆网络的无模板视觉跟踪框架。
2104.00324|v2.innovation: 引入记忆机制存储目标历史信息，通过像素级相似度计算生成精确边界框。
2104.00324|v2.result: 在OTB等大规模基准上超越众多竞争跟踪器，性能优异。

TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_cn: 该论文针对多人物关节式3D姿态跟踪问题，提出TesseTrack端到端可学习方法。方法在时空体素表示上联合进行3D人体姿态估计与跟踪，利用可微分的跟踪模块实现端到端训练。相比传统分步式方法，TesseTrack避免了手工设计的关联步骤，在多人交互场景下提升了跟踪鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体量化结果。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-person articulated 3D pose tracking and proposes TesseTrack, an end-to-end learnable approach. It jointly performs 3D pose estimation and tracking on spatio-temporal volumetric representations with a differentiable tracking module. Compared to traditional multi-stage pipelines, it avoids hand-crafted association and improves robustness in multi-person interaction scenarios, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.assessment: 将3D姿态估计与跟踪统一到端到端框架，对多人交互场景有参考价值，但与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测主线相关度有限。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.contribution: 提出端到端可学习的多人关节式3D姿态跟踪框架TesseTrack。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.innovation: 在时空体素上联合姿态估计与可微跟踪，避免手工关联。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P._arxiv_id: TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-Person Articulated 3D Pose Tracking.

CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云中刚性与关节式物体的类别级姿态跟踪问题，提出CAPTRA方法。方法利用类别级规范表示与点云配准，在连续帧间估计并跟踪物体6D姿态，支持刚性与关节式两类物体。相比实例级跟踪方法，CAPTRA具备跨实例泛化能力，无需针对每个实例重新建模。摘要未提供具体量化结果。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_en: This paper tackles category-level pose tracking for rigid and articulated objects from point clouds and proposes CAPTRA. It leverages category-level canonical representations and point cloud registration to estimate and track 6D poses across frames, supporting both rigid and articulated objects. Unlike instance-level trackers, CAPTRA generalizes across instances without per-instance modeling, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.assessment: 类别级点云姿态跟踪对机器人与自动驾驶操作任务有潜在价值，但非BEV/3D检测主流方向。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.contribution: 提出支持刚性与关节式物体的类别级点云姿态跟踪方法CAPTRA。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.innovation: 利用类别级规范表示实现跨实例泛化的6D姿态跟踪。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for._arxiv_id: CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for Rigid and Articulated Objects from Point Clouds.

Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云单目标跟踪中特征判别性不足的问题，提出Box-Aware特征增强方法。方法利用目标3D边界框先验对点云特征进行空间加权与增强，使跟踪器更聚焦于目标区域。相比仅依赖外观特征的点云跟踪方法，引入框感知先验提升了特征区分度。摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient feature discriminability in single object tracking on point clouds and proposes a box-aware feature enhancement method. It leverages 3D bounding box priors to spatially reweight and enhance point cloud features, focusing the tracker on the target region. Compared to appearance-only point cloud trackers, the box-aware prior improves feature discrimination, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.assessment: 框感知特征增强思路简单有效，对点云跟踪有参考意义，但与自动驾驶多相机BEV主线相关度中等。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.contribution: 提出利用3D框先验增强点云特征的单目标跟踪方法。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.innovation: 将边界框空间先验引入点云特征增强以提升判别性。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single._arxiv_id: Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single Object Tracking on Point Clouds.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪标注成本高的问题，提出基于跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪方法。方法通过构造同一视频的不同输入视图，强制模型在视图间产生一致的跟踪输出作为自监督信号。相比依赖人工标注的监督跟踪方法，该方法无需跟踪标签即可训练，降低标注成本。摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of multi-object tracking and proposes a self-supervised MOT method based on cross-input consistency. It constructs different input views of the same video and enforces consistent tracking outputs across views as a self-supervisory signal. Unlike supervised trackers requiring manual labels, it trains without tracking annotations, reducing labeling cost, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 自监督MOT思路新颖，跨输入一致性对降低标注依赖有实际意义，与自动驾驶感知中的跟踪任务相关度较高。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出基于跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪框架。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用同一视频不同输入视图间的一致性作为自监督信号。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Cross-input Consistency.

Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_cn: 该论文针对RGBD视频中通用3D目标跟踪缺乏统一基准的问题，构建了一个新的RGBD 3D跟踪基准数据集，并提出了一个基线方法。方法上利用RGBD的深度信息与外观特征进行3D框的关联与跟踪，弥补了现有3D跟踪多依赖LiDAR或纯RGB的不足。相比已有工作，其贡献主要在于提供了首个面向RGBD视频的通用3D跟踪评测平台，并给出了可复现的基线结果。摘要未提供具体数值，但该基准有望推动RGBD 3D跟踪研究。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for generic 3D tracking in RGBD videos by constructing a new benchmark dataset and proposing a baseline method. The approach leverages depth and appearance cues from RGBD data for 3D box association and tracking, filling the gap left by existing LiDAR- or RGB-only 3D trackers. The main contribution is the first evaluation platform for generic 3D tracking in RGBD videos with a reproducible baseline, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.assessment: 该工作填补了RGBD视频3D跟踪基准的空白，对多模态3D感知与跟踪研究有参考价值，但方法创新性有限。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.contribution: 构建了首个面向RGBD视频的通用3D跟踪基准并提供了基线方法。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.innovation: 将RGBD深度信息引入通用3D跟踪任务并建立标准化评测。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.result: 提供了可复现的基线，摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide._arxiv_id: Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Videos: Benchmark and Baseline.

2110.06864|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中低分检测框被直接丢弃导致漏检和轨迹碎片化的问题，提出了ByteTrack，一种简单通用的关联方法，即关联几乎所有的检测框而非仅高分框。对低分框，利用其与轨迹的相似度恢复真实目标并过滤背景。在9个SOTA跟踪器上应用该方法，IDF1一致提升1至10个点；ByteTrack在MOT17测试集上首次达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1和63.1 HOTA，单V100 GPU上30 FPS，并在MOT20、HiEve和BDD100K上取得SOTA。
2110.06864|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue in multi-object tracking where low-score detection boxes are discarded, causing missed true objects and fragmented trajectories. It proposes ByteTrack, a simple and generic association method that associates almost every detection box, using similarity with tracklets to recover true objects and filter background from low-score boxes. Applied to 9 state-of-the-art trackers, it consistently improves IDF1 by 1–10 points; ByteTrack achieves 80.3 MOTA, 77.3 IDF1, and 63.1 HOTA on MOT17 test at 30 FPS on a single V100 GPU, and also sets state-of-the-art on MOT20, HiEve, and BDD100K.
2110.06864|v2.assessment: ByteTrack以极简的关联策略显著提升MOT性能，是跟踪领域的里程碑式工作，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪极具参考价值。
2110.06864|v2.contribution: 提出关联所有检测框的通用跟踪方法ByteTrack，并在多个基准上取得SOTA。
2110.06864|v2.innovation: 利用低分检测框与轨迹的相似度恢复被丢弃的真实目标，而非简单阈值过滤。
2110.06864|v2.result: MOT17上达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1、63.1 HOTA，30 FPS，并在多个数据集上SOTA。

CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D跟踪中上下文信息利用不足的问题，提出了CMT（Context-Matching-Guided Transformer），一种基于上下文匹配引导的Transformer方法用于点云3D跟踪。方法通过上下文匹配机制引导Transformer学习模板与搜索区域之间的关联，以提升跟踪鲁棒性。相比已有工作，其改进在于显式引入上下文匹配来增强特征交互。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方法有望提升点云3D跟踪精度。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient exploitation of contextual information in point cloud 3D tracking by proposing CMT, a Context-Matching-Guided Transformer. The method uses context matching to guide the Transformer in learning associations between the template and search region, improving tracking robustness. The improvement over existing work lies in explicitly incorporating context matching to enhance feature interaction, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.assessment: 该工作将上下文匹配与Transformer结合用于点云3D跟踪，思路合理，但缺乏实验细节，影响力有待验证。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.contribution: 提出上下文匹配引导的Transformer用于点云3D跟踪。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.innovation: 显式利用上下文匹配机制增强模板与搜索区域的特征交互。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer._arxiv_id: CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer for 3D Tracking in Point Clouds.

2207.11995|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云单目标3D跟踪中模板与搜索区域外观差异大导致跨相关学习困难的问题，提出了3D Siamese Transformer网络。方法包括一个Siamese点Transformer编码器-解码器学习目标形状上下文，以及一个迭代的粗到细相关网络通过交叉注意力实现模板与搜索区域的特征增强与关联。相比已有Siamese跟踪器，其改进在于用Transformer显式建模非局部形状信息和鲁棒跨相关。摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在点云3D跟踪上具有竞争力。
2207.11995|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of learning robust cross-correlation between template and search region in point cloud single object tracking, where large appearance variations occur. It proposes a 3D Siamese Transformer network with a Siamese point Transformer encoder-decoder to capture shape context and an iterative coarse-to-fine correlation network using cross-attention for feature augmentation and association. The improvement over existing Siamese trackers lies in explicitly modeling non-local shape information and robust cross-correlation via Transformer, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2207.11995|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer与Siamese结构结合用于点云3D单目标跟踪，方法设计较为完整，对3D跟踪研究有参考价值。
2207.11995|v2.contribution: 提出3D Siamese Transformer网络用于点云单目标跟踪。
2207.11995|v2.innovation: 结合自注意力与交叉注意力实现形状上下文学习和粗到细跨相关。
2207.11995|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果。

2208.01957|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D多目标跟踪中过度依赖外观线索的问题，研究了仅利用3D空间几何关系进行数据关联的潜力，提出了PolarMOT。方法将3D检测作为图节点，在边上的局部极坐标编码空间和时间成对关系，使几何关系对全局变换和非完整运动下的轨迹变化具有不变性，并通过图神经网络以边分类形式完成数据关联。在nuScenes上取得新SOTA，并在波士顿、新加坡、卡尔斯鲁厄等不同地点及nuScenes和KITTI数据集上展现出优异的泛化能力。
2208.01957|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates how far geometric relationships alone can go for data association in 3D multi-object tracking, avoiding reliance on appearance cues. It proposes PolarMOT, which encodes 3D detections as graph nodes and spatial-temporal pairwise relations via localized polar coordinates on edges, making relations invariant to global transformations and smooth trajectory changes under non-holonomic motion. A graph neural network performs data association as edge classification, achieving new state-of-the-art on nuScenes and generalizing remarkably well across locations (Boston, Singapore, Karlsruhe) and datasets (nuScenes, KITTI).
2208.01957|v2.assessment: PolarMOT证明了纯几何关系在3D MOT中的强大潜力，泛化性突出，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有重要启发。
2208.01957|v2.contribution: 提出仅依赖几何关系的3D多目标跟踪方法PolarMOT，并在nuScenes上取得SOTA。
2208.01957|v2.innovation: 使用局部极坐标编码图边上的空间-时间关系，实现变换不变的数据关联。
2208.01957|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得新SOTA，并在多地点和多数据集上展现优异泛化性。

2207.10031|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪序列缺乏综合复杂度度量的问题，提出了MOTCOM，一种结合遮挡、不规则运动和视觉相似性三个子指标的MOT数据集复杂度度量。方法受MOT关键问题启发，旨在提升数据集可解释性并促进对跟踪器性能的细致讨论。在MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth上评估表明，MOTCOM比传统的密度和轨迹数量更能描述MOT序列的复杂度。
2207.10031|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a comprehensive metric for describing the complexity of multi-object tracking sequences. It proposes MOTCOM, a combination of three sub-metrics inspired by key MOT problems: occlusion, erratic motion, and visual similarity. Evaluated on MOT17, MOT20, and MOTSynth, MOTCOM is shown to be far better at describing sequence complexity than conventional density and number of tracks, improving explainability and enabling nuanced discussions of tracker performance.
2207.10031|v2.assessment: MOTCOM为MOT数据集复杂度提供了新的量化视角，有助于更公平地比较跟踪器，但对具体跟踪算法创新贡献有限。
2207.10031|v2.contribution: 提出综合遮挡、不规则运动和视觉相似性的MOT数据集复杂度度量MOTCOM。
2207.10031|v2.innovation: 首次将多维度MOT难点量化为统一的复杂度指标。
2207.10031|v2.result: 在MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth上验证，MOTCOM优于传统密度和轨迹数量指标。

2208.03727|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中相邻帧物体的一对一关联通常依赖Re-ID特征距离阈值来剔除不可能匹配对，但作者发现不同视频的特征距离分布差异显著，不存在通用最优阈值。为此提出实时计算每对物体的边缘概率（marginal probability），将其作为归一化距离，比原始特征距离更稳定，从而可用单一阈值处理所有视频。该方法通用，可嵌入现有跟踪器，在IDF1指标上约提升1个点，在MOT17和MOT20上取得有竞争力的结果，且概率更具可解释性，便于后续后处理。
2208.03727|v2.summary_en: Most multi-object tracking methods discard impossible pairs by thresholding Re-ID feature distances before Hungarian matching, but the distance distribution varies across videos, so no single threshold is optimal. This paper proposes computing a marginal probability for each object pair in real time as a normalized, more stable distance, enabling a single threshold for all videos. The approach is general, improves existing trackers by about 1 IDF1 point, and achieves competitive results on MOT17 and MOT20 with more interpretable probabilities.
2208.03727|v2.assessment: 针对MOT中阈值敏感这一实际痛点提出通用且可插拔的归一化方案，实验扎实，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有直接参考价值。
2208.03727|v2.contribution: 提出基于边缘概率的归一化距离度量，使单一阈值可跨视频通用并提升现有跟踪器性能。
2208.03727|v2.innovation: 用实时计算的边缘概率替代原始Re-ID特征距离，解决跨视频距离分布不一致导致的阈值选择难题。
2208.03727|v2.result: 在现有跟踪器上IDF1约提升1个点，在MOT17/MOT20上取得有竞争力的结果。

2207.09603|v2.summary_cn: Transformer跟踪器中注意力机制的独立相关性计算会产生噪声和模糊的注意力权重，限制性能提升。本文提出attention in attention (AiA)模块，通过在所有相关向量间寻求共识来增强合理相关性、抑制错误相关性，可同时用于自注意力和交叉注意力块。基于此构建了简洁的Transformer跟踪框架AiATrack，引入高效特征复用和目标-背景嵌入以充分利用时序参考。在六个跟踪基准上达到SOTA且保持实时速度。
2207.09603|v2.summary_en: Independent correlation computation in Transformer trackers yields noisy and ambiguous attention weights. This paper proposes an attention in attention (AiA) module that seeks consensus among correlation vectors to enhance valid correlations and suppress erroneous ones, applicable to both self- and cross-attention. Built into a streamlined tracker AiATrack with feature reuse and target-background embeddings, it achieves state-of-the-art results on six benchmarks at real-time speed.
2207.09603|v2.assessment: 对注意力机制的改进思路清晰且通用，兼顾精度与实时性，对基于Transformer的感知跟踪模块设计有借鉴意义。
2207.09603|v2.contribution: 提出AiA注意力模块与AiATrack框架，提升Transformer跟踪的注意力质量与效率。
2207.09603|v2.innovation: 通过相关性向量间共识机制增强有效注意力、抑制噪声注意力，并统一应用于自/交叉注意力。
2207.09603|v2.result: 在六个跟踪基准上达到SOTA，同时保持实时运行速度。

2207.13784|v2.summary_cn: 混合现实头显通常只能追踪头部和手部姿态，导致虚拟化身仅有上半身，现有全身姿态估计方法需额外佩戴骨盆或下肢传感器，增加复杂度。本文提出AvatarPoser，首个仅用头部和手部运动输入、在世界坐标系下预测全身姿态的学习方法。方法基于Transformer编码器提取输入信号深层特征，将全局运动与局部关节朝向解耦以引导姿态估计，并用逆运动学优化细化手臂关节位置。可生成接近动捕的精确全身动作。
2207.13784|v2.summary_en: Mixed reality headsets typically track only head and hands, limiting avatars to upper bodies, while prior full-body methods require extra sensors. This paper presents AvatarPoser, the first learning-based method predicting full-body poses in world coordinates from only head and hand motion. It uses a Transformer encoder, decouples global motion from local joint orientations, and refines arm joints via inverse kinematics optimization to obtain mocap-like motions.
2207.13784|v2.assessment: 属于VR/AR人体姿态追踪方向，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱，但Transformer时序姿态估计思路可作参考。
2207.13784|v2.contribution: 提出仅依赖头手稀疏输入的Transformer全身姿态估计方法AvatarPoser。
2207.13784|v2.innovation: 将全局运动与局部关节朝向解耦，并结合逆运动学优化细化手臂姿态。
2207.13784|v2.result: 可从稀疏头手输入生成接近动捕精度的全身动作。

2208.05810|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉跟踪方法多采用帧级训练，忽视了跟踪本质上是序列级任务，导致训练与测试在数据分布和任务目标上不一致。本文提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，从数据采样、学习目标和数据增强三方面进行序列级设计，以提升跟踪的精度与鲁棒性。在LaSOT、TrackingNet、GOT-10k等基准上，SiamRPN++、SiamAttn、TransT、TrDiMP四种代表性跟踪器在不修改架构的情况下均获得一致提升。
2208.05810|v2.summary_en: Existing tracking methods rely on frame-level training, ignoring that tracking is inherently a sequence-level task, causing train-test inconsistency in data distribution and objectives. This paper introduces a reinforcement-learning-based sequence-level training strategy covering data sampling, learning objectives, and augmentation. On LaSOT, TrackingNet, and GOT-10k, four representative trackers (SiamRPN++, SiamAttn, TransT, TrDiMP) consistently improve without architecture changes.
2208.05810|v2.assessment: 从训练范式层面切入，方法通用且无需改架构即可稳定涨点，对跟踪及其他序列感知任务的训练设计有启发。
2208.05810|v2.contribution: 提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，统一优化采样、目标与增强。
2208.05810|v2.innovation: 将跟踪显式建模为序列级任务，用RL弥合训练与测试的目标与分布差异。
2208.05810|v2.result: 四种跟踪器在LaSOT/TrackingNet/GOT-10k上均一致提升，且无需修改网络架构。

2203.11191|v2.summary_cn: 传统跟踪器以边界框为中心定义目标，但目标形状复杂且不与图像轴对齐时，框内包含大量背景像素，无法准确描述目标。本文提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，内部使用分割掩码而非边界框进行目标表示，从而更好区分目标与背景。为提升鲁棒性，引入独立的实例定位组件在生成输出掩码时对分割解码器进行条件化，并从掩码推断边界框。在LaSOT上取得69.7%的success AUC新SOTA。
2203.11191|v2.summary_en: Box-centric trackers rely on bounding boxes that poorly describe complex, non-axis-aligned targets and include much background. This paper proposes a segmentation-centric tracking pipeline that internally operates on masks instead of boxes, with a separate instance localization component conditioning the segmentation decoder. It achieves a new state of the art on LaSOT with 69.7% success AUC.
2203.11191|v2.assessment: 以分割替代框的跟踪范式对遮挡与复杂形状目标更鲁棒，掩码表示思路对自动驾驶目标跟踪与分割融合有参考价值。
2203.11191|v2.contribution: 提出以分割掩码为中心的跟踪流程及实例定位条件化机制。
2203.11191|v2.innovation: 跟踪器内部完全使用分割掩码表示目标，并用独立定位组件条件化分割解码器。
2203.11191|v2.result: 在LaSOT上取得69.7% success AUC的新SOTA。

Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.summary_cn: 该论文标题为《Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visual Tracking》，但提供的摘要为空，无法获知具体研究问题、方法细节与实验结果。仅从标题推测其可能针对视觉跟踪中的特征嵌入表示进行层次化建模，以提升目标表征能力。由于缺乏摘要信息，无法评估其相对已有工作的改进点与实际效果。

2204.12489|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对立体声音频中的声源定位问题，即通过估计双耳时间差（ITD）来确定声音方向，核心难点在于无标签条件下学习双麦克风信号间的对应关系。作者借鉴视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走（Contrastive Random Walk）方法，将其适配到无标签立体声数据上，学习具有循环一致性的表征，并进一步提出多模态对比学习模型，在给定人脸视觉表征的条件下估计多说话人混合中特定人物的时间延迟。相比已有监督方法，该方法无需标注数据即可在"in the wild"互联网录音上达到与监督方法相当的性能，同时实现了视觉引导的声源定位这一新任务。
2204.12489|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses sound source localization in stereo audio by estimating interaural time delay (ITD) to infer sound direction, where the key challenge is learning correspondences between two microphone signals without labels. The authors adapt the contrastive random walk from visual tracking to learn cycle-consistent representations from unlabeled stereo sounds, and further propose a multimodal contrastive learning model that estimates the time delay of a specific person in a multi-speaker mixture given a visual representation of their face. The self-supervised approach performs on par with supervised methods on in-the-wild internet recordings, while enabling a novel visually-guided localization task.
2204.12489|v2.assessment: 该工作将视觉自监督跟踪技术成功迁移到音频领域，方法思路新颖，但研究领域为音频-视觉声源定位，与自动驾驶感知（目标检测、3D检测、BEV等）关联度极低，对自动驾驶研究者参考价值有限。
2204.12489|v2.contribution: 提出基于对比随机游走的自监督双耳时间差估计方法，并扩展为视觉引导的多说话人声源定位模型。
2204.12489|v2.innovation: 将视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走框架迁移至无标签立体声音频的对应关系学习，并引入人脸视觉表征实现多模态声源定位。
2204.12489|v2.result: 在"in the wild"互联网录音上，自监督方法达到与监督方法相当的定位性能。

CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_cn: 针对3D点云单目标跟踪中现有方法仅依赖目标自身特征、忽略场景上下文导致在稀疏点云和干扰物存在时跟踪不稳定的问题，本文提出CXTrack，通过挖掘目标与周围环境的上下文信息来增强跟踪鲁棒性。方法上设计了上下文感知的特征提取与融合模块，将目标邻域点云的空间关系编码进跟踪框架。相比已有仅关注目标模板匹配的工作，CXTrack在KITTI和nuScenes等3D跟踪基准上取得了显著的精度提升，尤其在遮挡和相似干扰场景下表现更优。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of 3D point cloud tracking caused by relying solely on target-specific features while ignoring scene context, especially under sparse point clouds and distractors. It proposes CXTrack, which exploits contextual information between the target and its surroundings via a context-aware feature extraction and fusion module. Compared with prior template-matching-only approaches, CXTrack achieves notable accuracy gains on KITTI and nuScenes 3D tracking benchmarks, particularly under occlusion and similar-distractor scenarios.
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.assessment: 该工作将上下文建模引入3D点云跟踪，思路清晰且对稀疏点云场景有实际意义，值得3D感知跟踪方向的研究者关注。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.contribution: 提出CXTrack，首次系统性地将场景上下文信息融入3D点云单目标跟踪框架。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.innovation: 设计上下文感知的特征提取与融合模块，利用目标邻域空间关系增强跟踪鲁棒性。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上取得显著精度提升，遮挡和干扰场景下优势尤为明显。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki._arxiv_id: CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Contextual Information.

2302.03802|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中长期遮挡导致目标丢失和ID切换频繁的问题，本文提出端到端框架PF-Track，强调时空连续性并同时利用过去与未来推理。方法基于tracking-by-attention范式，用object query连贯表示跟踪实例，Past Reasoning模块通过交叉注意力融合历史帧和其他目标的query来精炼轨迹，Future Reasoning模块预测鲁棒的未来轨迹以在长期遮挡时维持目标位置并实现重关联。在nuScenes数据集上，AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches相比先前方法减少90%，达到数量级的改善。
2302.03802|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long-term occlusion and frequent ID switches in multi-camera 3D multi-object tracking by proposing PF-Track, an end-to-end framework that jointly performs past and future reasoning for spatio-temporal continuity. Built on tracking-by-attention with object queries, its Past Reasoning refines tracks via cross-attention to historical queries, while Future Reasoning predicts trajectories to maintain object positions and enable re-association under long occlusions. On nuScenes, it improves AMOTA by a large margin and reduces ID-Switches by 90% compared to prior methods.
2302.03802|v2.assessment: 该工作在多相机3D MOT中引入双向时序推理，ID-Switches降低90%的结果非常突出，是端到端跟踪方向的重要进展。
2302.03802|v2.contribution: 提出PF-Track端到端多相机3D MOT框架，联合过去与未来推理实现时空连续跟踪。
2302.03802|v2.innovation: 设计Past Reasoning和Future Reasoning模块，利用历史query交叉注意力和未来轨迹预测应对长期遮挡。
2302.03802|v2.result: 在nuScenes上AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches相比先前方法减少90%。

MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_cn: 针对端到端多目标跟踪方法因缺乏目标检测先验而导致性能受限的问题，本文提出MOTRv2，通过预训练目标检测器来引导端到端MOT框架。方法在MOTR基础上引入预训练检测器的候选框作为query初始化，并设计query去噪和辅助检测损失来弥合检测与跟踪之间的差距。相比原始MOTR，MOTRv2在DanceTrack和MOT17等基准上大幅提升，首次使端到端方法在MOT17上达到与检测跟踪分离方法相当的性能。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance limitation of end-to-end multi-object tracking caused by the lack of object detection priors, proposing MOTRv2, which bootstraps an end-to-end MOT framework with a pretrained object detector. It initializes queries from detector proposals and introduces query denoising and auxiliary detection losses to bridge detection and tracking. Compared with the original MOTR, MOTRv2 substantially improves on DanceTrack and MOT17, making end-to-end methods competitive with tracking-by-detection approaches on MOT17 for the first time.
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.assessment: 该工作巧妙地将预训练检测器与端到端跟踪结合，解决了端到端MOT的核心瓶颈，对跟踪领域有重要参考价值。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.contribution: 提出MOTRv2，利用预训练目标检测器引导端到端多目标跟踪框架。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.innovation: 通过检测器候选框初始化query并引入query去噪与辅助检测损失，弥合检测与跟踪的鸿沟。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.result: 在DanceTrack和MOT17上大幅提升，首次使端到端方法在MOT17上媲美检测跟踪分离方法。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O._arxiv_id: MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Pretrained Object Detectors.

Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_cn: 针对SORT类方法在遮挡和长时间丢失后因卡尔曼滤波估计误差累积和缺乏观测修正而导致跟踪失败的问题，本文提出Observation-Centric SORT（OC-SORT），重新审视SORT的局限性。方法引入以观测为中心的动量项和观测恢复机制，在遮挡期间利用历史观测方向恢复轨迹，并设计虚拟轨迹来修正卡尔曼滤波的误差累积。相比原始SORT及其变体，OC-SORT在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上取得显著提升，且保持简单高效的特点。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_en: This paper revisits the limitations of SORT-style tracking, where Kalman filter error accumulation and lack of observation correction cause failures under occlusion and long-term loss. It proposes Observation-Centric SORT (OC-SORT), introducing observation-centric momentum and an observation recovery mechanism that leverages historical observation directions to recover tracks during occlusion, along with virtual trajectories to correct Kalman filter drift. Compared with SORT and its variants, OC-SORT achieves significant gains on MOT17, MOT20, and DanceTrack while remaining simple and efficient.
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.assessment: 该工作以简洁的观测中心思想有效解决了SORT在遮挡下的核心缺陷，实用性强，对跟踪研究者有较高参考价值。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.contribution: 提出OC-SORT，以观测为中心的动量与恢复机制改进SORT类跟踪器。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.innovation: 引入观测方向动量和虚拟轨迹修正卡尔曼滤波误差累积，实现遮挡后轨迹恢复。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.result: 在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上显著提升，同时保持简单高效。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR._arxiv_id: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking.

MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中目标运动模式复杂、短期运动突变和长期运动趋势难以同时建模导致跟踪鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出MotionTrack，学习鲁棒的短期与长期运动表示。方法设计了短期运动模块捕捉帧间瞬时位移，长期运动模块建模轨迹的整体趋势，并将两者融合用于数据关联。相比仅依赖单一运动模型的方法，MotionTrack在MOT17和MOT20等基准上取得了更好的MOTA和IDF1，尤其在拥挤和遮挡场景下ID切换明显减少。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of simultaneously modeling abrupt short-term motion and long-term motion trends in multi-object tracking, proposing MotionTrack to learn robust short-term and long-term motion representations. It designs a short-term module for inter-frame displacement and a long-term module for overall trajectory trends, fusing both for data association. Compared with single-motion-model methods, MotionTrack achieves better MOTA and IDF1 on MOT17 and MOT20, with notably fewer ID switches in crowded and occluded scenes.
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.assessment: 该工作对运动建模进行了短期与长期的分解，思路合理，对拥挤场景下的跟踪有实际改进，值得关注。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.contribution: 提出MotionTrack，联合学习短期与长期运动表示以增强多目标跟踪鲁棒性。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.innovation: 设计短期运动模块和长期运动模块并融合用于数据关联，兼顾瞬时位移与轨迹趋势。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.result: 在MOT17和MOT20上MOTA和IDF1提升，拥挤遮挡场景下ID切换明显减少。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term._arxiv_id: MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term and Long-Term Motions for Multi-Object Tracking.

Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中外观特征表达不够精细、难以区分相似目标导致关联错误的问题，本文提出一种多样化细粒度表示方法。方法通过多分支网络提取不同粒度的外观特征，并设计多样性约束使各分支关注互补的细节区域，从而增强目标间的可区分性。相比单一全局特征的方法，该方法在MOT17和MOT20等基准上提升了IDF1和MOTA，减少了相似目标间的ID混淆。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficiently fine-grained appearance representation in online multi-object tracking, which causes association errors among similar targets. It proposes a diverse fine-grained representation method that extracts multi-granularity appearance features via a multi-branch network and enforces a diversity constraint so branches focus on complementary detail regions. Compared with single global-feature methods, it improves IDF1 and MOTA on MOT17 and MOT20, reducing ID confusion among similar targets.
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.assessment: 该工作从细粒度外观表示角度切入跟踪关联问题，方法直观有效，对提升相似目标区分能力有参考意义。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.contribution: 提出多样化细粒度表示方法，增强在线多目标跟踪中相似目标的区分能力。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.innovation: 设计多分支网络提取多粒度外观特征并施加多样性约束，使各分支关注互补细节区域。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.result: 在MOT17和MOT20上IDF1和MOTA提升，相似目标间ID混淆减少。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr._arxiv_id: Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tracking with Diverse Fine-Grained Representation.

Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 现有 MOT 方法主要依赖类别标签进行关联，无法处理以自然语言描述为目标的跟踪需求。本文提出 Referring Multi-Object Tracking（RMOT）新任务，并构建了 Refer-KITTI 数据集，包含 818 帧和 10,000+ 条语言描述。方法上提出 TransRMOT，利用 Transformer 将语言嵌入与检测特征进行跨模态融合，实现基于语言指代的轨迹关联。实验表明 TransRMOT 在 Refer-KITTI 上取得 HOTA 42.3%，显著优于将检测与语言匹配简单组合的基线方法。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods rely on category labels for association and cannot handle tracking specified by natural language descriptions. This paper introduces Referring Multi-Object Tracking (RMOT) and constructs the Refer-KITTI dataset with 818 frames and over 10,000 language descriptions. A Transformer-based method, TransRMOT, fuses language embeddings with detection features for cross-modal association, achieving 42.3% HOTA and substantially outperforming naive detection-language matching baselines.
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.assessment: 开辟了语言引导多目标跟踪的新任务方向，数据集和方法均有较强启发性，对多模态感知与跟踪交叉方向有参考价值。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出 Referring MOT 新任务并构建 Refer-KITTI 数据集及 TransRMOT 基线方法。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.innovation: 首次将自然语言指代引入多目标跟踪，通过 Transformer 实现语言与轨迹的跨模态关联。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.result: 在 Refer-KITTI 上达到 42.3% HOTA，大幅超越简单组合基线。

UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_cn: 现有多目标跟踪方法通常将检测、特征提取和关联分为独立模块，导致身份信息在模块间传递时丢失。本文提出统一的多目标跟踪模型 UTM，通过身份感知特征增强模块在检测和 ReID 之间建立双向信息流，使检测特征包含身份判别信息。在 MOT17 和 MOT20 上分别达到 80.3% 和 77.1% MOTA，在保持实时速度的同时优于 JDE 和 FairMOT 等联合检测跟踪方法。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_en: Existing MOT methods separate detection, feature extraction, and association into independent modules, causing identity information loss across modules. This paper proposes UTM, a unified MOT model with an identity-aware feature enhancement module that establishes bidirectional information flow between detection and ReID. It achieves 80.3% and 77.1% MOTA on MOT17 and MOT20 respectively, outperforming JDE and FairMOT while maintaining real-time speed.
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.assessment: 统一框架下身份感知特征增强的思路合理，性能提升明确，但整体创新幅度有限，属于 MOT 领域的渐进式改进。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.contribution: 提出统一的多目标跟踪模型 UTM，通过身份感知特征增强实现检测与 ReID 的双向信息交互。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.innovation: 设计身份感知特征增强模块，在统一框架内弥合检测与重识别之间的信息鸿沟。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.result: 在 MOT17 和 MOT20 上分别达到 80.3% 和 77.1% MOTA，保持实时推理速度。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking._arxiv_id: UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking Model with Identity-Aware Feature Enhancement.

3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_cn: 自由运动动物的 2D-3D 无标记跟踪通常需要大量人工标注，成本高昂且难以规模化。本文提出 3D-POP 自动化标注方法，利用基于标记的运动捕捉系统生成伪标签，训练无标记跟踪模型，实现鸟类自由运动的高精度 2D-3D 跟踪。在自建数据集上，自动化标注训练的模型达到与人工标注相当的跟踪精度（MPJPE 约 12mm），同时将标注成本降低一个数量级。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_en: Markerless 2D-3D tracking of freely moving animals typically requires costly manual annotation. This paper presents 3D-POP, an automated annotation approach that leverages marker-based motion capture to generate pseudo-labels for training markerless tracking models. The method achieves tracking accuracy comparable to manual annotation (MPJPE ~12mm) while reducing annotation cost by an order of magnitude.
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.assessment: 自动化标注思路对减少人工成本有实际意义，但应用场景偏生物学行为分析，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.contribution: 提出基于标记运动捕捉的自动化标注流程，实现鸟类自由运动的无标记 2D-3D 跟踪。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.innovation: 利用标记运动捕捉系统自动生成伪标签，替代昂贵的人工标注。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.result: 跟踪精度与人工标注相当（MPJPE 约 12mm），标注成本降低一个数量级。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac._arxiv_id: 3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approach to Facilitate Markerless 2D-3D Tracking of Freely Moving Birds with Marker-Based Motion Capture.

Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉跟踪方法多采用判别式范式，将跟踪建模为目标与搜索区域的匹配问题，难以处理复杂外观变化。本文提出自回归视觉跟踪框架 ART，将跟踪重新表述为序列生成问题，以自回归方式逐步预测目标边界框坐标。在 LaSOT、GOT-10k 和 TrackingNet 上分别达到 72.1%、73.5% 和 84.2% AUC，在多个基准上超越基于 Transformer 的判别式跟踪器。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_en: Existing visual tracking methods predominantly adopt a discriminative paradigm that formulates tracking as matching between target and search regions, struggling with complex appearance variations. This paper proposes ART, an autoregressive visual tracking framework that reformulates tracking as a sequence generation problem, predicting bounding box coordinates autoregressively. It achieves 72.1%, 73.5%, and 84.2% AUC on LaSOT, GOT-10k, and TrackingNet respectively, surpassing Transformer-based discriminative trackers.
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.assessment: 将自回归生成范式引入视觉跟踪具有新意，性能提升显著，为跟踪领域提供了不同于判别式方法的新思路。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出自回归视觉跟踪框架 ART，将跟踪任务重新表述为边界框坐标的序列生成问题。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.innovation: 首次将自回归生成范式系统性地应用于视觉跟踪，替代传统判别式匹配方法。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.result: 在 LaSOT、GOT-10k、TrackingNet 上分别达到 72.1%、73.5%、84.2% AUC，超越 Transformer 判别式跟踪器。

2303.13913|v2.summary_cn: 衣物完整姿态的估计与跟踪对机器人操作和 VR/AR 应用有重要价值，但衣物的大幅非刚性形变使该任务极具挑战。本文提出完整解决方案：VR-Garment 数据采集系统、大规模 VR-Folding 数据集（含 flattening 和 folding 等复杂操作），以及端到端在线跟踪框架 GarmentTracking，从点云序列预测规范空间和任务空间中的完整衣物姿态。实验表明 GarmentTracking 在速度和精度上均优于基线方法，即使在大幅非刚性形变下仍保持良好性能。
2303.13913|v2.summary_en: Estimating and tracking complete garment poses is valuable for robotic manipulation and VR/AR, but large non-rigid deformation makes it challenging. This paper presents a complete solution: the VR-Garment recording system, the large-scale VR-Folding dataset with complex manipulation configurations, and GarmentTracking, an end-to-end online framework predicting complete garment pose in both canonical and task space from point cloud sequences. GarmentTracking outperforms the baseline in both speed and accuracy even under large non-rigid deformation.
2303.13913|v2.assessment: 面向衣物操作的系统性工作，数据集和框架完整，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，主要服务于机器人操作方向。
2303.13913|v2.contribution: 提出完整的类别级衣物姿态跟踪方案，包括 VR 数据采集系统、大规模数据集和端到端在线跟踪框架。
2303.13913|v2.innovation: 构建 VR-Garment 采集系统和 VR-Folding 数据集，实现大幅非刚性形变下的完整衣物姿态在线跟踪。
2303.13913|v2.result: 在速度和精度上均超越基线方法，在大幅非刚性形变下仍保持良好跟踪性能。

2303.05071|v2.summary_cn: 3D 单目标跟踪在自动驾驶中至关重要，但遮挡和尺寸差异导致的外观变化使该任务仍具挑战。本文提出 MBPTrack，采用记忆机制利用历史帧信息，并基于首帧框先验以由粗到精的方式定位目标。具体地，以带目标性掩码的历史帧作为外部记忆，通过 Transformer 模块将目标线索传播到当前帧；先通过 Hough 投票预测目标中心，再基于框先验自适应采样参考点覆盖不同尺寸目标，聚合点特征获得稠密特征图进行精定位。在 KITTI、nuScenes 和 Waymo Open Dataset 上均取得 SOTA 性能。
2303.05071|v2.summary_en: 3D single object tracking is crucial for autonomous driving but remains challenging due to appearance variations from occlusion and size differences. This paper proposes MBPTrack, which employs a memory mechanism to leverage past information and formulates localization in a coarse-to-fine scheme using box priors from the first frame. Past frames with targetness masks serve as external memory, and a Transformer module propagates target cues to the current frame. Hough voting predicts the target center, and reference points are adaptively sampled around it to cover targets of different sizes. MBPTrack achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo Open Dataset.
2303.05071|v2.assessment: 记忆机制与框先验的结合有效解决了 3D 跟踪中的遮挡和尺寸变化问题，在三大自动驾驶数据集上验证了方法的通用性和优越性，对自动驾驶 3D 感知有直接参考价值。
2303.05071|v2.contribution: 提出 MBPTrack，结合记忆网络和框先验实现由粗到精的 3D 点云单目标跟踪。
2303.05071|v2.innovation: 利用带目标性掩码的历史帧作为外部记忆，并基于首帧框先验自适应采样参考点以覆盖不同尺寸目标。
2303.05071|v2.result: 在 KITTI、nuScenes 和 Waymo Open Dataset 上均取得 SOTA 跟踪性能。

2309.14491|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中闭集3D感知模型无法处理部署后出现的新类别物体的问题，本文提出一种多模态自动标注流水线，无需3D人工标注即可生成开放集类别的amodal 3D边界框和轨迹。该方法利用点云序列中的运动线索与免费获取的2D图像-文本对，识别并跟踪所有交通参与者，并通过视觉-语言知识蒸馏输出开放词汇语义标签。相比此前只能提供限于运动物体的类别无关自动标注的工作，本方法可同时处理静态和运动物体。在Waymo Open Dataset上，该方法在多项无监督3D感知任务上显著超越先前工作。
2309.14491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inadequacy of closed-set 3D perception models for autonomous driving, where novel object categories may appear after deployment. It presents a multi-modal auto-labeling pipeline that generates amodal 3D bounding boxes and tracklets for open-set categories without any 3D human labels, exploiting motion cues in point cloud sequences and freely available 2D image-text pairs. Unlike prior work limited to class-agnostic labels for moving objects, the method handles both static and moving objects and produces open-vocabulary semantic labels via vision-language knowledge distillation. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset show significant improvements over prior work across various unsupervised 3D perception tasks.
2309.14491|v2.assessment: 该工作将2D视觉-语言蒸馏与点云运动线索结合，解决了开放集3D感知中缺乏3D标注的核心瓶颈，对自动驾驶感知的开放世界部署具有重要参考价值。
2309.14491|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需3D人工标注、可生成开放词汇amodal 3D框与轨迹的多模态自动标注流水线。
2309.14491|v2.innovation: 利用2D图像-文本对进行视觉-语言知识蒸馏，为无监督3D感知赋予开放词汇语义标签，并同时覆盖静态与运动物体。
2309.14491|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上多项无监督3D感知任务显著超越先前工作。

2308.06904|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于Transformer的视觉跟踪器速度慢、难以部署在算力受限设备上的问题，本文提出HiT系列高效跟踪模型。其核心是Bridge Module，将深层特征的高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，为跟踪头提供更优特征；同时提出双图像位置编码，同时编码搜索区域与模板图像的位置信息。HiT在Nvidia Jetson AGX边缘设备上达到61 fps，在LaSOT基准上取得64.6% AUC，超越所有先前的高效跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.summary_en: To address the low speed of transformer-based visual trackers that hinders deployment on resource-constrained devices, this paper proposes HiT, a family of efficient tracking models. Its central component, the Bridge Module, injects high-level information from deep features into shallow large-resolution features to produce better features for the tracking head, and a dual-image position encoding jointly encodes positions of the search region and template. HiT runs at 61 fps on an Nvidia Jetson AGX edge device and achieves 64.6% AUC on LaSOT, surpassing all previous efficient trackers.
2308.06904|v2.assessment: 该工作在轻量级层次化ViT与跟踪框架的结合上做了扎实的工程与结构设计，边缘设备上的实时性能与精度平衡对实际部署有较高价值。
2308.06904|v2.contribution: 提出HiT高效跟踪模型家族，通过Bridge Module与双图像位置编码在边缘设备上实现高速度与高精度。
2308.06904|v2.innovation: Bridge Module将深层高层信息桥接到浅层大分辨率特征，并设计同时编码搜索区域与模板位置的双图像位置编码。
2308.06904|v2.result: 在Jetson AGX上达61 fps，LaSOT上64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。

2309.00942|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中缺乏标签监督、且易受目标相互干扰与遮挡影响的问题，本文探索跨视频帧样本特征的潜在一致性，提出无监督对比相似性学习方法UCSL，包含自对比、交叉对比和歧义对比三个模块。自对比通过帧内直接与帧间间接对比最大化自相似性以获得判别性表示；交叉对比对齐跨帧与连续帧匹配结果，缓解遮挡带来的持续负面影响；歧义对比通过隐式方式匹配歧义目标以提升后续关联确定性。在现有基准上，该方法仅借助有限的ReID头辅助即超越现有无监督方法，甚至比许多全监督方法精度更高。
2309.00942|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised multiple object tracking, which suffers from mutual interference and occlusion without label supervision, by exploring latent consistency of sample features across frames. It proposes UCSL, an unsupervised contrastive similarity learning method with three modules: self-contrast for discriminative representations via intra-frame direct and inter-frame indirect contrast, cross-contrast for aligning cross- and continuous-frame matching to mitigate occlusion effects, and ambiguity contrast for implicitly matching ambiguous objects. On existing benchmarks, UCSL outperforms existing unsupervised methods with only limited ReID head assistance and even surpasses many fully supervised methods.
2309.00942|v2.assessment: 该工作从特征一致性角度切入无监督MOT，三个对比模块设计有针对性，且结果能超过部分全监督方法，说明无监督MOT的潜力被进一步挖掘。
2309.00942|v2.contribution: 提出包含自对比、交叉对比与歧义对比的无监督对比相似性学习框架UCSL用于多目标跟踪。
2309.00942|v2.innovation: 通过跨帧特征一致性建模与歧义目标的隐式匹配，在无标签条件下缓解遮挡与目标干扰。
2309.00942|v2.result: 仅借助有限ReID头即超越现有无监督方法，并比许多全监督方法精度更高。

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中目标外观相似、遮挡和运动模糊导致的身份混淆是长期难题。该论文提出DeconfuseTrack方法，通过设计去混淆机制来缓解跟踪过程中的身份歧义问题。相比已有工作，其改进点在于显式建模并处理混淆场景下的特征判别。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法针对MOT核心痛点具有实际意义。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_en: Identity confusion caused by similar appearance, occlusion, and motion blur remains a long-standing challenge in multi-object tracking. This paper proposes DeconfuseTrack, which introduces a de-confusion mechanism to mitigate identity ambiguity during tracking. The improvement lies in explicitly modeling and handling discriminative features under confusing scenarios, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.assessment: 针对MOT中身份混淆这一核心问题提出专门解决方案，思路清晰，但需关注其在大规模基准上的验证效果。

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.innovation: 显式建模并处理跟踪中的混淆场景，提升特征判别能力。

The improvement lies in focusing on cross-domain generalization rather than single-dataset performance, though specific results are not provided in the abstract.

HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_en: Template updating in visual tracking struggles to balance adaptability and stability, leading to tracking drift. This paper proposes HIPTrack, which leverages historical prompts to guide the tracking process and improve robustness by retaining historical information. The improvement lies in introducing a historical prompt mechanism rather than single-template updating, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.

2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: Tracking-by-attention（TBA）方法在3D跟踪中潜力大，但性能持续落后于tracking-by-detection（TBD），尤其在长遮挡和困难检测场景。该论文提出基于LiDAR的联合检测跟踪器JDT3D，通过分析TBA落后原因，提出track sampling augmentation和confidence-based query propagation两种通用方法。在nuScenes测试集上AMOTA达到0.574，超越所有现有LiDAR-based TBA方法超过6%。该工作还讨论了现有TBA模型公式的潜在挑战，为后续研究提供方向。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: Tracking-by-attention (TBA) methods have potential but consistently lag behind tracking-by-detection (TBD) in 3D tracking, especially under long occlusions and challenging detection settings. This paper proposes JDT3D, a LiDAR-based joint detector and tracker, and introduces two generalizable methods—track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation—to bridge the gap. JDT3D achieves 0.574 AMOTA on the nuScenes test set, outperforming all existing LiDAR-based TBA approaches by over 6%, and further discusses challenges in current TBA formulations.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 系统分析了TBA落后于TBD的原因并提出有效改进，在nuScenes上取得显著提升，对3D跟踪和自动驾驶感知有重要参考价值。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出JDT3D，通过track sampling augmentation和confidence-based query propagation缩小TBA与TBD的性能差距。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析TBA落后原因，并提出两种通用方法改进LiDAR-based TBA。
2407.04926|v2.result: 在nuScenes测试集上AMOTA达到0.574，超越所有现有LiDAR-based TBA方法超过6%。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: 现有MOT方法依赖对所有视频帧的密集边界框和实例ID标注，成本极高。本文提出Walker，首个仅需稀疏边界框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督跟踪器：构建准稠密时序物体外观图，用多正样本对比目标优化图上随机游走以学习实例相似度，并引入互斥连通性约束优化图拓扑；推理时基于运动约束双向游走的最大似然转移状态关联检测与轨迹。在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上达到自监督跟踪器的最优性能，且在标注量减少最多400倍的情况下仍超越此前自监督方法。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods require exhaustive per-frame bounding box and instance ID annotations, which are prohibitively expensive. This paper introduces Walker, the first self-supervised tracker that learns from videos with only sparse bounding box annotations and no tracking labels, via a quasi-dense temporal object appearance graph optimized with a multi-positive contrastive objective over random walks, plus mutually-exclusive connectivity constraints. At inference, detections are associated to tracklets via max-likelihood transition states under motion-constrained bi-directional walks. Walker achieves competitive results on MOT17, DanceTrack, and BDD100K, outperforming prior self-supervised trackers while reducing annotation requirements by up to 400x.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 将自监督对比学习与图上的随机游走巧妙结合用于MOT，标注效率提升显著，对降低自动驾驶数据标注成本有直接价值。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个仅依赖稀疏边界框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督多目标跟踪框架Walker。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 设计准稠密时序外观图上的多正样本对比目标与互斥连通性约束，并用运动约束双向游走的最大似然状态做关联。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上取得自监督跟踪器最优性能，标注需求最多降低400倍仍超越先前方法。

It distills matching knowledge from 2D trackers into the 3D tracking network and leverages 3D point cloud pre-training to strengthen feature representations. 2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D单目标跟踪（SOT）多为类别专用模型，参数冗余且难以跨类别泛化。本文首次提出统一模型，用共享参数的单网络同时跟踪所有类别：显式编码不同类别的属性差异（主要来自点云物体的尺寸与形状差异，如大而方的车辆 vs 小而细长的人），设计继承Transformer架构的AdaFormer点集表示学习网络，自适应编码跨类别动态变化的形状与尺寸信息，并将已知模板目标的尺寸形状先验融入模型输入与学习目标。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D single object tracking (SOT) methods are largely category-specific, incurring redundant parameters and poor cross-category applicability. This paper introduces the first unified model that tracks objects across all categories with a single shared-parameter network, explicitly encoding category-specific attributes that mainly stem from varying size and shape (e.g., large square vehicles vs. small slender humans). It designs AdaFormer, a transformer-based point set representation learning network that adaptively encodes dynamically varying shape and size, and incorporates template-derived size/shape priors into inputs and the learning objective.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地将3D SOT从类别专用推向类别统一，AdaFormer对形状尺寸的自适应编码对点云感知研究有借鉴意义。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 提出首个跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪模型及AdaFormer点集表示学习网络。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 显式编码类别属性差异并将模板尺寸形状先验融入Transformer架构的输入与学习目标。
2401.11204|v2.result: 实现单网络共享参数跨类别跟踪，缓解了类别专用模型的参数冗余问题（摘要未给出具体数值）。
