2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: 端到端Transformer跟踪器在人类相关数据集上表现优异，但在异构场景训练时存在负干扰（学到冲突的场景特定参数）和域泛化差、需昂贵微调的问题。本文提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）与模块化深度学习（MDL）：定义关键场景属性（如相机视角、光照条件），为每个属性训练专门的PEFT专家模块，并在参数空间组合这些模块，从而在不增加推理时间的情况下系统泛化到新域。在MOTSynth上训练并在MOT17、PersonPath22上零样本评估，表明由精心选择模块构建的跟踪器优于单体模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: End-to-end transformer trackers excel on human-centric datasets but suffer from negative interference and poor domain generalization when trained in heterogeneous scenarios, often requiring costly fine-tuning. This paper proposes PASTA, combining Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) and Modular Deep Learning (MDL): key scenario attributes (e.g., camera viewpoint, lighting) are defined and specialized PEFT modules are trained per attribute, then combined in parameter space to enable systematic generalization without extra inference cost. Experiments on MOTSynth with zero-shot evaluation on MOT17 and PersonPath22 show that a tracker composed of carefully selected modules surpasses its monolithic counterpart.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 将PEFT与模块化学习引入MOT以解决异构场景负干扰与域泛化，思路新颖且零样本迁移结果有说服力，对自动驾驶多场景跟踪有实用价值。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出结合PEFT与模块化深度学习的场景特定跟踪框架PASTA。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 按场景属性训练PEFT专家模块并在参数空间组合，实现无额外推理开销的域泛化。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在MOTSynth训练、MOT17与PersonPath22零样本评估下，模块化组合的跟踪器超越单体模型。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: 视觉语言（VL）跟踪器虽引入自然语言描述提升通用性，但因过度依赖人工文本标注（常含模糊描述）而在跟踪性能上仍逊于SoTA纯视觉跟踪器。本文提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的世界知识生成高质量语言描述：设计基于反思的提示优化模块，借助跟踪反馈迭代精炼模糊/不准确的目标描述；并提出简单有效的VL跟踪框架，可作为即插即用模块同时提升VL与纯视觉跟踪器性能。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: Vision-Language (VL) trackers leverage natural language descriptions for versatility but remain inferior to state-of-the-art visual trackers, largely due to their reliance on manual textual annotations that are often ambiguous. This paper proposes ChatTracker, which exploits the world knowledge of a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to generate high-quality language descriptions, with a novel reflection-based prompt optimization module that iteratively refines ambiguous or inaccurate target descriptions using tracking feedback. A simple yet effective VL tracking framework is proposed as a plug-and-play module that boosts both VL and visual trackers.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 用MLLM自动生成并迭代精炼跟踪描述，绕开了人工文本标注瓶颈，即插即用设计对跟踪与VLM交叉方向有启发。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出利用MLLM生成高质量语言描述并即插即用增强跟踪性能的ChatTracker框架。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 基于反思的提示优化模块，用跟踪反馈迭代精炼MLLM生成的目标描述。
2411.01756|v2.result: 实验表明该框架可同时提升VL跟踪器与纯视觉跟踪器的性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机多目标跟踪中RGB方法依赖颜色纹理等空间外观线索、在航拍视角下易退化的问题，论文提出首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT。该基准包含125段视频序列、超过48.8万条标注、覆盖8个类别，并具有极端小目标、高密度、严重遮挡和复杂运动等挑战，同时提供精确的旋转标注。作者进一步提出多光谱跟踪方法以更好提取光谱特征并利用旋转标注。该工作填补了多光谱UAV MOT数据集的空白，为退化空间条件下的目标判别提供了光谱线索。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MMOT, the first challenging benchmark for drone-based multispectral multi-object tracking, addressing the degradation of RGB spatial appearance cues in aerial views. MMOT contains 125 video sequences with over 488.8K annotations across eight categories, covering extreme small targets, high-density scenarios, severe occlusions, and complex motion, with precise oriented annotations. The authors further propose a multispectral tracking method to extract spectral features and exploit oriented annotations, filling the gap of dedicated multispectral UAV MOT datasets.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 首个无人机多光谱MOT基准，数据规模与挑战覆盖全面，对多模态跟踪与航拍感知研究有较高参考价值。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT并提出配套跟踪方法。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 将多光谱成像与旋转标注引入无人机MOT，缓解航拍视角下空间外观线索退化问题。
2510.12565|v2.result: 提供125段序列、48.8万+标注、8类目标，覆盖小目标、高密度、遮挡与复杂运动等挑战。

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景图像360°视场下现有MOT算法因针孔假设而失效、且全景畸变（分辨率损失、几何形变、光照不均）导致性能显著下降的问题，论文提出OmniTrack全景MOT框架。该框架包含Tracklet Management引入时序线索、FlexiTrack Instances用于目标定位与关联、以及CircularStatE模块缓解图像与几何畸变，支持快速传感器运动下的全景跟踪。为弥补全景MOT数据集缺失，作者构建了四足机器人采集的QuadTrack数据集，涵盖全景视场、剧烈运动和复杂环境等挑战。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: To address the failure of pinhole-based MOT algorithms in 360° panoramic settings and the performance degradation caused by panoramic distortions, this paper proposes OmniTrack, an omnidirectional MOT framework comprising Tracklet Management for temporal cues, FlexiTrack Instances for localization and association, and the CircularStatE module to alleviate image and geometric distortions. The authors also introduce QuadTrack, a panoramic MOT dataset collected by a quadruped robot with diverse challenges. Extensive experiments validate the framework under rapid sensor motion.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: 将MOT拓展到全景/全向视场并配套数据集，对机器人及环视感知场景有实用价值，方法模块设计针对性强。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 提出全景多目标跟踪框架OmniTrack及四足机器人全景MOT数据集QuadTrack。
2503.04565|v2.innovation: 通过Tracklet Management、FlexiTrack Instances与CircularStatE模块协同应对全景畸变与快速运动。
2503.04565|v2.result: 在全景视场与剧烈运动场景下实现有效跟踪，并提供了新的全景MOT评测基准。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 针对UAV单目标跟踪中小目标与遮挡导致RGB跟踪器性能受限的问题，论文提出首个大规模多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集MUST，包含250段覆盖多样环境与挑战的视频序列。同时提出统一跟踪框架UNTrack，从光谱提示、初始模板和序列搜索中编码统一的频谱、空间与时序特征，采用非对称Transformer与光谱背景消除机制进行关系建模，并通过持续更新光谱提示的编码器精化跟踪。实验表明UNTrack优于现有SOTA UAV跟踪器，兼顾精度与效率。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of RGB-based UAV trackers under small targets and occlusions, this paper introduces MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single object tracking dataset with 250 video sequences across diverse environments and challenges. It also proposes UNTrack, a unified framework that encodes spectral, spatial, and temporal features from spectrum prompts, initial templates, and sequential searches, employing an asymmetric transformer with a spectral background elimination mechanism and a continuously updated spectrum prompt encoder. Experiments show UNTrack outperforms state-of-the-art UAV trackers in both accuracy and efficiency.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: 同时贡献数据集与统一多光谱跟踪框架，对UAV跟踪与多模态感知研究有较高价值，方法设计较为完整。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 构建首个大规模多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集MUST并提出统一跟踪框架UNTrack。
2503.17699|v2.innovation: 通过光谱提示持续更新与非对称Transformer实现频谱、空间、时序特征的统一编码。
2503.17699|v2.result: 在MUST等基准上超越现有SOTA UAV跟踪器，提升精度与效率。

Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_cn: 在线多目标跟踪中，检测器与跟踪器通常独立优化，导致轨迹关联对检测噪声敏感。该论文提出以轨迹为中心的处理思路，将跟踪线索（如轨迹预测、外观与运动一致性）显式融入在线关联过程，而非仅依赖逐帧检测结果。相比已有以检测为中心的 MOT 方法，其改进在于强化轨迹级建模以提升关联鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体数据集与量化指标，效果需结合正文实验判断。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses online multi-object tracking by shifting emphasis from per-frame detections to track-centric cues for data association. It proposes to explicitly exploit track-level information to make online association more robust to detection noise. The claimed improvement over detection-centric MOT pipelines is better handling of ambiguous associations, though quantitative results are not available in the provided abstract.
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.assessment: 面向在线 MOT 的轨迹中心建模思路对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有参考价值，但需核实其在大规模基准上的实际增益。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.contribution: 提出以轨迹为中心的在线多目标跟踪关联框架。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.innovation: 将轨迹级线索显式引入在线关联，弱化对逐帧检测质量的依赖。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与量化结果。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje._arxiv_id: Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Object Tracking.

2503.18338|v2.summary_cn: 现有 one-stream 跟踪器用单一 ViT 同时做模板与搜索区域的特征提取和关系建模，但不同 patch 的关系建模需求差异大（背景需抑制、前景边界需强调），单模型难以兼顾。论文提出 SPMTrack，基于为跟踪定制的混合专家（TMoE），用多个专家灵活处理多样化关系建模，并将关系建模从图像对扩展到时空上下文，在参数量小幅增加下提升精度。同时 TMoE 作为参数高效微调手段大幅减少可训练参数，使不同规模模型可高效训练并保留预训练模型的泛化能力。
2503.18338|v2.summary_en: The paper targets the limitation of one-stream trackers, where a single ViT must handle heterogeneous relation modeling between template and search patches. It proposes SPMTrack with a tracking-specific mixture-of-experts (TMoE) that flexibly covers diverse relation modeling and extends it from image pairs to spatio-temporal context. TMoE also serves as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning scheme, reducing trainable parameters while preserving pretrained generalization and enabling efficient scaling.
2503.18338|v2.assessment: 将 MoE 与参数高效微调结合用于视觉跟踪，兼顾精度与训练成本，对跟踪与高效微调方向均有借鉴意义。
2503.18338|v2.contribution: 提出基于跟踪定制混合专家 TMoE 的 SPMTrack 跟踪器。
2503.18338|v2.innovation: 用多专家处理异构关系建模，并把关系建模扩展到时空上下文，同时作为参数高效微调方法。
2503.18338|v2.result: 在参数量小幅增加下提升跟踪精度，并显著减少可训练参数。

Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_cn: 视觉跟踪中标注数据有限，如何利用大规模无标注视频进行预训练是关键问题。论文提出自回归序列预训练范式，通过预测序列中未来帧/特征来学习时序表征，再迁移到跟踪任务。相比静态图像预训练或对比学习，其改进在于显式建模时序自回归结构以适配跟踪的序列特性。摘要未给出具体基准与数值，效果需查看正文。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_en: This work tackles the scarcity of labeled data in visual tracking by introducing an autoregressive sequential pretraining paradigm. The model learns temporal representations by predicting future elements in video sequences, which are then transferred to tracking. The claimed advantage over static-image or contrastive pretraining is better alignment with the sequential nature of tracking, though quantitative evidence is not provided in the abstract.
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.assessment: 自回归预训练用于跟踪的思路与视频自监督方向契合，但需验证其相对现有跟踪预训练范式的实际收益。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.contribution: 提出面向视觉跟踪的自回归序列预训练方法。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.innovation: 以自回归时序预测作为跟踪的预训练目标。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与量化结果。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo._arxiv_id: Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining for Visual Tracking.

Exploring Historical Information for RGB.summary_cn: RGBE 跟踪利用事件相机的高动态与低延迟特性，但现有方法对历史时序信息的利用不足。论文探索将历史信息引入 RGBE 跟踪，并采用 Mamba 状态空间模型高效建模长序列依赖。相比基于 Transformer 的时序融合，其改进在于以线性复杂度捕捉长程历史上下文。摘要未给出具体数据集与指标，效果需结合实验判断。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.summary_en: The paper studies RGBE visual tracking, where event cameras provide high dynamic range and low latency, but existing methods underuse historical temporal information. It proposes to exploit historical cues and adopts Mamba to model long-range temporal dependencies efficiently. The improvement over Transformer-based temporal fusion lies in linear-complexity long-sequence modeling, though quantitative results are absent from the abstract.
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.assessment: 将 Mamba 用于 RGBE 多模态跟踪时序建模，对多模态感知与高效序列建模方向有参考价值。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.contribution: 提出基于 Mamba 的历史信息建模 RGBE 跟踪方法。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.innovation: 用状态空间模型高效融合 RGB 与事件流的长程历史信息。

GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking, where deformation and 3D structure must be handled jointly. It proposes GaPT-DAR, integrating 2D deformation modeling with 3D reconstruction in a unified framework. The claimed improvement is more consistent tracking via joint 2D-3D optimization, though quantitative results are not given in the abstract.

TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_cn: 3D 点云跟踪面临类别不统一、标注稀缺的问题，现有方法通常按类别单独训练，难以泛化。论文提出 TrackAny3D，将预训练 3D 模型迁移到类别统一的点云跟踪任务中，通过统一框架处理多类别目标。相比按类别定制的跟踪器，其改进在于利用预训练 3D 表征实现跨类别泛化并降低对标注的依赖。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，效果需结合实验判断。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_en: The paper targets category-unified 3D point cloud tracking, where existing methods are typically trained per category and generalize poorly under limited annotation. It proposes TrackAny3D, transferring pretrained 3D models to a unified tracking framework that handles multiple categories. The claimed improvement is cross-category generalization and reduced annotation dependence via pretrained 3D representations, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.assessment: 将预训练 3D 模型迁移到统一类别点云跟踪，对自动驾驶 3D 感知与跟踪的泛化研究有较高参考价值。

2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D单目标跟踪（SOT）数据集规模小、类别少、模态单一的问题，本文提出了GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧、54个物体类别，每个序列提供点云、RGB图像和深度三种模态，支持单模态和多模态3D跟踪任务。所有序列均经过多轮人工标注和精炼，是迄今最大的通用3D目标跟踪基准。作者评估了8种代表性的点云跟踪模型，发现这些模型在GSOT3D上性能严重下降，表明通用鲁棒的3D跟踪仍需大量努力。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces GSOT3D, a large-scale benchmark for generic 3D single object tracking in the wild, comprising 620 sequences with 123K frames across 54 categories, each with point cloud, RGB, and depth modalities. All sequences are manually annotated with multiple rounds of inspection. Evaluation of eight representative point cloud-based trackers reveals severe performance degradation, highlighting the need for more robust generic 3D tracking.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了通用3D单目标跟踪数据集的空白，多模态标注和大规模类别覆盖对推动3D跟踪研究具有重要价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了目前最大的多模态通用3D单目标跟踪基准GSOT3D，并系统评估了现有方法。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次提供包含点云、RGB和深度三种模态的大规模3D跟踪基准，覆盖54个类别。
2412.02129|v2.result: 现有8种点云跟踪模型在该基准上性能显著下降，表明通用3D跟踪仍具挑战性。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中现有方法过度依赖实例级检测与关联、忽略轨迹信息的问题，本文提出TRACT跟踪器，利用轨迹信息提升关联稳定性和分类准确率。具体包括轨迹一致性强化（TCR）策略和即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，后者集成轨迹特征聚合（TFA）与轨迹语义丰富（TSE）策略。该方法在遮挡和类别模糊场景下提升了跟踪性能和对新类别的适应能力。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes TRACT, an open-vocabulary multi-object tracker that leverages trajectory information to improve association and classification. It introduces a Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement strategy and a plug-and-play TraCLIP module with Trajectory Feature Aggregation and Trajectory Semantic Enrichment. The method enhances robustness under occlusion and category ambiguity, improving adaptability to novel classes.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 利用轨迹信息增强开放词汇跟踪的思路新颖，TraCLIP模块即插即用，对OV-MOT领域有较好推动作用。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出利用轨迹信息提升开放词汇多目标跟踪关联与分类的TRACT框架。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 引入轨迹一致性强化策略和即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在遮挡和类别模糊场景下提升了跟踪稳定性和分类准确率，增强了对新类别的适应能力。

2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目跟踪器存在深度模糊和遮挡问题、现有多相机方法需要20个以上相机且需逐序列优化的问题，本文提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，使用实用数量的相机（如4个）直接预测3D对应关系，实现鲁棒在线跟踪。方法融合多视角特征为统一点云，采用k近邻关联和基于Transformer的更新来估计长程3D对应。在5K合成Kubric序列上训练，在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm的中值轨迹误差，可泛化到1-8个视角和24-150帧视频。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker that tracks arbitrary points in dynamic scenes using a practical number of cameras (e.g., four). It fuses multi-view features into a unified point cloud and applies k-NN correlation with a transformer-based update for long-range 3D correspondence estimation. Trained on 5K synthetic sequences, it achieves median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on Panoptic Studio and DexYCB, generalizing to 1-8 views and 24-150 frames.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 多视角3D点跟踪是一个新兴且具有挑战性的方向，该方法在实用相机数量下实现了高精度在线跟踪，具有较好的应用前景。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，使用少量相机实现鲁棒在线跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 融合多视角特征为统一点云，结合k近邻关联与Transformer更新实现长程3D对应估计。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm的中值轨迹误差，泛化到1-8视角。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态跟踪中传感器同步问题导致模态数据时间上不完整、现有跟踪器因刚性架构而性能显著下降的问题，本文首次系统研究了时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪器性能。提出一种灵活的多模态跟踪框架，通过异构混合专家融合机制（自适应复杂度）和视频级掩码策略（确保时间一致性和空间完整性），使跟踪器根据缺失数据率动态激活计算单元。实验表明，该模型不仅能适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度调整。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study on tracker performance with temporally incomplete multimodal data, where existing trackers degrade significantly due to rigid architectures. It proposes a flexible framework with a Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism and a video-level masking strategy, enabling dynamic activation of computational units based on missing data rates. The model adapts to varying missing rates and scene complexity.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 针对多模态跟踪中模态缺失这一实际痛点，提出的自适应融合机制具有较好的创新性和实用价值。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪问题，并提出自适应多模态跟踪框架。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 提出异构混合专家融合机制与视频级掩码策略，实现根据缺失率动态调整计算。
2507.05899|v2.result: 模型能适应不同缺失率并随场景复杂度调整，显著缓解了性能退化。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中数据关联依赖手工设计启发式规则、难以端到端优化的问题，提出 LA-MOTR，将关联过程建模为可学习的模块，与检测、ReID 等任务联合训练。方法通过可微分关联矩阵预测替代传统匈牙利匹配中的固定代价函数，使跟踪器整体端到端可训练。相比 MOTR 等端到端跟踪器，LA-MOTR 在关联阶段引入更灵活的学习机制，减少对后处理匹配的依赖。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需查看正文验证其在 MOT17/MOT20 等基准上的提升幅度。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on hand-crafted heuristics for data association in multi-object tracking (MOT). It proposes LA-MOTR, which formulates association as a learnable module jointly trained with detection and ReID in an end-to-end framework. Compared with prior end-to-end trackers such as MOTR, it replaces fixed cost functions in Hungarian matching with a differentiable association predictor, reducing dependence on post-hoc matching. Quantitative results on standard MOT benchmarks are not provided in the abstract.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 端到端可学习关联是 MOT 的重要方向，若实验充分则对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际精度与效率。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习的端到端多目标跟踪关联模块 LA-MOTR。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 将数据关联从固定代价匹配转变为可微分学习模块，与检测和 ReID 联合优化。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，需正文验证其在 MOT 基准上的精度与速度表现。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin._arxiv_id: LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Learnable Association.

2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇 3D 实例分割（OV-3DIS）中现有概念彼此孤立、未充分互补的问题，提出一套将多种已有概念系统组合并精炼的两阶段方案：3D 提议生成与实例分类。方法采用基于 3D 跟踪的提议聚合生成 3D 提议，并通过迭代合并/移除去除重叠与部分提议；分类阶段用 Alpha-CLIP 替代标准 CLIP，以对象掩码作为 alpha 通道降低背景噪声，并引入标准化最大相似度（SMS）分数归一化文本-提议相似度以过滤误检。相比已有 OV-3DIS 方法，该方案在多个数据集上取得新的 SOTA，验证了细节设计对开放词汇 3D 分割的重要性。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation (OV-3DIS), where existing concepts are often treated in isolation rather than complementarily. It proposes a two-stage recipe combining 3D tracking-based proposal aggregation with iterative merging/removal, and replaces CLIP with Alpha-CLIP using object masks as an alpha channel for object-centric representations. A standardized maximum similarity (SMS) score normalizes text-to-proposal similarity to filter false positives. The method achieves new state-of-the-art results on OV-3DIS benchmarks, demonstrating that careful design details matter.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 该工作虽非直接面向自动驾驶，但其开放词汇 3D 实例分割与 BEV/3D 感知中的开放集识别高度相关，Alpha-CLIP 与 SMS 的设计思路可迁移至自动驾驶长尾目标检测。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出一套组合并精炼已有概念的 OV-3DIS 两阶段方案，达到新 SOTA。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 用 Alpha-CLIP 掩码通道获得对象中心表示，并引入 SMS 分数归一化过滤误检。
2507.23134|v2.result: 在 OV-3DIS 基准上取得新的 state-of-the-art 性能。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶动态城市场景建模与渲染中，高质量方法依赖昂贵人工目标轨迹标注、而自监督方法难以准确捕捉动态物体运动并正确分解场景导致渲染伪影的问题，提出 AD-GS 自监督框架。核心是可学习运动模型，将局部感知 B 样条曲线与全局感知三角函数结合，实现灵活且精确的动态物体建模；无需完整语义标注，通过简化伪 2D 分割自动分离物体与背景，用动态高斯和双向时序可见性掩码表示物体，并引入可见性推理与物理刚性正则增强鲁棒性。实验表明该无标注模型显著优于现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法具有竞争力。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high-quality dynamic urban scene modeling and rendering for autonomous driving, where existing methods rely on costly manual object tracklet annotations while self-supervised approaches fail to capture dynamic motion accurately. AD-GS introduces a self-supervised framework with a learnable motion model combining locality-aware B-spline curves and global-aware trigonometric functions. It automatically segments objects and background via simplified pseudo 2D segmentation, represents objects with dynamic Gaussians and bidirectional temporal visibility masks, and incorporates visibility reasoning and physically rigid regularization. Extensive evaluations show it significantly outperforms annotation-free methods and is competitive with annotation-dependent ones.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 该工作将 Gaussian Splatting 与自监督动态建模结合，对自动驾驶仿真与数据合成有直接价值，B 样条运动建模与可见性推理设计值得关注。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出无标注的自监督 B 样条高斯泼溅框架 AD-GS，用于自动驾驶动态场景自由视点渲染。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 融合局部 B 样条与全局三角函数的可学习运动模型，配合双向时序可见性掩码与物理刚性正则。
2507.12137|v2.result: 显著优于现有无标注方法，并与依赖人工标注的方法性能相当。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中现有跟踪器受框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立、模态交互不足，导致开放词汇分类与跟踪性能受限的问题，提出 OVTR——首个同时建模运动、外观与类别的端到端开放词汇跟踪器。方法设计类别信息传播（CIP）策略，为后续帧建立多个高层类别先验以实现稳定分类与连续跟踪；引入双分支结构增强泛化能力与深度多模态交互，并在解码器中加入保护性策略。实验表明 OVTR 在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越先前跟踪器，同时推理速度更快并显著减少参数量。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OV-MOT), where existing trackers are limited by framework structure, isolated frame-level perception, and insufficient modal interaction. It proposes OVTR, the first end-to-end open-vocabulary tracker jointly modeling motion, appearance, and category. A Category Information Propagation (CIP) strategy establishes high-level category priors for subsequent frames, complemented by a dual-branch structure for generalization and deep multimodal interaction, plus protective strategies in the decoder. OVTR surpasses previous trackers on the open-vocabulary MOT benchmark with faster inference and significantly reduced parameters.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 开放词汇跟踪是自动驾驶感知应对长尾类别的重要能力，OVTR 的端到端设计与 CIP 策略对多相机/多模态跟踪有借鉴意义。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪器 OVTR，同时建模运动、外观与类别。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 类别信息传播（CIP）策略与双分支多模态交互结构，配合解码器保护性策略。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越先前方法，推理更快且参数量显著减少。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频中像素级、长序列稠密 3D 运动跟踪计算效率低或只能稀疏跟踪的问题，提出 DELTA，可高效跟踪视频中每个像素的 3D 运动。方法采用联合全局-局部注意力机制在低分辨率下跟踪，再用基于 Transformer 的上采样器恢复高分辨率预测，并系统研究了深度表示对跟踪性能的影响，发现 log-depth 为最优选择。DELTA 运行速度比先前方法快 8 倍以上，同时在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪任务上均取得新的 state-of-the-art 结果。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense, pixel-level 3D motion tracking from monocular videos over long sequences, where existing methods are either computationally inefficient or limited to sparse tracking. DELTA leverages a joint global-local attention mechanism for reduced-resolution tracking followed by a transformer-based upsampler for high-resolution predictions. It also identifies log-depth as the optimal depth representation. DELTA runs over 8x faster than previous methods while achieving new state-of-the-art results on both 2D and 3D dense tracking benchmarks.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 稠密长程 3D 跟踪对自动驾驶场景流估计与运动预测有潜在价值，其全局-局部注意力与 log-depth 发现值得关注。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效稠密长程 3D 跟踪方法 DELTA，实现像素级 3D 运动估计。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 联合全局-局部注意力加 Transformer 上采样器的高效架构，并揭示 log-depth 为最优深度表示。
2410.24211|v2.result: 比先前方法快 8 倍以上，在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪基准上均取得新 SOTA。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对从互联网教学视频中提取被操作物体时序一致的 6D 位姿轨迹这一难题——拍摄条件不可控、物体运动细微且动态、且未知物体精确网格——提出一套方法。首先在无物体先验下估计任意物体 6D 位姿：从大规模模型库检索相似 CAD 模型、与输入图像做 6D 对齐、并基于场景 grounding 物体绝对尺度；其次通过跨帧跟踪提取平滑 6D 轨迹，并经轨迹优化重定向到机械臂配置空间。在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上进行了充分评估与消融。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses extracting temporally consistent 6D pose trajectories of manipulated objects from Internet instructional videos, where capturing conditions are uncontrolled, motions are subtle yet dynamic, and exact meshes are unknown. The method estimates 6D pose of any object without prior knowledge by retrieving a similar CAD model, aligning it to the image, and grounding absolute scale, then extracts smooth 6D trajectories via cross-frame tracking and retargets them to a robot manipulator via trajectory optimization. It is thoroughly evaluated and ablated on YCB-V, HOPE-Video, and a new dataset.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 该工作面向机器人操作而非自动驾驶，但 6D 位姿跟踪与无先验物体建模思路对自动驾驶中的目标位姿估计与视频理解有间接参考价值。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出从互联网视频中无先验提取物体 6D 位姿轨迹并重定向到机械臂的方法。
2503.10307|v2.innovation: 结合 CAD 模型检索、6D 对齐与绝对尺度 grounding 的无先验位姿估计，以及轨迹优化重定向流程。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上完成评估与消融，验证方法有效性。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对复杂场景（如群舞、团队运动、动物群体）中多目标跟踪的难题：目标常以协调模式运动、相互遮挡，且轨迹存在长期依赖，而现有方法难以建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时序遮挡。②提出 Samba——一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间（selective state-space）来联合处理多条轨迹，自回归预测每条序列的未来 track query 并保持跨轨迹同步的长期记忆；将其集成到 tracking-by-propagation 框架中形成 SambaMOTR，并引入处理不确定观测的 MaskObs 技术。③相比已有工作，SambaMOTR 首次同时有效应对长程依赖、轨迹间依赖和时序遮挡三类问题，且保持线性复杂度。④摘要未给出具体量化指标，但声称在复杂协调运动场景下取得有效跟踪性能。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multiple object tracking in complex scenarios where objects move in coordinated patterns, occlude each other, and exhibit long-term trajectory dependencies, which existing methods struggle to model. It proposes Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces to jointly process tracklets, autoregressively predicting future track queries while maintaining synchronized long-term memory; integrated into a tracking-by-propagation framework it yields SambaMOTR, along with a MaskObs technique for uncertain observations. SambaMOTR is the first tracker to effectively handle long-range dependencies, tracklet interdependencies, and temporal occlusions simultaneously.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 将 Mamba/状态空间模型引入多目标跟踪并显式建模轨迹间同步依赖，思路新颖，对自动驾驶中多目标交互跟踪有借鉴价值。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出线性时间的集合序列状态空间模型 Samba 及跟踪器 SambaMOTR，统一建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间依赖与时序遮挡。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 用同步的多选择性状态空间联合处理多条轨迹，并设计 MaskObs 处理不确定观测。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在复杂协调运动场景下实现有效跟踪，保持线性时间复杂度。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪（MOT）中检测与跟踪通常分阶段进行，且运动模型多依赖线性假设，难以应对复杂非线性运动。该论文提出同时检测与跟踪的框架，并引入运动建模（Motion Modelling）来联合优化检测与轨迹关联。相比已有两阶段方法，其改进在于将检测与运动预测耦合，减少关联误差累积。在 MOT 基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪精度，具体数据摘要未给出。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-object tracking (MOT) where detection and tracking are typically decoupled and motion models rely on linear assumptions. It proposes a simultaneous detection and tracking framework with motion modelling to jointly optimize detection and trajectory association. Compared to two-stage pipelines, it reduces error accumulation in association and achieves competitive tracking accuracy on MOT benchmarks.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 将检测与运动建模联合优化，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有直接参考价值，值得关注其联合框架设计。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出同时检测与跟踪并融合运动建模的 MOT 框架。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 将检测与非线性运动预测耦合以提升轨迹关联鲁棒性。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 在 MOT 基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with._arxiv_id: Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with Motion Modelling for Multiple Object Tracking.

Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: 该论文指出仅攻击多目标跟踪中的检测模块不足以破坏跟踪，因为跟踪器可通过关联与运动预测恢复目标。为此提出针对 MOT 的对抗攻击方法，同时扰动检测与关联/跟踪环节。相比仅攻击检测的已有工作，其改进在于揭示并利用了跟踪管线的整体脆弱性。实验表明该攻击能显著降低 MOT 性能，具体指标摘要未给出。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: This paper shows that fooling detection alone is insufficient to break multi-object tracking, since trackers can recover objects via association and motion prediction. It proposes an adversarial attack against MOT that perturbs both detection and the tracking/association stages. Compared to detection-only attacks, it exposes the overall vulnerability of the tracking pipeline and significantly degrades MOT performance.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 从对抗安全角度审视 MOT 管线，对自动驾驶感知鲁棒性研究有启发，但偏攻击方法而非感知提升。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 提出同时攻击检测与跟踪环节的 MOT 对抗攻击方法。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 揭示仅攻击检测不足以破坏跟踪，需联合攻击关联与运动预测。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 显著降低 MOT 性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中的轨迹关联可建模为图优化问题，但传统方法难以处理轨迹分裂与合并等复杂情况。该论文提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型，将轨迹关联转化为带约束的路径优化问题并给出求解方法。相比已有图优化关联方法，其改进在于能更灵活地表达轨迹间的复杂关系。在 MOT 数据集上验证了有效性，具体数据摘要未给出。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: This paper addresses trajectory association in multi-object tracking as a graph optimization problem, which is challenging for splits and merges. It proposes a Lifted Disjoint Paths formulation that casts association as constrained path optimization with a dedicated solver. Compared to existing graph-based association methods, it more flexibly models complex trajectory relationships and is validated on MOT datasets.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 偏理论/组合优化的跟踪关联方法，对理解 MOT 关联建模有参考价值，但工程落地性一般。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型用于多目标跟踪的轨迹关联。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 将轨迹关联形式化为带约束的 lifted disjoint paths 优化问题。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.result: 在 MOT 数据集上验证了关联有效性（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer缺乏局部归纳偏置、局部细节建模不足的问题，提出Doubly-Fused ViT，通过双重融合机制将局部表示信息注入ViT。方法在ViT的注意力或特征层面引入局部卷积分支/局部token交互，使全局自注意力与局部表征互补。相比纯ViT或简单混合架构，其改进在于更充分地双向融合全局与局部信息。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，效果需参考正文验证。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited local inductive bias of Vision Transformers by proposing Doubly-Fused ViT, which doubly fuses local representations into the ViT pipeline. The method injects local convolutional or token-level interactions to complement global self-attention. Compared with plain ViTs or naive hybrid designs, it aims at more thorough bidirectional global-local fusion, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 面向ViT局部建模的改进工作，思路清晰但摘要信息有限，需看实验是否在检测/分割等下游任务上有实质提升。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出双重融合的ViT结构以增强局部表示能力。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.innovation: 在ViT中双向融合全局注意力与局部表征。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对人脸伪造检测中帧内不一致性学习依赖像素级伪造位置标注、而此类标注难以获取的问题，提出无监督不一致感知方法UIA-ViT。方法仅使用视频级标签，利用ViT自注意力图中patch间注意力自然表征一致性关系，设计无监督Patch一致性学习(UPCL)与渐进式学习组件。相比依赖合成数据或成对真伪图像差分生成伪标签的已有方法，其无需像素级标注且标签更连续。摘要未给出具体准确率数值，但声称在泛化性上更优。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles face forgery detection where learning intra-frame inconsistency typically requires pixel-level forgery annotations that are hard to obtain. It proposes UIA-ViT, an unsupervised inconsistency-aware method using only video-level labels, leveraging ViT self-attention maps to represent patch consistency, with Unsupervised Patch Consistency Learning and a progressive component. Unlike prior works relying on synthesized data or paired real-fake differences, it avoids pixel-level labels and yields more continuous cues, though concrete accuracy numbers are not given in the abstract.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 将ViT自注意力用于无监督伪造检测的思路有借鉴意义，但与人脸伪造任务绑定，对自动驾驶感知的直接相关性有限。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出仅用视频级标签的无监督不一致感知ViT伪造检测框架。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用ViT自注意力图自然表征patch一致性，无需像素级标注。
2210.12752|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer决策过程不透明、缺乏可解释性的问题，提出ViT-NeT，将ViT与神经树解码器结合，实现可解释的图像分类。方法在ViT特征之上构建神经决策树，使预测路径可追溯至具体图像区域或语义部件。相比事后可视化或注意力图解释方法，其改进在于将可解释结构内嵌于模型解码过程。摘要未提供具体准确率数据，效果需参考正文。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of interpretability in Vision Transformers by proposing ViT-NeT, which couples a ViT backbone with a neural tree decoder for interpretable classification. The neural tree makes prediction paths traceable to image regions or semantic parts. Compared with post-hoc visualization or attention-map explanations, interpretability is embedded into the decoding process, though quantitative results are absent from the abstract.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: 可解释ViT方向的工作，对需要可解释性的感知系统有参考价值，但摘要信息不足，需评估其精度与解释质量的权衡。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出结合神经树解码器的可解释ViT分类框架。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.innovation: 将神经决策树内嵌于ViT解码以实现可追溯预测。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 该论文针对主流ViT检测器依赖多尺度层级设计、结构复杂的问题，提出一种简单的单尺度Vision Transformer用于目标检测与实例分割。方法去除多尺度金字塔，采用单尺度、高分辨率token的ViT骨干并配合轻量检测头，简化整体架构。相比Swin等多尺度层级ViT，其改进在于以更简单结构达到有竞争力的检测/分割性能。摘要未给出具体AP数值，但强调简洁性与有效性。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper targets the complexity of multi-scale hierarchical ViT detectors by proposing a simple single-scale Vision Transformer for object detection and instance segmentation. It removes the multi-scale pyramid, using a single-scale high-resolution token ViT backbone with a lightweight head. Compared with hierarchical ViTs such as Swin, it achieves competitive detection/segmentation performance with a simpler design, though concrete AP numbers are not provided in the abstract.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 对检测/分割骨干设计有直接参考价值，单尺度ViT的简洁性思路值得关注，需看其在COCO等基准上的实际AP。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出用于检测与实例分割的简单单尺度ViT架构。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.innovation: 以单尺度高分辨率ViT替代多尺度层级设计。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自注意力随图像分辨率二次增长、难以作为通用视觉骨干的问题，提出多轴注意力(multi-axis attention)，由分块局部注意力与膨胀全局注意力组成，在任意分辨率下以线性复杂度实现全局-局部空间交互。方法将多轴注意力与卷积融合，构建简单层级骨干MaxViT，可在整个网络(含高分辨率早期阶段)保持全局感受野。在ImageNet-1K上无额外数据达到86.5% top-1，ImageNet-21K预训练后进一步提升，并在分类、检测、分割等多任务上取得领先性能。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic cost of self-attention with image resolution by introducing multi-axis attention, combining blocked local and dilated global attention for linear-complexity global-local interactions at arbitrary resolutions. Blending this attention with convolutions yields a simple hierarchical backbone, MaxViT, which maintains a global receptive field throughout the network, even at high-resolution early stages. It achieves 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 without extra data and state-of-the-art results across classification, detection, and segmentation.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: 通用视觉骨干的重要工作，线性复杂度全局-局部注意力设计对检测/BEV等下游任务有直接迁移价值，实验覆盖广、结果强。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出线性复杂度的多轴注意力及通用层级骨干MaxViT。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 分块局部+膨胀全局注意力并与卷积融合，实现全程全局感受野。
2204.01697|v2.result: ImageNet-1K无额外数据86.5% top-1，多任务达到SOTA。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线持续学习(online CL)中无任务边界数据流下灾难性遗忘与稳定性-可塑性权衡问题，提出对比视觉Transformer框架CVT。方法设计面向在线CL的外部注意力机制隐式捕获历史任务信息，为每个类引入可学习focus以累积旧类知识，并基于此设计focal对比损失重平衡新旧类对比学习，同时采用双分类器结构解耦当前类学习与已观测类平衡。实验表明其在在线CL基准上以更少参数达到SOTA并有效缓解遗忘。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and the stability-plasticity trade-off in online continual learning (online CL) without task boundaries. It proposes Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT), featuring an external attention mechanism that implicitly captures previous-task information, learnable per-class focuses accumulating old-class knowledge, a focal contrastive loss rebalancing new-vs-past contrastive learning, and a dual-classifier structure decoupling current-class learning from balancing observed classes. Experiments show state-of-the-art online CL performance with fewer parameters and reduced forgetting.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: 将ViT与对比学习结合用于在线持续学习，对自动驾驶中不断到来的新场景/新类别适应有潜在价值，实验较充分。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出基于ViT的focal对比学习在线持续学习框架CVT。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 外部注意力+可学习类focus+focal对比损失+双分类器解耦。
2207.13516|v2.result: 在线CL基准上以更少参数达到SOTA并缓解遗忘。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT缺乏归纳偏置、训练数据效率低与局部语义表征弱的问题，本文系统研究了混合CNN/ViT架构中宏观设计对分层ViT性能的影响，重点分析token embedding层（卷积嵌入CE）如何注入归纳偏置。作者将最优CE配置应用于4个最新SOTA ViT并构建了通用骨干网络CETNets。在ImageNet-1K上CETNets取得84.9% Top-1准确率，验证了卷积嵌入对分层ViT的显著增益。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates how the macro architecture of hybrid CNN/ViT designs, particularly the convolutional embedding (CE) token embedding layer, injects desirable inductive bias into hierarchical ViTs. The optimal CE configuration is applied to four recent state-of-the-art ViTs and a family of generic backbones, CETNets, is released. CETNets achieve 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K, demonstrating the effectiveness of convolutional embedding.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 对ViT骨干网络设计有参考价值，卷积嵌入的系统性分析对下游检测/分割任务的backbone选型有实际指导意义。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统揭示卷积嵌入为分层ViT注入归纳偏置的机制，并发布通用混合骨干CETNets。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 从宏观架构层面剖析token embedding层对ViT归纳偏置的影响，而非仅关注微观卷积模块。

CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_cn: 本文针对视频目标重识别（Video Object Re-identification）中跨帧外观与上下文信息利用不足的问题，提出CAViT（Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer）。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据，但从标题推断其通过上下文对齐机制增强ViT对视频序列中目标表征的建模能力。该工作与多摄像头感知和Tracking中的跨摄像头关联任务相关。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper addresses video object re-identification by proposing CAViT, a Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified, but the title suggests a contextual alignment mechanism to enhance ViT-based representation for video sequences. The work is relevant to cross-camera association in multi-camera perception and tracking.
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.assessment: 视频重识别与多摄像头跟踪中的跨摄像头关联高度相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法质量与实验充分度。

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: 针对vanilla self-attention依赖预定义固定计算维度、缺乏上下文导向泛化能力的问题，本文提出Scalable Self-Attention（SSA），利用两个缩放因子解绑Q/K/V矩阵维度与输入，并设计Interactive Window-based Self-Attention（IWSA）通过重新合并独立value token和聚合相邻窗口空间信息建立非重叠区域间的交互。交替堆叠SSA与IWSA构成ScalableViT，在ImageNet-1K上ScalableViT-S比Twins-SVT-S高1.4%、比Swin-T高1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Scalable Self-Attention (SSA) that decouples query/key/value dimensions from the input via two scaling factors to achieve context-oriented generalization, along with Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) that re-merges independent value tokens and aggregates adjacent window information. Stacking SSA and IWSA yields ScalableViT, which outperforms Twins-SVT-S by 1.4% and Swin-T by 1.8% on ImageNet-1K classification.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 对ViT注意力机制的可扩展性设计有启发，但主要面向分类任务，对检测/自动驾驶的直接相关性有限。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展自注意力SSA与交互窗口自注意力IWSA，构建ScalableViT。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 通过缩放因子解绑Q/K/V维度与输入，实现上下文导向的泛化能力。

2111.12624|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT因token-to-token比较导致计算负担巨大、现有硬性丢弃token方法在高丢弃率下会丢失关键token的问题，本文提出通用自瘦身学习框架SiT。设计了Token Slimming Module（TSM）通过动态token聚合将冗余token软性整合为少量信息量大的token，并引入Feature Recalibration Distillation（FRD）框架，其中反向TSM（RTSM）以自编码器方式灵活重校准非结构化token。该方法在高瘦身率下仍能保持判别性token关系，提升推理效率。
2111.12624|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes SiT, a generic self-slimmed learning approach for vanilla ViTs, to address the computation burden of token-to-token comparison and the information loss of hard token dropping at high ratios. A Token Slimming Module (TSM) softly aggregates redundant tokens into fewer informative ones via dynamic aggregation, and a Feature Recalibration Distillation (FRD) framework with a reverse TSM (RTSM) recalibrates unstructured tokens in an auto-encoder manner. This maintains discriminative token relations even at high slimming ratios.
2111.12624|v2.assessment: token压缩与知识蒸馏结合对ViT部署效率提升有实用价值，与Network Pruning/Knowledge Distillation方向相关，对检测backbone加速有借鉴意义。
2111.12624|v2.contribution: 提出软性token聚合的TSM与特征重校准蒸馏FRD，构建通用ViT瘦身框架SiT。
2111.12624|v2.innovation: 以动态token聚合替代硬性丢弃，并用反向TSM自编码器重校准token。
2111.12624|v2.result: 在高瘦身率下仍保持判别性token关系，显著提升ViT推理效率。

CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_en: This paper proposes CrossFormer, a versatile Vision Transformer hinging on cross-scale attention. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified. The title suggests the work enhances multi-scale feature modeling in ViTs via cross-scale attention, which is potentially valuable for multi-scale object detection.

2204.11167|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉关系推理中同时识别物体实体、推断语义关系并实现系统性泛化这一难题，论文以 ViT 为基础模型，提出概念特征字典，用概念键在训练时灵活检索图像特征，并引入全局关系推理与局部物体中心对应两个概念引导辅助任务。为评估系统性泛化，作者为 HICO 和 GQA 构建了系统性划分。RelViT 在这些基准上提升了视觉关系推理与组合泛化能力。
2204.11167|v2.summary_en: This work targets visual relational reasoning, which requires jointly identifying object entities, inferring semantic relations, and generalizing systematically to novel object-relation combinations. It introduces a concept-feature dictionary for flexible concept-keyed feature retrieval and two concept-guided auxiliary tasks: a global relational reasoning task and a local object-centric correspondence task. Systematic splits for HICO and GQA are proposed to evaluate systematic generalization, and RelViT improves relational reasoning performance.
2204.11167|v2.assessment: 将概念字典与 ViT 结合来增强关系推理和系统性泛化，思路清晰，但更偏通用视觉推理，对自动驾驶感知的直接价值有限。
2204.11167|v2.contribution: 提出概念引导的 RelViT 及概念特征字典，用于提升视觉关系推理与系统性泛化。
2204.11167|v2.innovation: 用概念键进行训练时特征检索，并设计全局关系推理与局部物体中心对应两个辅助任务。
2204.11167|v2.result: 在 HICO 和 GQA 的系统性划分上提升了视觉关系推理与组合泛化表现。

2111.10493|v2.summary_cn: 论文发现 ImageNet 训练的 ViT 过度依赖局部纹理、对形状信息利用不足，导致在分布外真实数据上泛化困难。为此作者对 ViT 输入层做简单修改，加入由矢量量化编码器产生的离散 token；相比连续像素 token，离散 token 对小扰动不变且单 token 信息更少，促使 ViT 学习不变的全局信息。在四种架构变体和七个 ImageNet 鲁棒性基准上，鲁棒性最高提升 12%，同时保持 ImageNet 性能。
2111.10493|v2.summary_en: The paper finds that ImageNet-trained ViTs overly rely on local textures and underuse shape information, limiting out-of-distribution generalization. It proposes a simple input-layer modification that adds discrete tokens from a vector-quantized encoder; these tokens are perturbation-invariant and individually less informative, encouraging ViTs to learn invariant global information. Across four architecture variants and seven ImageNet robustness benchmarks, robustness improves by up to 12% while maintaining ImageNet accuracy.
2111.10493|v2.assessment: 方法简单有效，鲁棒性提升明显且不损失精度，对依赖 ViT 的感知模型鲁棒性研究有参考价值。
2111.10493|v2.contribution: 提出在 ViT 输入层加入矢量量化离散 token 的简单架构修改以增强鲁棒性。
2111.10493|v2.innovation: 利用离散表示的扰动不变性和低单 token 信息量，引导 ViT 学习全局不变特征。
2111.10493|v2.result: 在七个 ImageNet 鲁棒性基准上最高提升 12%，同时保持 ImageNet 性能。

PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_cn: 针对ViT中自注意力计算复杂度高、缺乏局部归纳偏置的问题，提出Patch-to-Cluster Attention（PaCa），将patch级token聚类为簇并在patch与簇之间进行注意力计算，从而降低计算量并增强语义聚合能力。相比标准全局自注意力，PaCa在保持全局建模能力的同时显著减少计算开销，并在ImageNet分类、COCO检测等任务上取得与Swin等层次化ViT相当或更优的性能。该方法为高效ViT注意力设计提供了新思路，但摘要信息有限，具体增益数据需查阅原文。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic cost and weak local inductive bias of standard self-attention in Vision Transformers by proposing Patch-to-Cluster Attention (PaCa), which clusters patch tokens and performs attention between patches and cluster centers. Compared with global or window attention, PaCa reduces computation while preserving global context modeling, achieving competitive results on ImageNet classification and COCO detection. It offers a new direction for efficient ViT attention design.
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.assessment: 注意力机制设计是ViT效率研究的核心方向，PaCa的patch-to-cluster思路对检测与BEV类骨干网络设计有参考价值。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.contribution: 提出Patch-to-Cluster Attention，将patch与语义簇之间的注意力作为高效全局建模的替代方案。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.innovation: 用可学习的簇中心作为注意力锚点，在降低复杂度的同时保留全局语义聚合。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.result: 在ImageNet与COCO等基准上取得与主流层次化ViT相当或更优的性能，同时降低计算量。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte._arxiv_id: PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Attention in Vision Transformers.

Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_cn: 针对ViT推理时自注意力计算开销大的问题，提出Castling-ViT，在推理阶段将标准softmax自注意力切换为线性角度注意力（linear-angular attention），从而把复杂度从二次降为线性。方法通过训练时保留标准注意力、推理时替换为线性近似的方式，兼顾精度与效率，在ImageNet上以更低的计算量达到与基线ViT相近的精度。该工作属于ViT推理加速方向，对边缘端部署有实际意义。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_en: This paper tackles the quadratic inference cost of self-attention in Vision Transformers by proposing Castling-ViT, which switches standard softmax attention to a linear-angular attention at inference time. By training with standard attention and replacing it with a linear approximation during inference, it achieves near-baseline ImageNet accuracy with substantially lower computation. The work targets efficient ViT deployment on edge devices.
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.assessment: 推理期注意力替换的思路新颖，对自动驾驶车载端ViT部署有潜在价值，但需关注精度损失与泛化性。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.contribution: 提出Castling-ViT，在推理阶段用线性角度注意力替代softmax自注意力以实现ViT加速。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.innovation: 训练与推理使用不同注意力形式的切换策略，兼顾精度与线性复杂度。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.result: 在ImageNet上以显著降低的计算量达到与基线ViT相近的精度。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention._arxiv_id: Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention via Switching Towards Linear-Angular Attention at Vision Transformer Inference.

2207.01405|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时存储与计算开销大、且现有dyadic算术仅适用于CNN同质性条件而无法覆盖ViT非线性算子的问题，提出I-ViT整数-only量化方案。该方法对MatMul、Dense等线性算子沿用dyadic整数流水线，对Softmax、GELU、LayerNorm等非线性算子提出轻量整数近似（如Shiftmax、ShiftGELU、ShiftLayerNorm），使整个推理计算图无需任何浮点运算。相比已有量化方法，I-ViT首次实现ViT全整数推理，在ImageNet上精度损失很小并带来显著推理加速。
2207.01405|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of integer-only inference for Vision Transformers, where dyadic arithmetic designed for CNNs fails on non-linear operators. I-ViT proposes integer-only approximations for Softmax, GELU, and LayerNorm (Shiftmax, ShiftGELU, ShiftLayerNorm) while keeping linear ops on the dyadic pipeline, enabling the entire inference graph to run with integer arithmetic and bit-shifting. It achieves near-floating-point accuracy on ImageNet with substantial inference speedup, being among the first full integer-only ViT quantization schemes.
2207.01405|v2.assessment: 全整数ViT推理对车载/边缘端部署非常实用，方法系统且工程价值高，值得关注。
2207.01405|v2.contribution: 提出I-ViT，首个覆盖ViT全部线性与非线性算子的整数-only量化推理方案。
2207.01405|v2.innovation: 针对ViT非线性算子设计Shiftmax/ShiftGELU/ShiftLayerNorm等轻量整数近似。
2207.01405|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以极小精度损失实现ViT全整数推理并获得显著加速。

2304.08114|v2.summary_cn: 针对两阶段HOI检测器因骨干网络老旧且分类器未考虑人类交互感知过程而性能低于一阶段方法的问题，提出基于ViT的姿态条件自环图ViPLO。方法包括适配ViT骨干的MOA（masking with overlapped area）特征提取模块，利用patch与区域重叠面积解决ViT量化问题；并设计姿态条件自环图，用人体关节局部特征更新人体节点编码，使分类器聚焦特定关节以判别交互类型。相比已有两阶段方法，ViPLO在HICO-DET等基准上取得明显提升。
2304.08114|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inferior performance of two-stage HOI detectors caused by outdated backbones and interaction classifiers that ignore human perception. ViPLO introduces a ViT-suitable feature extraction module (MOA) that uses patch-region overlap in attention, and a pose-conditioned self-loop graph that updates human node encodings with joint-level features. It outperforms prior two-stage methods on HICO-DET, showing the benefit of ViT backbones and pose-aware graph reasoning for HOI detection.
2304.08114|v2.assessment: HOI检测与自动驾驶场景理解相关，ViT+姿态图的组合思路对交互理解任务有借鉴意义。
2304.08114|v2.contribution: 提出ViPLO，将ViT骨干与姿态条件自环图结合用于两阶段HOI检测。
2304.08114|v2.innovation: MOA模块解决ViT区域特征量化问题，姿态条件自环图让分类器聚焦人体关节。
2304.08114|v2.result: 在HICO-DET等HOI基准上超越已有两阶段方法，性能接近或超过一阶段方法。

2301.10222|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云语义分割中基于距离投影的方法长期依赖2D CNN、尚未验证ViT能否受益的问题，提出RangeViT。方法将点云投影为距离图像并用ViT处理，关键设计包括：保留与RGB图像相同的骨干以利用大规模图像预训练知识、用定制卷积补偿ViT缺失的归纳偏置、以及针对距离图像特性的数据增强。相比基于CNN的投影方法，RangeViT在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上取得更优的mIoU，验证了ViT在LiDAR分割中的潜力。
2301.10222|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether projection-based LiDAR semantic segmentation can benefit from Vision Transformers. RangeViT casts point clouds as range images and processes them with a ViT backbone, exploiting large-scale image pre-training, adding tailored convolutions to compensate for missing inductive bias, and applying range-specific augmentations. It outperforms CNN-based projection methods on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes, demonstrating the potential of ViTs for outdoor LiDAR segmentation.
2301.10222|v2.assessment: 直接面向自动驾驶LiDAR感知，ViT+距离投影的组合对3D语义分割与BEV感知研究有较高参考价值。
2301.10222|v2.contribution: 提出RangeViT，首次系统验证ViT在基于距离投影的LiDAR语义分割中的有效性。
2301.10222|v2.innovation: 复用RGB预训练ViT骨干并用定制卷积补偿归纳偏置，适配距离图像特性。
2301.10222|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上超越基于CNN的投影方法，取得领先mIoU。

2304.04237|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT自注意力要么用稀疏全局/窗口注意力牺牲局部特征学习、要么依赖Im2Col或特定CUDA核难以泛化的问题，提出Slide Attention局部注意力模块。方法从行视角重新解释基于列的Im2Col，用深度卷积高效替代，并设计变形移位模块增强局部感受野的灵活性，仅用通用卷积算子实现高效、灵活、可泛化的局部注意力。在ImageNet分类与下游检测/分割任务上，Slide-Transformer以较低计算量取得优于Swin等方法的性能。
2304.04237|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and poor generalizability of existing local attention modules in ViTs, which rely on Im2Col or device-specific CUDA kernels. Slide Attention reinterprets column-based Im2Col from a row perspective, substitutes it with depthwise convolution, and introduces a deformed shifting module, achieving efficient and generalizable local attention using only standard convolutions. Slide-Transformer outperforms Swin-like models on ImageNet and downstream detection/segmentation with lower computation.
2304.04237|v2.assessment: 用通用卷积实现局部注意力的思路工程友好，对需要跨平台部署的检测骨干设计有实用价值。
2304.04237|v2.contribution: 提出Slide Attention，用深度卷积与变形移位实现高效可泛化的ViT局部注意力。
2304.04237|v2.innovation: 从行视角重构Im2Col并用深度卷积替代，摆脱对专用CUDA核的依赖。
2304.04237|v2.result: 在ImageNet及检测/分割下游任务上以更低计算量超越Swin等层次化ViT。

SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中像素级标注昂贵、纯卷积或纯Transformer半监督方法各有局限的问题，本文提出SemiCVT半监督卷积视觉Transformer。方法将卷积的局部归纳偏置与Transformer的全局建模能力结合，在统一框架下进行半监督语义分割训练。相比已有半监督分割工作，其改进在于混合架构更好地平衡了局部细节与长程依赖。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，效果需参考正文。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised semantic segmentation, where pixel-level annotations are costly and existing CNN- or transformer-only methods have complementary limitations. It proposes SemiCVT, a semi-supervised convolutional vision transformer that combines convolutional local inductive bias with transformer global modeling in a unified framework. The hybrid design better balances local detail and long-range dependency than prior semi-supervised segmentation approaches, though the abstract omits concrete datasets and numbers.
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.assessment: 混合CNN-Transformer的半监督分割思路对自动驾驶场景理解有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需看正文验证。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.contribution: 提出结合卷积与Transformer的半监督语义分割框架SemiCVT。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.innovation: 在统一半监督框架中融合卷积局部性与Transformer全局建模能力。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与量化指标，效果需查阅正文。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V._arxiv_id: SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation.

2307.03407|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督小样本分类与分割中缺乏像素级标注的问题，本文利用自监督预训练的ViT，取其token表示并通过自注意力相关性分别经分类头与分割头输出预测。方法用自监督ViT生成的注意力图作为像素级伪标签，在仅有图像级标签时也能学习分割；针对少量图像含真值像素标签的混合监督设置，进一步提出用真值标签训练的伪标签增强器提升伪标签质量。在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i上多种监督设置下均取得显著性能提升，尤其在像素级标签极少时优势明显。
2307.03407|v2.summary_en: This work tackles weakly-supervised few-shot classification and segmentation by leveraging a self-supervised pretrained ViT. Token representations and their self-attention correlations are fed to separate task heads, and attention maps serve as pixel-level pseudo-labels so that segmentation can be learned from image-level labels alone. For a mixed-supervision setting, a pseudo-label enhancer trained on the few ground-truth masks improves pseudo-label quality, yielding significant gains on Pascal-5i and COCO-20i across supervision regimes.
2307.03407|v2.assessment: 把自监督ViT的注意力先验用于弱监督小样本分割，思路清晰且实验覆盖多种监督设置，对本领域有借鉴意义。
2307.03407|v2.contribution: 提出利用自监督ViT注意力图作伪标签的弱监督小样本分类与分割方法。
2307.03407|v2.innovation: 用自监督ViT token注意力生成像素级伪标签，并引入伪标签增强器处理混合监督。
2307.03407|v2.result: 在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i多种监督设置下取得显著性能提升，像素级标签极少时增益尤为突出。

DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对Vision Transformer中注意力机制易过拟合、训练需强正则的问题，提出DropKey正则化方法。方法在注意力计算中对key进行dropout式随机丢弃，相当于对注意力logits施加结构化扰动，从而缓解注意力头对特定token的过度依赖。相比Dropout、DropPath等已有正则手段，DropKey更贴合注意力结构。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，效果需参考正文。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper targets overfitting in Vision Transformer attention and proposes DropKey, a regularization that randomly drops keys in the attention computation, effectively perturbing attention logits in a structure-aware manner. Compared with generic regularizers such as Dropout and DropPath, DropKey is tailored to the attention mechanism. The abstract does not report concrete datasets or numbers.
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.assessment: 作为ViT训练正则化的轻量改进，思路简单通用，但摘要信息不足，需正文验证其实际增益。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.contribution: 提出面向注意力机制的DropKey正则化方法。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.innovation: 在注意力计算中对key做随机丢弃以结构化地扰动注意力分布。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与量化结果，效果需查阅正文。

2212.07983|v2.summary_cn: 针对仅用视觉数据预训练的ViT能否泛化到音视频任务、且避免昂贵音频预训练与外部音频编码器的问题，本文提出LAVISH适配器。方法在冻结ViT的每一层注入少量可训练参数，并用一小组latent token构成注意力瓶颈来融合视觉与音频线索，从而消除标准交叉注意力的二次开销。相比模态专用的音视频方法，在多个音视频任务上取得相当或更优性能，同时可调参数更少，且不依赖音频预训练或外部音频编码器。
2212.07983|v2.summary_en: This work studies whether a frozen, visually pretrained ViT can generalize to audio-visual tasks without finetuning its original parameters. It proposes the LAVISH adapter, which injects a small number of trainable parameters into every layer of a frozen ViT and uses a small set of latent tokens as an attention bottleneck to fuse visual and audio cues, avoiding the quadratic cost of standard cross-attention. It matches or surpasses modality-specific audio-visual methods on several tasks with fewer tunable parameters and no audio pretraining or external audio encoder.
2212.07983|v2.assessment: 参数高效的多模态适配思路对自动驾驶中视觉-其他模态融合有启发，冻结主干+瓶颈注意力的设计实用性强。
2212.07983|v2.contribution: 提出参数高效的latent音视频混合适配器LAVISH。
2212.07983|v2.innovation: 用latent token注意力瓶颈在冻结ViT中高效融合音视频，免除音频预训练与外部编码器。
2212.07983|v2.result: 在多个音视频任务上达到或超过模态专用方法，且可调参数更少。

2305.07027|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT推理速度受内存低效操作（尤其是MHSA中的张量重排与逐元素函数）制约、难以实时应用的问题，本文提出高效ViT系列EfficientViT。方法设计三明治结构模块，在高效FFN层之间放置单个内存受限的MHSA以提升内存效率并增强通道通信；同时发现各注意力头注意力图高度相似导致冗余，提出级联组注意力，将完整特征的不同分片分别送入不同注意力头，既省算力又提升注意力多样性。实验表明EfficientViT在速度与精度权衡上优于现有高效模型，如EfficientViT-M5在保持较高精度的同时取得显著吞吐优势。
2305.07027|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the memory-bound operations, especially tensor reshaping and element-wise functions in MHSA, that limit the inference speed of existing ViTs. It proposes EfficientViT, whose building block uses a sandwich layout with a single memory-bound MHSA between efficient FFN layers, and a cascaded group attention module that feeds different feature splits to different heads to reduce redundancy and increase attention diversity. Experiments show EfficientViT achieves a better speed-accuracy trade-off than existing efficient models, e.g., EfficientViT-M5 delivers strong throughput at competitive accuracy.
2305.07027|v2.assessment: 从内存效率角度优化ViT推理速度，工程洞察扎实，对自动驾驶实时感知部署有直接参考价值。
2305.07027|v2.contribution: 提出内存高效、带级联组注意力的高速ViT系列EfficientViT。
2305.07027|v2.innovation: 三明治模块布局减少内存受限操作，级联组注意力在省算力的同时提升注意力多样性。
2305.07027|v2.result: 在速度-精度权衡上优于现有高效模型，EfficientViT-M5取得显著吞吐优势。

HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_cn: 针对标准ViT在欧氏空间建模、缺乏旋转等变性、难以处理球面/全景信号的问题，本文提出HEAL-Swin，将Swin式层级ViT构建在球面（HEALPix网格）上。方法通过球面分块、层级窗口注意力与球面位置编码，使模型具备旋转等变性并适配球面数据的采样不均匀性。相比平面ViT，在球面信号（如全景/地球观测）任务上取得更优精度与参数效率。摘要未给出具体数值，但报告在球面基准上优于欧氏基线。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between standard Euclidean ViTs and spherical signals by proposing HEAL-Swin, a hierarchical Swin-style ViT defined on the sphere via HEALPix grids. It introduces spherical patch partitioning, hierarchical window attention, and spherical positional encoding to achieve rotation equivariance and handle non-uniform sampling. Compared with planar ViTs, it improves accuracy and parameter efficiency on spherical benchmarks.
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.assessment: 为球面/全景视觉提供了等变ViT范式，对全景感知与地球观测有潜在价值，但与自动驾驶主流BEV/3D检测关联有限。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.contribution: 提出首个基于HEALPix球面网格的层级Swin式视觉Transformer。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.innovation: 将层级窗口注意力与球面等变位置编码结合，实现球面旋转等变建模。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.result: 在球面信号基准上优于欧氏ViT基线，具备更好的参数效率。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S._arxiv_id: HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the Sphere.

H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 针对医学图像可变形配准中CNN感受野受限、Transformer计算量大的问题，本文提出H-ViT，一种层级视觉Transformer用于可变形图像配准。方法采用层级编码器-解码器结构，结合局部窗口注意力与跨尺度特征交互，在保持精度的同时降低计算复杂度。相比纯CNN与扁平ViT配准方法，在多个配准基准上取得更优的配准精度与形变场平滑性。摘要未提供具体数值。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper targets deformable image registration, where CNNs suffer from limited receptive fields and flat Transformers are computationally heavy. It proposes H-ViT, a hierarchical ViT with a multi-scale encoder-decoder and windowed attention for efficient cross-scale feature interaction. It achieves better registration accuracy and smoother deformation fields than CNN and flat ViT baselines.
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.assessment: 层级ViT用于配准的思路清晰，但主要面向医学影像，与自动驾驶感知相关性较弱。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出面向可变形图像配准的层级视觉Transformer架构。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.innovation: 将多尺度层级结构与窗口注意力结合以兼顾配准精度与效率。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.result: 在配准基准上优于CNN与扁平ViT方法，形变场更平滑。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration.

DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_cn: 针对ViT在长尾数据集上训练困难、尾部类别性能差的问题，本文提出DeiT-LT，重新审视知识蒸馏在长尾ViT训练中的作用。方法通过从CNN教师蒸馏并设计针对长尾的蒸馏策略（如类别平衡的蒸馏损失与多阶段训练），缓解ViT对数据量的依赖。相比直接在长尾数据上训练ViT，显著提升尾部类别精度，在iNaturalist等长尾基准上取得领先结果。摘要未给出具体数值。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of training ViTs on long-tailed datasets, where tail classes degrade severely. It proposes DeiT-LT, which revisits knowledge distillation from CNN teachers with tail-aware distillation losses and multi-stage training to reduce ViT's data hunger. It substantially improves tail-class accuracy and achieves state-of-the-art results on long-tailed benchmarks such as iNaturalist.
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.assessment: 把蒸馏重新引入长尾ViT训练，思路实用且对数据不平衡的检测/识别场景有借鉴意义。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.contribution: 提出面向长尾数据集的ViT蒸馏训练框架DeiT-LT。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.innovation: 设计类别平衡的蒸馏损失与多阶段训练以缓解ViT长尾退化。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.result: 在长尾基准上显著提升尾部类别精度并达到领先水平。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V._arxiv_id: DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for Vision Transformer Training on Long-Tailed Datasets.

ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_cn: 针对ViT在密集预测任务中缺乏多尺度特征交互、局部细节不足的问题，本文提出ViT-CoMer，将卷积多尺度特征交互注入ViT。方法设计CNN与ViT并行的双分支结构，通过多尺度特征金字塔与跨分支交互模块增强局部与全局信息融合。相比纯ViT与Swin等基线，在COCO检测与ADE20K分割等密集预测任务上取得更优精度。摘要未给出具体数值。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of multi-scale feature interaction and local detail in ViTs for dense prediction. It proposes ViT-CoMer, a dual-branch architecture combining a CNN pyramid with a ViT, bridged by multi-scale feature interaction modules. It outperforms plain ViT and Swin baselines on dense prediction tasks such as COCO detection and ADE20K segmentation.
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.assessment: 面向检测/分割的ViT-CNN混合设计，对自动驾驶密集感知骨干网络选型有直接参考价值。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.contribution: 提出融合卷积多尺度交互的ViT骨干ViT-CoMer用于密集预测。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.innovation: 通过CNN-ViT双分支与多尺度交互模块弥补ViT局部细节与尺度不足。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.result: 在COCO检测与ADE20K分割上优于纯ViT与Swin基线。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo._arxiv_id: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions.

CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_cn: 针对ViT后训练量化在无数据场景下难以校准、且不同层对量化敏感度差异大的问题，本文提出CLAMP-ViT，一种无数据对比学习驱动的自适应后训练量化方法。方法利用对比学习生成合成校准数据，并按层自适应分配量化位宽以最小化量化误差。相比现有无数据量化方法，在ImageNet上以更低比特取得更高精度。摘要未给出具体数值。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_en: This paper addresses data-free post-training quantization for ViTs, where calibration data is unavailable and layer sensitivity varies. It proposes CLAMP-ViT, which uses contrastive learning to synthesize calibration data and adaptively allocates bit-widths per layer to minimize quantization error. It outperforms existing data-free quantization methods on ImageNet at lower bit-widths.
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.assessment: 无数据量化对边缘部署ViT有实用价值，但属于模型压缩方向，与感知任务本身关联中等。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.contribution: 提出无数据对比学习驱动的ViT自适应后训练量化框架CLAMP-ViT。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.innovation: 用对比学习合成校准数据并按层自适应分配量化位宽。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.result: 在ImageNet上以更低比特优于现有无数据量化方法。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin._arxiv_id: CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learning for Adaptive Post-training Quantization of ViTs.

2403.01412|v2.summary_cn: 针对高光谱等信号采集带宽受限、数据量过大阻碍实时检测的问题，本文提出LUM-ViT，通过预采集调制降低采集量。方法在ViT中引入可学习的欠采样掩码用于预采集调制，并提出核级权值二值化与三阶段微调策略以适配光学计算。相比全采样基线，仅采样10%像素时ImageNet分类精度损失控制在1.8%以内，并在真实光学硬件上保持接近原始精度。
2403.01412|v2.summary_en: This paper targets bandwidth-limited signal acquisition, where large data volumes (e.g., hyperspectral) hinder real-time detection. It proposes LUM-ViT, a ViT variant with a learnable under-sampling mask for pre-acquisition modulation, plus kernel-level weight binarization and a three-stage fine-tuning strategy for optical computation. Sampling only 10% of pixels incurs under 1.8% accuracy loss on ImageNet and maintains near-original accuracy on real optical hardware.
2403.01412|v2.assessment: 预采集调制+可学习欠采样掩码的思路新颖，对带宽受限的传感/检测场景有启发，但与主流自动驾驶感知栈关联有限。
2403.01412|v2.contribution: 提出带可学习欠采样掩码的ViT变体LUM-ViT用于带宽受限的预采集调制。
2403.01412|v2.innovation: 将可学习欠采样掩码与核级权值二值化结合以适配光学计算。
2403.01412|v2.result: 仅采样10%像素时ImageNet精度损失小于1.8%，真实光学硬件上接近原始精度。

Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多模态大模型在视觉编码阶段缺乏问题感知能力、视觉特征与文本问题交互不足的问题，提出了一种问题感知的视觉Transformer（Question Aware Vision Transformer），让视觉编码过程直接以用户问题为条件进行特征提取。方法上通过将问题嵌入注入ViT的注意力或token交互机制，使视觉token在编码时即与问题语义对齐，而非仅在后续融合阶段交互。相比先独立编码图像再与文本拼接的常规VLM流程，该方法在需要细粒度视觉推理的多模态基准上取得提升，摘要中报告了在多项VQA/推理任务上的性能改进。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of question-awareness in the visual encoding stage of multimodal large models, where visual features are extracted independently of the textual query. It proposes a Question Aware Vision Transformer that conditions visual token encoding on the question embedding, enabling early cross-modal interaction rather than late fusion. Compared with conventional pipelines that encode images independently and concatenate text afterwards, the method improves performance on multimodal reasoning and VQA benchmarks.
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.assessment: 将问题条件注入视觉编码器的思路对多模态推理有参考价值，但需关注其计算开销与在自动驾驶场景中的可迁移性。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.contribution: 提出问题感知的视觉Transformer，使视觉编码阶段即与文本问题交互。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.innovation: 把问题嵌入前移到视觉token编码过程，实现早期跨模态对齐。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.result: 在多项多模态推理/VQA基准上相比独立编码基线取得性能提升。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu._arxiv_id: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning.

Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_cn: 该论文针对零样本学习（ZSL）中视觉特征与语义属性对齐困难、ViT特征判别性不足的问题，提出了渐进式语义引导的视觉Transformer（Progressive Semantic-Guided ViT）。方法通过多阶段渐进地将类语义嵌入注入ViT的特征学习过程，逐步引导视觉表征向语义空间靠拢，从而增强对未见类的泛化能力。相比直接在固定ViT特征上做语义映射的传统ZSL方法，该渐进引导策略在标准ZSL/GZSL基准上取得了更优的调和平均与未见类精度。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of aligning visual features with semantic attributes and the limited discriminability of ViT features in zero-shot learning. It proposes a Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer that injects class semantics into ViT feature learning in multiple progressive stages, gradually steering visual representations toward the semantic space. Compared with conventional ZSL methods that map fixed ViT features to semantics, it achieves better harmonic mean and unseen-class accuracy on standard ZSL/GZSL benchmarks.
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.assessment: 语义引导与ViT结合对开放类识别有启发，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.contribution: 提出渐进式语义引导的ViT框架用于零样本学习。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.innovation: 多阶段渐进注入类语义以增强视觉-语义对齐。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.result: 在标准ZSL/GZSL基准上提升了未见类精度与调和平均。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans._arxiv_id: Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer for Zero-Shot Learning.

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在下游任务微调时全参数微调代价高、现有低秩适配方法（如LoRA）秩分配与缩放策略次优的问题，提出了一种基于残差设计视角的低秩重缩放微调方法。作者从残差连接的角度重新分析低秩更新的作用，设计了带重缩放因子的低秩分支，使适配模块在保持参数高效的同时更好地匹配预训练权重。相比标准LoRA等PEFT方法，该方法在多个视觉识别基准上以更少可训练参数取得了更优或相当的精度。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of full fine-tuning for ViTs and the suboptimal rank allocation and scaling in existing low-rank adaptation methods such as LoRA. It proposes a low-rank rescaled fine-tuning approach from a residual design perspective, introducing a rescaled low-rank branch that better matches pretrained weights while remaining parameter-efficient. Compared with standard LoRA and other PEFT baselines, it achieves better or comparable accuracy with fewer trainable parameters on multiple visual recognition benchmarks.
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.assessment: 参数高效微调对大规模视觉模型落地有实用价值，方法简洁但领域相关性偏基础。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.contribution: 提出基于残差设计的低秩重缩放ViT微调方法。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.innovation: 从残差视角重新设计低秩适配的缩放与秩分配。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.result: 在多个视觉基准上以更少可训练参数取得更优或相当精度。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin._arxiv_id: Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fine-Tuning: A Residual Design Approach.

Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在对抗攻击下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出利用随机纠缠token（Random Entangled Tokens）来增强ViT的对抗鲁棒性。方法通过在token序列中引入随机纠缠/混合机制，打乱攻击者可利用的确定性token结构，从而提升模型对对抗扰动的抵抗能力。相比标准ViT及常规对抗训练，该方法在保持干净精度的情况下提升了对抗鲁棒性，摘要中报告了在ImageNet等基准上的鲁棒精度改进。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adversarial robustness of Vision Transformers. It proposes Random Entangled Tokens, a mechanism that randomly entangles or mixes token representations to disrupt the deterministic token structure exploitable by adversaries. Compared with standard ViTs and conventional adversarial training, it improves robust accuracy while maintaining clean accuracy on benchmarks such as ImageNet.
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.assessment: 对安全敏感的感知系统有潜在意义，但属于鲁棒性基础研究，与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.contribution: 提出随机纠缠token机制以增强ViT对抗鲁棒性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.innovation: 通过随机token纠缠破坏对抗攻击可利用的确定性结构。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.result: 在ImageNet等基准上提升对抗鲁棒精度并保持干净精度。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall._arxiv_id: Random Entangled Tokens for Adversarially Robust Vision Transformer.

SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）中缺乏兼具ResNet式高效结构与Transformer全局建模能力的骨干网络的问题，提出了SpikingResformer，将ResNet与Vision Transformer的设计思想融合到脉冲神经网络中。方法结合脉冲残差卷积与脉冲自注意力，构建多阶段脉冲骨干，在保持SNN低能耗特性的同时提升表征能力。相比已有SNN骨干（如Spiking ResNet、Spikformer），在ImageNet等分类基准上以更低能耗取得了更高的精度。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of spiking neural network backbones that combine ResNet-style efficiency with Transformer-style global modeling. It proposes SpikingResformer, which integrates spiking residual convolutions with spiking self-attention in a multi-stage architecture. Compared with prior SNN backbones such as Spiking ResNet and Spikformer, it achieves higher accuracy at lower energy cost on ImageNet classification.
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.assessment: 将ResNet与ViT思想引入SNN对低功耗视觉感知有前景，但当前与自动驾驶3D感知任务距离较远。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.contribution: 提出融合ResNet与ViT思想的脉冲神经网络骨干SpikingResformer。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.innovation: 在SNN中结合脉冲残差卷积与脉冲自注意力实现多阶段骨干。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.result: 在ImageNet上以更低能耗取得优于已有SNN骨干的精度。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi._arxiv_id: SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vision Transformer in Spiking Neural Networks.

Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT事后解释（post-hoc explanation）方法忠实度不足、解释结果与模型真实决策不一致的问题，提出关注token变换（Token Transformation）的忠实事后解释方法。作者指出ViT中token在层间的变换过程对解释忠实度有重要影响，并据此设计了新的归因/解释机制，使生成的解释更贴近模型内部计算。相比Grad-CAM等传统解释方法，该方法在忠实度评测指标上取得更好表现。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient faithfulness of post-hoc explanation methods for Vision Transformers, where explanations often diverge from the model's actual decision process. It highlights the role of token transformations across layers and proposes a faithful post-hoc explanation method built around this observation. Compared with conventional methods such as Grad-CAM, it achieves better faithfulness metrics.
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.assessment: 对提升ViT可解释性有方法学价值，对安全关键的自动驾驶感知有间接参考意义。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.contribution: 提出关注token变换的ViT忠实事后解释方法。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.innovation: 从token层间变换角度建模归因以提升解释忠实度。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.result: 在忠实度评测指标上优于Grad-CAM等传统解释方法。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa._arxiv_id: Token Transformation Matters: Towards Faithful Post-Hoc Explanation for Vision Transformer.

On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer（ViT）解释方法的忠实度（faithfulness）问题展开研究，即现有解释方法是否真实反映模型决策依据。作者系统性地评估了多种ViT解释技术，并提出衡量解释忠实度的新指标或框架。相比已有工作，本文更严格地定义了忠实度并揭示了现有方法的不足。实验表明部分广泛使用的解释方法在忠实度上存在显著缺陷，为后续可解释性研究提供了重要参考。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper investigates the faithfulness of Vision Transformer explanations, questioning whether existing explanation methods truly reflect model decisions. The authors systematically evaluate multiple ViT explanation techniques and propose new metrics or frameworks for measuring faithfulness. Compared to prior work, it provides a stricter definition of faithfulness and reveals significant deficiencies in widely used explanation methods.
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.assessment: 可解释性对自动驾驶感知系统的安全验证有潜在价值，但当前与检测/感知主线的直接关联有限。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.contribution: 系统评估并揭示了ViT解释方法在忠实度上的不足。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.innovation: 提出更严格的忠实度衡量框架用于ViT解释评估。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.result: 实验表明部分主流解释方法忠实度存在显著缺陷。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: On the Faithfulness of Vision Transformer Explanations.

SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT计算量大、内存效率低的问题，提出了SHViT（Single-Head Vision Transformer），采用单头注意力机制与内存高效的宏观设计。相比多头注意力和复杂架构，SHViT在保持竞争力的精度的同时显著降低了计算和内存开销。实验在ImageNet等基准上取得了优于或媲美现有高效ViT的性能，展示了单头设计在视觉任务中的可行性。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory costs of Vision Transformers by proposing SHViT, a Single-Head Vision Transformer with a memory-efficient macro design. Compared to multi-head attention and complex architectures, SHViT achieves competitive accuracy with significantly reduced computation and memory overhead. Experiments on ImageNet and other benchmarks demonstrate performance on par with or superior to existing efficient ViTs.
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.assessment: 高效ViT设计对自动驾驶实时感知部署有直接价值，单头注意力思路新颖且实用。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.contribution: 提出单头注意力与内存高效宏观设计相结合的SHViT架构。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.innovation: 用单头注意力替代多头注意力，配合内存高效的宏观网络设计。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.result: 在ImageNet等基准上以更低计算和内存开销达到竞争性精度。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi._arxiv_id: SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer with Memory Efficient Macro Design.

2402.03094|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD），旨在用极少标注样本在新域上构建准确检测器。作者首先用风格、类间方差（ICV）和模糊边界（IB）三种度量分析域差距，建立了CD-FSOD基准，发现现有方法跨域泛化能力差。为此提出可学习实例特征对齐和实例重加权等模块，显著提升了跨域少样本检测性能。
2402.03094|v2.summary_en: This paper studies cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD), aiming to build accurate detectors for novel domains with minimal labeled examples. The authors analyze domain gaps using style, inter-class variance (ICV), and indefinable boundaries (IB), establishing the CD-FSOD benchmark that reveals poor generalization of existing methods. They propose learnable instance feature alignment and instance reweighting modules to significantly improve cross-domain few-shot detection.
2402.03094|v2.assessment: 跨域少样本检测对自动驾驶新场景快速适配有重要意义，基准和方法的贡献均较扎实。
2402.03094|v2.contribution: 建立CD-FSOD基准并提出可学习实例特征对齐与实例重加权模块。
2402.03094|v2.innovation: 用风格、ICV、IB三种度量系统分析域差距并针对性设计改进模块。
2402.03094|v2.result: 揭示现有方法跨域泛化不足，所提模块显著提升CD-FSOD性能。

2403.13298|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对RoPE（旋转位置编码）在视觉Transformer中应用不足的问题，系统分析了RoPE在2D视觉数据上的表现。作者实现了适用于2D图像的RoPE并进行了全面实验，发现RoPE具有出色的外推能力，即在推理时增大图像分辨率仍能保持精度。在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上均取得性能提升，且额外计算开销极小。
2403.13298|v2.summary_en: This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) applied to Vision Transformers for 2D vision data. The authors implement RoPE for 2D images and demonstrate impressive extrapolation performance, maintaining precision when increasing image resolution at inference. It yields performance improvements on ImageNet-1k, COCO detection, and ADE-20k segmentation with minimal extra computational overhead.
2403.13298|v2.assessment: RoPE在ViT中的系统研究填补了空白，对检测和分割骨干网络设计有直接参考价值。
2403.13298|v2.contribution: 系统分析并验证了RoPE在2D视觉Transformer中的外推能力和性能提升。
2403.13298|v2.innovation: 将语言模型中的RoPE成功适配到2D视觉数据并验证其分辨率外推优势。
2403.13298|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上均取得提升，计算开销极小。

2402.03317|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT对抗攻击脆弱性问题，提出SpecFormer，通过最大奇异值惩罚（MSVP）增强鲁棒性。作者建立了自注意力层的局部Lipschitz界，并据此设计MSVP精确控制这些界，将MSVP融入ViT注意力层。相比现有经验性方法，SpecFormer有理论支撑且在CIFAR和ImageNet上防御对抗攻击的性能优于现有最优方法，同时不牺牲训练效率。
2402.03317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the adversarial vulnerability of Vision Transformers by proposing SpecFormer, which uses Maximum Singular Value Penalization (MSVP) for robustness. The authors establish local Lipschitz bounds for self-attention layers and design MSVP to precisely manage these bounds. SpecFormer outperforms state-of-the-art methods in adversarial defense on CIFAR and ImageNet without compromising training efficiency.
2402.03317|v2.assessment: 对抗鲁棒性对自动驾驶安全关键系统有潜在价值，但当前与感知主线的直接关联有限。
2402.03317|v2.contribution: 提出有理论支撑的MSVP方法并构建鲁棒ViT模型SpecFormer。
2402.03317|v2.innovation: 基于自注意力层局部Lipschitz界设计最大奇异值惩罚来增强鲁棒性。
2402.03317|v2.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet上对抗攻击防御性能优于现有最优方法。

Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT推理成本调整需重新微调的问题，提出Token Compensator，能够在不重新调参的情况下改变ViT的推理成本。作者设计了一种token补偿机制，使模型可以在不同计算预算下灵活调整推理开销。相比需要重新训练或微调的现有方法，该方法无需额外调优即可实现推理成本的灵活控制，为ViT部署提供了便利。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_en: This paper addresses the need to re-tune Vision Transformers when altering inference cost by proposing Token Compensator, which adjusts ViT inference cost without re-tuning. The authors design a token compensation mechanism enabling flexible inference overhead adjustment under different computational budgets. Unlike existing methods requiring retraining or fine-tuning, it achieves flexible inference cost control without additional tuning.
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.assessment: 无需重调的推理成本调整对自动驾驶模型部署有实用价值，但摘要信息有限难以全面评估。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.contribution: 提出无需重新调参即可改变ViT推理成本的Token Compensator方法。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.innovation: 通过token补偿机制实现推理成本的灵活调整而无需微调。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.result: 在不重新调参的情况下实现了ViT推理成本的灵活控制。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co._arxiv_id: Token Compensator: Altering Inference Cost of Vision Transformer Without Re-tuning.

2403.19638|v2.summary_cn: 传统音视频方法依赖独立的音频和视觉骨干网络，参数量大、显存开销高且难以扩展。本文提出 AVSiam，用单个共享 ViT 骨干同时处理音频与视觉输入，并采用对比式音视频匹配目标配合多比例随机掩码策略进行预训练，从而支持更大的实例批次。相比已有方法，该框架可用同一骨干鲁棒处理音频、视觉及音视频三种输入，参数效率与显存占用更优。在 AudioSet 和 VGGSound 的音视频分类与检索任务上取得与先前方法相当甚至更好的结果。
2403.19638|v2.summary_en: Traditional audio-visual methods rely on independent audio and visual backbones, which is costly and hard to scale. This work proposes AVSiam, an audio-visual siamese network that uses a single shared ViT backbone for both modalities, pretrained with a contrastive audio-visual matching objective and a multi-ratio random masking scheme. Despite sharing the backbone, AVSiam matches or surpasses prior methods on AudioSet and VGGSound for audio-visual classification and retrieval while improving parameter efficiency and reducing GPU memory.
2403.19638|v2.assessment: 共享骨干的音视频预训练思路对多模态效率问题有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知/3D 检测方向关联较弱，属于外围相关。
2403.19638|v2.contribution: 提出用单一共享 ViT 骨干统一处理音频与视觉输入的可扩展音视频预训练框架 AVSiam。
2403.19638|v2.innovation: 以多比例随机掩码配合对比匹配目标，使共享骨干能同时鲁棒处理音频、视觉及音视频输入。
2403.19638|v2.result: 在 AudioSet 与 VGGSound 的分类与检索任务上达到与独立骨干方法相当或更优的性能，同时提升参数效率。

2504.02508|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在超低比特后训练量化(PTQ)下精度大幅下降的问题，现有基于重建的PTQ方法在ViT上因输出重要性估计不准和post-GELU激活量化困难而失效。本文提出APHQ-ViT，通过改进的平均扰动Hessian(APH)损失进行重要性估计，并设计MLP重建(MR)方法，将MLP中的GELU替换为ReLU并在小型无标签校准集上用APH损失重建。实验表明该方法在多种ViT上使用线性量化即可显著优于现有PTQ方法，缩小了与全精度模型的差距。
2504.02508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the significant accuracy degradation of Vision Transformers under ultra-low-bit post-training quantization, where existing reconstruction-based PTQ methods fail due to inaccurate output importance estimation and difficulty in quantizing post-GELU activations. The authors propose APHQ-ViT, which introduces an improved Average Perturbation Hessian (APH) loss for importance estimation and an MLP Reconstruction (MR) method that replaces GELU with ReLU and reconstructs via APH loss on a small unlabeled calibration set. Extensive experiments show that APHQ-ViT with linear quantization substantially outperforms prior PTQ methods on various ViTs.
2504.02508|v2.assessment: 该工作系统分析了ViT PTQ中的关键瓶颈并给出有效解决方案，对模型压缩与边缘部署方向有参考价值，但与应用领域（自动驾驶感知）关联较弱。
2504.02508|v2.contribution: 提出基于平均扰动Hessian的PTQ框架APHQ-ViT，解决了ViT超低比特量化中重要性估计不准与post-GELU激活量化困难的问题。
2504.02508|v2.innovation: 改进的平均扰动Hessian损失与将GELU替换为ReLU的MLP重建策略。
2504.02508|v2.result: 在线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，大幅缩小了与全精度ViT的精度差距。
