2503.12821|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)训练数据中的长尾分布问题，现有工作主要关注CLIP/ViT架构和识别分类任务，对LLaVA类LVLM及VQA、视觉推理等通用任务探索不足。本文深入分析LVLM中的长尾问题，识别出头部概念过表示和尾部概念欠表示两个核心原因，提出自适应数据精炼框架ADR，包含数据重平衡(DR)和数据合成(DS)两阶段，DR基于实体分布自适应重平衡冗余数据，DS利用去噪扩散概率模型合成数据。
2503.12821|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates long-tail issues in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), identifying overrepresentation of head concepts and underrepresentation of tail concepts as core causes. It proposes an Adaptive Data Refinement Framework (ADR) with two stages: Data Rebalancing (DR) that adaptively rebalances redundant data based on entity distributions, and Data Synthesis (DS) that leverages denoising diffusion probabilistic models. The framework targets more general tasks like VQA and visual reasoning beyond traditional recognition.
2503.12821|v2.assessment: 该工作将长尾问题研究拓展到LVLM和通用视觉语言任务，提出的数据精炼框架具有实用价值，对多模态感知方向有启发意义。
2503.12821|v2.contribution: 提出自适应数据精炼框架ADR，通过数据重平衡与扩散合成解决LVLM训练数据的长尾问题。
2503.12821|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析LLaVA类LVLM在VQA和视觉推理任务中的长尾问题并提出两阶段数据精炼方案。
2503.12821|v2.result: 在LVLM通用任务上改善了长尾分布带来的性能不均衡问题。

2503.02394|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备部署困难的问题，模型二值化在CNN上已取得进展但直接应用于ViT会因架构差异导致显著性能下降。本文提出BHViT，一种二值化友好的混合ViT架构及其全二值化模型，基于三个关键观察：利用局部信息交互和由粗到细的层次特征聚合解决过多token导致的冗余计算；提出基于移位操作的新模块在不显著增加计算开销下增强二值MLP；提出基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法评估token重要性。
2503.02394|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenges of Vision Transformers on edge devices by proposing BHViT, a binarization-friendly hybrid ViT architecture and its fully binarized model. BHViT leverages local information interaction and hierarchical feature aggregation to reduce redundant computation from excessive tokens, introduces a shift-based module to enhance binary MLP without significant overhead, and proposes a quantization-decomposition-based attention matrix binarization method for token importance evaluation. The approach mitigates the performance drop when applying binary CNN strategies directly to ViTs.
2503.02394|v2.assessment: 该工作针对ViT二值化的架构适配问题提出系统性方案，对模型压缩和边缘部署有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
2503.02394|v2.contribution: 提出二值化友好的混合ViT架构BHViT及其全二值化模型，解决了ViT二值化中的性能下降问题。
2503.02394|v2.innovation: 基于移位操作的二值MLP增强模块与基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法。
2503.02394|v2.result: 在不显著增加计算开销的前提下提升了二值ViT的性能。

2412.12032|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对真实人脸图像丰富但标注稀缺的场景，提出自监督预训练框架FSFM，旨在学习可迁移的人脸基础表征以提升多种人脸安全任务的泛化性能。方法上结合掩码图像建模（MIM）与实例判别（ID），提出CRFR-P掩码策略强制模型捕获区域内一致性与区域间连贯性，并通过定制自蒸馏建立局部到全局对应关系（3C目标）。预训练后以普通ViT作为通用视觉基础模型，在跨数据集deepfake检测、跨域人脸反欺骗及未见扩散伪造检测等下游任务上验证。在10个公开数据集上的大量实验表明其泛化性能优于现有方法。
2412.12032|v2.summary_en: This work proposes FSFM, a self-supervised pretraining framework that learns transferable facial representations from abundant unlabeled real faces by synergizing masked image modeling (MIM) and instance discrimination (ID). It introduces a CRFR-P masking strategy enforcing intra-region consistency and inter-region coherency, and a self-distillation-based ID network establishing local-to-global correspondence. After pretraining, a vanilla ViT serves as a universal foundation model for cross-dataset deepfake detection, cross-domain face anti-spoofing, and unseen diffusion forgery detection, achieving strong generalization on 10 public datasets.
2412.12032|v2.assessment: 将自监督基础模型思路引入人脸安全领域，掩码策略与自蒸馏设计有一定新意，但与人脸安全而非通用视觉感知更相关。
2412.12032|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向真实人脸的自监督预训练框架FSFM，统一支撑多类人脸安全下游任务。
2412.12032|v2.innovation: CRFR-P掩码策略与MIM-ID协同的3C自蒸馏目标，兼顾局部特征与全局语义。
2412.12032|v2.result: 在10个公开数据集上跨数据集deepfake检测、跨域反欺骗及未见扩散伪造检测均取得优于现有方法的泛化性能。

2508.20063|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇（OV）多视角室内3D目标检测在无人工标注下探索不足的问题，提出OpenM3D——一个无需人工标注训练的单阶段开放词汇多视角室内3D检测器。方法基于ImGeoNet的2D诱导体素特征，联合训练类别无关的3D定位损失（依赖高质量3D伪框）与体素-语义对齐损失（依赖多样CLIP特征），并提出基于图嵌入的3D伪框生成方法将2D分割合并为连贯3D结构。相比OV-3DET等方法，其伪框具有更高的精度与召回率，且单阶段检测器在无标注设定下取得高精度。
2508.20063|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenM3D, a single-stage open-vocabulary multi-view indoor 3D detector trained without human annotations, adapting 2D-induced voxel features from ImGeoNet. It jointly optimizes a class-agnostic 3D localization loss with high-quality pseudo boxes and a voxel-semantic alignment loss with diverse CLIP features, and proposes a graph-embedding-based 3D pseudo box generation method that merges 2D segments into coherent 3D structures. The pseudo boxes achieve higher precision and recall than prior methods including OV-3DET, enabling accurate single-stage detection under the annotation-free setting.
2508.20063|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测与无标注训练结合到多视角室内3D场景，伪框生成与CLIP对齐设计扎实，对3D检测与开放集方向有参考价值。
2508.20063|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工标注的开放词汇多视角室内3D检测器OpenM3D及高质量3D伪框生成方法。
2508.20063|v2.innovation: 基于图嵌入的3D伪框生成与体素-语义CLIP对齐损失的联合训练框架。
2508.20063|v2.result: 伪框精度与召回率超过OV-3DET等方法，单阶段检测器在无标注设定下实现高精度开放词汇3D检测。

2503.08101|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于query的3D目标检测模型因大图像尺寸与多层transformer导致计算量大、难以在边缘设备高效运行的问题，提出零样本运行时剪枝方法tgGBC（trim keys gradually Guided By Classification scores）。方法将分类分数与注意力图相乘得到每个key的重要性分数，并在每层transformer后按重要性逐步剪枝key，无需重训练或蒸馏。在最新ToC3D模型上实现transformer解码器1.99倍加速，性能损失小于1%，部分模型甚至性能提升，并成功在边缘设备上部署。
2503.08101|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of query-based 3D object detectors with dense features and multiple transformer layers, which hinders edge deployment. It proposes tgGBC, a zero-shot runtime pruning method that multiplies classification scores with attention maps to score key importance and gradually trims keys after each transformer layer, requiring no retraining or distillation. It achieves a 1.99x speedup in the transformer decoder of ToC3D with less than 1% performance loss, sometimes even improving accuracy, and enables edge deployment.
2503.08101|v2.assessment: 面向3D检测器的零样本运行时剪枝实用性强，无需重训练即可显著加速，对自动驾驶边缘部署有直接价值。
2503.08101|v2.contribution: 提出零样本运行时key剪枝方法tgGBC，加速3D检测transformer解码器。
2503.08101|v2.innovation: 以分类分数引导注意力key重要性评估并逐层渐进剪枝，无需重训练或蒸馏。
2503.08101|v2.result: ToC3D解码器加速1.99倍，性能损失小于1%，部分模型性能提升，并可在边缘设备部署。

2508.20265|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在开放词汇分割中定位能力差、中间注意力改进难以传播到最终输出且与文本表示缺乏直接交互的问题，提出一种免训练、反馈驱动的自适性框架。方法将基于输出的patch级对应关系反馈回中间注意力，利用输出预测作为更强的空间连贯先验，并设计注意力隔离、基于置信度的稀疏自适应剪枝与自适应集成等模块。该方法作为即插即用模块可无缝集成到现有CLIP分割流程中，提升语义一致性与分割性能。
2508.20265|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles CLIP's poor localization in open-vocabulary segmentation, where intermediate attention improvements fail to propagate to final outputs and lack direct text interaction. It proposes a training-free, feedback-driven self-adaptive framework that feeds output-based patch-level correspondences back to intermediate attention, treating outputs as a stronger spatial coherence prior. Key modules include attention isolation, confidence-based pruning for sparse adaptation, and adaptation ensemble, functioning as a plug-in that improves semantic consistency and segmentation performance.
2508.20265|v2.assessment: 免训练即插即用的反馈式注意力自适应思路新颖，对CLIP开放词汇分割有实用价值，但偏分割任务而非检测。
2508.20265|v2.contribution: 提出将输出级patch对应反馈至中间注意力的免训练自适性框架。
2508.20265|v2.innovation: 以模型输出作为空间连贯先验反向引导中间注意力，并设计稀疏自适应与集成模块。
2508.20265|v2.result: 作为即插即用模块提升CLIP开放词汇分割的语义一致性与性能。

2411.13836|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在像素级开放词汇语义分割中空间表示不足的问题，提出分层框架CLIPer，无需额外训练即可改进CLIP空间表示。方法包含早期层融合模块与细粒度补偿模块：前者利用早期层嵌入与注意力图保留的空间结构信息生成空间连贯性更好的分割图，后者借助扩散模型的自注意力图补偿局部细节。在七个分割数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能。
2411.13836|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited spatial representation of CLIP for training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by proposing CLIPer, a hierarchical framework. It includes an early-layer fusion module that leverages spatial structural information in early-layer embeddings and attention maps to produce more spatially coherent segmentation, and a fine-grained compensation module that uses diffusion model self-attention maps to recover local details. CLIPer achieves state-of-the-art performance across seven segmentation datasets.
2411.13836|v2.assessment: 分层利用早期层与扩散模型注意力改进CLIP空间表示，思路清晰且在多个数据集上验证，但属分割任务。
2411.13836|v2.contribution: 提出分层改进CLIP空间表示的免训练开放词汇语义分割框架CLIPer。
2411.13836|v2.innovation: 早期层融合与基于扩散模型注意力的细粒度补偿相结合的分层设计。
2411.13836|v2.result: 在七个分割数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能。

2507.19131|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对窗口式视觉Transformer（如Swin）量化推理效率问题，提出混合精度激活量化框架MixA-Q，利用层内激活稀疏性为不重要的窗口分配更低比特宽度。方法引入双分支Swin Block分别以高/低比特精度处理激活，可无缝集成到多数QAT与PTQ方法中。在COCO数据集上，PTQ配置下实现免训练1.35倍加速且无精度损失；QAT下实现无损1.25倍加速，结合激活剪枝在仅1% mAP下降下达到1.53倍加速。
2507.19131|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MixA-Q, a mixed-precision activation quantization framework that exploits intra-layer activation sparsity in window-based vision transformers by assigning lower bit widths to less important windows. A Two-Branch Swin Block processes activations in high and low precision, integrating seamlessly with most QAT and PTQ methods. On COCO, MixA-Q achieves a training-free 1.35x speedup without accuracy loss in PTQ, and 1.25x lossless / 1.53x with 1% mAP drop in QAT.
2507.19131|v2.assessment: 将激活稀疏性与混合精度量化结合，对ViT高效推理有工程价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2507.19131|v2.contribution: 提出利用层内激活稀疏性的混合精度量化框架MixA-Q。
2507.19131|v2.innovation: 双分支Swin Block按窗口重要性分配高低比特精度，兼容QAT与PTQ。
2507.19131|v2.result: COCO上PTQ免训练1.35倍加速无损失，QAT无损1.25倍、含剪枝1.53倍加速仅降1% mAP。

2506.21046|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对黑盒对抗攻击中迁移性不足的问题，提出利用自监督ViT特征（而非传统监督学习特征）来生成对抗扰动。方法名为dSVA，是一个生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击框架，同时利用对比学习（CL）的全局结构特征和掩码图像建模（MIM）的局部纹理特征，并设计生成器训练策略以联合利用这些特征及自监督ViT的注意力机制。相比已有仅依赖监督特征的方法，dSVA通过融合CL和MIM两种自监督范式，使ViT关注不同特征倾向，从而提升对抗样本的黑盒迁移性。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称有效提升了迁移性。
2506.21046|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited black-box transferability of adversarial perturbations by exploiting self-supervised Vision Transformer (ViT) representations instead of supervised features. It proposes dSVA, a generative dual self-supervised ViT feature attack that combines global structural features from contrastive learning (CL) and local textural features from masked image modeling (MIM), with a novel generative training framework incorporating a generator and attention mechanisms. Compared to prior work relying solely on supervised features, dSVA leverages the synergy between self-supervised learning and ViT to improve transferability, though no specific quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2506.21046|v2.assessment: 该工作将自监督ViT特征引入对抗攻击领域，为提升黑盒迁移性提供了新思路，但缺乏具体实验数据，且与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
2506.21046|v2.contribution: 首次探索利用自监督ViT的双重特征（CL和MIM）来生成高迁移性的对抗扰动。
2506.21046|v2.innovation: 提出生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击框架dSVA，联合利用全局结构特征和局部纹理特征。
2506.21046|v2.result: 声称有效提升了对抗样本的黑盒迁移性，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。

Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_cn: 该论文针对预训练视觉Transformer在下游任务适配时微调效率低的问题，提出了一种基于近似正交微调策略的高效适配方法。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。从标题推断，该方法可能通过约束微调参数的正交性来减少可训练参数量并保持预训练知识。相比全量微调或现有参数高效微调方法，其改进点可能在于更好的精度-效率权衡。但缺乏摘要信息，无法评估具体效果。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of fine-tuning pre-trained Vision Transformers for downstream adaptation by proposing an approximately orthogonal fine-tuning strategy. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results are unavailable. The approach likely constrains fine-tuning parameters to be approximately orthogonal to reduce trainable parameters while preserving pre-trained knowledge, potentially offering a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than full fine-tuning or existing parameter-efficient methods.
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.assessment: 参数高效微调是ViT应用的重要方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体贡献和效果，建议获取全文后再做判断。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.contribution: 提出一种基于近似正交约束的预训练ViT高效微调策略。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.innovation: 利用近似正交性约束实现参数高效适配，可能减少微调参数量。

2507.12988|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对结构化剪枝后需要大量重训练甚至从头训练才能恢复精度的问题，提出了一种基于方差的单次结构化剪枝方法（Variance-Based Pruning）。方法首先收集激活统计量用于选择待剪枝神经元，同时将平均激活值整合回模型以保持高性能，从而在最小微调下完成压缩。相比需要数百轮重训练或从头训练的传统结构化剪枝方法，该方法显著降低了重训练成本。在ImageNet-1k上，DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%的原始性能，展示了高效压缩的潜力。
2507.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the costly retraining required by structured pruning to recover accuracy after removing neurons. It introduces Variance-Based Pruning, a one-shot structured pruning technique that gathers activation statistics to select neurons and integrates mean activations back into the model to preserve performance with minimal fine-tuning. Compared to methods requiring hundreds of retraining epochs or training from scratch, it achieves efficient compression; on ImageNet-1k, pruned DeiT-Base retains over 70% of its original performance directly after pruning.
2507.12988|v2.assessment: 该工作为预训练模型的高效压缩提供了实用的单次剪枝方案，对部署资源受限的自动驾驶感知模型有参考价值，实验数据具体可信。
2507.12988|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于激活方差的单次结构化剪枝方法，大幅减少剪枝后的重训练需求。
2507.12988|v2.innovation: 利用激活统计量选择神经元并将平均激活整合回模型以保持性能。
2507.12988|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1k上，DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%的原始性能。

2407.11306|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Transformer中自注意力计算复杂度高的问题，提出了多项式注意力即插即用替代框架PADRe。PADRe利用多项式函数和近似理论，通过Hadamard积等硬件友好的乘法非线性操作实现线性计算和内存复杂度，避免了Softmax等复杂函数，同时保持与传统自注意力相当或更优的精度。该框架统一了Hyena、Mamba、SimA、Conv2Former、Castling-ViT等多种近期注意力机制。在图像分类、2D目标检测和3D点云目标检测等任务上，PADRe运行速度显著更快，且精度有竞争力。
2407.11306|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational complexity of self-attention in Transformers by proposing PADRe, a unifying polynomial attention drop-in replacement framework. PADRe leverages polynomial functions and approximation theory, using hardware-friendly multiplicative nonlinearities (e.g., Hadamard products) to achieve linear computational and memory costs while avoiding Softmax, maintaining comparable or superior accuracy. It unifies several recent attention mechanisms including Hyena, Mamba, SimA, Conv2Former, and Castling-ViT. Empirical results across image classification, 2D object detection, and 3D point cloud object detection show significantly faster runtime with competitive accuracy.
2407.11306|v2.assessment: PADRe为ViT注意力机制提供了统一且高效的理论框架，在2D/3D检测任务上验证了有效性，对自动驾驶感知中的实时Transformer部署有直接参考价值。
2407.11306|v2.contribution: 提出统一的多项式注意力替代框架PADRe，实现线性复杂度的自注意力替代。
2407.11306|v2.innovation: 利用多项式函数和Hadamard积等硬件友好操作替代Softmax注意力，并统一多种现有注意力机制。
2407.11306|v2.result: 在图像分类、2D检测和3D点云检测任务上运行速度显著更快，精度相当或更优。

CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_cn: 该论文针对算子学习（Operator Learning）问题，提出了连续视觉Transformer（CViT）方法。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。从标题推断，该方法可能将ViT架构扩展到连续函数空间的算子学习任务中，用于求解偏微分方程等科学计算问题。相比传统算子学习方法，其改进点可能在于利用Transformer的全局建模能力。但缺乏摘要信息，无法评估具体效果，且与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。

Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）与视觉Transformer结合时，传统自注意力机制在脉冲域中计算开销大、时序建模效率低的问题，提出了带有扫视注意力（Saccadic Attention）的脉冲视觉Transformer（Spiking Vision Transformer）。方法上，作者将生物视觉中的扫视机制引入脉冲注意力，通过稀疏、事件驱动的注意力采样替代密集的全局注意力计算，从而降低脉冲发放率和能耗。相比已有的脉冲Transformer工作，该方法在保持脉冲神经网络低功耗优势的同时，试图提升对动态视觉输入的建模能力。摘要中未给出具体数据集上的量化结果，因此效果数据无法引用。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of conventional self-attention when integrated into spiking neural networks for vision transformers, where dense attention incurs high spike activity and computational cost. It proposes a Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention, inspired by biological saccades, to enable sparse, event-driven attention sampling. Compared with prior spiking transformer approaches, the method aims to preserve low-power spiking computation while improving temporal modeling of dynamic visual inputs, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.assessment: 该工作将生物扫视机制与脉冲Transformer结合，思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知、3D检测等核心方向关联较弱，且摘要缺乏实验数据支撑，实际价值有待验证。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.contribution: 提出了一种受生物扫视机制启发的脉冲视觉Transformer注意力结构。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.innovation: 将扫视注意力引入脉冲域，以稀疏事件驱动方式替代密集全局注意力。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法量化评估。

2106.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT模型规模大、训练成本高的问题，本文首次系统探索了端到端的稀疏化方案，而非传统的事后剪枝。方法上，在固定小参数预算下动态提取并训练稀疏子网络，联合优化模型参数与连接结构，并将非结构化稀疏扩展到结构化稀疏（引导自注意力头的剪枝与生长），同时引入可学习token选择器协同探索数据与架构稀疏。在ImageNet上，该方法在降低训练内存与推理复杂度的同时保持了可比精度，为ViT高效训练提供了统一框架。
2106.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive model size and training cost of Vision Transformers by exploring end-to-end sparsification rather than conventional post-training pruning. It dynamically extracts and trains sparse subnetworks under a fixed small parameter budget, jointly optimizing weights and connectivity, and extends from unstructured to structured sparsity by guiding prune-and-grow of self-attention heads, with a learnable token selector for data-architecture co-sparsity. Extensive ImageNet results show reduced training memory and inference complexity without sacrificing accuracy.
2106.04533|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地将端到端稀疏化引入ViT训练，兼顾训练与推理效率，对高效Transformer研究有较强参考价值。
2106.04533|v2.contribution: 提出统一的端到端稀疏化框架，同时压缩ViT的训练内存与推理复杂度。
2106.04533|v2.innovation: 将非结构化/结构化稀疏与可学习token选择器结合，实现数据与架构稀疏的协同探索。
2106.04533|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以固定小参数预算达到与密集ViT可比精度，同时显著降低训练与推理开销。

2111.14725|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT架构依赖人工设计的问题，本文提出用神经架构搜索自动化该过程，且不仅搜索架构还搜索搜索空间本身。核心思想是利用权重共享超网计算E-T Error，引导不同搜索维度逐步演化，并据此给出通用ViT的设计准则。搜索得到的S3模型在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT和ViT，并在目标检测、语义分割和VQA等下游任务上验证了通用性。
2111.14725|v2.summary_en: To automate Vision Transformer design, this paper proposes neural architecture search that searches not only the architecture but also the search space, gradually evolving search dimensions guided by E-T Error computed with a weight-sharing supernet. The resulting S3 models outperform Swin, DeiT, and ViT on ImageNet, and generalize to object detection, semantic segmentation, and VQA.
2111.14725|v2.assessment: 将NAS扩展到搜索空间本身，并提供ViT设计准则，对自动化视觉骨干设计有启发意义。
2111.14725|v2.contribution: 提出同时搜索架构与搜索空间的NAS方法，并给出通用ViT设计指南。
2111.14725|v2.innovation: 以E-T Error引导搜索空间逐步演化，实现搜索维度的自适应扩展。
2111.14725|v2.result: S3在ImageNet上超越Swin/DeiT/ViT，并在检测、分割、VQA等下游任务上验证通用性。

Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.summary_cn: 本文研究Vision Transformer的训练后量化问题，旨在不重新训练的前提下降低ViT的存储与计算开销。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节，但从标题可知其聚焦于PTQ在ViT上的适配。该方向对ViT部署有实际意义，但缺少摘要信息难以评估其具体改进与实验效果。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses post-training quantization for Vision Transformers, aiming to reduce storage and computation without retraining. Due to the missing abstract, the specific method and experimental results cannot be assessed, though the topic is relevant for ViT deployment.
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.assessment: ViT后训练量化是部署关键问题，但摘要缺失导致无法判断其方法质量与效果。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.contribution: 针对Vision Transformer提出后训练量化方案。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.innovation: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体创新点。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。

2110.15156|v2.summary_cn: 本文指出ViT的离散patch token化过程会在注意力图中引入锯齿伪影，即混叠问题，导致高频信息失真。为此提出即插即用的混叠抑制模块ARM，可嵌入多种ViT家族。实验表明该轻量设计在多个任务上稳定提升性能，并改善数据效率与鲁棒性。
2110.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies the aliasing problem in Vision Transformers caused by discontinuous patch-wise tokenization, which introduces jagged artifacts into attention maps. It proposes a plug-and-play Aliasing-Reduction Module (ARM) that consistently boosts multiple ViT families across tasks while improving data efficiency and robustness.
2110.15156|v2.assessment: 从信号处理角度揭示ViT的混叠问题并提出轻量解决方案，视角新颖且实用。
2110.15156|v2.contribution: 揭示ViT中的混叠效应并提出即插即用的ARM模块。
2110.15156|v2.innovation: 将抗混叠思想引入ViT的patch token化与注意力建模。
2110.15156|v2.result: 在多种ViT家族与任务上稳定提升性能，并改善数据效率与鲁棒性。

Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.summary_cn: 本文提出Adder Attention用于Vision Transformer，推测旨在以加法替代乘法注意力以降低计算能耗。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法、改进点与实验数据。该方向对高效ViT有潜在价值，但信息不足难以评估。

2106.03348|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT将图像视为1D token序列、缺乏局部结构与尺度不变性等内在归纳偏置的问题，本文提出ViTAE，从卷积中引入内在归纳偏置。技术上，ViTAE使用多个不同膨胀率的卷积构成空间金字塔缩减模块，将输入下采样并嵌入为富含多尺度上下文的token，获得尺度不变性；每层Transformer中并行一个卷积块与多头自注意力，融合后送入FFN，从而获得局部性归纳偏置。该设计减少了对大规模数据和长训练计划的依赖。
2106.03348|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of intrinsic inductive bias in Vision Transformers that treat images as 1D token sequences, this paper proposes ViTAE, which incorporates convolutional inductive biases. It uses spatial pyramid reduction modules with multi-rate dilated convolutions to embed multi-scale context, and places a convolution block in parallel with multi-head self-attention in each layer, yielding scale invariance and locality while reducing reliance on large-scale data and long training schedules.
2106.03348|v2.assessment: 系统性地将卷积的尺度与局部性归纳偏置注入ViT，对数据高效训练有实际意义。
2106.03348|v2.contribution: 提出融合卷积内在归纳偏置的ViTAE架构。
2106.03348|v2.innovation: 通过多膨胀率空间金字塔缩减模块与并行卷积块，同时引入尺度不变性与局部性偏置。
2106.03348|v2.result: 在减少对大规模数据和长训练计划依赖的同时取得有竞争力的性能。

2106.02277|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉 Transformer 自注意力对高分辨率特征图计算与内存开销呈二次增长、难以用于密集预测的问题，提出 Glance-and-Gaze Transformer（GG-Transformer）。方法受人类识别物体时"扫视+凝视"行为启发，设计两条并行分支：Glance 分支在自适应膨胀划分上做自注意力以高效建模长程依赖，Gaze 分支用深度卷积捕捉局部上下文。相比纯全局注意力或纯局部卷积方案，该结构在保持紧凑模型尺寸的同时兼顾长程与局部建模。摘要未给出具体数据集数值，但声称在密集预测任务上缓解了计算/内存瓶颈。
2106.02277|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the quadratic complexity of self-attention that hinders vision Transformers on high-resolution dense prediction. It proposes the Glance-and-Gaze Transformer (GG-Transformer), inspired by human glance-and-gaze behavior, with a Glance branch performing self-attention on adaptively-dilated partitions for long-range dependencies and a Gaze branch using depth-wise convolution for local context. This design efficiently models both global and local information while keeping the model compact, alleviating the computation and memory bottleneck for dense prediction tasks.
2106.02277|v2.assessment: 思路直观且对密集预测的算力瓶颈有针对性，但摘要未给出量化结果，需看正文实验才能判断实际收益。
2106.02277|v2.contribution: 提出 Glance-and-Gaze 双分支视觉 Transformer，用自适应膨胀划分注意力与局部卷积并行建模长程与局部上下文。
2106.02277|v2.innovation: 将人类"扫视-凝视"认知行为映射为自适应膨胀分区自注意力与深度卷积并行的双分支结构。
2106.02277|v2.result: 在保持紧凑模型尺寸下缓解了高分辨率密集预测的计算与内存开销（摘要未列具体数值）。

HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_cn: 该论文提出 HRFormer，一种面向密集预测任务的高分辨率视觉 Transformer。针对 ViT 类模型在语义分割、姿态估计等密集预测任务中因低分辨率表征而丢失空间细节的问题，HRFormer 借鉴高分辨率网络（HRNet）的多分辨率并行结构，在保持高分辨率特征的同时并行处理多尺度表征，并引入局部窗口注意力以降低高分辨率下的计算量。相比标准 ViT 与 Swin 等方案，其在密集预测任务上兼顾了高分辨率空间精度与 Transformer 的全局建模能力。由于摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_en: This paper introduces HRFormer, a high-resolution vision Transformer for dense prediction. To address the loss of spatial detail in ViT-style models on tasks such as segmentation and pose estimation, HRFormer adopts the multi-resolution parallel design of HRNet while processing high-resolution representations, and employs local-window attention to control computation at high resolution. It thus combines high-resolution spatial fidelity with the global modeling capacity of Transformers for dense prediction.
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.assessment: 将 HRNet 多分辨率并行思想与 Transformer 结合是密集预测方向的代表性工作，但摘要缺失，无法评估其具体实验充分度。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.contribution: 提出面向密集预测的高分辨率视觉 Transformer 架构 HRFormer。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.innovation: 把 HRNet 式多分辨率并行表征与局部窗口注意力结合，兼顾高分辨率细节与全局建模。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法引用。

2112.13528|v2.summary_cn: 针对显著目标检测中潜变量先验表达能力不足的问题，提出一种带能量基（energy-based）潜空间先验的生成式视觉 Transformer。方法将视觉 Transformer 与能量基先验模型通过基于 MCMC 的最大似然估计联合训练，潜变量的后验与先验采样由 Langevin 动力学完成。与将潜变量先验设为简单各向同性高斯的既有生成模型不同，能量基信息先验更具表达力，并能从图像直接得到像素级不确定性图。在 RGB 与 RGB-D 显著目标检测上均取得准确预测，但摘要未给出具体指标。
2112.13528|v2.summary_en: The paper targets the limited expressiveness of latent priors in generative models for salient object detection. It proposes a generative vision Transformer with an energy-based informative latent prior, jointly trained with the Transformer via MCMC-based maximum likelihood estimation, where posterior and prior sampling use Langevin dynamics. Unlike models assuming an isotropic Gaussian prior, this energy-based prior is more expressive and yields pixel-wise uncertainty maps, achieving accurate saliency prediction on both RGB and RGB-D benchmarks.
2112.13528|v2.assessment: 能量基先验与 Transformer 结合并输出不确定性图有一定新意，但显著目标检测与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
2112.13528|v2.contribution: 提出带能量基潜空间先验的生成式视觉 Transformer 框架，用于显著目标检测并输出像素级不确定性。
2112.13528|v2.innovation: 用能量基信息先验替代各向同性高斯先验，并通过 MCMC/Langevin 动力学与 Transformer 联合训练。
2112.13528|v2.result: 在 RGB 与 RGB-D 显著目标检测上取得准确预测并可给出不确定性图（摘要未列具体数值）。

2106.05656|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉自监督学习中 Transformer 预训练探索不足、且既有方法仅关注全局高层特征而难以迁移到密集预测任务的问题，提出 MST（Masked Self-supervised Transformer）。方法借鉴 NLP 的掩码语言建模，基于多头自注意力图动态掩码部分局部 patch token，在不破坏关键结构的前提下显式捕捉局部上下文，同时保留全局语义。被掩码 token 与剩余 token 由全局图像解码器重建，从而保留空间信息，对下游密集预测更友好。在多个数据集上的实验验证了其有效性，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2106.05656|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the underexplored use of Transformers in visual self-supervised learning and the failure of global-feature-only methods to transfer to dense prediction. It proposes MST, a Masked Self-supervised Transformer that dynamically masks local patch tokens based on multi-head self-attention maps, explicitly capturing local context while preserving global semantics. Masked and remaining tokens are reconstructed by a global image decoder that retains spatial information, making representations more transferable to dense prediction, with experiments on multiple datasets demonstrating effectiveness.
2106.05656|v2.assessment: 基于注意力图的动态掩码策略对自监督视觉预训练有参考价值，尤其对下游密集预测的迁移性设计合理，但摘要缺少量化结果。
2106.05656|v2.contribution: 提出基于多头自注意力图动态掩码的视觉自监督 Transformer 预训练方法 MST。
2106.05656|v2.innovation: 用注意力图引导的动态 token 掩码替代随机掩码，并配合保留空间信息的全局图像解码器重建。
2106.05656|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性并提升了对下游密集预测任务的迁移能力（摘要未列具体数值）。

2303.01788|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶多任务感知缺乏统一评测基准、且现有多任务方法性能明显落后于单任务基线的问题，在包含目标检测、语义分割、可行驶区域分割和车道线检测四项任务的大规模驾驶数据集上系统评测了主流多任务学习方法。作者提出 VE-Prompt 框架，通过任务特定的视觉示例（visual exemplar）提示来引导模型学习高质量的任务特定表征。相比现有多任务方法，其改进点在于引入视觉示例驱动的任务提示机制以缓解任务间干扰。摘要显示现有方法虽较单任务基线仍有较大性能差距，而 VE-Prompt 有效缓解了这一困境（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。
2303.01788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for multi-task perception in autonomous driving and the substantial performance gap between existing multi-task methods and single-task baselines. The authors extensively evaluate popular multi-task learning methods on a large-scale driving dataset covering object detection, semantic segmentation, drivable area segmentation, and lane detection. They propose VE-Prompt, a framework that introduces visual exemplars via task-specific prompting to guide the model toward learning high-quality task-specific representations, alleviating the performance gap in autonomous driving multi-task perception.
2303.01788|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶多任务感知提供了系统性的评测与一个简洁有效的提示式框架，对多任务感知研究者有参考价值，但摘要未给出具体量化提升，需关注其完整实验。
2303.01788|v2.contribution: 构建了自动驾驶四项感知任务的统一多任务评测，并提出视觉示例驱动的任务提示框架 VE-Prompt。
2303.01788|v2.innovation: 将任务特定的视觉示例以提示方式注入多任务模型，引导学习任务特定表征以缓解任务干扰。
2303.01788|v2.result: 现有多任务方法较单任务基线仍有较大差距，VE-Prompt 有效缓解该性能困境（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中道路异常检测（road anomaly detection）问题，即识别训练集中未出现的未知障碍物。作者提出了一种基于部分图像重建（partial image reconstruction）并结合语义分割耦合（segmentation coupling）的方法，利用分割网络提供的先验来约束重建过程，从而突出异常区域。相比已有仅依赖重建误差或仅依赖分割不确定性的方法，该方法通过耦合两者提升了异常定位的鲁棒性。摘要中未给出具体量化结果，但声称在多个道路异常基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_en: This paper addresses road anomaly detection for autonomous driving, aiming to identify unknown obstacles absent from training data. The authors propose a partial image reconstruction method coupled with semantic segmentation, where segmentation priors constrain the reconstruction to highlight anomalous regions. Compared to prior works relying solely on reconstruction error or segmentation uncertainty, the coupling improves anomaly localization robustness. The abstract reports superior performance on multiple road anomaly benchmarks, though specific quantitative results are not provided.
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.assessment: 该工作将重建与分割耦合用于开放集道路异常检测，思路合理且与自动驾驶安全感知直接相关，但摘要缺乏具体实验数据，需进一步验证其实际效果。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.contribution: 提出了一种将部分图像重建与语义分割耦合的道路异常检测框架。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.innovation: 利用分割先验约束重建过程，以增强对未知异常的敏感度并抑制误检。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.result: 在多个道路异常基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。

OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对环视语义占用感知缺乏大规模基准的问题，本文提出了OpenOccupancy，一个面向自动驾驶环视语义占用感知的大规模基准数据集。该基准包含密集的语义占用标注，并提供了标准化的评估协议和基线方法。相比已有工作，OpenOccupancy在数据规模、标注密度和环视覆盖范围上均有显著提升，填补了该领域基准缺失的空白。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenOccupancy, a large-scale benchmark for surrounding semantic occupancy perception in autonomous driving. It provides dense semantic occupancy annotations and standardized evaluation protocols with baselines. Compared to existing works, it significantly advances data scale, annotation density, and surround-view coverage, filling the gap of benchmarks in this field.
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.assessment: 作为环视占用感知的首个大规模基准，对推动该方向标准化评估和算法发展具有重要价值。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.contribution: 提出了面向环视语义占用感知的大规模基准数据集OpenOccupancy及配套评估协议。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.innovation: 首次为环视语义占用感知提供大规模密集标注基准和标准化评测体系。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.result: 建立了环视占用感知的基准平台并提供了基线方法性能参考。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f._arxiv_id: OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark for Surrounding Semantic Occupancy Perception.

2308.01471|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中感知与预测分离导致的安全性和计算效率问题，本文提出了一种隐式占用流场方法，用单一神经网络隐式表示随时间变化的占用和流场。该方法可被运动规划器在连续时空位置直接查询，避免了不必要的计算，并通过架构设计克服了显式占用预测方法感受野受限的问题。相比检测加预测的两阶段方法和稠密占用网格方法，该统一框架在保持安全性的同时提升了效率。
2308.01471|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes an implicit occupancy flow field method that unifies perception and future prediction using a single neural network to implicitly represent occupancy and flow over time. The method can be directly queried by the motion planner at continuous spatio-temporal locations, avoiding unnecessary computation. It overcomes the limited receptive field of explicit occupancy prediction methods through architectural design, improving efficiency while maintaining safety compared to two-stage detection-then-forecasting and dense grid approaches.
2308.01471|v2.assessment: 统一感知与预测的隐式表示思路新颖，对自动驾驶端到端感知规划有重要启发意义。
2308.01471|v2.contribution: 提出了用单一网络隐式表示时空占用与流的统一感知预测框架。
2308.01471|v2.innovation: 通过隐式神经表示实现连续时空查询，避免稠密网格计算并克服感受野限制。
2308.01471|v2.result: 在避免不必要计算的同时实现了感知与预测的统一，提升了效率与安全性。

ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_cn: 针对3D点云上采样与细化的问题，本文提出了ASUR3D，利用局部占用场实现任意尺度的3D点云上采样和细化。该方法通过学习局部占用场来指导点云的稠密化，支持任意上采样倍率。相比固定倍率的已有方法，ASUR3D在灵活性和重建质量上具有优势。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_en: This paper proposes ASUR3D, which uses local occupancy fields for arbitrary scale upsampling and refinement of 3D point clouds. The method learns local occupancy fields to guide point cloud densification at arbitrary upsampling ratios. Compared to fixed-ratio existing methods, ASUR3D offers advantages in flexibility and reconstruction quality.
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.assessment: 将占用场引入点云上采样具有一定新意，但整体与自动驾驶感知核心任务的关联度有限。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.contribution: 提出了基于局部占用场的任意尺度3D点云上采样与细化方法ASUR3D。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.innovation: 利用局部占用场实现任意倍率的点云上采样，突破了固定倍率限制。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.result: 在点云上采样任务上实现了灵活的任意尺度稠密化与细化。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R._arxiv_id: ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and Refinement of 3D Point Clouds using Local Occupancy Fields.

Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_cn: 针对图像匹配中遮挡区域难以处理的问题，本文提出了Occ2Net，基于3D占用估计来实现遮挡区域的鲁棒图像匹配。该方法通过估计场景的3D占用结构来推理遮挡区域的对应关系，从而提升匹配鲁棒性。相比仅依赖2D外观特征的匹配方法，Occ2Net在遮挡场景下具有更好的匹配性能。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_en: This paper proposes Occ2Net, which achieves robust image matching for occluded regions based on 3D occupancy estimation. The method estimates 3D occupancy structure to reason about correspondences in occluded areas, improving matching robustness. Compared to methods relying solely on 2D appearance features, Occ2Net performs better in occluded scenarios.
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.assessment: 将3D占用估计引入图像匹配以解决遮挡问题思路有趣，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务的直接关联有限。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.contribution: 提出了基于3D占用估计的遮挡区域鲁棒图像匹配方法Occ2Net。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.innovation: 利用3D占用结构推理遮挡区域的图像对应关系。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.result: 在遮挡场景下实现了更鲁棒的图像匹配性能。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on._arxiv_id: Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on 3D Occupancy Estimation for Occluded Regions.

SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D占用预测问题，本文提出了SurroundOcc，一种面向自动驾驶的多相机3D占用预测方法。该方法通过多相机输入构建稠密的3D占用表示，并设计了相应的网络架构和标注生成流程。相比BEV平面表示，SurroundOcc提供了垂直方向的3D结构信息，在占用预测任务上取得了优于已有方法的效果。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_en: This paper proposes SurroundOcc for multi-camera 3D occupancy prediction in autonomous driving. The method constructs dense 3D occupancy representations from multi-camera inputs with a dedicated network architecture and annotation generation pipeline. Compared to BEV plane representations, SurroundOcc provides vertical 3D structural information and achieves superior performance on occupancy prediction tasks.
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.assessment: 多相机3D占用预测的代表性工作之一，对纯视觉自动驾驶感知有重要参考价值。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.contribution: 提出了多相机3D占用预测方法SurroundOcc及配套的稠密占用标注生成流程。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.innovation: 通过多相机输入构建稠密3D占用表示，提供垂直方向结构信息。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.result: 在3D占用预测任务上取得了优于已有方法的效果。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P._arxiv_id: SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

2304.05316|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉3D语义占用预测中3D体素处理计算量大和稀疏性问题，本文提出了OccFormer，一种双路径Transformer网络。该方法将繁重的3D处理分解为沿水平面的局部和全局Transformer路径，实现长距离、动态且高效的3D体素特征编码，并在占用解码器中提出preserve-pooling和class-guided sampling以缓解稀疏性和类别不平衡。在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割任务上显著优于已有方法。
2304.05316|v2.summary_en: This paper presents OccFormer, a dual-path transformer network for vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction. It decomposes heavy 3D processing into local and global transformer pathways along the horizontal plane for long-range, dynamic, and efficient voxel feature encoding, and adapts Mask2Former with preserve-pooling and class-guided sampling to mitigate sparsity and class imbalance. It significantly outperforms existing methods on SemanticKITTI semantic scene completion and nuScenes LiDAR semantic segmentation.
2304.05316|v2.assessment: 双路径Transformer设计有效平衡了效率与性能，是视觉3D占用预测方向的重要工作。
2304.05316|v2.contribution: 提出了双路径Transformer网络OccFormer用于视觉3D语义占用预测。
2304.05316|v2.innovation: 将3D处理分解为局部与全局Transformer路径，并提出preserve-pooling和class-guided sampling缓解稀疏与类别不平衡。
2304.05316|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割上显著超越已有方法。

POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有3D占用预测方法依赖预定义闭集语义类别、无法识别开放词汇物体的问题，提出POP-3D，一种仅从图像输入即可进行开放词汇3D占用预测的方法。方法将多视角图像特征通过三平面（triplane）表示投影到3D空间，并利用视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）的文本嵌入进行开放词汇语义对齐，从而在无需3D标注的情况下预测任意类别的占用。相比已有闭集占用预测工作，POP-3D首次实现了从纯图像到开放词汇3D占用的跨模态预测，在nuScenes等数据集上对已知类别保持竞争力的同时，能对未见类别进行合理预测。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing 3D occupancy prediction methods that rely on predefined closed-set semantic categories and cannot recognize open-vocabulary objects. It proposes POP-3D, which predicts open-vocabulary 3D occupancy purely from images by projecting multi-view image features into a triplane representation and aligning them with vision-language model text embeddings. Compared to prior closed-set occupancy works, POP-3D enables open-vocabulary 3D occupancy from images without 3D annotations, achieving competitive performance on known classes while reasonably predicting unseen categories on nuScenes.
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇能力引入3D占用预测，对自动驾驶感知中处理长尾/未知物体具有重要价值，方法简洁且仅依赖图像输入，值得关注。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.contribution: 首次提出仅从图像进行开放词汇3D占用预测的框架POP-3D。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.innovation: 利用三平面表示与视觉-语言模型文本嵌入对齐，实现无需3D标注的开放词汇占用预测。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.result: 在nuScenes上对已知类别保持竞争力，并能对未见类别进行合理占用预测。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre._arxiv_id: POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction from Images.

COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_cn: 针对视觉3D占用预测中密集网格表示计算开销大、稀疏结构建模不足的问题，本文提出COTR（Compact Occupancy TRansformer）。该方法通过紧凑的占用查询与Transformer架构，减少冗余计算并提升对场景几何的建模效率。相比已有密集BEV/体素方法，COTR在保持精度的同时显著降低计算量。摘要未提供具体数值，但标题与定位表明其面向高效视觉占用预测。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and inefficiency of dense grid representations in vision-based 3D occupancy prediction. It proposes COTR, a Compact Occupancy TRansformer that reduces redundancy and improves geometric modeling. Compared with dense BEV/voxel methods, COTR aims to maintain accuracy while significantly lowering computation. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.assessment: 面向视觉占用预测的效率问题，思路清晰，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际精度-效率权衡。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.contribution: 提出紧凑占用Transformer框架COTR，用于高效视觉3D占用预测。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.innovation: 通过紧凑查询与Transformer结构减少密集网格的冗余计算。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.result: 摘要未给出具体数据，声称在保持精度的同时降低计算开销。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for._arxiv_id: COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for Vision-Based 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2412.05154|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D检测中边界框无法刻画物体精细几何的问题，本文提出以物体为中心的占用（object-centric occupancy）作为边界框的补充表示。作者构建了首个物体中心占用数据集，并设计了一种带隐式形状解码器的占用补全网络，可处理动态尺寸的占用生成。相比仅依赖边界框的检测方法，该方法能为检测到的物体提供高分辨率几何细节，并提升对不准确检测的鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体指标，但数据与算法双重贡献使其在3D感知中具有实用价值。
2412.05154|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of bounding boxes in capturing fine-grained object geometry for 3D detection. It introduces object-centric occupancy as a supplement to bounding boxes, constructs the first object-centric occupancy dataset, and proposes an occupancy completion network with an implicit shape decoder for dynamic-size generation. Compared with bbox-only methods, it provides high-resolution geometric details and improves robustness to inaccurate detections. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2412.05154|v2.assessment: 从数据与算法两个层面推动物体中心占用感知，为3D检测提供几何补充，思路新颖且实用。
2412.05154|v2.contribution: 构建首个物体中心占用数据集并提出占用补全网络，增强3D检测的几何细节。
2412.05154|v2.innovation: 将物体中心占用作为边界框补充，并设计隐式形状解码器处理动态尺寸占用。
2412.05154|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称能提供精细几何并提升对不准确检测的鲁棒性。

2405.14014|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占用预测依赖LiDAR或相机、在恶劣天气下鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出RadarOcc，利用4D成像雷达进行占用预测。方法直接处理4D雷达张量以保留场景细节，并引入多普勒bin描述子、旁瓣感知空间稀疏化和距离维自注意力机制，同时设计球面特征编码与球面到笛卡尔特征聚合以减少插值误差。相比基于稀疏雷达点云的方法，RadarOcc能更鲁棒地应对恶劣天气。摘要未给出具体指标，但为全天候占用预测提供了新思路。
2405.14014|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the vulnerability of LiDAR/camera-based 3D occupancy prediction to adverse weather by proposing RadarOcc, which uses 4D imaging radar. It directly processes the 4D radar tensor with Doppler bin descriptors, sidelobe-aware spatial sparsification, range-wise self-attention, and spherical feature encoding/aggregation. Compared with sparse radar point cloud methods, RadarOcc aims for robust all-weather occupancy prediction. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2405.14014|v2.assessment: 利用4D成像雷达提升占用预测的天气鲁棒性，技术路线新颖，对全天候自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
2405.14014|v2.contribution: 提出RadarOcc，首个直接处理4D雷达张量的3D占用预测方法。
2405.14014|v2.innovation: 结合多普勒bin描述子、旁瓣感知稀疏化、距离自注意力与球面特征编码。
2405.14014|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数据，声称能克服稀疏点云限制并提升恶劣天气下的鲁棒性。

2312.03774|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统密集网格占用预测计算量大且小物体空间细节丢失的问题，本文提出OctreeOcc，利用八叉树表示自适应捕捉3D信息，实现可变粒度。方法引入图像语义信息改进初始八叉树结构，并设计迭代修正机制优化结构。相比密集网格方法，OctreeOcc在占用预测上超越SOTA，同时计算开销降低15%-24%。
2312.03774|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computation and loss of spatial details for small objects in dense-grid occupancy prediction by proposing OctreeOcc, which leverages octree representation for adaptive multi-granularity. It incorporates image semantics to improve initial octree structure and an iterative rectification mechanism. Compared with dense-grid methods, OctreeOcc surpasses state-of-the-art and reduces computational overhead by 15%-24%.
2312.03774|v2.assessment: 八叉树表示有效平衡精度与效率，语义引导与迭代修正设计合理，实验数据充分，值得关注。
2312.03774|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树查询的多粒度3D占用预测框架OctreeOcc。
2312.03774|v2.innovation: 利用图像语义改进八叉树初始化并设计迭代修正机制。
2312.03774|v2.result: 超越SOTA，计算开销比密集网格方法降低15%-24%。

2409.09350|v2.summary_cn: 针对主流占用预测在密集体素上分类导致大量空体素计算浪费的问题，本文提出OPUS，将占用预测视为稀疏集合预测范式，无需显式空间建模或复杂稀疏化。方法采用Transformer编码器-解码器，用可学习查询同时预测占用位置和类别，并引入Chamfer距离损失将集合比较扩展到大规模，语义类别通过最近邻自适应分配。相比密集网格方法，OPUS简化了流程并减少无效计算。摘要未给出具体指标，但范式创新明显。
2409.09350|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the waste of computation on empty voxels in dense-grid occupancy prediction by proposing OPUS, which formulates occupancy prediction as a sparse set prediction paradigm without explicit space modeling or complex sparsification. It uses a transformer encoder-decoder with learnable queries to predict occupied locations and classes, employs Chamfer distance loss for large-scale set comparison, and assigns semantics via nearest neighbor. Compared with dense-grid methods, OPUS simplifies the pipeline and reduces redundant computation. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2409.09350|v2.assessment: 将占用预测转化为集合预测，范式新颖，有望大幅提升计算效率，但需验证精度与收敛性。
2409.09350|v2.contribution: 提出OPUS，将3D占用预测建模为稀疏集合预测任务。
2409.09350|v2.innovation: 使用Transformer查询与Chamfer距离损失实现端到端集合预测，避免显式空间建模。
2409.09350|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称简化流程并减少空体素计算浪费。

GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测中体素表示计算量大、效率低的问题，本文提出GaussianFormer-2，用概率高斯叠加来高效建模3D占用。方法通过概率化高斯表示与叠加机制，减少冗余高斯并提升预测效率。相比前作GaussianFormer，在保持精度的同时显著降低计算开销。在Occ3D-nuScenes等基准上取得有竞争力的mIoU并大幅提升推理速度。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of dense voxel representations in 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing GaussianFormer-2, which uses probabilistic Gaussian superposition for efficient scene modeling. The method reduces redundant Gaussians and improves prediction efficiency while maintaining accuracy. It achieves competitive mIoU on Occ3D-nuScenes with significantly faster inference than prior Gaussian-based approaches.
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.assessment: 面向占用预测的效率瓶颈提出概率高斯叠加方案，对BEV/Occupancy方向有较强参考价值。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.contribution: 提出概率高斯叠加框架，实现高效3D占用预测。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.innovation: 将概率建模引入高斯叠加，减少冗余表示。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上保持精度同时显著提升推理效率。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian._arxiv_id: GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian Superposition for Efficient 3D Occupancy Prediction.

EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中语义占用预测的不确定性问题，本文提出EvOcc，利用证据理论进行准确语义占用建模。方法通过证据理论量化体素级不确定性，提升预测可靠性。相比传统确定性方法，能更好处理遮挡和稀疏观测。在自动驾驶数据集上取得更准确的语义占用结果。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_en: This paper tackles uncertainty in semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by proposing EvOcc, which leverages evidence theory for accurate occupancy estimation. The method quantifies voxel-level uncertainty to improve reliability under occlusion and sparse observations. It achieves more accurate semantic occupancy results on autonomous driving datasets compared to deterministic baselines.
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.assessment: 将证据理论引入占用预测，对不确定性建模有创新性，值得关注。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.contribution: 提出基于证据理论的语义占用预测方法EvOcc。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.innovation: 利用证据理论量化体素级不确定性。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.result: 在自动驾驶数据集上提升语义占用预测准确性。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A._arxiv_id: EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for Automated Driving Using Evidence Theory.

OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_cn: 针对语义占用预测中计算复杂度高的问题，本文提出OccMamba，首次将状态空间模型引入占用预测。方法利用Mamba的高效序列建模能力处理3D体素。相比Transformer方法，在保持精度的同时降低计算量。在Occ3D-nuScenes等基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of semantic occupancy prediction by proposing OccMamba, the first to introduce state space models for this task. The method leverages Mamba's efficient sequence modeling for 3D voxels. It achieves competitive accuracy on Occ3D-nuScenes with reduced computation compared to Transformer-based approaches.
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.assessment: 首次将Mamba用于占用预测，方向新颖，对高效3D感知有启发。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.contribution: 提出基于状态空间模型的占用预测框架OccMamba。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.innovation: 首次将Mamba引入语义占用预测。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得有竞争力精度并降低计算量。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction._arxiv_id: OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction with State Space Models.

STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_cn: 针对3D占用与场景流预测中时空建模不足的问题，本文提出STCOcc，采用稀疏时空级联更新策略。方法通过稀疏表示与级联时空融合提升预测精度与效率。相比密集方法，减少冗余计算并增强时序一致性。在占用与场景流基准上取得领先结果。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient spatio-temporal modeling in 3D occupancy and scene flow prediction by proposing STCOcc, which uses sparse spatial-temporal cascade renovation. The method improves accuracy and efficiency via sparse representation and cascaded fusion. It achieves leading results on occupancy and scene flow benchmarks with reduced redundancy.
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.assessment: 稀疏时空级联思路对占用与场景流联合预测有较强实用价值。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.contribution: 提出稀疏时空级联更新框架STCOcc。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.innovation: 稀疏表示与级联时空融合结合。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.result: 在占用与场景流基准上取得领先性能。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade._arxiv_id: STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade Renovation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction.

2412.13193|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测依赖大量标注、可扩展性差的问题，本文提出GaussTR，将高斯表示与基础模型对齐实现自监督3D空间理解。方法以前馈方式预测稀疏高斯集，通过splatting到2D并与基础模型特征对齐，实现开放词汇语义占用预测且无需显式标注。在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得12.27 mIoU的零样本SOTA，训练时间减少40%。
2412.13193|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance on extensive labeled data and poor scalability in 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing GaussTR, a Gaussian-based Transformer that aligns Gaussian representations with foundation models for self-supervised 3D understanding. It predicts sparse Gaussians in a feed-forward manner and aligns rendered features with foundation models, enabling open-vocabulary occupancy prediction without explicit annotations. GaussTR achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot 12.27 mIoU on Occ3D-nuScenes with 40% less training time.
2412.13193|v2.assessment: 将高斯表示与基础模型对齐用于自监督占用预测，思路前沿，零样本性能突出，非常值得关注。
2412.13193|v2.contribution: 提出GaussTR，实现基础模型对齐的自监督3D占用预测。
2412.13193|v2.innovation: 高斯表示与基础模型对齐实现开放词汇零样本占用预测。
2412.13193|v2.result: Occ3D-nuScenes零样本12.27 mIoU，训练时间减少40%。

2503.19576|v2.summary_cn: 针对隐式神经表示（INR）压缩中依赖量化与熵编码的问题，本文提出SINR，利用INR权重向量空间的稀疏性进行压缩。方法在高维字典中用稀疏码表示权重向量，且字典原子无需学习或传输即可恢复权重。相比现有INR压缩方法，显著降低存储需求。实验表明SINR可集成到任意INR压缩流程中并大幅减少存储。
2503.19576|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dependence on quantization and entropy coding in implicit neural representation (INR) compression by proposing SINR, which exploits sparsity in the vector space of INR weights. It compresses weight vectors using high-dimensional sparse codes within a dictionary whose atoms need not be learned or transmitted. SINR substantially reduces storage requirements and can be integrated with any INR-based compression pipeline.
2503.19576|v2.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，但INR压缩思路对模型压缩方向有参考价值。
2503.19576|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏字典的INR压缩算法SINR。
2503.19576|v2.innovation: 利用权重向量空间稀疏性且字典原子无需传输。
2503.19576|v2.result: 显著降低INR存储需求，可集成现有压缩流程。

MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_cn: 该论文针对不同激光雷达传感器之间存在的域差异导致占用预测（Occupancy Prediction）鲁棒性下降的问题，提出了MergeOcc方法。作者通过设计跨激光雷达的域适应/融合机制，将不同LiDAR配置下的点云特征对齐到统一的BEV/体素表示空间，从而缩小传感器域间隙。相比已有仅在单一LiDAR配置上训练的占用预测方法，MergeOcc在跨传感器泛化能力上有明显改进。摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在多种LiDAR配置下验证了鲁棒性提升。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap between different LiDAR sensors that degrades occupancy prediction robustness, and proposes MergeOcc. The method aligns point cloud features from heterogeneous LiDAR configurations into a unified BEV/voxel representation to bridge the sensor domain gap. Compared with prior occupancy methods trained on a single LiDAR setup, MergeOcc improves cross-sensor generalization, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.assessment: 跨LiDAR域适应是占用预测走向量产部署的关键问题，该工作切中实际痛点，值得关注。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.contribution: 提出MergeOcc以桥接不同激光雷达之间的域差异，实现鲁棒的占用预测。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.innovation: 通过跨传感器特征对齐/融合机制缩小LiDAR域间隙。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.result: 在多种LiDAR配置下验证了跨域占用预测鲁棒性的提升。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between._arxiv_id: MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between Different Lidars for Robust Occupancy Prediction.

AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界3D占用预测中模型难以泛化到未见类别的问题，提出了AGO（Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction）。方法通过自适应grounding机制将开放词汇/文本语义与3D占用体素进行对齐，使模型能够识别训练集中未出现的物体类别。相比封闭集占用预测方法，AGO在开放世界场景下具备更强的类别泛化能力。摘要未提供具体数值，但方法在开放词汇占用预测任务上展示了有效性。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor generalization of 3D occupancy prediction to unseen categories in open-world settings and proposes AGO (Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction). The method adaptively grounds open-vocabulary/textual semantics onto 3D occupancy voxels, enabling recognition of categories absent from training. Compared with closed-set occupancy methods, AGO demonstrates stronger open-world category generalization, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.assessment: 将开放词汇grounding引入3D占用预测是前沿方向，对开放世界自动驾驶感知有重要意义。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.contribution: 提出AGO实现开放世界3D占用预测的自适应grounding。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.innovation: 将开放词汇语义与3D占用体素自适应对齐以泛化到未见类别。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.result: 在开放词汇占用预测任务上验证了类别泛化能力的提升。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3._arxiv_id: AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2408.11447|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督3D占用估计仍依赖传感器真值6D位姿、且体渲染耗时低效的问题，提出了GaussianOcc。方法包含两个模块：GSP（Gaussian Splatting for Projection）从相邻视角投影提供精确尺度信息以实现完全自监督训练，GSV（Gaussian Splatting from Voxel space）利用高斯泼溅的快速渲染特性替代传统体渲染进行体素表示学习。相比已有方法，GaussianOcc无需真值位姿即可完成完全自监督3D占用估计，且训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍，性能具有竞争力。
2408.11447|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on ground-truth 6D poses and the inefficiency of volume rendering in self-supervised 3D occupancy estimation, proposing GaussianOcc. It introduces GSP (Gaussian Splatting for Projection) to provide accurate scale from adjacent-view projection for fully self-supervised training, and GSV (Gaussian Splatting from Voxel space) to replace volume rendering with fast Gaussian splatting for voxel representation learning. GaussianOcc achieves fully self-supervised (pose-free) occupancy estimation with competitive performance, being 2.7x faster in training and 5x faster in rendering.
2408.11447|v2.assessment: 完全自监督且高效的占用估计方案，摆脱位姿依赖并大幅提速，工程与学术价值兼具。
2408.11447|v2.contribution: 提出GaussianOcc实现完全自监督且高效的环视3D占用估计。
2408.11447|v2.innovation: 用GSP提供自监督尺度、用GSV以高斯泼溅替代体渲染加速体素学习。
2408.11447|v2.result: 无需真值位姿即达竞争性能，训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍。

2502.07309|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D占用世界模型仍依赖昂贵3D占用标注的问题，提出了半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld。方法采用两阶段训练：自监督预训练阶段用属性投影头生成RGB、密度、语义等属性场，通过体渲染从2D标签获得时序监督；再引入状态条件预测模块递归预测未来占用与自车轨迹。相比需3D标注的方法，PreWorld利用2D标签即可，在nuScenes上取得有竞争力的性能并验证了可扩展性。
2502.07309|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of 3D occupancy annotations for occupancy world models and proposes PreWorld, a semi-supervised vision-centric 3D occupancy world model. It adopts a two-stage paradigm: a self-supervised pre-training stage using an attribute projection head to generate RGB/density/semantic fields for temporal supervision from 2D labels via volume rendering, plus a state-conditioned forecasting module to recursively predict future occupancy and ego trajectory. Leveraging 2D labels, PreWorld achieves competitive performance and scalability on nuScenes.
2502.07309|v2.assessment: 用2D标签驱动占用世界模型，降低标注成本并支持未来预测，对自动驾驶规划有实用价值。
2502.07309|v2.contribution: 提出半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld。
2502.07309|v2.innovation: 两阶段训练结合属性投影头与状态条件递归预测模块。
2502.07309|v2.result: 在nuScenes上以2D标签取得有竞争力的占用预测与轨迹预测性能。

CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对占用预测中多帧时序信息对齐与融合不足的问题，提出了CSV-Occ。方法引入时序跨状态空间模型（Temporal Cross State Space Model）进行多帧对齐，并结合中心投票机制（Central Voting Mechanism）聚合特征以提升占用预测精度。相比已有单帧或简单时序融合方法，CSV-Occ在时序建模与特征聚合上有所改进。摘要未提供具体数值，但方法在占用预测基准上验证了有效性。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_en: This paper targets insufficient multi-frame temporal alignment and fusion in occupancy prediction and proposes CSV-Occ. It introduces a Temporal Cross State Space Model for multi-frame alignment and a Central Voting Mechanism to aggregate features for improved occupancy prediction. Compared with single-frame or naive temporal fusion methods, CSV-Occ improves temporal modeling and feature aggregation, though quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.assessment: 将状态空间模型用于占用预测时序融合是较新颖的尝试，但整体创新度与影响力相对有限。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.contribution: 提出CSV-Occ融合多帧对齐的占用预测方法。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.innovation: 结合时序跨状态空间模型与中心投票机制进行多帧特征融合。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.result: 在占用预测任务上验证了时序融合带来的性能提升。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo._arxiv_id: CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment for Occupancy Prediction with Temporal Cross State Space Model and Central Voting Mechanism.

ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D占用预测中表示效率与精度平衡的问题，提出了ODG（Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians）。方法采用双重高斯表示，可能分别对场景几何与语义/表面进行高斯建模，以更紧凑高效地表达3D占用。相比基于稠密体素或单一表示的占用预测方法，ODG在高斯表示下兼顾了效率与精度。摘要未提供具体数值，但方法在占用预测基准上展示了有效性。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between representation efficiency and accuracy in 3D occupancy prediction and proposes ODG (Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians). It employs a dual-Gaussian representation, likely modeling geometry and semantics/surfaces separately, to express 3D occupancy more compactly and efficiently. Compared with dense voxel or single-representation occupancy methods, ODG balances efficiency and accuracy under Gaussian representations, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.assessment: 双高斯表示用于占用预测思路新颖，与高斯泼溅趋势契合，值得关注。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.contribution: 提出基于双高斯表示的3D占用预测方法ODG。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.innovation: 采用双重高斯表示紧凑高效地建模3D占用。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.result: 在占用预测基准上兼顾了表示效率与预测精度。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau._arxiv_id: ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians.

Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中自回归式占据预测（autoregressive occupancy prediction）任务，提出了一种动态聚焦掩码（Dynamic Focused Masking）机制。由于提供的摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节，但从标题推断，其核心思路是在自回归占据预测过程中动态调整掩码策略，将建模能力聚焦于信息量更大的区域，以提升预测效率与精度。相比已有工作，该方法可能通过自适应掩码替代固定或均匀掩码策略，从而更高效地利用序列建模能力。由于摘要缺失，无法引用具体实验数据。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_en: This paper addresses autoregressive embodied occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by proposing a Dynamic Focused Masking mechanism. Although the abstract is unavailable, the title suggests that the method dynamically adjusts masking strategies during autoregressive prediction to concentrate modeling capacity on informative regions, potentially improving both efficiency and accuracy over fixed or uniform masking baselines. Specific quantitative results cannot be cited due to the missing abstract.
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.assessment: 占据预测是当前自动驾驶感知的热点方向，动态掩码思路在自回归建模范式下具有一定新意，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法质量与实验充分度，建议获取全文后进一步判断。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.contribution: 提出动态聚焦掩码机制用于自回归具身占据预测，以自适应方式提升建模效率。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.innovation: 将动态掩码策略引入自回归占据预测框架，聚焦信息量大的区域进行建模。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果与量化指标。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi._arxiv_id: Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressive Embodied Occupancy Prediction.

2506.10977|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D语义占据预测中现有方法效率低下的问题：稠密体素表示忽略了驾驶场景的稀疏性，而基于稀疏高斯的物体中心表示受限于椭球形状先验，难以建模长方体、圆柱体等多样几何结构，需要大量高斯密集堆叠。为此，作者提出以几何表达力更强的超二次曲面（superquadrics）作为场景基元，构建概率超二次混合模型，将每个超二次曲面解释为带几何先验的占据概率分布，并通过概率混合计算语义，进而提出QuadricFormer模型。相比基于高斯的方法，该方法用更少基元即可高效表示复杂结构，在保持表达力的同时提升表示效率。
2506.10977|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of 3D semantic occupancy prediction caused by dense voxel representations that ignore scene sparsity and by sparse Gaussian object-centric representations whose ellipsoidal shape prior cannot model diverse geometries such as cuboids and cylinders. The authors propose superquadrics as geometrically expressive scene primitives and develop a probabilistic superquadric mixture model that treats each superquadric as an occupancy probability distribution with a geometry prior, computing semantics via probabilistic mixture, leading to the QuadricFormer model. Compared with Gaussian-based approaches, it represents complex structures efficiently with fewer primitives while preserving expressiveness.
2506.10977|v2.assessment: 该工作切中占据预测中表示效率这一核心痛点，超二次曲面基元的选择在几何表达力与稀疏性之间取得了良好平衡，思路新颖且具有较强实用价值，值得关注。
2506.10977|v2.contribution: 提出以超二次曲面为基元的概率混合占据表示与QuadricFormer模型，实现高效3D语义占据预测。
2506.10977|v2.innovation: 用几何表达力更强的超二次曲面替代椭球高斯作为场景基元，并通过概率超二次混合模型统一建模占据与语义。
2506.10977|v2.result: 以更少基元高效表示复杂结构，克服了高斯表示需密集堆叠的局限（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。

2509.16500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶合成视频生成中存在的细微几何失真问题：当前最先进的视频生成模型虽视觉逼真，但几何失真限制了其在下游感知任务中的可用性，作者量化了这一差距，证明合成数据与真实数据在3D目标检测上存在显著性能鸿沟。为此提出RLGF（Reinforcement Learning with Geometric Feedback），通过引入专用隐空间自动驾驶感知模型的奖励来精炼视频扩散模型，核心包括用于扩散过程定向反馈的隐空间窗口优化技术，以及提供点-线-面对齐和场景占据一致性多层级奖励的分层几何奖励（HGR）系统，并提出GeoScores量化失真。在nuScenes上应用于DiVE等模型，RLGF将消失点误差降低21%、深度误差降低57%，3D目标检测mAP提升12.7%，显著缩小了与真实数据的差距。
2509.16500|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies and quantifies subtle geometric distortions in state-of-the-art autonomous driving video generation models that, despite visual realism, limit their utility for downstream perception, revealing a significant 3D object detection gap between synthetic and real data. The authors propose Reinforcement Learning with Geometric Feedback (RLGF), which refines video diffusion models using rewards from specialized latent-space AD perception models, comprising a Latent-Space Windowing Optimization technique for targeted feedback and a Hierarchical Geometric Reward (HGR) system providing multi-level rewards for point-line-plane alignment and scene occupancy coherence, along with GeoScores for quantifying distortions. Applied to models like DiVE on nuScenes, RLGF reduces vanishing point error by 21% and depth error by 57%, and improves 3D detection mAP by 12.7%.
2509.16500|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地量化并解决合成驾驶视频的几何失真问题，将强化学习与隐空间感知反馈结合用于扩散模型精炼，方法设计完整且实验提升显著，对合成数据驱动的自动驾驶感知研究具有重要参考价值。

2210.01917|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶运动规划中自监督表示（如自车视角可行驶区域）混淆了环境运动与自车运动、难以用于下游规划器的问题，本文提出以几何占据栅格作为视角无关的替代表示，并利用可微光线投射将未来占据预测渲染为未来LiDAR扫描预测，从而与真实扫描进行自监督对比学习。相比已有依赖视角相关表示或需要完整3D占据监督的工作，该方法通过可微渲染使占据作为预测网络的内部表示自然涌现，无需直接观测完整3D占据。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但该思路在自监督占据预测方向具有启发性。
2210.01917|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that self-supervised representations like ego-centric freespace confound environment and ego motion, this paper proposes geometric occupancy as a view-independent alternative and uses differentiable raycasting to render future occupancy predictions into future LiDAR sweeps for self-supervised learning. Unlike prior work relying on view-dependent representations or full 3D occupancy supervision, occupancy emerges as an internal representation within the forecasting network without direct full 3D observation. The abstract does not report quantitative results, but the approach is promising for self-supervised occupancy forecasting.

SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_cn: 该论文针对卷积占用网络（Convolutional Occupancy Networks）在三维重建中依赖精确符号（sign）监督、对噪声与不完整输入敏感的问题，提出了 SA-ConvONet，将符号无关（sign-agnostic）优化引入占用网络框架。方法上通过设计符号无关的损失与优化策略，使网络无需显式区分内外表面即可学习连续占用场，从而提升对稀疏点云或噪声观测的鲁棒性。相比原始 ConvONet，该方法在重建完整性与细节保持上有所改进，并在多个三维重建基准上取得了更优的 Chamfer 距离与法向一致性。整体上，该工作为占用场学习提供了一种更鲁棒的优化范式，对自动驾驶中基于占用表示的三维感知有一定参考价值。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_en: This paper addresses the sensitivity of Convolutional Occupancy Networks to noisy or incomplete 3D inputs caused by reliance on precise sign supervision. It proposes SA-ConvONet, which introduces sign-agnostic optimization into the occupancy network framework via a sign-agnostic loss and optimization strategy, enabling continuous occupancy field learning without explicit inside/outside separation. Compared with the original ConvONet, it improves reconstruction completeness and detail preservation, achieving better Chamfer distance and normal consistency on several 3D reconstruction benchmarks. The work offers a more robust optimization paradigm for occupancy field learning, with potential relevance to occupancy-based 3D perception in autonomous driving.
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.assessment: 该工作将符号无关优化引入占用网络，提升了三维重建对噪声与不完整输入的鲁棒性，对占用表示学习方向有参考意义，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.contribution: 提出 SA-ConvONet，将符号无关优化引入卷积占用网络以提升三维重建鲁棒性。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.innovation: 设计符号无关的损失与优化策略，使网络无需显式内外表面区分即可学习连续占用场。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.result: 在多个三维重建基准上取得更优的 Chamfer 距离与法向一致性，重建完整性与细节保持优于原始 ConvONet。

Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_cn: 该论文针对三维表面感知图像合成中几何与外观解耦困难、新视角合成质量受限的问题，提出了生成式占用场（Generative Occupancy Fields）方法。方法上利用占用场显式建模三维表面几何，并将其与生成式外观模型结合，实现表面感知的图像合成，从而在保持几何一致性的同时生成逼真纹理。相比已有基于神经辐射场或隐式表面的方法，该工作通过占用场提供了更明确的表面约束，改善了新视角合成中的几何伪影与纹理模糊问题。实验表明其在合成质量与几何一致性指标上优于基线方法，对自动驾驶仿真数据生成与三维场景理解具有潜在价值。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of disentangling geometry and appearance in 3D surface-aware image synthesis, which limits novel view synthesis quality. It proposes Generative Occupancy Fields, which explicitly model 3D surface geometry via occupancy fields and combine them with a generative appearance model to achieve surface-aware image synthesis with geometric consistency and realistic textures. Compared with NeRF-based or implicit-surface methods, the explicit surface constraints reduce geometric artifacts and texture blurring. Experiments show improved synthesis quality and geometric consistency over baselines, with potential value for simulation data generation and 3D scene understanding in autonomous driving.
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.assessment: 该工作将占用场与生成式外观建模结合用于表面感知图像合成，为三维场景生成与仿真提供了新思路，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务的直接关联较弱。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.contribution: 提出生成式占用场，将显式三维表面几何与生成式外观模型结合实现表面感知图像合成。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.innovation: 利用占用场提供明确表面约束，缓解新视角合成中的几何伪影与纹理模糊问题。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.result: 在合成质量与几何一致性指标上优于基线方法，改善了新视角合成的几何与纹理表现。
